works.d: Hiiumaa rahvariides seisev naine seljaga vaataja poole. Peas kõrge peakate, seotud pealinast. Kukalt katab punane riideosa. Seljas must pikk-kuub ja must seelik.
works.de: A woman in Hiiumaa folk costume standing with her back to the viewer. On her head a tall headdress, tied from linen. The back of the head is covered with a red piece of cloth. Wearing a black long coat and a black skirt.

works.d: Esiplaani künklik maastik, mille keskosas põõsaid ja puusalu, areneb tagaplaanil paremal kaugelt paistvaks mäeahelikuks. Ees vasakul tahutud kivilahmakaid. Tõusva päikese laialipaiskuv kiirtevihk katkeb vasakul etteulatuva halli pilverünka tõttu.
works.de: A hilly landscape in the foreground, with bushes and a grove of trees in the middle section, developing into a distant mountain range visible on the right in the background. In front on the left, hewn boulders. The spreading beam of the rising sun's rays is interrupted on the left by a jutting grey cloud mass.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Kõrge laup läheb üle juusteta lagipeaks, mis külgedelt ja tagant piiratud kõrvuni ulatuvate ühtlases joones kärbitud juustega. Nägu piirab kitsas põskhabe. Kehakatteks punase nöörkaunistusega mulgi vammus.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man in three-quarter profile to the right. A high forehead merges into a hairless crown, bordered on the sides and back by evenly trimmed hair reaching to the ears. The face is bordered by a narrow side-whisker. Clothing consists of a Mulgi jacket with red cord trimming.

works.d: Esiplaanil vahutavaid laineid, mille harjad koondunud vesineitside ja vesiratsude kujudeks. Lainetest kerkib keskel järsk kaljutipp, laskuv kaldajärsakuna pildi parema ääreni. Kaljult alasti naine pikkade blondide juuste lehvides vette laskumas, kuhu on juba käest kukkunud lüüra. Paremal, kaldajärsakul, rühm munki tõrvikute valguses, krutsifikside ja viirukianumatega. Vanim neist tõstab Lorelei suunas risti. Paremal äärel üks munk laintesse vajunud, vesineitsi embuses.
works.de: In the foreground, foaming waves whose crests have gathered into the shapes of water nymphs and water-horses. From the waves rises in the middle a steep cliff peak, descending as a coastal cliff to the right edge of the picture. From the cliff, a naked woman with long blond hair fluttering is descending into the water, where a lyre has already fallen from her hand. On the right, on the cliff face, a group of monks in torchlight, with crucifixes and incense vessels. The oldest of them raises a cross towards Lorelei. At the right edge, one monk has sunk into the waves, in the embrace of a water nymph.

works.d: Pildil taluõu. Esiplaanil paremal rebane kanaga suus. Keskel vasakul õlgkatusega ja aknalaudadega suitsutare, mille lävel inimene. Suitsutarest paremal väike hoone ja salvkaev. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: The picture shows a farmyard. In the foreground on the right a fox with a hen in its mouth. In the centre left a smoke sauna with a thatched roof and window sills, with a person at its threshold. To the right of the smoke sauna a small building and a draw-well. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal oja, vana vesiratas ja rippuvate okstega puu. Taga lagunenud hoone. Vasakul kaljud.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a stream, an old water wheel and a tree with hanging branches. Behind, a dilapidated building. On the left, cliffs.

works.d: Vana mehe rinnapilt veerandprofiilis vasakule. Juustel ja pisut allapoole kõrvalesta ulatuval lühikesel põskhabemel halli vinet. Riietuseks lahtinööbitud pintsakuga must ülikond. Ümber valge "Vatermorder" tüüpi krae.
works.de: Bust of an old man in quarter profile facing left. Grey vignette on the hair and on the short side-whiskers reaching slightly below the earlobe. Dressed in a black suit with unbuttoned jacket. A white "Vatermorder" type collar around the neck.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt, peapöördega poolprofiilis paremale. Pruunid juuksed kõrva vabaks jätvaks soenguks kammitud, seda kaunistavad lilled. Helesinisel siidkleidil valge plisseeritud tüllkaelus, millele lisanduvad pärltikandid ja pitskaunistused. Kaelaehteks neljakandiliselt ümber kaela keeratud ja pikalt rinnale ulatuv pärlikee.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, head turned in a semi-profile to the right. Brown hair styled to leave the ear free, adorned with flowers. On the light blue silk dress a white pleated tulle collar, complemented by pearl embroidery and lace decorations. As a necklace, a pearl necklace wound four times around the neck and reaching far down onto the chest.

works.d: Interjöör muusikastseeniga. Paremal äärel külgvaates pianiino, mille ees istuv triibulises kleidis daam jälgib oma klaverimängu mõju vasakul, punases tugitoolis istuvale tumedajuukselisele tütarlapsele.
works.de: An interior with a music scene. On the right edge, seen from the side, a piano, in front of which a lady in a striped dress sits, observing the effect of her piano playing on a dark-haired girl sitting on the left in a red armchair.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt peapöördega poolprofiilis paremale. Tumedad juuksed sätitud soengusse, mis jätab vabaks kõrvarõngaga kõrva. Sügavalt dekolteeritud valge pitskleit.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with her head turned in half-profile to the right. Dark hair arranged in a hairstyle that leaves visible an ear with an earring. Deeply décolleté white lace dress.

works.de: Standing nude figure of a young man, resting on his right leg, left leg bent at the knee. Left hand raised upward, right hand holding a torch down at the side. Behind the male figure a bundle of bound brushwood and an ancient Roman-style urn with blazing fire. The sculpture stands on a round base.

works.de: Standing nude figure of a young woman, resting on her left leg, right leg bent at the knee, right arm raised and bent over her head holding a globeflower, left arm lowered to the side holding an extinguished torch, beneath the torch an ancient Roman-style empty urn. The figure stands on a round base.

Figure of a young man sits at the feet of the woman's figure, head on her knees, dagger in sheath on his right side.

works.de: Bust portrait of a décolleté lady, lace edging on the décolletage, diadem in the hair. Bust pedestal polished, profiled.

works.d: Mapi esikaanel Kristjan Raua autogramm ja reproduktsioon "Magav Kalevipoeg". Mapis reproduktsioonidega koos hallist kartongist leht inglisekeelse tekstiga Kristjan Raud (21. X 1865 - 19. V 1943) ja ülevaade kunstnik K. Raua elust ja loomingust, autor Juta Kivimäe, foto: Kristjan Raud oma aias Nõmmel. Lehe pöördel inglisekeelne nimekiri 12 reproduktsioonist. Reproduktsioonid 12-l kriitpaberist lehel.(eesti)
works.de: On the front cover of the folder Kristjan Raud's autograph and a reproduction "Magav Kalevipoeg" [Sleeping Kalevipoeg]. In the folder, together with the reproductions, a grey cardboard sheet with English text Kristjan Raud (21 X 1865 - 19 V 1943) and an overview of the life and work of the artist K. Raud, author Juta Kivimäe, photo: Kristjan Raud in his garden in Nõmme. On the verso of the sheet an English-language list of 12 reproductions. Reproductions on 12 sheets of chalk paper.

works.d: Esiplaanil järskude mäekülgede vahel org üksikute majadega. Vasemal taga teravaid mäetippe.
works.de: In the foreground, a valley between steep mountainsides with individual houses. In the back on the left, sharp mountain peaks.

works.d: Tugitoolil istuva mustajuukselise naise põlvportree. Nägu otsevaates, silmad suunatud paremale, keha kerge pöördega paremale, käed rüppes.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a dark-haired woman seated in an armchair. Face in frontal view, eyes directed to the right, body slightly turned to the right, hands in the lap.

works.d: Ees keskel veeloik kahe kase ja kuusega. Paremal liivakaldal mänd. Tagapool kuppel mäestik üksikute puudega.
Jalgadel istuva tüdruku täisportree. Tütarlapse parem käsi asetatud ta kõrval olevale tamburiinile. Ees paremal kollane savikann.
works.de: Full-length portrait of a girl sitting on her legs. The girl's right hand is placed on a tambourine beside her. In front on the right a yellow clay jug.

works.d: Esiplaanil suurte kivide vahel puud, taamal veekogu. Horisondil punased pilvad.
works.de: Trees between large stones in the foreground, a body of water in the distance. Red clouds on the horizon.

works.d: Naise põlvportree külgvaates vasakult. Vasak käsi toetub istme korjule. Valge plussi rinda kinnitatud lõhe värvi roos. Valge peakate lõua alt kinnistatud samet paelaga.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman in left profile. The left hand rests on the seat's frame. A pink rose fastened to the chest of a white blouse. A white headdress fastened under the chin with a velvet ribbon.

works.d: Esiplaanil kurruline maastik suurte kivide ja rändrahnudega. Taamal maja ja metsa kontuur.
works.de: In the foreground a rugged landscape with large stones and boulders. In the distance a house and the outline of a forest.

works.d: Ees paremal eest taha mäkke suunduva tee ääres telefonipostide rida. Vasakul üle oru sild ja teelahk. Taga vasakul (ülal mäe künkal) punane gooti stiilis kirik - keskel ja paremal majad.
works.de: In the front on the right, along a road leading from the foreground into the hill, a row of telephone poles. On the left a bridge over a valley and a fork in the road. In the back on the left (up on a hillock) a red Gothic-style church - in the centre and on the right houses.

works.d: Esialal sügavusse suunduv tänav puudereaga kummalgi pool, mis suubub võlvkäiku. Selle taga hoonete rühmi järsult tõusva mäe jalal ja nõlvakul. Taevas sünkjas.
works.de: In the foreground a street receding into the depth with a row of trees on either side, opening into a vaulted passage. Behind it groups of buildings at the foot and on the slope of a steeply rising mountain. The sky is dusky.

works.d: Valge rüüžiga pluusi riietatud naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Parema kõrva kohal juustes punane roos.
works.de: Chest portrait of a woman dressed in a blouse with white ruche, in half-profile to the right. A red rose in the hair above the right ear.

works.d: Püstiseisva noore daami põlvportree. Üle parema õla sall, millest kinni hoiavad rinnale toetuv parem ja vabalt alla rippuv vasak käsi.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a standing young lady. A shawl over the right shoulder, held by the right hand resting on the chest and the left hand hanging freely down.

works.d: Pikkade, rinnale langevate juustega, murumütsis mehe figuur koobastikus. Mehel seljas pikk pükste peale tõmmatud särk, jalas pastlad. Vasakus, ülestõstetud käes kelluke. Mehe ees, vasakul, maas hiireke.
works.de: A figure of a man with long hair falling to his chest, wearing a grass cap, in a cave system. The man wears a long shirt pulled over his trousers, and bast shoes on his feet. In his raised left hand a bell. In front of the man, on the left, a little mouse on the ground.

works.d: Veekogu keskel suur kivi. Sellel lamav naisakt, käed laiali, tagaplaanil vees kivid.
works.de: A large rock in the middle of a body of water. On it a reclining female nude, arms spread, rocks in the water in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand laudu kandva tugeva mehe kujuga. Tagaplaanil lainetav veteväli.
works.de: In the foreground a stony shore with the figure of a strong man carrying boards. In the background a wavy expanse of water.

works.d: Kühmulisel maastikul vasakult paremale sammuva naise kuju kiviga süles. Tagaplaanil üle laia veepinna silmapiirile laskuv päike ehatamas.
works.de: In a hilly landscape, the figure of a woman walking from left to right with a stone in her lap. In the background, the sun setting in the evening glow over a wide expanse of water.

works.d: Fantastiline kompositsioon naise ja mehe figuuridega.
works.de: Fantastical composition with figures of a woman and a man.

works.d: Keskel "Linda Libeneitsi": reel istuv talumees, rahvarõivais tütarlapsega põlvedel.
works.de: In the middle "Linda Libeneits": a farmer sitting on a sledge with a girl in folk costume on his knees.

works.d: Pildi keskel neli üksteise embuses kiires tantsuhoos keerlevat paari. Meesfiguurid tumesinistes ülikondades, naised pikkades kollakas-pruunides kleitides, mille voldistik sulab kokku pruunikates toonides fooniga.
works.de: In the centre of the picture, four couples embracing one another, whirling in a swift dance. The male figures in dark blue suits, the women in long yellowish-brown dresses, whose folds merge with the background in brownish tones.

works.d: Triibulises rahvariideseelikus, punases vestis ja valges pluusis istuv tütarlaps. Pikad punakad juuksed langevad õlgadele, sirge profiil ja selgepiiriline suujoon, pilk langetatud. Tütarlapse käes raamat, selg toetub rohelisele seljatoele. Foon kollakas-rohelistes toonides, käed antud skemaatiliselt, visandlikku joont rõhutades.
works.de: A girl sitting in a striped folk costume skirt, red vest and white blouse. Long reddish hair falls onto her shoulders, straight profile and clearly defined mouth line, gaze lowered. The girl holds a book in her hands, her back resting against a green backrest. The background is in yellowish-green tones, the hands rendered schematically, emphasizing the sketchy line.

works.d: Roigasaed, taga erkroheline rohumaa, mille ääres madal, õlgkatusega talumaja. Katuse kohal, paremal puude kirevad lehekroonid.
works.de: A picket fence, behind it bright green grassland, at its edge a low farmhouse with a thatched roof. Above the roof, on the right, the colourful crowns of trees.

works.d: Haritorniga kirikuhoone, samas juures kasvavate suurte puude ning madala kiviaiaga. All vasakus servas teeb väikese kaare kiriku juurde viiv tee. Koloriidis ülekaalus sinised värvivarjundid.
works.de: A church building with a bell tower, with large trees growing beside it and a low stone wall. In the lower left corner the road leading to the church makes a small curve. Blue colour shades predominate.

works.d: Keskel sinises rõivastuses istuv mehefiguur (Kalevipoeg), ümber vasaku käsivarre ussikujuline võru. Vasakul odaga mees, asetamas istujale pähe murumütsi taolist peakatet. Paremal mehefiguur saunakibu ja vihaga. Taustaks talumaja. Koloriit tume; kontuurid rõhutatud.
works.de: In the centre a seated male figure dressed in blue (Kalevipoeg), a snake-shaped ring around his left forearm. On the left a man with a spear, placing a grass-cap-like headgear on the seated figure's head. On the right a male figure with a bathhouse whisk and switch. Background a farmhouse. Colouring dark; contours emphasised.

works.d: Paremal ettepoole sammuv sõdalaste malev. Meestel vasakus käes peremärke kandvad kilbid, paremas odad (eessammuval figuuril paljastatud mõõk). Tagaplaanil, künkal linnus. All punane tekstiriba: MAAMEESTE MALEWA, mille alguses ning lõpus kirve kujutised. Koloriit tume; kontuurid rõhutatud.
works.de: A troop of warriors marching forward to the right. The men hold shields bearing family marks in their left hands, and spears in their right (the leading figure has a bared sword). In the background, a fortress on a hill. Below, a red text band: MAAMEESTE MALEWA, with images of axes at its beginning and end. The colour scheme is dark; the contours are emphasised.

works.d: Punasel foonil ringis neli embavat paari. Esiplaanil, vasakpoolse paari meesfiguuril peaks kolp; naise nägu kätega kaetud.
works.de: Four embracing couples in a circle on a red background. In the foreground, the male figure of the left couple has a skull for a head; the woman's face is covered with her hands.

works.d: Mere kaldal valges särgis ning tumesinistes lühikestes pükstes peapeal seisev mees. Ümber parema käsivarre ussikujuline võru. Mere kohal lendamas kajakad. All servas keskel kitsal punasel ribal tekst: Kalevipoeg.II.714-727
works.de: On the seashore, a man in a white shirt and dark-blue short trousers standing on his head. Around his right arm a snake-shaped bracelet. Gulls flying above the sea. At the bottom edge, in the centre, on a narrow red strip, the text: Kalevipoeg.II.714-727

works.d: Sammaldunud rookatusega ait. Selle avatud ukse juures, räästa all paremal suur riidekirst; vasakul punane tekk jmt. Paremal, aida taga puud.
works.de: Mossy thatched-roof barn. By its open door, under the eaves on the right a large clothing chest; on the left a red blanket etc. On the right, behind the barn, trees.

works.t: a) Lamav akt b) Kalev kotka seljas
works.d: Laineid meenutaval sinisel taustal keskel horisontaalselt paigutatud selili lamav naisakt. Pea pööratud küljele, vaatajale, pilk suunatud alla. Vasaku kõverdatud käsi kuklal, parem sirutatult küljel õlakõrgusel. Vasak jalg tõstetud üle parema. Akt maalitud beežikashallides toonides tumeda kontuuriga väliseid piirjooni rõhutades.
works.de: On a blue background reminiscent of waves, a female nude lying on her back is placed horizontally in the middle. Head turned to the side, towards the viewer, gaze directed downward. Left bent arm behind the head, right stretched out at the side at shoulder height. Left leg raised over the right. The nude is painted in beigish-grey tones with a dark contour emphasizing the outer outlines.

works.de: In the foreground on the right a street, on the left gardens, behind tall trees and houses.

works.d: Ees vasakul ja keskel veekogu. PAremal ja tagapool vasakul kõrgenev kallas metsaga.
works.de: In front on the left and in the middle a body of water. On the right and further back on the left, a rising bank with forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi, paremal kallas. Avar vaade kaugusesse üksikute saartega keset vett. Esiplaanil puude peegeldus.
works.de: In the foreground water, on the right a shore. A wide view into the distance with individual islands in the middle of the water. In the foreground a reflection of trees.

works.d: Vasakul klaver, sellel valge lapseskulptuur. Paremal laud, sellel suurem amforakujuline vaas pajuurbadega ja madal punane vaas suure kollase õiega.
works.de: On the left a piano, on it a white child sculpture. On the right a table, on it a larger amphora-shaped vase with pussy willow twigs and a low red vase with a large yellow flower.

works.d: Pruunil laual kipsist naise figuur, kann lilledega, rull sinist paberit ja pudel ning valge riie.
works.de: On a brown table a plaster figure of a woman, a jug with flowers, a roll of blue paper and a bottle, and a white cloth.

works.d: Esiplaanil kevadine jõgi, paremal, jääpankade vahel tume paat, tagapool kaarsild. Teiselpool kaldal kaks paati, kaugemal raagus puude rida, mitmekorruselised majad. Maalitud heledates toonides, kohati akvarellilkult õhuliselt.
works.de: In the foreground a spring river, on the right, among ice floes a dark boat, behind it an arched bridge. On the other side of the bank two boats, further off a row of bare trees, multi-storey houses. Painted in light tones, at places airily, in a watercolour-like manner.

works.d: Suvine vaade heledale kivisillale, ülal pruunikate käsipuude sõrestik. Silla all tumesinine veetriip. Tagapool, kaare alt paistab heleroheliste puude ja põõsastega kaetud nõlvak. Maalitud pastelsetes valkjasbeežides, rohekais toonides, üksikute tumedate kontuuridega, lühikese pintslilöögiga.
works.de: A summer view of a light-coloured stone bridge, above a lattice of brownish handrails. Under the bridge a dark blue strip of water. Beyond, through the arch, a slope covered with light green trees and bushes is visible. Painted in pastel, whitish-beige, greenish tones, with a few dark contours, in short brushstrokes.

works.d: Mustal foonil valges peakattes vana naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes vasakule. käed süles. Tumedad silmad suunatud otse enda ette, suu triibuna kokku pigistatud. Naisel seljas sinine nööbitav jakk, mille alt paistab valge kaelus. Maalitud laiema pintsliga, näo osas sujuvalt vormides.
works.de: On a black background, a half-figure of an old woman in a white headdress, in a three-quarter turn to the left, hands in her lap. Dark eyes directed straight ahead, mouth pressed together into a line. The woman is wearing a blue buttoned jacket, from under which a white collar shows. Painted with a broader brush, softly modelled in the face area.

works.d: Ülaltvaade rohekassinistes-roosades toonides maastikule. Esiplaanil paremal järv, selle taga sõitev rong, aurupilv taga. Kaugemal künkad puude ja lagendikega. Maalitud laiade pindadena, tumeda kontuurjoonega.
works.de: A top-down view of a landscape in greenish-blue-pink tones. In the foreground on the right a lake, behind it a moving train, a cloud of steam behind it. Further away, hills with trees and clearings. Painted in broad areas with dark contour lines.

works.d: Kahvatutes rohelistes ja kollastes toonides maastik: esiplaanil vasakul tohutusuur põõsas, millest paremal väike veesilm pisikese kuusega esiplaanis. Paremal servas keskel kolm raagus puudegruppi. Silmapiiril ühtlane roheline metsaviirg. Ülal kollaste ja helesiniste täppidega antud taevas.
works.de: A landscape in pale green and yellow tones: in the foreground on the left an enormous bush, to the right of which a small pool of water with a tiny spruce in the foreground. At the middle right edge, three groups of bare trees. On the horizon an even green strip of forest. Above, a sky rendered with yellow and light-blue dots.

works.d: Lilled 30.000(eesti). Asukoht objektil: alusraamil
works.de: Flowers 30.000. Location on object: on the strainer

works.d: Konstruktsionistlikult lahendatud motiiv tänavanurga, paadi ja puuga. Puhtad geomeetrilised pinnad, kaetud ühtlaselt, õhukeselt.
works.de: A constructivistically resolved motif of a street corner, a boat and a tree. Clean geometric surfaces, covered evenly, thinly.

works.d: Konstruktsionistlik motiiv, mis kujundatud geomeetrilistest pindadest, ülaosas must piklik nelinurk.
works.de: Constructivist motif formed from geometric planes, in the upper part a black elongated quadrangle.

works.d: Heledad, hallikad, pruunikad, roosakad geomeetrilised pinnad moodustavad mitmesuguseid kujundeid. Ülal nägu profiilis ja en face.
works.de: Light, grayish, brownish, pinkish geometric planes form various shapes. Above, a face in profile and en face.

works.d: Peamiselt piki- ja diagonaalsuunalised geomeetrilised pinnad heledais toonides üksikute tugevate roheliste, punaste ja pruunide aktsentidega ülal ja paremal moodustuvad neist naiste näod.
works.de: Mainly longitudinal and diagonal geometric surfaces in light tones with a few strong green, red and brown accents above and on the right form women's faces.

works.d: Heledates valkjates toonides konstruktiivne linnavaade. Vasemal majasein kolme aknaga, paremal heleroheline poolsõõr, taevas helesinine ellipsikujuline pilv, keskel hooneid.
works.de: A constructive townscape in light, whitish tones. On the left a house wall with three windows, on the right a light green half-circle, in the sky a light blue elliptical cloud, buildings in the middle.

works.d: Vaade Kiek in de Kök ja Neitsitornile. Maalitud suurte pruunikate, beezika - ja lillakate pindadega.(eesti)
works.de: View of Kiek in de Kök and the Maiden's Tower. Painted with large brownish, beige and purplish planes.

works.d: Läbi ümarkaarelise väravaava avaneb vaade kitsale tänavale. Maaalitud  suurte roosakate, hallikate, beezikate ja pruunide pindedega.(eesti)
works.de: Through a round-arched gateway opening a view opens onto a narrow street. Painted with large pinkish, greyish, beige and brown surfaces.

works.d: Ruugetest, beežidest, valgetest, mustadest ja rohelistest geomeetrilistest pindadest moodustuvad majad kahvatu, sinakas - roheka taeva foonil.(eesti)
works.de: Houses formed of brown, beige, white, black and green geometric surfaces against the background of a pale, bluish-greenish sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinises rõivastuses naise rinnafiguur. Taga punaste katustega majad, Oleviste torn, elektrivabriku korsten ja meri.
works.de: In the foreground the bust of a woman dressed in blue. Behind, houses with red roofs, the tower of St Olaf's Church, the chimney of the electricity plant, and the sea.

works.d: Hallil ja pruunil taustal linnavaade geomeetriliste pindadena. Esiplaanil pruunid lillad ja rohelised katused, taamal kirik.(eesti)
works.de: On a grey and brown background a townscape as geometric planes. In the foreground brown, purple and green roofs, in the distance a church.

works.d: Kompositsioon maju ja puid markeerivatest geomeetrilistest ning ebakorrapärastest pindadest. Värvitoonid pastelsed - pruun, helesinine, hall, tsentris üks suur mustjaspruun pind.(eesti)
works.de: A composition of geometric and irregular surfaces marking houses and trees. Pastel colour tones - brown, light blue, grey, in the centre one large blackish-brown surface.

works.d: Siniste ja musta liistudega liigendatud raamistuse geomeetriline kompositsioon perspektiivilise lühendustega sinisest, sinakashallist, kreemkollasest ja mustast kujundist. Kompositsiooni allosas malekorras paigutatud kolm perspektiiviliselt kahanevat punast ruutu.(eesti)
works.de: A geometric composition within a framework articulated by blue and black strips, made up of a shape in blue, bluish-grey, cream-yellow and black with perspectival foreshortenings. In the lower part of the composition, three red squares diminishing in perspective are arranged in a chequerboard pattern.

works.d: Kompositsioon puude ja majakatusega. Pruunikasmustal pinnal ees vasemal laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud pruunikastuhmjas iiriroheline puukroon oranžikaspruuni tipuga; ees paremal valkjassinine pind. Paremal tagaplaanil veidi  heledamaroheliste puude vahel oranžikaspruun püsthoone kõrguva tornikesega keskel. Sellest vasemal silmapiiril helesinised ja valkjassinised piklikud värvilaigud, nende all tume punakasbeež pind.(eesti)
works.de: A composition with trees and a house roof. On a brownish-black surface, at front left, a brownish-dull, iris-green tree crown painted with broad brushstrokes, with an orangish-brown top; at front right, a whitish-blue surface. In the background at right, among slightly lighter green trees, an orangish-brown upright building with a rising little tower in the middle. To its left on the horizon, light blue and whitish-blue elongated colour patches, below them a dark reddish-beige surface.

works.d: Majakatuseid kujutavate geomeetriliste kujunditeni üldistatud kompositsioon. Kogu maalivälja ümbritseb mustjaspruun raam (kruntimata lõuend). Esiplaanil all kaks valget rõhtliistu, neist ülemine astmeline. Paremas kuldlõikes keskel rohekashall katuseviil kõrge mustjaspruuni (krunitamata lõuend) uksega. Selle taga purpurpruunjas majakatus korstnaga ja paremal, allpool, osa väikesest valgest katuseviilust. Taga paremal roheline puudemass. Vasakul must katuseviil korstnaga, sellest paremal fragment valgest katuseviilust. Nende ees roheline puudemass. Valkjas helesinine taevas.(eesti)
works.de: A composition generalised to geometric forms depicting lighthouse roofs. The entire painting field is surrounded by a blackish-brown frame (unprimed canvas). At the bottom foreground, two white horizontal battens, the upper one stepped. In the right golden section, in the centre, a greenish-grey roof gable with a tall blackish-brown (unprimed canvas) door. Behind it a purplish-brown lighthouse roof with a chimney, and on the right, lower down, part of a small white roof gable. Behind on the right, a green mass of trees. On the left a black roof gable with a chimney, to the right of it a fragment of a white roof gable. In front of them a green mass of trees. A whitish light-blue sky.

works.d: Geomeetriliselt üldistatud kompositsioon värvipindadest. Esiplaanil kahe haruna vasakust kuldlõikest ja paremast nurgast kokku voolav hallikassinine jõgi, nende vahel esiplaanil roheline neem tumepruunil (kruntimata lõuend) silmapiiril muutub jõgi kitsaks horisontaalseks viiruks. Keskplaanil paremal suure pruuni (kruntimata lõuend) värvipinnana puudemass, selle ees väiksem roosakasbeež lehtpuu. Ees vasakul liigendatud jõekallas pruunides toonides (kruntimata lõuend) rohekashalli ja summutatud hallikas - sinakasrohelise puudemassiga. Silmapiiril horisondi kohal ja osaliselt veepinnal hallikassinised värvipinnad. Hallikasvalge taevas. (eesti)
works.de: A geometrically generalised composition of colour planes. In the foreground, two branches of a greyish-blue river flowing together from the left golden section and the right corner; between them, in the foreground, a green headland on a dark brown (unprimed canvas) surface; on the horizon the river narrows into a horizontal streak. In the middle ground on the right, a mass of trees as a large brown (unprimed canvas) colour plane, in front of it a smaller pinkish-beige deciduous tree. In front on the left an articulated riverbank in brown tones (unprimed canvas), with a greenish-grey and muted greyish blue-green mass of trees. On the horizon, above the skyline and partly on the water surface, greyish-blue colour planes. A greyish-white sky.

works.d: Kaks maja järsult perspektiivis pildi keskele koondumas. Mõlema hallikaspruuni maja otsas üksteise all kolm piklikku akent. Vasakpoolse maja üks sein hallvalge, paremal majal tumepruun. Kogu kompositsioon samasugusel hallikaspruunil foonil. Väga jäme lõuend jätab krobelise faktuuri.(eesti)
works.de: Two houses converging sharply in perspective toward the centre of the picture. On the gable end of each greyish-brown house, three elongated windows one below the other. One wall of the left-hand house is greyish-white, on the right-hand house dark brown. The whole composition is set against a similar greyish-brown background. The very coarse canvas leaves a rough texture. (eesti)

works.d: Kolmest järjestikku korduvast motiivist geomeetriline kompositsioon, mis koosneb meander - ornamenti meenutavast püst ja rõhtsatest mustadest triipudest ning nelinurksetest beezikaspruunikatest, punastest, sinistest pindadest; viimased asetsevad motiivi keskel. Mustri ülal ja all valkjas taust.(eesti)
works.de: A geometric composition of three consecutively repeating motifs, consisting of vertical and horizontal black stripes reminiscent of a meander ornament, and quadrangular beige-brownish, red and blue surfaces; the latter are placed in the centre of the motif. Above and below the pattern, a whitish background.

works.d: Nurgelistest geomeetrilistest pindedest (must, hall, pruun, sinine, punane, kollane) söörjas kompositsioon.(eesti)
works.de: Angular geometric surfaces (black, grey, brown, blue, red, yellow) forming a somber composition.

works.d: Kubistlik kompositsioon 5-st erinevast mustast, hallist, pruunist ja oranžikast kujundist, millest moodustub aimatav poolik hall inimfiguur musta akna taustal.(eesti)
works.de: Cubist composition of 5 different black, grey, brown and orange-ish shapes, forming a suggestive, partial grey human figure against a black window background.

works.d: Kaabuga mehe portree veerandpöördes paremale. Seljas valge särk ja tume pintsak, taust roosakates toonides.
works.de: Portrait of a man with a hat in three-quarter turn to the right. Wearing a white shirt and dark jacket, background in pinkish tones.

works.d: Kolmveerand maalist lumiste katuste all, paremal üksikuid raagus puid. Taga keskelt tõuseb esile punase katusega hoone pooliku torniga (kiiver puudub) ja vasemalt punasekatuseline ehitusmassiiv peene kõrge torniga.
works.de: Three-quarters of the painting under snowy roofs, on the right a few bare trees. Behind, in the middle, a building with a red roof rises with a partial tower (the spire is missing), and on the left a building mass with a red roof with a slender tall tower.

works.d: Keskplaanil pikk veskihoone, mille vasakus otsas asuva ukse ees seisab kotikoorem, vasakul lähenevaid ja kaugenevaid hobusekoormaid. Tagapool kõrge metsatukk, taevas rünkpilveis. Koloriit hallikas-sinine, taevas mürksinist.
works.de: In the middle ground a long mill building, in front of the door at its left end stands a sack-load, on the left approaching and departing horse-drawn loads. Behind, a tall clump of forest, the sky with cumulus clouds. The colouring is greyish-blue, the sky a deep dark blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil suvine maastik kollakates-lillakates toonides, vasakul põõsaid, taamal sinine viirg. Taevas sinistes-rohelistes-kollakates-lillakates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a summer landscape in yellowish-purplish tones, bushes on the left, a blue streak in the distance. The sky in bluish-greenish-yellowish-purplish tones.

works.d: Rohekad, lillakad, roosakad, hallid ja valged geomeetrilised pinnad. Keskplaanil kolm musta rõivastatud meest. Ülal vasakul latern.
works.de: Greenish, purplish, pinkish, grey and white geometric planes. In the middle ground three men dressed in black. Upper left a lantern.

works.dm: kõrgus: 32.4 cm (vm.); kujutise laius: 32.0 cm (km.); kujutise kõrgus: 29.0 cm (km.); laius: 40.3 cm (vm.)
works.d: Hallile papile kleebitud punased, sinised, rohelised, pruunid ja mustad geomeetrilised pinnad moodustavad majad ja tänava.
works.de: Red, blue, green, brown and black geometric surfaces glued onto grey cardboard form houses and a street.

works.d: Noormehe pea otsevaates rohekal foonil.
works.de: A young man's head in frontal view against a greenish background.

works.d: Vertikaalsuunaline kompositsioon heledais pruunikais, kollakais ja sinakais toonides. Keskosas risttahukakujulised majad.
works.de: Vertical composition in light brownish, yellowish and bluish tones. In the middle section, cuboid-shaped houses.

works.dm: kõrgus: 64.0 cm; sügavus: 24.5 cm; laius: 25.5 cm
works.d: Ruumilis-geomeetriline kompositsioon, mis meenutab inimese pead
works.de: Spatial-geometric composition resembling a human head

works.d: Kompositsioon pruunidest, hallidest, rohelistest, sinistest, kollastest ja punastest geomeetrilistest pindadest. Maali parempoolne alumine nurk muust osast tumedama raamiga eraldatud.
works.de: Composition of brown, grey, green, blue, yellow and red geometric surfaces. The lower right corner of the painting is separated from the rest by a darker frame.

works.d: Ülaltvaade vanalinna kõverale tänavale, tagapool osa kirikust. Modelleeritud väikeste värviliste geomeetriliste pindadega tumesinisega piiritledes.
works.de: Bird's-eye view of a curving old town street, part of a church behind. Modelled with small coloured geometric surfaces, delineated with dark blue.

works.d: Värvilistest, sinistest-rohelistest-punastest-roosadest värvilaikudest ja väiksematest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon. Vasakul kaks roosakat sõõri motiivi.
works.de: Composition of colourful, blue-green-red-pink patches of colour and smaller geometric surfaces. On the left two pinkish disc motifs.

works.d: Keskealise prillidega mehe pea veerandpöördes paremale. Nägu ja taust väikeste heledate geomeetriliste pindadega modeleeritud. Üksikud pinnad tumesinise joonega rakutaoliseks mustriks piiritletud.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man with glasses, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Face and background modelled with small light-coloured geometric planes. Individual planes delimited by a dark blue line into a cell-like pattern.

works.d: Hallides ja rohelistes tuhmides toonides kevadmaastik: esiplaanil lage väli, paremal kuused ja hooned, silmapiiril metsamassiiv. Ülal hallikassinine, kiudjate pilvedega taevas.
works.de: Spring landscape in gray and green muted tones: bare field in the foreground, spruces and buildings on the right, a forest mass on the horizon. Above, a grayish-blue sky with fibrous clouds.

works.dm: kõrgus: 31.8 cm (Maastikumotiiv); laius: 31.8 cm (Autoportree); kõrgus: 41.7 cm (Autoportree); laius: 41.7 cm (Maastikumotiiv)
works.d: a) Punakaspruunides ja rohelistes toonides täppidest ja kriipsukestest abstraktne kompositsioon, vasakul servas sulab sellesse kaabuga mehe nägu.
works.de: a) Abstract composition of dots and small strokes in reddish-brown and green tones, on the left edge a man's face with a hat merges into it.

works.d: Tumedas kleidis vanema naise rinnaportree tugevas pöördes paremale. Juuksed ja nägu vormitud tugevate eredavärviliste tahkude kombinatsioonina. Samamoodi maalitud käed rinnal vaheliti.Foon roheliste, pruunide ja tumesiniste laikude põiming.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in a dark dress, strongly turned to the right. Hair and face formed as a combination of strong, brightly coloured facets. Hands likewise painted, placed alternately on the chest. Background a weave of green, brown and dark blue patches.

works.d: Tasane maastik, vasakul servas silmapiiri poole suunduv tee, teest vasakul männimetsa tukk. Silmapiiril keskel üksikud puud, paremal servas metsaviirg. Sinises taevas lopsakad valged pilved. Maalitud kontrastseid värvilaike kõrvuti asetades.
works.de: A flat landscape, with a road heading toward the horizon at the left edge, a stand of pine forest to the left of the road. Solitary trees at the centre of the horizon, a strip of forest at the right edge. Lush white clouds in a blue sky. Painted by placing contrasting patches of colour side by side.

works.d: Pastelsetes beežides, sinistes ja rohelistes toonides habemega vanema mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel kühmuga nina, pisut taandunud juustepiir, näo parem pool heledasti valgustatud. Nii portree, riietus kui foon maalitud erivärviliste laikude kombinatsioonina, kus värvilaigud asetsevad kord kõrvuti, kord sulavad üksteisesse.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older bearded man in a slight turn to the right, in pastel beige, blue and green tones. The man has a hooked nose, a slightly receding hairline, the right side of his face lightly lit. Both the portrait, the clothing and the background are painted as a combination of differently coloured patches, where the patches of colour are sometimes side by side, sometimes blend into one another.

works.d: Selgeid värvilaike moodustavate pikkade pintslilöökidega maalitud talumaastik: vasakul kaks madalat talumaja, paremal madal maja ja teivasaed. Pildi sügavuses keskel suurte kroonidega puud. Selgelt eristatavate värvilaikude kompositsioon jätab peaaegu abstraktse kogumulje, objektid eristuvad vaevu.
works.de: A farm landscape painted with long brushstrokes forming distinct patches of colour: on the left two low farmhouses, on the right a low house and a stake fence. In the depth of the picture, in the middle, trees with large crowns. The composition of clearly distinguishable colour patches leaves an almost abstract overall impression, the objects are barely distinguishable.

works.d: Roosadest, hallidest ja rohelistest pintslitõmmetest koosnev agulivaade. Vasakul matsaka puumaja otsasein, mille vasakpoolne otsaaken luugiga kaetud. Paremal pildi servaga läbilõigatud majanurk rippsildiga, millele on saabas maalitud. Maja nurga juures mees, seljaga vaataja poole. Taamal paremal roheline puudemassiiv, ülal sinine, helehallide pilvedega taevas.
works.de: An urban outskirts view composed of pink, grey and green brushstrokes. On the left, the gable end of a squat wooden house, its left-side gable window covered with a shutter. On the right, a house corner cut off by the picture's edge, with a hanging sign painted with a boot. Near the corner of the house, a man with his back to the viewer. In the background on the right, a green mass of trees, above a blue sky with light grey clouds.

works.d: Futuristlik kompositsioon kaarjatest, teravnurksetest ruumilistest, üksteisega läbi põimunud abstraktsetest värvilistest kujunditest, kus domineerivad sinkjad, rohekad, punakad toonid.
works.de: A futuristic composition of arched, sharp-angled, spatial, interwoven abstract coloured forms, in which bluish, greenish, reddish tones dominate.

works.de: Head of a young woman with curls falling behind, cut off below the chin, resting on a base of polished red granite

works.de: A frontal portrait head of a middle-aged man with a strong, full face and a balding crown. Mounted with a bolt on a vertical polished red-black granite slab.

works.d: Poisikese pea veidi avatud suuga, sileda soenguga, pea on raiutud ühes tükis risttahukast alusega. Pea pind sile.
works.de: Head of a small boy with slightly open mouth, smooth hairstyle, the head is carved in one piece with a rectangular base. The surface of the head is smooth.

works.de: The face of a man of very full forms with a double chin, wavy hair combed back over the head, short moustache.

A burning cigarette in the right corner of his mouth, his gaze directed at the man sitting opposite him, of whom his left hand, his left side, and a diagonally lying newspaper sheet on the table are visible in a gesturing posture.

works.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in an armchair. Right hand supporting the head, left on the armrest of the chair. Wearing a grayish-blue suit with a red tie. Pasty brushstrokes on the face and the body parts closer to the viewer.

works.d: Pildi esiplaanil järv, mille kaldal taamal majad. Silmapiiril kõrge mägimassiiv ning kollakashall taevas. Vasakul nurgas kivine kaaristuga kaldarinnatis, millel rohelised puud ja põõsad ning valge torniga loss nende vahel. Sinakashallides üldtoonides pilt kohati, eriti puude osas, selgelt eraldavate pintslilöökidega maalitud.
works.de: In the foreground of the picture a lake, with houses on its shore further back. On the horizon a high mountain massif and a yellowish-grey sky. In the left corner a stony arched embankment wall with green trees and bushes, and between them a castle with a white tower. In overall bluish-grey tones, the picture is painted, at places especially in the trees, with clearly separated brush strokes.

works.d: Kaks ratsanikku valgete hobuste seljas: vasakpoolne ratsanik alasti, parempoolsel seljas tumesinine särk ja valge kübar. Ratsanikest paremal lillakasroosas kleidis ja tumedas sõbas naine, pruun korv käes ja valge pikakarvaline koer jalge ees. Foonil tumerohelised puud ja ähvardav pilvine taevas. Maalitud pastelselt, pehmete üleminekutega.
works.de: Two riders on white horses: the left-hand rider naked, the right-hand one wearing a dark blue shirt and a white hat. To the right of the riders a woman in a purplish-pink dress and a dark shawl, with a brown basket in her hand and a white long-haired dog at her feet. In the background dark green trees and a threatening cloudy sky. Painted pastel-toned, with soft transitions.

works.d: Helepruuni plaadi ja pisut tumedamate jalgadega laud pealtvaates. Laual erinevatest perspektiivirakurssidest antud esemed: sinakasvalge ja kollane taldrik, roheline ja punane kera. Tagaplaanis paremal kahvaturohelises raamistuses aknaava, milles veinpunane kera. Aknast paistavad helesinised pallikesed. Foon alt määrdunud rohelist tooni, ülalt vasakult bordoopunane.
works.de: A table with a light brown top and slightly darker legs, seen from above. On the table, objects given from different perspective angles: a bluish-white and yellow plate, a green and red sphere. In the background on the right, a window opening in a pale green frame, in which a wine-red sphere. Light blue balls are visible through the window. The background is a soiled green tone at the bottom, bordeaux red at the top left.

works.d: Geometriseeritud vormiga esemetest koostatud seadeldis: keskel kollakaspruun, valgete ja pruunide laikudega keelte asemel, kitarr. Pilli kohal viinamarjakobar ja värvipinda kraabitud noodivõti ning ristikuleht. Kitarrist paremal mürkroheline, kollast värvi sisemusega karp, pruun piip kahaga otsapidi sees. Esiplaanil all vasakul kirsse ja apelsini meenutavad viljad rohelistel lehtedel. Foon üksteisesse lõikuvatest värvilistest pindadest.
works.de: An arrangement composed of objects of geometricized form: in the middle a yellowish-brown guitar with white and brown patches instead of strings. Above the instrument a bunch of grapes and a treble clef and clover leaf scraped into the paint layer. To the right of the guitar a poison-green box with a yellow interior, a brown pipe with its stem end inside it. In the foreground, lower left, fruits resembling cherries and an orange on green leaves. Background of intersecting coloured planes.

works.d: Huvitavas rakursis nähtud tänavapilt, kus inimfiguurid paistavad rinnuni või vööni. Esiplaanil vasakul hallis pikas rüüs ja hallides saabastes matsakas mammi, vasakus käes lillade kaantega raamat ja munade ning juurviljadega täidetud korv. Mammist vasakul räbalates sant, kaabu välja sirutatud, almust palumas. Paremal siidisukkades, mustades lakk-kingades ja tumesinises seelikus daam, kellele omakorda kõnnib vastu soliidses hallis ülikonnas, kinnaste ja jalutuskepiga härrasmees. Paremal servas narmendava rohelise kuulutusega kuulutustulp, esiplaanil roosa sigaretikarp tänaval maas ja punase lehviga valge koerake. Fooniks punastest tellistest müür.
works.de: A street scene seen from an interesting angle, where human figures are shown to the chest or waist. In the foreground on the left, a stout old woman in a long grey robe and grey boots, in her left hand a book with purple covers and a basket filled with eggs and vegetables. To the left of the old woman, a beggar in rags, cap held out, asking for alms. On the right, a lady in silk stockings, black patent-leather shoes and a dark blue skirt, towards whom walks a gentleman in a solid grey suit, with gloves and a walking cane. On the right edge a billboard post with a tattered green announcement, in the foreground a pink cigarette box lying on the street and a white dog with a red bow. The background is a wall of red brick.

works.d: Keskealise naise portree sinisel foonil poolpöördes paremale. Tume pluus, punane seelik, peas valge rätik. Perem käsi toetub tooli seljatoele, vasak süles.

works.d: Ümmargune vaas punaste, roosade ja kollaste moonidega sinakal foonil.
works.de: Round vase with red, pink and yellow poppies on a bluish background.

works.d: Suvine heinamaa üksikute puudesalkudega, paremal üksik heinakuhi, eemal rõugud. Taamal tume mets.
works.de: Summer hayfield with individual clusters of trees, on the right a single haystack, in the distance heaps of hay. Beyond, a dark forest.

works.d: Kõrgete puudega pargis rahvahulk punaste lippudega. Maal krobelise faktuuriga.
works.de: A crowd with red flags in a park with tall trees. The painting has a rough texture.

works.d: Kompositsioon krobelise pinnaga sinakatest, punakatest ja kollastest erineva kujuga laikudest.
works.de: A composition with a rough surface of bluish, reddish and yellowish spots of various shapes.

works.d: Kaheosaline kompositsioon pastoosselt maalitud kõrgest kivist. Vasakul tumesinises vees, paremal pildiservani ulatuva rohelise taimkatte ja tumesinise taeva taustal kivid erivärvilistes varjundites.
works.de: A two-part composition of pastosely painted high stone. On the left in dark blue water, on the right against a background of green vegetation reaching to the edge of the picture and dark blue sky, rocks in various colour shades.

works.d: Paremal rohelised, pruunid, taamal sinakad, osaliselt faktuurselt maalitud (reljeefne krunt) puud ja lagendikke kujutavad pinnad. Esiplaanil kaks lillakaspunast majakatust. Vasakust servast, suunaga diagonaalselt tsentrisse, kerkimas piimjas udumass.
works.de: On the right, green and brown surfaces, further back bluish, partly texturally painted (relief ground), depicting trees and clearings. In the foreground two purplish-red roof ridges. From the left edge, rising diagonally towards the centre, a milky mass of mist.

works.d: Vasemal pildi keskjoonel lilla veekogu, selle kohal erksinine taevaviirg, paremal metsane kaldajärsak, esiplaanil paremal üksik kollase lehestikuga puu.
works.de: On the left at the centre line of the picture a purple body of water, above it a bright blue streak of sky, on the right a wooded steep riverbank, in the foreground on the right a solitary tree with yellow foliage.

works.d: Reljeefne, segatehnikal põhinev maastik hajuvas, rohekaspruunis värvigammas. Vasakul alumises nurgas majade katused puude keskel, paremas alumises nurgas tee, millest kõrgemal puud ja põõsad. Paremas ülanurgas mõned künkal asetsevad heledad majad. Vasakul ülal järv seda ümbritseva rohelusega.
works.de: A relief-like landscape based on mixed technique, in a diffuse, greenish-brown colour scheme. In the lower left corner the roofs of houses amid trees, in the lower right corner a road, above which are trees and bushes. In the upper right corner some light-coloured houses situated on a hill. At upper left a lake surrounded by greenery.

works.d: Keskel jõekäär, osalt jääs, osalt lahtise veega. Vasakul raagus puud, üle jõe roosades ja rohelistes toonides metsatukk, vasakul silmapiiril sinakasroheline metsaviirg. Esiplaanil paremal kollase kuluga, lume alt paljastunud küngas. Taevas tihedad pilved, vasakul ülal viirg helesinist taevast.
works.de: In the middle a river bend, partly frozen, partly with open water. On the left bare trees, across the river a copse in pink and green tones, on the left on the horizon a bluish-green strip of forest. In the foreground on the right a hillock with yellow dead grass, exposed from under the snow. Dense clouds in the sky, on the left above a strip of light blue sky.

works.d: Ühtlaselt halli taeva all vasakul kollakas viljapõld kolme kähara pajupuuga. Silmapiiril rohekashall metsatriip. Maalitud siledate ühtlaste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Under an evenly grey sky, a yellowish grain field with three curly willow trees on the left. On the horizon a greyish-green strip of forest. Painted with smooth, even brushstrokes.

works.d: Kiilaspäise, istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, profiilis paremale. Ees ümarate raamidega prillid, suus sigarett. Vasak jalg üle parema põlve tõstetud. Seljas tume kuub ja halli-mustatriibulised püksid. Foon tume.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a balding, seated man, in profile to the right. Round-framed glasses, a cigarette in his mouth. Left leg raised over the right knee. Wearing a dark coat and grey-black striped trousers. Dark background.

works.d: Kirjudes toonides, otsekui läbi loori antud sügisene metsamotiiv. Esiplaanil roheline lagendik, ülal helehalli taeva viirg. Maali pind üle pildi pinna faktuurne, koloriit pastelse kogumõjuga.
works.de: In variegated tones, an autumn forest motif rendered as if through a veil. In the foreground a green clearing, above it a streak of pale grey sky. The painted surface is textured throughout, the colour scheme with a pastel overall effect.

works.d: Pastelse mõjuga rohelistes toonides antud looritatud, otsekui nägemuslik maastik. Esiplaanil kaks põõsast ja jõgi. Tagaplaanil eri puuliikidest mets, ülal kaks pilve, mille vahel helesinine taevalõik.
works.de: A veiled, almost visionary landscape rendered in pastel-toned greens. In the foreground two bushes and a river. In the background a forest of various tree species, above two clouds with a strip of pale blue sky between them.

works.d: Keskel järvesopp, mida ümbritsevad rohekashallides, sinistes ja roosades toonides lopsakad puud ja põõsad. Teispool järve erkroheline niit, silmapiiril tumesinine metsaviirg. Ülal sinine, silmapiiriga kokkupuutumise kohal valge ja roosakas taevas.
works.de: In the centre a bay of a lake, surrounded by lush trees and bushes in greenish-grey, blue and pink tones. Beyond the lake a bright green meadow, on the horizon a dark blue strip of forest. Above, a blue sky, white and pinkish near the horizon.

works.d: Vaade ülalt järvele, liivasele kaldale esiplaanil ning järve ümbritsevatele puudele ja põõsastele. Paremal keskel sügavalt järve ulatuv põõsastega kaetud saar või maanina.
works.de: A view from above of a lake, of a sandy shore in the foreground and of the trees and bushes surrounding the lake. In the centre right, an island or headland covered with bushes reaching deep into the lake.

works.d: Esiplaanil poollamav naisakt, vasak käsi ülestõstetult ümber pea. Naisakti jalgadest paremal ilusa, lainjate poolpikkade juuste, sirge nina ja pruunide silmadega naise portree. Lamava akti kohal vasakul üleelusuuruses näo ülaosa kahe silma ja ninajoonega. Foonil otsekui üksteisesse murduvad tahukad. Pastelne rohekashall-roosa värvigamma.
works.de: In the foreground a semi-reclining female nude, left arm raised around the head. To the right of the nude's legs, a portrait of a woman with beautiful wavy shoulder-length hair, a straight nose and brown eyes. Above the reclining nude on the left an over-life-size upper part of a face with two eyes and the line of a nose. In the background facets seemingly breaking into one another. A pastel greenish-grey-pink colour range.

works.de: The left-hand part of the triptych. In the foreground, blue flowers in a large glass jar on a windowsill. In the background, St. John's Church on the left, and partly the building of the "Gloria" cinema on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil laual klaaspurk mitmesuguste lilledega. Keskel aknalaud. Läbi akna paistab maastik.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on a table a glass jar with various flowers. In the middle a windowsill. Through the window a landscape is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil akna laual sangaga potis kirjud lilled. Paremal raamat, selle üle rippuva valge rätikuga. Taustaks vaade Narva kindlusele: vasakul Ivangorod, paremal Hermani kindlus.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, on a windowsill, colourful flowers in a pot with a handle. On the right a book, over which a white towel hangs. In the background a view of Narva Fortress: on the left Ivangorod, on the right Hermann Castle.

works.t: Eestlaste juhid saavad kutse Paide lossi
works.d: Esiplaanil paremal raagus puude all üksikuid sõjamehi, vasakul rühm sõjamehi. Taamal vasakul linnus.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the right, individual soldiers under bare trees, on the left a group of soldiers. In the distance on the left a fortress.

works.d: Nelja rahvarõivais naise rinnapilt, kõik poolprofiilis.(eesti)
works.de: Bust of four women in folk costume, all in three-quarter profile.

works.d: Vasakul kepi kõrval pea 3/4 profiilis pöördega paremale, paremal 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Vasakul õlal kepp. Mõlemad pead kaetud karvamütsiga.(eesti)

works.d: Muistse sõjamehe pea 3/4 profiilis pöördega paremale.(eesti)
works.de: Head of an ancient warrior in 3/4 profile turned to the right.

works.d: Ees keskel laual viiul poognaga, sellest paremal mannekeeni pea, tagapool vasakul kõrvaga kannus lilled.(eesti)
works.de: In the front centre on the table a violin with a bow, to its right a mannequin's head, behind on the left flowers in a jug with a handle.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal veoautol üles tõstetud kätega mees - kõneleja, auto ümber rühmiti sõdureid ja erariides mehi. Keskosas puude vahele tõmmatud punasel kangal loosung: KÕIK jõud Nõukogude Tallinna kaitseks! Vasemal inimesi kindlustuste ehitamisel. Keskel rannaäärse okaspuumetsa raba, selle järel Tallinna lahe veepind, mille teisel kaldal näha Tallinna. Merel siluettidena sõjalaevad.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the right a man on a truck with raised hands - a speaker, around the truck groups of soldiers and men in civilian clothes. In the middle section, on a red cloth stretched between trees, a slogan: KÕIK jõud Nõukogude Tallinna kaitseks! On the left people building fortifications. In the middle a coastal coniferous bog forest, behind it the water surface of Tallinn Bay, on whose other shore Tallinn can be seen. On the sea warships as silhouettes.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannamaastikul rohkesti traattõkkeid; paremal kahe raagus puu vahel kõlkumas naise ja mehe laibad, vasakul ääres laudadest pantser, neli mehe figuuri. Eemal, üle vee näha Tallinna siluetti.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, on a beach landscape, numerous barbed-wire obstacles; on the right, the corpses of a woman and a man swinging between two bare trees, on the left edge a plank armour, four male figures. In the distance, across the water, the silhouette of Tallinn is visible.

works.d: Punaarmeelase riietuses seisva noore mehe kolmveerand portree kerge pöördega vasakule. Parem käsi vöörihmal, vasak toetatud lauanurgale.(eesti)
works.de: Three-quarter portrait of a young man standing, dressed as a Red Army soldier, with a slight turn to the left. Right hand on the belt, left resting on the corner of a table.

works.d: Esialal paremal salk ambumehi muistses eesti sõjamehe rõivastuses, keskel ja tagapool, linnuse müüri ääres suurem osa mehi rünnakul - osa linnuse väravat lõhkumas-, kasutades müüri najale asetatud redeleid. Osa mehi müüril käsivõitluses ristirüütleist kaitsjatega. Võitlejate taga linnusest kerkivad leegid.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a group of archers in ancient Estonian warrior dress, in the middle and further back, by the fortress wall, a larger group of men in attack — some breaking down the fortress gate — using ladders placed against the wall. Some men on the wall in hand-to-hand combat with the crusader knights defending it. Behind the fighters, flames rising from the fortress.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõekäär, kaugemal rohtunud kallas. Keskel, käänu vastaskaldal suur haraline puu. Paremal maja nurk. Taga puid.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the left a river bend, further away a grassy bank. In the middle, on the opposite bank of the bend, a large branching tree. On the right the corner of a house. Trees behind.

works.d: Kahe istuva tütarlapse (peaaegu en face) poolfiguurid. Vasapoolsel käes lehvik, parempoolsel teatrikava. Taust erkpunane.
works.de: Half-figures of two seated girls (almost en face). The one on the left holds a fan, the one on the right a theatre programme. Background bright red.

works.d: Ees keskel harkisjalu seisev naine. Vasakus käes kann jooksva veekraani all. Taga väike kaheruuduline aken.
works.de: In the centre foreground a woman standing with legs apart. In her left hand a jug under a running water tap. Behind, a small two-paned window.

works.d: Hallikas-lillas kleidis ja punases kübaras istuva naise põlvpilt. Parem, kinnastatud käsi küünarnukist ülestõstetud.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman sitting in a greyish-lilac dress and a red hat. Right hand, gloved, raised from the elbow.

works.d: Laual keskel klaasist puuviljavaas (jalaga), kus üksteise sisse asetatuna taldrik, plekkkauss ja kolm tassi. Üle kausi rippumas tomatioks tomatitega. Vaasi taga laual triibuline rätik. Vaasi ees keskel pirnid ja paremal väike kausike.
works.de: On the table in the centre a glass fruit vase (on a stem), inside which are placed, one within another, a plate, a tin bowl and three cups. Over the bowl hangs a tomato branch with tomatoes. Behind the vase on the table a striped towel. In front of the vase, pears in the centre and a small bowl on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal palett ja vaas pintslitega. Vasakul veekann ja pesukausi alus kausiga. Kausi ääres püsti ruudulistes pükstes mehe (naise) kuju. Taamal läbi akna vaade üle õue asetsevale majale.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a palette and a vase with brushes. On the left a water jug and a washbasin stand with a basin. Standing by the basin, the figure of a man (woman) in checkered trousers. In the background, through a window, a view of a house situated across the yard.

works.d: Esiplaanil lauale asetatuna vasakul kaks pudelit, keskel kuulja keskosaga pudel ja kohvikann, paremal savikann, plekkkann ja roheline veiniklaas. Paremal, ülal lauaservalt alla rippuv pruun rätik.
works.de: In the foreground, placed on a table, on the left two bottles, in the middle a bottle with a bulbous midsection and a coffee pot, on the right an earthenware jug, a tin can and a green wine glass. On the right, above, a brown towel hanging down from the edge of the table.

works.d: Rehetoa ahjunurk. Paremal äärel uksepiit ja ahju soemüür, keskosas ahjusuu leel asetsevate padadega. Ahju kõrval pink kastruli ja veeämbriga. Ees vasakul kaks kassi põrandal, tagaseinas aken ja parsile viiv redel.
works.de: Corner of the stove in a threshing barn room. On the right edge the door jamb and the stove's heating wall, in the middle section the stove mouth with pots standing on the hearth. Beside the stove a bench with a saucepan and a water bucket. In front on the left two cats on the floor, in the back wall a window and a ladder leading to the loft.

works.d: Veest kerkivad kaks teravatipulist kaljut. Esiplaanil all paremal linnulennult vaadatud maaribal mõned miniatuursed paadid ja paar maja. Kaljud pehmeis hallikas-beežides toonides, veepind tugev-sinine.
works.de: Two sharp-peaked cliffs rise from the water. In the foreground, lower right, on a strip of land seen as if from a bird's-eye view, a few miniature boats and a couple of houses. The cliffs in soft grayish-beige tones, the water surface strong blue.

works.d: Istuva keskealise mehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, must kübar peas, tume ülikond seljas. Mehe nägu pruunides-ookertoonides selgelt välja vormitud. Sinised silmad, tumedad sirged kulmud, sirge nina, huuled kokku pigistatud. Vasak õlg veidi tõstetud, käsi toetub põlvele, parem kõverdatult süles. Kaeluses kriiskavvalge särgikrae, punane lips ees, valge rätt rinnatasukus. Foon beežikas, kohati heledama sinaka jumega.
works.de: Half-length figure of a seated middle-aged man in three-quarter turn to the right, wearing a black hat and a dark suit. The man's face is clearly modelled in brown-ochre tones. Blue eyes, dark straight eyebrows, straight nose, lips pressed together. Left shoulder slightly raised, hand resting on the knee, right hand bent in the lap. At the neckline a glaringly white shirt collar, a red tie in front, a white handkerchief in the breast pocket. Background beige, in places with a lighter bluish tinge.

works.d: Pruunil alusel, viimasega lähedases toonis vaasis valged ja punased nelgid ja paar avatud õiega roosat roosi. Foon tume.
works.de: On a brown base, in a vase of a similar tone, white and red carnations and a couple of open pink roses. Dark background.

works.d: Kolm tüdrukut ümber tabureti, millel õmblustarbed. Keskmine seisab, käes suur punane riidetükk, äärmised istuvad põrandal. Taustal jalgadel pesukauss ja voodi, millel lamab kass.
works.de: Three girls around a stool holding sewing implements. The middle one stands, holding a large piece of red cloth, the outer ones sit on the floor. In the background a wash basin on legs and a bed on which a cat is lying.

A narrow path leads to the house from the front, with two human figures on it. Further back, another fence with bare trees and houses visible in the distance. The ground and roofs covered with snow.

works.de: In the foreground on the right a girl in a light blouse and dark skirt, a pink shawl around her hips, a long blue scarf around her neck. On the left a boy in a purplish blouse and brown trousers. People in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kalda ääres kaks lotja. Eemal hulk madalaid hooneid, inimesi hobuvankritega.

works.de: In the foreground tall old deciduous trees. On the left the corner of a farm building. Between the tree trunks a view of the farm buildings. In the middle a woman's figure walking under the trees, seen from the front.

works.d: Sügisene maastik. Esiplaan lage, pruunides toonides. Teisel plaanil reana küpressikujulised puud, paremal kaks madalat hoonet. Paremal maaliservas teisel plaanil metsatukk. Tagaplaanil lage maastik. Taevas sinine tuules tormavate tumedate pilvedega. Pintslitõmbed pikad.
works.de: An autumn landscape. The foreground bare, in brown tones. On the second plane a row of cypress-shaped trees, on the right two low buildings. On the right edge of the painting, on the second plane, a small patch of forest. In the background a bare landscape. The sky blue with dark clouds rushing in the wind. The brushstrokes long.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks paati madalas vees. Esimesel ümber hulk inimesi. Keskel paadis mees purje kokku panemas, paremal poiss pruuni hobuse seljas, vasakul kaks naist.

works.de: Composition in dark greenish and brownish tones. In the foreground a slash-and-burn farmer and a ploughman, further away a herd of cows.

works.d: Sinakasrohelistes ja pruunides toonides külamaastik talumajade ja roigasaedadega lehtpuude vahel.
works.de: Village landscape in bluish-green and brown tones with farmhouses and pole fences among deciduous trees.

works.d: Rohekas-punakal tumedal taustal paremal ülaltpoolt ahenev hallikas kann väikeseõieliste, roosakates õiekobarates lilledega. Maalitud hoogsalt, vineertahvel kumb läbi värvi.

works.de: In front, diagonally from the lower right corner to the left edge, a row of fishing boats, among which people are busy with horse-drawn carts. On the lower right four female figures by the nets. In the distance two fishermen's huts can be seen. Sea surface dark green, sky cloudy.

works.d: Sinakas-rohekas koloriidis maastik. Vasakus servas all kaks kadakat. Paremal kaob diagonaalse joonena pildi sügavusse metsaviirg. Taevas mõned valkjad pilved.
works.de: Landscape in bluish-greenish colouring. In the lower left corner two junipers. On the right a strip of forest recedes into the depth of the picture as a diagonal line. A few whitish clouds in the sky.

works.d: Täppivas laadis maalitud abstraktne kompositsioon, kus domineerivad teose ülaosas mustjasrohelised, allpool heledamad värvilised laigud.
works.de: Abstract composition painted in a pointillist manner, dominated by blackish-green patches in the upper part of the work, lighter coloured patches below.

works.d: Panoraamvaade sinkjasroosale kaljusele mäeahelikule kahvatulilla taeva
works.de: Panoramic view of a bluish-pink rocky mountain range under a pale lilac sky

works.d: Kaljurahnudega mere ja punaste majakestega rannaküla taustal noore naise ja vana mehe poolfiguurid külgvaates vasakule. Vasakul valges pearätis, heledas riides noorik, käed sõrmseongus kõhu peal. Tema taga paremal kongus nina ja vuntsidega vana mees, sonimüts peas, hele särk musta vestiga seljas. Musti kontuure rõhutav joonistuslik laad. Maalipind näiliselt õhukeseks hõõrutud, kihiti läbipaistev.
works.de: Against the background of a sea with rocky cliffs and a coastal village with small red houses, half-figures of a young woman and an old man in side view facing left. On the left, a young woman in a white headscarf and light-coloured clothing, hands clasped over her stomach. Behind her on the right, an old man with a hooked nose and moustache, wearing a cap, a light shirt and a black waistcoat. A drawing-like manner emphasising black contours. The paint surface appears rubbed thin, translucent in layers.

works.d: Ekspressiivse musta kontuurjoonega markeeritud, peamiselt pruunides ja rohekates toonides antud maastikuvaade.  Esiplaanil abstraheeritud mets, millest eristatavad mõned puud ja teerada, taamal paistmas veekogu saartega.
works.de: A landscape view marked by an expressive black contour line, given mainly in brown and greenish tones. In the foreground an abstracted forest, from which a few trees and a path are distinguishable, further back a body of water with islands can be seen.

works.d: Akna alla laua taga istumas tinglikult antud, lehte lugev mees ja naine.
works.de: Under the window, behind a table, sitting a schematically rendered man and woman reading a page.
