works.d: Pikk pruunikas tekstiilist toru, mille ühes, vertikaalselt seisvas otsas kotis oleva naisekeha kontuurid nii eest- kui tagantvaates
works.de: A long brownish textile tube, at one, vertically standing end of which the contours of a woman's body in a bag can be seen both from front and back view

works.dm: kõrgus: 170.0 cm; sügavus: 60.0 cm; laius: 50.0 cm
works.d: Valge androgüünne figuur, pea lõpeb koonusekujuline moodustisega, kõrvadeks ümmargused lapid, käed "taskutes", keha kaetud heleda tekstiiliga, mille pinnal sinised ning kollased nelinurksed lapikesed.
works.de: A white androgynous figure, the head ending in a cone-shaped form, with round flaps for ears, hands "in pockets," the body covered with a light-coloured textile whose surface bears blue and yellow rectangular patches.

works.dm: kõrgus: 184.0 cm; sügavus: 37.0 cm; laius: 58.0 cm
works.d: Ülemisest osast ahenev tumeda musta tekstiiliga mähitud koonuseline toru, mille torukujuline ülaosa on pika kaelana alla keeratud; selle otsas omakorda on tamiili otsas rippumas kera. Pikka kaela hoiab kinnastatud käsi; Kompositsiooni  ümber keritud niiti, mille vahel väiksemad valged suled.
works.de: A conical tube, tapering from the upper part, wrapped in dark black textile, whose tube-shaped upper part is turned down like a long neck; at its end in turn a ball hangs from the end of a tassel. The long neck is held by a gloved hand; thread is wound around the composition, with small white feathers between it.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal triibulises kampsunis, hõredate juustega, suitsetava keskealise mehe poolfiguur; kerges pöördes paremale. Vasakul, mehe selja taga maanteel, kahe auto rusud.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, the half-figure of a smoking middle-aged man with thinning hair, in a striped sweater; in a slight turn to the right. On the left, behind the man's back on the highway, the wreckage of two cars.

works.d: Esiplaanil ülisuurtena aedmaasikad, lahtilõigatud puuvilja lõigud ja täpiline tass piimaga. Paremas servas ripuvad suured mustad pirnitaolised puuviljad. Natüürmorti eraldab tagaplaani maastikust must riba, mida piirab kollane-roheline-kollane ääris. Maastikus raagus puud, maja, ehitatav vabrikuhoone kõrgete suitsevate korstnatega. Käsitlus rõhutatult selgejooneline.
works.de: In the foreground, oversized garden strawberries, cut-open fruit slices and a spotted cup with milk. On the right edge hang large black pear-shaped fruits. The still life is separated from the background landscape by a black band bordered by a yellow-green-yellow edging. In the landscape leafless trees, a house, a factory building under construction with tall smoking chimneys. The treatment is emphatically clear-lined.

works.d: Kahefiguuriline kompositsioon esiplaanil rohu ja heinamaa, tagaplaanil maastiku foonil. Esiplaanil, keskel, valges kleidis oranžide sõõridega, punase mütsiga neiu poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale, pea kallutatud vasemale küljele, huulte vahel taim. Kompositsiooni vasakul äärel punase kübaraga ja sinise pluusiga ning kootud vestiga neiu, käed kuklal. Nende vahel keskplaanil improviseeritud laud, millel asetsevad pintslid, tušipudel ja väike kompositsioon noortest vanaaegse traktori ümber. Keskplaanil, paremal äärel rohul, punaste sõõridega laudlinal anumad toiduga.
works.de: A two-figure composition, in the foreground grass and meadow, in the background against a landscape backdrop. In the foreground, in the centre, the half-figure of a girl in a white dress with orange circles and a red hat, in half-profile facing left, her head tilted to the left side, a plant between her lips. On the left edge of the composition, a girl with a red hat, a blue blouse and a knitted vest, hands behind her head. Between them, in the middle ground, an improvised table on which lie brushes, a bottle of ink and a small composition of young people around an old-fashioned tractor. In the middle ground, on the right edge, on the grass, vessels with food on a tablecloth with red circles.

works.d: Esiplaanil tugevasti suurendatud detailid Heda natüürmordist: paremal poolenisti täidetud pokaal, pistoda, pooleldi söödud pirukas laialivalgunud täidisega, tükk pirukat metalltaldrikul ja vasakul servast purunenud ümberkukkunud klaas. Piruka taga tavaline, pooleldi täidetud klaas, kogu natüürmort valgel, servadest rullikeeratud linal. Laua taga sinises pluusis ja rinnataskutega rohelises jakis poiss, üks silm kinni, teine lahti. Foon tumeroheline.
works.de: In the foreground, strongly enlarged details from Heda's still life: on the right a half-filled goblet, a dagger, a half-eaten pie with spilled filling, a piece of pie on a metal plate, and on the left a fallen glass broken at the edge. Behind the pie, an ordinary, half-filled glass, the whole still life on a white cloth with rolled-up edges. Behind the table, a boy in a blue blouse and a green jacket with breast pockets, one eye closed, the other open. Background dark green.

works.d: Esiplaanil, sinakashallil, triikimisvoltides linaga kaetud laual üks väikese praoga ja teine purunenud koorega kanamuna, kollane sisu välja voolamas. Purunenud munast paremal punase-kollasetriibulise käepidemega terav pussnuga ning kõrge silindrikujuline klaas. Foon tume, sujuvate üleminekutega hallikassiniselt määrdunud pruunile toonile.
works.de: In the foreground, on a table covered with a bluish-grey cloth with ironed folds, one egg with a small crack and another with a broken shell, the yellow contents flowing out. To the right of the broken egg a sharp knife with a red-and-yellow striped handle and a tall cylindrical glass. Background dark, with smooth transitions from a dirty greyish-blue to brown tone.

works.d: Õhtune vaade Pirita uuele jahtklubihoonele mere poolt. Otse üle vee kaid ääristavad tribüünid lipuvarraste, tulekohaga. Tagapool püramiidi-taoline hoone, paremal kai ääres jahte, peegeldus vees. Silmapiiril ehapunas taeva taustal Tallinna vanalinna siluett. Esiplaanil vasakul osa jahi triibulisest spinnakerist numbriga SR-37.
works.de: An evening view of the new yacht club building at Pirita, seen from the sea. Directly across the water, stands line the quay with flagpoles and a fire place. Behind them a pyramid-like building, on the right yachts moored by the quay, reflected in the water. On the horizon, the silhouette of Tallinn's Old Town against a sky glowing red with sunset. In the foreground on the left, part of a yacht's striped spinnaker with the number SR-37.

works.d: Neli poolalasti naist istumas antiikesemetega kaunistatud ruumis (stuudios). Naiste ülakeha on paljas, nad on rikkalikult ehitud, alakehasid katab kangatükk. Kujutis on must-valge, fotolaadne. Maali esiplaanil all punase-valgeruudulise linaga kaetud laud, millele asetatud ümaraid, läikiva pinnaga esemeid. Maali must-valgel osal pealemaalitud kraklee- või murdejoonte imitatsioon.
works.de: Four half-naked women seated in a room (studio) decorated with antique objects. The women's upper bodies are bare, they are richly adorned, their lower bodies covered by a piece of cloth. The image is black and white, photo-like. In the foreground of the painting, below, a table covered with a red-and-white checked cloth, on which round objects with a shiny surface are placed. On the black-and-white part of the painting, an imitation of craquelure or crack lines has been painted on.

works.d: Kompositsioon vanaaegses kleidis ja lillepärjas noore naisega, taustal kandilised õhuavad, erinevad taimed ja sinine taevas.
works.de: Composition with a young woman in an old-fashioned dress and a flower wreath, in the background rectangular air vents, various plants and a blue sky.

works.d: Vaade Pärnu maanteelt. Esiplaanil üksik raagus puu ja hekk. Vasakule jääb pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud hoone vaateakendega. Paremal vana linnatorn ning roheliseks värvitud maja nurk.
works.de: View from Pärnu Road. In the foreground a single bare tree and a hedge. On the left, cut off by the upper edge of the picture, a building with display windows. On the right an old town tower and the corner of a house painted green.

works.d: Vaade sadamakaile väikeselt laevalt, mille metallosad ja peened vandid on paigutatud esiplaanile vasakul serval ja vasakul all. Paremal äärel valge laeva vöör. Keskplaanil hallikasroheline rahulik veepind, tagaplaanil kai kolme kaubavaguniga ja kahe punakollase kraanaga, tumedate teravatipuliste küngaste taustal. Helesinine taevas.
works.de: A view of the harbour quay from a small ship, whose metal parts and slender shrouds are placed in the foreground on the left edge and lower left. On the right edge the bow of a white ship. In the middle ground a calm greyish-green water surface, in the background the quay with three freight wagons and two reddish-yellow cranes, against a backdrop of dark, sharp-peaked hills. A light blue sky.

works.d: Poole pildi pinnast võtab enda alla haljasala, kahe, esiplaani horisontaalse ribana läbiva heki, ümmarguse klumbi ning põõsastega. Paremale ja vasakule jäävad mitmekordsed kivihooned. Vaade avaneb Võidu väljaku suunas.
works.de: The green area occupies half of the picture's surface, with a hedge running as two horizontal strips across the foreground, a round flowerbed, and bushes. To the right and left are multi-storey stone buildings. The view opens towards Võidu Square.

works.d: Pildi ülaosas roheline kõrge plankaed. Kahe väravaposti vahel ülalt kaarjas värav, väravapostidel suured kerad. Plangu tagant paistavad puud, värava ees laiadest mustadest ja peenematest värvilistest pintslilöökidest kuhjatis heledal foonil.
works.de: In the upper part of the picture, a tall green board fence. Between two gate posts, an arched gate above, large spheres on the gate posts. Trees show behind the fence, in front of the gate a mass of broad black and finer coloured brushstrokes on a light background.

works.d: Ühtlase helekollase fooni keskel lilla-oranži-musta ruuduline nelinurkne pind kaetud spontaansete kollakasoranžide kaarjate pintslitõmmetega. Esiplaanil, maali alumistes nurkades sümmeetrilised pruuni lauaplaadi kujutised, kummalgi türkiissinine ülalt laienev, karikakujuline vaas teravaotsaliste, palmitaoliste taimedega. Lauaplaatide vahel tume liist, millel ripneb pael.
works.de: In the center of a uniform light yellow background, a purple-orange-black checkered rectangular surface is covered with spontaneous yellowish-orange arching brushstrokes. In the foreground, in the lower corners of the painting, symmetrical depictions of a brown tabletop, each with a turquoise-blue upward-widening, goblet-shaped vase with sharp-tipped, palm-like plants. Between the tabletops, a dark ledge from which a ribbon hangs.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumehallil rinnatisel punakaspruun seadeldis, mis koosneb üksteisele asetatud plaatidest ja risttahukast ning selles kõrguvast triibulisest vardast hallil foonil. Paremal ja vasakul servas värvilistest kujunditest abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: In the foreground, on a dark grey parapet, a reddish-brown device consisting of plates placed one upon another and a rectangular block, with a striped rod rising from it, against a grey background. At the left and right edges an abstract composition of coloured shapes.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelise lauapaberiga kaetud pruun kirjutuslaud, millel rohelise klaaskupliga laualamp juhe üle laua stepslisse jooksmas; ümberläinud sinise tindi pott, hall vihik, pruun diagonaalse punase triibuga karp, tumepunane küünal, ülalt avarduvas topsis pintslid. Lauaplaadil paremal värviline õhuline kuhelik. Lambi taga kollane ristkülikukujuline pind. Foon helesinine, valgete, roheliste ja punaste rõngastega.
works.de: In the foreground a brown writing desk covered with green table paper, on which stands a table lamp with a green glass dome, its cord running across the table to a socket; a spilled blue ink pot, a grey notebook, a brown box with a diagonal red stripe, a dark red candle, brushes in a cup widening at the top. On the right of the tabletop a colourful airy heap. Behind the lamp a yellow rectangular surface. Background light blue, with white, green and red rings.

works.d: Keskel pruun ümmargune, taevasinist värvi linaga kaetud laud, mille tagumises servas raamatukuhi, kust lookleb alla kollane mõõdulint. Laual vasakul erepunane märkmik. Lauast vasakul koobaltsinine diivan, sein valge, paremas ülanurgas paistab osa maalist. Laua taga toetub vastu seina must pildiraam.
works.de: In the centre, a round brown table covered with a sky-blue cloth, at its back edge a stack of books from which a yellow tape measure winds down. On the table to the left, a bright red notebook. To the left of the table, a cobalt-blue sofa, the wall white, in the upper right corner part of a painting is visible. Behind the table, a black picture frame leans against the wall.

works.d: Otsekui läbi udu antud vaksali perroon, millel neli inimest suunduvad pildi sügavusse, rongile vastu. Esiplaanil keskel seljaga vaataja poole seisva heledas särgis noore mehe figuur. All vasakus servas ja all paremal must triip, üle pildi pinna musta-punasekirju joon. Töö parempoolne ülemine neljandik lillades toonides, selle all värvilistest kaarjatest pintslitõmmetest kompositsioon.
works.de: As if seen through fog, a station platform on which four people move into the depth of the picture, toward an arriving train. In the foreground, in the centre, the figure of a young man in a light-coloured shirt, standing with his back to the viewer. In the lower left corner and lower right a black stripe, across the picture surface a black-and-red patterned line. The upper right quarter of the work is in purple tones, below it a composition of colourful curved brushstrokes.

works.d: Lilla laudpõrandaga ja tumehalli seinaga ruum, mille ülaosas aken. Akna ette on punaste nööridega riputatud lillelaud suure lillepotiga keskel ja kahe kaktusepotiga servades. All põrandal suur hüljes.
works.de: A room with a purple plank floor and a dark grey wall, with a window in the upper part. In front of the window a flower shelf is hung with red cords, with a large flowerpot in the middle and two cactus pots at the edges. Below on the floor a large seal.

works.d: Esiplaanil all hall laud kahe kõrge kitsa klaasvaasiga, milles roosad oksakesed valgel foonil. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut kõrgemal punane triip ja helesinine taevas, mille keskel hall korsten.
works.de: In the foreground below a grey table with two tall narrow glass vases holding pink twigs against a white background. Slightly above the horizontal centre line a red stripe and a light blue sky, with a grey chimney in the middle.

works.d: Pruuni värvi laudadest põranda ja valgete seintega ruum, mille keskel tumepruun kolme jalaga taburet. Taburetil valge ümar vaas rukkilillede ja viljapeadega. Paremas alumises nurgas maalimispukk, millel rohelistes toonides kivide ja kadakatega maastikupilt. Molberti taga suurem suvemaastik, millest paistab peamiselt taeva osa. Vasakul toetub seinale maastik, millelt paistab äikese-eelne taevas, roheline heinamaa ja kollane viljapõld ning osa punaseks värvitud niidumasinast. Ruumi tagaseinas maastik põldudega esiplaanil. Põldude taga valge katusega puudesse uppuv talumaja, taamal metsaviirg ning kollakas taevas.
works.de: A room with a floor of brown-coloured planks and white walls, in the middle of which stands a dark brown three-legged stool. On the stool a white round vase with cornflowers and ears of grain. In the lower right corner an easel, on which stands a landscape painting in green tones with rocks and junipers. Behind the easel a larger summer landscape, from which mainly the sky portion is visible. On the left, leaning against the wall, a landscape showing a pre-thunderstorm sky, green meadow and yellow grain field, and part of a mowing machine painted red. On the back wall of the room a landscape with fields in the foreground. Behind the fields a farmhouse with a white roof sinking into the trees, in the distance a strip of forest and a yellowish sky.

works.d: Beežikaspruuni, marmortahvleid imiteerivat tausta läbib ülalt alla selgelt piiritletud alumiiniumplaate meenutav pind. Sellel, ülal keskel, punane kummuli poolkuu kiiremotiividega. Alumises neljandikus Tallinna siluett. Allääres tume lauaplaat koobaltsinise tahvliga, millel lebab kala, meretaimi, punane nöörijupp ja kuul.
works.de: A clearly delineated surface resembling aluminium plates runs from top to bottom through a beige-brown background imitating marble slabs. On it, at the top centre, a red upside-down half-moon with ray motifs. In the lower quarter, the Tallinn skyline. Along the bottom edge, a dark tabletop with a cobalt-blue slab, on which lie a fish, sea plants, a red piece of cord and a bullet.

works.d: 3/4 maali vasakpoolsest osast kujutab ühtlaselt valget peente punaste horisontaaltriipudega pinda, mis liitub paremal aimatava tähistaevaga. Selle foonil ülal paremal hõbedase sputniku kujutis, allääres, toekal lauaplaadil makett talumajast roheluses ja kolmnurkse alusega mürkroheline laualamp.
works.de: 3/4 of the left part of the painting depicts a uniformly white surface with fine red horizontal stripes, which merges on the right with an implied starry sky. Against this background, upper right, the image of a silvery sputnik, at the bottom edge, on a sturdy tabletop a model of a farmhouse amid greenery and a poison-green table lamp with a triangular base.

works.d: Lõuendi vasakus servas tumedal, mürkrohelise linikuga kaetud laual, punakaspruunis lillepotis toalill - havisaba. Poti ees valkjasrohelised, hapraid taimi meenutavad kujundid. Poti ja laua taga midagi Erkoranži. Poti fooniks ilusatest mustadest peentest raudvarbadest aed, selle taga muruplats ja põõsastik. Ülal kollakashall taevas. 4/5 pildi pinnast põimuvad teineteisesse metalli ja marmorit imiteerivad kujundid.
works.de: On the left edge of the canvas, on a dark table covered with a poisonous-green cloth, in a reddish-brown flowerpot, a houseplant - horsetail. In front of the pot whitish-green shapes resembling fragile plants. Behind the pot and the table something in Erko-orange. The background of the pot is a fence of beautiful thin black iron bars, behind it a lawn and shrubbery. Above, a yellowish-grey sky. 4/5 of the picture surface consists of intertwining shapes imitating metal and marble.

works.d: Allservas esiplaanil peaaegu mustjashalli marmori imitatsioonis rinnatis. Rinnatisel vasakul ja paremal abstraktsed ruumilised kujundid. Keskel lööb marmorisse punane sakiline välk, löögikohast paiskub 90-kraadise nurga alt värviline kiirtevihk. Rinnatisel, umes 1/4 pildi laiuse kaugusel paremast servast väike taevasinine läikiv kuulike.
works.de: In the foreground at the bottom a parapet imitating almost blackish-grey marble. On the parapet, to the left and right, abstract spatial forms. In the centre a red jagged flash strikes the marble, and from the point of impact a colourful bundle of rays bursts out at a 90-degree angle. On the parapet, at a distance of about 1/4 of the picture's width from the right edge, a small sky-blue glossy ball.

works.d: Valgeid kahhelkiviplaate meenutavate pindade vahel realistlikult maalitud meremotiiv kõrge taeva all, mis paremalt 3/4 võrra kattub strontsiumkollase, punaste siksakjoontega piiratud ja läbitud kujundiga. Keskosas merest välja viskuv suur sinkjasvalge kala.
works.de: Between surfaces resembling white tiles, a realistically painted sea motif under a high sky, three-quarters covered from the right by a strontium-yellow shape bordered and traversed by red zigzag lines. In the central part a large bluish-white fish leaping out of the sea.

works.d: Maali allosas ühtlaselt valgel, keskjoonelt siksakservalisel pinnal hall vaal. Kala sabapoolt läbib tumepunane nooljas kujund. Ülemise poole valget ja selle all olevat rohekate horisontaaltriipudega halli tausta katab paremas ülemises neljandikus erkkollane ruudukujuline pind, mille alumine äär rebitud moega. Tumepunane teravnurkne kujund vaala pea kohal.
works.de: In the lower part of the painting, on an evenly white surface with a zigzag edge along the midline, a grey whale. A dark red arrow-like shape passes through the tail end of the fish. In the upper part, the white area and the grey background with greenish horizontal stripes below it are covered, in the upper right quarter, by a bright yellow square-shaped surface with a torn-looking lower edge. A dark red sharp-angled shape above the whale's head.

works.d: Kollakasroheline lopsakas maastik käharate põõsaste-puudega. Keskel, puude tagant paistavad kraananokad, jupike vett helesinise taeva all. Taimestiku osas pealmine maalikiht kaetud korrapäraste lühikeste rõhtsate pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: Yellowish-green lush landscape with curly bushes and trees. In the middle, crane beaks visible behind the trees, a patch of water under a light blue sky. In the vegetation area the upper paint layer is covered with regular short horizontal brush strokes.

works.d: Türkiissinise taeva ja kahe kähara põõsaga suvemaastiku taustal tehiskeskkonnast pärit, omavahel põimuvad, värvilised, kahele poole kõrguvad kuhilad. Detailid enamasti ruumilised: kõverad torud, silindrid, tahvlid, kastid jne.
works.de: Against the background of a summer landscape with a turquoise-blue sky and two curly bushes, intertwined, colourful heaps originating from an artificial environment, rising to both sides. Details mostly three-dimensional: curved pipes, cylinders, panels, boxes, etc.

works.d: Läbi valgete ruudukujuliste käepidemetega klaasukse, sinakasrohelistes toonides maastiku taustal sinkjasvalge lauaplaat. Laual pardel, ümbrik, raamat, elektripirn ja värvituub. Kõik maalitud läbipaistvas rohekasvalges gammas, kohati kontuure rõhutades. Klaasukse taga, kahel pool ääres maali ülemises neljandikus rõdu nurki meenutavad kujundid. Taevas elektersinine, pilvevines.
works.de: Through a glass door with white square-shaped handles, against the background of a landscape in bluish-green tones, a bluish-white tabletop. On the table a razor, an envelope, a book, a light bulb and a tube of paint. All painted in a transparent greenish-white gamut, in places with emphasized contours. Behind the glass door, on both edges in the upper quarter of the painting, shapes reminiscent of the corners of a balcony. The sky electric blue, with hazy clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil värviliste kohvrite ja kottidega täidetud transpordikärule toetumas külgvaates noormehe põlvfiguur. Tumedad juuksed, korrapärane kreeka profiil, nägu veidi vaataja poole pööratud. Noormehel seljas helevalge särk mustade pükstega. Mehe parem käsi toetub kõverdatult pakkidele. Fooniks hele, punase käsipuuga lõppev eresinine taevas musta ja valge nelinurgaga.
works.de: In the foreground, a young man's knee-length figure in profile, leaning on a handcart loaded with colourful suitcases and bags. Dark hair, a regular Greek profile, face turned slightly toward the viewer. The young man wears a bright white shirt with black trousers. The man's right hand rests, bent, on the packages. The background is a bright blue sky ending in a red handrail, with a black and white rectangle.

works.d: Pilt jaotatud kaheks osaks. Parempoolsel, suuremal osal tehase sisevaade juhtimispuldi, mootorite, juhtmete, torude ja kaitsevõrkudega. Vasakpoolses osas sinisel foonil punaste ja siniste joonte ning kuulikeste kogum, mis mõjub väga ruumiliselt. Domineerib sinine toon, üksikute detailide maalimisel on spektritriipude kombel kasutatud punast, kollast, rohelist, tumelillat. Peamiselt pihustiga maalitud.
works.de: The picture is divided into two parts. In the larger, right-hand part, an interior view of a factory with a control panel, motors, wires, pipes and protective grilles. In the left-hand part, against a blue background, a cluster of red and blue lines and small balls, which creates a very spatial effect. Blue tone dominates, in painting individual details red, yellow, green and dark purple have been used in the manner of spectral stripes. Mainly painted with a spray gun.

works.d: Lahtikäristatud roosasse paberisse mähitud pakk, millest paistab intensiivselt sinises toonis teraline mass. Pakk kinni seotud punase paelaga, paki sisse on püsti torgatud neli peenikest varrast.
works.de: A package wrapped in torn pink paper, from which an intensely blue granular mass is visible. The package is tied shut with a red ribbon, four thin rods are stuck upright into the package.

works.d: Suurema osa pildi pinnast katab valge sein, mille suurelt osalt pudenenud krohvi mustad ja punased jooned. Paremal ülalt alla kulgev riba värvilistest horisontaalsetest triipudest ning pastoosse värvi ülalt alla tõmmatud looklev joon. Vasakus servas tükike majast, mille alumisel korrusel on äri ning roheliste luukidega piirnevast ülemisest aknast paistab helesinise särgi ja sinise ülikonnaga figuur, pea kohal oranž täpp.
works.de: Most of the picture's surface is covered by a white wall, whose plaster has largely flaked off, with black and red lines. On the right a strip running from top to bottom of coloured horizontal stripes and a winding line drawn from top to bottom in pastose paint. In the left edge a fragment of a house, with a shop on the ground floor, and from the upper window bordered with green shutters a figure in a light blue shirt and blue suit is visible, with an orange dot above the head.

works.d: All vigastatud, paremas nurgas suure ripneva rebendiga maastikumaali kujutis, mille kohal raam sellesse löödud noa, lilla silindri ja puuklotsiga, mis otsast punane. Foon hallikas-valge.
works.de: Below, damaged, in the right corner a depiction of a landscape painting with a large hanging tear, above which a knife struck into the frame, a purple cylinder and a wooden block, red at the end. Background greyish-white.

works.d: Vaade kahte lagedasse, mahajäetud rohelisse ruumi, mille põrandal lahtimonteeritud radiaatorid ja vasakpoolses ruumis prahti. Aknaavausest vaade oranžile teele ja tribüünile, mille pingid sektorite kaupa eri värvi. Tribüüni taga park kahe puuga teedevahelisel rohuribal. Aknaavavustes mustad ruudud. Rohekas värvigamma.
works.de: A view of two bare, abandoned green rooms, on the floor of which are dismantled radiators, and in the left-hand room, rubbish. From the window opening a view onto an orange path and a grandstand, whose benches are of different colours by sector. Behind the grandstand a park with two trees on a strip of grass between the paths. Black squares in the window openings. Greenish colour scheme.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm hallist kivist postamenti kartuššide, ornamentide ja bareljeefidega. Vasakpoolsel postamendil ülalt järkjärguliselt ahenev torn (alt roheline, ülalt roosa), mille tipus väike punane vardake. Torni tipust vasakul ebamäärase kujuga sinine laik. Keskmisest postamendist kasvab välja heleroosa aatomipilve meenutav kujund. Paremal postamendil tükike maastikku rohelise puu, laternaposti ja muruga, ülal tumesinise taeva foonil kuusirp. Foon helehall. Postamendid maalitud liiva-värvi segatehnikas, mõjuvad väga pastoosselt.
works.de: In the foreground three pedestals of grey stone with cartouches, ornaments and bas-reliefs. On the left pedestal a tower narrowing gradually from top (green at the bottom, pink at the top), with a small red rod at its tip. To the left of the tip of the tower an indeterminately shaped blue patch. From the middle pedestal grows a light pink form resembling an atomic cloud. On the right pedestal a piece of landscape with a green tree, a lamp post and grass, above, against a dark blue sky background, a crescent moon. The background is light grey. The pedestals are painted in a sandy-coloured mixed technique, with a very pastose effect.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrgemale ulatuvate postamentidega hall kivist rinnatis. Vasakpoolsel postamendil ebakorrapärase kujuga ülalt ahenev tumeroosat varju heitev kivisammas, mille all punastest joontest nelinurk. Parempoolse postamendi kohal roosa pilv, mille all postamendi ees rohelistest joontest nelinurk. Helehallil foonil rõhtsalt üle pildi ulatuv hall riba, geomeetriliste sisselõigetega. Rinnatis ja kivisammas segatehnikas, reljeefselt mõjuv.
works.de: In the foreground, a gray stone parapet with pedestals rising higher. On the left pedestal an irregularly shaped stone column narrowing towards the top, casting a dark pink shadow, under which a rectangle of red lines. Above the right pedestal a pink cloud, under which, in front of the pedestal, a rectangle of green lines. On a light gray background a gray strip extends horizontally across the picture, with geometric incisions. The parapet and stone column in mixed media, with a relief effect.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks ebakorrapärase kujuga tipust murenenud kivi, mõlemad maalitud pastoosselt, kivi pinnale veetud lõikuvaid jooni. Vasaku kivi all pastoosne roheline triip ning kohal valge nr. 1. Parema kivi all punane triip ja kohal nr. 2. Numbrite kohal ülaservas valge horisontaalne triip üle kogu töö. Foon hall. Üle kogu pildi pinna kasutatud reljeefsuse saavutamiseks liiva.
works.de: In the foreground two stones of irregular shape, weathered at the top, both painted pastosely, with intersecting lines drawn on the stone surface. Under the left stone a pastose green stripe and above it a white no. 1. Under the right stone a red stripe and above it no. 2. Above the numbers, at the upper edge, a white horizontal stripe across the whole work. Background grey. Sand used across the entire surface of the picture to achieve relief.

works.dm: kõrgus: 130.0 cm (III osa   ); kõrgus: 130.0 cm (II osa    ); laius: 130.0 cm (I osa   ); laius: 65.0 cm (III osa   )
works.d: I osa: klaasist seintega Tallinna mere-reisisadama ootepaviljon. Läbi klaasseinte paistab meri, valge laev, kai ja sadamahooned. Ülaservas tumesiniste pilvedega taevas, Oleviste kiriku torn ja kahe suurema maja katused vasakul ja paremal servas.
works.de: Part I: the glass-walled waiting pavilion of Tallinn's sea passenger port. Through the glass walls the sea, a white ship, the quay and port buildings are visible. At the upper edge a sky with dark blue clouds, the tower of St. Olaf's Church and the roofs of two larger buildings at the left and right edges.

works.dm: kõrgus: 81.0 cm (III osa   ); kõrgus: 243.0 cm (II osa    ); laius: 70.0 cm (I osa   ); laius: 70.0 cm (III osa   )
works.d: Kolmest osast koosnev kompositsioon, mille fooni moodustab seeriatena antud reklaamtrükised kõrrega jooki imevast naisest ja poisist ning Tallinna vaadetest. Keskmisele osale on kruvitud neli punase puunupuga nagi ning 8 väikest alumiiniumist keeksivormi, keskkosa vertikaalsest keskteljest paremale on pildi pinnale kinnitatud pikad keerduvad plekklindid. Trükistega kaetud foon pildi kesktahvlil osaliselt kaetud vasakul musta, paremal ekspressiivselt musta, valge ja punase värviga. Parempoolsel osal ülal musta ja kollasega tõmmatud laiad pintslilöögid.
works.de: A composition consisting of three parts, the background of which is formed by advertising prints given in series of a woman and a boy sipping a drink through a straw, and views of Tallinn. Four red wooden-knobbed coat hooks and 8 small aluminium cake tins are screwed onto the middle part; to the right of the vertical central axis of the middle section, long twisting sheet-metal strips are attached to the surface of the picture. The background covered with prints on the central panel of the picture is partially covered on the left with black, on the right expressively with black, white and red paint. On the right-hand part, above, broad brushstrokes drawn in black and yellow.

works.dm: kõrgus: 76.3 cm (III osa   ); kõrgus: 153.0 cm (II osa    ); laius: 70.3 cm (I osa   ); laius: 70.0 cm (III osa   )
works.d: Reklaamtrükistega kaetud foonile on maalitud oranžid ja roosad nelinurgad ning peamiselt punakates toonides pintslilöökidega kaetud astmeliselt sakiliste servadega pinnad. Kolmest tahvlist koosnev töö kahaneb astmeliselt vasakult paremale. Vasakpoolse pilditahvli servas kaks mängulennukit. Vasakpoolsel tahvlil kolm, keskmisel kaks ja parempoolsel üks hall manlikujuline kujund, mille sees must kollase servaga mandel.
works.de: On a background covered with advertising prints, orange and pink quadrangles are painted, along with surfaces with stepped, jagged edges covered mainly in reddish-toned brushstrokes. The work, consisting of three panels, diminishes in steps from left to right. On the edge of the left-hand picture panel, two toy planes. On the left-hand panel three, on the middle one two, and on the right-hand one, one grey manlike figure, inside which is a black almond with a yellow edge.

works.d: Heledal taustal vasakul heledapäise vuntsidega noormehe pea, vasak pool varjus. Paremal keskel pliiatsiga markeeritud nuga ja aimatav lõikekaar.
works.de: On a light background at left, the head of a fair-haired young man with a moustache, the left side in shadow. At centre right, a knife marked with pencil and a suggested cutting arc.

works.d: Poolelioleva ehitise sisevaade fluorestsentslambi ja juhtmejupiga. Lamp ja juhtmejupp teravustatud, nende taustale jäävad ehitusplokkidest sein ja uksest avanev vaade udused. Toonid külmad, rohekas-sinikad, teostatud osaliselt aerosooltehnikas.
works.de: Interior view of an unfinished building with a fluorescent lamp and a piece of wire. The lamp and the piece of wire are in focus, while the wall of building blocks and the view opening through the doorway in the background are hazy. Tones cold, greenish-bluish, executed partly in aerosol technique.

works.d: Interjöörivaade peegli ja punase uksega. Vasakul ümarate nurkade ja esemealusega peegel, millest paistab ukseava riidenagiga ruumi ja pildistaja välgust tekkiv valgussõõr. Punasele uksele kleebitud loodusfoto, ukse kohal ümmargune lamp.
works.de: Interior view with a mirror and a red door. On the left a mirror with rounded corners and a shelf, in which is reflected a doorway leading to a room with a coat rack and the circle of light created by the photographer's flash. A nature photo glued onto the red door, above the door a round lamp.

works.d: Interjöörivaade segamini tööruumiga. Ruumi põrandal laiali pillutatud esemeid: esiplaanil helesinine poekott ja lauasahtel, nende taga lahtisi pabereid, vihikuid ja mängukaarte. Tagaplaanil kirjutuslaud, riiul, lahtise uksega kapp ja tool, kõikidel pindadel esemeid. Maal viimistletud aerosooltehnikas ja värvi tilgutades, vasakule ülevale äärde maalitud värvikaart.
works.de: An interior view, mixed up with a work room. Objects scattered on the floor of the room: in the foreground a light blue shopping bag and a table drawer, behind them loose papers, notebooks and playing cards. In the background a writing desk, a shelf, a cabinet with an open door and a chair, objects on all surfaces. The painting finished in aerosol technique and by dripping paint, a colour chart painted in the upper left edge.

works.d: Heledates toonides topeltportree tagasi vaatava mehega. Kompositsiooni keskmes blondi pintsakus mehe kahekordne poolfiguur: parempoolne välja maalitud näojoonte ja õlaga, vasakpoolne vaid väljamaalitud õlaga. Taustaks kaugusesse ulatuv asfalttee roheliste aasadega mõlemal pool, kogu kompositsioon maalitud osaliselt tasapinnaliselt ja matilt, osaliselt reljeefselt ja emailituna.
works.de: A double portrait in light tones with a man looking back. At the centre of the composition a double half-figure of a man in a blond jacket: the right one painted out with facial features and shoulder, the left one only painted out with a shoulder. The background is an asphalt road extending into the distance with green meadows on both sides, the whole composition painted partly flat and matte, partly in relief and enamelled.

works.d: Stseen alasti mehe ja musta olevusega öises tuulises meres. Stseeni ümbritseb roosakas maalitud raam, mille vasak- ja parempoolsel osal reljeefsed liivakarva püramiidid.
works.de: A scene of a naked man and a black being in a windy night sea. The scene is surrounded by a pinkish painted frame, on the left and right parts of which are relief pyramids in a sand colour.

works.d: Maali pind jaotatud neljaks erinevas tumedusastmes mustaks pinnaks, millest kolmel keskel kokkupuutuvad nurgad hõõguvpunased.
works.de: The surface of the painting is divided into four black areas of varying darkness, on three of which the touching corners glow red in the centre.

works.dm: kõrgus: 70.0 cm; laius: 80.0 cm; kõrgus: 70.0 cm; laius: 80.0 cm
works.d: I. Helesinisel foonil reljeefselt väljaulatuv töö autori kipsmask, mille ülemise osa roosa läheb lõuendil laia ribana allapoole kulgedes servas all üle erkpunaseks.
works.de: I. On a light blue background a relief protruding work, the author's plaster mask, the upper part of which, pink, runs down the canvas as a wide band, turning bright red at the edge below.

works.d: Töö alumine osa kollakashall, ülemine osa lillakashall, horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut kõrgemal üks laiem ja teine kitsam hall triip. Kitsamat triipu läbib vertikaalteljel hele ristkülik. Koloriit erinevate hallide toonide gradatsioon.
works.de: The lower part of the work is yellowish grey, the upper part purplish grey; slightly above the horizontal centre line there are two grey stripes, one wider and one narrower. The narrower stripe is crossed on the vertical axis by a light rectangle. The colour scheme is a gradation of different grey tones.

works.d: Kaks lineaarperspektiivis antud teineteise taga asetsevat püsttahukat. Toonid elevandiluuvärvist helehalli ja -siniseni.
works.de: Two upright rectangular blocks placed one behind the other in linear perspective. Tones ranging from ivory to light grey and blue.

works.d: Altservast sinisel, edasi keskplaanis roosal ja ülal tasapisi taas siniseks mineval foonil kaks tumesinist, kergelt kaldu triipu.
works.de: From the bottom edge blue, further in the middle ground pink and above gradually turning blue again, on this background two dark blue, slightly slanted stripes.

works.d: Pildi pind on jaotatud väikesteks hallideks ruutudeks, milles erinevates toonikombinatsioonides sinised, hallid, mustad, valged ja punased kolmnurgad ja ringid.
works.de: The surface of the picture is divided into small grey squares, in which, in various tonal combinations, there are blue, grey, black, white and red triangles and circles.

works.d: Hallikassinisel foonil sööstab pildi paremast ülemisest kolmandikust, servast viltu vasakule alla algul erksinine, lõpuks valgeks muutuv juga.
works.de: Against a greyish-blue background a waterfall shoots down from the upper right third of the picture, diagonally from the edge to the lower left, at first bright blue, finally turning white.

works.d: Allosas õrnsinine pind, mis teravate, kuristiku serva meenutavate nurkadena lõikuvad ülemisse, roosasse ruumi.
works.de: Pale blue surface at the bottom, cutting into the upper, pink area with sharp corners resembling the edge of a ravine.

works.d: Alt paremast nurgast tõusevad ülespoole kaks teineteisega väikese nurga all asuvat halli pinda, mida ülalt, otsekui platoona katab teravalt ülejäänud heledasse ruumi lõikuv õrnsinine pind.
works.de: From the lower right corner two grey planes rise upward at a small angle to each other, covered from above, as if by a plateau, by a delicate blue plane that cuts sharply into the remaining light space.

works.d: Süsimustal foonil pildi keskel hõõguv roheline nelinurk.
works.de: On a jet-black background, a glowing green rectangle in the middle of the picture.

works.d: Peamiselt roosadest ja sinistest, erinevates suurustes kolmnurkadest koosnev kompositsioon sinisel foonil. Keskel suur must kolmnurk, mille keskel omakorda tilluke valge kolmnurk.
works.de: A composition consisting mainly of pink and blue triangles of various sizes on a blue background. In the centre a large black triangle, in the centre of which in turn a tiny white triangle.

works.d: Sinine, vasakult paremal pürgiv kolmnurk, mis algab servast valkjassinisena ja on tipus sügavsinine. Foon ülal ja paremal kahvatusinistes toonides.
works.de: A blue triangle rising from left to right, beginning at the edge whitish-blue and deep blue at the tip. The background above and to the right in pale blue tones.

works.d: Üksteisesse lõikuvatest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon: esiplaanil moodustavad tohutu tahuka helesinine ja sinakasroheline pind. Ülal läheb, vasakult alates sinakasvalge toon-toonilt üle siniseks ja sealt edasi kahvaturoosast parema serva tumeroosani.
works.de: A composition of intersecting geometric planes: in the foreground a huge faceted block forms a light blue and bluish-green surface. Above, starting from the left, a bluish-white tone shifts gradually into blue, and further on from pale pink to dark pink at the right edge.

works.d: Smaragdrohelisel taustal punastest joontest korrapärane sõrestik, igas ruudus omakorda kolmnurk. Keskosas pool must, pool valge kaldjoon, otstel tume ja hele ring. Ülemise ääre keskel valge, all must ring.
works.de: On an emerald green background a regular lattice of red lines, in each square in turn a triangle. In the centre part black, part white diagonal line, at the ends a dark and a light circle. At the centre of the upper edge a white, at the bottom a black circle.

works.d: 3/4 maali ülemisest osast kahvatusinine aimatav taevalaotus, all helelilla pind. Silmapiiril vasakul astmeliselt paigutatud helesinised nelinurksed kujundid.
works.de: 3/4 of the upper part of the painting shows a pale blue suggested sky, below a light lilac surface. On the horizon at left, light blue rectangular shapes arranged in steps.

works.d: 2/3 maali ülaosast kahvatusinine taevalaotus, mis liitub selgepiiriliselt alt tumedama sinakaslilla pinnaga. Silmapiirilt vasakult lõikub taevasse noolsirge kujund.
works.de: 2/3 of the upper part of the painting is a pale blue sky, which merges at the bottom, with a clear boundary, with a darker bluish-purple surface. From the horizon on the left an arrow-straight form cuts into the sky.

works.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon: keskel peentest punastest joontest moodustuv ruut, milles samasuguse joonega antud ring ja kolmnurk. All osalt ruutu ulatuv kollane ring, üks segment servas must. Paremal ülemises neljandikus osalt samuti ruutu ulatuv roheline kolmnurk, paremal taevasinine ruut. Üla- ja alaserv mustad. Foonil hall ja valge pind.
works.de: An abstract composition made up of coloured geometric shapes: in the middle a square formed by thin red lines, in which a circle and a triangle given with the same kind of line. From below a yellow circle reaching into the square, one segment at the edge black. In the upper right quarter a green triangle also partly reaching into the square, on the right a sky-blue square. Upper and lower edges black. Background a grey and white surface.

works.d: Apelsinikarva foonil, mis all paremas nurgas läheb üle rohekashalliks, on vasemas ülemises neljandikus kaks suurt nelinurka. Neist vasakpoolne kollakashall ja parempoolne hallikassinine.
works.de: On an orange-coloured background, which in the lower right corner turns into greenish-grey, there are two large quadrangles in the upper left quarter. Of these the left one is yellowish-grey and the right one is greyish-blue.

works.d: Suurtest helesinistest pindadest kujundatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Vasakus ülemises nurgas kollakas kuma.
works.de: Abstract composition formed of large light-blue areas. In the upper left corner a yellowish glow.

works.d: Hallidele üleminekutoonidele rajatud, üksteise sees paiknevatest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon: helehallil taustal mustjashall ring, selles veidi heledam ruut, milles omakorda veidi heledam võrdkülgne kolmnurk. Kujundeid läbivad vasakult ülalt kolm peent musta paralleelset diagonaaljoont, paremalt ülalt peened vikerkaarevärvilised jooned, joonte ristumiskohad valged.
works.de: A composition of geometric surfaces nested within one another, built up in grey transitional tones: on a light grey background a blackish-grey circle, within it a slightly lighter square, within which in turn a slightly lighter equilateral triangle. The shapes are crossed from the upper left by three thin parallel black diagonal lines, from the upper right by thin rainbow-coloured lines, the points where the lines cross are white.

works.d: Lennuvälja maandumis - ja stardirada: vasakul servas keskel lennuk vaataja poole küljega, sabal punane viisnurk ja küljel punane number. Pildi keskel maanduv lennuk, mille sabal samuti viinurk, küljel punane viisnurk ja numer 23. All paremal auk, millest ulatuvad välja kollased torud. Ülaservas helesinine taevas. Hallikassinises üldkoloriidis pilt maalitud kohati väga pastoosse valge värviga.
works.de: An airfield landing and take-off strip: on the left edge in the middle an aircraft with its side facing the viewer, a red five-pointed star on the tail and a red number on the side. In the centre of the picture a landing aircraft, on whose tail also a five-pointed star, on the side a red five-pointed star and the number 23. Below right a hole, from which yellow pipes protrude. At the top edge a light blue sky. In an overall greyish-blue colouring the picture is painted, at places with very pastose white paint.

works.d: Kujutatud osa kaatri pardast mitmesuguste metalsete vaheseinte, ustega kahel pool torubarjääri taga. Kaatri kõrval paremal kõrgub suurema laeva külg. Roheks - mustjas koloriit, fotolikke võtteid kasutav laad.
works.de: Depicted is a part of a boat's side with various metal partitions, doors on both sides behind a tube railing. Next to the boat on the right rises the side of a larger ship. Green-blackish colour scheme, style using photographic techniques.

works.d: Esiplaanil lähedaltvaates osa neoonrekleemi tähest, roosal foonil helesinise gaasiga täidetud torud. Foon tume, kohati üleval ja eriti all vasakus nurgas tumehalli pastoosse värvi abstraktne mäng.
works.de: In the foreground, in close-up, part of a neon sign letter, light blue gas-filled tubes on a pink background. Background dark, in places above and especially in the lower left corner an abstract play of dark grey pastose paint.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kohati väga pastoosselt maalitud sinises teksajakis heledapäine noormees redelil töökindad käes akent pesemas. Paremal kaks akent, vasakul majasein ja vihmaveetoru. Kõik elusuuruses.
works.de: In the foreground, painted at times very impasto, a fair-haired young man in a blue denim jacket on a ladder, wearing work gloves, washing a window. On the right two windows, on the left the house wall and a drainpipe. All life-size.

works.d: Vaade ülalt kaubajaamale: esiplaanil tihedalt rööbasteid ja ronge, üksikuid vaguneid ja tsisterne. Tagaplaanil vaade Tallinna Toompeale. Ülal hallikas taevas. Koloriit tume, kasutatud peamiselt pruune ja tumerohelisi toone, kohati pastoosset valget värvi.
works.de: A view from above of a freight yard: in the foreground densely packed rails and trains, individual wagons and tank cars. In the background a view of Toompea in Tallinn. Above, a greyish sky. Colouring dark, mainly browns and dark greens used, with pastose white paint applied in places.

works.d: Paremal tiival kai ääres suur laev, esiplaanil kaks seisvat ja üks lendav kajakas. Vasakul tiival osa ujuvast alusest, keskel meri, taamal kolmas laev. Ülal helesinine, vasakul ülanurgas valge ristiga, taevas. Sinistes toonides, kohati väga pastoossed valged pintslitõmbed.
works.de: On the right wing, a large ship by the quay, in the foreground two standing and one flying gull. On the left wing, part of a floating vessel, in the middle the sea, in the distance a third ship. Above, a light blue sky, in the upper left corner with a white cross. In blue tones, in places very pastose white brushstrokes.

works.d: Pildi keskteljel vertikaalselt peaaegu üle kogu pildi pinna alt valge, ülalt hallikassinine tuletorn vilkuva helgiheitjaga tipus. Foon erinevatestoonides sinine ja hall, kohati valgeid pastoosseid triipe ja laike.
works.de: On the picture's central vertical axis, extending almost across the entire picture surface, a lighthouse - white below, greyish-blue above - with a flashing beacon at its top. The background in various tones of blue and grey, in places white pastose stripes and patches.

works.d: Altvaade hotelli "Kopli" neoonkirjaga fassaadiosale. keskel reklaam sõnadega: KOPLI, selle all tumedal, fassaadist eenduval alusel: hotell, (sama vene keeles). Ümbritseb liivapruun poollagunenud sein, millel vasakul maja numbrimärk valgustiga selle kohal, osa kaablist. Ülal keskel ja paremal paistab osa avatud aknaist. Kasutatud slaidi. Maalitud beezides, sinkjais toonides pahtli, pulverisaatori, pintsliga kohati väga pastoosselt.
works.de: Front view of a section of the facade of the hotel "Kopli" with a neon sign. In the middle, an advertisement with the word: KOPLI, below it, on a dark base projecting from the facade: hotell, (the same in Russian). Surrounded by a sandy-brown, half-decayed wall, on which, at left, is the house number plate with a light above it, part of a cable. Above, in the middle and at right, part of open windows is visible. A slide has been used. Painted in beige, bluish tones with putty knife, spray gun, brush, in places very impasto.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel suurelt reisilaev "Georg Ots", üleni valge, sinine triip küljel. Laeva ees, tohutute tiibadega laeva osaliselt varjates, pikeerib väljasirutatud jalgade ja lahtise nokaga kajakas. Laeva ja kajakat ümbritsev vesi ja taevas ühtviisi rohekas - sinised. Kajaka sulestik ja vahused laineharjad on maalitud pastoosselt valge värviga.
works.de: In the foreground, large in the centre, the passenger ship "Georg Ots", entirely white with a blue stripe on the side. In front of the ship, partly obscuring it with its enormous wings, a gull dives with outstretched legs and open beak. The water and sky surrounding the ship and the gull are alike greenish-blue. The gull's plumage and the foamy wave crests are painted pastosely in white paint.

works.d: Ruumis paremal seina ääres avatud kohver riietega, kummuti nurk, millel pappkast, ümber kukkunud triikraud. Kummuti kohal paistab osa maalist etiketiga: "Naine peegli ees". Sellel kujutatud pikajuukseline noor naine peegli ees. Vasakul osa uksest varjab pilti.
works.de: In the room, on the right by the wall, an open suitcase with clothes, a corner of a chest of drawers with a cardboard box on it, a fallen-over iron nearby. Above the chest of drawers, part of a painting with the label "Woman in Front of a Mirror" is visible. It depicts a young woman with long hair in front of a mirror. Part of a door on the left conceals the picture.

works.d: Vanadest maalitud lõuenditest kokku õmmeldud alusel värvinirede ja spaatliga maalitud mitmekihiline abstraktne kompositsioon. Valdavalt valge - musta - sinise kombinatsioonis. Vasak alumine osa sinkjasmust maaliline nelinurkne pind. Maali ülemine ja parem alumine pool määrdunud valgega spaatlitõmmetega maalitud. All keskel aerograafiga kirjutatud hall kiri: POVERTY STINKS, all paremal pastoosselt maalipinnas: FOR EVER AND EVER.
works.de: A multilayered abstract composition on a base sewn together from old painted canvases, painted with dripped paint and a spatula. Predominantly in a combination of white - black - blue. The lower left part is a bluish-black painterly rectangular surface. The upper and lower right half of the painting are painted with soiled white spatula strokes. At bottom centre, written with an airbrush, grey text: POVERTY STINKS, at bottom right, painted impasto in the paint surface: FOR EVER AND EVER.

works.d: Linnavaade sõitva kollase Ikarus-bussiga. Autoteest paremal asfalteeritud parkla maha joonistatud keksumängu ja maas lebavate prillidega. Taamal elektriliin, majad ja puud.
works.de: Cityscape with a moving yellow Ikarus bus. To the right of the road, an asphalted parking lot with a hopscotch grid drawn on it and glasses lying on the ground. In the distance a power line, houses and trees.

works.d: Madala, külmalt helenduva silmapiiriga avaruse foonil mustjas trapetsikujuline, vasakule üles suunduv pind, mis katab osaliselt vasakul ülal rohelise kumaga kera, paremal ääres uksepiita meenutavat kujundit. Allosas, sinkjast udust paistmas tume kujundi nurk. Vasakul ääres kitsas, alt üles ühtlaselt tumenev pind.
works.de: Against the background of a low, coldly glowing horizon of open space, a blackish trapezoidal surface directed upward to the left, partly covering, at the upper left, a sphere with a greenish glow, and on the right edge a shape resembling a doorpost. In the lower part, the dark corner of a shape shows through bluish mist. On the left edge, a narrow surface, evenly darkening from bottom to top.

works.d: Mustades, hallides, sinistes ja valgetes toonides metafüüsiline maastik: ees keskel neljakandiline sammas, mille taha jäävad suured üksteisesse lõikuvad hallid pinnad. Paremal servas valge muna, mille alt voolab välja hall riie. Silmapiiril, vertikaalsel keskteljel, suundub ülespoole suitsujuga meenutav hall joon.
works.de: A metaphysical landscape in black, grey, blue and white tones: in the centre foreground a rectangular column, behind which lie large intersecting grey surfaces. On the right edge a white egg, from under which a grey cloth flows. On the horizon, on the vertical central axis, a grey line resembling a smoke trail rises upward.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest kehadest koosnev metafüüsiline maastik hallides ja sinistes toonides. Foonil ülasuunas tumenev sinine taevas. Vasakul torniga kindlust meenutav hoone, mille ees horisontaalsel joonel suur muna. Muna vari langeb hallile maapinnale.
works.de: A metaphysical landscape composed of geometric bodies in grey and blue tones. In the background a blue sky darkening upwards. On the left a building resembling a fortress with a tower, in front of it on a horizontal line a large egg. The egg's shadow falls onto the grey ground.

works.dm: laius: 130.5 cm (tosa II   ); kõrgus: 230.0 cm (osa I   ); kõrgus: 230.0 cm (osa II   ); laius: 130.5 cm (osa I   )
works.d: Koosneb kahest osast. Sinakashallides, pruunides toonides müstiline tehismaastik arhitektuurimotiivide ja draperiidega. Vasakul oranžika kumaga öötaeva foonil püramiidjas objekt ühtlaselt kaetud langeva draperiiga. Selle taga vasakul ja paremal sammastega väravaorvad. Esiplaanil, heledale lagedale langevad pruunikad varjud, ees keskel tume siidja läikega volditud draperii. Paremal pool üle terve pinna lähivaates sammastega ehituse osi, paremas ülanurgas ringikujuline detail.
works.de: Consists of two parts. A mystical artificial landscape in bluish-grey, brown tones with architectural motifs and draperies. On the left, against a night sky background with an orange glow, a pyramid-shaped object evenly covered with a falling drapery. Behind it, on the left and right, gateways with columns. In the foreground, brownish shadows falling on a bright open area, in front in the centre a dark, silky-glossy folded drapery. On the right, across the entire surface, a close-up view of parts of a building with columns, in the upper right corner a circular detail.

works.d: Sinine taust muutub ülaltpoolt sujuvalt mustjaks. Tausta keskel nelinurkne metafüüsiline kujund-vaade: terashall ühtlane sein-pind all vasakul, üle selle heidetud siidise voldustikuga tumesinine draperii. Halli pinna paremal nurgal kollakasroheline kera, lummav valgus keral ja draperiivoldil. Tagapool sinkjashall avarus.
works.de: The blue background gradually turns blackish toward the top. In the centre of the background a rectangular metaphysical shape-view: a steel-grey uniform wall-surface at the lower left, over which a dark-blue drapery with silky folds is cast. At the right corner of the grey surface, a yellowish-green sphere, a captivating light on the sphere and on the drapery fold. Behind it, a bluish-grey expanse.

works.d: Illusioon ribikardinaga aknavaatest valgus-varju triipudega. Maalipind jaotatud vertikaalselt pooleks. Vasakul, maali keskme suunas ühtlaselt laienevad valgustriibud vaheldumisi varjuga. Paremal, varjupoolel tumedamad sinkjashallide toonide üleminekud.
works.de: An illusion of a window view through venetian blinds with stripes of light and shadow. The painted surface is divided vertically in half. On the left, stripes of light evenly widening toward the center of the painting alternate with shadow. On the right, the shadow side, darker transitions of bluish-grey tones.

works.d: Illusioon ribikardinaga aknavaatest valgus-varju triipudega. Maalipind jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks, 1/3 osa vasakul varjupool. Paremal, valgustriibud muutuvad keskme suunas laiemaks ja heledamaks. Sinkjad ja hallid üleminekutoonid.
works.de: Illusion of a view through a window with a ribbed blind, in stripes of light and shadow. The painted surface is divided vertically into two, 1/3 on the left being the shaded side. On the right, the stripes of light become wider and lighter towards the centre. Bluish and grey transitional tones.

works.de: An elongated animal-like body welded together from rusted scrap iron, standing on three legs. Under the single front leg a saw blade, under each of the rear legs two gear wheels of different sizes. At the front of the sculpture the snout is marked by an elongated flat weld, at the rear a "tail" made of a rounded bent iron reinforcement bar. No signature, no inscriptions on the front or back.

works.d: Plekkplaadil tõrvapapp, millel heleda ja tumeda siluetina inimese pea ja käed. Kujutis osaliselt raamitud, ebatasaselt lõigatud ja painutatud plekiga.

works.d: Kaheosaline kompositsioon. Robustsele püstpuitraamistuselekinnitatud tõrvapapp ja roostetanud plekkalus (ülal vasakul, all paremal), millele valge värviga markeeritud kahest kõverdatud käest ja kahest jalast koosnev haakristitaoline propelleri kujund. Taust maalitud hõbe-, pronks- ja punaka värviga. Kahe osa vahele kinnitatud saeleht.
works.de: A two-part composition. Tar paper and a rusted sheet-metal base (upper left, lower right) fastened to a robust upright wooden frame, on which a swastika-like propeller shape composed of two bent arms and two legs is marked in white paint. The background is painted in silver, bronze and reddish colour. A saw blade is fastened between the two parts.

works.d: Kaheosaline, sinisel pinnal olev kujund saab alguse ülalt vasakult. Ümarjas punane kujund evib poolkuu kujulist vasakut serva mis on valge. Punane ebaühtlane joon kulgeb kaarjalt maali keskossa kus paikneb keskteljest veidi paremal roosakas-valge kolmnurgasarnane kujutis, millest kasvavad välja kaks sinistes toonides jalgu meenutavat osa; mille vahelt väljub punane värv nõrguvate niredena. "Jalad" on põlvedest kõverdatud, kahele poole kõrvale väänatud.
works.de: A two-part shape on a blue surface begins at the upper left. A rounded red form has a crescent-shaped left edge that is white. An uneven red line curves into the middle of the painting, where a pinkish-white triangle-like image is located, slightly to the right of the central axis, from which grow two leg-like parts in blue tones; between them red paint emerges in trickling drips. The "legs" are bent at the knees, twisted out to either side.

works.dm: kõrgus: 290.0 cm; kujutise laius: 206.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 270.7 cm; laius: 206.0 cm
works.d: Suur avatud suuga nägu, musta suuava ümbritsevad leekidest huuled. Näo alaosa rohekais-kollastes toonides, nina roosakais toonides. Nina meenutab ilma peata tagurpidi tordot. Rombilaadsed silmad on kollased ilma täpsema detailinguta. Laup sinine, laubal 4 lainjat, valget, lendavaid linde meenutavat kortsu. Oimud oranžid, ninajuurel reljeefsed värvitükid.
works.de: A large face with an open mouth, the black mouth opening surrounded by lips made of flames. The lower part of the face in greenish-yellow tones, the nose in pinkish tones. The nose resembles an upside-down cake without a top. The rhombus-like eyes are yellow without more detailed articulation. The forehead is blue, with 4 wavy white wrinkles resembling flying birds. The temples are orange, with relief-like patches of paint at the root of the nose.

works.d: Illusoorne kaksikfiguur alasti noorest habemikust mehest (autoportree) külgvaates. Heledal alusel põlvili asendis, kõverdatud käed, ülakeha ja pea kummargil ette alusele. Pea pööratud vaatajale, silmad suletud. Tõstetud istmikust kasvab välja teine pea profiilis paremale. Illusioon tõstetud ülakehaga figuurist, kõverdatud käte asemel varvastele toetuvad jalad. Lillakashall ühtlane taust, heledale alusele langevad varjud. Figuur modelleeritud pruunikate, ookertoonidega. Metafüüsiline atmosfäär.(eesti)
works.de: An illusory double figure of a naked young bearded man (self-portrait), in profile. In a kneeling position on a light-coloured pedestal, with bent arms, the upper body and head bowed forward onto the pedestal. The head turned towards the viewer, eyes closed. From the raised buttocks grows a second head, in profile, facing right. An illusion of a figure with a raised upper body, with feet resting on toes instead of bent arms. A uniform lilac-grey background, shadows falling onto the light-coloured pedestal. The figure is modelled in brownish, ochre tones. A metaphysical atmosphere.

works.d: Heledal taustal, keskmest veidi vasakul, seisva noore mehe (Toomik) 3/4 figuur selgvaates. Alasti kuju läbib istmiku kohalt lamav alasti (eesti)

works.t: Tee São Paulosse (Way to São Paulo)
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 44.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 10.0 minut
works.d: Teos koosnes kahest osast: a) klaaskuubi ujutamine aprillist oktoobrini 1994 (aktsioonid, performance'id); b) video-installatsioon Brasiilias, Sâo Paulo biennaalil. Dokumentaalvideo kujutab suure peeglitest kuubi ujutamist Emajõel ja Vltava jõel, Prahas. Klaaskuup reflekteerib vett, taevast, möödavilksatavaid puid, inimesi, kaarsildu.
works.de: The work consisted of two parts: a) floating a glass cube from April to October 1994 (actions, performances); b) a video installation in Brazil, at the São Paulo Biennial. The documentary video depicts the floating of a large mirrored cube on the Emajõgi River and the Vltava River in Prague. The glass cube reflects water, sky, flashing trees, people, arched bridges.

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 35.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 2.0 minut
works.d: Kunstnik uisutab alasti üle jäätunud mere. Ta teeb oma 10-aastase poja koraalilaulu saatel mitu ringi ümber vaataja, kuni uisutab tagasi sinna kust ta tuli, kadudes valgesse olematusse. Esmakordselt eksponeeriti 1998. a personaalnäitusel Tallinnas Linnagaleriis
works.de: The artist skates naked across the frozen sea. Accompanied by his 10-year-old son's chorale singing, he makes several circles around the viewer, until he skates back to where he came from, disappearing into white nothingness. First exhibited at his 1998 solo exhibition at the Tallinn City Gallery.

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 42.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 1.0 minut
works.d: Alasti mees on valge riideribaga seotud tokki otsa, mis asetseb keset mudast põldu. Mehel jalas vaid vanad nahksed jalatsid. Riideriba, mis on seotud mehe suguelundite ümber, tirib neid mehe liikumisel tahapoole, nii et eestpoolt pole neid enam näha. Aeglaselt ja valuliselt komberdab mees ringiratast, ulatudes nii kaugele, kui riideriba võimaldab. Helitaustaks on puukiige vms. kääksumine. Taevas pilvine ja madal.
works.de: A naked man is tied by a white strip of cloth to a stick standing in the middle of a muddy field. The man wears only old leather footwear. The strip of cloth, tied around the man's genitals, pulls them backward as the man moves, so that they are no longer visible from the front. The man slowly and painfully hobbles round and round, reaching as far as the strip of cloth allows. The sound background is the creaking of a wooden swing or the like. The sky is cloudy and low.

works.d: Valdavalt kollakasrohelisel, kohati ekspressiivsete erksavärviliste tõmmetega, kohati voolavate värviniredega maalitud foonil kaks värvivines alasti naisfiguuri teineteise süles-embuses. Malbe, äraoleva ilmega näod pööratud vaatajale. Parempoolse pea kohal roheline, vasakpoolsel sinine värvilaik.
works.de: On a predominantly yellowish-green background, painted in places with expressive bright-coloured strokes, in places with flowing streams of colour, two nude female figures in a colourful embrace, in each other's lap. Meek, absent-looking faces turned toward the viewer. Above the head on the right, a green colour patch, on the left one a blue colour patch.

works.d: Kahvatutes toonides alasti meesfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, pea vasakule. Vasakus käes kirves, parema käe kohal tiivataoline kujutis. Mees suure kala taustal-seljas. Kujundid ümbritsetud laiade värviliste kontuurjoontega.
works.de: In pale tones a nude male figure in a three-quarter turn to the right, head to the left. In his left hand an axe, above his right hand a wing-like image. The man against the background of, and on the back of, a large fish. The figures are surrounded by broad coloured contour lines.

works.d: Heledal, värviliste vertikaalsete vööndite foonil, pea alaspidi alla paremale, jalad täisnurkselt vasakule, kollases rõivas üldistatult noore naise figuur rohekas-kollakate juustega; kõhu juures mesilane. Keskel horisontaalselt üle naise figuuri alasti selili inimese figuur, helerohekas toonis ja ilma peata, põlvist murtud jalad täisnurkselt alla vasakule.
works.de: Against a light background of coloured vertical bands, head upside down toward the lower right, legs at a right angle to the left, a generalized figure of a young woman in yellow clothing with greenish-yellowish hair; a bee near her stomach. In the middle, horizontally across the woman's figure, a nude human figure lying on its back, in light greenish tones and without a head, legs bent at the knee at a right angle downward to the left.

works.d: Heledaks krunditud pinnal savi, orgaaniline aine ja värvi pritsmeid, hõõrutud mööda alust. Pastoosne moodustis rohust, savist, ograanilisest materjalist ja liimainest kompositsiooni vasakul ülemises kolmandikus kinnitatud pinnale kruvidega.
works.de: On a lightly primed surface, clay, organic matter and splashes of paint, rubbed over the base. A pasty formation of grass, clay, organic material and adhesive substance fixed to the surface with screws in the upper left third of the composition.

works.d: Heledale pinnale määritud, hõõrutud orgaaniline aine, kinnitatud liimainega (?), pastoosseid ruumilisi moodustisi savist, sõnnikust, õlgedest, kuivanud rohust.
works.de: Organic matter smeared and rubbed onto a light-coloured surface, attached with an adhesive (?), pasty spatial formations of clay, dung, straw, dried grass.

works.d: Püstistest viimistlemata laudadest alusele maalitud kaks diagonaalselt  asetsevat sinkjashalli ellipsikujulist pinda. Mõlema kujundiga liitub altpoolt ruumiliselt maalitud  2 kirsipruuni lõigatud torumotiivi.
works.de: Two diagonally placed bluish-grey elliptical surfaces painted on a base of upright, unfinished planks. Both shapes are joined from below by 2 cherry-brown cut pipe motifs painted with spatial effect.

works.d: Püstistest viimistlemata laudadest alusel diagonaalselt paigutatud kaks valget, üksteist veidi katvat ellipsikujulist pinda. Ülemise vasakpoolsega liitub must-valge ruumiliselt kujutatud torujupi motiiv. Alumise ellipsi suunas pikem sama motiiv.
works.de: Two white, slightly overlapping elliptical surfaces placed diagonally on a base of unfinished vertical boards. The upper left one is joined by a black-and-white spatially depicted motif of a pipe section. The same motif, longer, extends towards the lower ellipse.

works.d: Hallikal plangul keskel suur sinakas-hallikais toonides tangide kujutis. Tangide vahel (maali paremas servas) jalgupidi ripnemas väike, suure ümmarguse peaga, hallikas-sinine "kriipsumehike". Plangus mõned suured (sepistatud?) raudnaelad.
works.de: On a greyish plank, in the centre, a large depiction of pliers in bluish-grey tones. Between the pliers (at the right edge of the painting), hanging by its feet, a small, greyish-blue "stick figure" with a large round head. In the plank a few large (forged?) iron nails.

works.d: Helehallil ehitusplangul keskel ülaosas suur sinine kandiline elektripistiku pesa, mille valgetest aukudest väljaulatuvate traatide otsas ripub jalgupidi väike sinakais-lillakais toonides suure ümmarguse peaga "kriipsumehike". Plangu sees mõned suured (sepistatud?) raudnaelad.
works.de: On a light grey construction board, in the centre at the top a large blue rectangular electrical socket, from whose white holes protruding wires hang a small "stick figure" in bluish-purple tones with a large round head, hanging by its feet. Inside the board some large (forged?) iron nails.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipspoissi valmistamas, joonistamas, maalimas. Valgel taustal fotolikult monokroomselt maalitud käed, parem hoiab poolviltu lehte, vasak maalib pintsliga halli kriipspoisi pead-kera.
works.de: A 6-part painting series of men's hands making, drawing, painting a paper stick figure. On a white background, photo-like monochromatically painted hands, the right holding a sheet at an angle, the left painting with a brush the grey stick figure's head-sphere.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipspoissi valmistamas. Vasak käsi hoiab lehte, parem kääridega terashalli, kera-peaga kriipspoissi paberist välja lõikamas. Valge taust, monokroomne fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a paper matchstick figure. The left hand holds a sheet, the right cuts a steel-grey, ball-headed matchstick figure out of the paper with scissors. White background, monochrome photographic manner of depiction.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipsipoissi valmistamas. Vasak käsi hoiab välja lõigatud, volditud terashalli värvi kera-peaga astuvat kriipspoissi parema käe peopeal. Valge taust, monokroomne fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a matchstick figure out of paper. The left hand holds, on the palm of the right hand, a cut-out, folded, steel-grey ball-headed striding matchstick figure. White background, monochrome photographic manner of depiction.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest kriipspoissi valmistamas. Lõuendil vasakul kera-peaga, volditud kehaga terashalli tooni kriipspoiss punktiirjoonena parema käe pihku pissimas. Valge taust, monokroomne fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a stick figure. On the left of the canvas a steel-grey stick figure with a ball-shaped head and folded body, urinating in a dotted line into the palm of the right hand. White background, monochrome photo-like manner of depiction.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest kriipspoissi valmistamas. Vasakul alumises neljandikus kätepaar randmeni, sõrmed vaheliti koos. Valge taust, monokroomselt halliga fotolikult maalitud käed.
works.de: 6-part painting series of male hands making a cardboard-tube figure ("kriipspoiss"). In the lower left quarter a pair of hands to the wrists, fingers interlaced together. White background, hands painted photorealistically, monochromatically in grey.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipspoissi valmistamas. Valgel taustal poolpõigiti hele leht, parem käsi hoiab lehel kollakat joonlauda, vasak pliiatsiga kriipspoisi kontuure joonistamas. Fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a paper cut-out boy. On a white background a bright sheet lies diagonally, the right hand holds a yellowish ruler on the sheet, the left hand draws the contours of the cut-out boy with a pencil. A photographic manner of depiction.

works.d: Vaade auto tagaistmelt: vasakul rooli taga osa sinises jopes mehest (Mäetamm), kõrvalistmel osa noorest mehest (Ole) sõrmega osutamas läbi esiklaasi avanevale rohelisele maastikule, millel valgetest plokktähdest kiri: HOLOCAUST. Maali ülemine osa hall, autolage kujutav, keskel peegel, mis varjab osaliselt CA tähti.
works.de: A view from the back seat of a car: on the left, behind the wheel, part of a man in a blue jacket (Mäetamm), on the passenger seat part of a young man (Ole) pointing his finger at the green landscape opening through the windshield, on which there is text in white block letters: HOLOCAUST. The upper part of the painting is grey, depicting the car ceiling, in the centre a mirror, which partly conceals the letters CA.

works.de: On a uniform grey background, a dark grey round speaker of a music centre placed symmetrically, seen from the front. Mechanically arranged brushstrokes of the same size create an illusory sense of space for the device.

works.d: Valgel foonil vasakus servas suur, maalipinnast reljeefina eenduv hollandi ahi Kadrioru lossist. Ahju kahlid sinise koobaltmaalinguga, lillemustris. Ahju otsas kahvaturoheline lipp ja ees mänguautona mõjuv roheline kastmisauto, tohutu hallikasbeež suitsusammas taga.
works.de: On a white background in the left edge a large Dutch stove from Kadriorg Palace, protruding as a relief from the paint surface. The stove's tiles with blue cobalt painting, in a floral pattern. On top of the stove a pale green flag and in front a green watering truck resembling a toy car, an enormous grey-beige column of smoke behind it.

works.t: Kunstnik R. Rajangu ja abiliste saabumine Viljandisse
works.dm: kõrgus: 182.0 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 286.0 cm
works.d: Ülaosas kujutatud kahte vaipa tsitaatidega vene maalikunstist (Kolm vene vägilast. Aljonuška) vaipkattele maalituna. Keskosas Viljandi kesklinna risttee heleda kahekorruselise hoonega nurgal, reljeefselt vormitud. Maja katusel tumepunane sametlipp. Hoone ees vasakul reljeefne tänavavalgustuspost, vasakult lähenemas veoauto musta sargaga. Maali allosas nurk kireva ornamendiga vaibast. Sellel karnevalikostüümis väike tüdruk kollase olevusega, kiri all: "Õ-JUTA". Paremas alumises nurgas alusel paiknev palmipuu ja lapsekäega joonistatud auto.
works.de: In the upper part, two carpets are depicted with quotations from Russian painting (Three Bogatyrs, Alyonushka) painted onto the carpet coverings. In the central part, the crossroads of Viljandi town centre, at the corner of a light-coloured two-storey building, formed in relief. On the roof of the building a dark red velvet flag. In front of the building on the left a relief street lamp post, a truck with a black box approaching from the left. In the lower part of the painting, the corner of a carpet with colourful ornament. On it, a small girl in a carnival costume with a yellow creature, with the inscription below: "Õ-JUTA". In the lower right corner, a palm tree on a stand and a car drawn with a child's hand.

works.d: Kompositsioon Tartu vana anatoomikumi ja lumememmega. Vasakul roheline kolmnurkse frontooni, pseudosammaste ja rõduga anatoomikumi keskosa, mille külge kinnitatud pärg ning mille ees seisab pruutpaar koos käivitatud auto ja ehitud kuusepuuga. Stseenile peale, anatoomikumi kohale lohakalt maalitud helesinine lumememm ja kaks loomade ja kuusepuudega pilti.
works.de: Composition with the old Tartu Anatomicum and a snowman. On the left, the green central part of the Anatomicum with a triangular pediment, pseudo-columns and a balcony, to which a wreath is attached, and in front of which stands a bridal couple together with a running car and a decorated fir tree. Over the scene, above the Anatomicum, a carelessly painted light blue snowman and two pictures with animals and fir trees.

works.d: Dekoratiivne autoukse kujutis auto seestpoolt vaadatuna. Valgel taustal paksude mustade ümardatud kontuuridega markeeritud ukse üldkuju, akna sulgur, hinged, ukse käepide, aknalink, sisetasku, millest paistab ajakirja nurk kirjaga: NEW SP(EED). The door upholstery is a uniform light blue tone. The colours are applied from behind according to ready-made shapes. At the top right of the work, in black: "UKS"

Allservas valgega kiri: "MEASURING INSTRUMENTS"

On the right a lights and fuel gauge depicted in yellow, white, red. The colour is applied by stencil onto the other side of the plexiglass. At the bottom edge, in white, text: "MEASURING INSTRUMENTS"

works.d: Valge ühtlane taust peene leinaraamistuse ja musta lindiga diagonaalselt paremal alumises nurgas. Keskosas leinakaunistustega puusärk, selles traksipükstes poisi kuju külgvaates, kujutatud must-valgelt. Ülal paremal punases vestis kollane piilupart leinamas. Valmiskujundi koomiksilaadne kujutamisviis.
works.de: A white, even background with a fine mourning frame and a black ribbon diagonally in the lower right corner. In the central section, a coffin with mourning decorations, in which lies the figure of a boy in braced trousers seen in profile, depicted in black and white. Above right, a yellow duckling in a red waistcoat, mourning. The finished design is rendered in a comic-like manner.

works.d: Sinkjasroheline ühtlane taust, millel pastellvärvides leinaküünla kujutised, üla- ja alaääres pitsiline valge kaunistus. Keskmest vasakul tumpunasel-mustal polsteralusel poisi peaga karu kuju istumas otsevaates, must-valgelt kujutatud. Pea juures nn mõttepilved, milles kiri: TRY Me! All paremal kiri: AND SEE WHAT HAPPENS! Valmiskujundi koomiksilaadne dekoratiivne kujutamisviis. Must kontuurjoon ümbritseb kujutatut.
works.de: A uniform bluish-green background, with pastel-coloured depictions of mourning candles, and a lacy white decoration at the top and bottom edges. Left of centre, on a dark red-black upholstered base, the figure of a bear with a boy's head sits, viewed frontally, depicted in black and white. Near the head, so-called thought bubbles, in which is written: TRY Me! Below, on the right, the text: AND SEE WHAT HAPPENS! A comic-like decorative manner of depicting the finished design. A black contour line surrounds the depicted figure.

works.d: Pihtimuslik dialoog ema ja poja vahel, kus viimane justkui iseennast sundides üritab midagi väga olulist emale ära öelda. Mustvalges, dokumentaalsust rõhutava kareda ülesvõttega video põhiosas – esitatud piklikus kinoformaadis, mis lähtematerjalile omakorda  võõritusefekti lisab – domineerib poja dramaatiline eneseavamisponnistus ja ema ning ka vaataja venitatud ootus, et see miski, lõpuks ära öeldud saaks. Seda raamib argisem, värviline ja tavaformaadis lõik kaamera, valguse ja "esinejate" ülessättimisest.
works.de: A confessional dialogue between mother and son, in which the latter, as if forcing himself, tries to say something very important to his mother. In the main part of the video, shot in black and white with a rough, documentary-emphasizing style – presented in an elongated cinematic format, which in turn adds an alienation effect to the source material – the son's dramatic effort at self-disclosure dominates, along with the prolonged expectation of the mother, and also the viewer, that this something will finally be said. This is framed by a more everyday, colour, standard-format segment showing the setting up of the camera, lighting and "performers".
