works.d: Fotofilm remiksib arhiivfotosid Kreenholmi Manufaktuurist kuuldemänguga Elfriede Jelineki näidendist „Mis juhtus pärast seda, kui Nora oma mehe maha oli jätnud ehk Ühiskondade toed“. 1950.-1960. aastatest pärit propagandistlikud mustvalged fotod tekstiilitööstuses töötavatest naistest on asetatud näidendi 15. stseeni konteksti, milles Nora on tulnud vabrikusse, et hoiatada naistöölisi ettevõtte peatse sulgemise eest ja kutsuda neid üles emantsipatsioonile. Teos kuulus 2012. aasta Manifesta kunstibiennaali näitusekomplekti, mille eest Marge Monkole eraldati rahvusvaheliselt mainekas Kesk-Ida-Euroopa kaasaegse kunsti toetamiseks asutatud Henkeli kunstipreemia.
works.de: The photo-film remixes archival photographs from the Kreenholm Manufaktuur with a radio play based on Elfriede Jelinek's play "What Happened After Nora Left Her Husband or Pillars of Society". Black-and-white propagandistic photographs from the 1950s–1960s of women working in the textile industry are placed in the context of the play's 15th scene, in which Nora has come to the factory to warn the female workers of the company's impending closure and to call on them to embrace emancipation. The work was part of the exhibition package of the 2012 Manifesta art biennial, for which Marge Monko was awarded the internationally prestigious Henkel Art Award, established to support contemporary art in Central-Eastern Europe.

works.d: Fotoinstallatsioon kõrgel neljarattalisel heledast puidust konstruktsioonil. Fotol rohekas-kollakate seinte ja trellitatud aknaga tööruum, milles auruvedurit meenutav erinevatest esemetest koosnev kuhi üksteise otsa asetatud plastikpaakidest ja kokkuvolditud pappkarpidest. Kuhja esiküljele kinnitatud Eesti kaart, küljele toetatud ümar isteplaat ja ratas ning otsas keemialabori läbipaistvatest klaasanumatest ehitatud relva meenutav ese ning kõige tipus pesukaussi hoidev harjavars.
works.de: A photo installation on a tall four-wheeled structure made of light-coloured wood. The photo shows a workroom with greenish-yellowish walls and a barred window, in which a pile resembling a steam locomotive is composed of various objects, plastic tanks stacked on top of each other, and folded cardboard boxes. On the front of the pile a map of Estonia is attached, a round seat plate and a wheel are leaned against the side, and at the end an object resembling a weapon built from transparent glass vessels from a chemistry lab, and at the very top a broom handle holding a wash basin.

works.d: Fotoinstallatsioon kõrgel viieharulise jalaga heledast puidust konstruktsioonil. Fotol tühi valgete seinte ja puitparketiga elutuba, mille nurgas tagajalgadel karu meenutav erinevatest esemetest kuhi, mis koosneb küljele keeratud diivanilauast, selle peale asetatud taburetist ja tabureti külge kinnitatud kahest kohvitassist ja juhtmega laualambist.
works.de: A photo installation on a tall five-legged light wood construction. The photo shows an empty living room with white walls and a wooden parquet floor, in the corner of which, standing on its hind legs like a bear, is a pile of various objects, consisting of a coffee table turned on its side, a stool placed on top of it, and two coffee cups attached to the stool along with a corded table lamp.

works.t: Munakeetja-ajaveetja No. PRO-160S-B18 (Egg Cooker – Time Spender No. PRO-160S-B18)
works.d: Fotoinstallatsioon madalal kolmerattalisel kahe toega heledast puidust konstruktsioonil. Fotol rohekates toonides söögikoha köök, mille põrandale ja tööpindadele laotud kõrgetes virnades potte, vaheldumisi klaase ja taldrikuid, klaase ja kausse ning tasse ja alustasse. Osades klaasides valged või pruunid munad, plaaditud vaheseina serval kummuli asetatud klaasid, mille sees samuti munad.
works.de: A photo installation on a low, light-coloured wooden construction with three wheels and two supports. In the photograph, in greenish tones, a restaurant kitchen, on the floor and work surfaces of which pots are stacked in high piles, alternating with glasses and plates, glasses and bowls, and cups and saucers. In some of the glasses there are white or brown eggs; on the edge of a tiled partition, glasses placed upside down, also containing eggs inside.

works.t: Dokumentaalfilm Cubus Larviku Vatiteatri etendusest. Soodevahe Muuseum
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 4.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 6.0 minut
works.d: Dokumentaalfilm Cubus Larviku etendusest Soodevahe linnakus asunud Vatiteatris 2011. aasta sügisel. Õhtupäikeses koguneb seltskond inimesi aknaklaasideta ning laest rippuvate vatiribadega Vatiteatri hoone ümber. Hoonet ümbritsevast kõrgest rohust ilmub üleni vatti mähitud pruuniks võõbatud näoga Cubus Larvik, kes viskab enda ees suuri kilepampusid ja siseneb hoonesse, kus improviseerib erinevate seal leiduvate esemetega. Operaator Sergei Trofimov. Montaaž Timo Toots ja Marika Agu. Helitaust Karl Saks.
works.de: A documentary film of Cubus Larvik's performance at the Vatiteater [Cotton Wool Theatre] located in the small town of Soodevahe in the autumn of 2011. In the evening sunlight, a group of people gathers around the Vatiteater building, which has no window panes and strips of cotton wool hanging from the ceiling. From the tall grass surrounding the building emerges Cubus Larvik, entirely wrapped in cotton wool with his face painted brown, who throws large plastic bundles ahead of himself and enters the building, where he improvises with various objects found there. Camera operator Sergei Trofimov. Editing by Timo Toots and Marika Agu. Sound by Karl Saks.

works.t: Aljona Suržikova dokumentaalfilmi „Not My Land“ treiler. Soodevahe Muuseum
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 9.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 3.0 minut
works.d: Aljona Surzhikova dokumentaalfilmi „Not My Land“ (2013) treiler, mis tutvustab Soodevahe aedlinnaku „elanikke“ – kelle seas ka kunstnik Timo Toots - ning näitab nende reaktsiooni aedlinnaku hoonetele ja aedadele kinnitatud Tallinna Lennujaama lammutusteadetele ja vastavasisulisele uudistele meedias. Operaator Sergei Trofimov.
works.de: A trailer for Aljona Surzhikova's documentary film "Not My Land" (2013), which introduces the "residents" of the Soodevahe garden town - among them the artist Timo Toots - and shows their reaction to the demolition notices of Tallinn Airport attached to the garden town's buildings and gardens, and to the corresponding news in the media. Camera by Sergei Trofimov.

works.d: Dokumentaalfilm Soodevahe linnakus asunud Linnujaama lammutamisest 2012. aasta suvel, mis näitab Tallinna Lennujaama reklaamtahvlitest seinte demonteerimist kunstniku ja kaaslaste poolt kuni alles jääb hoone skelett katusega. Film monteeritud kiirendusega, taustaks filmilindi kerimise heli. Operaator, montaaž ja heli Timo Toots.
works.de: A documentary film about the demolition of the Bird Station in the town of Soodevahe in the summer of 2012, showing the dismantling of the walls made of Tallinn Airport advertising boards by the artist and his companions until only the building's skeleton with the roof remains. The film is edited with time-lapse, with the sound of film reel winding as background. Camera, editing and sound by Timo Toots.

works.t: Dokumentaalfilm Linnujaama stendi ekraanide kogumisest. Soodevahe Muuseum
works.d: Dokumentaalfilm Soodevahe linnakus asunud, juba lammutatud SOMU juures toimetavast kunstnikust, kes sorteerib hoonesse ja selle ümbrusesse visatud jäätmete hulgast Linnujaama stendi loomiseks välja mobiiltelefonide ekraane.
works.de: A documentary film about an artist working at the already-demolished SOMU near the Soodevahe settlement, who sorts through the waste thrown onto the building and its surroundings, selecting mobile phone screens from among it in order to create the Linnujaam stand.

works.d: Lihtsailmelises interjööris istuvate kolme mehe poolprofiilis. works.de: Three men sitting in a plain interior, shown in half-profile. On the left a man with a cap and side whiskers, almost in full profile to the right, pointing with his left hand towards those sitting opposite, while his right hand holds a double-barrelled shotgun resting on the floor. On the right an older man wearing a lakki-type cap, in profile to the left. His right hand holds a curved pipe in his teeth, his left hand rests on his knees. Between the two, seen frontally, a young peasant man in a felt hat and folk costume.

In the middle, on a bridge crossing the river, a woman driving cows. On the left a flat plain stretching to the horizon, a small wood beyond the bridge on the limestone ground.

works.de: Half-figure of an old peasant with long hair and a chin beard, holding a pipe to his mouth with both hands, wearing a long coat, in a slight turn to the left.

works.d: Pikkade juustega, viltkaabuga mehe rinnapilt kerges pöördes vasakule. Valge kaelus, pruunikas kuub. Lõuendi servad valged.
works.de: Chest portrait of a long-haired man with a felt hat, in a slight turn to the left. White collar, brownish coat. The edges of the canvas are white.

works.d: Keset lõuendit, roosakate paeltega vasakule ja paremale kaskedele riputatud, ümmargune pilt maja kujutisega. Esiplaanil vasakul, kaskede all, päkapikk õllekannuga. Ümmarguse pildi ümber kolm kooldunud lehte. Ülal vasakul värava, paremal kiriku, all maastiku kujutisega.
works.de: In the middle of the canvas, hung on birches to the left and right with pink ribbons, a round picture depicting a house. In the foreground on the left, under the birches, a gnome with a beer jug. Around the round picture, three curled leaves. Above left a depiction of a gate, on the right a church, below a landscape.

works.d: Laua ümber viis meest, neist neli istuvad ja üks, vasakul kaabuga, seisab, toetudes parema käega tooli seljatoele.
works.de: Five men around a table, four of them seated and one, on the left, wearing a hat, standing, leaning with his right hand on the back of a chair.

works.d: Jõemaastik. Esiplaanil hulk hanesid ja punase rätiku, sinise seelikuga naine selgvaates. Üle jõe, paremal, pajud jõekaldal; kaugemal, keskel, tuulik ja sellest paremal majakatus suitseva korstnaga.
works.de: River landscape. In the foreground a number of geese and a woman in a red kerchief and blue skirt, shown in a frontal view. Across the river, on the right, willows on the riverbank; further away, in the middle, a windmill and to the right of it a house roof with a smoking chimney.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks küngast. Vasakpoolsel hulk mände, parempoolsel kaks mändi ja naise figuur selgvaates, kerviga. Maali parempoolses osas avaneb vaade üle lausmaastiku kaugusesse, kus sinendava metsa vahelt valendab üksik puri.
Esiplaanil Kremli müürid torniga. Taamal kaks kirikut valgete seinte ja kuldsete kuplitega.
works.de: In the foreground the walls of the Kremlin with a tower. In the background two churches with white walls and golden domes.

works.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt profiilis paremale punases, lõua alla seotud rätikus. Seljas rohelise-beeži triibuline jakk.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in profile to the right, in a red kerchief tied under the chin. Wearing a green-and-beige striped jacket.

works.d: Kiriku sisemus altari ja kantsliga. Keskel altarimaal ristilöödud Kristuse kujutisega.
works.de: The interior of a church with an altar and a pulpit. In the centre an altar painting depicting the crucified Christ.

works.d: Lõuendil viltu vasakult paremale maalitud tume leht, millele maalitud mehe rinnaportree profiilis paremale.
works.de: On the canvas, painted diagonally from left to right, a dark leaf, on which is painted a man's chest portrait in profile to the right.

works.d: Vanema mehe täisfiguur kolmveerand profiilis paremale, torukübaras, kott kaelas, kepp paremas käes.
works.de: Full figure of an older man in three-quarter profile to the right, wearing a top hat, a bag around the neck, a cane in the right hand.

works.d: Keskel teel eemalduv ühehobuse vanker, millel istub mees piitsaga käes. Vankril puunõu. Vankri kõrval vasakul lehm. Tagapool horisondil mets, mille ees paremal sõiduk, kooguga kaev, küün ja üksik puu.
works.de: In the middle of the road, a receding one-horse cart on which a man sits holding a whip. A wooden vessel on the cart. Beside the cart on the left a cow. Further back on the horizon a forest, in front of which on the right a vehicle, a well with a sweep, a barn and a solitary tree.

works.d: Kolletaval põllul mehe täisfiguur külgvaates vasakule seisvas asendis vikatit löe külge sidumas.
works.de: In a yellowing field, the full figure of a man in side view, standing facing left, tying a scythe to its handle.

works.d: Kollendaval põllul naine otsevaates tumedas üleskeeratud seelikus ja heledas särgis, rehaga riisumas.
works.de: On a yellowing field a woman seen frontally in a dark rolled-up skirt and a light shirt, raking with a rake.

works.t: Kolme eestlase vestlus / Keskustele / Kolm meest / Eestipärane
works.dm: graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 9.5 cm; lehe laius: 10.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 13.3 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 11.8 cm

works.de: In the interior two peasant men sitting at a table, on the right beside them a peasant man with a thoughtful expression standing, holding a pipe. All are wearing long coats.

works.de: A man's head, almost in full profile to the right, with the right hand holding a pipe in the mouth. On the head a fox-fur hat, on the neck a high white collar. Dark background.

works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man in profile to the left. Dark clothing, a wooden flask on his back. Black hat, a stick in his right hand, left hand holding the flask's straps.

works.d: Vasakul põld kündjaga. Tagaplaanil talumajad. Paremal puude grupp majadega. Koloriit pruunikas-roheline.
works.de: On the left a field with a ploughman. In the background farm houses. On the right a group of trees with houses. Colouring brownish-green.

Behind the house a pole fence running to the left and to the right. In the middle right of the sheet a two-masted sailboat without sails. Above, a sketch of thatched roofs. On the verso of the sheet sketches of buildings with thatched roofs.

works.d: Kivine rand üksiku puu ja kaugemal asuva kuuriga. Kaldal, kivide vahel mastidega paadid.
works.de: Rocky shore with a solitary tree and a shed farther away. On the shore, among the rocks, boats with masts.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu tammiga, selle taga majake, taamal puud.

works.de: In the foreground, piles of stumps and stones rising from the river. On the bank, a wooden fence. In the distance, thatched-roof farm buildings at the edge of the forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu äärest kerkiv kõrge kallas puudega. Sellest vasakul kauguses paistmas põõsad ja õlgkatusega hooned.
works.de: In the foreground, a high bank with trees rising from the edge of a body of water. To the left of it, in the distance, bushes and thatched-roof buildings are visible.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
works.d: Lehel all vasakul tundmatu päritoluga põõsastaim, üleval kanad õrrel, keskel maja, selle tagant paistmas üksikud puud.
works.de: At the lower left of the sheet, a shrub of unknown origin, above hens on a perch, in the centre a house, behind which individual trees are visible.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.9 cm; lehe laius: 28.0 cm
works.d: Suure jändriku lehtpuu visand.
works.de: Sketch of a large gnarled deciduous tree.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.9 cm; lehe laius: 28.0 cm
works.d: Vasakul ääres kapis visandid. Kaane kavandil all küllusesarve motiive, kõrval ja ülal trofeede ja lippude motiive.
works.de: On the left edge, sketches in a cabinet. On the cover design below, motifs of cornucopias, beside and above motifs of trophies and flags.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtukasvanud veekogu kaldal üksik paat, vaia külge kinnitatuna. Suured harali juurtega puud, üksik teerada, taamal jalakäija suundumas puude vahelt paistva maja poole.
works.de: In the foreground, on the bank of a grass-grown body of water, a solitary boat, tied to a stake. Large trees with spreading roots, a solitary footpath, in the distance a pedestrian heading towards a house visible through the trees.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.9 cm; lehe laius: 28.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil avar pargitee puudega mõlemas ääres. Pikas tualetis daam päevavarjuga jalutamas tütarlapsega. Murul skulptuure, kaugemal põõsad ja poolavatud värav.
works.de: In the foreground a spacious park path with trees on both sides. A lady in a long gown with a parasol walking with a girl. Sculptures on the lawn, further away bushes and a half-open gate.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.9 cm; lehe laius: 28.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil neljaharuline lehtpuu maani ulatuvate okstega.
works.de: In the foreground a four-branched deciduous tree with branches reaching to the ground.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu kivilaidudega. Kaugemal puude vahel viljakuivati ja aed. Taevas kergelt pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with rocky islets. Further away, among trees, a grain drying barn and a garden. The sky is slightly cloudy.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi, kivisild. Silla taga üksik hoone korstnata. Vasakul rukkipõld, kivitara ning mets.
works.de: In the foreground a river, a stone bridge. Behind the bridge a single building without a chimney. On the left a rye field, a stone fence and a forest.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, taamal kiviaiast piiratud põld, teerada paremale. Metsa taustal üksik maja. Vasakul all nurgas näha kustutatud maja jälgi.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, in the distance a field bordered by a stone wall, a path leading to the right. In the background forest with a single house. In the lower left corner traces of an erased house can be seen.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil kivist barjääriga sild, selle taga kergelt varjutatud põõsastik.
works.de: In the foreground a bridge with a stone barrier, behind it a lightly shaded shrubbery.

works.d: Ees vasakul, lagedal õuel, istuv naise figuur. Taga vasakul teivasaia ääres hobune. Keskel ja paremal õlgkatusega hooned. Keskmise hoone ees heinakoorem. (õliskits)
works.de: In front on the left, in an open yard, a seated female figure. Behind on the left, by a pole fence, a horse. In the centre and on the right thatched-roof buildings. In front of the middle building a haystack. (oil sketch)

works.d: Noore ruugejuukselise naise rinnapilt otsevaates - keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Pikad juuksed koondatud kohevil soengus kõrvu vabaks jätvalt ülesse. Õhulisest materjalist heledat tooni kleidi sügava väljalõikega sallkaelus eest lõdvas sõlmes.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young reddish-haired woman in frontal view - body slightly turned to the left. Long hair gathered up in a fluffed-up hairstyle leaving the ears bare. A light-coloured dress of airy material with a deep scarf-collar neckline, loosely knotted in front.

works.d: Vana naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis, käed süles - profiilis (peaaegu) paremale. Seljas hall triibuline kleit, peas lahtiselt valge rätt.
works.de: Half-figure of an old woman in a seated position, hands in the lap - (almost) in profile to the right. Wearing a grey striped dress, on the head a loosely tied white kerchief.

works.dm: kõrgus: 97.0 cm; laius: 78.5 cm; kõrgus: 99.0 cm; laius: 76.5 cm (vm)
works.d: Naise poolfiguur profiilis paremale istuvas asendis, vasakul käel hoiab last, paremas taldrikut kirssidega. Taustaks paremal figuurikujutisega gobelään.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in profile, seated facing right, holding a child with her left hand, a plate with cherries in her right. In the background on the right a tapestry with figural depiction.

works.d: Talu karjaõues esialal paremal mustvalge kirju lehma juures lüpsmisasendis naine suunaga vasemale. Keskel, selgvaates sama tõugu lehma kõrval püsti punakat tooni seelikuga naine. Pildi mõlemal äärel paistvaid majandushooneid ühendava tara tagant paistab talu puhasõu ja õlgkatusega rehielamu. Visand teostatud üldjooneliselt.
works.de: In a farm cattle yard, on the right foreground, a woman in milking position by a black-and-white patterned cow, facing left. In the centre, in full view, a woman in a reddish-coloured skirt standing beside a cow of the same breed. On both edges of the picture, farm outbuildings connected by a fence can be seen, behind which the farmyard and a straw-roofed threshing barn are visible. The sketch is executed in general outlines.

works.d: Kiilaspäise, hallide vurrudega vanemas eas mehe põlvportree istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis vasakule. Vasak käsi nõjatub tooli külgtoele kusjuures sõrmed puudutavad reit, parem käsi hoiab kinni tooli külgtoest. Riietuseks tume pintsakülikond ja tärgeldatud püstkrae ja kätistega särk. Taust punast tooni; vasakul ülal perekonna vapi kujutis - lõvi kõveral mõõgal - selle kõrval pealkiri "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"
works.de: Knee-length portrait of an elderly bald man with grey moustaches, seated, in three-quarter profile to the left. The left hand rests on the side support of the chair, with the fingers touching the thigh, the right hand holds onto the side support of the chair. Dressed in a dark suit jacket and a shirt with a starched stand-up collar and cuffs. The background is a red tone; at upper left, a depiction of the family coat of arms - a lion on a curved sword - next to it the title "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"

works.d: Heledate, rinnale langevate lahtiste juustega tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis. Kätega toetub istme seljatoele. Seljas hall rohekas riietus.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl with light, loose hair falling to the chest, in a sitting position. Supporting herself with her hands on the back of the seat. Wearing greyish-green clothing.

works.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur seistes parem külg vaataja poole, pea pööratud otse. Kõrvade juures lahtiseid juuksekiharaid, taga patsikene musta paelaga. Hallikas-sinine kinnise kraega riietus.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl, seated, right side towards the viewer, head turned straight ahead. Loose curls of hair near the ears, a small braid behind tied with a black ribbon. Grayish-blue clothing with a closed collar.

works.d: Vasemal pikkade juustega halli pika habemega vanamehe rindporree 3/4 profiilis paremale. Paremal heledate juustega tütarlapse rindportree profiilis paremale. Juustes roosakas lint.
works.de: On the left a bust portrait of an old man with long hair and a long grey beard, in 3/4 profile facing right. On the right a bust portrait of a girl with fair hair, in profile facing right. A pinkish ribbon in her hair.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelisel murul, metsa veerel grupp mehi ja naisi. Taustaks mets.
works.de: In the foreground on green grass, at the edge of a forest, a group of men and women. Forest as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul naine kummargil pesuküna kohal. Tagapool last süles hoidev mees. Taustal keskel õlgkatusega palkhoone.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a woman bent over a washtub. Behind her a man holding a child. In the background, a log building with a thatched roof in the centre.

works.d: Maali keskel naine lehma lüpsmas, selgvaates. Naise riietus: tume seelik, helesinine pluus, punane pearätik. Naisest vasakul kaks vasikat, paremal lehm. Taustaks laut ja palkhoone õlgkatusega nurk.
works.de: In the middle of the painting a woman milking a cow, shown frontally. The woman's clothing: dark skirt, light blue blouse, red headscarf. To the left of the woman two calves, to the right a cow. In the background a barn and the corner of a log building with a thatched roof.

works.d: Mehe rindportree profiilis paremale. Üle pea kammitud, kaelani ulatuvad juuksed (pruunid, kõrva kohal hallid). Pruun-rohekas kuub, punane kaelarätik.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in profile to the right. Hair combed over the head, reaching to the neck (brown, grey above the ear). Brown-greenish coat, red neckerchief.

works.d: Vasakul lattaia juures pink, millel istuvad kaks naist ja üks mees. Samas selgvaates laps, pööratud peaga vaataja poole. Tagapool, maja avatud uksel seisev naine.
Vasakul maja avatud uksel istumas käsitööd tegev naine. Temast paremal riietesse mässitud laps.
works.de: On the left a woman doing handwork sitting in an open doorway of a house. To her right a child wrapped in clothes.

works.d: Ees lage muruplats, tagapool õlgkatusega hooned. Paremal tara ääres seisev mees lapsega süles. Vasakul lehm tara ääres.
works.de: In front, a bare grassy area, behind it thatched-roof buildings. On the right, a man standing by the fence with a child in his arms. On the left, a cow by the fence.

works.d: Vanema naise pea veerandpöördes vasakule. Peas kohevil valge peakate. Seljas pruun mustaga kirjatud rõivastus.
works.de: Head of an older woman in quarter-turn to the left. Fluffed white headdress on the head. Wearing brown clothing patterned with black.

works.d: Pikkade juuste ja lopsaka habemega vanema mehe rindportree. Pea kolmveerand pöördes paremale. Peas must müts. Seljas tumepunane riietus.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man with long hair and a bushy beard. Head turned three-quarters to the right. Black cap on his head. Dark red clothing.

works.d: Istuva vana naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Käed süles. Must kleit, must rätik peas.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated old woman, frontal view. Hands in lap. Black dress, black kerchief on head.

works.d: Seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasakule. Vuntsid ja hallid juuksed, must ülikond, paremas käes sigar.
works.de: Full figure of a standing man in profile to the left. Moustache and grey hair, black suit, a cigar in his right hand.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaseoksa küljes rippuv häll lapsega. Tagapool kaskedega piiratud lagendikul naine riisumas.
works.de: In the foreground a cradle with a child hanging from a birch branch. Beyond, on a clearing bordered by birches, a woman raking.

works.d: C.R. Jakobsoni põlvportree: kerge kehapööre paremale, parem käsi hoiab kuuerevääri.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of C.R. Jakobson: slight turn of the body to the right, right hand holding the lapel of his coat.

works.d: Punase-sinisetriibulises seelikus ja valges pluusis istuv neiu sukka kudumas. Seinal vasakul lillekirjaline rätt.
works.de: A young woman sitting in a red-blue striped skirt and white blouse, knitting a stocking. On the wall on the left, a floral-patterned scarf.

works.d: Turustseen hulga inimeste ja suurte päikesevarjudega müügilettide kohal. Tagaplaanil monument ratsafiguuriga.
works.de: Market scene with many people and large sunshades above the sales stalls. In the background a monument with an equestrian figure.

works.d: Suvine talumaastik kolme hoonega paremal. Taevas vasakul hele valgusviirg.
works.de: Summer rural landscape with three buildings on the right. On the left in the sky a bright streak of light.

works.d: Hämar suvemaastik üksiku hoonega keskel ja puudegruppidega paremal ja vasakul. Silmapiir väga madalal.
works.de: Dim summer landscape with a single building in the middle and groups of trees on the right and left. The horizon very low.

works.d: Lage liivane rand kahe männiga vasakul. Eemal meri.
works.de: Bare sandy beach with two pines on the left. Sea in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõekäär ja roheline aas üksikute puudega. Silmapiir kõrge.
works.de: In the foreground a river bend and a green meadow with scattered trees. High horizon.

works.d: Tooli seljatoele nõjatuv tumedais riideis ja nokkmütsis vanem mees.

works.de: A bust portrait of a middle-aged woman with a round face, hair combed back. Soft facial features; wearing a dark dress with a V-shaped neckline.

works.de: Seated three-quarter figure of a young, red-cheeked girl. Head turned to the right. Hands folded in her lap. Dark background.

works.d: Suurte halliseguste vuntside ja lõuahabemega keskealise mehe otsevaates rinnaportree. Lõua alt paistab kitsas valge kaelus.
works.de: A frontal bust portrait of a middle-aged man with large grey-streaked moustache and chin beard. A narrow white collar shows beneath the chin.

works.d: Mustas, sulgedega kübaras keskealise pehmete näojoontega naise rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale. Ülal servas vasakul kiri: M.N. 138
works.de: Bust portrait, in half-turn to the right, of a middle-aged woman with soft facial features, in a black feathered hat. In the upper left corner, an inscription: M.N. 138

works.d: Mustjaspruunide, kuklale seotud kergelt lainetavate juutsega musta riietatud naise profiilportree paremale. Juustes pärlinöör. Sirge, veidi ülespidine nina. Tume hallikasroheline foon.
works.de: Profile portrait facing right of a woman dressed in black, with dark brown, slightly wavy hair tied at the nape. A string of pearls in her hair. A straight, slightly upturned nose. Dark greyish-green background.

works.d: Heledate hallikaspruunide, kuklale seotud juustega rohelisse riietatud naise poolprofiilportree paremale, pea kallutatud paremale, langetatud pilguga. Lühike nina, punased lopsakad põsed, terav lõug. Hall taust.

Hallikate, kuklale seotud juustega musta riietatud naise poolprofiilportree paremale, ülestõstetud pilguga. Püstise laubaga ja kitsa näo etteulatuva alaosaga, terava ninaga, suurte silmadega. Pruunikaspunane foon.
Motiiv vanalt kalmistult: üksikud ristid, valgetüvelised kased; tagapoolt paistab kabel, mille avatud uksest näha küünalde valgust, kabeli  ümber matuserongi tume siluett.
works.de: A motif from an old cemetery: solitary crosses, white-trunked birches; behind, a chapel is visible, through whose open door the light of candles can be seen, around the chapel the dark silhouette of a funeral procession.

works.d: Eesti talumehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes vasakule, kõrge laup, pikad juuksed, lühike hall habe ümbritseb lõuga. Vammusel kaks rida nööpe. Tumepruun värvigamma.
works.de: Bust portrait of an Estonian peasant man in a slight turn to the left, high forehead, long hair, short grey beard surrounding the chin. Two rows of buttons on the tunic. Dark brown colour scheme.

works.dm: laius: 26.0 cm (klaasitud, kitsas kuldliist); kõrgus: 34.0 cm
works.d: Heledapäise tüdruku pea profiilis vasakule. Lühikesed juuksed kergeis laineis, seljas lillakas-hall kleit. Taust roheline.
works.de: Head of a fair-haired girl in profile to the left. Short hair in gentle waves, wearing a purplish-grey dress. Background green.

works.d: Esiplaanil hallis toonis põld, millel korvid ja kott, põllu servas seisab mehefiguur. Tagapool kitsas rohekas maariba, eraldatud mere poolt aiaga. Heledas taevas pilved markeeritud tumedamate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground a field in grey tones, with baskets and a bag on it, a male figure standing at the edge of the field. Behind it a narrow greenish strip of land, separated from the sea by a fence. In the light sky, clouds marked with darker brushstrokes.

works.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud tükike rohelist maastikku, milles eralduvad kolm jämedat puutüve keskplaanil ja hõre põõsas paremal.
works.de: A patch of green landscape painted with lush brushstrokes, in which three thick tree trunks stand out in the middle ground and a sparse bush on the right.

works.d: Hallides toonides foonil pruunis ümaras vaasis kimp sireleid. Vaasi all tumesinine, - punaste laikudega riie. Vaasil suur ovaalne sinine laik.
works.de: Against a background in grey tones, a bunch of lilacs in a round brown vase. Under the vase a dark blue cloth with red spots. On the vase a large oval blue spot.

works.d: Pildi keskel lookleva sillutamata tänava ääres vasakul hoogsate pintslilöökidega maalitud pruun ning selle kõrval valge akendeta maja. Pildi paremas servas valge maja ots, mille katust varjab pooleldi paremat ülanurka täitev roheline lehestik. All paremal laiade pintslilöökidega markeeritud kiviaed. Vasakul ülanurgas sinist, valkjashallide pilvedega taevast.
works.de: In the centre of the picture, along a winding unpaved street, on the left a brown house painted with sweeping brushstrokes, and next to it a white house without windows. On the right edge of the picture, the end of a white house, whose roof is half-hidden by green foliage filling the upper right corner. Lower right, a stone wall marked with broad brushstrokes. In the upper left corner, a blue sky with whitish-grey clouds.

works.d: Taluõuel, vasakul, kaevul mees vett pumpamas, samas kõrval, joogiküna juures kaks lehma. Pildi paremas servas naisefiguur tema juures rüselevate lammastega. Taamal, lattaia taga taluhooned. Värvigammas valdavad pruunid toonid.
works.de: In the farmyard, on the left, at the well a man pumping water, next to him, at the drinking trough two cows. On the right edge of the picture a female figure with sheep jostling around her. In the distance, behind a picket fence, farm buildings. Brown tones predominate in the colour range.

works.d: Esiplaanil põllusiilul kummargil figuur, tema taga seisev mees ning sinises seelikus naine. Siin-seal maas rukkivihud. Taamal tuulik. Maalimislaad etüüdlik. Värvipilt - hele.
works.de: In the foreground a figure bent over a stack of grain in the field, behind her a standing man and a woman in a blue skirt. Sheaves of rye lie here and there on the ground. A windmill in the distance. Sketch-like painting style. Bright colour scheme.

works.d: Hallide, õlgadele langevate juuste ning habemega vanamehe peaetüüd, pöördega vasakule. Pea kummardatud ette, suu kergelt avatud.
works.de: Head study of an old man with grey hair falling to the shoulders and a beard, turned to the left. Head bowed forward, mouth slightly open.

works.d: Esiplaanil kasetüvi, vasakul oksa küljes ripub punutud häll. Selles istukile tõusnud valges särgis laps veerandpöördes paremale, vaatab ja naeratab oksal istuvale kirjule linnule. Tagapool lagendikul heina riisuv noor naine poolkummargil, pilk pööratud linnule. Naisel seljas valge pluus ja peakate, pikitriibuline seelik. Taamal, heleda, üksikute pilvedega taeva all lagendikku piiravad käharad puud. Maal pastelses rohekas koloriidis, värvikiht õhuke.
works.de: In the foreground, a birch trunk, on the left a woven cradle hangs from a branch. In it, a child in a white shirt, having risen to a sitting position, turned a quarter to the right, looks and smiles at a mottled bird sitting on the branch. Further back in the clearing, a young woman raking hay, bent halfway over, her gaze turned toward the bird. The woman wears a white blouse and a headscarf, a longitudinally striped skirt. In the distance, under a light sky with isolated clouds, curly trees border the clearing. The painting is in a pastel greenish colouring, the paint layer thin.

works.d: Esiplaanil kiviaiaga ääristatud karjatee, sellel kaks lehma. Ees paremal, aia ääres seisev naine. Tagapool vasakul taluhooned, paremal mereäärne. Maal pruunikashallis koloriidis.
works.de: In the foreground a cattle path bordered by a stone wall, with two cows on it. In front on the right, a woman standing by the wall. Beyond, on the left, farm buildings, on the right the seaside. The painting in a brownish-grey colour scheme.

works.d: Hämaras ruumis toolil istuv mees profiilis vasakule. Mehel pikemad ülepea kammitud juuksed, põskhabe. Seljas tume kuub, põlvpüksid punaste tuttidega, pastlad jalas. Käed süles, paremaga hoiab kollakat karpi. Vasak jalg kõverdatult tooli jala juures. Tagapool paremal naise figuur. Maal tihketes hallides toonides.
works.de: A man sitting on a chair in a dim room, in profile to the left. The man has longer hair combed back over his head, a beard on the cheeks. Wearing a dark coat, knee breeches with red tassels, sandals on his feet. Hands in his lap, holding a yellowish box with the right. Left leg bent by the leg of the chair. Behind, on the right, a woman's figure. The painting in dense grey tones.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 28.0 cm (km); lehe laius: 47.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 38.6 cm; kujutise laius: 34.0 cm (km)
works.d: Pruunikashallil põllul paremal kolm mustendavat kartulivagu. Kaks naist äärmisel vasakpoolsel vaol, eespoolne kummargil, toetub parema käega korvile, selgvaates, tagumine otsevaates. Tagapool, paremal mees hobusega. Silmapiiril vasakul lage maastik, paremal puudegrupp ja talu. Maal hallikaspruunis, samblarohelises koloriidis.
works.de: On a brownish-grey field, three blackening potato furrows on the right. Two women on the leftmost furrow, the one in front bent over, resting with her right hand on a basket, seen in profile, the one behind in a frontal view. Further back, on the right, a man with a horse. On the horizon, on the left an open landscape, on the right a group of trees and a farm. The painting is in a greyish-brown, moss-green colour scheme.

works.d: Mustal taustal hallipäise, vuntsidega mehe pea veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel sinised silmad, heledad kulmud, sirge nina. Nägu piklik, roosakas jumega. Punakas kaelus. Näo osas maal pastoossem.
works.de: Against a black background, the head of a grey-haired, moustached man in a quarter-turn to the right. The man has blue eyes, light eyebrows, a straight nose. The face is elongated, with a rosy complexion. Reddish collar. The face area of the painting is more pastose.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree, profiilis. Tugev, veidi kongus nina, kitsad, kokkusurutud huuled, väikesed, sügaval asetsevad silmad. Suu ümbruses teravalt väljajoonistatud kortsud. Peas kaabu, seljas tume, pruunikas kuub. Värvigamma tume.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man, in profile. Strong, slightly hooked nose, narrow, pressed-together lips, small, deep-set eyes. Sharply defined wrinkles around the mouth. Wearing a hat on his head, a dark, brownish coat. Dark colour scheme.

works.d: Heledapäise tütarlapse portree. Pea poolpöördes vasakule. Suurte, sügaval asetsevate, tumedate silmade pilk suunatud vaatajale. Lõua otsas lohk. Seljas lillakasroosa ja valge triibuline rõivastus.
works.de: Portrait of a fair-haired girl. Head in a half-turn to the left. The gaze of large, deep-set, dark eyes directed at the viewer. A dimple at the tip of the chin. Wearing purplish-pink and white striped clothing.

works.d: Vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur. Ülakeha veidi vasakule painutatud, pea kergelt ette kallutatud; käed rüpes. Seljas valged käised, mille kinniseks silmadega prees. Pead katab tumepruun rätt. Koloriit tume.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an older woman. Upper body bent slightly to the left, head tilted slightly forward; hands in her lap. Wearing white sleeves fastened with an eyelet brooch. Head covered with a dark brown kerchief. Dark colouring.

works.t: Onu Paul punases kampsunis ja ema. Lõpetamata
works.d: Esiplaanil istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, keha pöördes vasakule, vaade otse. Seljas punane, peente tumedate triipudega kampsun, peas karusnahkne müts. Taga vasakul seisab tumedas rõivastuses naine, pea poolpöördes paremale, käed kõverdatud vöökoha kõrgusele.
works.de: In the foreground, three-quarter figure of a seated man, body turned to the left, gaze straight ahead. Wearing a red sweater with fine dark stripes, a fur cap on his head. Behind, on the left, stands a woman in dark clothing, head in a half-turn to the right, arms bent at waist height.

works.d: Heledate vurrudega noore mehe rinnaportree. Vaade otse, keha kergelt vasakule pööratud. Seljas tume kuub ning hele särk, kaelas must kikilips. Peas, veidi üles koolutatud servadega kaabu. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young man with light-colored moustache. Facing straight ahead, body turned slightly to the left. Wearing a dark coat and a light shirt, a black bow tie at the neck. On his head, a hat with slightly upturned brim. Sketch-like painting style.

works.d: Vasakul, lahtiaetud kartulivagude vahel, viis naisefiguuri. Esiplaanil olev seisab, käed külgedel, keha kergelt pöördes paremale; seljas roosakas jakk. Taustaks kitsas meretriip ja pilvine taevas.
works.de: On the left, between opened-up potato furrows, five female figures. The one in the foreground stands with her hands at her sides, body turned slightly to the right; wearing a pinkish jacket. Background a narrow strip of sea and a cloudy sky.

works.d: Vanema mehe profiilportree. Suu kergelt avatud, pilk suunatud otse ette. Kaelas ookritoonis kaelarätt, seljas tume kuub. Foon hele, paremal tume.
Paremal, pildi sügavusse looklev hall teelint. Vasakul, teeveerul valge hobune vankriga. Paremas servas paistab tükike kiviaeda ning maja otsasein. Taamal puud-põõsad, paar inimfiguuri, kooguga kaev.
works.de: On the right, a grey road winding into the depth of the picture. On the left, at the roadside, a white horse with a cart. In the right margin a piece of stone wall and the gable end of a house are visible. In the distance trees and bushes, a couple of human figures, a well with a sweep.

works.d: Kahvatusinise taeva taustal kerkib madala kellatorniga kirik. Kirikuesisel suuremate ja väiksemate gruppidena värvikates rahvariietes inimesed. Esiplaanil, all vasakus nurgas, valge hobune reega, selles istuva naise ning rakendi kõrval sammuva pruunis pikkkuues mehega. Koloriit hele. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
works.de: Against a background of pale blue sky rises a church with a low bell tower. In front of the church, larger and smaller groups of people in colourful folk costumes. In the foreground, in the lower left corner, a white horse with a sledge, in which a woman sits, with a man in a brown long coat walking beside the harness. Light coloring. Painted in a study-like manner.

works.d: Koidueelse taeva taustal, käed rinnal kaugusesse vaatava mehe poolfiguur, profiilis vasakule.
works.de: Against the background of a pre-dawn sky, a half-figure of a man with hands on chest looking into the distance, in profile facing left.

works.d: Kikkhabemega mehe poolprofiil paremale. Tume, mustjas-lillakas taust.
works.de: Half-profile of a man with a goatee, facing right. Dark, blackish-purple background.

works.d: Ees vasakul rannariba maasse taotud pikkade vaiadega. Tagapool, vasakul, merre tungiv maanina üksiku männiga. Horisondil kollane viirg.
works.de: In the front left a strip of shore with long stakes driven into the ground. Further back, on the left, a headland extending into the sea with a solitary pine. On the horizon a yellow strip.

works.d: Istuva vana naise poolfiguur väikses püüdega paremale. Tumedas kleidis. Käed ristamisi süles.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated old woman, small, striving to the right. In a dark dress. Hands crossed in her lap.

works.d: Lahekäär. Esiplaanil madal klint sellel kasvate taimedega, mis pildivälja keskel ulatub liigendatud neemena paremale merre; ees paremal moodustub väike lahesopp. Tagaplaanil ulatub pika kitsa ribana paremale merre neem. Üleval väga kitsas taevaosa.
works.de: A bay inlet. In the foreground a low bluff with plants growing on it, which in the centre of the picture field extends as an articulated headland to the right into the sea; on the right in front a small bay inlet is formed. In the background a headland extends as a long, narrow strip to the right into the sea. Above, a very narrow strip of sky.

works.t: a) Otepää maastik; b) Daami portree
works.d: Tagaplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kuppel üksiku kase ja ees vasakul jalamil kasvavate sihvakate kuuskedega. Esiplaanil paremal künka jalam selle tagant paistvate kuusekroonidega. Ees vasakul looklev oja. Tagaplaanil lainjas metsasiluett. Taevas valged ja roosakad rünkpilved.
works.de: In the background, on the left in the golden section, a dome with a solitary birch and, in front on the left, slender spruces growing at its base. In the foreground on the right, the foot of a hill with spruce crowns visible behind it. In front on the left a winding stream. In the background a wavy forest silhouette. The sky with white and pinkish cumulus clouds.

works.d: Pildipinna keskel lohkjas tasandik pikliku kujuga järvega esiplaanil künkjaste vallide vahel, üksiku majaga puude vahel tasandiku vasakus servas. Esiplaanil vasakul järvesopp selle taga kasvavate kaskedega. Ees paremal künka jalam, selle taga kaks kaske. Silmapiiril kõrgendikel lehtpuude salud. Taevas pastoossed ebamäärased pilved. Maalil hele värvigamma.
works.de: In the centre of the picture surface, a hollow plain of elongated shape with a lake, in the foreground between hillocky ridges, with a solitary house among trees on the left edge of the plain. In the foreground on the left, a bay of the lake with birches growing behind it. In front on the right, the foot of a hill, behind it two birches. On the horizon, on elevated ground, groves of deciduous trees. The sky has pastose, indistinct clouds. The painting has a light colour palette.

works.d: Lohkjas maastik madalate laugjate küngaste vahel, kitsa lookleva jõekesega diagonaalselt maali vasakust alumisest nurgast. Pildivälja keskplaanil paremast äärest vasaku kuldlõikeni kulgev kitsas põõsastesalu kahe heledama lehtpuuga selle lõpus. Tagaplaanil paremas kuldlõikes maja puude vahel. Silmapiiril kogu maali laiuse ulatuses sinetav metsatriip. Taevas lillakasroosad valged rünkpilved. Maali värvigamma - heledates toonides.
works.de: A hollowed landscape between low, gently sloping hills, with a narrow winding river running diagonally from the lower left corner of the painting. In the middle ground of the picture plane, from the right edge to the left golden section, a narrow grove of bushes with two lighter-coloured deciduous trees at its end. In the background, at the right golden section, a house among trees. On the horizon, across the whole width of the painting, a bluish strip of forest. In the sky, purplish-pink white cumulus clouds. The painting's colour scheme is in light tones.

works.d: Tüüpiline Lõuna-Eesti järve-, metsatukkade-, nõlvakutega maastik: esiplaanil rohekad, kollakad ja punakad põllulapid, keskplaanil järv, millesse ulatub vasakul, peaaegu pildi servani, maanina; keskel ümarakujuline metsane saar; tagaplaanil uuesti punakad nõlvakud, taevas rahutuis pilvedes.
works.de: A typical South Estonian landscape with a lake, groves and slopes: in the foreground greenish, yellowish and reddish plots of farmland, in the middle ground a lake, into which, on the left, a spit of land extends almost to the edge of the picture; in the centre a rounded, wooded island; in the background reddish slopes again, the sky with restless clouds.

works.d: Kitsa, peenejoonelise näoovaali ja suurte siniste silmadega naise poolprofiilis rinnaportree. Keskelt lahkukammitud blondid juuksed kuklal sõlmes. Avaralõikelise, pehmete voltidena langeva kleidi kaeluses oranžikas ja kollane roos.
works.de: Half-profile bust portrait of a woman with a narrow, finely lined oval face and large blue eyes. Blonde hair parted in the middle and gathered in a knot at the back of the head. In the neckline of a loosely cut dress falling in soft folds, an orangish and yellow rose.

works.d: Kõrgemate ja madalamate põimuvate küngastega Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Keskplaanis laiem org paari sinise järvesilmaga keskel. Esiplaanil lilleline aas hallide kivide ja kuuskedega vasakul nurgas. Silmapiir väga kõrgel. Silmapiiril keskel ja paremal metsaviirg. Vasakul ülanurgas helesinine taevas pilvedega. Maalitud erksates värvitoonides hõredalt täppivas laadis.
works.de: A South Estonian landscape with higher and lower intertwining hills. In the middle ground, a wider valley with a couple of blue lake-eyes in the centre. In the foreground, a flowery meadow with grey stones and spruce trees in the left corner. The horizon is very high. At the horizon, centre and right, a strip of forest. In the upper left corner, a light blue sky with clouds. Painted in bright colour tones in a sparsely dabbing manner.

works.d: Pikkade täppivate pintslilöökidega maalitud, suurte värvipindade mõjule põhinev kompositsioon: keskel stiliseeritult antud jõgi, millest paremal üksikud pika puukrooniga tumerohelised puud, vasakul metsast ümbritsetud järvesilm, metsatukk ja kõrgemal lage väli. Silmapiiril ribake merd, ülal hall taevas. Hallikasroheline üldkoloriit.
works.de: A composition painted with long, precise brushstrokes, based on the effect of large colour surfaces: in the middle a stylised river, to the right of which single dark green trees with tall crowns, on the left a lake eye surrounded by forest, a copse and, higher up, an open field. On the horizon a strip of sea, above a grey sky. Overall grayish-green colour scheme.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud, mis kaetud oranžikas-punaste lillede ja väänlevate mustritega kollasel foonil. Laual sinise-punasekirju vaas suure puhma lillade ja valgete sirelitega. Foonil erinevate mustritega vaibad või tapeedid. Fooni silmatorkavalt suur ja efektne muster annab tugeva dekoratiivse mõju. Laudlina ja foon maalitud pikkade täppivate pintslilöökidega.
Madalal silmapiiril punane ja valge maja. Nende vahel kõrgub sihvakas korsten. Hoonete ees rivi pügatud puid. Sinises taevas, majade kohal, valkjad pilved. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
works.de: A red and white house on a low horizon. A slender chimney rises between them. In front of the buildings a row of trimmed trees. In the blue sky, above the houses, whitish clouds. The paint surface is slightly textured.

works.d: Täppivalt maalitud ainisekirju veekogu, keskel türkiissinine looklev joon. Esiplaanil rohelise-lillakirju kallas. Vastaskaldal, roosakaspunase taeva foonil heleroheline aimatav mets.
works.de: A precisely painted, variegated body of water, in the middle a turquoise-blue winding line. In the foreground a green-purplish variegated shore. On the opposite bank, against a pinkish-red sky background, a faintly discernible light green forest.

works.d: Maalipinna jagab kaheks paarikorruseliste majade rivi, suunaga vasakult servast üles paremale. Rahutus pintslikirjas taevas maalitud intensiivsetes sinistes toonides.
works.de: The painted surface is divided in two by a row of two-storey houses, running from the left edge upward to the right. A restless sky painted in intense blue tones with agitated brushwork.

works.d: Keskel suurt, paelaga köidetud kivi kandva naise kuju. Seljas tume seelik ja sõlega kaunistatud sinine pluus, lopsakad juuksed lehvimas. Fooniks ereda päikeseketta särast erksates toonides taevas ning veekogu. Esiplaanil tumedad kivid, mille vahel üksikud viljapead ja pildi kummaski servas paar kidurat kuuske.
works.de: In the centre a figure of a woman carrying a large stone bound with a ribbon. She wears a dark skirt and a blue blouse decorated with a buckle, her luxuriant hair fluttering. As a background, a sky in bright tones with the glow of a bright solar disc, and a body of water. In the foreground dark stones, among which individual ears of grain, and on each edge of the picture a couple of stunted spruces.

works.d: Nikerdustega punakaspruunis tugitoolis istub poolpöördes kõhukas mees, käed süles puhkamas. Seljas tume rohekashall ülikond, valge särk ja lips. Juuksed pisut lokkis, paksud vuntsid ja kergelt kongus nina. Figuurist paremal ümmargune madal laud sigaretihoidja, sigarite ja sigarettidega. Foon helebeež, põrandal kirju vaip.
works.de: In a reddish-brown carved armchair sits a portly man in half-turn, hands resting in his lap. He wears a dark greenish-grey suit, a white shirt and a tie. His hair is slightly curly, with a thick moustache and a slightly hooked nose. To the right of the figure, a low round table with a cigarette holder, cigars and cigarettes. Background light beige, a patterned carpet on the floor.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik, üksik kivi keskel. Tagapool üldistatult lahendatud puukroonid rohekassinise, lillaka taeva taustal. Tume mets kaugeneb paremale.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing, a single stone in the middle. Behind it, generalised tree crowns against a greenish-blue, purplish sky. A dark forest recedes to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, kõrgemal kaldal helerohelised lehtpuukroonid, tumedate sihvakate tüvedega männid. Paremal, madalamate puude tagant paistab sinakasroosa vesi ja silmapiiril tume vastaskalda triip. Taevas õrnroosa, - sinine, -roheline. Maalitud jõuliselt, vorme üldistavalt. Puude osas maal faktuurne.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on a higher bank, light green deciduous tree crowns, pines with dark slender trunks. On the right, behind lower trees, bluish-pink water is visible and, on the horizon, a dark strip of the opposite bank. The sky is pale pink, blue, and green. Painted vigorously, generalising the forms. The painting is textured in the area of the trees.

works.d: Üle nõlvaku mere äärde viiv liivatee, paremal pool seda kaks jändrikku mändi taeva taustal, vasakul üks puu. Taevas kuu. Silmapiiril meretriip. Hallikas, samblaroheline koloriit. Jõuline vormiv pintslikäik, kohati väga pastoosne maal.
works.de: Across a slope a sandy road leading to the sea, on the right side of it two stunted pines against the sky, on the left one tree. In the sky the moon. On the horizon a strip of sea. Greyish, moss-green colouring. A vigorous, form-giving brushstroke, in places a very pastose painting.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud tumerohelised põõsad lumelaikudega nende vahel. Väikesel künkal keskplaanis punane tuuleveski, millest vasakul liivane kallas. Paremal üksik puu, ülal lillakashall taevas. Tume üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the foreground isolated dark green bushes with patches of snow between them. On a small hillock in the middle ground a red windmill, to its left a sandy shore. On the right a lone tree, above a lilac-grey sky. Dark overall colour scheme.

works.d: Punasest puust lainelise käetoega toolis istub tumedas ülikonnas keskealine mees 3/4 pöördes vasakule, jalg üle põlve. Parem käsi toetub põlvele, vasak tooli seljatoele. Tumedal vestil jäme uurikett, valgel püstkraega särgil lai tume kaelaside. Mehel väikese kühmuga nina, vuntsid ja laubalt taandunud juustepiir. Foon tumehall.
works.de: A middle-aged man in a dark suit sits in a red wooden chair with a wavy armrest, in a 3/4 turn to the left, leg crossed over knee. His right hand rests on his knee, his left on the back of the chair. On the dark waistcoat a thick watch chain, on the white stand-up collar shirt a wide dark necktie. The man has a small hump on his nose, a moustache, and a receding hairline. Background dark grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil lahesopp veest väljaulatuvate kividega. Keskplaanis liivane rand, õhtupäikeses männitukk, millest paremal väike majake. Servades vasakul ja paremal silmapiiril roheline metsaviirg. Ülal kahvatusinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a bay inlet with stones jutting out of the water. In the middle ground a sandy beach, a pine grove in the evening sun, with a small house to its right. On the left and right edges a green forest strip on the horizon. Above, a pale blue sky.

works.d: Erksates värvides dekoratiivne maastikumaal kujutab vaadet kõrgendikult alla fjordile. Taustaks sinine taevas roosakas-lillakate pilvedega. Ees all keskel rohelistes-oranžides toonides stiliseeritud okaspuud, vasakul veidi kaugemal on väiksemad tumedavärvilised puud. Maapind rohelistes-oranžides-sinistes toonides, kohati maali alaosas paremal markeeritud kinist kaljupinda. Madalal horisondil lillakais-rohekais toonides vastaskallas.
works.de: A decorative landscape painting in vivid colours depicts a view from a height down onto a fjord. The background is a blue sky with pinkish-purple clouds. In the foreground at the bottom centre stylised coniferous trees in green-orange tones, on the left slightly farther away smaller dark-coloured trees. The ground in green-orange-blue tones, in places at the bottom right of the painting a bluish rocky surface is indicated. On the low horizon the opposite shore in purplish-greenish tones.

works.d: Maali servadel maalitud pruunikas-punastes, paremal ultramariinsinistes toonides kangialune, tagapool, maali keskel, tume rinnatis ja trepikoda. Joonistuses rõhutatud nurgelisust. Sellest avausest toodud väiksena fookusesse erksates toonides alllinna punased katused, Oleviste, erksinine meri ja rohekas taevas. Esiplaanil nurgeline inimfiguur kandamiga.(eesti)
works.de: At the edges of the painting, painted in brownish-red, on the right in ultramarine blue tones, an archway, behind which, in the centre of the painting, a dark parapet and a stairwell. The drawing emphasises angularity. Through this small opening, brought into focus in bright tones, are the red roofs of the lower town, St Olaf's Church, a bright blue sea and a greenish sky. In the foreground, an angular human figure with a burden.

works.d: Tänava ääres paremal oranžikaspunase viilkatusega maja valge müüriaiaga, tagapool roheluses hallikas kirik tumeda tornikiivriga (Toomkirik). Vasakul, tänava varjupoolel kõrgete tumedate kivimajade vahel paar madalamat hoonet. Maalitud värvikalt, laiemate pintslitõmmetega.(eesti)
works.de: By the street on the right a house with an orangish-red gabled roof and a white boundary wall, behind it in the greenery a greyish church with a dark spire (the Cathedral). On the left, on the shaded side of the street, between tall dark stone buildings a couple of lower buildings. Painted colourfully, with broader brushstrokes.

works.d: Pruunides sukkades täidlane naisakt rohelisel diivanil, pea pööratud, vasak käsi seljatoele toetumas. Diivani ees paremal ümmargune laud nikerdatud jalaga ja suur kummipuu. Kahvatud roosad ja rohelised toonid, hõredate pintslilöökide vahelt kumab läbi paberi pind.
works.de: A full-figured female nude in brown stockings on a green sofa, head turned, left hand resting on the backrest. In front of the sofa on the right a round table with a carved leg and a large rubber plant. Pale pink and green tones, the surface of the paper glowing through between sparse brushstrokes.

works.d: Suvine vaade rohekasbeežile lameda tipuga mäele. Esiplaanil hallikad, rohekad kivirahnud, vasakul kividest laotud rinnatis tõuseb mäkke. Silmapiiril vasakul, helesinise taeva taustal peente tüvedega käharad puud. Maalitud tugeva faktuuriga, kohati värvi pinnale vormides.
works.de: A summer view of a greenish-beige, flat-topped mountain. In the foreground, greyish, greenish boulders; on the left a parapet built of stones rises up the mountain. On the horizon on the left, curly-crowned trees with slender trunks against a pale blue sky background. Painted with a strong texture, in places the paint modelled on the surface.

works.d: Lage maastik. Tagaplaanil, metsa ääres grupp maju. Taevas hallikas. Valdavad rohelised toonid. Värvipind faktuurne.
works.de: Open landscape. In the background, at the edge of a forest, a group of houses. Sky greyish. Green tones predominate. Textured paint surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil, lumisel väljal astuv hobune reega, külgvaates. Reel asuvatel rohekatel jääpankadel istub tumedais rõivais mees, vasak käsi hoiab ohje, parem toetub jääplokile. Tagaplaanil kaks lumise katusega talumaja, silmapiiril sinine metsatriip. Maalitud vorme üldistavalt, laiade pintslilöökidega, pastoosselt.
works.de: In the foreground, a horse pulling a sledge, walking across a snowy field, seen from the side. On the sledge, on greenish ice blocks, sits a man in dark clothing, his left hand holding the reins, his right resting on an ice block. In the background two farmhouses with snowy roofs, on the horizon a blue strip of forest. Painted in a generalising manner of forms, with broad, impasto brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, mäeveerul astmeliselt kuubikutaolised majad päikesevalguses. Nende ees paremal kaks käharat lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil lausk mägi. Maalitud sumedates rohekaspruunides ja ookertoonides laiade vabade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on a mountain slope, cube-like houses arranged in steps in sunlight. In front of them on the right, two curly deciduous trees. In the background a sheer mountain. Painted in muted greenish-brown and ochre tones with broad free brush strokes.

works.d: Maali paremas servas, ümmarguse laua juures seisab tumedas ülikonnas mees ja parema käega tooli seljatoele toetuv, heledas seelikus ning pluusis naisefiguur. Vasakul esiplaanil suur pott mingi toataimega. Viimase taga, ruumi sügavuses, küljega vaataja poole lehte lugev naine.
works.de: On the right side of the painting, by a round table, stands a man in a dark suit, and a female figure in a light-coloured skirt and blouse leaning with her right hand on the back of a chair. In the foreground on the left, a large pot with some houseplant. Behind it, in the depth of the room, a woman reading a newspaper, seen sideways to the viewer.

works.d: Hämaras interjööris vasakul lauanurk, selle taga istub sirge seljaga daam, jalg üle põlve poolpöördes paremale. Naisel suure karusnahkse kraega mantel, punase seosega sinakasroheline kübar silmadel. Parem käsi toetub lauale, vasak süles. Tagaplaanil paremal uks, seinal pilt. Maali koloriit tume, hallikassinine.
works.de: In a dim interior, on the left the corner of a table, behind it sits a lady with a straight back, one leg crossed over the knee in a half-turn to the right. The woman wears a coat with a large fur collar, a bluish-green hat trimmed with red hangs over her eyes. Her right hand rests on the table, her left in her lap. In the background on the right a door, on the wall a picture. The colouring of the painting is dark, greyish blue.

works.d: Vasakul, pliidi ääres seisev noor naine, paremas käes oleva kulbiga liigutab auravas potis, vasakuga asetab valge purgi pliidiservale. Naisel seljas õlapaeltega kleit, pearätt peas. Tagapool kolme ruuduga aken, aknalaual potilill, paremal taburett. Maalitud sinakashallis heledas koloriidis õhuliselt, üldistavalt, kohati värvipinda sisse kraapides.
works.de: On the left, a young woman standing by the stove is stirring in a steaming pot with a ladle in her right hand, while placing a white jar on the edge of the stove with her left. The woman is wearing a dress with shoulder straps, a headscarf on her head. Behind, a window with three panes, a potted plant on the windowsill, a stool on the right. Painted airily and in a generalised manner in a light bluish-grey colour scheme, in places scratching into the paint layer.

works.d: Vasakul lauanurk, mille ääres istumas mees, näoga vaataja poole. Laual kolm taldrikut ja pudel. Paremal tüseda naise kolmveerandfiguur, paremas käes taldrik. Ruumi sügavuses roosaka kattega, ovaalse seljatoega tugitool ja seinakell. Maalitud kahvatutes, beežikais toonides.
works.de: On the left, the corner of a table, at which a man is sitting, facing the viewer. On the table three plates and a bottle. On the right, the three-quarter figure of a stout woman, a plate in her right hand. In the depth of the room an armchair with a pinkish cover and an oval back, and a wall clock. Painted in pale, beige-ish tones.

works.d: Maja nurga juures, suvaliselt rohelise aia ees pingil istub mees vaataja poole. Temast vasakul punases seelikus, valges pluusis naine toetub aiale. Neile läheneb kummargil, žestikuleeriv punases rätis naine. Taamal vasakul avar põld. Maalitud hoogsalt sinakasrohelistes heledates toonides üksikute kollakate päikeselaikudega.
works.de: By the corner of a house, in front of a randomly green fence, a man sits on a bench facing the viewer. To his left a woman in a red skirt and white blouse leans on the fence. A gesturing woman in a red kerchief, bent over, approaches them. In the distance on the left an open field. Painted vigorously in light bluish-green tones with a few yellowish sun patches.

works.d: Etüüdlikus laadis teostatud maastik lagendiku ning taamal olevate suurte lehtpuude grupiga. Värvid pastelsed - roheline, sinine. Maalitud suures osas pahtli või maalinoaga.

Ees valge, lamav härg. Tema turjale astumas naine, keda selja tagant toetab mehefiguur. Paremal ja vasakul pool härga kaks põlvitavat figuuri. Tagapool kolm maani rüüdes naist. Vasakul puud. Maalimislaad etüüdlik; värvigamma hele.
works.de: In front, a white, lying bull. A woman stepping onto its back, supported from behind by a male figure. On the right and left of the bull, two kneeling figures. Behind, three women in floor-length robes. On the left, trees. The painting style is study-like; the colour range light.

works.d: Kohviku vaade. Keskel ukseava, millest paremal, akna all istuvad kaks meest. Uksest vasakul valge, klaasidega kapp ning pikk, madal lett. Viimase nurga juures seisab heledas särgis kelner, ees valge põll. Maalimislaad impressionistlik.
works.de: View of a café. In the middle a doorway, to the right of which, under a window, sit two men. To the left of the door a white cabinet with glasses and a long, low counter. At the end of the latter stands a waiter in a light shirt, with a white apron in front. Impressionistic painting style.

works.d: Madala rannariba ääres vees purjekad. Silmapiir madal, taevas pilvitu, helesinine. Käsitluslaad impressionistlik. Koloriidis valdav sinine toon.
works.de: Sailboats in the water beside a low strip of shore. Low horizon, cloudless, pale blue sky. Impressionistic treatment. Blue is the predominant tone in the colouring.

Kneeling by the man's left leg is a woman, her upper body in the man's lap, her arms around him, her right arm around his neck, her left arm around his upper body, her face hidden against the man's chest, the man's left hand around the woman.

works.d: Realistlik vaade kaherealise maantee, sõitva auto ja tööstushoonetega taamal. Vasakul puudesalu, paremal kõrgeks kasvanud rohuga eraldusriba, taamal suitsevate korstendega tööstushooned.

works.d: Rohelistes ja sinistes toonides abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kaherealise maantee ja suitseva korstnaga tööstushoonega taamal. Maantee maalitud pruunis, suits taamal rohelises toonis.
works.de: An abstracted landscape view in green and blue tones with a two-lane highway and a smoking industrial building in the distance. The highway is painted in brown, the smoke in the distance in a green tone.

works.d: Sinistes ja pruunides toonides abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kahesuunalise maantee ja suitsevate korstendega tööstushoonetega taamal. Maantee maalitud valges, eraldusriba ja suits pruunides ja maastik sinistes toonides.

Heledates ja pruunides toonides abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kahesuunalise maantee ja suitsevate korstendega tööstushoonetega taustal. Maantee maalitud heledates toonides, ümbritsev maastik markeeritud katmata pruuni lõuendiga, taevas helesinine.

Kollaažielementidega abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kaherealise maantee ja suitseva korstnaga tööstushoonega taustal. Maantee maalitud heledates toonides, ümbritsev maastik markeeritud mustades toonides ja pruunide kollaažielementidega, taevas hele.

Realistlik maastikuvaade kaherealise maantee, sõitva auto ja taamal olevate tööstushoonetega. Esiplaanil roosakas maantee ja pruunikas eraldusriba, vasakul tume puudesalu, taamal hallikad tööstushooned.
works.de: A realistic landscape view with a two-lane highway, a moving car, and industrial buildings in the distance. In the foreground a pinkish road and a brownish median strip, on the left a dark grove of trees, in the distance greyish industrial buildings.

works.d: Impressionistlik maastikuvaade kahesuunalise maantee, auto ja tööstushoonetega taamal. Esiplaanil hele maantee ja kirju rohuga eraldusriba, vasakul puudesalu, taamal suitsevate korstendega tööstushooned.
works.de: Impressionist landscape view with a two-way road, a car and industrial buildings in the distance. In the foreground a light-coloured road and a dividing strip with colourful grass, a grove of trees on the left, industrial buildings with smoking chimneys in the distance.

works.d: Ülaltvaade tallinna vanalinnale. Esiplaanil vasakul all üksik puu ja nelinurkse kahekorruselise maja külgvaade, paremal pikk madal hoone kolme avatud uksega. taga vasakul keskaegne kindluse torn, majade katuseid ja lehtpuude rida. taamal kõrgendikul (Toompeal) tihedalt üksteise kõrval majad ja kiriku torn.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of the Tallinn Old Town. In the foreground on the lower left a lone tree and the side view of a rectangular two-storey house, on the right a long low building with three open doors. Behind on the left a medieval fortress tower, house roofs and a row of deciduous trees. In the distance on a height (Toompea) houses closely set next to one another and a church tower.

Paremal halli katusega vesiveski selle alt läbivoolava väikese jõega. Veskist vasakul tee, millel taamal kaks pruuni hobust vankrite ja meestega. Veski ukse ees üks hobuserakend kottidega vankril seismas. Vasakul karjamaa, taamal roheline mets, ülal helesinine taevas suurte valkjashallide pilvedega.
works.de: On the right, a watermill with a grey roof, with a small river flowing beneath it. To the left of the mill, a road on which two brown horses with carts and men can be seen in the distance. In front of the mill door, a horse harnessed to a cart with sacks is standing. On the left, a pasture, in the distance a green forest, above a light blue sky with large whitish-grey clouds.

works.d: Skulptuur kujutab Fr. R. Kreutzwaldi seismas, paremas käes raamat, vasak tõstetud lõua juurde. Kujul kujutatud seljas eest lahti pikk kuub, ees nööbid. Kuju seisab kandilisel alusel. Alusel vasaku jala taga autori nimetähed JR ja aastaarv 1958-59. Valge kipsist kuju kokku pandud 2 osast: alumise osa moodustavad alus ja keha alumine pool keskkohani ja ülemise osa moodustab keskkohast keha ülemine pool.
works.de: The sculpture depicts Fr. R. Kreutzwald standing, a book in his right hand, his left hand raised to his chin. The figure is depicted wearing a long open coat in front, with buttons in front. The figure stands on a rectangular base. On the base, behind the left foot, the author's initials JR and the year 1958-59. The white plaster figure is assembled from 2 parts: the lower part forms the base and the lower half of the body up to the middle, and the upper part forms the upper half of the body from the middle up.
