works.de: Sculpture on the right, green and white trams and park trees on the left. The silhouette of the Eiffel Tower in the distance at the centre.

works.d: Esiplaanis jõgi väikese praamiga, millel trikoloori toonides, tugevasti suitsev korsten. Ees paremal, kaldapealsel, väike stafaažne inimfiguur ja suured puud. Keskel kolme kaarega hele sild, mille taga võimas katedraal. Ülal sinakasrohelistes toonides, ähvardavate pilvedega taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a small barge, on which a heavily smoking chimney in tricolour tones. In front on the right, on the riverbank, a small staffage human figure and large trees. In the middle a light-coloured bridge with three arches, behind it a mighty cathedral. Above, a sky in bluish-green tones with threatening clouds.

works.d: Pariisi panoraam: üle pinna majadekuubid hallides ja rohelistes toonides. Majaderägust eralduvad kõrged, pruuni suitsu ajavad korstnad. Läbi pruuni suitsu paistab vasakul ülal, taeva taustal Eiffeli torni siluett. Taevas kaetud ähvardavate tumesiniste pilvedega.
works.de: Panorama of Paris: cubes of houses in grey and green tones stretch across the surface. Tall chimneys emitting brown smoke rise out of the mass of houses. Through the brown smoke, upper left, the silhouette of the Eiffel Tower appears against the sky. The sky is covered with threatening dark blue clouds.

works.d: Vasakul türkiissinise veega jõgi ja Seine'ile sõitev pika suitseva korstnaga väike laev. Paremal Seine'i kaldapealne: esiplaanis keskel istub kaldarinnatisel, seljaga vaataja poole, tumerohelises mantlis ja mustas kaabus mees. Paremal suured puud ja stafaažina mõjuvad figuurid nende vahel. Kaldapealne üle kallatud läbi puudelehestiku tungivate päikeselaikudega. Keskplaanis kolme kaarega sild ning suured majad teisel kaldal. Läbi puudevõra paistab rohekaskollane taevas.
works.de: On the left, a turquoise-blue river and a small ship with a tall smoking chimney sailing towards the Seine. On the right, the embankment of the Seine: in the foreground in the centre sits a man on the embankment parapet, his back to the viewer, wearing a dark green coat and a black hat. On the right, large trees and figures among them functioning as staffage. The embankment is covered with sunspots breaking through the foliage of the trees. In the middle ground, a bridge with three arches and large houses on the other bank. Through the treetops a greenish-yellow sky is visible.

works.d: Keskel voolab Seine  kolme kaarega suure kollase silla alt läbi. Esiplaanil paremal kaldarinnatis, millele toetuvad vette vaadates kaks erksatesse toonidesse rõivastunud figuuri, parempoolsel peas must kübar. Ees keskel asetseb kaldapealne, millel kõnnivad üksikud jalutajad, on üle kallatud heledast päikesest ja läbi puude lehestiku tunginud üksikutest päikeselaikudest. Vasakul servas ja rinnatise taga paremal suured puud. Parempoolsete puude ja silla taga on aimata suurt hoonet. Ülal kollakasroheline taevas.
Vasakul kõrge korstna, ookerkollase katuse ja suure paljuruudulise aknaga maja. Maja taga ja esiplaanil paremal punakaspruunide tüvedega männid. Ülal kollakas taevas.
works.de: On the left a house with a tall chimney, an ochre-yellow roof and a large multi-paned window. Behind the house and in the foreground on the right, pines with reddish-brown trunks. Above, a yellowish sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaljune pinnas, millel keskel kulgeb pildi sügavusse rada. Rajast kahel pool üksikud kidurat kasvu puud, ülal kollane, hallide pilvedega varjutatud taevas. Maalitud rohelistes ja punakaspruunides toonides, värvipindu akvarelliklikult üksteisesse sulada lastes.
works.de: In the foreground, rocky ground with a path running through the middle into the depth of the picture. On both sides of the path, isolated stunted trees; above, a yellow sky shadowed by grey clouds. Painted in green and reddish-brown tones, the colour surfaces allowed to blend into one another in a watercolour-like manner.

works.d: Allservas vasakul maadligi katusega hallikaspruun talumaja, mida ümbritsevad luhtunud toonis lehtedega kaetud puud ja põõsad. Paremal mitmeharuline, peenikeste tüvedega, peaaegu kõik lehed kaotanud puu, tuulest sasitud. Pildi kompositsiooniliseks keskpunktiks on suurte, halli servaga valgete pilvedega kaetud ähvardav taevas. Maalitud hallides ja pruunides toonides, allservas on puude lehed ja rohelus maas antud pastoossete värvikänkratena.
works.de: In the lower part on the left a grayish-brown farmhouse with a low-hanging roof, surrounded by trees and bushes covered with faded-toned leaves. On the right a multi-branched tree with thin trunks, having lost almost all its leaves, tousled by the wind. The compositional focal point of the picture is the threatening sky covered with large white clouds with gray edges. Painted in gray and brown tones, in the lower part the leaves and greenery of the trees on the ground are rendered as pastose lumps of paint.

works.d: Kompositsiooni keskpunktis on ähvardav llillakashall (ülalt erksinine) taevas, mida kroonib keskel asuv tohutu valge pilvekuhil. Pilvekuhilast allpool, maa kohal, tumehallide pilvede riba. Allservas vasakul pastoosse värviga antud puud. Paremal luitunudroheline niit tuuliku ja tumerohelise puuderibaga silmapiiril.
works.de: At the centre of the composition is a menacing purplish-grey (bright blue at the top) sky, crowned in the middle by a huge white cloud mass. Below the cloud mass, above the ground, a band of dark grey clouds. In the lower left, trees rendered in impasto. On the right a faded green meadow with a windmill and a dark green strip of trees on the horizon.

works.d: Halli kikkhabeme, vuntside ja hallide, laubalt pisut taandunud juustega mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel tugev nina, tõsine ilme, seljas veinpunane särk ja lips ning rohekashall pintsak. Mehe parema õla kohal, pildi vasakus servas tumerohelise värviga maskeeritud linnatornid. Foon keskelt lillades, ülal hallides toonides. Foonil ülal vasakul värvikihti kraabitud vapi kontuurid.
works.de: A bust portrait, in half-turn to the left, of a man with a grey goatee, moustache and grey hair somewhat receded at the forehead. The man has a strong nose, a serious expression, wearing a wine-red shirt and tie and a greenish-grey jacket. Above the man's right shoulder, at the left edge of the picture, city towers disguised in dark green paint. The background in the middle in shades of purple, above in shades of grey. In the background, upper left, the contours of a coat of arms scratched into the paint layer.

works.d: Pikkade, kaunilt kaarduvate lokkidega heledapäise tütarlapse portree veerandpöördes paremale. Tütarlapsel helesinised silmad, kergelt püstjas nina, kauni vormiga väike suu. Seljas pruun kampsun, mille kaelusest paistab veinipunase pluusi krae. Foon hallides ja beežides toonides. Maalipind kohati pastoosne, juuste piirkonnas on värvikihti pintslivarrega jooni veetud.
works.de: Portrait of a fair-haired girl with long, beautifully curling locks, in a quarter-turn to the right. The girl has light blue eyes, a slightly upturned nose, a small beautifully shaped mouth. She wears a brown jumper, from whose collar the collar of a wine-red blouse shows. The background is in grey and beige tones. The paint surface is pastose in places, in the hair area lines have been drawn into the paint layer with the brush handle.

works.d: Esiplaanil jupike karjamaast paremal rohtu sööva loomaga ja kogu pilti horisontaalselt läbiva roigasaiaga. Aia taga puudesse ja põõsastesse mattunud väike punane maja, paremal servas puudegrupp. Taamal paistab tumesinine meri ja kahvatu taevas. Maalitud pisikeste, säbrulist maalipinda loovate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground a patch of pasture with an animal grazing on the right and a pole fence running horizontally across the whole picture. Behind the fence a small red house buried among trees and bushes, on the right edge a group of trees. Further away a dark blue sea and a pale sky are visible. Painted with small brushstrokes creating a rippled paint surface.

works.d: Pildi vasemas ja paremas servas osa kalurihütist. Vasakul esiplaanil, maja kõrval kolm peene tüvega puud. Majade vahel rannaks üleminev muruplats üksiku punasesse riietatud figuuriga kaldal. Taamal keskel kollakas meri ja aurik, ülaservas hallikas taevas. Maalitud väikeste säbruliste pintslilöökidega.

Esiplaanil väike abajas maanina, millel kolm punakate katustega kalurihütti. Vasakul servas rannal ja vees suured kivid, keskel osalt kaldale tõmmatud paat. All paremas nurgas osa lähivaates antud paadist ja mastidest. Taamal ülal sügavsinine meri, ülaservas ribake kahvatut, lillaga varjutatud taevast. Maalitud peamiselt sinakasrohelistes ja punakates toonides, kohati pastoosselt.
works.de: In the foreground a small bay-like headland with three fishermen's huts with reddish roofs. On the left edge, on the shore and in the water, large stones, in the middle a boat partly pulled up onto the shore. In the bottom right corner, part of a boat and masts seen in close-up. In the distance above, a deep blue sea, at the top edge a strip of pale sky shaded with lilac. Painted mainly in bluish-green and reddish tones, in places impasto.

works.d: Panoraamne mägimaastik: Taamal karmiilmeline mäestik, keskel järv või fjörd, mida kahelt poolt piiravad järskude veerudega mäed. Esiplaanil laineline klibuline mäenõlv, all paremas nurgas kahe kaabuga mehe pea- ja rinnaosa, vasakpoolsel mehel õlal pikk kepp. Ülaservas pilveriba, mille lõikavad läbi kahel pool fjordi paiknevate mägede tipud. Mäetippude vahel ülal hallikassinine taevas. Maalitud peamiselt roosades, ookri- ja sinakasrohelistes toonides.
works.de: A panoramic mountain landscape: in the distance, a harsh-looking mountain range, in the middle a lake or fjord bordered on both sides by mountains with steep slopes. In the foreground, a wavy, pebbly mountain slope, in the lower right corner the head and chest of two men wearing hats, the man on the left with a long stick on his shoulder. At the top edge, a strip of clouds cut through by the peaks of the mountains situated on either side of the fjord. Between the mountain peaks above, a greyish-blue sky. Painted mainly in pink, ochre and bluish-green tones.

works.d: Peamiselt sinakasrohelistes, lillakaspunastes ja mustades toonides panoraamne maastik: esiplaanil all vasakus nurgas musta värviga antud kaabus mehe ülakeha, selg vaataja poole, kepp käes. Taamal lahesopp laevadega ning tihedalt maju täis tipitud kaluriküla. Ülal teravatipulised, laiade lahtiste pintslilöökidega maalitud suured mäed, mille tippude vahelt  paistab rohekas-sinine taevas. Maali ülaosas krunt puhuti värvikihiga katmata, kohati värvikiht pastoosne.
works.de: A panoramic landscape mainly in bluish-green, purplish-red and black tones: in the foreground in the lower left corner the upper body of a man in a hat, given in black, back to the viewer, a stick in hand. Further back a bay inlet with ships and a fishing village densely packed with houses. Above, tall pointed mountains painted with broad, open brushstrokes, between whose peaks a greenish-blue sky is visible. In the upper part of the painting the ground is at places left uncovered by the paint layer, at places the paint layer is impasto.

works.d: Baretti kandva vanema mehe üleelusuuruses antud pea kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel prillid, tugev nina, pilk pööratud vaatajale. Mehel seljas avatud kaeluse ja triibulise rinnaesisega särk ning kuub. Paremat õlga varjab osa molbertist. Foon paremal ja ülal sinakasroheline. Maalitud sinistes, veinipunastes ja hallides toonides, kohati pikkade lahtiste pintslilöökidega, kohati pastoosselt.
works.de: The over-life-size head of an older man wearing a beret, turned slightly to the right. The man has glasses, a strong nose, his gaze directed at the viewer. He wears a shirt with an open collar and striped front, and a jacket. Part of an easel obscures his right shoulder. The background at the right and top is bluish-green. Painted in blue, wine-red and grey tones, at places with long, loose brushstrokes, at places impasto.

works.d: Vaade aknast Stockholmile: esiplaanil jõgi, taamal hallides toonides antud majad. Aknalaual paremal kaks punast lille, üle kogu pildi parema serva läbipaistev valge kardin. Tihedalt läbimaalitud, kohati kontuure rõhutades.
works.de: View from a window onto Stockholm: in the foreground a river, in the distance houses rendered in grey tones. On the windowsill on the right two red flowers, over the whole right edge of the picture a transparent white curtain. Densely painted through, in places with emphasised contours.

works.d: Paremal servas pikas kuues kaabuga mees, pikk teivas õlal, kaabu on silmile tõmmatud. Mehest vasemal ümarate vormidega lamav naine, jalad paljad, suur dekoltee paljastab osa rinnast. All vasakus nurgas musta kontuurjoonega visandatud roomava lapse figuur. Ülaservas keskel, mehe kohal kaks väikest figuuri, seljad vaataja poole. Maalitud roosades ja rohelistes toonides, visandlikult, valget krunti läbi kumada lastes.
works.de: On the right edge a man in a long coat with a hat, a long pole on his shoulder, the hat pulled down over his eyes. To the left of the man a reclining woman with rounded forms, bare feet, a large décolleté revealing part of her breast. In the lower left corner the figure of a crawling child sketched with a black contour line. In the upper edge, in the middle, above the man, two small figures with their backs to the viewer. Painted in pink and green tones, sketchily, letting the white ground shine through.

Visandlikult maalitud kompositsioon kahe figuuri ning nende taga oleva aknaga. Maali vasakul serval asetsev poolfiguur on maalitud otsevaates. Lugevas asendis, veidi paremale pööratud pea nõjutamas käele. Esiplaanil keskel, veidi vasakul asetsev poolfiguur on profiilis, suunaga paremale, õlani paljastatud parem käsi toetab pead. Vasak on ette lauale sirutatud. Aknapind jääb põhiosas maali paremasse ülapoolde. Aknast on näha aimatavaid puu- ja maastikukontuure. Maali koloriidi moodustavad tugevad roosad-rohelised toonid. Figuuride rõivad on valged, markeeritud rohelisega. Kitsas laud kahe figuuri vahel on hele: rohekas-valge. Ruumi osa on ookerjaspruun. Aknapind roosa.
works.de: A sketch-like composition of two figures with a window behind them. The half-figure at the left edge of the painting is painted in a frontal view. In a reading pose, the head turned slightly to the right, resting on the hand. The half-figure in the foreground, in the centre, slightly to the left, is in profile, facing right, the right hand, bared to the shoulder, supports the head. The left is stretched forward onto the table. The window surface mainly occupies the upper right part of the painting. Through the window, indistinct outlines of trees and landscape can be discerned. The colouring of the painting consists of strong pink-green tones. The figures' clothing is white, marked with green. The narrow table between the two figures is light: greenish-white. The part of the room is ochre-brown. The window surface is pink.

works.de: Painting without frame.

works.d: Põikformaadis poolabstraktne maal. Esiplaanil kümme erineva suuruse ja kujuga kartulit horisontaalse kompositsiooni lahendusega. Kartulid maalitud ruumilisena, valgus - varjuga. Kartulite toonid kollakad, sinakashallid. Taust abstraktne, valdavalt roosakad-sinakad toonid. (eesti)
works.de: Semi-abstract painting in landscape format. In the foreground ten potatoes of various size and shape arranged in a horizontal composition. The potatoes are painted with volume, light and shadow. The tones of the potatoes are yellowish, bluish-grey. The background is abstract, predominantly pinkish-bluish tones.

works.d: Abstraktne, tumedates toonides, segatehnikast tulenevalt kohati krobelise faktuuriga maal. Esiplaanil kujutatud poolabstraktselt üksteisega põimunud tormist lõhutud puude oksi ja tüvesid-rohekas hallides, pruunides toonides. Taust: pildi vasakpool ülalt alla sambaroheline toon läheb sujuvalt üle mürkroheliseks. Alumine vasak nurk sügav tumesinine.(eesti)
works.de: Abstract painting in dark tones, with a texture that is in places rough due to the mixed technique. In the foreground, semi-abstractly depicted, intertwined branches and trunks of trees broken by a storm, in greenish-grey, brown tones. Background: on the left side of the picture, from top to bottom, a bottle-green tone smoothly transitions into poison green. The lower left corner is deep dark blue.

works.d: Põikformaadis lüpsja kaksikportree. Kompositsioon: Maal jaotatud kolmeks. 2/3 pildi pinnast kujutab külgvaates kükitavat valge kitliga ja mütsiga lüpsjat (pildi keskel) lüpsimasinat lehmale seadmas. Pildi vasemal pool lüpsja ees lehm, tagant vaates. 1/3 maalist jaotatud helerohelise raamiga pooleks. Ülal L.Peipsi poolprofiilis näoportree.  All aasta 1976 ja numbrid 5323 511 T.  Maalitud realistlikus laadis, pruunides, rohelistes toonides. Maali keskne osa (lüpsja) valge, hele roosakas, sinakas hallid toonid. (eesti)
works.de: A double portrait of a milkmaid in horizontal format. Composition: The painting is divided into three parts. 2/3 of the picture surface depicts, in profile, a milkmaid crouching (in the centre of the picture) in a white smock and cap, setting a milking machine on a cow. On the left side of the picture, in front of the milkmaid, a cow, seen from behind. 1/3 of the painting is divided in half by a light green frame. Above, a semi-profile face portrait of L. Peips. Below, the year 1976 and the numbers 5323 511 T. Painted in a realistic manner, in brown and green tones. The central part of the painting (the milkmaid) in white, light pinkish, bluish-grey tones.

works.d: Maastkumaal - Järvemaal sooja lillakas- kollakas koloriidis keskne koht- Järv pildi keskel- läbiv - tume lillas toonis. Silmapiiril - taamal lillades toonides metsatukad. Esiplaanil paremal metsatukad. Esiplaanil paremal mürkroheline roosa katusega maja, kõrge korstnaga. Pildi keskel all kaks kuuske kõrvuti. Maalitud üldistatult, ilma oluliste detailideta.(eesti)
works.de: A landscape painting - Lake District - in a warm lilac-yellowish colouring, a central place - a lake in the middle of the picture, running through - in a dark lilac tone. On the horizon - in the distance, clumps of forest in lilac tones. In the foreground on the right, clumps of forest. In the foreground on the right, a poison-green house with a pink roof and a tall chimney. In the middle of the picture at the bottom, two spruces side by side. Painted in a generalised manner, without significant detail.

works.dm: laius: 73.0 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 89.0 cm (koos raamiga)
works.d: Maastikumaal- järvemaal, kujutatud lossimäge ja Viljandi järve- mõlemat, raamivad kogu maali. Vasakul lossimäe külg, paremal intensiivses sinises toonis järve tipp ja nende vahel puude ja majade grupp. Vasakul ülal intensiivsete siniste toonidega taevas, koloriidilt kirju: oranzides kollastes sügistoonides.(eesti)
works.de: A landscape painting – a lake view, depicting the Castle Hill and Lake Viljandi – both framing the whole painting. On the left the side of the Castle Hill, on the right the tip of the lake in an intense blue tone, and between them a group of trees and houses. Above on the left, a sky in intense blue tones, varied in colouring: in orange, yellow autumn tones.

works.d: Lillemaal - kujutab hoogsate pintslilöökide ja erksate värvidega kolme sorti lillebuketti vaasides. Pool maali ülemist pinda kujutab kollastes, oranžides toonides kullerkuppude buketti, mille õied laiuvad üle kogu ülemise maalipinna. Pildi keskel väike hele vaas siniste meelespeadega, all paremal roosakad-lillad lilled. Maali foon (alumine osa) lahendatud abstraktsete vana-roosa, sinakasrohelise ja tumepruunide värvipindadega.(eesti)
works.de: Flower painting - depicts, with bold brushstrokes and vivid colours, three kinds of flower bouquets in vases. Half of the upper surface of the painting shows, in yellow and orange tones, a bouquet of globeflowers, whose blossoms spread over the entire upper painting surface. In the centre of the picture a small light-coloured vase with blue forget-me-nots, at the bottom right pinkish-purple flowers. The background (lower part) of the painting is rendered with abstract surfaces of old-rose, bluish-green and dark brown colour.

works.d: Püstformaadis poolabstraktne helehallides pruunides rohelistes toonides segatehnikast tulenevalt kohati krobulise faktuuriga maal. Kujutatud tormist räsitud pooleks murdunud kännukujulist puutüve, mis nagu pildi alumisest osast välja kasvab. Maaliliselt - stiiliselt lahendatud(kännuront) kubistlikus geomeetrilises laadis. Maali taust jagatud kolmeks: hall, pruun, hall.(eesti)
works.de: A vertically formatted, semi-abstract painting in light grey, brown and green tones, with a surface that is in places rough in texture due to the mixed technique used. Depicted is a storm-battered, split tree trunk resembling a tree stump, which seems to grow out of the lower part of the picture. Pictorially and stylistically the (stump-shape) is treated in a cubist, geometric manner. The background of the painting is divided into three parts: grey, brown, grey.

works.de: At the bottom edge a corner of a table, on which a brown clay vessel with a colourful bouquet of wildflowers. In the background part of a window opening onto a view of nature.

works.d: Päikesepaisteline männimetsa alune, maapinnale laskuvate varjudega. Põõsaste vahelt paistavad kaks värvilist figuuri.(eesti)
works.de: A sunny spot beneath pine trees, with shadows falling on the ground. Between the bushes two coloured figures can be seen.

works.d: Klaaspurgis pikavarrelised, punased tulbid ja teised lilled. Maalimislaad - impressionistlik.(eesti)
works.de: Long-stemmed red tulips and other flowers in a glass jar. Painting style - impressionistic.

works.d: Vasakus nurgas kunstniku enese palja pealaega pea vaatega paremale, õla kõrguselt ära lõigatud. Tagapool tänavaristmik, puudega skväär, voorimees, tillukesi figuure. Tänav suundub kaarega kaugemale, kiriku ja tornide poole. Maal tihedalt läbi maalitud, portrees rõhutatud plastilisust, keskplaanil tähtis osa puude oksastiku mustreil.(eesti)
works.de: In the left corner the artist's own head with a bare crown, viewed towards the right, cut off at shoulder height. Behind, a street crossing, a square with trees, a coachman, tiny figures. The street curves further away, towards the church and towers. The painting is densely worked through, plasticity emphasised in the portrait, in the middle ground the pattern of tree branches plays an important role.

works.d: Aknalaual seisab suures plaanis purk kolme amarülliseõiega, mis ulatuvad pildi ühest servast teiseni ja väike tume naisfiguur - skulptuur. Aknast avaneb vaade linna majadele, mis tõusevad kuni Toompea nõlvani, nii et taevast jääb ülaservas paistma ainult väike riba.(eesti)
works.de: On the windowsill stands, in a large close-up, a jar with three amaryllis flowers reaching from one edge of the picture to the other, and a small dark female figure - a sculpture. From the window opens a view of the city's houses, rising up to the slope of Toompea, so that only a narrow strip of sky remains visible at the upper edge.

works.d: Pehmes rohekas üldtoonis foonil seisab kreeka kuninga ihukaitseväelane, kel on seljas lühike kohevil, laiade varrukatega vöötatud rüü; peas punane ümarik müts; tuttidega jalanõud; parem käsi puusas.(eesti)
works.de: Against a soft greenish overall tone stands a bodyguard of the Greek king, wearing a short fluffy, wide-sleeved belted robe; on his head a round red cap; footwear with tassels; right hand on hip.

works.d: Esiplaanil osaliselt valgustatud hallikate varjutriipudega õuenurk, mida piirab paremalt hallikaspruun plankaed ja vasakult osa kumerate võlvidega sammaskäiguga ühekordsest kivihoonest. Hoovi keskel pumbakaev. Aia tagant paistab osa heleda äärisega punasest kivikatusest, kaugemal, heledal taevafoonil kolme kiriku tornikiivrid.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a partly lit courtyard corner with grayish shadow stripes, bounded on the right by a grayish-brown plank fence and on the left by part of a single-storey stone building with a colonnade of curved arches. In the middle of the yard a pump well. Behind the fence part of a red tiled roof with a light-coloured edge can be seen, and further away, against a light sky background, the tower helms of three churches.

works.d: Pildi keskosas kanal, millest viib üle punakaspruun kaarsild. Kahel pool kanalit on tugevalt tahke rõhutades maalitud järskude katustega, verandade ning mansardkorrustega majad. Vasakul all paatide randumise koht. Ülal majade vahel jupike hallikassinist taevast. Pastelselt pruunikashallis üldkoloriidis.(eesti)
works.de: In the central part of the picture a canal, over which a reddish-brown arched bridge leads. On both sides of the canal, houses with steep roofs, verandas and mansard floors are painted with a strongly solid emphasis. At the bottom left a landing place for boats. Above, between the houses, a patch of greyish-blue sky. In an overall pastel brownish-grey colouring.

works.d: Pildi keskel tee mehe, hobuse ja vankriga. Vasakul lippidest aed, millest seespool põõsad. Teest paremal üksik suur puu, taamal skemaatiliselt antud puuvõrad. Taevas silmapiiri kohal hall, pilvedega kaetud. Rohekaskollane üldkoloriit, maalitud hõredalt täppivas laadis.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle of the picture, a road with a man, a horse and a cart. On the left, a fence of poles, with bushes inside it. To the right of the road, a single large tree, with schematically rendered tree crowns further back. The sky above the horizon is grey, covered with clouds. The overall colouring is greenish-yellow, painted sparsely in a stippled manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil nööridega ümbritsetud alal kollakal vaibal seljaga meesfiguur sinist särki ära tõmbamas. Vasakul kummargil tooli kohal punases särgis ja soniga mees trummi löömas. Tooli najale toetub jõumehe foto. Maas lebavad pomm ja tõstekangid ning suur roheline kohver. Eemal kasseerib poisike nööri taha kogunenud vaatajatelt raha. Tagapool tsirkuse vankrid ja telgid kaugelt paistvate linnamajadega.
works.de: In the foreground, within an area bounded by ropes, on a yellowish carpet, a male figure with his back turned is pulling off a blue shirt. On the left, a man bent over a chair, wearing a red shirt and cap, is beating a drum. A photograph of a strongman leans against the chair. On the ground lie a weight and lifting bars and a large green suitcase. In the distance a boy is collecting money from spectators gathered behind the rope. Further back circus wagons and tents with town houses visible in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil tugevate pintslilöökidega, pastoosselt maalitud valgetes õites puu, millest paremal roosas pluusis, sinises seelikus ja pearätis kummarduv naine. Keskplaanis väljaehitusega maja ning kõrvalhoone, tagaplaanil teisigi maju vasakul, ülal pilvedes taevas. Esiplaanil kolm keppidele toetuvat taimepuhmast pildiservast välja ulatumas.
works.de: In the foreground, painted with strong brushstrokes in impasto, a tree in white blossom, to the right of which a woman bends over, wearing a pink blouse, a blue skirt and a headscarf. In the middle ground a house with an extension and an outbuilding, in the background other houses to the left, above them a sky in clouds. In the foreground three plant clumps supported by sticks project beyond the edge of the picture.

works.d: Pildi alumises pooles värviliselt sillerdav jõgi, kaldariba ja vee kohale küündiva puuga paremal. Vasakul kaldal paadid, mõnes istuvad inimesed. Rohelise rohu, puukese ja paari põõsaga kaetud kaldast tagapool tänav kõndivate inimestega ning punasteks, kollasteks, roheliseks ja valgeks värvitud majad. Ülal sinine, valgete pilvedega taevas. Eredad rõõmsad värvitoonid, paadid ja vesi kohati kaunis pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: In the lower half of the picture, a river shimmering with colour, a strip of shore and a tree reaching over the water on the right. On the left bank, boats, in some of which people are sitting. Behind the bank, covered with green grass, a small tree and a couple of bushes, a street with walking people and houses painted red, yellow, green and white. Above, a blue sky with white clouds. Bright, joyful colour tones, the boats and water painted in places quite impasto.

works.d: Kerges paremalepöördes istuva naise põlvportree. Küünarnukist tõstetud parem käsi toetub diivani seljatoele, vasak, sõrmustatud käsi, puhkab põlvedele laotatud elevandiluukarva narmastega rätikul. Seljas ühesuguses sinises toonis seelik ja kübar ning kirju pluus. Foon tumedated hallides ja pruunides toonides.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman sitting in a slight turn to the right. Her right arm, raised from the elbow, rests on the back of a sofa, her left hand, wearing a ring, rests on a shawl with ivory-coloured fringes laid over her knees. She wears a skirt and hat of the same blue tone and a colourful blouse. The background is in dark grey and brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil koristatud põld. Keskel üksik puu. Sellest paremal ja vasemal viljarõugud. Tagaplaanil metsatukki.
works.de: In the foreground a harvested field. In the middle a solitary tree. To the right and left of it, sheaves of grain. In the background a small patch of forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakas-rohelistes toonides põllud üksikute suurte kivide ja põõsastega. Põldude taga ja paremal sileda pinnaga kääruline järv. Üle järve paremal kõrge metsaga kaetud kallas, vasakul ähmased linna kontuurid. Silmapiiril sinetav viirg. Taevas sinakas-hall.
works.de: In the foreground, fields in yellowish-green tones with single large stones and bushes. Behind the fields and on the right, a winding lake with a smooth surface. Across the lake on the right, a bank covered with tall forest, on the left the hazy contours of a city. A bluish strip on the horizon. The sky bluish-grey.

works.d: Tänav kõrgete majadega, taamal kaks torni. Esiplaanil ja tagapool üles paremale vaatavaid inimesi.
works.de: A street with tall buildings, two towers in the background. People looking upward to the right in the foreground and behind.

works.d: Künklik maasti puudegruppidega keskplaanil ja taamal sinetavate metsadega. Esiplaanil paremal naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule, keskel ja vasakul töötavaid inimesi, vasakul 2 madalat hoonet.
works.de: Hilly landscape with groups of trees in the middle ground and bluish forests further back. In the foreground on the right the half-figure of a woman in profile facing left, in the centre and on the left people at work, on the left 2 low buildings.

works.d: Laual vasakul suur purk, klaas ja pudel, paremal hallikaspruun kann ja taldrik viinamarjadega. Ees keskel, taburetil sinakas tops.
works.de: On the table on the left a large jar, a glass and a bottle, on the right a greyish-brown jug and a plate with grapes. In front, in the middle, a bluish cup on a stool.

works.d: Maastik sinistes toonides. Ees keskel järv, paremal puudegrupp, vasakul tee. Taamal metsaga kaetud künkad,
works.de: Landscape in blue tones. In the front centre a lake, on the right a group of trees, on the left a road. In the background hills covered with forest,

works.d: Esiplaanil kollane põld viljahakkidega paremal, metsatuka ja hoonetega vasakul. Kaugemal kollased põllud, metsaga kaetud künkad ja veekogu vasakul.
works.de: In the foreground a yellow field with sheaves of grain on the right, a copse and buildings on the left. Further away yellow fields, hills covered with forest and a body of water on the left.

works.d: Punastes ja sinakates toonides linnavaade madalate majadega. Majade vahel ja esiplaanil puud. Taevas hele.
works.de: A townscape in red and bluish tones with low houses. Trees among the houses and in the foreground. The sky is bright.

works.d: Laual natüürmort, mis koosneb viiulist, raamatutest, pudelist ja sidrunitest. HAllil foonil kirju draperii, pildiraam.
works.de: On the table a still life consisting of a violin, books, a bottle and lemons. Against a grey background, a colourful drapery, a picture frame.

works.d: Avar rannikupanoraam: teravasopilised merekäänud ja metsatukad, esiplaanil looklev tee, telefonipostid. Vormid üldistatud, kontuurid rõhutatud.
works.de: A broad coastal panorama: sharply indented sea bays and clumps of forest, in the foreground a winding road, telephone poles. Forms generalised, contours emphasised.

works.d: Kaks tütarlast, pilk vaatajale suunatud, istuvad kõrvuti, õmblustöö käes, ees madal korv. Seljas heledad pluusid. Foonis punakat.
works.de: Two girls, gaze directed at the viewer, sitting side by side, needlework in hand, a low basket in front. Wearing light blouses. Reddish in the background.

works.d: Neljakandilisel laual hele naise büst, valge kann, raamatuid, kaks punast taldrikut.
works.de: On a square table a light-coloured bust of a woman, a white jug, books, two red plates.

works.d: Sombreeros tumedahabemelise mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käed puusas. Seljas sinine särk.
works.de: Half-figure of a dark-bearded man in a sombrero, frontal view, hands on hips. Wearing a blue shirt.

works.d: Natüürmort tumedast keraamilisest vaasist, valgest kannust, pudelist ja kausist. Laual õunu ja ploome. Foon punane-valge.
works.de: Still life of a dark ceramic vase, a white jug, a bottle and a bowl. On the table, apples and plums. Background red and white.

works.d: Künklik Lõuna-Eesti maastik soojades toonides. Paremal põldudega, vasakul metsaga kaetud voored.
works.de: Hilly South Estonian landscape in warm tones. Drumlins covered with fields on the right, with forest on the left.

works.d: Nelinurksel laual hele kann ümmargusel alusel, roheline pudel ja kolm suurt granaatõuna.
works.de: On a rectangular table a light-coloured jug on a round base, a green bottle and three large pomegranates.

works.d: Keskel kollase näoga naine, laps süles. Tema taga paremal ja vasakul kaks seisvat kolmveerandfiguuri ja üks ees alumises ääres nägu otsevaates.
works.de: In the middle a woman with a yellow face, a child in her lap. Behind her on the right and left two standing three-quarter figures and one face in frontal view at the lower edge in front.

works.d: Keskosa: Keskel laulvad inimfiguurid ja istuv ema lapsega. Külgedel seisvad figuurid.
works.de: Central part: In the middle singing human figures and a seated mother with a child. Standing figures on the sides.

works.d: Rühm inimesi põlevate tõrvikutega, keskel suur tuleleek.
works.de: A group of people with burning torches, a large flame in the middle.

works.d: Pindadesse jaotatud foonil habemega mehe rinnaportree. Kontuurid rõhutatud, maalitud pruunikas gammas, kuub punane. Raam must.
works.de: Bust portrait of a bearded man against a background divided into planes. Contours emphasised, painted in a brownish gamut, coat red. Frame black.

works.d: Maali keskplaanil stiliseeritud puudevormid, vertikaalsed jooned rõhutavad kõrgust, värvid loovad mulje sügisest. Tagaplaanil sinetab veepind.
works.de: In the middle ground of the painting, stylised tree forms, vertical lines emphasising height, colours creating an impression of autumn. In the background a bluish water surface.

works.d: Kogu pildi pinna täidab suur sinine sõõr. Sõõri keskel pikas valges rüüs naisefiguur, parem käsi rinna kõrgusele tõstetud. Tema kohal kosmonauti kujutav horisontaalis olev figuur. Ülejäänud osal sõõri pinnast kujutatud inimesi mitmesuguste tegevuste juures.
works.de: The whole surface of the picture is filled with a large blue circle. In the centre of the circle a female figure in a long white robe, right hand raised to chest height. Above her a horizontal figure depicting a cosmonaut. On the remaining surface of the circle, people are depicted engaged in various activities.

works.d: Pildil paremal kolm erisuuruses kannu, keskmine, valge kann tilaga. Kannude taga, foonil naise kujutisega pilt. Pildil vasakul küünlajalg ühe küünlaga ja kogukas raamat; keskel ketiga lehmakell.
works.de: On the right of the picture three jugs of different sizes, the middle, white jug with a spout. Behind the jugs, in the background a picture with the image of a woman. On the left of the picture a candlestick with one candle and a bulky book; in the middle a cowbell with a chain.

works.d: Keskel, üle kogu pildi pinna elektrikitarr. Selle all pindade kombinatsioone moodustavad raamatute kujutised. All paremal suur mesikarp. Vasakul, kitarri taga moodustab mustvalge pinna malelaud. Kontuurid rõhutatud.
works.de: In the middle, over the entire surface of the picture, an electric guitar. Below it images of books forming combinations of surfaces. At bottom right a large beehive. On the left, behind the guitar, a chessboard forms a black-and-white surface. Contours emphasised.

Grupid teatrimaskide ja butafooria hulgas. Kompositsiooni vasakul kollakasvalge pind kitsa musta vertikaalliistuga vasakul serval, allääres inimmass. Mustal ja pruunikal foonil paremal ees kaks baleriini suure butafoorse moodustise taustal, mille peal asetsevad kaks maski ja millele kuldlõikes ronib redeliga puhvpükstes mees.
works.de: Groups among theatre masks and stage props. On the left of the composition a yellowish-white surface with a narrow black vertical batten on its left edge, at the bottom edge a mass of people. Against a black and brownish background, in the foreground on the right two ballerinas in front of a large prop structure, on top of which sit two masks, and on which, in golden-section position, a man in puffed breeches climbs a ladder.

works.d: Teravate kontuuridega, üldistatud joonistusega peamiselt mürkrohelistes toonides künklik maastik. Kompositsiooni alaäärest algav ja parema poole ülaosani kulgev astmeline tõus künkale, tihedate lehtpuudega kaetud järsem vasak serv. Kupli harjal tumeda siluetina puuderiba. Maali keskosas järsk kolmnurkne küngas, selle ees kolletav põlluriba. Vasakul org majakatusega, silmapiiril sujuvalt tõusev maapind metsaviiruga.
works.de: A hilly landscape with sharp contours and generalised drawing, mainly in poisonous green tones. A stepped rise beginning at the lower edge of the composition and running to the upper part on the right side, towards a hill; a steeper left edge covered with dense deciduous trees. On the crest of the dome a strip of trees as a dark silhouette. In the middle of the painting a steep triangular hill, in front of it a strip of yellowing field. On the left a valley with a house roof, on the horizon a gently rising terrain with a strip of forest.

works.d: Perspektiiviliste "vigadega" tasapinnalisust toonitav, erinevate esemete suhtes mitmest erinevast kõrgusest jälgitud natüürmort tihedalt asetatud esemetest ebakorrapäraselt paigutatud geomeetriliste värvipindadega foonil ning ebakorrapärase liigendatud kujuga geometriseeritud, erinevates värvitoonides alusel. Ees keksel nelinurkse, voolavates vormides sügavas anumas kaks punast puuvilja. Selle taga vasakul vanaaegne käsikohviveski, paremal kõrge idamaine kann peene pika püstjase tilaga. Selle foonil ülal värvilinebukett lilledest ja lehtedest. Laual vasakul all murelioks lehtede ja oranžikate-punakate marjadega.
works.de: A still life emphasising flatness through perspectival "errors", with closely placed objects viewed from several different heights in relation to different objects, set against a background of irregularly arranged geometric colour planes and on an irregularly articulated, geometricised base in various colour tones. In front, in the middle, two red fruits in a deep quadrangular vessel of flowing forms. Behind it on the left an old-fashioned hand coffee grinder, on the right a tall oriental jug with a thin, upright spout. Above, against this background, a colourful bouquet of flowers and leaves. On the table, lower left, a branch of mahaleb cherry with leaves and orangish-reddish berries.

works.d: Vasak tiib: keskel valges sportlikus riietuses noormehe täisfiguur pea kohale tõstetud kettaga (keskel sini-valge maakera sümbol, servas tekst KOGU MAAILMA NOORED). Tagaplaanil sammastik, ees all neegritar lilledega, sombreeroga ladinaameeriklane, kitarri mängiv pikkade juustega neiu.
works.de: Left wing: in the centre the full figure of a young man in white sportswear with a discus raised above his head (in the centre a blue-and-white globe symbol, on the rim the text KOGU MAAILMA NOORED [YOUTH OF THE WHOLE WORLD]). In the background a colonnade, in front below a black woman with flowers, a Latin American man with a sombrero, a girl with long hair playing a guitar.

works.d: Natüürmort laual ja selle taga asetseval kapil. Esiplaanil ümmargune tume laud, mis on osaliselt kaetud kergelt volti hoidva, heleda laudlinaga, mille serv ripub üle laua parema ääre. Sellel, esiplaanil, kollakas klaasist, kahe käepidemega, ümar puuviljavaagen kahe väiksema ja ühe suurema puuviljaga. Selle ees, laua katmata osal, kaardipakk ühe eralduva lehega. Vaagnast paremal, osaliselt selle all, ajakiri, ning selle peal helesinine raamatuköide. Vaagna taga lopsakates vormides suur keraamiline kann. Laua taga beežikas kapp sellele heidetud kirju riidega, mis piklikult kokku voldituna moodustab kapil hobuseraua kuju. Selle otsal, paremal, kaks õuna. Tume rohekaspruun foon.
works.de: Still life on a table with a cabinet standing behind it. In the foreground a round dark table, partly covered with a light-coloured tablecloth held in a gentle fold, the edge of which hangs over the right side of the table. On it, in the foreground, a yellowish glass, round, two-handled fruit bowl with two smaller and one larger piece of fruit. In front of it, on the uncovered part of the table, a deck of cards with one card set apart. To the right of the bowl, partly beneath it, a magazine, and on top of it a light blue book binding. Behind the bowl a large ceramic jug of lush form. Behind the table a beige-coloured cabinet with a colourful cloth thrown over it, which, folded lengthwise, forms the shape of a horseshoe on the cabinet. At its end, on the right, two apples. Dark greenish-brown background.

works.d: Laual kauss roosade marjadega, pudel, pruun kann, tass alustassiga, vasemal toos, keskel kauss õuntega, esiplaanil kahvel. Foon hall, keskel ülal kaks pruuni (üks triibuline) pinda. Paremal servas tumehallid ja pruunid triibud.
works.de: On the table a bowl with pink berries, a bottle, a brown jug, a cup with saucer, on the left a box, in the middle a bowl with apples, in the foreground a fork. Background grey, in the middle above two brown surfaces (one striped). On the right edge dark grey and brown stripes.

works.d: Kesksel alusel mandoliin, punakas pruun kauss kahe puuviljaga ja kõrge piklik vaas. Paremal foonil hele, esemete all sinine riie. Foonil vasemal värvilistest nelinurkadest mosaiikne pind.
works.de: On a central stand a mandolin, a reddish brown bowl with two pieces of fruit and a tall elongated vase. On the right background, light, under the objects a blue cloth. On the left background a mosaic-like surface of coloured rectangles.

works.d: Vasakul ühtlasel, heledal, rohekashallil pinnal tumedas ruudus akna motiiv. Paremal pruunikashall pind. Nende vahel punastes, sinistes, valkjates ning pruunides toonides abstraktsetest pindadest kompositsioon, millest kerkivad esile: all servas vuntsidega mehe rinnafiguur, sellest paremal vanema naise nägu ja ülal noore naise täisfiguur. Maalipind kergelt fraktuurne.
works.de: On the left, on an even, light, greenish-grey surface, a window motif in a dark square. On the right, a brownish-grey surface. Between them a composition of abstract surfaces in red, blue, whitish and brown tones, out of which emerge: at the bottom edge the chest figure of a moustached man, to the right of it the face of an older woman, and above the full figure of a young woman. The paint surface is slightly fractured.

works.d: Pruunides-valkjates toonides geomeetrilistest pindadest ja inimfiguuridest kompositsioon. Kesksel kohal sinises lühikeses seelikus, last süleskandva naise figuur. Kontuurid rõhutatud.
works.de: Composition of geometric surfaces and human figures in brown-whitish tones. In the centre a figure of a woman in a short blue skirt carrying a child in her arms. Contours emphasised.

works.d: Ees- ja keskplaanil kergelt geometriseeriva joonega maalitud kuus poolfiguuri. Taamal rohekal merepinnal sinise nelinurkse pinnaga eraldatud valge laeva kujutis
works.de: In the foreground and middle ground, six half-figures painted with a slightly geometricising line. Further back, on a greenish sea surface, the image of a white ship separated by a blue rectangular area.

works.d: Esiplaanil tanum rohelise karjaväravaga, kiviaedadega tükeldatud põllu- ja heinamaalapid. Silmapiiril rookatustega talumajad ja põlispuud nende vahel. Ülal pilvitu erksinine taevas. Rohekas üldkoloriit, kohati selgesti eristatavad pikad pintslitõmbed.
works.de: In the foreground, a homestead with a green farm gate, patches of field and meadow divided by stone fences. On the horizon, thatched-roof farmhouses and ancient trees between them. Above, a cloudless bright blue sky. Overall greenish colouring, in places clearly distinguishable long brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumedas seelikus, tumedas mustrilises pluusis istuv naine, roheline rätik õlgadel. Pluusi kaeluses pross, peas beež kübar, nägu selle all heledasti valgustatud. Naisest paremal, aknalaual, triibulisel linal hele vaas värviliste puuviljadega. Vasakul triibulised kardinad, foonil aken vaatega helesinisele taevale ja linnale.
works.de: In the foreground a woman sitting in a dark skirt and dark patterned blouse, a green shawl on her shoulders. A brooch at the blouse's neckline, a beige hat on her head, her face brightly lit beneath it. To the woman's right, on a windowsill, on a striped cloth, a light-coloured vase with colourful fruits. On the left striped curtains, in the background a window with a view of a light blue sky and the city.

works.d: Esiplaanil viis inimfiguuri: keskel seisval mehel peas väike kübarakujuline müts, õlgadel pruun kuub, valge särgi rinna kohale on tõstetud vasaku käe kõverdatud peopesa. Esiplaanil seisva mehe selja taga heledapäine noor mees rohekas kuues, meeste vahel kaks heledasse rõivastunud valgetes pearätikutes naist, üks neist profiilis. Paremas servas sinist kapuutsi kohendav naine. Foonil künklik panoraammastik. Nurgelised vormid, koloriit peamisel roosakaspruun ja sinine.
works.de: In the foreground five human figures: the man standing in the centre wears a small hat-like cap on his head, a brown coat on his shoulders, and the curved palm of his left hand is raised to the level of his white shirt's chest. Behind the man standing in the foreground is a fair-haired young man in a greenish coat; between the men are two women dressed in light clothing with white headscarves, one of them in profile. In the right edge a woman adjusting a blue hood. In the background a hilly panoramic landscape. Angular forms, the colour scheme mainly pinkish-brown and blue.

works.d: Tumsesinise kaabuga mehe rinnaportree (vöökohani). Nägu suures osas kaabu varjus, rohelistes ja kollastes toonides. Seljas pruun kuub, tume särk ja hele vest. Figuur ja riideesemed ümbritsetud tumesinise kontuuriga, vormid kergelt geometriseeritud. Foon rohekas-sinine, läbi töötatud nähtavate, kohati roosade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: A bust portrait (to the waist) of a man in a dark blue hat. The face is largely in the shadow of the hat, in green and yellow tones. He wears a brown coat, a dark shirt and a light waistcoat. The figure and clothing items are surrounded by a dark blue contour, the forms slightly geometricized. Background greenish-blue, worked through with visible, at places pinkish, brush strokes.

works.d: Hallikassinisel järil istuv naine, peas valge ümarate servadega kübar, seljas rohelise kraega hele jakk, rohekas seelik ja ruudulised sukad. Naise süles heledas kleidis, punases mütsis ja sukkades ning rohelistes saabastes tüdruk. Nii naisel kui tüdrukul sirge nina, naisel pruunid, tüdrukul rohelised silmad. Foon keskosas ruuduline, pruun, servades hallikasrohelised triibud. Foonil vasakus nurgas hele väike ruut.
works.de: A woman sitting on a greyish-blue sledge, on her head a white hat with rounded edges, wearing a light jacket with a green collar, a greenish skirt and checked stockings. In the woman's lap a girl in a light dress, a red cap and stockings, and green boots. Both the woman and the girl have straight noses, the woman has brown eyes, the girl green eyes. The background in the middle section is checked, brown, with greyish-green stripes at the edges. In the background, in the left corner, a small light square.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist: parempoolsel toetab parem jalg ookrikarva kastile, käed toetavad kivi põlvel, seljas valge lühikeste varrukatega pluus ja punane seelik, peas valge rätik. Vasakpoolne naine hoiab vasaku käega kivi pea peal, parem käsi puusas, seljas valge käisteta pluus ja tume seelik. Foonil vasakul majanurk ja hall kott, paremal maastikufragment.
works.de: In the foreground two women: the one on the right rests her right foot on an ochre-coloured box, her hands support a stone on her knee, she wears a white short-sleeved blouse and a red skirt, on her head a white kerchief. The woman on the left holds a stone on her head with her left hand, her right hand on her hip, wearing a white sleeveless blouse and a dark skirt. In the background on the left, the corner of a house and a grey bag, on the right a fragment of landscape.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, mille keskel frontaalselt grupp naisi, teine grupp neist paremal trepiga hoone taustal, millel paistab säravvalgete hammastega groteskne pea. Hoonest vasakul jupp maastikku ja noormees neiuga seismas kohvri kõrval platvormil. Vasakul servas, joonega muust kompositsioonist eraldatud 3 figuuri, üks neist lõõtspilliga, maastiku taustal.
works.de: A figural composition, in the centre of which a group of women frontally, a second group of them on the right against the background of a building with a staircase, on which a grotesque head with brightly white teeth can be seen. To the left of the building, a piece of landscape and a young man with a girl standing next to a suitcase on a platform. On the left edge, separated from the rest of the composition by a line, 3 figures, one of them with an accordion, against a landscape background.

works.d: Vasakul tellingutes torniga Niguliste kirik, keskel kraana kollase kabiiniga, selle taga "Viru" hotelli risttahukakujuline hoone. Esiplaanil müüri taustal kollane teerull ja jupp punase-kollasekirjut piirdeaeda. Foonil sinine taevas kandiliselt antud valgete pilvedega. Domineerivad summutatud hallid, rohelised, sinised toonid. Pildil struktuuri rõhutav maalimisviis.
works.de: On the left, St. Nicholas' Church with its tower in scaffolding, in the middle a crane with a yellow cabin, behind it the cuboid building of the "Viru" hotel. In the foreground, against a wall backdrop, a yellow road roller and a piece of a red-and-yellow patterned fence. In the background a blue sky rendered in an angular manner with white clouds. Muted grey, green and blue tones dominate. The painting emphasises structure in its manner of execution.

works.d: Rohekashallides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: keskplaanis grupp hangude ja rehadega mehi ja naisi suurt heinakuhja tegemas. Neist vasakul istuvast ja joovast mehest ning kahest naisest koosnev grupp, ühel naisel käsi laubale tõstetud. Esiplaanil servas maas reha ja hang, kauss, korv ja suur tumeroheline pudel. Fooniks heinamaade, puude, loomade ja taluehitustega maastik. Taevas kollakasroheline, mõne roosa pilvega.
works.de: Figural composition in greenish-grey tones: in the middle ground a group of men and women with pitchforks and rakes building a large haystack. To the left of them a group consisting of a seated, drinking man and two women, one woman with her hand raised to her forehead. In the foreground at the edge, on the ground, a rake and a pitchfork, a bowl, a basket and a large dark green bottle. Background a landscape of hayfields, trees, animals and farm buildings. Sky yellowish-green, with a few pink clouds.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon kartulivõtjatega esiplaanil: kolm tumedas riides pearätikutega naist seisavad, neljas kallab korvist kartuleid pildi keskele maalitud vankrisse, mille maas lebavatel aistel pruun kuub. Naistest vasakul künnab tumedates riietes mees valge hobusega kartulivagusid lahti. Foonil, otsekui läbi udu antud hall küün ning üksikud puud. Taevas tinahall.
works.de: A figural composition with potato pickers in the foreground: three women dressed in dark clothing with headscarves stand, a fourth pours potatoes from a basket into a cart painted in the center of the picture, on whose bed a brown coat lies. To the left of the women, a man in dark clothes ploughs open potato ridges with a white horse. In the background, as if given through fog, a gray barn and solitary trees. The sky is leaden gray.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal tumedas varrukateta kleidis ja valges pearätis istuv naine, heledas särgikeses laps põlvedel. Tema taga pruunis seelikus ja pluusis ning valges rätis naine seismas, väljasirutatud käsi rehavarrele toetamas. Naiste ees, pildi keskel esiplaanil kann, korv ning teised majapidamisesemed. Keskplaanis kaks seelikutes ja pluusides naist ning kaks kaabudes meest, rehad ja hargud õlal, sammumas. Paremal servas pruun hobune, taevas roosakaspruun.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a woman sitting in a dark sleeveless dress and a white headscarf, with a child in a light shirt on her lap. Behind her, a woman standing in a brown skirt and blouse and a white scarf, her outstretched hand resting on a rake handle. In front of the women, in the centre foreground, a jug, a basket and other household items. In the middle ground two women in skirts and blouses and two men in hats, rakes and forks on their shoulders, walking. On the right edge a brown horse, the sky pinkish-brown.

works.d: Väikese aknaga tumedate seintega ruumis esiplaanil alasti naisfiguur oma tumedaid juukseid pesemas. Naise jalgade ja niuete ümber helevalge lina, selja taga valge kauss. Ruumi avatud uksel seisab vastu valgust teine naisekuju pruuni linaga ümber jalgade. Avatud uksel ripuvad riided ja rätikud.
works.de: In a room with dark walls and a small window, in the foreground a nude female figure washing her dark hair. Around the woman's legs and hips a very light-coloured sheet, behind her back a white bowl. In the open doorway of the room stands, against the light, another female figure with a brown cloth around her legs. On the open door hang clothes and towels.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal valges kleidis mustade juustega naine peseu pesemas. Vasakul foonil üks must ja teine punakaspruun hobune ning kaks inimest: valges kleidis ja rätikus naine ja triibulistes riietes musta mütsiga mees, pikk roigas õlal. Tagaplaanil heinasaadudega kollane põld ja roheline metsaviirg. Taevas kollakasroosa.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a black-haired woman in a white dress is washing herself. In the background on the left, one black and one reddish-brown horse and two people: a woman in a white dress and headscarf and a man in striped clothing with a black cap, a long pole on his shoulder. In the background, a yellow field with haystacks and a green strip of forest. The sky is yellowish-pink.

works.d: Peamiselt tuhmides rohelistes, sinistes ja hallides toonides maastik kaarduva kiviaiaga esiplaanil paremal ja pukktuulikuga keskel. Tuuliku taga paremal mustaks küntud põld, vasakul tee, mis viib pildi sügavuses asuva külani. Silmapiiril asetsevad vaheldumisi küla moodustanud talumajad ja puud. Ülal kollakashall taevas.
works.de: A landscape mainly in muted green, blue and grey tones, with a curving stone fence in the foreground at right and a post mill in the centre. Behind the mill at right, a field ploughed black, at left a road leading to a village in the depth of the picture. On the horizon, farmhouses and trees forming the village alternate. Above, a yellowish-grey sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil väike, nikerdatud jalgadega tumedast puust laud. Laual beeži-pruunitriibuline lina. Laual seadeldis: esiservas kaks ülestikku asetatud raamatut, pealmine neist rohelise kaanega. Raamatutel tume, hallikasroheline, altpoolt ahanev kauss, mille ülaservas kaks tumedat triipu. Raamatute taga paremal tumesinine, ülalt kitsa kaelaga vaas, milles suur kollane roos. Roosiga vaasist vasemal sale, ülaosas ahenev, sangaga pruun keraamiline vaas. Foon vanaroosades ja rohekassinistes toonides, servades on pisut imiteeritud draperiid.
works.de: In the foreground a small table of dark wood with carved legs. On the table a beige-brown striped tablecloth. On the table an arrangement: at the front edge two books placed one on top of the other, the top one with a green cover. On the books a dark, greyish-green bowl narrowing at the bottom, with two dark stripes at its upper edge. Behind the books, on the right, a dark blue vase with a narrow neck at the top, in which a large yellow rose. To the left of the vase with the rose, a slender brown ceramic vase with a handle, narrowing at the top. The background is in old rose and greenish-blue tones, with slightly imitated drapery at the edges.

works.d: Konstruktiivses laadis maalitud seadeldis: esiplaanil keskel valge, sinise koobaltmaailinguga kõhukas kann, millest paremal kaks siredat kõrgusesse pürgiva vormiga pudelit, kannu kohal sirelililla servaga sinine keraamiline taldrik või plaat. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks tuhmi sinepikollast tooni sidrunit. Maalitud summutatud sinistes, kollakates, rohelistes toonides, pindade kontuure tublisti rõhutades.
works.de: An arrangement painted in a constructive manner: in the foreground centre a white, bulbous jug with blue cobalt design, to the right of which two slender bottles with upward-striving forms, above the jug a blue ceramic plate or platter with a lilac edge. In the foreground on the left two dull mustard-yellow toned lemons. Painted in muted blue, yellowish, green tones, strongly emphasising the contours of the surfaces.

works.d: Panoraamne Lõuna-Eesti maastik mäeküngaste, nende vahel asuvate põllu- ja heinamaasiilude, puude ja metsatukkadega. Keskplaanis, puude ja küngaste vahel, madalad taluhooned, silmapiiril vasakul tumesinine metsa siluett. Ülal hallika pilvesäbruga kaetud roosa taevas. Maalitud rohelistes ja roosades toonides, looduse vorme kergelt geometriseerides. Kohati on värvikihti pinna elustamiseks veetud terava esemega kriipse.
works.de: A panoramic South Estonian landscape with hillocks, strips of field and hayfield between them, trees and clumps of forest. In the middle ground, between the trees and hills, low farm buildings, on the horizon on the left a dark blue silhouette of forest. Above, a pink sky covered with a greyish fringe of clouds. Painted in green and pink tones, with the forms of nature lightly geometricised. In places, scratches have been drawn with a sharp object through the paint layer to enliven the surface.

works.de: A red horse, a black foal and two women in a room

works.d: taluelu stseen: punane hobune, must varss ja neli naist
works.de: scene of rural life: a red horse, a black foal and four women

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel tiibklaver, mille peal lillevaas ja kast, klaveri kõrval tool, ülaosas aken
works.de: In the foreground centre a grand piano, on which a flower vase and a box stand, a chair beside the piano, a window above

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, prillidega
works.de: Man's chest picture in half-profile to the right, with glasses

works.d: Esiplaanil aknalaud mitmesuguste vaaside ja kirevate lilledega. Paremal akna all pehme tugitool. Aknast vaade talumaastikule.
works.de: In the foreground a windowsill with various vases and colourful flowers. On the right below the window a soft armchair. View from the window onto a farm landscape.

works.d: Esiplaanil põõsad väikeste punaste marjadega. Tagaplaanil puud ja taevas.
works.de: In the foreground bushes with small red berries. In the background trees and sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil frontaalselt alla minev väike trepp ja pildi sügavusse suunduv kõrgete puudega ääristatud tee. Läbi raagus puude paistavad majad. Maa kaetud osaliselt kerge lumega.
works.de: In the foreground, a small staircase descending frontally and a road bordered by tall trees leading into the depth of the picture. Houses visible through bare trees. The ground partially covered with a light layer of snow.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage vesi. Tagapool kaks väikest saart puudega. Eemalt paistab sinakas metsaga kallas.
works.de: In the foreground open water. Further back two small islands with trees. In the distance a bluish shore with forest is visible.

works.d: Künklik maastik. Esiplaanil oja ja sellest üle viiv rippsild, millel inimesi. Esiplaanil grupp istuvaid inimesi. Oja teisel kaldal puude all hulgaliselt inimesi.
works.de: Hilly landscape. In the foreground a stream and a suspension bridge crossing over it, with people on it. In the foreground a group of seated people. On the other bank of the stream many people under the trees.

works.t: Eesti punakaartlased Lenini ja Stalini juures
works.d: Ruumi sisevaade. Vasakul esiplaanil Lenin, tagapool laua taga Stalin. Paremal rühm mehi relvadega, osa sõduririietuses.
works.de: Interior view of a room. On the left in the foreground Lenin, behind him Stalin at a table. On the right a group of men with weapons, some in soldiers' uniforms.

works.d: Vasakul avaneva akna ette paigutatud lilleriiulil mitmesugustes pottides ja kastides lilli. Samasuguseid potililli ka paremal.
works.de: On a flower shelf placed in front of a window opening to the left, flowers in various pots and boxes. Similar potted flowers also on the right.

works.d: Hoogsa, dünaamilise pallimängu abstraheering: lõuendi keskosas, mida koondab nelinurk, on mängijad sirutunud palli suunas. Keskne stseen on organiseeritud punakate, sinakate, rohekate värvilaikude ja joonte rütmiga, mida piirab avaralt hele roosakates ja rohekates toonides foon.
works.de: An abstraction of a vigorous, dynamic ball game: in the central part of the canvas, gathered into a quadrangle, the players are stretched towards the ball. The central scene is organized by a rhythm of reddish, bluish, greenish patches of colour and lines, bordered by an expansive light background in pinkish and greenish tones.

works.d: Akna all laual mitmesuguseid potte ja kaste roheliste taimedega; akna heledale taustale tõusevad kaks kõrgemat laialehelist lille.
works.de: On the table under the window various pots and boxes with green plants; against the light background of the window two taller broad-leaved flowers rise.

works.d: Mägine panoraam madalast vaatenurgast. Vasakule jäävad üksikud ehitised ja puud. Tagaplaanil kõrguvad lumised mäeahelikud.
works.de: Mountain panorama from a low viewpoint. On the left are individual buildings and trees. Snowy mountain ranges rise in the background.

works.d: Järsul mäeküljel alt vasakult üles paremale suunduv kääruline oja, mille kaldail üksikuid maju, puid.
works.de: A winding stream running from lower left to upper right on a steep hillside, with a few houses and trees on its banks.

works.d: Esiplaanil kitsa ribana org oja ja üksiku puuga; samas tõusevad järsult kõrged mäeahelikud, mis ulatuvad ülaservas heleda taevani.
works.de: In the foreground a narrow strip of a valley with a stream and a solitary tree; at the same time high mountain ranges rise sharply, reaching to the bright sky at the upper edge.

works.d: Rohelisel taustal eralduvad pehmelt üksikud puud ja madal lumise katusega maja.
works.de: Against a green background, individual trees and a low house with a snow-covered roof stand out softly.

works.d: Maalipinna keskosas naisefiguur otsevaates, tema taga tihedalt teised figuurid profiilis; nende ülessirutatud kätel lapsefiguur. Ülaservas päikeseketta kujutis.
works.de: In the central part of the painted surface, a female figure in frontal view, behind her other figures tightly packed in profile; on their raised arms a figure of a child. In the upper edge, the image of a solar disc.

works.d: Tihkelt üksteise läheduses seisvad figuurid, paigutatud maali keskplaanile. Koloriit hele, siniste aktsentidega.
works.de: Figures standing closely together, placed in the middle ground of the painting. Colouring light, with blue accents.

works.d: Abstraheeritud figuur üle pildi pinna. Heledal foonil pruunid kontuurid punakate ja siniste aktsentidega.
works.de: An abstracted figure across the surface of the picture. Brown contours with reddish and blue accents on a light background.

works.d: Pruunikais-beežikais-rohekates toonides kompositisoon viie tingliku naisfiguuriga, kellest äärmised istuvad.
works.de: Composition in brownish-beige-greenish tones with five schematic female figures, of which the outer ones are seated.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud toidunõudega. Selle juures sinises riietuses inimene; temast vasakul veel kolm figuuri.
works.de: In the foreground a table with dishes of food. Beside it a person dressed in blue; to the left of them three more figures.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm seisvat figuuri. Nende taga lillakates ja rohekates toonides saal kuulajatega.
works.de: In the foreground three standing figures. Behind them a hall in purplish and greenish tones with listeners.

works.dm: laius: 180.0 cm ((kõik kolm osa)); kõrgus: 119.0 cm
works.d: Musitseeriv orkester - paremal keelpillide mängijad, vasakul pianist.
works.de: An orchestra making music - on the right string players, on the left a pianist.

works.dm: laius: 180.0 cm ((kõik kolm osa)); kõrgus: 119.0 cm
works.d: Noored tütarlapsed balletitunnis.
works.de: Young girls in a ballet class.

works.dm: laius: 180.0 cm ((kõik kolm osa)); kõrgus: 119.0 cm
works.d: Paremal neli figuuri - kaks seisvat ja kaks istuvat. Vasakul maalija molberti ees.
works.de: On the right four figures - two standing and two sitting. On the left a painter before an easel.

works.d: Hallil foonil väga tinglikud pruunikates ja hallikates toonides figuurid.
works.de: Against a grey background very conventionalised figures in brownish and greyish tones.

works.d: Keskel vasakul Lenini figuur, parem käsi tõstetud rinna kõrgusele. Paremal keskel kolm meest, kaks sõduri- ja üka madruseriietes. Vasakul- ning allääres stseenid Lenini elust. Üleval ääres ja ülal paremal nurgas sõdurid.
works.de: In the centre left, the figure of Lenin, right hand raised to chest height. To the right in the centre, three men, two in soldier's and one in sailor's clothing. On the left and lower edges, scenes from Lenin's life. At the top edge and in the upper right corner, soldiers.

works.d: Ruumi sisevaade; vasakul laua ääres istub mees, vasakus käes avatud raamat, paremaga toetub lauale. Paremal seisab mees, käes pintsel ja palett.
works.de: Interior view of a room; on the left a man sits at the table, in his left hand an open book, with the right he leans on the table. On the right stands a man, holding a brush and palette.

works.d: Pastelsetes, põhiliselt pruunides ja rohelistes toonides pinadade kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskel valged pinnad.
works.de: A composition of planes in pastel, mainly brown and green tones. White planes in the centre of the composition.

works.d: Tumedates pehmetes toonides heledale taustale maalitud kompositsioon. Keskel laud paari heleda pudeli ja tassiga, selle taga üks naise ja kaks mehe figuuri. Kompositsiooni paremal serval veel üks figuur.
works.de: A composition painted in dark, soft tones against a light background. In the centre a table with a pair of light-coloured bottles and a cup, behind it one female and two male figures. At the right edge of the composition, one more figure.

works.d: Vasakul seisva, viiluit mängiva tütarlapse figuur. Paremal valge riidega kaetud laua ääres kaks istuvat figuuri. Tagaplaanil paistab aken.
works.de: Figure of a girl standing on the left, playing the violin. On the right, by a table covered with white cloth, two seated figures. In the background a window is visible.

works.d: Rohekal foonil sinise tooniga antud kompositsiooniline grupp inimese ülakeha ja hobuse alakehaga figuuridest. Grupi tsentris, samuti äärtel rohkesti mustjaspruune ja mustjassiniseid pindu.
works.de: On a greenish background, given in blue tones, a compositional group of figures with human upper bodies and horse lower bodies. In the centre of the group, as well as at the edges, plenty of blackish-brown and blackish-blue planes.

works.d: Fooniks mustad ja pruunid pinnad. Esiplaanil valgete ja mustade joontega antus neli inimfiguuri. Vasakpoolse figuuri pea kallutatud vasakule.
works.de: Background of black and brown surfaces. In the foreground four human figures rendered with white and black lines. The head of the left figure tilted to the left.

works.d: Rohekad ja pruunikad jooned ning pinnad moodustavad abstraktsete inimfiguuride grupi. Siin-seal üle kogu pildi pinna sinakaslillad pinnad.
works.de: Greenish and brownish lines and surfaces form a group of abstract human figures. Here and there over the whole surface of the picture bluish-purple surfaces.

works.d: Kompositsioon pruunikas-hallis koloriidis, mõne roosaka pinnaga. Esiplaanil terrass, millel mehe ja naise seisvad figuurid. Nende ees terrassil kaks valget tuvi. Tagaplaanil majad.
works.de: Composition in brownish-grey coloring, with some pinkish surfaces. In the foreground a terrace, on which stand the figures of a man and a woman. In front of them on the terrace two white doves. In the background houses.

works.d: Beežika taeva ja pruunides toonides maastiku taustal, pildi keskel rohekatest, pruunidest, valgetest ning oranžidest pindadest ja joontest moodustuv kolmefiguuriline grupp.
works.de: Against a beige sky and a landscape in brown tones, in the middle of the picture a three-figure group formed of greenish, brown, white and orange planes and lines.

works.d: Kollasel taustal, sinistest, rohelistest ja punastest pindadest moodustuv fantastiliste, abstraktsete figuuride grupp. Nende keskel kaks inimfiguuri, parempoolsel pea kallutatud paremale.
works.de: On a yellow background, a group of fantastical, abstract figures formed from blue, green and red surfaces. Among them two human figures, the one on the right with its head tilted to the right.

works.d: Rohekas-pruunil foonil sinistest, mustadest ja valkjatest joontest ning pindadest kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni ülemises pooles ülekaalus tumedad toonid, allosas heledad.
works.de: A composition of blue, black and whitish lines and surfaces on a greenish-brown background. Dark tones predominate in the upper half of the composition, light tones in the lower part.

works.d: Kolm pikaksvenitatud, tugevasti stiliseeritud figuuri heledal foonil.
works.de: Three elongated, strongly stylised figures on a light background.

works.d: Tumedas koloriidis kompositsioon kolmest figuurist. Keskmise figuuri juures üksikud ookerjad ning oranžikad pinnad.
works.de: Composition of three figures in a dark colour scheme. Near the middle figure, individual ochre and orangish areas.

works.d: Vana naine ja mees kartuleid koorimas. Naine paremal pool profiilis, valges rätis, punakas seelikus. Kartulikauss kahe vahel taburetil. Kogu maal tumedates pruunides toonides, valgus helendab kartulitel ja pearätil.
works.de: An old woman and man peeling potatoes. The woman on the right in profile, in a white headscarf, reddish skirt. A bowl of potatoes on a stool between them. The whole painting in dark brown tones, light gleaming on the potatoes and the headscarf.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremas ääres soniga mehe poolfiguur ning osa majast. Vasakul pikad müügilauad juurviljadega ning müüjad ja ostjad. Tagaplaanil linna hooned.
works.de: In the foreground on the right edge the half-figure of a man with a cane and part of a house. On the left long sales tables with vegetables, and sellers and buyers. In the background city buildings.

works.d: Tumedal foonil punases laiaäärse kübaraga, mõtliku ilmega naise istuv poolfiguur; kerge pöördega paremale. Käed asetatud vaheliti rinnale; õlgadel hele triibuline jakk.
works.de: On a dark background a seated half-figure of a pensive-looking woman in red, in a wide-brimmed hat; with a slight turn to the right. Hands placed crossed on the chest; on the shoulders a light striped jacket.

works.d: Värvilisel foonil heledad, mitmesugused ebakorrapärased kujundid.
works.de: Against a coloured background, light-coloured, various irregular shapes.

works.d: Heledal taustal tume, ebakorrapärane kujund. Sellel valkjad, sinised, punased moodustised.
works.de: On a light background, a dark, irregular shape. On it whitish, blue, red formations.

works.d: Üle pildipinna maalitud laiade hoogsate pintslilöökidega sinistes ja ookertoonides rahutu meri, millel laeva kujutis mustade, punaste, siniste pintslitõmmetega visandatud.
works.de: Painted over the picture surface with broad, sweeping brushstrokes in blue and ochre tones a restless sea, on which the image of a ship is sketched with black, red and blue brush strokes.

works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man sitting in front of a bookshelf, in a half-turn, one hand on his hip, the other on his knee, a purplish-blue shirt with sleeves rolled up to the elbow, collar open, light-grey trousers, dark hair, high forehead, straight nose.

works.d: Pruunikas-rohelistes, keskosas pastelsetes roosakais ja kollastes toonides joontest ning pindadest abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: Abstract composition of lines and surfaces in brownish-green, in the middle part in pastel pinkish and yellow tones.

works.d: Suur figuraalne kompositsioon. Esiplaanil viljakottide juures seisvad pearätikutes naised, ühel neist märkmik ja punane pliiats käes. Keskplaanil paremal viljapeksumasin, millel kolm inimest, kelle kätte jangub mees hobusekoormalt viljavihke. Kaks meest koguvad vilja kottidesse. Keskplaanil vasakul sinises kleidis ja pearätikus naine seljaga vaataja poole hangule toetumas. Temast vasakul kaal viljakottidega ja mehed viljakotte autole laadimas. Tagaplaanil õlekuhi, vasakul ja paremal maastik.
works.de: A large figural composition. In the foreground, women in headscarves standing by grain sacks, one of them holding a notebook and a red pencil. In the middle ground on the right a threshing machine, at which three people are handing sheaves of grain to a man from a horse-drawn load. Two men are collecting grain into sacks. In the middle ground on the left a woman in a blue dress and headscarf, with her back to the viewer, leaning on a pitchfork. To her left a scale with grain sacks and men loading grain sacks onto a truck. In the background a haystack, landscape to the left and right.

works.d: Naise põlvportree pöördes paremale. Tumedatel juustel punane kübar. Seljas samas toonis seelik ja vest sinisekirju pluusiga. Foon helepruun.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman turned to the right. A red hat on dark hair. Wearing a skirt and vest of the same tone with a blue-patterned blouse. Background light brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline maapind, millel kerge pintslitõmbega visandatud looklev teerada. Vasakule jäävad kõrged kadakad ja põõsad ning paremale põõsad. Madalamal keskplaanil metsa ja natukene näha merd. Taevas hallikaid pilvi. Etüüdilikult maalitud.
works.de: In the foreground a green ground on which a winding path is sketched with a light brush stroke. To the left are tall junipers and bushes, and to the right, bushes. Lower in the middle ground, forest and a bit of the sea can be seen. In the sky, grayish clouds. Painted in an etude-like manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi sinakasmustade põõsapuhmastega alumistes nurkades. Üle jõe mõned tuules kooldunud tumedad puud punaka paadiga nende vahel. Taamal rohekashall väli, väga kõrge horisont. Koloriit tume, peamiselt sinakates ja rohelistes toonides, pilvisest taevast varjutatud.
works.de: In the foreground a river with bluish-black bush clumps in the lower corners. Across the river some dark trees bent by the wind, with a reddish boat between them. In the distance a greenish-grey field, a very high horizon. The colouring dark, mainly in bluish and green tones, shaded by an overcast sky.

works.d: Pruunides, hallides, sinistes ja kollastes toonides abstraktne, väga dünaamiline kompositsioon, mille jooonterägust on aimatavad vaataja poole pööratud näod ja ülestõstetud käed. Hoogsate, selgelt eristuvate, impulsiivsete pintslilöökidega maalitud.
works.de: Abstract, highly dynamic composition in brown, grey, blue and yellow tones, in whose linear texture faces turned toward the viewer and raised hands can be discerned. Painted with vigorous, clearly distinguishable, impulsive brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunil toolil istuva noore naise portree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas mustast ja hallist riidest kombineeritud valge kraega kleit. Poolpikad kastanpruunid juuksed on otsmikult tagasi kammitud. Naise parem käsi toetub küünarnukiga lauale, millel pikk rida raamatuid. Käes rohekas-hallist savist tass alustassiga. Foon täppivalt mustaga kaetud, alt kumab läbi roheline toon. Kohati pastoosne, selgelt eristuvate pintslijälgedega.
works.de: In the foreground, a portrait of a young woman sitting on a brown chair, slightly turned to the right. Wearing a dress combined of black and gray fabric with a white collar. Her shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair is combed back from her forehead. The woman's right hand rests with the elbow on a table, on which there is a long row of books. In her hand a cup with a saucer made of greenish-gray clay. The background is covered with dotted black, through which a green tone shows below. Somewhat pastose, with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes.

works.d: Kolmest naisfiguurist koosnev kompositsioon: tumedate puude all paremal vilepilli puhuv, vasakul lamav ja vasakul ülal lambatallega naisakt. Tumedad hallikaspruunid värvitoonid, maalitud piirjooni hajutavalt.
works.de: A composition of three female figures: under dark trees, on the right a nude woman playing a pipe, on the left a reclining one, and above on the left a nude woman with a lamb. Dark greyish-brown colour tones, painted with diffused contour lines.

works.d: Suvine maastik pildi sügavusse suubuva väikese, tumedate varjude ja peegeldustega veepinnal, jõega esiplaanil. Jõe kallastel suured puud ja põõsad, vasakul kaldal väike suvitusseltskond. Foonil tume metsaviirg. Ülaservas riba valkjaskollaste pilvedega kaetud taevast.
works.de: Summer landscape with a river in the foreground, its surface receding into the depth of the picture with dark shadows and reflections. On the riverbanks large trees and bushes, on the left bank a small group of vacationers. In the background a dark strip of forest. At the upper edge a strip of sky covered with whitish-yellow clouds.

On the stripes, surfaces bordered by a blue stripe, striped red-yellow inside with blue spots. In the upper right corner, an Indian in profile with a red headband, to his left a reddish spot within a large grey spot. Below on the right a quadrangular figure filled inside with labyrinth lines.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskosas üks poolik ja üks terve roosa ring (otsekui aastaringidega kaetud). Ülaservas paremal osa vikerkaarest. Piki paremat serva hallikaslilla triip, ülalt heledam, alt tumedam. Üle pildi pinna otsekui suurendatud jäälilled, millest paistab läbi roosa, tumesinine ja kollakas foon.
