works.d: Esiplaanil madal jõekallas üksiku majaga. Keskosas jõgi. Vasakul Hermani kindlus. Paremal Ivangorodi linnuse nurgatorn. Taamal Narva vanalinna katuseid ja kirikutorne.
works.de: In the foreground a low riverbank with a single house. In the middle section the river. On the left Hermann Castle. On the right the corner tower of Ivangorod Fortress. In the distance rooftops and church towers of Narva's old town.

works.d: Laual vasakul kaks õuna, taldrik kahe õunaga, vaas lilledega; paremal tumesinisel riidel õunu ja vaas lilledega.
works.de: On the table on the left two apples, a plate with two apples, a vase with flowers; on the right, on a dark blue cloth, apples and a vase with flowers.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 125.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 115.0 cm
works.d: Jõemaastik ülalt alla vaates. Esiplaanil vasakpoolsest nurgast paremale taha kulgeva tee ääres (vaataja pool) aiamaa. Teiselpool teed, vasakul jõgi veskihoonetega ja hobustega lasipuu juures. Keskel ja paremal laienev veskijärv. Keskelt otse taha kulgeva jõe kallastel: paremal põllud üksikute hoonete gruppidega ja metsaga; vasakul lehtpuu metsaribaga. Taamal keskel kõrgenev maastik.
works.de: A river landscape seen from above. In the foreground, along a road running from the left corner to the back on the right (on the viewer's side), a vegetable garden. On the other side of the road, on the left, a river with mill buildings and horses by a hitching post. In the middle and on the right, a widening mill pond. Along the banks of the river running straight back from the centre: on the right fields with individual groups of buildings and forest; on the left a strip of deciduous forest. In the distance in the middle, rising terrain.

works.d: Ees põllud vasakult paremale jooksva katkendliku põõsaste reaga. Keskel vasakult paremale looklev jõgi. Vastaskaldal kõrgeneval maastikul põllud üksikute puude tukkadega. 1/3 tööst taeva all.
works.de: In the foreground, fields with a broken row of bushes running from left to right. In the middle a river winding from left to right. On the opposite bank, rising terrain with fields dotted with clumps of trees. 1/3 of the work under sky.

works.d: Ees peenramaa. Keskel kitsas, looklev jõgi. Vastaskaldal rida hajali taluhooneid. Tagapool, kergelt lainjal maastikul põllud üksikute hoonetega. Silmapiiril mets.
works.de: In front a garden bed. In the middle a narrow, winding river. On the opposite bank a row of scattered farm buildings. Beyond, in a gently undulating landscape, fields with isolated buildings. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Ees paremal künka serv kuuskede ja üksikute lehtpuu latvadega. Keskel, orus eest vasakult taha paremale kulgev jõgi. Vastaskallas mägine, üksikute metsatukkadega.
works.de: In front, right, the edge of a hill with spruces and the tops of a few deciduous trees. In the middle, in the valley, a river running from front left to back right. The opposite bank is mountainous, with isolated groves.

works.d: Ees paremal, üksikute puude ja kaevuga rohumaa ääres, taraga piiratud aianurk. Taga vasakul aiaga piiratud maja. Kaugemal, rohumaa ääres rida maju.
works.de: In front on the right, at the edge of a grassy area with individual trees and a well, a fenced corner of a garden. Behind on the left a house enclosed by a fence. Further away, along the edge of the grassy area, a row of houses.

works.d: Ees kuni diagonaalselt paremalt taha vasakule kulgeva teeni põõsastik ja üksikud männid. Teiselpool teed taluhooned, mille taga laiuvad päikesekiirtest valgustatud põllud. 1/6 tööst taeva all.
works.de: In front, up to a road running diagonally from the right to the back left, shrubbery and single pine trees. On the other side of the road farm buildings, behind which lie fields lit by sunbeams. 1/6 of the work under the sky.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha keskele kulgev teekurv madala kiviaia ja ühekordete kivimajadega vasakul ja paremal.
works.de: A road curving from the front left to the back centre, with a low stone wall and single-storey stone houses on the left and right.

works.dm: lehe laius: 44.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.3 cm
works.d: Laual klaasvaasis punased moonid, vaasist paremal sini-rohelise kirju klaaskausike, laual pudenenud mooni õielehti ja peegeldushelki.
works.de: Red poppies in a glass vase on a table, to the right of the vase a blue-green patterned glass bowl, on the table scattered poppy petals and reflected light.

works.dm: lehe laius: 77.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 81.5 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu taga vooremaastik põllulaikude, kahe kollase heleda valgusrefleksi ja sinetava võsa ja kauge metsaga. Tagafoonil rünkpilvine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, beyond a body of water, a drumlin landscape with patches of field, two yellow bright light reflections and bluish scrub and distant forest. In the background a sky with cumulus clouds.

works.d: Üle astangutena tõusvate majade katuste paistab Oleviste kiriku torn. Tornikiiver pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Põhitooniks punaka varjundiga pruun.
works.de: Above the roofs of houses rising in terraces, the tower of St. Olaf's Church is visible. The spire is cut off by the upper edge of the picture. The main tone is a reddish-tinged brown.

works.d: Panoraammaastik: esiplaanil küngas ja pildi allservas põõsad, paremal servas punaka ja kollase lehestikuga puud. Taamal erksinine järv paari kuusega vasakus servas, edasi künkad kuni kõrge silmapiirini. Taevas hall, paksude valgete pilvedega.
works.de: Panoramic landscape: in the foreground a hillock and bushes at the bottom edge of the picture, on the right edge trees with reddish and yellow foliage. In the background a bright blue lake with a couple of spruces at the left edge, further on hillocks up to a high horizon. Sky gray, with thick white clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruun mäeveer, mille servas kasvavad kollased kased ja rohelised põõsad eraldavad esiplaani kesk- ja tagaplaanist. Kaskede taga helesinine järv, silmapiiril künkad ja metsatukad. Ülal hall taevas.

Panoraammaastik: esiplaanil ja tagaplaanil künkad, mille vahel helesinine veekogu. Vasakul, peamiselt kuuskedest metsatukk. Ülal kergelt pilvine hall taevas. Pildi vasak pool maalitud lühikeste tihedate pintslilöökidega, parem laseerivamalt.

Kirju sügismaastik: esiplaanil rohelised niidud, vasakul ja paremal punaste lehtedega haavad ning kollaseks tõmbunud kroonidega kased. Täpselt pildi keskpunktis eriti säravkollases toonis puu. Tagaplaanil mäekallak põllu- ja heinamaasiiludega. Ülal tumesinine taevas valgete pilvedega. Pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: A colourful autumn landscape: in the foreground green meadows, on the left and right aspens with red leaves and birches with crowns turned yellow. Exactly at the picture's central point a tree of especially bright yellow tone. In the background a hillside with strips of field and hayfield. Above a dark blue sky with white clouds. Painted pastosely.

works.d: Vaade Tallinnale Kadriorust. Mõlemas servas suured lehtpuud, keskel meres kivid, taustal Tallinna panoraam, mille kohal sinises taevas roosakad pilved.
works.de: View of Tallinn from Kadriorg. On both edges large deciduous trees, in the centre rocks in the sea, in the background a panorama of Tallinn, above which in the blue sky pinkish clouds.

works.d: Pruunikasbeežil foonil allveelaeva veepealse osa mustjas siluett, selle ümber paremal ja all hele pind. Laeva kuju kordab maali ülemises osas paiknev hallikaspruun kujund. Maalitud ühtlaste pikisuunaliste, õhukeste, krundil läbi paista laskvate pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: On a brownish-beige background, the blackish silhouette of the above-water part of a submarine, surrounded on the right and below by a light surface. The shape of the vessel is echoed by a greyish-brown form in the upper part of the painting. Painted with even, lengthwise, thin brushstrokes that let the ground show through.

works.t: Kas sa panid tähele nende inimeste riietust seal Arhitektuurimuuseumis - nad kuuluksid nagu ühte ususekti
works.d: Abstraktne; vaarikapunased, ülalt tumedamad, valguvad, sulanduvad, pritsitud värvipinnad osaliselt katmata vineeril, looklevad pliiatsijooned läbi värvi kumamas.
works.de: Abstract; raspberry-red, darker at the top, running, merging, sprayed patches of colour partly leaving the plywood uncovered, meandering pencil lines showing through the paint.

works.t: Mine võta oma nimekaart ära, üks ajakirjanik istub selle taga
works.d: Abstraktne: mustjaspunane maalipind muutub sujuvalt vasakus ülanurgas heledamaks, läbipaistvamaks. Vasakul serval pastoossed värvinired.
works.de: Abstract: a blackish-red painted surface smoothly becomes lighter, more transparent in the upper left corner. Pastose streaks of colour along the left edge.

works.d: Peaaegu ühtlane punakaspruun maalipind, keskel veidi heledam kaarjas osa, kohati aluspinda läbi kumav.
works.de: An almost even reddish-brown paint surface, in the middle a slightly lighter arched area, in places the ground shining through.

works.d: Katmata vineeril kaks ebamäärase kujuga musta värvipinda äärtelt akvarellilikult lahja aluspinda sulanduv, pritsmeid all paremas nurgas.
works.de: On uncoated plywood, two vaguely shaped black colour surfaces blending at the edges into a thin, watercolour-like base surface, splashes in the lower right corner.

works.d: Ees vasemal ja keskel viljapõld, tagapool hakid ja naisefiguur. Paremal rohumaa teerööbastega. Taamal nelinurksed põllulapid, siin-sääl põõsastikke. Viljapõllul värv pastoosne.
works.de: In front, on the left and in the middle, a grain field, behind it jackdaws and a female figure. On the right, meadow with wheel ruts. In the distance, rectangular field plots, here and there bushes. The paint on the grain field is impasto.

works.d: Sürrealistlik kompositsioon militaarsetest ja erootilisest kujunditest ulmelise türhermaa taustal.
works.de: A surrealist composition of military and erotic imagery against a background of a fantastical wasteland.

works.t: Paruness Margaretha Elisabeth von Stackelbergi portree
works.d: Puuderdatud soenguga naise poolportree kerges pöördes vasakule. Soengus lilled, ümber kaela pitspael, valge atlasskleidi kaeluses roosikimp. Õlgadel karusnahaga ääristatud jakk.
works.de: Half-portrait of a woman with powdered hairstyle, in slight turn to the left. Flowers in the hairstyle, lace ribbon around the neck, a bouquet of roses at the neckline of the white satin dress. Fur-trimmed jacket on the shoulders.

works.d: Puuderdatud parukaga mehe poolportree kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas roheline punaste revääridega kuub, mille all kuldbrokaadist vest, ees pitsist šaboo. Kaenla all sulgedega kaunistatud kolmnurkkübar.
works.de: Half-portrait of a man with a powdered wig, in a slight turn to the left. Wearing a green coat with red lapels, under which a gold brocade waistcoat, with a lace jabot in front. A tricorne hat decorated with feathers under his arm.

works.d: Paljastatud ülakehaga napis seelikus tantsijanna vaataja suunas, vasak käsi linikuga tõstetud. Hoogsalt markeeritud figuuri ilmestab musta aktsendiga roosa, kollane, heleroheline koloriit.
works.de: Dancer with bare torso in a scanty skirt, facing the viewer, left hand raised with a cloth. The vigorously marked figure is enlivened by a colour scheme of pink, yellow and light green with a black accent.

works.dm: kõrgus: 26.0 cm (lm.); laius: 23.3 cm (vm); kõrgus: 24.0 cm (vm.); laius: 26.0 cm (lm.)
works.d: Üle terve pinna hoogsate tõmmetega modelleeritud mongoliidne naisepea veerandpöördes paremale.
works.de: A Mongoloid woman's head modelled over the whole surface with vigorous strokes, in a three-quarter turn to the right.

works.dm: kõrgus: 75.0 cm; laius: 60.0 cm; kõrgus: 89.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 74.0 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Kahe kurb-tõsise ilmega poisiohtu noormehe 3/4 figuurid teineteise taga seismas: ees vasakul noorem tumedas mantlis, müts käes, taga peakattes vanem poiss otsevaates. Monokroomne gamma, ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: The 3/4 figures of two sad, serious-looking adolescent boys standing one behind the other: in front on the left, a younger boy in a dark coat, cap in hand; behind, an older boy in headwear, facing forward. Monochrome palette, expressive painting style.

works.d: Tugevate näojoonte, ovaalse kujuga kahvatu naisenägu õlgadeni. Tumedad pikad juuksed, silmad suletud, suu veidi paokil. Tume punakas, roheline foon. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
works.de: Pale woman's face with strong facial features, oval in shape, down to the shoulders. Dark long hair, eyes closed, mouth slightly open. Dark reddish, green background. Expressive manner of depiction.

works.d: Põldude ja puudega maastiku taustal ees paremal maas istuv tumedas riides noor mees, kirst kõrval, parem käsi ümber sarga. Kurb-tõsine pilk kaugusesse suunatud. Rohekad, pruunikashallid toonid, ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
works.de: Against a background of fields and trees with trees, in the foreground on the right a young man dressed in dark clothes sitting on the ground, a coffin beside him, right hand around the coffin. Sad-serious gaze directed into the distance. Greenish, brownish-grey tones, expressive manner of depiction.

works.d: Mustjast taustast joonistub välja tugevate joontega heledam naisenägu: tugev lõug, nina, suu kriipsuna kokku pigistatud, silmad veidi kõõrdi vasakule suunatud. Tumedad juuksed pead ümbritsemas. Ekspressiivne maalilaad
works.de: Against a blackish background a lighter woman's face is drawn with strong lines: strong chin, nose, mouth pressed together as a line, eyes slightly slanted to the left. Dark hair surrounding the head. Expressive painterly style

works.dm: kõrgus: 61.5 cm; laius: 47.7 cm; kõrgus: 72.6 cm (raamiga); laius: 59.0 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Esiplaanil kahvatu alasti naise poolfiguur lebamas, pea veidi küljel, silmad suletud, pikad rohekad juuksed küljel. Taustal öine tumesinine maastik. Taevas täiskuu peegeldumas veekogus. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: In the foreground, the pale half-figure of a nude woman lying down, head slightly turned to the side, eyes closed, long greenish hair to the side. In the background, a dark blue nocturnal landscape. In the sky, a full moon reflected in a body of water. Expressive painting style.

works.dm: kõrgus: 45.0 cm; laius: 60.5 cm; kõrgus: 56.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 72.0 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Ees vasakul hallis kleidis kahvatu näoga noore naise poolfiguur vaataja suunas, kätega kõrvu sulgemas. Lumelaikudega maastik taustal, kus kolm musta hobust regedega kihutamas, taevas rünkpilvedest mustriga kaetud. Sinkjad, hallikad, enamasti heledad toonid üksikute tumedate aktsentidega. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: In front, on the left, a half-figure of a pale-faced young woman in a grey dress facing the viewer, her hands covering her ears. A snow-patched landscape in the background, where three black horses are racing with sledges, the sky covered with a pattern of cumulus clouds. Bluish, greyish, mostly light tones with individual dark accents. Expressive painting style.

works.dm: kõrgus: 39.5 cm; laius: 30.0 cm; kõrgus: 58.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 48.5 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Pruun-beežikal rakumustrilisel taustal triibulises vangiriietuses kõhna mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käsi tõstetud rinnale. Mehel kahvatu jume, pöetud pea, kriipsuna pigistatud suu, pilk suunatud alla. Sinkjashallid, pruunikad toonid. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: Half-figure, frontal view, of a thin man in striped prison clothing against a brown-beige checkered background, hand raised to his chest. The man has a pale complexion, a shaved head, a mouth pressed into a line, gaze directed downward. Bluish-gray, brownish tones. Expressive painting style.

works.dm: kõrgus: 54.5 cm; laius: 46.0 cm; kõrgus: 65.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 57.5 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Noore naise 7/8 figuur istuvas asendis, magades veidi viltu vajunud, parem käsi süles, vasak ripub küljel. Heledat ovaalset nägu raamivad tahakammitud pikad pruunid juuksed. Silmad suletud, suu täpina koos. Naise rohelisel jaki all punakaspruun avara dekolteega kleit. Sinkjasroheline krähmuline hele taust. Laia pintsliga maalitud, ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a young woman in a seated position, sleeping, slumped slightly to the side, right hand in her lap, left hanging by her side. Her light oval face is framed by long brown hair combed back. Eyes closed, mouth closed like a dot. Under the woman's green jacket a reddish-brown dress with a wide décolleté. Bluish-green mottled light background. Painted with a wide brush, expressive painting style.

works.d: Maali keskel seisev noor mees otsevaates, parem käsi üle rinna. Kandilised näojooned, tõsine ilme, pruunikad juuksed üle pea kammitud, tugevad soonilised käed. Seljas üleskääritud käistega särk, sinkjad püksid, sandaalid jalas. Taust tellisseina imiteerivate kraapsudega hele pind. Nurgeline kujutamisviis.
works.de: In the middle of the painting a young man standing in a frontal view, right hand across his chest. Angular facial features, serious expression, brownish hair combed back over his head, strong sinewy hands. Wearing a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, bluish trousers, sandals on his feet. Background a light surface with scratches imitating a brick wall. Angular manner of depiction.

works.d: Harkisjalu seisev üle keskea mees, parem käsi puusal, veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel kortsuline piklik nägu, otse suunatud tõsine pilk, ülepea kammitud tumedad juuksed. Sinise jaki alt paistab punakas särk, tumedad püksid, jalanõud. Tausta ülemine pool intensiivne koobaltsinine, all vasakul aimatav tellisehunnik. Nurgeline kujutamisviis.
works.de: A man over middle age standing with legs apart, right hand on hip, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man has a wrinkled elongated face, a serious gaze directed straight ahead, dark hair combed straight back. Under the blue jacket a reddish shirt is visible, dark trousers, footwear. The upper part of the background is intense cobalt blue, at the bottom left a pile of bricks can be discerned. An angular manner of depiction.

works.d: Maali keskel keskealine töömees rohekas ruudulises särgis, käised kääritud, käed rippu kõrval, sirgelt seismas. Mehel veidi imestunud ilme, pilk üles suunatud, peas barett. Taust ülalt intensiivne sinine, alt poolt roostepruun ehitusdetaile markeeriv. Kontuure rõhutav nurgeline kujutamisviis.
works.de: In the centre of the painting a middle-aged workman in a greenish checked shirt, sleeves rolled up, arms hanging at his sides, standing upright. The man has a slightly astonished expression, gaze directed upward, a beret on his head. The background is intense blue from above, rust-brown below, marking construction details. An angular manner of depiction emphasising the contours.

works.d: Noorepoolne pikliku näo, pisut peast eemal olevate kõrvadega tumedapäine mees seismas, rusikas käed rippu. Mehel otse suunatud pilk, pisut altkulmu pilk. Tumeda jaki hõlmade vahelt paistab punakas särk. Taust ülalt intensiivne koobaltsinine, alt virna kujutav. Kontuure rõhutav kujutamisviis.
works.de: A youngish dark-haired man with an elongated face and ears standing slightly away from his head, standing with fists hanging at his sides. The man's gaze is directed straight ahead, slightly from under his brows. Between the lapels of his dark jacket a reddish shirt is visible. The background is intense cobalt blue above, below depicting a stack. A manner of depiction emphasising contours.

works.d: Kahvatuhallis, -beežis toonis udune kõrbemaastik raagus puudega. Ees paremal, veekogu ääres kaks kaelkirjakut, taga vasakul sarvedega loom udust välja joonistumas. Õrn, unenäoline kujutamisviis.
works.de: A pale grey-beige hazy desert landscape with bare trees. In front on the right, by a body of water, two giraffes, behind on the left a horned animal emerging from the haze. A delicate, dreamlike manner of depiction.

works.d: Avar vaade lõunamaisele kõrbemaastikule silmapiiril kõrguvate ookertoonis mägedega roosaka taeva all. Ees rohekas jõgi, liivasel kaldal üle vee paremal kolm lõvi, vasakpoolne istub. Summutatud toonid, õrn udune kujutamisviis.
works.de: A wide view of a southern desert landscape with ochre-toned mountains rising on the horizon under a pinkish sky. In front a greenish river, on the sandy bank on the right, above the water, three lions, the one on the left sitting. Muted tones, a soft hazy manner of depiction.

works.d: Õrnades beežikates, ooker- ja halltoonides kujutatud lõunamaine kõrbemaastik, vasakul heledate ogadega puu-põõsas. Paremal helenduva taeva taustal heledas riietuses sammuv naine, kandam pea peal ja seljale seotud.
works.de: Rendered in delicate beige, ochre and grey tones, a southern desert landscape, on the left a bush-like tree with pale thorns. On the right, against a glowing sky, a woman walking in light-coloured clothing, a load on her head and tied to her back.

works.d: Ülaltvaade avarale, käärulise jõega, kalda ümbruses rohelisele maastikule. Uduses ookertoonis maastikul eespool paistmas kolm lõvi, teiselpool jõge kollakaspruun maa kaetud puude hallika mustriga kahvaturoosa taeva all.
works.de: A top view of a wide, meandering river, with a green landscape around the banks. In the hazy ochre-toned landscape three lions visible in the foreground, on the other side of the river yellowish-brown land covered with a greyish pattern of trees under a pale pink sky.

works.d: Oranžides, kollakasroosades toonides õhtumaastik vaatega kummis mäenõlvale, mille külge piirab varjus olevate puukroonide tume triip. Eespool, orust tõusmas külmroheline udu. Kauguses vasakul roosakad mäed kollaka taeva taustal.
works.de: Evening landscape in orange, yellowish-pink tones with a view of a rubber-coloured mountain slope, bordered by a dark strip of tree crowns in shadow. In front, cold green mist rising from the valley. In the distance on the left, pinkish mountains against a yellowish sky.

works.t: Peter August Friedrich von Koskulli portree
works.d: Puuderdatud parukaga poisslapse portree poolpöördes vasakule, käsi puusas. Seljas nöörkaunistusega sinine vest ja kuub, ees pitsžaboo, vasak käsi toetub lauale, millel paberirull joonistusega.
works.de: Portrait of a boy with a powdered wig, in half-turn to the left, hand on hip. Wearing a blue waistcoat and coat with cord trimming, a lace jabot in front, left hand resting on a table on which lies a roll of paper with a drawing.

works.d: Linnavaade kollendavate puude ja trammiteega. Paremal suure maja nurk. Sõiduteel sagivad inimesed vihmavarjudega, paar hobuveokit, ooteplatvormidel trammi ootav rahvahulk.
works.de: A city view with yellowing trees and a tram line. At right the corner of a large building. On the roadway people bustle about with umbrellas, a couple of horse-drawn carts, a crowd waiting for the tram on the waiting platforms.

works.d: Maali keskel sihvaka tüvega kasepuu, õrnad oksad kiirehõrvus lehtedega katavad terve pinna, okste vahelt paistab uduvines taevalaotus. Pehme, udune maalilaad, hallikasroheline üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the middle of the painting a slender-trunked birch tree, delicate branches with fast-hatched foliage cover the whole surface, through the branches a hazy expanse of sky is visible. Soft, hazy painting style, greyish-green overall colour scheme.

works.d: Keskel haraliste käharate okstega lehtpuu võra katab tervet maali, sinkjas udune taevas puu tagant paistmas. Valdavalt sinkjas-rohelised, pruunikad toonid, ülal heledamad, all tumedamad. Pehme udune maalimisviis, toonid üksteise sisse sulanduvad.
works.de: In the middle the crown of a deciduous tree with sprawling curly branches covers the whole painting, a bluish hazy sky showing through behind the tree. Predominantly bluish-green, brownish tones, lighter above, darker below. A soft, hazy painting manner, tones merging into one another.

works.d: Maali keskel suure kuuse tüvi, tugevad tumedad oksad lainjalt rohekashalli taeva taustal, katavad tervet pinda. Tumedad rohelised toonid, ülalt heledam ookerhallikas joon. Pehme, udune maalilaad, värvid üksteise sisse sulanduvad.
works.de: In the middle of the painting the trunk of a large spruce, strong dark branches wavily against a greenish-grey sky background, covering the entire surface. Dark green tones, from above a lighter ochre-grey line. Soft, hazy painting style, colours merging into one another.

works.d: Maali keskel veidi kaardus hallika tüvega haavapuu, peente okste ja helerohekate lehtedega puukroon heleda taeva taustal täidab ülemist pinda. Keskel tüve taga kollakas, allpool hallikas maastiku taust. Pehme udune maalilaad, rohekad-hallikad toonid üksteise sisse sulanduvad.
works.de: In the middle of the painting, a slightly curved aspen with a greyish trunk, its crown of fine branches and light greenish leaves filling the upper surface against a light sky background. In the middle, behind the trunk, a yellowish landscape background, greyish further below. A soft, hazy painting style, greenish-greyish tones merging into one another.

works.d: Vaade tüüpilisele Lõuna-Eesti kuppelmaastikule. Vasakul looklemas kitsas jõgi. Taamal seguneb metsa ja aasa rohelisega viljapõldude kollaseid laike. Helesinises taevas roosakad pilvesagarad. Maalimislaad etüüdilik.
works.de: View of a typical South Estonian hilly landscape. On the left a narrow river winding. In the distance the green of forest and meadow mixes with yellow patches of grain fields. In the light blue sky pinkish cloud wisps. Painting manner sketch-like.

works.d: Lillakassiniste lopsakate pilvede all kirevate, roheliste, roosakate, täpiliste nõlvakute vahel sinine järv. Vasakul kaldal püramiidselt tervatipulised põõsad-puud, silmapiiril rohekassinine metsa siluett. Maalitud diagonaalsete, vertikaalsete ühtlaste pikemate pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: Under lush purplish-blue clouds, between colourful, green, pinkish, spotted slopes, a blue lake. On the left bank pyramidally rounded-topped bushes and trees, on the horizon the greenish-blue silhouette of a forest. Painted with diagonal, vertical, even, longer brushstrokes.

works.d: Vasakul valgete ning roosakate õitega potilill. Foon heleroheline.
works.de: On the left a potted flower with white and pinkish blossoms. The background is light green.

works.d: Esiplaanil kääruline veekogu, tagapool punakais, ookertoonides künklik maastik üksikute põõsa- ja puudegruppidega. Taevas kaetud roosakassinise pilvekahuga. Maalitud värvikalt täppivas laadis, taeva osas pastoosselt.
Kireval mustal-punasel taustal kirjus vaasis sirelioksad, kolm lillakat ja kaks valget  õlekobarat heleroheliste lehtede vahel. Maalitud jõulsiselt, pastoosselt.
works.de: Against a colourful black-and-red background, in a mottled vase, lilac branches, three purplish and two white clusters of blooms among light green leaves. Painted powerfully, pastosely.

works.d: Rohekas-ookrites toonides künklikus maastikus looklemas kitsas jõelint. Taevas tumesinine, valgete pilveräpsudega. Maastiku vormide dünaamilisust rõhutatud kontuuridega. Koloriit tume. Taeva osa maalitud viltuste (paremalt vasakule) pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In a hilly landscape in greenish-ochre tones, a narrow ribbon of river winds. The sky is dark blue, with white wisps of cloud. The dynamism of the landscape forms is emphasised with contours. The colouring is dark. The area of sky is painted with slanting brush strokes (from right to left).

works.d: Paremal osa aheneva suuga rohelisest vaasist, milles harvade lillakasroosade õiekobaratega sirelioksad. Maalitud lühikese nõtke pintslilöögiga. Tumesinine katkev kontuurjoon ümbritseb lehti, hapraid oksi. Taust ookerkollastes, samblarohekais toonides.

works.dm: lehe laius: 35.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 44.3 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil täppivas laadis maalitud lillakas-rohekas toonis lage maapind. Tagapool habraste heledate tüvedega sookased, tüvede vahelt paistavad kaugemad metsad. Maal pastoosne pruunikaslillas, rohekas üldtoonis.
works.de: In the foreground, bare ground painted in a pointillist manner in purplish-green tones. Behind, bog birches with fragile pale trunks, between the trunks more distant forests can be seen. The painting is pastose, in an overall brownish-purple, greenish tone.

works.d: Noore mehe rinnaportree veerandpöördes paremale. Kollakaspruunid juuksed, tumesinised silmad ja kulmud, sirge nina, teravapiirjooneline tumepunane suu. Näo-osa maalimisel kasutatud rohelist ja helelillat, kõrv lilla. Riided üldiselt markeeritud, täpselt antud valge krae ja rohelistes-oranžides toonides täpuline lips. Pea ümbruses foon lilla.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man in a quarter turn to the right. Yellowish-brown hair, dark blue eyes and eyebrows, straight nose, sharply outlined dark red mouth. Green and light purple used in painting the face area, the ear purple. Clothing generally indicated, white collar precisely rendered and a dotted tie in green-orange tones. Background around the head purple.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannasopp üksiku kivi ja suure tumeda lodjaga esiplaanil. Taamal paremal kaks palkmaja ja aed, nende taga tumeroheline metsatukk. Metsast vasakul kuldkollane liivane kaldajärsak ja selle kõrval taas mets. Ülal hall taevas. Maalitud hõredalt täppides, aluspappi paista lastes. Mets antud tugevasti siluetti rõhutades.
works.de: In the foreground a cove with a single rock and a large dark barge in the foreground. Further back on the right two log houses and a garden, behind them a dark green patch of forest. To the left of the forest a golden-yellow sandy bank slope, and beside it forest again. Above, a grey sky. Painted sparsely in dots, letting the underlying cardboard show through. The forest is given with a strongly emphasized silhouette.

works.d: Esiplaanil neli lillakaspruunide tüvedega ja rõhutatud siluetiga antud rohelise võraga männid. Tagaplaanil vertikaalsete joontega vahendatud metsa siluett. Ülal suured valged pilvekuhilad, mille vahelt paistab jupike erksiniset taevast. Esiplaanil täppimistehnikas rohi ja lilled. Valitsevad rohelised ja valged toonid.
works.de: In the foreground four pine trees with purplish-brown trunks and an emphasised silhouette, given with green crowns. In the background the silhouette of a forest rendered with vertical lines. Above, large white cloud masses, between which a small patch of bright blue sky can be seen. In the foreground grass and flowers in a stippling technique. Green and white tones predominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelistes toonides põõsastik, väike lagendik vasakul, tagaplaanil silmapiiril sinakas metsamassiiv. Ülaservas hallikassinise taeva riba. Maalitud pisikeste, tihedalt kõrvuti asetsevate pastoossete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground shrubbery in green tones, a small clearing on the left, in the background on the horizon a bluish forest massif. A strip of greyish-blue sky along the upper edge. Painted with tiny, densely placed pastose brushstrokes.

works.d: Impressionistlikus laadis maastikuvaade. Ees vasakul kõrge puuvõra rohelistes toonides punaste õitega. Esiplaanil all fjord. Maali keskosas roheline, puude-põõsastega osaliselt kaetud maasäär, mis ei ulatu maali parema servani. Tagaplaanil sinakas-rohelised mäed, millede alaosas tumeroheline mets. Maali ülaosas taevas, mis allpool rohelistes toonides ning valkjate pilvedega, kõrgemal helesinine roosakais-sinakate pilvedega.

works.t: a) Mehe portree b) Naise portree
works.d: Mehe portree: Noorepoolse tumedapäise mehe rindportree kerges pöördes paremale, käed vaheliti rinnal. Mehel piklik nägu,hallikad silmad, ilme tõsine. Hele kollakasroosa mosaiigitaoline taust.
works.de: Portrait of a man: Bust portrait of a youngish dark-haired man in a slight turn to the right, hands crossed on the chest. The man has an elongated face, greyish eyes, a serious expression. Light yellowish-pink mosaic-like background.

works.d: Tumedas riides, tumedas peakattes noore naise pisut hirmul kahvatu nägu otsevaates. Tumedad silmad, paokil punane suu. Taustal aimatav öine linnamaastik tuledega. Tume gamma, lühike närviline pintslikiri.
works.de: The slightly frightened pale face, in frontal view, of a young woman in dark clothing and dark headwear. Dark eyes, red mouth slightly open. In the background a barely discernible night cityscape with lights. Dark colour range, short nervous brushwork.

works.d: Ümaranäolise nöpsninaga tüdruku portree veerandpöördes paremale. Pisut pruntis suu, tumedad silmad sirgete kulmude all, juuksed ülepea kammitud soengus. Roosakas heleda kraega kleit seljas. Nägu maalitud türkiissiniste markeerivate joontega, tekitades rambivalguse illusiooni.
works.de: Portrait of a round-faced, snub-nosed girl, in a three-quarter turn to the right. A slightly pouting mouth, dark eyes under straight eyebrows, hair combed back in a style over the head. She wears a pinkish dress with a light-coloured collar. The face is painted with turquoise-blue marking lines, creating the illusion of footlight illumination.

works.d: Tumedapäine lühikese soenguga tumedasilmne tüdruk istumas heledas ruumis poolpöördes vasakule, käed süles. Tüdrukul unistav pilk. Seljas sirge kaelusega, kolmveerand varrukatega erkroosa pluus. Õhuline, impressionistlik pintslikiri.
works.de: A dark-haired girl with dark eyes and a short hairstyle, sitting in a light room in a half-turn to the left, hands in her lap. The girl has a dreamy gaze. Wearing a bright pink blouse with a straight collar and three-quarter sleeves. Airy, impressionistic brushwork.

works.d: Heleda sinkja joonega markeeritud naisenäo taustal esiplaanil mustad risti-rästijooned (puutüved). Vasakul allnurgas kollaste õitega oks ja lennul pääsulind.
works.de: Against a background of a woman's face marked with a light bluish line, black criss-crossing lines (tree trunks) in the foreground. At the lower left corner a branch with yellow blossoms and a swallow in flight.

works.d: Hallipäise vanema naise poolfiguur käsipõsakil toetumas aiale, murelik pilk vaatajale suunatud. Taustal ja vasakul lopsakas roheluses aiad
works.de: Half-figure of an elderly grey-haired woman, chin resting on her hand, leaning against a fence, with a worried gaze directed at the viewer. In the background and on the left lush green gardens.

works.d: Ülalt vaade koobaltsinisega kujutatud surnuaiale saledate mustade puutüvede ja beezikate teeradade mustriga. Ees paremal lillepärgadega kaetud kalmuküngas, tagapool kollakad  küünalde valgustäpid.
works.de: A view from above of a cemetery depicted in cobalt blue with a pattern of slender black tree trunks and beige-toned paths. In front on the right a burial mound covered with flower wreaths, behind it yellowish points of candlelight.

works.d: Tehase interjööris kaks seisvat meest: vasakpoolne tumedas rõivas
works.de: In the factory interior two standing men: the one on the left in dark clothing

works.d: Lühikeste punakate juustega kahvatunäolise noormehe otsevaates portree paljaste õlgadeni,peas tume okaskroon. Ühtlane õrnroheline taust helesinise taevatriibuga.
works.de: A frontal portrait of a pale-faced young man with short reddish hair, down to the bare shoulders, a dark crown of thorns on his head. A uniform pale green background with a light blue sky stripe.

works.d: Sügavroheline kompositsioon aimatavatest põõsapuhmastest sügavuses, mis maali
works.de: Deep green composition of vaguely discernible clumps of bushes in the depth, which the painting

works.d: Üksteise sisse sulanduvate kahvatute värvidega kujutatud abstraheeritud
works.de: Abstracted forms depicted in pale colours blending into one another

works.d: Maaliline abstraktsioon: ühtlase sügavsinise maalipinna vasakul ja sinkjasroheka paremal jagab poolviltu kaheks heledatest joonte-pindade rägastikust koosnev kõrge faktuuriga tuulispesa-sarnane kujund.
works.de: A painterly abstraction: a deep blue painted surface on the left and a bluish-green one on the right are divided diagonally by a high-textured, whirlwind-like shape composed of a tangle of light lines and planes.

works.d: Kahest osast koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon, mille moodustavad  hieroglüüfimustrilised rohelise, sinkjaslilla, tumepunase pintslikirja vahelduvad horisontaalread samblarohelisel taustal. Maalitud laia pintsilga, voolavad värvinired moodustamas vertikaaltriipe.
works.de: An abstract composition consisting of two parts, formed by alternating horizontal rows of hieroglyph-patterned brushwork in green, bluish-purple and dark red on a moss-green background. Painted with a broad brush, flowing streams of paint forming vertical stripes.

works.d: Valdavalt hallikaslillas gammas mitmekihiline,erineva faktuuriga abstraktne maal, parem
works.de: A multi-layered abstract painting predominantly in a greyish-lilac gamut, with varying texture, right

works.d: Valdavalt hallikasrohelises gammas krobelise faktuuriga abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: An abstract composition with a rough texture, predominantly in a greyish-green range.

works.dm: kõrgus: 210.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm; laius: 90.0 cm; laius: 90.0 cm
works.d: Kolmeosaline, valdavalt intensiivsetes punastes, roosades toonides krobelise faktuuriga kompositsioon. Vasakul osal roosaga piiritletud suur naisenägu, suu, ninajoon, silm mustaga markeeritud. Paremal-keskel maali allosas udupunasel mustaga katkendlikult markeeritud lamava mehe poolfiguur. Väga reljeefne maalipind, mustad kontuurjooned ebaühlaselt sügavates maalikihtides.
works.de: A three-part composition, predominantly in intense red and pink tones, with a coarse texture. On the left part a large woman's face outlined in pink, mouth, nose line, eye marked in black. On the right-centre, in the lower part of the painting, the half-figure of a lying man marked intermittently in black on a hazy red ground. A very relief-like painted surface, black contour lines in unevenly deep paint layers.

works.d: a) Autoportree. Noore naise rindportree poolpöördes vasakule, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Naisel pruunid silmad,pehmed näojooned; keskelt lahkukammitud pikki lopsakaid juukseid hoiab soengus ümber pea seotud lilla rätik. Heleroheka jaki hõlmade vahelt paistab roosa pluus. Taustal paremal seinal rippuva pildi nurk.
works.de: a) Self-portrait. A bust portrait of a young woman in a half-turn to the left, her gaze directed at the viewer. The woman has brown eyes, soft facial features; her long, luxuriant hair, parted in the middle, is held in place by a purple kerchief tied around her head. Between the lapels of her light green jacket a pink blouse is visible. In the background, on the right, the corner of a picture hanging on the wall.

works.d: Noore naise kolmveerandfiguur külgvaates paremale, tumedad juuksed kuklasoengus, pea pööratud üle õla, pilk suunatud alla, käed seljal. Naisel pehmed näojooned, tõsine ilme, seljas püstkraega, pikkade varrukatega õhuline valge kleit. Taustaks kahvatukollane, oliivikarva maastik roosaka taevaga. Nägu ja pea hoolikalt modelleeritud, tumeda kontuuriga ümbritsedes. Kehaosa hoogsalt kriitidega markeeritud, jättes aluspinna nähtavale.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman in side view facing right, dark hair in a bun, head turned over the shoulder, gaze directed downward, hands behind the back. The woman has soft facial features, a serious expression, wearing an airy white dress with a stand-up collar and long sleeves. The background is pale yellow, an olive-coloured landscape with a pinkish sky. The face and head are carefully modelled, surrounded by a dark contour. The body area is marked energetically with chalks, leaving the underlying surface visible.

works.d: Tumedanahalise poisi portree veerandpöördes vasakule, pea suunatud vaatajale, pilk üles, lõug toetub vasakule käele. Peas roosakaspunane müts, üle õlgade hele rüü. Roheline mustjas taust. Tumedaid kontuure rõhutav laad, foon osaliselt katmata.
works.de: Portrait of a dark-skinned boy in a quarter-turn to the left, head turned toward the viewer, gaze upward, chin resting on the left hand. On the head a pinkish-red cap, over the shoulders a light robe. Green-blackish background. A manner emphasizing dark contours, the background partly uncovered.

works.d: Vana naise otsevaates rinnaportree tumedate kontuuridega. Naise peas rohekas-roosakas lilleline valge pitsiga pottmüts, õlgadel punakas-pruunikas rätik, seljas sinine 3 nööbiga pluus-kleit. Taust tume.
works.de: A frontal bust portrait of an old woman with dark contours. On the woman's head a greenish-pink floral white lace bonnet, on her shoulders a reddish-brown shawl, wearing a blue 3-button blouse-dress. Dark background.

works.d: Tumedal foonil, poolprofiilis vasakule, tüdruku rinnaportree, peas kollakas, veidi kirju, lõua alt seotud rätik, suu veidi avatud, seljas valge pluus ja punane vest. Pilk vasakule.
works.de: On a dark background, in half-profile to the left, the bust portrait of a girl, on her head a yellowish, slightly patterned kerchief tied under the chin, mouth slightly open, wearing a white blouse and a red vest. Gaze to the left.

works.d: Foto järgi maalitud noore mehe rinnaportree: mehe pea ja vaade pööratud paremale, sirge nina, selge otsekohese vaatega silmad, juustepiir kahelt poolt oimukohtadelt taandunud. Seljas valge, ärapööratud kraenurkadega särk, tume lai lips ja ülikond vestiga. Figuur on maalitud ovaalsesse hõõguvpunasesse fooni otsekui peeglisse. Ovaali ümbritsevad nurkadest mustjasrohelised foonipinnad.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man painted after a photograph: the man's head and gaze turned to the right, straight nose, clear direct-looking eyes, hairline receded on both sides at the temples. Wearing a white shirt with turned-down collar corners, a dark wide tie and a suit with a waistcoat. The figure is painted into an oval glowing red background as if into a mirror. The oval is surrounded at the corners by blackish-green background areas.

works.d: Pannoo kavandina mõjuv maal. Sügiseselt kirev metsaviirg helesinise, üksikute valgete rünkpilvedega taeva all. Taevas maalitud põikitõmmetega, puud tumedal foonil lühikeste kollaste, roheliste, punaste püstjoonekestega.
works.de: A painting resembling a design for a panel. An autumnally colourful strip of forest under a light blue sky with a few white cumulus clouds. The sky painted with horizontal strokes, the trees on a dark background with short yellow, green, red upright line strokes.

works.d: Sügisene vaade põldude vahel asetsevatele taluhoonetele puudega. Esiplaanil vasakul jupike kiviaeda ja roigasaeda. Selle taga ookerkollane põld. Talu kohal tumedad pruunikad pilved, silmapiiril taevas õrnheledas gammas. Üksteise sisse hajuvad vormid kergelt kontuurjoontega markeeritud.
works.de: Autumn view of farm buildings among fields with trees. In the foreground on the left a piece of a stone wall and a pole fence. Behind it an ochre-yellow field. Above the farm dark brownish clouds, on the horizon the sky in a delicately light gamut. Forms merging into one another, lightly marked with contour lines.

works.d: Suviseslt ereda roosakaskollaka taeva all kivine rannaäärne maastik. Esiplaanil mererohune kaldaosa, vasakul keskel mürakas rändrahn poolenisti teava taustal. Kaugemal teine suurem kivi peegeldusega vees. Kirkad toonid, erksinised refleksid kividel. Meri ja maa jagatud silmapiiril peene metsatriibuga.
works.de: Under a summery, bright pinkish-yellow sky, a rocky coastal landscape. In the foreground a sea-grassy shore area, on the left in the middle a massive erratic boulder half against the sky. Farther away another larger stone with a reflection in the water. Bright tones, bright blue reflections on the stones. The sea and land are divided at the horizon by a thin strip of forest.

works.d: Pildi sügavusse suubuv erkroheline niit kollaste lilledega esiplaanil. Ees kaks tumedatüvelist, habraste rippuvate okste ja kollaste lehtedega suurt puud. Tagapool on aimata valgesse ja
works.de: A bright green meadow with yellow flowers receding into the depth of the picture, in the foreground. In front two large trees with dark trunks, fragile hanging branches and yellow leaves. Behind, one can discern white and

works.d: Esiplaanil pildi allservas lilleniit, mis keskplaanis läheb üle kollaseks väljaks ja tagapool esialgu madalamateks lillakateks küngasteks ning silmapiiril kõrgeteks sinetavateks mäeharjadeks. Ülal helesinine, valgete ja kollaste pilvedega ühtlaselt kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the foreground at the bottom edge of the picture a flower meadow, which in the middle ground turns into a yellow field and further back initially into lower purplish hills and on the horizon into high bluish mountain ridges. Above a light blue sky, evenly covered with white and yellow clouds.

works.d: Kollakaspruuni paberi foonil säravate rohekas-siniste silmadega, sirge nina ja punaste poikvel huultega tütarlapse portree. Helepruunide juuste kiharad raamivad mõlemalt poolt nägu.
works.de: Against a background of yellowish-brown paper, a portrait of a girl with bright greenish-blue eyes, a straight nose and red slightly parted lips. Curls of light brown hair frame the face on both sides.

works.d: Sinises kleidis ja rohelises pitsidega servatud tanus noore naise profiilportree tumesinisel foonil. Naise kaelas rohelise-roosakirju rätik ja rahad keti otsas.
works.de: A profile portrait of a young woman in a blue dress and a green lace-edged cap, against a dark blue background. Around the woman's neck, a green-and-pink patterned scarf and coins on a chain.

works.d: Panoraamne maastik, mille esiplaanil tee (paralleelne pildi alaservaga), roheline teeperv üksiku sööva must-valgekirju lehma ja põõsastega. Keskplaanis kiviaed, helekollane viljapõld valge, pruunikatuselise majaga keskel. Silmapiiril roheline metsaviirg. Taevas roheline, valgete ja siniste viirgudega.
works.de: A panoramic landscape, in the foreground a road (parallel to the lower edge of the picture), a green roadside with a single grazing black-and-white spotted cow and bushes. In the middle ground a stone wall, a light yellow grain field with a white, brown-roofed house in the centre. On the horizon a green strip of forest. The sky is green, with white and blue streaks.

works.d: Keskel helehall pildi sügavusse suunduv tee, millest vasakul triibuline post ja põldu teeveerest eraldav kiviaed. Teest paremal, aia taga taluhooned ja puud ning kooguga kaev. Silmapiiril vasakul tumehalli katusega talumajad ja siluetina antud puud. Ülal helesinine, valkjasroosade pilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the middle a light grey road leading into the depth of the picture, to the left of which a striped post and a stone wall separating the field from the roadside. To the right of the road, beyond the wall, farm buildings and trees, and a well with a sweep. On the horizon to the left, farmhouses with dark grey roofs and trees given as silhouettes. Above, a light blue sky covered with whitish-pink clouds.

works.d: Laugjas panoraammaastik heleroheliste niitudega keskplaanis ning sinava mere ja küngastega tagaplaanil. Taevas valkjassinine. Keskel niidul markeeritud tumedamaga üksikud puud ja põõsad.
works.de: A gently sloping panoramic landscape with pale green meadows in the middle ground and a bluish sea and hills in the background. The sky whitish-blue. In the centre, on the meadow, isolated trees and bushes marked in a darker tone.

works.d: Esiplaanils üle pildi pinna vasakult paremale kiviaeda meenutav piire põõsastega. Selle taga, keset muru üks suur ümara krooniga ja üks väike roosades õites mandlipuu. Nende taga kergelt mäkke tõusev maastik, väikeste puudega roheluse keskel.
works.de: In the foreground, running across the picture surface from left to right, a fence resembling a stone wall with bushes. Behind it, in the middle of the lawn, one large round-crowned and one small almond tree in pink blossom. Behind them a landscape rising gently uphill, with small trees amid greenery.

works.d: Esiplaanil terrakotapunase ja mustaga põõsad. Paremal kaheharuline puutüvi, mille kohal kõrgub üle pildi pinna paindunud puutüvi. Foon antud erekollase, rohelise ja valgega. Taevas sinine. Ülaservas markeeritud puude lehestik.
works.de: In the foreground shrubs in terracotta-red and black. On the right a two-branched tree trunk, above which a bent tree trunk towers over the surface of the picture. The background is given in bright yellow, green and white. The sky is blue. Foliage of trees marked along the upper edge.

works.d: Esiplaanil roosakaspunased kivid või põõsad. Nende kõrval paremal kaheharuline murdunud puu, mille taga üle terve pildi pinna paindunud roosa puutüvi. Foonil sügavsinine taevas rahutute valgete pilvedega. Ülaservas mustaga markeeritud puude lehestik.
works.de: In the foreground pinkish-red stones or bushes. Beside them on the right a forked broken tree, behind which a bent pink tree trunk stretches across the whole surface of the picture. In the background a deep blue sky with restless white clouds. At the upper edge foliage of trees marked in black.

works.d: Esiplaanil mäeveerul üksik jändrik mänd roosades-punastes toonides. Foonil kuni silmapiirini rohekas-sinine meri, mis läheb horisontaalselt keskjoonest pisut allpool üle samakarvaliseks taevaks. Vee ja taeva vahel kaks kollast ja üks sinine triip.
works.de: In the foreground on a hillside a lone stunted pine in pink-red tones. In the background, up to the horizon, a greenish-blue sea, which passes horizontally, slightly below the middle line, into a sky of the same hue. Between the water and the sky two yellow stripes and one blue stripe.

works.d: Maalimata foonil rohekas pearätis naeratav tütarlaps otsevaates, pea pisut kallutatud vasakule. Räti alt paistavad otsmikul lahku kammitud tumedad juuksed. Tüdrukul tumedad silmad, terav lõug. Ülakeha markeeritud hallika poolkustunud joonega.
works.de: Against an unpainted background, a smiling girl in a greenish headscarf, seen frontally, head tilted slightly to the left. Under the scarf, dark hair parted on the forehead is visible. The girl has dark eyes, a sharp chin. The upper body is marked with a grayish, half-faded line.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree, pea pöördes vasakule. Kitsaste huultega, suu ümber ja ninajuurel teravad kortsud. Nägu raamib puhmas, hall põskhabe. Pikad, keskelt lahkukammitud juuksed langevad õlgadele. Seljas Vigala rõivad. Foon tume.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man, head turned to the left. Narrow lips, sharp wrinkles around the mouth and at the bridge of the nose. The face is framed by a bushy grey side-beard. Long hair parted in the middle falls to the shoulders. Wearing Vigala folk costume. Dark background.

works.d: Esiplaanil olevast erkrohelisest vööndist kerkib tumedatüveline mitmeharuline mänd. Taustaks tumesinine  mäesein. Ülal paistab laik helesinist taevast.
works.de: From a bright green zone in the foreground rises a dark-trunked, multi-branched pine tree. Background a dark blue mountain wall. Above, a patch of light blue sky is visible.

works.d: Kõrgemalt vaatepunktist avar vaade maastikule: esiplaanile jäävad põõsad, tara kaharate puudega selle ääres, tagapool valge pastellidega markeeritud jõekäär, mille kaldal kasvavad metsasalud, ülaosas hallpilvine taevas. Võrreldes repliigiga M 2023 toonidelt summutatum ja meeleolult melanhoolsem.
works.de: From a higher viewpoint, a broad view of the landscape: in the foreground bushes, a fence with spreading trees along it, further back a river bend marked with white pastels, on whose banks small groves grow, at the top a grey-clouded sky. Compared to the replica M 2023, the tones are more subdued and the mood more melancholic.

works.d: Keskealise, vuntside ja lõuahabemega mehe rinnaportree en face, tumedas pintsakus, valges särgis, roosaka kaelasidemega. Rinnas vasakul pool (vaataja suhtes) kollaseõieline lill. Tume foon, õlgade kohal sinine.
works.de: A bust portrait of a middle-aged man with moustache and beard, en face, in a dark jacket, white shirt, pinkish necktie. On the left side of the chest (from the viewer's perspective), a flower with yellow blossoms. Dark background, blue above the shoulders.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud valgetüvelised raagus puud, silmapiiril tihe võsa. Maapind kollakaspruun, kohati kaetud lumega, lumelaikude piirjooni on tugevasti sinisega rõhutatud.
works.de: In the foreground solitary white-trunked bare trees, dense scrub on the horizon. The ground yellowish-brown, in places covered with snow, the outlines of the snow patches strongly emphasised with blue.

works.d: Üle pildi pinna gruppidena valged kasetüved, mis on pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Paremal nurgas teerada.
works.de: White birch trunks in groups across the surface of the picture, cut off by the upper edge of the picture. A path in the right corner.

works.d: Esiplaanil kividega kaetud maapind ning madal kivimüür, mille tagant paistab roheline puudesalu. Taamal kõrgub tumeda lumega kaetud mägi.
works.de: In the foreground, ground covered with stones and a low stone wall, behind which a green grove of trees can be seen. In the distance rises a mountain covered with dark snow.

works.d: Keskplaanil kaks madalat, peaaegu maapinnani ulatuvate katustega, vana taluhoonet. Koloriit tume, taevaosas tugevad küps kollased viirud.
works.de: In the middle ground, two low old farm buildings with roofs reaching almost to the ground. Dark colouring, with strong ripe yellow streaks in the sky area.

works.d: Esiplaanil massiivsed kaljurünkad, tagaplaanil erksinine meri. Silmapiiril mäe siluett.
works.de: In the foreground massive rocky crags, in the background a bright blue sea. The silhouette of a mountain on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil tee, mis viib kahe vana taluhoone juurde. Majade juures, teest vasakul kasvab suur haruline puu. Taevas helesinine, valgete pilvetortidega.
works.de: In the foreground a road leading to two old farm buildings. Near the houses, to the left of the road, grows a large branching tree. The sky is light blue, with white cloud towers.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rohekates ja valkjates toonides väli, taga mets. Taevas kollakas.
works.de: In the foreground a bare field in greenish and whitish tones, forest behind. The sky is yellowish.

works.d: Punaste, valgete ja roosade rooside kimp pruunikas vaasis tumedal foonil.
works.de: A bouquet of red, white and pink roses in a brownish vase against a dark background.

works.d: Üle rohelise muru talumajade vahelt looklev tee. Esiplaanil vasakul vöödiline piiritulp.
works.de: A path winding across green grass between farmhouses. In the foreground on the left a striped boundary post.

works.d: Sügisene maastik üksikute puudega esiplaanil. Nende taga kaks õlgkatusega taluhoonet.
works.de: Autumn landscape with solitary trees in the foreground. Behind them, two farm buildings with thatched roofs.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage väli rohelistes ja kollastes toonides. Kaugemal õlgkatusega taluhooneid ja puid.
Noore tüdruku portree pöördega paremal. Pikk juuksepats üle parema õla. Seljas hele pluus, kinnitatud rinnanõelaga ja rooosa pihik. Foon tume.
works.de: Portrait of a young girl turned to the right. Long braid over the right shoulder. Wearing a light blouse, fastened with a brooch, and a pink bodice. Dark background.

works.de: In the foreground, in half-shadow, the opening of an arched gate, through which white buildings and a patch of blue sky can be seen. Sky is also visible in the upper part of the picture, above the gate.

works.de: Half-figure of a young woman, frontal view. Dark long hair to the shoulders. Green blouse with a white collar.

works.de: Half-figure of a woman seen frontally. Needle tattoos. A pink shawl and cap, over which a heavy cloth also lies, which falls down and covers the shoulders. A blue dress, large earrings and chest ornaments.

works.d: Noore tütarlapse kujutus profiilis paremale. Heledad lokkis juuksed, valge pluus. Must foon.
works.de: Depiction of a young girl in profile to the right. Light curly hair, white blouse. Black background.

works.d: Vana mehe rindportree otsevaates. Valge juus ja habe. Must kuub, valge kaelus.

works.de: Bust portrait of an old man in a slight turn to the right. Bald head, beard and moustache. Black coat, white collar. A pencil in his right hand, a book in his left.

works.d: Tagakülg vineeriga kaetud.

works.de: Half-figure of a young man in standing position, frontal view. Dark moustache, dark hair reaching to the ears. Blue high-collared shirt. Dark sky with a red streak on the horizon.

works.d: Vana mehe rinnakujutis kerges pöördes paremale. Pikk hall habe ja vurrud. Punane särk.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old man in a slight turn to the right. Long grey beard and moustache. Red shirt.

works.d: Valgete pikkade juuste ja habemega vanamehe pea profiilis vasemale. Tume riietus.
works.de: The head of an old man with long white hair and beard, in profile facing left. Dark clothing.

works.d: Noor naine vasaku küljega, pea pöördes, vaataja suunas. Pruunikad juuksed, keskelt lahuga, kuklas sõlme keeratud. Naeratav nägu. Rohekas-hall rõivastus sinise püstkraega. Taust punane.
works.de: A young woman shown from the left side, her head turned toward the viewer. Brownish hair, parted in the middle, twisted into a knot at the nape. A smiling face. Greenish-grey clothing with a blue stand-up collar. Red background.

works.d: Noorema mehe rindportree kerge peapöördega vasakule. Kõrge valge kaelus, tume kuub, lõuani suletud vest.
works.de: Bust portrait of a younger man with a slight turn of the head to the left. High white collar, dark coat, waistcoat buttoned up to the chin.

works.d: Noore naise portree otsevaates, peas kollane rätik. Taustal paremal kolm, vasakul üks kasetüvi.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman in frontal view, wearing a yellow headscarf. In the background, three birch trunks on the right, one on the left.

works.d: Valge habeme ja vurrudega vanema mehe rindportree kerges pöördes paremale.
works.de: Chest portrait of an elderly man with white beard and moustache, slightly turned to the right.

works.d: Hallijuukselise, kiilaspäise vuntside ja lõuahabet kandva mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Ninal kuldraamidega prillid. Mehel seljas must saterkuub sügavalõikelise vestiga. tärgeldatud rinnaesise ja kõrge pitskraega ja musta ristlipsuga. Kuuerevääril metallist märk.
works.de: The half-figure of a grey-haired, bald man with a moustache and chin beard, in three-quarter profile facing right. Gold-rimmed spectacles on his nose. The man wears a black frock coat with a deeply cut waistcoat, a starched shirt front, a high lace collar and a black cross tie. A metal badge on the coat's lapel.

works.de: In the foreground a lake, with a solitary bush in front of it, a yellow landscape behind, few cloud wisps in the sky. Tones: blue, green.

works.de: In the front centre, on a road emerging from between bushes, two human figures dressed in white moving to the left. Between the bushes and treetops, further below, a sea spreading out is visible.

works.de: On a street receding from front to back, in the foreground a solitary veiled oriental female figure. The right side of the street is lined with walls of light-toned buildings.

works.de: Bust portrait of an older man in half-profile facing right. Dark hair and a trimmed goatee with gray streaks.

works.d: Esiplaanil murupind üksikute madalate pääsastega, paremal diagonaalis pildi keskele suunduv püst-tara, mille ääres põõsas-puid, keskel suurem sopiline veekogu, mille madalail kallastel segametsa.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud liivane maapind, taga mets.
works.de: Grassy sandy ground in the foreground, forest behind.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise, keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Punases pluusis.
works.de: Half-length portrait of a dark-haired, middle-aged woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a red blouse.

works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged woman in frontal view. On her shoulders a pink coat with a fur collar, a wide-brimmed hat on her head.

works.d: Ees sügisene kartulipõld töölt tulevate inimestega, korvid täis. Tagapool põhuga kaetud kuhjad, pruunikad ja samblarohelised põllusiilud, majakesed veekogu ääres. Sünge taeva taustal kahe suitseva korstnaga massiivsed tehasehooned.
works.de: In the foreground, an autumn potato field with people coming from work, baskets full. Behind, stacks covered with straw, brownish and moss-green field silos, small houses by a body of water. Against a gloomy sky, massive factory buildings with two smoking chimneys.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi kõrge sillaga. Kahel pool kallastel majad abihoonetega, puud. Teisel pool silda tehasehooned paljude suitsevate korstnatega. Pruunikashallid toonid, jõuline pintslilöök.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a high bridge. On both banks houses with outbuildings, trees. On the other side of the bridge factory buildings with many smoking chimneys. Brownish-gray tones, vigorous brushwork.

works.d: Ees astmelise kaldaga kaiäärne, pardid vees ujumas. Vasakul neid jälgivad inimesed. Tagapool kai ääres kalapaatide rida, hulk rahvast tänaval hoonete taustal. Pruunikas, hallikad küllastunud toonid, kohati pahtliga maalitud.
works.de: In front, a quay with a stepped bank, ducks swimming in the water. On the left people watching them. Further back, along the quay, a row of fishing boats, a crowd of people on the street against the background of buildings. Brownish, greyish saturated tones, in places painted with a palette knife.

works.d: Suvine vaade jõele. Ees poolenisti vette uppunud paadisild kõrkjate vahel. Paremal kaldal tume metsatukk. Vasakul päikesest valgustatud kaldal puud, kaugemal kaldalagendikul hooned. Maaliline laad.
works.de: Summer view of a river. In front a boat landing half-sunk in water among sedges. On the right bank a dark patch of forest. On the left bank, lit by the sun, trees, further away on the clearing by the bank buildings. Painterly style.

works.d: Sombus-halli taeva all avar sügisene maastik veekoguga. Esiplaanil vasakul lillakaspruun küntud põld. Põlluveerel paremal looklev tee, sellel kaks naisfiguuri istumas.
works.de: Under a gloomy grey sky an expansive autumn landscape with a body of water. In the foreground on the left a purplish-brown ploughed field. At the edge of the field on the right a winding road, on which two female figures are sitting.

works.d: Paremal nurgas esiplaanil mäenõlvak, millel kasvab hallide tüvede ja tumerohelise okstetihnikuna antud kuusemets. Taamal paistab läbi tüvede heledamini valgustatud lagendik.
works.de: In the right corner, in the foreground, a mountain slope on which grows a spruce forest rendered as grey trunks and dark green thicket of branches. Further back, a more brightly lit clearing shows through the trunks.

works.d: Vaade Tallinna vanalinnale Tornide väljaku lähedalt. Keskplaanis viis punase katusekiivriga linnamüüri kaitsetorni. Vasakul, kahe torni vahelt, paistab Niguliste kiriku torni osa. Ees kahekorruseline valge, planguga ümbritsetud kivimaja ning raagus puud.
works.de: View of Tallinn's Old Town from near Tornide Square. In the central plan five city-wall defence towers with red tiled roof helmets. On the left, between two towers, part of the tower of St. Nicholas' Church is visible. In front a two-storey white stone house surrounded by a plank fence, and bare trees.

works.d: Pikliku näoga noormehe rinnaportree, pea pööratud kergelt vasakule, kõrge laup, heledad, lühikesed, sirged juuksed. Seljas kollakaspruun kuub, sinise-valgeruuduline särk  lipsuga. Kokku sulatatud erinevaid toone, kohati pastoosne. Foonil selgelt eristatavad pintslilöögid, hallid, sinised, lillad ja külmrohelised toonid.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man with an elongated face, his head turned slightly to the left, a high forehead, light-coloured, short, straight hair. He is wearing a yellowish-brown coat, a blue-and-white checked shirt with a tie. Different tones are blended together, in places pastose. In the background, clearly distinguishable brushstrokes in grey, blue, purple and cold-green tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel oja, millest paremal jupike männimetsa. Ojast vasakul põllulapid ja heinamaa. Taamal üksikud majad, millede taga metsamassiiv. Ülal sinine taevas. Maalitud erivärvilisi pintslilööke mõjuda lastes. Koloriit rohelistes, sinistes ja punastes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground centre a stream, to the right of which a patch of pine forest. To the left of the stream fields and a meadow. In the distance solitary houses, behind which a forest mass. Above a blue sky. Painted letting varicoloured brushstrokes take effect. Colouring in green, blue and red tones.

works.d: Kitsa näoga, õlekarvaliste, ülepea kammitud juustega noore mehe rinnaportree. Pea pöördes paremale, pilk suunatud otse. Särk eest avatud. Maalitud jõulise pintslilöögiga.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young man with a narrow face and straw-coloured hair combed straight back. Head turned to the right, gaze directed straight ahead. Shirt open at the front. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil haljasala, kus jalutavad inimesed. Taga kõrgub Tallinna vanalinn linnamüüri tornide ja majadega. Vasakule jääb Oleviste kirik.
works.de: In the foreground a green area where people are walking. Behind it rises Tallinn's Old Town with the towers and houses of the town wall. To the left is St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Esiplaanil ridastikku diagonaalis paremalt raagus puud, mis lõikavad ülaserva. Tagapool tara, inimfiguurid ja ülaservaga lõikuvad majad.
works.de: In the foreground, bare trees in a row diagonally from the right, cutting the upper edge. Behind them a fence, human figures and houses cutting the upper edge.

works.d: Kõrgete kallaste vahel voolav kivise sängiga jõgi. Vasakul servas kaheksa hobust. Paremal kaldaserv lehtpuudega ja põõsastega.
works.de: A river with a stony bed flowing between high banks. On the left edge eight horses. On the right the bank edge with deciduous trees and bushes.

works.d: Esiplaanil, merel, paat aerutava naise ja võrke paati tõmbava mehega. Eemal teisi paate ja rannariba.
works.de: In the foreground, at sea, a boat with a woman rowing and a man pulling nets into the boat. In the distance other boats and a shoreline.

works.d: Esiplaanil osa laevast, tekil kolm meest, neist parempoolseimal käes köis.
works.de: In the foreground part of a ship, on deck three men, the rightmost holding a rope.

works.d: Kalapaat kolme mehega. Neist kaks võrke välja tõmbamas, üks aerutamas.
works.de: A fishing boat with three men. Two of them pulling out nets, one rowing.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrgendikul männid, tagapool metsad ja järveserv, taevas pilved.
works.de: In the foreground, pines on a rise, forests and the lakeshore behind, clouds in the sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane nõlvak üksikute puuvõsudega. Vasakul rohupuhmad. Tagaplaanil tumeroheliste mändidega kaetud madalad künkad. Vasakul peale mändide mõned kased. Taevas kollakates-lillakates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy slope with solitary shrubs. On the left tufts of grass. In the background low hills covered with dark green pines. On the left, beyond the pines, a few birches. Sky in yellowish-purplish tones.

works.d: Kaks halli kala pruunil laual, milledest esimene katki lõigatud ja punane mari paistab. Tagapool kauss.
works.de: Two grey fish on a brown table, the first of which is cut open and a red roe can be seen. Behind, a bowl.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule näha osa laeva pardast kahe mastiga. Paremal üks mees ja vasakul kaks meest purjeid üles tõmbamas. Paremal meri. Kõrge horisont.
works.de: In the foreground diagonally from right to left part of a ship's side with two masts is visible. At right one man and at left two men hoisting the sails. At right the sea. High horizon.

works.d: Diagonaalselt vasakult paremale sõitev paat kümne mehega. Paremal ülanurgas näha tükk punakat
works.de: A boat with ten men sailing diagonally from left to right. In the upper right corner a piece of reddish [is visible].

works.d: Esiplaanil tänaval, paralleelselt tornide reaga, ruttavad inimesed. Vasakul seisvate autode tagant, vanade puumajade tagant, paistab elektrijaama korsten, keskel Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: In the foreground on the street, parallel to a row of towers, people are hurrying. Behind the parked cars on the left, behind old wooden houses, the chimney of a power plant is visible, in the middle the tower of St Olaf's Church.

works.d: Keskel tahasuunduv tee, millel liikumas sõdureid ja veokeid.
works.de: In the middle a road receding into the distance, with soldiers and trucks moving on it.

works.d: Rutja. Esiplaanil kivise kaldaga jõgi. Paremalt maanteetamm ja sillapostide rida suunaga metsa poole. Kaugemal männimets, põõsastik. Metsa ja kalda vahelisel maaribal inimesed heina rõngu panemas. Taevas süngelt pilves.
works.de: Rutja. In the foreground a river with a stony bank. On the right a roadway embankment and a row of bridge posts leading towards the forest. Further away a pine forest, shrubbery. On the strip of land between the forest and the bank people making hay bundles. The sky darkly overcast.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivaselt rohtunud rannalt vaade vahutavate lainetega merele. Vasakul tuulest painduvate okstega puude vahel võrke kandvad mehed ja paat. Paremal puud.
works.de: In the foreground a view from a sandy, grassy shore to the sea with foaming waves. On the left, among trees with branches bending in the wind, men carrying nets and a boat. Trees on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt vasakult paremale lahtiaetud kartulivagude kohale kummardunud inimfiguurid. Keskel hobune kastiga, selle ees kartuleid noppiv mees. Paremal poolik kartulikuhi, selle juures korvi tühjendav mees, kummarduv naine. Kaugemal kollendavad põllud ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground, diagonally from left to right, human figures bent over opened potato furrows. In the middle a horse with a cart, in front of it a man picking potatoes. On the right a partial pile of potatoes, next to it a man emptying a basket, a bending woman. In the distance yellowing fields and trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil põld, tagapool paistab mets.
works.de: A field in the foreground, a forest visible behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil vaataja suunas voolav oja jäätükkidega. Kallastel tükati lund. Tagaplaanil segamets kuuskedega, mis varjab silmapiiri.
works.de: In the foreground a stream flowing towards the viewer with pieces of ice. On the banks patches of snow. In the background a mixed forest with spruces obscuring the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil väike riba kallast ja jõgi paatidega. Paremal meri ja eemalt paistev Tallinna siluett. Vasakul lipumast punase lipuga ja hooned ning puud.
works.de: In the foreground a small strip of shore and a river with boats. On the right the sea and, visible from a distance, the silhouette of Tallinn. On the left a flagpole with a red flag, and buildings and trees.

works.d: Jõeorg kõrgete kallastega vasakul ja parema, millel mets. Esiplaanil vasakul madalal luhal lehmad söömas. Paremal jõele ehitatud tamm.
works.de: River valley with high banks on the left and on the right, the latter with forest. In the foreground on the left, on a low water-meadow, cows grazing. On the right a dam built on the river.

works.d: Suur järv rohkete saartega. Paremal kallas kõrgete kaljurahnudega, millel kasvamas üksikud männid. Samuti vasakul kaljune kallas mändide ja kaskedega. Kõrge silmapiir. Järvel laev palgiparvega.
works.de: A large lake with numerous islands. On the right a shore with tall boulder rocks, on which single pine trees are growing. Likewise on the left a rocky shore with pines and birches. High horizon. On the lake a ship with a log raft.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal mägisel maastikul kivide vahel valged kitsed. Sellest vasakul üksikute puudega mägi. Tagaplaanil kõrged mäed, mille tipud ulatuvad pilvedesse.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, white goats among rocks on a mountainous landscape. To the left of it, a mountain with solitary trees. In the background, high mountains whose peaks reach into the clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja, mille kaldal vasakul spinninguga õngitsev mees, seisvas asendis, profiilis paremale. Oja käänaku kohal üksik suur kivi vees. Parempoolne tõusev kallas kaetud tiheda põõsastikuga. Maali keskosas teisel pool kallast küün. Pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a stream, on whose bank on the left a man is fishing with a spinning rod, standing, in profile to the right. Above a bend in the stream, a single large stone in the water. The rising bank on the right is covered with dense bushes. In the middle part of the painting, on the other side of the bank, a barn. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Lumise maastiku keskel tee, viis last. Paremal, metsatukk. Taga vasakul hooned. Piki teed vasakul telefonipost.
works.de: In the middle of a snowy landscape a road, five children. On the right a small patch of forest. In the background on the left buildings. Along the road on the left a telephone pole.

works.d: Ees vasakul kahe suure kivi vahel kolm last tule juures. Kaugemal keskelt paremale must-valget tõugu kari metsa ääres söömas. Pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, between two large stones, three children by a fire. Further away, from the centre to the right, a black-and-white herd grazing by the edge of a forest. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil niitmata, tagapool niidetud põld. Põldude  keskel, pildi keskel tumeroheline põõsas. Taustal üksikuid puid ja hooneid. Nende taga mets. Kõrge hallikas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground an unmown field, behind it a mown field. In the middle of the fields, in the middle of the picture, a dark green bush. In the background solitary trees and buildings. Behind them a forest. A high, greyish sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kahe laudsilla vahel veekogu. Vasakul silla lähedal kalapaat kaluriga. Temast vasakul seisab sillal mees, käes kalavõrk. Kaldal, kahe silla vahel, mootorpaat. Taamal kolme kuuri juures inimesed askeldamas. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water between two plank bridges. On the left, near the bridge, a fishing boat with a fisherman. To his left a man stands on the bridge, holding a fishing net. On the shore, between the two bridges, a motorboat. Further off, people busy near three sheds. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Vasakul keskaegsete majade taga, Tallinna raekoja punane katus torniga. Majade taga vasakul Pühavaimu kiriku torn. Esiplaanil Harju väljak jalutajatega.
works.de: On the left, behind medieval houses, the red roof with tower of Tallinn Town Hall. Behind the houses on the left the tower of the Church of the Holy Spirit. In the foreground Harju Square with strollers.

works.d: Peaaegu maali keskel oleva palkidest ehitatud, rohelise loosungiga ehitud värava taga paremal, keset veiste karja, askeldamas neljast inimesest koosev grupp. Nende taga paremal ajavad kaks naist kaht lehma (üks punane, teine valge) sindlikatusega kivilauta. Värava taga vasakul selgvaates sinise rätikuga naine ja tema kõrval vasakul lehm. Värava ees vasakul, raagus kase all, kaks tütarlast lüpsikutega. Paremal veab naine kettipidi lehma. Lehmast paremal kaabuga mees, piibuga paremas käes. Nende taga näha osaliselt punast lehma, valget hobust, kelle päitseid hoiab mõlema käega kinni nokkmütsiga mees. Taamal männiokste varjus, heinakuhja otsas, tõstavad kaks meest heina lakka. Heina võtab lakas
works.de: Almost in the middle of the painting, behind a gate built of logs and decorated with a green slogan banner, on the right, amid a herd of cattle, a group of four people busy at work. Behind them on the right two women are driving two cows (one red, the other white) toward a stone barn with a shingle roof. Behind the gate on the left, in full view, a woman with a blue kerchief, and beside her on the left a cow. In front of the gate on the left, under a bare birch, two girls with milk pails. On the right a woman is leading a cow by a chain. To the right of the cow a man in a hat, with a pipe in his right hand. Behind them a red cow is partly visible, as well as a white horse whose halter is held with both hands by a man in a peaked cap. In the distance, in the shade of pine branches, on top of a haystack, two men are lifting hay onto the stack. Hay is being taken on the stack

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kaares tahapoole suunduva süvendamisel oleva oja (või magistraalkraavi) kummalgi kaldal ekskavaator töös, parempoolsel kopp alla lastud, vasakpoolsel üleval. Vasakul kaldal kuus inimfiguuri, neist üks naine, kellede olekust ilmneb seotust tööprotsessiga - käes plaan, mille järgi uuritakse ümbrust. Üks töömees labidaga, teine teiba ja kirvega. Tagapool vesine madalik hõredate puudega.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, on both banks of a stream (or main drainage ditch) being deepened and curving backward, an excavator is at work, on the right one with its bucket lowered, on the left one raised. On the left bank six human figures, one of them a woman, whose actions show they are involved in the work process - one holds a plan, according to which the surroundings are being examined. One workman with a shovel, another with a pole and an axe. Further back a watery lowland with sparse trees.

works.d: All paremast nurgast diagonaalselt keskele suunduv katus, millest vasemal varemeis linn. Tagaplaanil paistab Tallinna raekoja torn, sellest vasakul Pühavaimu kiriku torni kiiver ja paremal Oleviste torn.
works.de: A roof running diagonally from the lower right corner to the centre, to the left of which a ruined town. In the background the tower of Tallinn Town Hall is visible, to its left the spire of the Church of the Holy Spirit and to the right the tower of St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Esialal vasakul rannaliival suuri lõhesid ja suuri kalakaste. Keskel kaldale uhutud kalapaat täis kalu. Paadi juures askeldamas mehi ja naisi. Tagapool vasakul täidetud kalakastide taga, kuivanud võrke, paremal paadisillal kalapüügi vahendeid, sillast tagapool asetsevat paati tõmbab mees merre tõmbamas. Taga vasakul metsane rand ja paremal avameri.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on the beach sand, large salmon and large fish crates. In the middle, a fishing boat full of fish washed up on the shore. Men and women busying themselves by the boat. Further back on the left, behind filled fish crates, dried nets; on the right on a jetty, fishing implements; behind the jetty a man is pulling a boat into the sea. Further back on the left a forested shore and on the right the open sea.

works.d: Hoonete keskel vasakul kõrge torn, paremal teistest hoonetest kõrgemale tõusev kuppelkatusega torniga ehitus.
works.de: Among the buildings, on the left a tall tower, on the right a structure with a domed-roof tower rising higher than the other buildings.

works.d: Ees paremal mees kaamliga ja kolm ratsurit eeslitel, vasakul mees eeslil. Keskel loss, lossi sissekäik kahe tornitaolise ehituse vahel.
works.de: In front on the right a man with a camel and three riders on donkeys, on the left a man on a donkey. In the middle a castle, the castle entrance between two tower-like structures.

works.d: Kivine rannik. Vasakul maalipoolel: ees kaks mängivat last, grupp mehi nendes üks ajalehte ette lugemas. Tagapoolt paistab tükike merd, kaldal üksik mänd, inimfiguure. Keskel kaldale tõmmatud paate. Paremal: tagaplaanil majade grupp, ees ristpuudele riputatud esemeid, inimfiguure. Taevas rahutuis pilveis.
works.de: A rocky coast. On the left side of the painting: in front two children playing, a group of men, one of them reading a newspaper aloud to the others. Behind, a piece of sea is visible, on the shore a solitary pine, human figures. In the middle, boats pulled up onto the shore.
