Predominantly rust-brown tones, painterly treatment.

works.d: Aknast välja vaatav mees on maalitud tumedais, pruunikais-hallikais toonides. Pruun kardin varjab osa figuurist. Aknalaual on õitsva hüatsindiga lillepott. Mehe seljataga on näha veidi toa sisustust: kirju vaip, pruun tool. Mehe parem käsi toetub aknalauale.
works.de: A man looking out of a window is painted in dark, brownish-grayish tones. A brown curtain conceals part of the figure. On the windowsill is a flowerpot with a blooming hyacinth. Behind the man, part of the room's furnishings can be seen: a patterned rug, a brown chair. The man's right hand rests on the windowsill.

works.dm: kõrgus: 47.1 cm; laius: 40.7 cm; kõrgus: 52.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 46.0 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Naise portree ekspressiivses laadis, tumedates toonides, tugevate mustade kontuuridega. Kohkunud ilmega naine on surunud parema käe suule. Taust hallikais toonides, naise kleit pruun. Maalil neljas kohas ca 1 cm2 suurused tükid vineeri pealiskihist puuduvad, pinnad üle maalitud.
works.de: A woman's portrait in an expressive style, in dark tones, with strong black contours. The woman, with a startled expression, has pressed her right hand to her mouth. The background is in greyish tones, the woman's dress is brown. In four places on the painting, pieces of about 1 cm2 of the plywood's surface layer are missing, the surfaces have been repainted.

works.d: Tumedapäise kissis silmadega mehe portree otsevaates, piip hambus. Ekspressiivne maalikäsitlus, erksad toonid: heleroheline kuub, sinine särk lipsuga. Diagonaalsete laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud roosa foon.
works.de: Portrait of a dark-haired man with narrowed eyes, frontal view, a pipe between his teeth. Expressive painting style, bright tones: a light green coat, a blue shirt with a tie. Pink background painted with wide diagonal brushstrokes.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille keskmes ruumiliselt kujutatud avatud (tubaka)karp, sinine silinder selle taga, ees paremas nurgas piip. Taustal läbisegi selgepiirilised geomeetrilised ja abstraktsed kujundid maalitud siledapinnaliselt, kohati lühikeste pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: A geometric composition, in the centre of which is spatially depicted an open (tobacco) box, a blue cylinder behind it, in front on the right corner a pipe. In the background, mixed together, clearly outlined geometric and abstract shapes painted with smooth surfaces, in places with short brushstrokes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.0 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 31.0 cm
works.d: Kuuekandiline, 4 cm paksune, tumesinine-lillakas objekt, mille mõlemal poolel sinistes, rohelistes, oranžides ja punastes toonides geomeetrilistest pindadest maalingud. Ühel poolel moodustub kuusnurkne täht, teisel siniste pindadega piiratud kuusnurk, kahel pool rohelised kolmnurgad, keskel kirju, ruudu ja kahe rombiga kujund.
works.de: A hexagonal, 4 cm thick, dark blue-purplish object, with paintings of geometric surfaces in blue, green, orange and red tones on both sides. On one side a six-pointed star is formed, on the other a hexagon bounded by blue surfaces, with green triangles on either side, and in the centre a colourful figure with a square and two rhombi.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon, mille keskmes sõõr mitmete ruumiliste kujunditega: ülal silinder, paremal kuubik, allpool kaks piipu. Sõõri läbivad diagonaaljooned tekitades ruumilisi lõikeid. Roosakasbeeź, hallikasroheline summutatud koloriit. Tihe spaatli, pintslikiri.
works.de: A composition of geometric shapes, at the centre a circle with several spatial forms: at the top a cylinder, on the right a cube, below two pipes. Diagonal lines run through the circle creating spatial intersections. Pinkish-beige, greyish-green muted colouring. Dense palette-knife and brush work.

works.d: Pilvelõhkujate ja tuledes linna taustal noore ema (madonna) poolfiguur mähkmeis sülelapsega, ulatamas talle revolvrit. Naise pea kaetud kollase rätiga, õlgadel punane rüü. Ekspressiivne laad, musta kontuuriga vorme rõhutav.
works.de: Against the backdrop of a city of skyscrapers and lights, half-figure of a young mother (madonna) with a swaddled infant in her arms, handing it a revolver. The woman's head covered with a yellow shawl, a red robe on her shoulders. Expressive manner, emphasising forms with black contour.

works.d: Rohelisel künkal avara maastiku taustal kolme ukseorvaga hele kabel, mille ees müürijupp. Vasakul hoonet varjamas raagus puutüvi, üksik puu hoonest paremal. Realistlik, pinnaline kujutamisviis.
works.de: On a green hill against a background of open landscape, a light-coloured chapel with three door openings, in front of it a piece of wall. On the left a bare tree trunk partly obscuring the building, a single tree to the right of the building. Realistic, planar manner of depiction.

works.d: Geomeetriliselt üldistatud, konstruktiivne, punastes toonides nägu valgete iiristega silmadega, kerges pöördes vasakule. Laubal ovaalne vari punasega. Mustas ülikonnas, kikilipsuga.
works.de: A geometrically generalised, constructive face in red tones with eyes with white irises, in a slight turn to the left. On the forehead an oval shadow in red. In a black suit, with a bow tie.

works.d: Noore, õlgadeni ulatuvate blondide juustega naise rindportree kerges pöördes paremale. Valge kaelus, roosakas jakk. Tume rohekas-sinine foon.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with blonde shoulder-length hair, in a slight turn to the right. White collar, pinkish jacket. Dark greenish-blue background.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul keskealise mehe rinnafiguur poolpöördes paremale. Seljas tume pintsak ja valge särk, peas tume soni. Taustaks viljapõld, eemal veekogu ja grupp punase katusega maju.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, the chest figure of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the right. Wearing a dark jacket and white shirt, a dark hat on his head. Background a grain field, in the distance a body of water and a group of houses with red roofs.

works.d: Narmasõlakutega mereväeparaadkuues noormehe põlvpilt peaaegu enface. Parem käsi toetatud ankru ristpuule.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a naval dress uniform with fringed epaulettes, almost en face. Right hand resting on the crossbar of an anchor.

works.d: Keskealise naise poolfiguur punase drapeeringu taustal. Peas väike peakate, seljas helerohekas dekolteeritud kleit kuldtikandiga rinnaesisel ja tumesinine, pruuni karusnahkse äärega ürp. Nähtavas vasemas käes mehe miniatuurportree. Ülal vasakul vapi kujutis.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman against a red drapery background. On her head a small headdress, wearing a light greenish low-necked dress with gold embroidery on the bodice, and a dark blue robe with a brown fur trim. In her visible left hand, a miniature portrait of a man. Upper left, a depiction of a coat of arms.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rohumaa. Taga mets.
works.de: Open grassland in the foreground. Forest behind.

works.dm: kõrgus: 38.5 cm (tööm.); laius: 38.2 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 37.4 cm (vm.); laius: 40.2 cm (tööm.)
works.d: Valgepäise poisikese põlvpilt kitarriga, poolprofiilis vasakule. Riietatud helebeeži kuube valge krae ja kätistega. Üldfoon tumepruun. Poisikese taga nelinurkne hele laik millele langeb poisi profiili tume vari.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a white-haired boy with a guitar, in half-profile to the left. Dressed in a light beige coat with a white collar and cuffs. Overall background dark brown. Behind the boy a rectangular light patch, onto which the dark shadow of the boy's profile falls.

works.dm: kõrgus: 84.0 cm (vm); laius: 103.0 cm (arm); kõrgus: 85.0 cm (arm); laius: 102.0 cm (vm)
works.d: Helendava mereliiva taustal jookseb grupp valgetes supeltrikoodes noori naisi. Kõigil päevitunud kehad. Näojooned ebaselged. Juuksed lendlevad tuules. Liivale langevad nende varjud.
works.de: Against a background of glowing sea sand a group of young women in white swimsuits are running. All have tanned bodies. Facial features indistinct. Hair flying in the wind. Their shadows fall on the sand.

works.d: Kolm seisvat naisakti: vasakpoolne kerge pöördega paremale, keskmine vasemale; parempoolne en face.
works.de: Three standing female nudes: the left one slightly turned to the right, the middle one to the left; the right one en face.

works.d: Keskealise, prillidega mehe poolfiguur peaaegu enface. Pruunikal taustal.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with glasses, almost en face. Against a brownish background.

works.d: Profiilis vasakule keskealise mehe poolfiguur, paremast küünanrnukist tõstetud käes puuvarras, vasak käsi rinna kohal; seljas särk, pehme krae ja roheka kaelasidemega.
works.de: In profile facing left, the half-figure of a middle-aged man, in his raised right hand from the elbow a wooden stick, left hand at chest level; wearing a shirt, a soft collar and a greenish necktie.

works.d: Istuva vana naise poolfiguur profiilis paremale. Peas valge rätik, ees prillid, käes hoiab raamatut. Maalitud siledalt, ühtlaselt, lokaalselt.
works.de: Half-figure of a sitting old woman in profile to the right. White kerchief on the head, glasses in front, holding a book in hand. Painted smoothly, evenly, locally.

works.d: Konstruktivistlikus laadis kompositsioon kolme naisfiguuriga. Vasakul istuva naise rinnafiguur, tema ees sinine vaas ja korv värviliste keradega. Keskel seisev naine, parem käsi puusas ja paremal istuv naine selgvaates. Samas, läbi võlvkaare avaneb vaade linnale.
works.de: A composition in constructivist style with three female figures. On the left the bust of a seated woman, in front of her a blue vase and a basket with colourful balls. In the middle a standing woman, right hand on hip, and on the right a seated woman seen frontally. In the same place, through an arched vault, a view of the city opens.

works.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Foon hele.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man in a slight turn to the left. Background light.

works.d: Kolm figuuri kubistlikult geometriseeritud, ümbritsetud muusikariistade elementidega. Parempoolne naisfiguur suletud silmadega, vasak kinnastatud käsi ees, vasakpoolne figuur kollase ihutooniga, tagumine figuur tõmmu, punase mütsiga.
works.de: Three figures in cubistically geometricised form, surrounded by elements of musical instruments. The figure on the right, a woman with closed eyes, gloved left hand in front; the figure on the left with yellow skin tone; the rear figure swarthy, wearing a red cap.

works.d: Pikliku peaga kõrge nõgusa laubaga ja kõrge, veidi esileulatuva kuklaga, rohekashallide, eest sirgelt lõigatud juustega poisi portree poolprofiilis vasakule. Helesinised silmad kõrgete kulmukaartega, pika sirge, nõrga ninajuurega ninaga, tagasiulatuva lõuaga. Hallikassinises pluusis selle alt paistva punase kaelusega. Neutraalne erineva heledusega foon.
works.de: Portrait, in half-profile facing left, of a boy with an elongated head, a high concave forehead and a high, slightly protruding back of the head, with greenish-grey hair cut straight at the front. Light blue eyes with high arched eyebrows, a long straight nose with a weak bridge, and a receding chin. Wearing a greyish-blue blouse with a red collar showing beneath it. Neutral background of varying lightness.

works.d: Geomeetriliselt lihtsustatud kahe naise rinnafiguurid. Eespool, vasakul, roheliste, peadligi liibuvate, tagant patsina langevate juustega naine poolprofiilis paremale, helerohelises, kolmnurkse sisselõikega rüüs, tema seljataga pildivälja keskel kollaste juustega, langetatud pilguga, pead paremale (vaataja suhtes) kallutav naine sügava dekolteega hallikassinises kleidis. Tema õla juures ornažikaspunane kera. Fooniks värvilised geomeetrilised kujundid.
works.de: Geometrically simplified bust figures of two women. In front, on the left, a woman with green hair, close to the head, falling into a braid at the back, in half-profile to the right, in a light green robe with a triangular cutout; behind her, in the centre of the picture field, a woman with yellow hair, with a lowered gaze, tilting her head to the right (in relation to the viewer), in a greyish-blue dress with a deep décolletage. Near her shoulder, an orange-red sphere. The background consists of coloured geometric shapes.

works.d: Tumedal neutraalsel foonil kollakates ja pruunikates toonides modelleeritud askeetlikult teravate, karakteersete näojoontega, kergelt lainetavate helepruunide juustega, tumerohelises pluusis ning punaste triipudega tumesinise kikilipsuga mehe rinnaportree  enface, kerges pöördes vasakule, rohekate silmade, altkulmu uuriv-terav pilk suunatud vaatajale. Rinna kõrgusele tõstetud pikkade küüntega peenes paremas käes roheline pliiats. Teravad tundelised punased huuled, piklik lõuapartii, veidi kongus nina.
works.de: A bust portrait, en face, of a man modelled in yellowish and brownish tones against a dark neutral background, with ascetically sharp, characterful facial features, slightly wavy light-brown hair, wearing a dark green blouse and a dark blue bow tie with red stripes, in a slight turn to the left, with greenish eyes and a probing, sharp gaze directed at the viewer from under his brows. In his slender right hand, raised to chest height, with long fingernails, a green pencil. Sharp, sensitive red lips, an elongated jawline, a slightly hooked nose.

works.d: Tumedast foonist eraldub sulava siluetiga heledas särgis, tumeda kaelasideme, kaabu ja prillidega mehe poolfiguur. Paremas käes pintsel, vasemas palett, millel mitmesuguseid värvitoone.
works.de: From a dark background emerges, with a melting silhouette, the half-figure of a man in a light shirt, dark necktie, hat and glasses. In his right hand a brush, in his left a palette with various colour tones.

works.d: Veerandpöördes, pisut langetatud peaga naise rinnaportree, silmad maha vaatamas. Peas punakaspruuni lindiga väike must kübar, seljas beež jakk ning kirju pluus, mille kaeluses kiviga pross. Kübarast langeb laubale vari, varju jääb ka osa vasemast põsest. Jaki krae nurgas roheline lilleke. Valdavalt rohekaspruunides toonides.
works.de: A quarter-turned bust portrait of a woman with her head slightly lowered, eyes looking down. On her head a small black hat with a reddish-brown ribbon, wearing a beige jacket and a patterned blouse with a brooch with a stone at the neckline. The hat casts a shadow on the forehead, and part of the left cheek is also in shadow. A green little flower at the corner of the jacket collar. Predominantly in greenish-brown tones.

works.d: Valges rätikus ja pluusis naine, lambaraudadega käes, lamba kohale kummardumas. Näojooned väga skemaatiliselt antud. Pildi esiplaanil pooleldi pügatud lammas, kellest kõrgemal paremat kätt korv villaga. Koloriit rohekaspruunides ja kollastes värvitoonides. Valgusega on esile tõstetud naise pea ning õlad ja lamba tagaosa.
works.de: A woman in a white kerchief and blouse, holding sheep shears, bending over a sheep. The facial features are given very schematically. In the foreground a half-shorn sheep, above which, at right, a basket with wool. The colour scheme is in greenish-brown and yellow tones. The woman's head and shoulders, and the sheep's hindquarters, are highlighted with light.

works.d: Vasakult üks seljaga ning üks näoga istuv naisfiguur alasti, vastavalt punase ja musta riidepalakaga käes. Paremal seljaga veerandpöördes alasti seisev naisfiguur valge riidega käes. Vasakul ja keskel istuvate naiste taga tumedad sinakashallid puukroonid, ülal pilvine taevas. Naiste kehad ja riidetükid on maalitud üldistavas laadis, tugevasti valgust ja varju rõhutades.
works.de: From the left, one seated female figure with her back turned and one facing forward, nude, holding a red and a black piece of cloth respectively. On the right, a nude female figure standing in a quarter-turn with her back turned, holding a white cloth. Behind the seated women on the left and in the center, dark bluish-gray treetops, above a cloudy sky. The women's bodies and pieces of cloth are painted in a generalized manner, strongly emphasizing light and shadow.

works.d: Arhitektuurimotiivide taustal-vahel kuuest noorest inimesest grupp, väike puu keskel. Vasakul sinkja tellismüüri ja sinise draperii ees, sepisaiaga müürinurgal istub heledas suvekleidis ja kübaraga naine poolpöördes paremale, käed süles, pilk suunatud ette, ilme tõsine. Temast paremal, aimataval künkal kasvab noor raagus lehtpuu. Pildil paremal, Väravaorja ja torniga linnamüüri osa taustal poolselgvaates naine tüdrukuga, lapse pilk vaatajal. Nende taga lillesülemiga naise ja kahe mehe kujud, suunaga puul, istujal. Kahvatud pastelsed toonid, suure üldistuse, valdavalt pahtliga maalitud.
works.de: Against a background of architectural motifs, a group of six young people, a small tree in the middle. On the left, before a bluish brick wall and a blue drapery, at the wrought-iron corner of the wall sits a woman in a light summer dress and a hat, turned half-way to the right, hands in her lap, gaze directed forward, expression serious. To her right, on a suggested hillock, grows a young bare deciduous tree. On the right of the picture, against the background of part of the town wall with the Gate Servant's Tower [Väravaorja tower], in half-view, a woman with a girl, the child's gaze directed at the viewer. Behind them the figures of a woman with an armful of flowers and two men, facing the tree and the seated figure. Pale pastel tones, executed with great generalisation, mostly painted with a palette knife.

works.d: Erinevas suuruses geomeetrilistest kujunditest mosaiigitaoliselt kombineeritud kompositsioon, mille keskpunktis otseti  lamav naisakt, põlved enda alla konksu tõmmatud. Naise vasak käsi on pisut tõstetult välja sirutatud, parema (küünarnukist kõverdatud käe) labakäsi toetab lühikeste sirgete juustega pead. Figuuri reiepiirkonnas kolm risti. Väljasirutatud käest vasakul kuusirp. Figuuri kohal foonil on teisigi maastikule viitavad detaile (täht, majakatus). Valdavalt tumeroosades, beežides, sinistes toonides.
works.de: A composition combined mosaic-like from geometric shapes of varying size, at the centre of which lies a female nude, viewed straight on, knees drawn up beneath her. The woman's left arm is stretched out, slightly raised; the hand of her right arm (bent at the elbow) supports her head, which has short straight hair. In the thigh area of the figure, three crosses. To the left of the outstretched arm, a crescent moon. Above the figure, in the background, are other details referring to a landscape (a star, a roof of a house). Predominantly in dark pink, beige, and blue tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine maapind. Taamal rida raagus puid.
works.de: In the foreground, snowy ground. In the distance a row of bare trees.

works.d: Toolil istuva tumedajuukselise naise täisportree. Pea poolprof. pöördega vasemale. Parem käsi toetub tooli istmelauale, vasak rüpes. Üle vasaku õla punane mantel.
works.de: Full-length portrait of a dark-haired woman seated on a chair. Head in half-profile turned to the left. Right hand resting on the seat of the chair, left in her lap. A red coat over the left shoulder.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu (end. vallikraav) kai ääres seisva praami ja laevaga. Keskel, vasakul madalale kaldale veetud kaks väikest aurikut, paremal järsult tõusev vana linnus all puudega ja üle latvade paistva lootsi torniga; taamal maju ja lehtpuid.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water (former moat) with a barge and a ship standing by the quay. In the centre, on the left, two small steamships drawn up on the low shore, on the right a steeply rising old fortress with trees below and a pilot's tower visible over the treetops; in the distance, houses and deciduous trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage tasane muru, taamal puude vahel kaks punase katusega maja.
works.de: In the foreground open flat lawn, in the distance among trees two houses with red roofs.

works.d: Laual taldrik banaaniga, selle taga banaane ja apelsin. Vasakul kaks apelsini. Taga keskel põll leht-kaktusega.
works.de: On the table a plate with a banana, behind it bananas and an orange. On the left two oranges. In the background in the centre an apron with a leaf cactus.

works.d: Prillidega keskealise toolil istuva mehe põlvpilt, enface. Keha puusadest kerge pöördega paremale. Parem käsi tooli leenil, vasak põlvel.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged bespectacled man sitting on a chair, en face. Body slightly turned to the right from the hips. Right hand on the armrest of the chair, left hand on the knee.

works.d: Esialal vasakul kivine jõekallas, keskel, peegelduval veepinnal ankrus lootsik õngemehega. Tagapool jõe kallaste ääres pooleldi kaldale tõmmatud paate ja purjekaid, jõe keskel väike purjekas valendava purjega. Taga linna suitsvaid korstnaid ja kirikutorni tipp taeva taustal.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky riverbank, in the centre, anchored on the reflecting water surface, a small boat with an angler. Further back along the riverbanks, boats and sailboats partly drawn up onto the shore, in the middle of the river a small sailboat with a whitish sail. Behind, the city's smoking chimneys and the tip of a church tower against the sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi paatidega. Taga linna panoraam. Vasakul korstnad.
works.de: In the foreground a river with boats. Behind it a panorama of the city. On the left chimneys.

works.d: Vasakul nurgas taburett, millelt langeb põrandale eredates värvides kirju riie. Põrandal kauss õuntega, paremal üksik õun. Kausist paremal, kaugemal kaks kõrget vaasi. Taburetil kaks õuna ja vaas. Paremal pool fooniks sinine, tumesiniste täppidega draperii.
works.de: In the left corner a stool from which a brightly coloured cloth falls to the floor. On the floor a bowl with apples, on the right a single apple. To the right of the bowl, further back, two tall vases. On the stool two apples and a vase. On the right side, the background is a blue drapery with dark blue dots.

works.d: Noore tütarlapse põlvportree toolil istumas, käed vaheliti süles, peapööre vasakule. Seljas valge pluus ja kirju vest.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young girl sitting on a chair, hands folded in her lap, head turned to the left. Wearing a white blouse and a patterned waistcoat.

works.d: Ees paremal, saanis naine ja mees. Vasakul, künka varjus, ebamäärane, sinises rüüs, kaamete nägudega figuuride grupp. Taga, künka harjal taluhooned.
works.de: In front on the right, a woman and a man in a sleigh. On the left, in the shadow of a hill, a vague group of figures in blue robes with pale faces. Behind, on the crest of the hill, farm buildings.

works.d: Ees keskel murul lõke. Lõkkest otse üles tõusev suitsujoon moodustab ülal horisontaalselt üle töö jooksva suitsuvinega risti. Tule juures vasakul seljaga vaatleja poole istuv mees paremal poolprofiilis vasemale naine lapsega süles. Taga vasakul hobune rohtu söömas. Lagedat rohumaad palistavad taamal lehtpuude grupid.
works.de: In the front centre, a campfire on the grass. The line of smoke rising straight up from the fire forms a cross with the smoke haze running horizontally across the top of the work. Beside the fire on the left a man sits with his back to the viewer, on the right in half-profile facing left a woman with a child in her lap. Behind, on the left, a horse grazing on grass. Groups of deciduous trees border the open meadow in the distance.

works.d: Ees, paremal ja vasakul servas kõrge, lopsaka lehestikuga puu. Vasemal, puu all kolm selgvaates sinises kuues kergelt kühmus istuv mees. Puude vahelt vaade laiuvale rohumaale, mida taamal ääristab mets kollase majaviiluga paremal. Ülal ääres sinises rida tumedajuukselisi inimpäid-maske.
works.de: In front, at the right and left edges, a tall tree with lush foliage. On the left, under the tree, three men in blue coats sit slightly hunched, seen clearly. Between the trees a view of an expansive meadow, bordered in the distance by a forest with a yellow house gable on the right. Along the upper edge, in blue, a row of dark-haired human heads-masks.

works.dm: kõrgus: 29.5 cm (km); laius: 45.6 cm (pm); kõrgus: 32.0 cm (pm); laius: 44.7 cm (km)
works.d: Esiplaanil lage maapind, tagapool lumelaike ja üksikud puutüved, ülaääres kitsas veeriba.
works.de: In the foreground bare ground, behind it patches of snow and single tree trunks, at the upper edge a narrow strip of water.

works.d: Valgeis rünkpilves sinise taeva foonil esiplaanil vasakul maja ees puude all grupp kirevais riideis naisi pereemaga eesotsas, tema vasta väljasirutatud parema käega Kalev, seljataga kolm meest laegaste ja kannuga, keskel Kalevi ratsu teda hoidva mehega, paremal puude all ratsanike rivi odadega.
works.de: Against a background of white cumulus clouds and blue sky, in the foreground on the left, in front of a house under trees, a group of women in colourful clothes with the mother of the family at the head, towards her with outstretched right hand Kalev, behind him three men with chests and a jug, in the middle Kalev's steed with a man holding it, on the right under trees a row of horsemen with spears.

works.d: Valgete pilverünkadega sinisel taevafoonil pildi esiplaanil kolm palveseisakus püstiseisvat naist pikkades maani kuubedes, äärmistel pead rinnal, parempoolsel käed kokkupandult rinnal, keskmisel pea kuklasse kallutatud, vaatega kolmveerand vasakule; vasakul äärel ohvrituli üleskerkiva suitsu
works.de: Against a blue sky background with white cloud masses, in the foreground of the picture three women stand upright in an attitude of prayer, in long floor-length robes, the outer ones with heads bowed on their chests, the one on the right with hands folded on her chest, the middle one with head tilted back, gazing three-quarters to the left; at the left edge a sacrificial fire with rising smoke.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline muru. Paremal riputab naine nööridele pesu, kus ripuvad sinised, kollased, punased, valged pesuesemed. Nööride tagant paistab laudaed, mille taga vasakul põõsad. Sinine taevas.
works.de: Green grass in the foreground. On the right a woman is hanging laundry on lines, with blue, yellow, red, white pieces of laundry hanging on them. Behind the lines a plank fence is visible, behind which on the left are bushes. Blue sky.

works.d: Madala hämara ruumi nurk. Vasakul seina ääres pikk pink istuva mehega. Paremal kirst. Vasakul ees näha osa aknapiidast.
works.de: Corner of a low, dim room. On the left by the wall a long bench with a seated man. On the right a coffin. In the foreground on the left part of a window frame is visible.

works.d: Ahju suu ees pingil tume nõu, selle kohal ripub triibuline rätik.
works.de: In front of the furnace opening on a bench a dark vessel, above it hangs a striped towel.

works.d: Neli alasti figuuri suunduvad väänlevaid kehaliigutusi tehes tantsuekstaasis üle pildi pinna paremalt vasakule. Foon tuhm sinine, maapind roheline, kehad pruunikad, all paremal punane ketas. Leht koosneb mitmest kokkuliimitud tükist.
works.de: Four nude figures move across the picture surface from right to left in a dance ecstasy, making writhing bodily movements. Background dull blue, ground green, bodies brownish, lower right a red disc. The sheet consists of several pieces glued together.

works.d: Keskel taeva helesinisel taustal seisev naisakt, sinistest lilledest pärg käes, murul seismas. Naise parem jalg lõdvalt kõverdunud, ümber pea on põimitud pats. Naisest vasakul väike, heledapäine alasti lapsuke seljaga vaataja poole, ülestõstetud käes sinine lill. Kauguses madala silmapiiri kohal valged pilved.
works.de: In the centre, against the light blue background of the sky, a standing female nude with a wreath of blue flowers in her hand, standing on grass. The woman's right leg is loosely bent, a braid is wound around her head. To the left of the woman a small, fair-haired naked child with its back to the viewer, holding a blue flower in its raised hand. In the distance, above the low horizon, white clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaks seisvat naisefiguuri, keskel veekogu, selle taga mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the left two standing female figures, in the middle a body of water, behind it a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivisel küngastikul vasakul kolmeharaline puu, paremal künka tipul rida puid (mände), keskel veekogu. Vees peegelduvate puudega tagaplaanil täitvast metsast.
works.de: In the foreground on a rocky hillock on the left a three-forked tree, on the right at the top of the hill a row of trees (pines), in the middle a body of water. In the background a forest filling the space with trees reflected in the water.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu milles peegeldub taga kaldal asuv lehtpuumets.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water in which the deciduous forest on the far shore is reflected.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul üksik suur puu. Tagapool puude vahel aed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a single large tree. Behind it, a garden among trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil värvilisel linal õunad, vasemal õun taldrikul. Tagapool õitsev oks. Taust sinine.
works.de: In the foreground, apples on a coloured canvas, an apple on a plate on the left. Behind, a flowering branch. Blue background.

works.d: Keskplaanis kõrge kaldapank, millel paistab maja viilkatus. Panga all kaldale tõmmatud paat. Vasakul meri. Taevas pilvine. Maalitud hoogsate, laiade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the middle ground a high riverbank on which the gable roof of a house can be seen. Under the bank a boat drawn up onto the shore. On the left the sea. The sky cloudy. Painted with vigorous, broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Teisel pool kaldal heinamaa. Vasakul puudesalu, paremas servas kaks puud. Maalitud rohekas-pruunides toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water. On the other side of the bank a meadow. On the left a grove of trees, two trees at the right edge. Painted in greenish-brown tones.

works.d: Ülalvaade katuste rägale. Paremal lehvib taeva foonil "Punase Risti" lipp. Värvigamma hele. Maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: View from above of a jumble of roofs. On the right a "Red Cross" flag flutters against the sky. Light colour scheme. Painted with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Vana naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Pisut ettepoole kummardunud. Käed küünarvarrelt toetuvad ette lauale. Naisel kortsuline nägu, silmad vidukil, pilk suunatud vasakule. Tume pearätt peas. Maal visandlik-markeeriv, osa lõuendist katmata.
works.de: A frontal chest portrait of an old woman. Bent slightly forward. Her arms rest forward on the table from the forearms. The woman has a wrinkled face, eyes half-closed, gaze directed to the left. A dark headscarf on her head. The painting is sketchy-marking in style, part of the canvas left uncovered.

works.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa, looredelid vasakul. Tagapool puudeviirg majadega, kiriku siluett paremal. Kõrge hallikas taevalaotus. Maalitud ühtlaste laiade pintslitõmmetega, üldistavalt.
works.de: In the foreground a meadow, hay racks on the left. Beyond, a row of trees with houses, the silhouette of a church on the right. A high, greyish expanse of sky. Painted with even, broad brushstrokes, in a generalising manner.

works.d: Veekogu kaldal puude vahel punase katusega madal maja. Esiplaanil osa veekogust, peegeldus vees. Maalitud üldistavalt laia pintslilöögiga rõhekashallides toonides.
works.de: On the shore of a body of water, among trees, a low house with a red roof. In the foreground part of the body of water, reflection in the water. Painted in a generalized manner with broad brushstrokes in greenish-gray tones.

works.d: Jalad harkis seisev põlvpükstes noormees otsevaates, paremas tõstetud käes löögivalmis reket. Maalitud visandlikult, värvikalt, alusmaterjal kumab läbi.
works.de: A young man in knee-breeches standing with legs apart, in frontal view, in his raised right hand a racket ready to strike. Painted sketchily, colourfully, the ground material shining through.

works.d: Erksates toonides suvine maastik jõekääruga. Esiplaanil ja paremal neli habrast kaske, lilleline kallas. Taamal nõlvak taluga. Rünkpilvine kõrge taevas.
works.de: A summer landscape in bright tones with a river bend. In the foreground and on the right four delicate birches, a flowery bank. Beyond, a slope with a farmstead. High sky with cumulus clouds.

works.d: Lage rabamaastik kahe kõrgema kuusega. Madala silmapiiri kohal valge pilvetriip. Taevalaotus ühtlaselt lillakashall.
works.de: Bare bog landscape with two taller spruces. White cloud stripe above the low horizon. The sky evenly purplish-grey.

works.d: Leentoolis istuva neiu poolfiguur poolpöördes paremale, käed süles. Poolpikad keskelt lahkukammitud juuksed, tumedal kleidil kaelakee. Näo osas maal täpne, selge kontuuriga piiritletud.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman sitting in an armchair, in a half-turn to the right, hands in her lap. Semi-long hair parted in the middle, a necklace on the dark dress. The face area of the painting is precise, delimited by a clear contour.

works.d: Ümaranäoline seisev figuur lillakassinises laias hõlstis profiilis vasakule. Taustal markeeritud interjöör. Maal värvikas visandlik, aluspind kumab läbi.
works.de: A round-faced standing figure in a wide purplish-blue robe, in profile to the left. Marked interior in the background. The painting is colourful and sketch-like, the underlying surface shining through.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel, peaaegu küljega vaataja poole, seisab valges madrusekraega pluusis ja tumedas kitsas seelikus noor naine, käsi rohelisele rinnatisele toetatud. Naisel pisut püstjas nina, kergelt väljaulatuvad põsesarnad ja teravajooneline ülespoole nurkadega suu. Juuksed kuklal suures krunnis. Pluusi kaeluses must kunstlill. Fooni ülaosa lilla, paremal ülanurgas uduselt antud maastikumaal.
works.de: In the foreground in the centre, almost with her side to the viewer, stands a young woman in a white blouse with a sailor collar and a dark narrow skirt, hand resting on a green bodice. The woman has a slightly upturned nose, slightly protruding cheekbones and a sharply lined mouth with upturned corners. Hair in a large bun at the nape. In the neckline of the blouse a black artificial flower. The upper part of the background is purple, in the upper right corner a hazily rendered landscape painting.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivisel rannal kalu korvidesse sortreerijate grupid. Nende taga keskel ninapidi rannaliivale tõmmatud paadi ümber naisi. Vasakul ja keskel meri, paremal kivine kalurihüttide, askeldavate inimeste ja metsatukkadega rannik.
works.de: In the foreground, on a stony shore, groups of people sorting fish into baskets. Behind them, in the centre, women around a boat drawn up nose-first onto the sandy shore. Sea on the left and centre, on the right a rocky coastline with fishing huts, bustling people and patches of forest.

works.d: Ees vasakul meri järsu kõrge kaldaga. Keskel põõsaid ja paremal rohtunud maal kari ja karjane.
works.de: On the left the sea with a steep, high shore. In the middle bushes, and on the right on grassy land a herd and a herdsman.

works.d: Kalaranna esiplaanil ruttav mees, püksid põlvini üleskääritud, kalakorviga õlal, tema kõrval vasakul naine. Keskosas rannarahvast askeldavas tegevuses. Parempoolses osas taga näha paari ülestõmmatud purjedega paati, neist paremal rannal võrgumajad. Majade taga üksikuid kuuski. Taevas pilves.
works.de: In the foreground of a fishing shore a hurrying man, trousers rolled up to the knees, a fish basket on his shoulder, beside him on the left a woman. In the middle section shore folk busy with various activities. In the right part, further back, two boats with hoisted sails can be seen, to their right on the shore net-houses. Behind the houses a few solitary spruces. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Esialal vasakul puust kahejärguline paadisild, mille alumisel järgul mehed silla ääres seisvaist paatidest üleantavaid täis kalakaste virna ladumas. Sama silla kõrgema järgu kaitsepuudel kuivamas võrkusid. Kergemal lameda katusega sadama teenistushoone. Esialal paremal virvendav veepind, kaugemal rida ankrus seisvaid, allalastud purjedega purjekaid - kuunareid. Tagaplaanil, pilvistatud taeva taustal Tallinna siluett, Oleviste torniga keskosas ja mitme suitseva tehase korstnaga vasakul.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a two-tiered wooden pier bridge, on the lower tier of which men are stacking piles of fish crates being handed over from boats standing by the bridge. On the railings of the higher tier of the same bridge, nets are drying. Lighter, a flat-roofed harbour service building. In the foreground on the right, a rippling water surface, further away a row of schooners at anchor with sails lowered. In the background, against a clouded sky, the silhouette of Tallinn, with the tower of Oleviste [St. Olaf's Church] in the middle section and several smoking factory chimneys on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil veepinnal paadisilla juures paremal sinakashall mootorpaat, selle taga näha kaks vestlevat meest. Silla peal keset maali kolmest mehest koosnev inimgrupp, nende taga paremal paadi sees üksik mees. Vasakul kaldal heleda vooderdusega maja ots ja kõrged lehtpuud. Taamal sild ja sellest paremal kolmemastiline purjekas.
works.de: In the foreground on the water's surface by the boat pier on the right a bluish-grey motorboat, behind it two conversing men can be seen. On the pier in the middle of the painting a group of three men, behind them on the right a lone man in a boat. On the left bank the gable end of a house with light-coloured cladding and tall deciduous trees. In the distance a bridge and to the right of it a three-masted sailboat.

works.d: Ees rannariba veeloikudega. Keskplaanil sile merepind paari valendava purjekaga.
works.de: In front a strip of shore with puddles of water. In the middle ground a smooth sea surface with a couple of pale sailing boats.

works.d: Paremal rand lambakarjaga, vasakul meri.
works.de: On the right a beach with a flock of sheep, on the left the sea.

works.d: Lainetav merepind, esiplaanil vasakul neljamehega kaluripaat, paremal tagapool kaks eemalduvat paati. Kaugemal silmapiiril uduselt näha kaks kahe mastiga laeva. Taeval pilved.
works.de: A wavy sea surface, in the foreground on the left a fishing boat with four men, on the right further back two boats moving away. In the distance on the horizon, hazily visible, two two-masted ships. Clouds in the sky.

works.d: Meri kuuvalgel ööl. Esiplaanil keskel 2 paati sõudjatega, silmapiiril udu. Taevas kergelt pilves.
works.de: Sea on a moonlit night. In the foreground in the middle 2 boats with rowers, mist on the horizon. The sky is slightly cloudy.

works.d: lõuendi kaitseks papp alusraami külge löödud Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel
works.de: cardboard nailed to the stretcher to protect the canvas. Location on object: on the verso

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel naised sirpidega rukist lõikamas, vihku sidumas, hakki kandmas. Vasakul nurgas lapsed rukkivihkudel istumas. Kaugemal hakirida, põlluääres vanad õlgkatusega talumajad. Taevas tume.
works.de: In the foreground, women cutting rye with sickles, tying sheaves, carrying stooks. In the left corner, children sitting on rye sheaves. Further away a row of stooks, old thatched-roof farmhouses at the edge of the field. Dark sky.

works.d: Lainetav merepind, keskel suur traallaev, paremal uduses kauguses veel kaks traallaeva.
works.de: Rippling sea surface, a large trawler in the middle, two more trawlers in the hazy distance on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil otse vaataja suunas voolav kivine oja. Kahelpool kõrged kaldad ja raagus puud.
works.de: In the foreground a stony brook flowing straight towards the viewer. On both sides high banks and bare trees.

works.d: Kivine rand üksikute hoonetega ja keskel asuva suure männiga. Paremal paadid, vasakul metsatukk.
works.de: A rocky shore with a few buildings and a large pine tree in the middle. Boats on the right, a small forest on the left.

works.d: Avar vaade Lõuna-Eesti vooremaastikule: nõlvakud tumedate metsatukkadega, heledad põllud nende vahel, vasakul looklev tee. Taevas rahutuis rünkpilveis.
works.de: Broad view of a South Estonian drumlin landscape: slopes with dark clumps of forest, light fields between them, on the left a winding road. Sky with restless cumulus clouds.

works.d: Vasakul uduvines meri, paremal kivine rand: esiplaanil võrku parandav naine ja neli last, kaks figuuri jalgupidi vees; tagapool paadid, kalurimajad ja kalakuurid. Maalitud kahvatutes toonides, hallikas üldgammas.
works.de: On the left a misty sea, on the right a rocky shore: in the foreground a woman mending a net and four children, two figures with their feet in the water; further back boats, fishermen's houses and fish sheds. Painted in pale tones, a greyish overall colour scheme.

works.d: Kärestikulisel jõel 7 meest pootshaakidega palgiparvel. Taga kallas metsaribaga. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: On a rapid river, 7 men with pike poles on a log raft. Behind, a bank with a strip of forest. Sky cloudy.

works.d: Avar, panoraamne sügismaastik Lõuna-Eestist. Esiplaanil põllud, üksikud kased ja männid. Taga keskel järv, puude ja majade grupp. Taamal sinetavad mäenupud.
works.de: A broad, panoramic autumn landscape from South Estonia. In the foreground fields, single birches and pines. Behind in the middle a lake, a group of trees and houses. In the distance bluish hilltops.

works.d: Panoraamne maastik järvega, milles metsaga kaetud saared ja poolsaared.
works.de: Panoramic landscape with a lake containing forested islands and peninsulas.

works.d: Liivasel rannal askeldavad inimesed kalakasti juures, paremal helehalli mere kaldal naised ja mehed paatide ümber, neist vasemal neli figuuri mingi töövahendiga, tagapool inimesi kalakuuride juures, vasemale jääb hobune vankriga. Koloriit hele: hallikas, ookerjas, üksikuid punakaid ja sinakaid aktsente, esiplaanil rohekaid rohututte.
works.de: On a sandy beach people are busy by a fish crate, on the right on the shore of a light-grey sea women and men around boats, to their left four figures with some tool, further back people by fish sheds, to the left a horse with a cart. Light colour scheme: grayish, ochreish, occasional reddish and bluish accents, greenish tufts of grass in the foreground.

works.d: Vaade Kloostrimetsast Piritale. Lumine, kohati paljas maastik raagus puude ja halli lookleva jõega. Taamal paistavad mõned punaste katustega majad ning Pirita kloostri varemed.
works.de: View of Pirita from Kloostrimets. Snowy, in places bare landscape with bare trees and a grey winding river. In the distance a few houses with red roofs and the ruins of Pirita Convent can be seen.

works.d: Rohus ees vasakul tigu karbil istuva lapsega; tema taga lillas kleidis, kurekellukese õiega peas vasakule sammuv tütarlaps. Tagapool vana puutüve lähedal õõnsuses istub öökull, liblika taha rakendatud vankris heledapäine tütarlaps. "Sõiduki" ees päkapikk laternaga. Taevas täiskuu.
Suure puu all, künkal, heledapäine nuttev tütarlaps. Ta ees lillas kleidis, kurekella õiega peas, teda lohutav tütarlaps. Kaugemal voored. All vasakul asula. Paremal voore taha vajuv kuu.
Merelaht, mille ees väikeste põõsastega rand.
works.de: Sea bay with a shore lined with small bushes in front.

works.d: Esiplaanilt keskelt pildi sügavusse suunduv kõrgete puudega ääristatud tee, kus jalutab mees koeraga.
works.de: A path lined with tall trees leading from the middle foreground into the depth of the picture, where a man is walking with a dog.

works.d: Vaade kõrgetest mägedest piiratud järvele. Esiplaanil vasakul kaldariba puudega.
works.de: View of a lake enclosed by high mountains. In the foreground on the left a strip of shore with trees.

works.d: Ristilöödu figuur T-kujulisel ristil, millel ülal keskel näha ebamäärane valge laik - nimetahvel. Teostus impressionistlikus laadis. Taust sinirohelistes toonides, risti ümbruses helerohekaks muutuvalt.
works.de: The figure of the Crucified on a T-shaped cross, at the top centre of which an indistinct white patch is visible - the title plate. Executed in an impressionistic manner. The background in blue-green tones, turning light greenish around the cross.

works.d: Lail aknalaual arvukal hulgal mitmesuguse kujuga värvilisi klaasnõusid lilledega, toataimi. Vasakul kolm kõrgemat vaasi ja kauss nupuliste kaunistustega, täis õielilli ja väikeselehelisi oksi. Keskel ja paremal pudelid, väiksemad vaasid, okkalised toalilled, silindriline sinine vaas kahe närbunud roosiga. Taustal aknal roosakad, sinised peegeldused. Maal rohekassinises koloriidis.
works.de: On a wide windowsill, a large number of variously shaped coloured glass vessels with flowers, potted plants. On the left three taller vases and a bowl with knobbed decorations, full of flowering plants and small-leaved branches. In the middle and on the right, bottles, smaller vases, spiky houseplants, a cylindrical blue vase with two wilted roses. In the background, on the window, pinkish, blue reflections. The painting in a greenish-blue colour scheme.

works.d: Heleda taeva taustal eesti rahvariietes naised tervitavad sõjamehi. Vasakul viiest inimesest grupp: Kolm Harjumaa rõivastes (sinisetriibuline seelik, pitsidega pluus, rahad rinnas) noorikut pöörduvad nende ees paremal seisvate sineleis, kiivrites sõdurite poole. Vasakpoolne mees selg-, parem külgvaates. Lõuendil paremal kaks vestlevat sõjameest: Eespool vasakul õlgkübaras, püss seljas mees selgvaates, tema vastas paremal sinelis-kiivris sõdur otsevaates. Taamal keskel ja paremal rahvariietes figuurid. Maal heledais hallikates, pruunides toonides.
works.de: Against a light sky, women in Estonian folk costume greet soldiers. On the left a group of five people: three young women in Harjumaa costume (blue-striped skirt, lace blouse, coins on the chest) turn towards soldiers standing in front of them on the right, wearing greatcoats and helmets. The left-hand man is seen from behind, the right one in side view. On the right of the canvas two soldiers conversing: in front on the left a man in a straw hat with a rifle on his back, seen from behind, opposite him on the right a soldier in greatcoat and helmet seen frontally. In the background, in the centre and on the right, figures in folk costume. The painting is in light greyish, brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul istuv tütarlaps rahvarõivais: seljas valge tikitud varrukate ja pitsist kraeservaga pluus, punane vest, valge seelik laiade horisontaalsete triipudega, pluusi kaeluses sõlg. Tütarlapsel kuldpruunid, pealael soengusse kammitud juuksed, käed rüpes. Tema kõrval paremal seisab tumedas mulgi kuues tumedapäine vurrudega noormees. Foon põhiliselt rohekashall, servadest kirju.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a seated girl in folk costume: wearing a white blouse with embroidered sleeves and a lace-edged collar, a red vest, a white skirt with wide horizontal stripes, a brooch at the blouse's neckline. The girl has golden-brown hair combed into a hairstyle on top of her head, her hands in her lap. Next to her, on the right, stands a dark-haired, moustached young man in a dark Mulgi costume. The background is mainly greenish-grey, patterned at the edges.

works.d: Ettepoole tormav mees, paremas tõstetud käes mõõk, teine käsi kuklal. Maalitud hoogsalt, visandlikult. Sinakaspruun figuur roosakal foonil.
works.de: A man rushing forward, a sword raised in his right hand, the other hand on the back of his head. Painted vigorously, in a sketchy manner. A bluish-brown figure on a pinkish background.

works.d: Suur figuraalne kompositsioon tähtsamate eesti vanema ja noorema põlvkonna kunstnike portreedega. Vasakpoolsel tiival all paremal E. Okka autoportree. Teiste kunstnike portreed vahelduvad mitmesuguste reaaliatega. Vasakul tiival all koer ning maalimistarbed, tort, ülaservas ehituskonstruktsioonid. Keskosas all roosas õhulises kleidis ja punase parukaga mannekeen, klaasmull ning aktifiguur ülal. Paremal tiival all avatud raamat pildil kujutautud kunstnike numbrite ja nimedega, sulg, öökull. Parempoolse tiiva ülaservas treppide ja sammastega ehitused ning tormav hobune. Portreede vahel taimi, lilli ja kõrsi.
works.de: A large figural composition with portraits of the most important Estonian artists of the older and younger generations. On the left wing, lower right, a self-portrait of E. Okas. The portraits of other artists alternate with various realia. On the left wing below, a dog and painting implements, a cake, and building structures at the upper edge. In the middle section below, a mannequin in a pink airy dress with a red wig, a glass bubble, and a nude figure above. On the right wing below, an open book with the numbers and names of the artists depicted in the picture, a quill, an owl. At the upper edge of the right wing, buildings with stairs and columns and a galloping horse. Between the portraits, plants, flowers and stalks.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon lippudega marssivast rahvahulgast. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks pearätikutes naist, paremal vanem lippu kandev meestööline. Külmades rohelistes, sinistes ja punastes toonides.
works.de: Figural composition of a crowd marching with flags. In the foreground on the left two women in headscarves, on the right an older male worker carrying a flag. In cold green, blue and red tones.

works.d: Pruunis läkiläkis ja kuues, rohelise särgiga noore mehe rinnaportree. Pea pisut paremale kallutatud, pilk suunatud otse vaatajale. Foon maalimata.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young man in a brown coat and jacket, with a green shirt. Head tilted slightly to the right, gaze directed straight at the viewer. Background unpainted.

works.d: Peente, kuid teravate näojoontega noore naise pea ja keha poolpöördes paremale, tumedate silmade pilk aga suunatud vasakule. Naisel pikad tumedad juuksed, sinakasroheliste kividega kõrvarõngad ja sinakashall kleit. Foon erinevates sinistes toonides, kohati maalitud pikkade hoogsate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: The head and body of a young woman with fine but sharp facial features, in a half-turn to the right, while the gaze of her dark eyes is directed to the left. The woman has long dark hair, earrings with bluish-green stones, and a bluish-grey dress. The background in various shades of blue, painted in places with long, vigorous brushstrokes.

works.d: Lillakaspunasel foonil profiilis antud neegritari poolfiguur. Juustes ja kaelas rohkesti ehteid. Paremal servas laual karahvin veega, klaas ja kaks suurt oranži vilja.
works.de: On a purplish-red background, in profile, the half-figure of a black woman. Many ornaments in her hair and around her neck. On the right edge, on a table, a carafe with water, a glass and two large orange fruits.

works.d: Taevasinisel foonil esiplaanil keskel pikki tumedaid juukseid palmitsev poolakt. Paremal servas mustas frakis ja kaabus mehefiguur profiilis, pea ja pilk naise poole pööratud. Allservas vabade värviliste pintslitõmmete vöönd.
works.de: Against a sky-blue background in the centre foreground a half-nude figure braiding long dark hair. On the right edge a male figure in a black tailcoat and top hat, in profile, head and gaze turned toward the woman. Along the lower edge a band of free coloured brushstrokes.

works.d: Kunstniku kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates: juuksed laubalt taandunud, terane pilk läbi prilliklaaside, kulm kortsus. Seljas sinine särk ja töökittel, vasakus, küünarnukist kõverdatud, käes pintsel. Pildi allservas ateljeelaud värvituubide ja pudelitega. Vasakus servas profiilis, pildi servaga läbilõigatud aktifiguur. Foon sinine, ülanurkades tumenev. Pildi pind on tihedasti värviliste pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud. Kohati on värvikiht pastoosne.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of the artist, frontal view: hair receded from the forehead, a sharp gaze through spectacle lenses, brow furrowed. Wearing a blue shirt and a work smock, holding a brush in his left hand, bent at the elbow. At the bottom of the picture, a studio table with paint tubes and bottles. On the left edge, a nude figure in profile, cut off by the edge of the picture. The background is blue, darkening in the upper corners. The surface of the picture is densely covered with colourful brushstrokes. In places the paint layer is impasto.

works.d: Räigete punaste, siniste ja roheliste veiklevate värvilaikude foonil keskel on punaste juustega, kübaras, poolpalja rinnaga daam üles tõstnud oma valge õhulise kleidi seelikuosa. Vasakul alumises nurgas punaste juustega ja terava lõuaga naise pea kerges pöördes paremale.
works.de: Against a background of glaring flickering patches of red, blue and green, in the centre a red-haired lady in a hat, with a half-bare bosom, has lifted the skirt part of her white airy dress. In the lower left corner, the head of a red-haired woman with a sharp chin, turned slightly to the right.

works.d: I. Vasakpoolsel osal tihedalt kirgastes toonides läbimaalitud naisfiguurid. Vasakul esiplaanil dekolteeritud õhulises punases kleidis naine kõrvarõngastega. Temast kõrgemal lilledega kaunistatud valges ja mustas kübaras daamid.
works.de: I. On the left-hand part, female figures densely painted through in bright tones. On the left in the foreground a woman in an airy red dress with a décolleté, wearing earrings. Above her, ladies in white and black hats decorated with flowers.

works.dm: lehe laius: 21.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.6 cm
works.d: Hoogsalt, skitseerivas laadis maalitud noormehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Mehel tumedad veidi turris juuksed, vuntsid nina all, tumedad kulmud, pilk tõsine. Seljas sinine jopp. Paberibind osaliselt katmata.
works.de: A vigorously, sketchily painted bust portrait of a young man in full front view. The man has dark, somewhat tousled hair, a moustache under his nose, dark eyebrows, a serious gaze. Wearing a blue jacket. The paper mount partly uncovered.

works.d: Pimedas talutoas, kuue väikese ruuduga akna all vasakul punase rätiga ketrav naine voki taga külgvaates. Paremal, akna all pingil istuv vana mees, pea maas, käed süles. Aknast tulev valgus loob põrandale helehalli laigu. Maal pruunis-hallis koloriidis.
works.de: In a dark peasant room, under a six-paned window on the left, a woman with a red kerchief spinning at a spinning wheel in side view. On the right, an old man sitting on a bench under the window, head down, hands in his lap. Light coming from the window creates a light-grey patch on the floor. The painting is in a brown-grey colouring.

works.d: Natuuritruu pruunikais-hallikais toonides heleda tausta ning tumeda alusega vaikelu. Pildi keskele on kolmnurkse kompositsiooniga asetatud nõud. Vasakul suurem pruun kauss, veidi tagapool tume anum, millele asetatud madalam kollakas-pruunikais toonides savist kauss puulusikaga. Paremale poole jääb väike plekk-kruus.
works.de: A naturalistically true still life in brownish-grey tones with a light background and a dark base. Vessels are arranged in a triangular composition in the middle of the picture. On the left a larger brown bowl, slightly behind it a dark vessel on which a lower clay bowl in yellowish-brownish tones with a wooden spoon is placed. To the right there is a small tin cup.

works.d: Ülaosas vasakul osa taluhoonest, avatud väravad. Tumedas ukseavas paistmas esemeid. Paremal ukse peal ripub vikat, vasakul ukse küljes riideesemeid. Ukse ees murul istub punases rätis laps. Seina ääres vasakul osa alumist maalipinda katmata. Hallikad, rohelised summutatud toonid.
works.de: In the upper part on the left, part of a farm building, an open gate. Objects visible in the dark doorway. On the right a scythe hangs above the door, on the left items of clothing hang by the door. In front of the door a child in a red kerchief sits on the grass. Along the wall on the left part of the lower painting surface is left uncovered. Greyish, green muted tones.

works.d: Metsamaastiku eelplaanil rohul magav naine põllel istuva lapsega, vasakult kaks lähenevat ingel-last, teisel lillepärjake käes, taga paremal rohelise metsa all veisekari.
works.de: In the foreground of a forest landscape, a woman sleeping on the grass in a field with a child sitting nearby, from the left two approaching angel-children, one holding a little wreath of flowers, behind on the right a herd of cattle under a green forest.

works.d: Ateljeenurga vaade ülalt nähtuna: pruunil poodiumil kipstorso selgvaates vaarikapunase draperii taustal. Eespool kollase linaga kaetud taburetil punaseõieline potilill. Vasakul ülal paistmas helesinise raamiga pildinurk, paremal all osa alusest maalivahenditega. Esemeid jälgiv laad, erksad puhtad toonid.
works.de: A view of a studio corner seen from above: on a brown pedestal a plaster torso in profile against a raspberry-red drapery background. In front, on a stool covered with a yellow cloth, a potted flower with red blossoms. Upper left, a corner of a picture with a light blue frame is visible, lower right part of a stand with painting materials. A style attentive to objects, vivid pure tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha vasakule suunduva tänava ääres aiad. Paremal aedades maju üksikuid põõsaid ja puid. Taamal suitsev vabriku korsten. Taustaks suitsune taevas.
works.de: In the foreground gardens along a street running from front to back towards the left. On the right houses in gardens, scattered bushes and trees. In the distance a smoking factory chimney. Background of smoky sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul varemed, paremal rusuhunnik. Taga purustatud Niguliste kiriku varemed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left ruins, on the right a heap of rubble. Behind, the ruins of the destroyed Niguliste Church.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur; pea profiilis vasakule; muistse sõjamehe rõivastuses. Paremas käes piik. Taga kaks sõjameest.
works.de: Half-figure of a man; head in profile to the left; dressed as an ancient warrior. In his right hand a pike. Behind him two warriors.

works.d: Ees keskel kolme laiba vahel selgvaates valges Liivi ordu riides mees odaga. Vasakul kaks ordutüütli figuuri. Paremal ordurüütlid hobustel. Taga keskel grupp inimesi.
works.de: In the front centre, among three corpses, a man in white Livonian Order attire with a spear, seen clearly. On the left two figures of Order sergeants. On the right Order knights on horses. Behind, in the middle, a group of people.

works.d: Ees kaks meest kivi kangutamas. Nende taga mehi kandmas kive ja palke. Taustaks linnamajad.
works.de: In front, two men prying up a stone. Behind them, men carrying stones and logs. City houses in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks raagus puud, latt-tara, hoonete lumised katused. Härmanud.
works.de: In the foreground two bare trees, a lath fence, snowy roofs of buildings. Frosted.

works.d: Esiplaanil naine lapsega kõndimas piki puutaraga äärestatud tänavat. Tara taga viis raagus puud, lumine lagendik ja majade siluetid. Koloriit beežikas hall.
works.de: In the foreground a woman with a child walking along a street lined with a wooden fence. Behind the fence five bare trees, a snowy open area and silhouettes of houses. Colouring beige-grey.

works.d: Noore naise rindportree kerges pöördes paremale. Tumedad sirged õlgadele langevad juuksed. Punaseruuduline jakk, valge krae.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a slight turn to the right. Dark straight hair falling to the shoulders. Red-checked jacket, white collar.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Juuksed mustad, silmad mustjaspruunid, ilmekad. Ülikond külmas pruunis toonis, särk roosaka varjundiga, lips rohelise-valge triibuline. Fooniks terashall, voltides pruunikat tooni draperii.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, frontal view. Black hair, dark brownish-black expressive eyes. Suit in cold brown tone, shirt with a pinkish shade, tie striped green and white. Background steel-grey, drapery in brownish tone in folds.

works.d: Vaade kõrgemalt järveäärsele maastikule: ees majade katused, vasakule jääb helendav järv, tagapool nõlvakud metsaviirgudega. Sumedad toonid.
works.de: View from above onto a lakeside landscape: in front the roofs of houses, to the left a glimmering lake, behind slopes with strips of forest. Soft tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil üle kogu pildi pinna roheka mere taustal suur mitmeharuline puutüvi.
works.de: In the foreground, across the entire surface of the picture, against a background of a greenish sea, a large multi-branched tree trunk.

works.d: Kõhuli lamav noore alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur külgvaates. Kõverdatud käte all kõrgem padi, pea puhkab kätel, nägu pööratud vaatajale. Foonil rikkaliku voldistikuga türkiissinistes, roosades pastelsetes toonides draperii. Keha maalitud helebeežides toonides, vorme pehmelt modelleerides, piirjooni hajutavalt.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a young naked woman lying on her stomach, seen from the side. A higher pillow lies beneath her bent arms, her head rests on her hands, her face turned toward the viewer. In the background a richly draped fabric in turquoise-blue, pink pastel tones. The body is painted in light beige tones, its forms softly modelled, with diffused contours.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur 3/4 profiilis pöördega paremale, mundris, epolettidega.
works.de: Half-figure of a man with sideburns in 3/4 profile turned to the right, in uniform, with epaulettes.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur, pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Põskhabe, juuksed püstihoidvana. Mundris, ordenipaela ja ordenitega. Käed kehast eemal.
works.de: Half-figure of a man, head in half-profile to the left. Side whiskers, hair standing upright. In uniform, with an order ribbon and orders. Hands held away from the body.

works.d: Mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis paremale, paremas käes valged kindad, kõrgeis säärikuis, taustaks maastik veekogu ja lossiga.
works.de: Full figure of a man, in half-profile facing right, white gloves in his right hand, in tall boots, with a landscape with a body of water and a castle as background.

works.d: Poolfiguur, peaaegu enface, pea kallutatud vasakule, mustas kleidis, valge rüüškrae ja pika uuriketi ja uuriga, taustaks vasakul veidi akent ja potililli.
works.de: Half-figure, almost en face, head tilted to the left, in a black dress, white ruffled collar and a long watch chain with a watch, background with a bit of window and potted flowers on the left.

works.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis, käed süles. Pea en face, pisut kallutatud. Seljas valge kleit rüüžkaelusega ja tume jakk. Õlgadel pikk taskukellakett.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl in a seated position, hands in her lap. Head en face, slightly tilted. Wearing a white dress with a ruffled collar and a dark jacket. A long pocket-watch chain on her shoulders.

works.t: Simuna kiriku altarimaali kavand. Kristus templis
works.d: Kompositsioon piibli ainetel. Ees keskel võlvistikus preester lapsukesega kätel. Paremal sinises rüüs naine (Maria) vasakul mees (Joosep) ja põlvitav vanaeit kepp käes.
works.de: Composition on biblical themes. In the front centre, under a vault, a priest with a small child in his arms. On the right a woman in a blue robe (Mary), on the left a man (Joseph), and a kneeling old woman with a stick in her hand.

works.d: Hallipäise, ebasümmeetrilise näoga mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Pea kallutatud kergelt ette, paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man with an asymmetrical face, almost en face. Head tilted slightly forward, to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm kajakat. Taamal bulvar raagus puudega ja majade rida.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, three gulls. In the distance, a boulevard with bare trees and a row of houses.

works.d: Öises maastikus, ees paremal veekogu paadiga ja kahe sõudjaga. Vasakul kaldavõsa. Tagapool, keskel, kuust valgustatud loss.
works.de: In a night landscape, in front on the right a body of water with a boat and two rowers. On the left shoreline brush. Further back, in the centre, a castle lit by the moon.

works.d: Vaade maastikule ülalt alla: ees lehtpuu-metsa ladvad; üle nende tõuseb vasakul kaks kirik-ehitist kõrgete tornidega. Pilvistatud taevas ehapunas.
works.de: View of a landscape from above downward: in front the tops of a deciduous forest; above them rise on the left two church buildings with tall towers. Clouded sky in sunset red.

works.d: Noorepoolse mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, mustade pikkade juuste ja valge kraega.
works.de: A bust portrait of a youngish man in half-profile to the left, with black long hair and a white collar.

works.d: Ees vasakul madal kallas, millelt paremal silmupüüdmise aed. Vastaskaldal vasakul kindlus, paremal lehtpuude taustal maju.
works.de: In the front on the left a low bank, from which on the right an eel-trap fence extends. On the opposite bank on the left a fortress, on the right houses against a background of deciduous trees.

works.d: Ees paremal õu kuivava pesuga ja ühekordse puuhoonega selle taga; vasakul suur raagus puu ja selle kõrval tünnid.
works.de: In front on the right a yard with laundry drying and a single-story wooden building behind it; on the left a large bare tree and barrels beside it.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal üksikud suured puud ja põõsad. Vasakult nõlvakult vaade alla jõele. Vastaskaldal lage maastik, horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, solitary large trees and bushes. From the slope on the left a view down to the river. On the opposite bank open landscape, forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremas nurgas veekogu. Taamal lumine kallas üksikute suurte puudega.
works.de: In the foreground in the right corner a body of water. In the distance a snowy shore with solitary large trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul raudaiaga piiritletud kivikõnnitee. Paremal vesi. Jõe vastaskaldal üksikuid hooneid ja puid. Taamal väljad.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a stone pavement bounded by an iron fence. On the right water. On the opposite bank of the river individual buildings and trees. In the distance fields.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, paremal kaldal olevate suurte puude ja põõsaste tugeva vastupeegeldusega.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, on the right bank large trees and bushes with strong reflection.

works.d: Paremal tänava äärse plangu taga lehtpuid. Vasakul tänava nurgal kõrge kivimüür. Tagapool madal kivihoone.
works.de: On the right deciduous trees behind a fence along the street. On the left a high stone wall at the street corner. Behind it a low stone building.

works.d: Paremal nurgas väike veekogu. Üle välja looklemas tee. Tagapool kaks üksikut kuuske. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the right corner a small body of water. A road winding across the field. Behind, two solitary spruces. On the horizon a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil rühm lumistunud noori kuuski. Taustaks sinendav mets.
works.de: In the foreground a group of snow-covered young spruces. Bluish forest as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivaluide, tagapool muru äärestav põõsastik. Taustaks hall-sinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, sand dunes, behind them bushes bordering grass. In the background, a grey-blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu paatidega, taga kõrgenev rand.
works.de: Body of water with boats in the foreground, rising shore behind.

works.d: Vasakul rohtunud kallas põõsastega. Paremal veekogu. Vastaskaldal hooneid.
works.de: On the left a grassy bank with bushes. On the right a body of water. Buildings on the opposite bank.

works.d: Paremal veekogu, vasakul ja taga madal rand liivaluidete ja madalate põõsastega.
works.de: On the right a body of water, on the left and in the background a low shore with sand dunes and low bushes.

works.d: Vasakul meri. Paremal kergelt rohtunud kallas.
works.de: On the left, the sea. On the right, a slightly overgrown shore.

works.d: Suvises maastikus ees vasakul grupp kuuski. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In a summer landscape, in front on the left a group of spruces. A forest on the horizon.

works.d: Vasakult paremale suunduv tänav. Ees vasakul kivimüür. Tagapool kahekordne kivihoone.
works.de: A street running from left to right. In the foreground on the left, a stone wall. Behind it, a two-storey stone building.

works.d: Rohekal veel kaks lotja. Vaskapoolsem väiksem, parempoolsem suurem.
works.de: On the greenish water two more barges. The one on the copper side smaller, the one on the right larger.

works.d: Kaheksa grupis seisva poisi ja tütarlapse poolfiguuri; parempoolsel naeratava näoga poisil käes helepruun õun. Värv pastoosne, eriti maali allosas.
works.de: Half-figures of eight boys and girls standing in a group; the boy on the right, with a smiling face, holds a light brown apple. The paint is pasty, especially in the lower part of the painting.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, keha täisprofiilis paremale. Taust kollane.
works.de: A middle-aged woman's bust in three-quarter profile facing right, the body in full profile facing right. Background yellow.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv kääruline jõgi moodustab võsastunud heinamaal "s" tähe kuju. Ees vasakul väike heinaküün. Keskel talumaja. Taga lehtpuumets.
works.de: A winding river running from the front left to the back right forms the shape of the letter "s" in an overgrown meadow. In the front left, a small hay barn. In the middle, a farmhouse. Behind, a deciduous forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil (peaaegu pool maalipinnast) rohekates toonides jõgi (Narva), millel kolm sõudepaati, ilmselt sõjameestega (ajaloost). Keskel horisontaalselt heledatooniline kindlus, mille jalal rohelist. Taevas ühtlaselt lilla.
works.de: In the foreground (almost half of the painting's surface) a river (Narva) in greenish tones, on which three rowing boats, apparently with soldiers (from history). In the middle, horizontally, a light-toned fortress, with green at its base. The sky uniformly purple.

works.d: Seisev naisefiguur, keha pööratud paremale, peapööre vasemale. Juustes helepunane pael, seljas pikk, kehaligi liibuv, vööga seotud kleit. Foon figuuri taga sinine, osa tuhmunud.
works.de: Standing female figure, body turned to the right, head turned to the left. Light red ribbon in the hair, wearing a long, body-hugging dress tied with a belt. Background behind the figure blue, partly faded.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kahel pool, sini-rohelised kõrged puud, paremal, puude all viilkatusega hoone otsavaade. Taevas kollane, ülal siniste pilve-laikudega.
works.de: In the foreground, on both sides, tall blue-green trees, on the right, under the trees, the gable end view of a building with a pitched roof. Sky yellow, with blue cloud patches above.

works.d: Ees keskel ja paremal algab rohekates toonides neem, mis lõpeb käänuga vasakule. Ees keskel ja vasakul üksikud sinakad kivid. Taamal, neeme tipu lähedal keskel suur kollakas kogu (kivi?). Silmapiiril veekogus erk-sinine viirg. Taevas kollakas-rohekas.
works.de: In the front middle and right, a greenish-toned headland begins, ending with a bend to the left. In the front middle and left, isolated bluish stones. Further back, near the tip of the headland in the middle, a large yellowish mass (a stone?). On the horizon in the body of water, a bright blue streak. The sky is yellowish-green.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rannariba; keskel ja paremal vesi. Vastas järsk ja kaljune kallas. Kõrgemail tippudel lumelaike.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky strip of shore; in the centre and on the right water. Opposite a steep and rocky bank. Patches of snow on the higher peaks.

works.d: Vaade merele. Ees keskel ja taga suured kivid. Kaugemal lainetel vahused harjad.
works.de: View of the sea. In the foreground centre and background large rocks. In the distance, foamy crests on the waves.

works.d: Esiplaanil kännustik suurte üksikute kuuskedega. Kaugemal saetud puud. Vasakult paremale (diagonaalselt) kulgev tee. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing with tree stumps and large solitary spruces. Further away sawn trees. A road running diagonally from left to right. In the distance a forest.

works.dm: lehe laius: 28.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.6 cm
works.d: Vasakul, paremast nurgast taha vasakule suunduv kivine rannaviirg, paremal lainetav meri. 1/3 tööst taeva all.
works.de: On the left, a rocky coastline running from the right corner into the background to the left, on the right a rippling sea. 1/3 of the work is sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja, ümbritsetud raagus põõsastest. Keskplaanil põllu keskel lumi. Tagaplaanil lagedad põllud, suletud metsaga horisondil.
works.de: In the foreground a stream, surrounded by bare bushes. In the middle ground snow in the middle of a field. In the background open fields, closed off by forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil algav ja taha vasakul suunduv mäeseljandik. Seljandiku külgedel puid ja põõsastikke. Paremal puude vahelt paistmas veekogu.
works.de: A mountain ridge beginning in the foreground and receding to the left in the back. Trees and bushes on the sides of the ridge. On the right a body of water visible among the trees.

works.d: Ees keskel rohumaa piiratud vasakult suurte lehtpuude grupiga. Tagapool paremal rida mesipuid ja õlgkatusega talumaja nurk paistmas puude tagant.
works.de: In the front centre a meadow bordered on the left by a group of large deciduous trees. Behind on the right a row of beehives and the corner of a straw-roofed farmhouse visible behind the trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa, oja ja üle selle suunuva purdega. Keskel vasakul lehtpuid ja küün. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a meadow, a brook with a footbridge crossing it. In the centre-left deciduous trees and a barn. In the background a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm kaske, paremal kaks laiakroonilist vana lehtpuud, nende taga põõsastik. Puutüvede ja kroonide vahelt vaade veekogule (keskel ja paremal); vasakul kitsas, vette tungiv maariba. Taamal metsad.
works.de: In the foreground on the left three birches, on the right two broad-crowned old deciduous trees, behind them shrubbery. Between the tree trunks and crowns a view of a body of water (in the middle and on the right); on the left a narrow strip of land reaching into the water. In the distance forests.

works.d: Paremal ja vasakul ääres heinasoo serv, vasakpoolses ääres tihedasti teineteise kõrval naise ja mehe figuurid. Taamal loomad.
works.de: On the right and left edge the border of a hay marsh, in the left edge closely side by side the figures of a woman and a man. In the background animals.

works.d: Keskel puude vahel niit heinasaatudega, esiplaanil puude vari; vasakul saatude taga õhtuses poolvalguses mets.
Esialal lausik heinamaa, millel rida heinasaade. Tagapool, lattaia taga, paremal lehtpuude salu, vasakul põllud, millede tagant paistab metsamassiiv. Taevas hallis pilves.
works.de: In the foreground flat hayfield with a row of haystacks. Further back, behind a picket fence, at right a grove of deciduous trees, at left fields, behind which a forest mass is visible. The sky is grey and cloudy.

works.d: Vasakul taluhooned, mille taga kõrge puu ja kaugemal mets. Esiplaanil tee, mis läheb otse pildi sügavusse. Teest paremal põõsad ja järv.
works.de: On the left, farm buildings behind which a tall tree and further away a forest. In the foreground a road going straight into the depth of the picture. To the right of the road bushes and a lake.

works.d: Esiplaanil õitsev aas, selle taga heledam riba. Taga vasakul ja ees paremal suured puud. Õhtune valgustus.
works.de: In the foreground a blooming meadow, behind it a lighter strip. Behind on the left and in front on the right large trees. Evening lighting.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja purdega. Tagapoolt paistab puude vahelt küün. Looduses õhtune hämarus, kerge uduvine, taevas horisondi kohal roosatab. Pruunikas üldtoon, õhuke värvkate.
works.de: In the foreground a stream with a footbridge. Behind, a barn is visible through the trees. Evening dusk in nature, a light haze, the sky glows pink above the horizon. Brownish overall tone, thin paint layer.

works.d: Paremal jõgi, vasakule tõuseb nõlvak viljapõlluga, keskplaanile jääb õlgkatusega talumaja ja kõrged puud.
works.de: On the right a river, on the left a slope rises with a grain field, in the middle ground a thatched-roof farmhouse and tall trees.

works.d: Vasakul kääruline oja, paremal kaks heinarõuku. Keskplaanil puude varjus pikk talumaja suitsva korstnaga.
works.de: On the left a winding brook, on the right two haystacks. In the middle ground a long farmhouse with a smoking chimney in the shade of trees.

works.d: Paremal külavahetee, mille ääres puuderida ja majad, vasemal ülaservaga läbilõigatud männid, tahapoole jääb viljapõld.
works.de: On the right a village road with a row of trees and houses along it, on the left pines cut off by the upper edge, behind lies a grain field.

works.d: Maastik jõega, mis suundub diagonaalselt vasakult alt paremale üles. Käänukohal paremal kaldal puudegrupp ning heledamas toonis põlluviirg.
works.de: Landscape with a river running diagonally from lower left to upper right. At the bend, on the right bank, a group of trees and a lighter-toned strip of field.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja, mille kaldail heinamaa ja kaugemal viljapõld. Keskel puude vahel maja, keskplaanil vasakul puudegrupp.
works.de: In the foreground a stream, with meadows on its banks and a grain field further away. In the middle, a house among trees, in the middle ground on the left a group of trees.

works.d: Suvine maastik: keskosas suur lehtpuu, tumeda varjuga, mille all paremal väike veekogu. Puust vasakule - rohumaa, paremale rohumaa väikese ojaga. Tagaplaanil vasakul väike küün üksiku kase kõrval.
Esiplaanil paremal osa rohtunud müürist, mille ääres kasvab lehtpuude salu. Vasakul kitsas tee, mis kaob puude vahele. Tagapool kõrged puud ning punase katusega maja. Silmapiiril paistab meri.
works.de: In the foreground on the right part of a grass-grown wall, along which grows a grove of deciduous trees. On the left a narrow path disappearing among the trees. Further back tall trees and a house with a red roof. The sea is visible on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul pildi ülaservani kolm kaske. Keskplaanil viljapõld, paremale jäävad heinasaod. Kaugemal vanad taluhooned puude vahel.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, three birches reaching to the upper edge of the picture. In the middle ground a grain field, haystacks to the right. Further away old farm buildings among trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasakule kalduv nõlvak, selle taga kahe taluhoone katused ja kooguga kaev. Tagaplaanil üksikud suured puud, vasemal metsaviirg. Sinises taevas üksikud pilved.
works.de: In the foreground a slope inclining from right to left, behind it the roofs of two farm buildings and a well with a sweep. In the background solitary large trees, on the left a row of forest. In the blue sky solitary clouds.

works.d: Puudega kaetud künklik maastik: vasakus servas männid, nende tagant laskub pildi esiplaanile tee, teispool teed küngas puudesaluga, paremal puude rühm.
works.de: Hilly landscape covered with trees: in the left edge pines, from behind which a road descends into the foreground of the picture, on the other side of the road a hill with a grove of trees, on the right a group of trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskelt algab tee, mis kitsenedes jõuab taluhoonete grupini. Kahelpool teed kivid. Paremal paralleelselt teega kulgev oja; mõlemal kaldal kasvavad üksikud kased.
