works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Pea kummardunud vasakus käes hoitava kirja kohale. Pead ja keha katab pruunis toonis rätt.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in profile to the left. Head bowed over a letter held in her left hand. Head and body covered by a brown-toned shawl.

works.d: Keskel valges rüüs Kristus hauaplaadil. Ümber ehmunud sõdurid - valvurid - kaks eespoolset on kummuli laskunud. Taga väänistega kattunud müüriosa, taevas, üleval serval koiduvalgus.
works.de: In the centre Christ in a white robe on the tombstone slab. Around him startled soldiers - guards - the two in front have sunk down prostrate. Behind, a section of wall covered with tendrils, the sky, at the upper edge the light of dawn.

works.d: Pilvise taeva, kauge maastiku taustal noore naise portree poolpöördes vasakule, pea veidi kallutatud, pööratud vaatajale. Roosapõskset näoovaali ümbritseb keskelt lahkukammitud poolpikk lokiline soeng. Naisel suured tumedad silmad, malbe ilme. Seljas avara dekoltee ja puhvvarrukatega valge kelit, kolm rida pärleid kaelas. Paremal õlal ja ümber keha rohekas sall ehisnõelaga kinnitatud.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman in half-turn to the left, against the background of a cloudy sky and a distant landscape, head slightly tilted, turned towards the viewer. The rosy-cheeked oval face is framed by a shoulder-length curly hairstyle parted in the middle. The woman has large dark eyes and a gentle expression. She is wearing a white gown with a wide décolletage and puffed sleeves, three rows of pearls around her neck. On the right shoulder and around the body a greenish scarf fastened with a decorative pin.

works.d: Suvesombune vaade pargiteede lahknemiskohta. Kummalgi pool teed roosaõielised puud rohelistes, nupuliste nurkadega kastides. Tagapool vasakul lilledega ääristatud muruplats, puud-põõsad. Silmapiiril nõlvakul lossi siluett. Paremal rohelised puukroonid. Maal pastelselt hele, läbi sinaka vine nähtud.
works.de: A summer, overcast view of a fork in park paths. On either side of the path, trees with pink blossoms in green boxes with knobbed corners. Further back on the left, a lawn bordered with flowers, trees and bushes. On the horizon on a slope, the silhouette of a castle. On the right, green tree crowns. The painting pastel-light, seen through a bluish haze.

works.d: Ees lage, üksikute raagus põõsastega lumine plats. Tagapool, vasakul, üksikud suured raagus puud, keskel kuusk. Puude taga teivasaiast piiratud hooned. Paremal vaade üle jäätunud veekogu taamal olevale asulale.
works.de: In front, an open snowy area with a few bare bushes. Further back, on the left, a few large bare trees, a spruce in the middle. Behind the trees, buildings enclosed by a pole fence. On the right, a view over a frozen body of water to a settlement in the distance.

works.d: Ees paremal, rohtunud teekese ääres kabel, vasakul kaks raagus puud. Tagapool kivimüür kahe lehtpuuga.
works.de: In front on the right, by a grassy path, a chapel, on the left two bare trees. Behind, a stone wall with two deciduous trees.

works.d: Ees keskel kirju kukk. Vasakul suurel rohelisel lehel kaks õuna. Paremal seened. Üsna laua äärel vuugid, lillakas savipott ja pudel. Taga keskel vaas paari lilleoksaga.
works.de: In the front centre a mottled rooster. On the left, on a large green leaf, two apples. On the right, mushrooms. Right at the edge of the table, joints, a purplish clay pot and a bottle. Behind, in the centre, a vase with a couple of flower branches.

works.d: Väikese 7-8 a. tütarlapse portree elusuuruses istuvas asendis. Foon tume. Tütarlapsel pruunid, lühikeseks lõigatud juuksed, seljas roosa kleit. Paljad pruunikad käsivarred ja jalasääred. Istub kirju riidega kaetud istmel, asetades ühe jala risti üle teise põlve. Üks käsi asetatud põlvele, teine istmele.
works.de: A life-size portrait of a small 7–8-year-old girl in a sitting position. Dark background. The girl has brown, short-cropped hair, wearing a pink dress. Bare brownish arms and lower legs. She sits on a seat covered with patterned fabric, placing one leg crossed over the other knee. One hand placed on the knee, the other on the seat.

works.d: Toolil istuva pikkades pükstes naise täisfiguur. Paremas käes samale õlale toetuv avatud päikesevari. Taustaks põõsastik.
works.de: Full figure of a woman in long trousers, seated on a chair. In her right hand an open parasol resting on the same shoulder. Background of shrubbery.

works.d: Interjöör esialal keskel viini tooliga, millel vaas lilledega; tooli ees põrandal turukorv aedviljaga, korvi kõrval seeni. Vasakul näha ümmarguse laua serv lilledega. Taga paremal ukseaval seisev naine.
works.de: Interior, in the foreground centre a Vienna chair with a vase of flowers on it; in front of the chair on the floor a market basket with vegetables, mushrooms beside the basket. On the left the edge of a round table with flowers is visible. Behind, on the right, a woman standing in a doorway.

works.d: Otsejoones tahapoole suunduv tänav kõrgete majadega mõlemal pool. Tänaval inimesi ja sõidukeid.
works.de: A street running straight into the distance with tall houses on both sides. People and vehicles on the street.

works.d: Akna ees laual asetsev vaas kirevate lilledega.
Akna ees laual tume vaas kollaste ja roosakate õitega, selle ees punaseruuduline rätik ja punutud korvike. Vasakul laeva nurgal klaaskann. Akna taga puud.
works.de: On a table in front of the window, a dark vase with yellow and pinkish flowers, in front of it a red-checked cloth and a small woven basket. On the left, at the corner of the table, a glass jug. Trees behind the window.

works.d: Ees keskel kahe seisva mehe täisfiguurid. Paremal toolile asetatud maal. Parempoolse mehe jalg toetatud toolile. Parema käega hoiab vaadatavat teost. Vasakpoolsel käed ristamisi rinnal.
works.de: In front in the center full figures of two standing men. On the right a painting placed on a chair. The right-hand man's leg is resting on the chair. With his right hand he holds the work being viewed. The left-hand man has his arms crossed on his chest.

works.d: Maastik õitsevate põõsastega, ees vasakul valguselaikudega tee naise ja lapsega, tagapool puid ja sinetavat vett, valgeis pilveis taevas.
works.de: Landscape with flowering bushes, in front on the left a path with patches of light with a woman and a child, behind it trees and bluish water, sky with white clouds.

works.d: Keskel jõgi, paremal taga uduvines linna panoraam suitsevate vabrikukorstnatega. Vasakul kaldale tõmmatud paadid ja vanad puud.
works.de: A river in the middle, in the back on the right a hazy panorama of a city with smoking factory chimneys. On the left, boats pulled onto the shore and old trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal raagus puud. Kesklaanil jõgi, sillaga vasakul jõesadam. Jõgi kohati jääga kaetud.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, bare trees. In the middle ground a river, with a bridge, on the left a river harbour. The river partly covered with ice.

works.d: Esiplaanil kahel pool raagus puud ja vasakul mäenõlv. Tagapool paistavad uduselt majade katused ja raekoja torn. Maapind ja katused kaetud lumega.
works.de: In the foreground on both sides bare trees and on the left a hillside. Behind, the roofs of houses and the town hall tower appear hazily. Ground and roofs covered with snow.

works.d: Esiplaanil säravas päikeses rohelised puud ja põõsad, tagapool puude keskel näha kahte viilkatusega maja.
works.de: In the foreground green trees and bushes in bright sunshine, further back among the trees two houses with gable roofs are visible.

works.d: Ülaservas ja paremal suured allapoole langevad puuoksad, mis sulavad ühte tihedalt lilli ja põõsaid täis kasvanud aia rohelusega. Keskel roosakas teerada mille lõpus paistavad heledalt valgustatud põõsad.
works.de: At the top edge and on the right, large drooping tree branches merge with the greenery of a garden densely overgrown with flowers and bushes. In the centre, a pinkish path at the end of which brightly lit bushes can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil peaaegu frontaalselt lai aknalaud ja alaosa suurest aknast. Läbi ruudustiku paistab uduselt talvine linnavaade. Vasakul akna taga raagus puu. Ruumi sees akna ees vasakul valge viini tool. Aknalaual lill ja mitmesuguseid esemeid.
works.de: In the foreground, an almost frontal view of a wide windowsill and the lower part of a large window. Through the grid a hazy winter cityscape is visible. On the left, behind the window, a bare tree. Inside the room, in front of the window on the left, a white Viennese chair. On the windowsill a flower and various objects.

works.d: Avaral aknalaual vaas lilledega ja pintsleid. Vasakul jalgadega maalikast, palett ja kirju draperii. Aknast vaade talvisele linnale.
works.de: A vase with flowers and brushes on a spacious windowsill. On the left a paint box with legs, a palette and a colourful drapery. View from the window of a wintry city.

works.d: Esiplaanil laual potilill, virn raamatuid ja vaas kollaste lilledega. Taga laual kirju riie ja raamatuid.
works.de: In the foreground on a table a potted plant, a stack of books and a vase with yellow flowers. Behind, on a table, patterned cloth and books.

works.d: Esiplaanil allee. Vasakul ja paremal puud. Teel inimesi.
works.de: In the foreground an alley. Trees on the left and right. People on the path.

works.d: Esiplaanil osaliselt jääga kaetud jõgi. Taga keskel sild, paremal hoonete siluetid, vasakul puudegrupp.
works.de: In the foreground a river partly covered with ice. Behind, in the middle, a bridge, on the right silhouettes of buildings, on the left a group of trees.

works.d: Künklik maastik. Esiplaanil kollakates-rohekates toonides põllud, üksikud puudegrupid. Keskplaanil vasakul järv. Vasakul ja paremal hooneid. Taamal mets.
works.de: Hilly landscape. In the foreground, fields in yellowish-greenish tones, isolated groups of trees. In the middle ground on the left, a lake. Buildings on the left and right. Forest in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul sinine valgete täppidega vaas kollaste iiristega, keskel klaasnõu paremal õunad. Taga vasakul lillakas-sinine draperii, paremal aken.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a blue vase with white dots and yellow irises, in the middle a glass vessel, apples on the right. Behind on the left a lilac-blue drapery, on the right a window.

works.d: Lumine maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul kaugusse viiv tee, mille ääres vasakul hooneid ja mõned puud, paremal puudetukk.
works.de: Snowy landscape. In the foreground on the left a road leading into the distance, with buildings and a few trees along it on the left, a clump of trees on the right.

works.d: Lõuna-Eesti maastik laias orus kulgeva teega. Vasakul ja paremal metsaga kaetud mäed.
works.de: South Estonian landscape with a road running through a wide valley. On the left and right, forest-covered hills.

works.d: Lai jõgi lehtpuudega kallastel. Vasakul randumissild ja paadid, paremal hooneid ja kõrge suitsev korsten.
works.de: A wide river with deciduous trees on the banks. On the left a landing pier and boats, on the right buildings and a tall smoking chimney.

works.d: Suvine Pariisi tänavavaade. Vasakul üksikuid puid, paremal mõned inimfiguurid. Taga Sacre Coeur´i hele kuppel.
works.de: A summer view of a Paris street. On the left a few solitary trees, on the right some human figures. Behind, the pale dome of Sacré-Cœur.

works.d: Lapse seisev figuur poolprofiilis paremale. Pool kehast kaetud heleda riidega. Foon sinine - ovaali ümbritseb osaliselt heledam rant.
works.de: Standing figure of a child in three-quarter profile to the right. Half of the body covered with light-coloured cloth. Blue background - the oval is partially bordered by a lighter rim.

works.d: Mehe täisfiguur peapöördega paremale. Peas kaabu, rind paljastatud, põlvini ulatuvais pükstes, jalad paljad. Vasemal ülal hoiab vikatit, paremas käes mingi ümmarik ese. Fooni ülaosa sinine, all ähmaselt nähtav künklik maastik.
works.de: Full figure of a man with head turned to the right. Wearing a hat, chest bared, in knee-length trousers, feet bare. Holding a scythe up on the left, in the right hand some round object. The upper part of the background is blue, below a hilly landscape is vaguely visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil varemete vahel töötavad taastajad, keskel väljaku ehitajad, taga Niguliste kiriku varemed.
works.de: In the foreground, restorers working among ruins, in the centre builders of the square, behind the ruins of St. Nicholas' Church.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul madalas vees asuvalt paadilt täies relvastuses mehi välja ronimas; keskel vees paremal asuva kivise ranna suunas jooksvaid sõdureid, kelledest mõned juba jõudnud randa. Rannal madal männik, millest üle paistavad mürskude detonatsioonidest tekkinud tule ja suitsusambad. Aovalguses taeval üksikuid pilvi.
works.de: In the foreground at left, fully armed men are climbing out of a boat in shallow water; in the middle, soldiers running through the water towards a rocky shore at right, some of whom have already reached the shore. On the shore a low pine grove, above which pillars of fire and smoke from shell detonations are visible. In the dawn light, scattered clouds in the sky.

works.t: Sakslaste viimase tugipunkti vallutamine Velikije Lukis
works.d: Esiplaanil lage koht. Vasakul purustatud katusega hoone ees viis sõdurit suurtüki taga askeldamas. Paremal viis sõdurit valmistumas rünnakuks.
works.de: In the foreground an open area. On the left, in front of a building with a damaged roof, five soldiers busy behind a cannon. On the right five soldiers preparing for an attack.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine kivi- ja raudtaraga piiratud väljak. Väljakul liivakast, mille ümber pingid. Liivakastist vasakul kaks raagus puud. Kivi- ja raudtara taga maja- ja aedade foonil jalakäijad tänaval.
works.de: In the foreground, a snowy square enclosed by a stone and iron fence. In the square a sandbox, surrounded by benches. To the left of the sandbox, two bare trees. Behind the stone and iron fence, pedestrians on the street against a background of houses and gardens.

works.d: Esiplaanil haljasala pargitee, puude ja pinkidega. Paremal ja taga tänav majadega. Eemalt paistavad korstnad ja tornid.
works.de: In the foreground a green area with a park path, trees and benches. On the right and in the background a street with houses. In the distance chimneys and towers are visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil kalda ääres kaks suuremat ja üks väiksem kalapaat. Väiksema juures kaks meest sillal võrke paadist välja võtmas. Taga meri, üksikute rünkpilvedega taevas, vasakul maariba.
works.de: In the foreground by the shore two larger and one smaller fishing boat. By the smaller one two men on a bridge taking nets out of the boat. Behind, the sea, a sky with scattered cumulus clouds, a strip of land on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil lauanurk ja lai aknalaud, milledel vaasid lilledega, kaktused, mõned raamatud. Aknast vaade õhtusele Võidu väljakule. Otse akna all raagus puud.
works.de: In the foreground a corner of a table and a wide windowsill, on which vases with flowers, cacti, some books. From the window a view of the evening Võidu Square. Directly below the window, bare trees.

works.d: Paremal esiplaanil laev kai ääres. Vasakul ja taga hulgaliselt laevu.
works.de: A ship at the quay in the right foreground. Numerous ships on the left and in the background.

works.d: Talvine linnavaade: allservast pildi sühavusse suunduv tänav, millest kahel pool, diagonaalselt kõrged uued majad; tahapoole jääb Toompea ja teised tornid.
works.de: Winter cityscape: a street leading from the lower edge into the depth of the picture, on both sides of which, diagonally, tall new buildings; behind, Toompea and other towers.

works.d: Vaade linnamüürile Nunnatorni ja Kuldjala torni vahelisel alal. Selle tagant paistavad Oleviste ja Issanda-muutmise kiriku tornid. Esiplaanil jalakäijad.
works.de: View of the town wall in the area between the Nuns' Tower and the Golden Foot Tower. Behind it, the towers of St. Olaf's Church and the Church of the Transfiguration can be seen. Pedestrians in the foreground.

works.d: Paremal kai ääres suur laev ja hulganisti väiksemaid. Vasakul meri.
works.de: On the right by the quay a large ship and many smaller ones. On the left the sea.

works.d: Aknalaual vaasides ja purkides punaseid roose, nelke ja muid lilli. Aknast avaneb vaade männimetsale.
works.de: On the windowsill, red roses, carnations and other flowers in vases and jars. From the window a view opens onto a pine forest.

works.d: Õhtune linnavaade: esiplaanil suunduvad pildi sügavusse sõidutee ja peenikeste raagus puudega ääristatud rahvarohke kõnnitee, puude ümber lumevallid. Tagaplaanil tuledesäras suured majad, ülal tumesinine ja pimenev taevas. Maalitud pruunides ja sinistes toonides.
works.de: An evening cityscape: in the foreground a roadway and a crowded pavement lined with thin bare trees extend into the depth of the picture, snowbanks around the trees. In the background large buildings ablaze with light, above a dark blue and darkening sky. Painted in brown and blue tones.

works.d: Vaade vana Tallinna mere lähedusse jäävale osale kõrgelt ülalt: esiplaanil Lai t., punaste katustega majad, tagapool Oleviste kirik. Silmapiiril meri, sadamakraanad paremal ja kahvatu hall taevas. Maalitud hõredate, aluspinda läbi kumada laskvate pintslilöökidega, objektide kontuure rõhutades.
works.de: A view of the part of old Tallinn near the sea, from high above: in the foreground Lai t., houses with red roofs, further back St. Olaf's Church. On the horizon the sea, harbour cranes on the right and a pale grey sky. Painted with sparse brushstrokes through which the underlying surface shines through, emphasising the contours of the objects.

works.d: Udune suvehommik hõredate mändide ja põõsatuttidega rabamaastikul. Esiplaanil rohune lagendik, tagapool metsaveer sinkjas udus.
works.de: A hazy summer morning in a bog landscape with sparse pines and clumps of bushes. In the foreground a grassy clearing, further back the edge of a forest in bluish haze.

works.d: Lahesopis ranna ääres paadisildade vahel viis kaluripaati. Ees paremal, kalakastide, korvide vahel istuvad mehed. Pilvise taeva all kauge sinkjas metsatriip. Hoogne skitseeriv maalilaad.
works.de: In a bay by the shore, among boat jetties, five fishing boats. In front on the right, men sitting among fish crates and baskets. Under a cloudy sky a distant bluish strip of forest. Vigorous, sketchy painting style.

works.d: Suvine vaade sadamale. Esiplaanil kai ääres kalalaevad. Taga, kõrgemal kaldal elumajad. Hoogne maaliline laad.
works.de: A summer view of a harbour. In the foreground fishing boats by the quay. Behind, on higher ground, dwelling houses. A vigorous, painterly style.

works.d: Kolm meest molbert´ide ees maalimas.
works.de: Three men painting in front of easels.

works.d: Ees keskel telefonipost. Pisut tagapool vasakul vedur, keskel depoo otsvaade, paremal rida kaubavaguneid.
works.de: In the front centre a telephone pole. A little further back on the left a locomotive, in the middle a frontal view of a depot, on the right a row of freight cars.

works.d: Vasakul ja keskel väljak üksikute inimfiguuridega. Paremal tellingutes ehitatav hoone. Taga keskel suur sammastega kivihoone.
works.de: On the left and in the middle a square with individual human figures. On the right a building under construction with scaffolding. In the background in the middle a large stone building with columns.

works.d: Esiplaanil parvel paremal ja keskel hobused vankritega, vasakul grupp inimesi. Keskel jõgi. Vastaskaldal paremal ja keskel üksikuid väikeseid maju.
works.de: In the foreground on a raft on the right and in the middle horses with carts, on the left a group of people. In the middle a river. On the opposite bank on the right and in the middle a few small houses.

works.d: Ees paat, paadi otstes paati aerudega paigalhoidvad mehed, paadi keskel kaks veest võrku välja tõmbavat meest. Taga vasakul vette ulatuv neemik kõrgete puudega.
works.de: In the foreground, a boat; at the ends of the boat, men holding it in place with oars, in the middle of the boat two men pulling a net out of the water. In the background on the left, a headland reaching into the water with tall trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel teerada. Vasakul paremal ja taga suured põlispuud. Esiplaani puude varjust avaneb vaade päikesest valgustatud lagendikule.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle a path. On the left, right and in the back large ancient trees. From the shadow of the foreground trees a view opens onto a sunlit clearing.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduv tee madala kiviaiaga. Selle kõrval suur puu, mille lehestik võtab enda alla suure osa pildipinnast. Vasakul ja paremal väiksemaid puid. Vasakul puude all valge maja.
works.de: In the foreground a road running from left to right with a low stone wall. Beside it a large tree, the foliage of which takes up a large part of the picture surface. Smaller trees on the left and right. On the left, under the trees, a white house.

works.d: Tasane õhtune maastik. Esiplaanil kollakates-pruunikates toonides põld viljarõukudega. Põllu taga põõsaste vahel jõgi. Üle jõe vaade madalale soisele luhale üksikute suurte puudega. Horisondil keskel madal kõrgendik. Taevas rohekates-lillakates toonides.
works.de: A flat evening landscape. In the foreground a field in yellowish-brownish tones with grain stacks. Behind the field, among bushes, a river. Across the river a view of a low marshy floodplain with a few large trees. On the horizon in the centre a low elevation. Sky in greenish-purplish tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil järv, mille paremalt kaldalt ulatub sügavale (maali keskossa) metsaga kaetud maariba. Tagapool Lõuna-Eesti künklik maastik metsatukkade ja lookleva teega.
works.de: In the foreground a lake, from whose right bank a strip of land covered with forest reaches deep (into the centre of the painting). Behind it the hilly landscape of South Estonia with clumps of forest and a winding road.

works.d: Esiplaanil lai, suurelt osalt jääs olev jõgi. Vasakul ridastikku mitmekorruselised kivihooned; paremal kaldapealsel kasvavad puud. Tagapool paistab üle jõe viiv Vabaduse sild.
works.de: In the foreground a wide river, largely covered with ice. On the left a row of multi-storey stone buildings; on the right, on the bank, growing trees. Behind, the Vabaduse Bridge crossing the river can be seen.

works.d: Murtud hallikates ja rohekates ning üksikutes, nendega harmoneeruvates roosakasvioletsetes toonides maalitud külamaastik veekogu ääres. Esi- ja keskplaanil peegelsileda veepinnaga hõbehall tiik. Esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes väike maariba sellel kasvava hõreda lehestikuga puuga, mis maapinnalt hargneb paljudeks pikkadeks, peenteks, habrasteks tüvedeks. Tagaplaanil, veekogu kaldal, kolm ühekorruselist hoonet, neist parempoolne osaliselt lehtpuudesalu varjus. Hele-sinakashall taevas.
works.de: A village landscape by a body of water, painted in broken greyish and greenish tones and, in a few places, in harmonising pinkish-violet tones. In the foreground and middle ground, a silver-grey pond with a mirror-smooth water surface. In the foreground, on the left, in the golden section, a small strip of land with a tree with sparse foliage growing on it, which branches from the ground into many long, thin, fragile trunks. In the background, on the shore of the body of water, three single-storey buildings, of which the one on the right is partially shaded by a grove of deciduous trees. A light bluish-grey sky.

works.d: Järveäärsel põllul hulk rahvast viljakoristustöödel. Paremal rehepeksumasin, selle ümber askeldavad inimesed, keskel kaks naist põhukubu hangu otsas kandmas. Vasakul kaks meest ja naine põhukuja tegemas, tagapool hobune viljakoormaga. Tumeneva õhtutaeva all metsaga kaetud mäekuppel, peegeldus vees.
works.de: In a field by a lake, a crowd of people at harvest work. On the right a threshing machine, around it people bustling about, in the centre two women carrying a sheaf of straw on a pitchfork handle. On the left two men and a woman making a straw stack, further back a horse with a load of grain. Under a darkening evening sky, a forest-covered hill, reflected in the water.

works.d: Hallikassinise sünge taeva all künklik maastik mäeseljakute ja puude-põõsaste puhmastega. Keskel looklev oja kaugeneb puudemasside vahele. Summutatud hallikad värvikooskõlad, hoogne maalilaad.
works.de: Under a greyish-blue, gloomy sky a hilly landscape with mountain ridges and clumps of trees and bushes. In the middle a winding brook recedes among masses of trees. Muted greyish colour harmonies, vigorous painting style.

works.d: Kõrges, silindirlises postamentvaasis kimp valgeid ja kollaseid krüsanteeme.
works.de: In a tall, cylindrical pedestal vase, a bouquet of white and yellow chrysanthemums.

works.d: Eespool madalamad künkad, tagapool kõrged mäed. Keskel puude ja põõsaste vahel valge kirikutorn. Taeval rahutud pilved.
works.de: In front lower hills, behind them high mountains. In the middle, among trees and bushes, a white church tower. Restless clouds in the sky.

works.d: Pahtliga maalitud valkjale taustale võrdsete vahedega põikijooned sisse kraabitud. Sellel foonil kaks üksteise kohal olevat hallikat keha, mis jätavad taustale aimatava varju ja mille vastas olevad küljed on sarnase lainelise joonega. Piki paremat äärt hallikas pind. Maal kohati tugeva faktuuriga, kasutatud pahtlit, aerograafi.
works.de: Crosswise lines scratched at equal intervals into a whitish background painted with putty. On this background two greyish bodies one above the other, which leave a suggested shadow on the background and whose opposite sides have a similarly wavy line. Along the right edge a greyish surface. The painting has a strong texture in places, using putty and an airbrush.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest kombineeritud abstraktne kompositsioon: sinine, roosa, valge nelinurk lõikuvad pildi keskel hallides toonides foonil. Paremas ülanurgas punane nelinurk, millest jooksevad alla paralleelsed valged triibud. Samasugune triipude riba all vasakul. Värvilised pinnad musta-halli-laigulised.
works.de: Abstract composition combined from geometric shapes: a blue, pink, white quadrangle intersect in the middle of the picture against a grey-toned background. In the upper right corner a red quadrangle, from which parallel white stripes run down. A similar strip of stripes below on the left. Coloured surfaces black-grey-spotted.

works.d: Kolmest figuuripaarist kompositsioon: vasakul servas külitsi kaks vestlevat noormeest, paremal tumedapäise noormehe käsi ümber traksidega pükstes tüdruku õla. Keskel vasakul peaaegu kiilaspäine keskealine mees, käed vaheliti, pilk kontsentreeritult vaatajal.
works.de: A composition of three pairs of figures: on the left edge, two young men conversing side by side, on the right the arm of a dark-haired young man around the shoulder of a girl wearing trousers with suspenders. In the middle left, an almost bald middle-aged man, hands folded, gaze concentrated on the viewer.

works.d: Tihke, läikiva, helepruuni värvikihina antud seina foonil esiplaanil vasakul käsisaag, seina vastu toetuv plaat, balloon ja liistujupp. Maalitud sinistes ja pruunides toonides.
works.de: Against a background of a wall rendered in a dense, glossy, light brown layer of paint, in the foreground on the left a handsaw, a board leaning against the wall, a balloon and a piece of moulding. Painted in blue and brown tones.

works.d: Vasakul pliidil küünlajalgu, nurgas poolavatud vakk, paremal aken, seintele riputatud rõivaid.
works.de: On the left, on the stove, candlesticks, in the corner a half-open chest, on the right a window, clothes hung on the walls.

works.d: Ees vasakul viljarõuk, tagapool paremal neli rõuku.
works.de: In front on the left a grain stack, further back on the right four stacks.

works.d: Keskel eest taha suunduva veekogu kaldail raagus puid. Vasakul puu vahelt paistmas hooned.
works.de: In the centre, bare trees on the banks of a body of water receding from front to back. On the left, buildings visible through the trees.

works.d: Hallikas, udutaolises üldtoonis, pehmete kontuuridega lumine tänavavaade peaaegu kogu kompositsioonipinda katvate õrnlillade, -kollakate ja -rohekate majafassaadidega tagaplaanil. Keskplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kuubikujuline kahekorruseline rohekas maja, esiplaanil paremal äärel ühekorruseline lillakas-rohekas puumaja.
works.de: In a greyish, misty overall tone, a snowy street view with soft contours, with pale purple, pale yellowish and pale greenish house façades covering almost the entire compositional surface in the background. In the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a cube-shaped two-storey greenish house, in the foreground on the right edge a one-storey purplish-greenish wooden house.

works.dm: kõrgus: 170.0 cm; sügavus: 3.0 cm; laius: 170.0 cm
works.d: Pronksvärviga toonitud aluse keskel ovaalse kujuga helesinistest plastikroosiõitest kogum. Teose äärtel volditud sinised plastikaadiribad.
works.de: In the centre of a base tinted bronze colour, an oval-shaped cluster of light blue plastic rose blossoms. Folded blue plastic strips at the edges of the work.

works.d: Lumega kaetud Lõuna-Eesti maastik, põõsaste ja puudegruppe, esiplaanil tee jälgi, silmapiiril metsamüür. Taevas hall. Põllul lumest paljaid musti laike.
works.de: A snow-covered South Estonian landscape, groups of bushes and trees, in the foreground tracks of a road, on the horizon a wall of forest. The sky grey. Black patches bare of snow in the field.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur seisvas asendis otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule. Tuume juuks ja ülikond. Vasak käsi puusal, parem toetub alusele.
works.de: A man's half-figure standing frontally, head turned to the left. Dark hair and a suit. Left hand on the hip, right resting on a base.

works.d: Öises maastikus vasakul preestri kuju, paremal kaks väikest kuuske ja mäenõlv. Taamal kõrge ohvritule ümber valges riietuses figuure.
works.de: In a nocturnal landscape, a priest's figure on the left, on the right two small spruces and a hillside. In the distance, figures in white clothing around a tall sacrificial fire.

works.d: Kompositsioon fantastiliste lendavate loomade ja figuuridega põrandal.
works.de: A composition with fantastic flying animals and figures on the floor.

works.d: A. Promet; Kullerkupud; ....; Pöördel kleebitud paberijälgi. Asukoht objektil: pöördel taga.
works.de: A. Promet; Kullerkupud; ....; Traces of glued paper on the verso. Location on object: on the verso.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtmaa, üksikute sügistuules kõverdunud kaskedega. Keskel vasakult kaarjalt paremale kulgev, tahapoole järsult langev paeranniku äär. Taamal lainetav meri.
works.de: In the foreground grassland, with solitary birches bent by the autumn wind. In the middle, curving from left to right and dropping steeply backward, the edge of a limestone coast. In the distance a rolling sea.

works.d: Lagedas maastikus vasakul, ebamääraste jalgadega naise akt, mille ümber põimunud kaks madu.
works.de: In an open landscape on the left, a female nude with indistinct legs, around which two snakes are entwined.

works.d: Ees ristküliku kujulisel maa-alal aktiivsed varemed. Taustaks suitsev Vesuuv.
works.de: In front, on a rectangular piece of land, active ruins. In the background, smoking Vesuvius.

works.d: Paremas servas ja ülemises vasakus neljandikus nokkmütsiga, habemiku vanamehe figuur. Esiplaanil olev poolpöördes vasakule, teine otsevaates, vasakus käes kepp.
works.de: On the right edge and in the upper left quarter, the figure of a bearded old man with a peaked cap. The one in the foreground is in a half-turn to the left, the other in frontal view, with a cane in his left hand.

works.d: Lillakasroosa ehapunas taeva taustal kaks võitlevat ratsanikku: vasakpoolne mustal hobusel raudrüüs, tõstetud mõõk käes. Parempoolne pruunil hobusel viskevalmis odaga eestlasest sõdalane külgvaates. Maalitud jõuliselt, tumedaid kontuurjooni rõhutades.
works.de: Against the backdrop of a lilac-pink sunset sky, two fighting horsemen: the left one on a black horse in armour, a raised sword in hand. The right one on a brown horse, an Estonian warrior in side view with a spear ready to throw. Painted forcefully, emphasising dark contour lines.

works.d: Istuva naise põlvportree profiilis, vaatega vasakule, käed süles. Peas kitsas, äärteta kübar. Taustaks lehtpuude oksad.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated woman in profile, facing left, hands in her lap. On her head a narrow, brimless hat. Background of deciduous tree branches.

works.d: Teravas valguse-varju kontrastis antud figuur pöördes paremale. Lühikesed tumedad juuksed, pilusilmad, naeratav suu, käed põlvedel. Peast paremal diagonaalis kollane ja punane laserikiirt meenutav triip. Foon tume, risti-rästi värvilistest joontest läbi põimitud, vasakul ülemises neljandikus kaks nelinurka, all valge, punaste horisontaaljoontega tahvel või paberileht. Kohati väga pastoosne.
works.de: A figure given in sharp light-shadow contrast, turned to the right. Short dark hair, narrow eyes, a smiling mouth, hands on the knees. To the right of the head, diagonally, a yellow and red stripe resembling a laser beam. Background dark, criss-crossed with colourful lines, in the upper left quarter two rectangles, below a white board or sheet of paper with red horizontal lines. In places very impasto.

works.d: Hallikassinises, väikeste roosade lilledega kleidis noore naise profiilportree. Naise kollakaspruunid juuksed tagant allapoole koolutatud, pealael lokk. Naisel väike punane suu, pisut kongus nina. Foon roosa. Eriti näo ja kaela piirkonnas kumab läbi õhukese värvikihi alusjoonistus.
works.de: A profile portrait of a young woman in a greyish-blue dress with small pink flowers. The woman's yellowish-brown hair is curled downwards at the back, with a curl at the crown. The woman has a small red mouth, a slightly hooked nose. The background is pink. Especially in the area of the face and neck, the underdrawing shows through the thin layer of paint.

works.d: Esiplaanil karjavärav, paremal kooguga kaev, vasakul taluhoone. Taamal maja ees naise figuur.
works.de: In the foreground a herd gate, on the right a well with a sweep, on the left a farm building. In the distance a woman's figure in front of the house.

works.d: Heleda draperii foonil istuv naisakt otsevaates, vasak käsi ümber paabulinnu, parem süles. Naise lühikeste tumedate juustega pea kummardunud alla paremale, pilk linnul. Parem jalg viidud vasaku taha. Taustal paremal punane, vasakul sinakas, all rohekassinine draperii. Maalitud siledalt, vorme üldistavalt.
works.de: Against a light drapery background a seated female nude in frontal view, left hand around a peacock, right hand in her lap. The woman's head, with short dark hair, bent down to the right, gaze on the bird. Right leg placed behind the left. In the background, red on the right, bluish on the left, greenish-blue drapery below. Painted smoothly, generalising the forms.

works.d: Esiplaanil peegeldustest virvendav veekogu. Vees hobused vankritega ning seal istuvate inimfiguuridega. Silmapiiril roheline puude-põõsaste vöönd. Maalitud etüüdlikult, tumedates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water shimmering with reflections. In the water horses with carts and human figures sitting in them. On the horizon a green belt of trees and bushes. Painted in an etude-like manner, in dark tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinises seelikus ja punases mütsis naine, keskplaanis suurte kuhjadega pruunikaskollane viljapõld üksikute figuuridega, taamal tumeroheline puudeviirg. Ülal hallikassinine, pilvekuhilatega taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a woman in a blue skirt and red cap, in the middle ground a brownish-yellow grain field with large stacks and scattered figures, in the distance a dark green line of trees. Above, a greyish-blue sky with piled-up clouds.

works.d: Sinises sportliku lõikega mantlis istuva prillidega naise täisfiguur en-face, vasem õlg kergelt tahapoole, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas beež sviiter, helepruun seelik, parem jalg üle põlve tõstetud. Täidlased jalad, pruunid sukksaapad. Parem käsi vabalt süles, vasak vabalt rippuva käelabaga toetub toolileenile. Käharad helepruunid juuksed, lai nägu. Summutatud üldtoon, neutraalne foon.
works.de: A full figure, en-face, of a bespectacled woman sitting in a blue sportily cut coat, left shoulder slightly turned back, head slightly turned to the right. Wearing a beige sweater, a light brown skirt, right leg crossed over the knee. Plump legs, brown suede boots. Right hand resting loosely in the lap, left hand with a loosely hanging palm resting on the arm of the chair. Curly light brown hair, a broad face. Muted overall tone, neutral background.

works.d: Esiplaanil rand üksikute kivide ja mändidega. Taga meri. Vasakul ja taamal rannariba metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground a beach with solitary stones and pines. Behind it the sea. On the left and in the distance a strip of shore with forest.

works.d: Summutatud murtud toonides, detaile ning värvivarjundeid tumeda jämeda kontuuriga piiratud vormide ültooni sulatavalt maalitud väikelinna maastik, vaadatud kõrgest vaatepunktsist. Esiplaanil all hall rohekassinine jõgi kahe kõrvuti ujuva väikese purjepaadiga. Keskplaanil jõe kaldal oranžikas-punaste katustega madalad kiviehitised: vasakul hoone neljatahulise tornikesega selle taga; keskel astmelise katusega hoone ning neljatahuline tornikene, ühendatud väravaavaga madala müüriga; paremal katusega madal sammastik terrassil. Hoonete taga kaks suurt lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil künkal tihedasti paigutatud kaitsetornidega keskaegne linnus.
works.de: A small-town landscape painted in muted broken tones, with details and colour shades melting into an overall tone within forms bordered by a dark thick contour, viewed from a high viewpoint. In the foreground below, a grey greenish-blue river with two small sailboats floating side by side. In the middle ground on the riverbank, low stone buildings with orangish-red roofs: on the left a building with a four-sided little tower behind it; in the middle a building with a stepped roof and a four-sided little tower, connected by a low wall with a gateway opening; on the right a low colonnade with a roof on a terrace. Behind the buildings, two large deciduous trees. In the background on a hill, a medieval fortress with densely arranged defence towers.

works.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur patjadele toetuvana. Peas sinine sulega kübar, seljas samavärviline kleit. Ees avatud raamat.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman leaning on pillows. On her head a blue feathered hat, wearing a dress of the same colour. An open book in front of her.

works.dm: kõrgus: 245.0 cm; kujutise laius: 171.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 243.5 cm; laius: 179.0 cm
works.d: Alevivaade tiigi ja punase katusega majadega vasakul. Paremal kõrge tara ja üksik maja. Esiplaanil inimesi. Kaugemal põõsad, majad, metsad punakas valguses.
works.de: View of a small town with a pond and red-roofed houses on the left. On the right a tall fence and a single house. People in the foreground. Further away bushes, houses, forests in reddish light.

works.d: Esiplaanil 4 saani sõitjatega ja hulk inimesi. Taustaks kaks kõrgemat torniga hoonet ja üks väiksem maja. Taevas sinakais roosakais toonides.
works.de: In the foreground 4 sledges with riders and a number of people. In the background two taller buildings with a tower and one smaller house. Sky in bluish pinkish tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil lennukimudel ja kuus töösse süvenenud, arutlevat noort konstruktorit laua ümber. Paremas nurgas näha toolileen. Väike poiss selgvaates pioneerirätikuga kaelas, kehaga vastu lauda toetumas. Üleval keskel mudellennuk rippumas. Seinal kahe raamitud pildi vahel plakat, mis kujutab lendurit noorte mudellendurite keskel.
works.de: In the foreground a model airplane and six young engineers absorbed in discussion, gathered around a table. In the right corner a chair back can be seen. A small boy in full view with a pioneer scarf around his neck, leaning with his body against the table. Above in the centre a model airplane hanging. On the wall between two framed pictures a poster depicting a pilot among young model-aircraft builders.

works.d: Ees keskel talutares õlgedel lamav noor mees, pea toetumas vasakule käele. Temast paremal rahvarõivais istuv naine. Taga kannelt helistav vanamees ja kaks last.
works.de: In the front centre, in a farmhouse room, a young man lying on straw, his head resting on his left hand. To his right, a woman in folk costume sitting. In the background, an old man playing the kannel and two children.

works.d: Esiplaanil viiulit mängiva, seisva mehe poolfiguur, profiilis vasakule. Tagaplaanil keskel kuulava mehe sidemes pea.
works.de: In the foreground, half-figure of a standing man playing the violin, in profile to the left. In the background, centre, the bandaged head of a listening man.

works.d: Pime ruum madala aknaga. Akna juures seisab väike tüdruk, vasakul rohelise kattega voodi. Paremal tool ja redel, reheahi.
works.de: A dark room with a low window. By the window stands a little girl, on the left a bed with a green cover. On the right a chair and a ladder, a threshing-barn stove.

works.d: Esiplaanil nattadega mineva mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Taga veepind ja kõrge horisondiga maastik.
works.de: In the foreground the half-length figure of a man going with a knapsack, in profile to the left. Behind, a water surface and a landscape with a high horizon.

works.d: Vana istuv naine profiilis vasakule. Vasaku käega kallutab kaussi, paremas lusikas. Paremal põrandal kass.
works.de: An old woman sitting in profile to the left. With her left hand she tilts a bowl, in her right hand a spoon. On the floor on the right a cat.

works.d: Lage lumine maastik hämaruses, keskplaanil kaks madalat maja, milledel kummalgi üks aken valgustatud.
works.de: Open snowy landscape in twilight, in the middle ground two low houses, each with one window lit.

works.d: Kõrged tumedad, osalt lumega kaetud mäed.
works.de: High dark mountains, partly covered with snow.

works.d: Kirjus ruumis akna all istuv vana naine, kann süles.
works.de: An old woman sitting under a window in a colourful room, a jug in her lap.

works.d: Ees paremal grupp noori kuuski. Paar okaspuud vasakus servas. Puude vahelt avaneb vaade silmapiiril metsaga piiratud lagendikule. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: In front on the right a group of young spruces. A couple of conifers on the left edge. Between the trees a view opens onto a clearing bordered by forest on the horizon. Sketch-like manner of painting.

works.d: Seltskond kaetud pidulaua taga: keskel priske vanapaar, proua vasakul, prillidega härra paremal. Mõlemal pool kiitsakate meeste kujud. Kõik tumedates riietes, heledad särgid, kraed paistmas. Groteskselt lahendatud figuurid, dekoratiivne laad.
works.de: A company at a laid festive table: a plump elderly couple in the middle, the lady on the left, a bespectacled gentleman on the right. Gaunt male figures on both sides. All dressed in dark clothes, light shirts, collars showing. Grotesquely rendered figures, decorative style.

works.d: Hallides toonides akvarellilikult maalitud järvemaastik: vasakul järvesopp kividega rannal, paat, võrguvaiad ja -kuurid. Paremal hele veepind. Ülal hele, kergelt roosalt kumav taevas.
works.de: A lake landscape painted in a watercolour-like manner in grey tones: on the left a bay of the lake with rocks on the shore, a boat, net poles and sheds. On the right a light water surface. Above, a light sky with a faint pink glow.

works.d: Noor vormikas istuv naisakt veerandpöördes paremale. Ülakeha veidi ette kummardunud, pea paremale pööratud, käed selja taga, vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud ja tõstetud. Figuur lõigatud altpoolt põlvi. Hoogne skitseeriv maalilaad, valguse ja varjuga vormiv. Taust pruunikaskollane.
works.de: A young shapely seated female nude turned a quarter to the right. The upper body slightly bent forward, the head turned to the right, the hands behind the back, the left leg bent at the knee and raised. The figure is cropped below the knees. A vigorous, sketchy painting style, modelling with light and shadow. The background is brownish-yellow.

works.d: Rohelisel alusel istuv akt selgvaates, veidi pööratud paremale, pea vasakule suunatud. Parem käsi süles, vasak toetub küljel. Taust markeerib ruumi. Visandlik, hoogne kujutamisviis.
works.de: A nude seated on a green base in side view, turned slightly to the right, head turned to the left. Right hand in the lap, left hand resting on the side. The background marks the space. Sketch-like, vigorous manner of depiction.

works.d: Toolil istuv heledapäine noor alasti naine poolpöördes paremale, parem käsi süles, vasak toetub toolileenile. Figuur lõigatud põlvede alt. Taust markeerib ruumi, vasakul ripub roosal toolil kollane draperii.
works.de: A fair-haired young naked woman sitting on a chair, in a half-turn to the right, right hand in her lap, left hand resting on the chair's arm. The figure is cropped below the knees. The background marks a room, on the left a yellow drapery hangs on a pink chair.

works.d: Vormikas alasti naine selgvaates istumas, poolpöördes paremale, pea vasakule küljele suunatud. Parem jalg kõverdatud, vasak ette sirutatud. Käed toetuvad taha küljele. Taust allosas kollane, ülal pruunikashall. Lopsakas pintslitöö, kohati vormi kontuuriga markeeriv.
works.de: A shapely nude woman seen frontally, sitting in a half-turn to the right, head turned to the left side. Right leg bent, left leg stretched forward. Hands resting behind on the side. Background yellow below, brownish-grey above. Lush brushwork, in places marking the form with contour.

works.d: Noore mehe portree poolpöördes vasakule. Peas laia äärega tumesinine kaabu, ninal sinises toonis antud raamidega prillid, mille klaasid varjavad silmi. Sirged, teravalt väljajoonistuvad nina ja suu. Huulte vahel põlev sigaret. Seljas rohekassinine mantel. Nägu antud erivärviliste pintslilöökidega. Foon kollane ja kollakasroheline.

Kastanpruunide lokkis juustega tütarlapse pea poolpöördes vasakule. Pruunid mandlilõikelised silmad, teravalt väljajoonistuv korrapärane suu, hea jume. Seljas roheline jakk või kleit, millel oranž krae. Foon peamiselt sinistes ja lillakashallides toonides.
works.de: The head of a girl with chestnut-brown curly hair in half-turn to the left. Brown almond-shaped eyes, a sharply outlined regular mouth, good complexion. Wearing a green jacket or dress with an orange collar. Background mainly in blue and purplish-grey tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal männid. Neist vasakul põõsas ning vasakult alumisest nurgast paremale kulgev metsavahetee. Teest vasakul, foonil segamets. Puude vahelt paistab hallikassinine taevas. Valdavad on mitmesugused rohelised toonid, maalitud põõsaste ja puude võra osas pastoosselt.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, pine trees. To their left a bush and a forest track running from the lower left corner to the right. To the left of the track, in the background, mixed forest. Between the trees, a greyish-blue sky is visible. Various shades of green predominate, the foliage of the bushes and trees painted pastosely.

works.d: Noore naise rinnaportree, pea pöördes paremale. Tugevad põsesarnad, teravalt etteulatuv kandiline lõug. Suuümber kerge naeratuse vine. Peas must, nn. pottkübar, heleda ilustisega paremal; seljas must, valge kraega kleit.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, head turned to the right. Strong cheekbones, a sharply protruding angular chin. A faint trace of a smile around the mouth. On her head a black so-called bowler hat, with light-coloured trimming on the right; wearing a black dress with a white collar.

works.d: Neegri rinnaportree, poolpöördes paremale. Tumedate silmade pilk suunatud vaatajale. Näol joonistuvad selgelt välja lihasekühmud. Seljas bordoopunane kuub, valge särk ning lips. Foon pruun.
works.de: Bust portrait of a Black man, in half-turn to the right. The gaze of the dark eyes directed at the viewer. Muscle contours are clearly drawn on the face. Wearing a burgundy-red coat, white shirt and tie. Brown background.

works.d: Kolmnurkne dekoratiivne kompositsioon nelja naisaktiga. Sinistes, rohekates, punakates toonides geomeetrilistest kujunditest interjööris vasakul külgvaates põlvitav naine, käed üles ette situtatud. Keskel oranžile padjale nõjatuv figuur, ülakeha tõstetud, paremas tõstetud käes sinine pudel. Parempoolne seisev figuur poolseglvaates, vasakus käes sinine peeker. Tagaplaanil keskel, oranžis rombikujulises avas seisev figuur.
works.de: Triangular decorative composition with four female nudes. In blue, greenish and reddish tones, in an interior of geometric shapes, on the left a kneeling woman in profile, hands raised forward. In the centre a figure leaning on an orange pillow, upper body raised, in the raised right hand a blue bottle. On the right a standing figure in half profile, in the left hand a blue goblet. In the background in the centre, a figure standing in an orange rhombus-shaped opening.

works.d: Helesinisel taustal vöödiline, tumeda rohekaspruuni äärega, keskel valkjas, allpool roheline pind pikisuunaliselt pooleks lõigatud. Poolte vahel kiiluna helesinine tagapõhi.
works.de: On a light blue background, a striped area with a dark greenish-brown edge, whitish in the middle, below a green surface cut lengthwise in half. Between the halves, a light blue background wedges in.

works.d: Pildi keskel hall kanditud servadega kiviplaat, millel horisontaalselt jooksev loogeline punane triip. Vasakus ja paremas servas tumepruun, punase servaga triip. Vasakus ülanurgas tume triip otsekui laiali pühitud. Foon hallikas, roosalt kumav.
works.de: In the centre of the picture a gray, bordered stone slab, on which a horizontally running wavy red stripe. On the left and right edges, a dark brown, red-edged stripe. In the upper left corner a dark stripe as if smeared out. Background grayish, with a pink glow.

works.d: Keset pildi pinda tume nelinurk, alt paremast nurgast punakaspruun, vasakult horisontaalse keskjoone kohalt hallid udused triibud. Tumeda nelinurga taga helesinine nelinurk. Foon ülalt tuhmroheline, alt servast helepruun.
works.de: In the middle of the picture surface a dark quadrangle, from the lower right corner reddish-brown, from the left above the horizontal centre line grey hazy stripes. Behind the dark quadrangle a light blue quadrangle. Background dull green at the top, light brown at the bottom edge.

works.d: "Rukkililled. A. Promet" Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel pliiatsikirjas.
works.de: "Rukkililled. A. Promet" Location on object: on the reverse, in pencil.

works.d: Vaiba all lamava habemiku mehe ees istuv naise figuur, parem käsi tõstetud sirutatult ette.
works.de: A seated female figure in front of a bearded man lying under a carpet, right hand raised and extended forward.

works.d: Sügisene rand tormise mere ja taevaga, tagaplaanil, ees paremal ja vasakul saledad kased tormis paindunud, puistamas lehti.
works.de: An autumn shore with a stormy sea and sky, in the background, in front on the right and left slender birches bent in the storm, shedding their leaves.

works.d: Veekogu kaldal, ees vasemal ja tagapool paremal tuules paindunud kasepaarid. Taevas tugevais sinistes toonides.
works.de: On the shore of a body of water, in front on the left and further back on the right pairs of birches bent by the wind. The sky in strong blue tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, mille vasakul kaldal kivi ja üksik leinakask. Taga lagendik.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, on the left bank of which a rock and a solitary weeping birch. Behind it an open field.

works.d: Esiplaanil paadi nina punase purjega. Vasakul ehmunud näoga mehe poolfiguur. Paremal stiliseeritud laine valges vahus näha naise figuur pikkade blondide juustega.
works.de: In the foreground the bow of a boat with a red sail. On the left the half-figure of a man with a startled face. On the right in the white foam of a stylised wave the figure of a woman with long blonde hair is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel, kogu vertikaalse kesktelje ulatuses mänd, millest vasakul seljaga vaataja poole, valges, kirjatud allserva ja varrukatega ning vööga kleidis, pikkade tumedate patsidega neiu, parem käsi silmile tõstetud, merele vaatamas. Mere kaldalt tõuseb paremale mäkke liivarand, kaetud lillade taimedega. Ülal helesinine taevas, paremal nurgas pastelsetes toonides kontsentrilistes ringides maalitud suur, kollast valgust kiirgav päike.
works.de: In the foreground in the centre, spanning the entire vertical central axis, a pine tree, to the left of which, with her back to the viewer, a girl with long dark braids, wearing a white dress with a patterned lower hem and sleeves and a belt, her right hand raised to her eyes, looking at the sea. From the seashore a sandy beach rises to a hill on the right, covered with purple plants. Above, a light blue sky, in the right corner a large sun painted in pastel-toned concentric circles, radiating yellow light.

works.d: Esiplaanil kägistab kukepeaga koletis pikkade hallide juustega kõhna paljasjalgset meest. Mehe sõrmede vahelt pudenevad mündid tema kõrval olevasse raha täis kastikesse. Kasti ümber münte ja kalliskividest ehteid. Foon sinakasroheline, koletise pea ümber päikeseketta taoliselt  helendav sõõr.
works.de: In the foreground a monster with a cockerel's head is strangling a thin, barefoot man with long grey hair. Coins fall from between the man's fingers into a box full of money beside him. Around the box are coins and jewels set with precious stones. The background bluish-green, around the monster's head a glowing disc like the sun.

works.d: Tumehallil lõuendil keskel paksu kihina horisontaalne ebakorrapärase kujuga must laik. Värvi on justkui kortsutades ära kraabitud. Kogu maali pind jätab kratsitud, kriimustatud, torgitud mulje. Ülal ja alaosas mitmed sisselõiked - rebendid. Suurim neist all vasakul: ca 2x20 cm. Maali ülaosas lõuend tumedamat tooni kui all. Minimalistlik, monokroomne.
works.de: On a dark grey canvas, in the centre, a thick layer forming an irregularly shaped horizontal black stain. The paint appears to have been scraped off as if crumpled. The entire surface of the painting gives an impression of being scratched, scraped, and pricked. Above and below there are several incisions – tears. The largest of them, at lower left: approx. 2x20 cm. In the upper part of the painting the canvas is darker in tone than below. Minimalist, monochrome.

works.d: Hiirehallis toonis peenekoelisel lõuendil heledad sissekraape jooned. Üle terve maali korrapäratuid, suuremad, väiksemad narmastatud servaga rebendid, suurem neist vasakul keskel.
Keskel kuuskede vahel tahumata palkidest ehitatud onn.
works.de: In the middle, among spruces, a hut built of unhewn logs.

works.d: Esiplaanil tänava nurgal viltu vajunud telefonipost. Taga diagonaalselt vasemalt paremale kulgeva tänava ääres varemeis hooneid. Nende vahel põõsaid ja kolm lehtpuud.
works.de: In the foreground on a street corner a telephone pole leaning askew. Behind it, along a street running diagonally from left to right, ruined buildings. Between them bushes and three deciduous trees.

works.t: I järgu kapten E.V. Ossetski portree
works.d: Mereväelase mundris keskealise mehe kolmveerandfiguur istuvas asendis. Parema käe pöial kitli hõlma vahel, vasak käsi tooli leenil. Peas valge põhjaga "mereväelase müts".
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a middle-aged man in a naval uniform, in a seated position. The thumb of his right hand is tucked between the folds of his coat, his left hand rests on the arm of the chair. On his head a white-based "naval cap".

works.d: ... S. Rida ... Lilled köögilaual Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel all vasakul lipik.
works.de: ... S. Rida ... Flowers on a kitchen table. Location on object: label at lower left on the back.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt peaaegu profiilis paremale. Seljas tume kuub rohekas toonis vestiga ja rohekas-musta narmaliste otstega kaelasidemega.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man almost in profile to the right. Wearing a dark coat in a greenish tone with a vest and a greenish-black necktie with fringed ends.

works.d: Pikkade, sassis, heledate juustega habemiku vanamehe rinnapilt. Õlad kerge pöördega paremale, pea peaaegu en face.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old bearded man with long, tousled, light-coloured hair. Shoulders slightly turned to the right, head almost en face.

works.d: Interjööris nikerdatud laua ümber kolm mungarüüs meest. Vasakpoolne sileda lõuaga mees osutab tema ees olevasse raamatusse, kuna paremal pool lauda asuv valge pika habemega, kirjutamisega tegelenud munk seletab midagi, vasak käsi osutavas asendis ülespoole suunatud. Kolmas, noor mees laua taga istub mõtlikus poosis,  pea toetatud paremale käele.
works.de: In an interior, around a carved table, three men in monks' robes. The clean-shaven man on the left points into the book in front of him, while the monk on the right side of the table, with a long white beard, who has been writing, explains something, his left hand raised upward in a gesturing position. The third, young man, sits behind the table in a pensive pose, his head resting on his right hand.

works.d: Kaks lähivaates talumaja, üks külje-, teine otsaseinaga vaataja poole. Majade ees õuel suur kivi, esiplaanil vasakul väiksemaid kive, rohtu ja lilli. Majade taga ulatuvad kõrged puud üle katuseharjade. Taevas hallikassinine. Parempoolsele majale langeb loojangukuma.
works.de: Two farmhouses in close view, one facing the viewer with its side wall, the other with its gable end. In front of the houses in the yard a large stone, in the foreground on the left smaller stones, grass and flowers. Behind the houses tall trees rise above the roof ridges. Sky greyish-blue. Sunset glow falls on the house on the right.

works.d: Avar panoraammaastik erksinise järvesilmaga keskel. Järve kaldal üksikud puud, kaldad tõusevad küngastikuks. Taamal ülal metsatukad ja hall taevaviirg. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati spaatli ja pintslivarrega. Kollakasroheline värvigamma.
works.de: Wide panoramic landscape with a bright blue lake in the centre. Solitary trees on the lakeshore, the banks rising into a hilly area. Further away above, patches of forest and a grey strip of sky. Painted pastosely, in places with a palette knife and the brush handle. Yellowish-green colour range.

works.d: Habemiku mehe täisfiguur, pool profiilis paremale, vasem käsi toetunud mõõgale, mundris, ordenitega, interjööris.
works.de: Full figure of a bearded man, half profile to the right, left hand resting on a sword, in uniform, with orders, in an interior.

works.d: Keskel, eest otse taha suunduv teerada. Paremal ja vasemal üksikud kõrgetüvelised lehtpuud. Tagapool tihedam noor mets. Keskel, teerajast vasakul pikas maani seelikus ja valges pearätis naise figuur.
works.de: In the middle, a path leading straight from the front to the back. On the right and left, single tall-trunked deciduous trees. Further back, denser young forest. In the middle, to the left of the path, the figure of a woman in a long ankle-length skirt and a white headscarf.

works.d: Eest taha paremale suunduv veekogu vesiroosidega ja veelindude parvega. Vasakul kõrgeneval kaldal rühm vanu tammesid. Taga paremal rohtunud vastaskaldal lehtpuumets.
works.de: A body of water leading from front to back to the right, with water lilies and a flock of waterfowl. On the left, on a rising bank, a group of old oaks. Behind, on the right, on the overgrown opposite bank, a deciduous forest.

works.d: Ees paremal künkal kaks istuvat figuuri. Vasakul nende poole sammuv mees. Paremal, pisut tagapool, kõrge küngas üksiku puuga, selle ees, vee ääres hoone (veski).
works.de: In front, on the right, on a hillock, two seated figures. To the left, a man walking towards them. On the right, a little further back, a high hillock with a solitary tree, in front of it, by the water, a building (a mill).

works.d: Esiplaanil plats kaubitsejate telkidega, kahel pool puud ja paremal lossivaremed. Ostjaid ja jalutajaid.
works.de: In the foreground a square with vendors' tents, trees on both sides and castle ruins on the right. Buyers and strollers.

works.d: Esialal keskel idamaises riietuses põlvili vaipa kudumas. Tema taga asuva telgi all vasakul lambaid, veidi paremale püstiseisev naine veekruusidega ja istuv poisike. Naiste vahel taga pada lõkke kohal rippumas; lõkke tagant paistavad kahe naise pead. Paremal, telgi all vaibal, kolm idamaises riietuses meest, kaks istumas piibud käes, kolmas püsti jooki karikasse kallamas. Meeste taga kaks hobust.
works.de: In the foreground centre, a person in oriental dress kneels weaving a carpet. Behind her, under a tent, on the left sheep, slightly to the right a standing woman with water jugs and a sitting boy. Between the women, further back, a pot hangs over a fire; behind the fire the heads of two women are visible. On the right, under the tent on a carpet, three men in oriental dress, two sitting with pipes in hand, the third standing pouring a drink into a goblet. Behind the men two horses.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale. Kõrgel soengul keisrikroon, hermeliinmantlil orden. Portreed ümbritseb ovaal.
works.de: Bust of a middle-aged woman with head turned to the left. On her high coiffure an imperial crown, on her ermine mantle an order. The portrait is surrounded by an oval.

works.d: Keskealise daami keha poolfiguur, poolprofiilis paremale, pea pöördega vasakule, vanaroosas, pitsidega ja seostega kleidis, parem käsi hoiab rohelist mantlit.
works.de: The half-figure body of a middle-aged lady, in half-profile facing right, head turned to the left, in an old-rose dress with lace and ties, her right hand holding a green coat.

works.d: Keskealise daami poolfiguur, kolmveerand profiilis vasakule, vanaroosas kuldtikandiga ja valge pits-garnituuriga kleidis, kaela ümber pael.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged lady, in three-quarter profile facing left, in an old-rose dress with gold embroidery and white lace trimming, a ribbon around the neck.

works.d: Paremal paadisild, mille ääres paate. Tagaplaanil meri. Maalitud pikkade, laiade pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: A boat pier with boats on the right. The sea in the background. Painted with long, broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil grupp raagus puid. Nende vahelt paistavad majade lumised katused.
works.de: In the foreground, a group of bare trees. Between them, snowy roofs of houses can be seen.

works.d: Mitmesugustest geomeetrilistest pindadest moodustub rongkäigus sammuv rahvahulk. Vasakul majad.
works.de: A crowd walking in procession is formed from various geometric planes. Houses on the left.

works.d: Valges mannergus kimp ultramariinsiniste õitega lilli. Maaling pastoosne.
works.de: In a white mug a bouquet of flowers with ultramarine blue blossoms. Painted in a pastose manner.

works.d: Sinises riietuses prillidega mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes vasakule.
works.de: Chest-length figure of a man in blue clothing with glasses, frontal view, head slightly turned to the left.

works.d: Keskel mees- ja naisfiguur, paremal ja vasakul pillimängijad. Taga keskel puu ja laululava kaar.
works.de: In the middle a male and female figure, on the right and left musicians. Behind in the middle a tree and the arc of the song-festival stage.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakates toonides maapind roosade kividega. Eemal rohekassinine meri.
works.de: In the foreground ground in yellowish tones with pink stones. In the distance a greenish-blue sea.

works.d: Sinise taeva taustal heledates toonides kujundeid - esiplaanil horisontaalse, keskplaanil vertikaalse ülesehitusega.
works.de: Against a blue sky background, shapes in light tones - horizontal composition in the foreground, vertical composition in the middle ground.

works.d: Heledal lauanurgal rohekas purk kirjude lilledega. Foon hallikates-pruunikates toonides.
works.de: On a light-coloured table corner a greenish jar with colourful flowers. Background in grey-brown tones.

works.d: Istuva, rohelises riietuses vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, käed toolileenil. Foon kollakates ja pruunikates toonides.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated older woman dressed in green, turned halfway to the left, hands resting on the chair back. The background is in yellowish and brownish tones.

works.d: Kolme istuva tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguurid.Vasakus ääres olev tütarlaps poolpöördes paremale, ülejäänud kaks otsevaates. Kõigil kolmel käed kokkupandult süles.
works.de: Three-quarter figures of three seated girls. The girl on the left edge in a half-turn to the right, the other two in frontal view. All three have their hands folded in their laps.

works.d: Ees suures plaanis põlvele toetuv palja ülakehaga mees, kes suure kruvivõtmega töötab rööbastel. Maalitud pruunikates ja helesinistes toonides, plastilist vormi tükeldavalt modelleerides.
works.de: In the foreground, in large scale, a bare-chested man resting on his knee, working on the rails with a large wrench. Painted in brownish and light blue tones, modelling the plastic form in a fragmenting manner.

works.d: Pildil vasakul all ääres maas kuhi arbuuse. Samas vasakul valges kitlis müüja arbuusi kaalumas, tema ümber hulk inimesi - ostjaid, kõige ees punases kleidis naine valge kotiga. Paremal veoauto, millelt laaditakse maha kaste arbuusidega. Taga suur kastanipuu ja majad.
works.de: In the picture, lower left edge, a heap of watermelons on the ground. There too, a seller in a white smock weighing a watermelon, surrounded by a number of people - buyers, in front a woman in a red dress with a white bag. On the right, a truck being unloaded of crates of watermelons. Behind, a large chestnut tree and houses.

works.d: Roheliste, pruunide ja kollaste laikudega maalitud kaarjas rannariba ja sügavsinine merepind.
works.de: A curved shoreline and deep blue sea surface painted with green, brown and yellow patches.

works.d: Noormehe rinnaportree. Pea rinnale langetatud, kerges pöördes vasakule; käed vaheliti rinnal. Ilme mõtlik, endassesüvenenud. Markantne, konstruktiivne siluett en face, toonitatud külmades toonides terava kontuuriga. Foonil teravnurksed geomeetrilised kujundid. Figuur ja foon maalitud hallikais ja ookerjais toonides (figuuril detailid antud sinisega.)
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man. Head lowered toward the chest, in a slight turn to the left; hands crossed on the chest. Expression pensive, absorbed in thought. A striking, constructive silhouette en face, toned in cold tones with a sharp contour. In the background, sharp-angled geometric shapes. The figure and background painted in greyish and ochreish tones (details on the figure given in blue).

works.d: Kõrge horisondiga, perspektiivilise kahanemiseta laual, mida katab ristuvate sirgete mustade ja hallide joontega ruuduline laudlina, asetsevad paremal ees suure tila ja käepidemega metallist kohvikann, selle taga vasemal 3-liitriline klaaspurk ja paremal kruus. Kompositsiooni vasemal osal tagapool etiketiga pudel selle kõrval asuva pruuni kõrge, pealt lahtitehtud paberist pakiga ning nende ees väikesemustriline punane pearätik. Fooniks pruun draperii punakaspruunide ja sinakasmustade varjudega.
works.de: On a table with a high horizon and no perspective diminution, covered with a checked tablecloth of crossing straight black and grey lines, there stands in front on the right a metal coffee pot with a large spout and handle, behind it on the left a 3-litre glass jar and on the right a mug. In the left part of the composition, further back, a bottle with a label next to a tall brown paper package opened at the top, and in front of them a small-patterned red headscarf. The background is a brown drapery with reddish-brown and bluish-black shadows.

works.d: Kompositsiooni kõrguse alumisel kolmveerandil meri, mis on maalitud sirgete horisontaalsete, enamasti paralleelsete joonte vahele jäävate värvipindadega (pruunikad, kollakad, helesinised, mustad, rohekad, lillakas-sinised). Esiplaanil ees kolm väikest ja vasakul keskplaanil suurem kivi, modelleeritud sirgete teravate kontuuride ja joontega. Pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the lower three-quarters of the composition's height, the sea, painted with patches of colour between straight, mostly parallel horizontal lines (brownish, yellowish, light blue, black, greenish, purplish-blue). In the foreground, three small stones, and in the left middle ground a larger stone, modelled with straight, sharp contours and lines. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Kompositsiooni vertikaalteljest veidi paremal hallide ja pruunide sirgjoontega modelleeritud kortsulise näoga vana naise portree otsevaates, kerges pöördes vasemale, pea veidi paremale kallutatud. Hallid, tagasikammitud juuksed lahuga vasakul pool (vaataja suhtes), kolmnurkse rinnasisselõikega ja suure kraega pruunis kleidis. Hallid silmad. Hallikassinine, kohati kollakaspruun foon.
works.de: Slightly to the right of the vertical axis of the composition, a frontal portrait of an old woman with a wrinkled face modelled with grey and brown straight lines, in a slight turn to the left, head tilted slightly to the right. Grey, combed-back hair with a parting on the left side (in relation to the viewer), wearing a brown dress with a triangular neckline and a large collar. Grey eyes. Greyish-blue, in places yellowish-brown background.

works.d: Hallide sirgjoonte ning hallide ja beežide värvipindadega modelleeritud keskealise naise portree otsevaates, kerges pöördes vasemale, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Ülespidiste silmanurkadega hallid mandlisilmad. Käisteta, nelinurkse dekolteega kollane kleit. Hall foon paremal õla kohal väikese kollase ning suurema beeži ristkülikuga.
works.de: A portrait of a middle-aged woman modelled with grey straight lines and grey and beige colour surfaces, facing front, in a slight turn to the left, gaze directed at the viewer. Grey almond eyes with upturned corners. A sleeveless yellow dress with a square neckline. Grey background with a small yellow and a larger beige rectangle above the right shoulder.

works.d: Heledajuukselise poisikese rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas tumehall kaherealine kinnise kaelusega kuub.
works.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired boy in three-quarter profile to the right. Wearing a dark grey double-breasted coat with a closed collar.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal küün, selle juures askeldava viie inimesega, kolm neist istuvad. Taga tume okaspuumets.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a barn, with five people busy near it, three of them sitting. Behind, a dark coniferous forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, selle paremal ja vasakul kaldal tihe põõsastik ja puud. Taamal puude vahel valge hoone punase katusega.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, on its right and left banks dense shrubbery and trees. Further back among the trees a white building with a red roof.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi, selle taga kõrgenev küngas kaskedega. Pildi ülaservas kitsas riba sinist taevast.
works.de: Water in the foreground, behind it a rising hill with birches. A narrow strip of blue sky at the top edge of the picture.

works.d: Lumises, siniste varjudega metsalagendikul keskel grupp heledatüvelisi kuuski, kaugemal metsaviirg. Rohekas taevas roosakad pilved.
works.de: In a snowy forest clearing with blue shadows, in the centre a group of light-trunked spruces, further away a strip of forest. Greenish sky with pinkish clouds.

works.d: Heledal laual triibulises vaasis kimp kirjusid lilli. Foon kirevate abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioon. Vasakul ülanurgas koobaltsinine liblikas.
works.de: On a light table, in a striped vase, a bunch of colourful flowers. The background is a combination of vivid abstract patches of colour. In the upper left corner a cobalt-blue butterfly.

works.d: Keskplaanis suurtest massiivsetest roosakashallidest horisontaalsetest ja vertikaalsetest plokkidest monument, vasakul langetatud peaga pronksist sõdur. Monumendil lilled. Esiplaanil valges puhvis varrukatega kleidis sammuv noor naine, punane nelgiõis käes. Foonil hallikasroheline maastik ja tume taevas.
works.de: In the middle ground a monument of large massive pinkish-grey horizontal and vertical blocks, on the left a bronze soldier with bowed head. Flowers on the monument. In the foreground a young woman walking in a white dress with puffed sleeves, a red carnation flower in her hand. In the background a greyish-green landscape and a dark sky.

works.d: Punastes ja rohelistes toonides abstraktsetest värvilaikudest koosnev kompositsioon. Keskel üksikud kollased laigud.
works.de: Composition of abstract colour patches in red and green tones. Isolated yellow patches in the centre.

works.d: Tugevasti geometriseeritud vormidega natüürmort: ees keskel äratuntavamalt antud pika kaelaga vaas, millel keerulise konfiguratsiooniga sang. Kompositsiooni põhiosa moodustab kollaste ja lillakaspruunide värvipindade kombinatsioon.
works.de: Strongly geometricised still life: in the middle foreground, a more recognisably rendered long-necked vase with a handle of complex configuration. The main part of the composition consists of a combination of yellow and purplish-brown colour areas.

works.d: Osaliselt selgepiirilistest, enamasti pinnalistest värvikatest kujunditest poolabstraktne kompositsioon. Ülal türkiissinisel taustal aimatavad hoonete kujutised. Keskel, rohekaskollakal põhjal tinglikult maalitud taimemotiive.
works.de: Semi-abstract composition of partly sharply defined, mostly flat, coloured shapes. Above, against a turquoise-blue background, discernible images of buildings. In the centre, on a greenish-yellowish ground, conventionally painted plant motifs.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon rannal lebavatest ja istuvatest inimestest. Ees vasakul raamatuga mehe kuju, vasakus ülanurgas paistavad naisterahva jalad. Keskel heledapäine külitav naine helesinises trikoos, tagapool kollases päevituskostüümis lebav naine, päikeseprillidega mees. Paremal istuv mees, tops käes, osa naisfiguurist sinises kostüümis. Mahedad hallikaspruunid toonid, üldistav maalilaad.
works.de: A figural composition of people lying and sitting on a beach. In front on the left a man's figure with a book, in the upper left corner a woman's legs can be seen. In the centre a light-haired woman lying on her side in a light blue swimsuit, further back a woman lying in a yellow sunbathing costume, a man with sunglasses. On the right a sitting man with a cup in his hand, part of a female figure in a blue costume. Mellow greyish-brown tones, generalising painting manner.

works.d: Lillakal maastikulisel foonil kikkhabeme ja vuntsidega mehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, mantel üle käe. Paremal, vaataja suunas hundikoera kuju. Heledad pastelsed toonid, pooltinglik maalilaad.
works.de: Against a purplish landscape background, the half-figure of a man with a goatee and moustache in a quarter-turn to the right, coat over his arm. On the right, facing the viewer, the figure of a wolfhound. Light pastel tones, semi-conventional painterly style.

works.d: Kääruline rannaäär üksikute rohekate kõrkjatuttidega. Keskel kolm seisvat figuuri rannarõivais. Vasakpoolne, kollases trikoos naine jalgupidi vees. Hallikad ja ookertoonid, tinglik käsitlus.
works.de: A curving shoreline with solitary greenish tufts of sedge. In the middle three standing figures in beach clothing. On the left, a woman in a yellow leotard standing in the water. Greyish and ochre tones, conventional treatment.

works.d: Lainepapist alusele kleebitud tekstiili ja paberitükid. Ülal paberist, beež, peaaegu ring, vasakul siidine beež ja hallikas-valge, paksem riie, paremal horisontaalselt kaks tumepruuni riide riba, tükike pitsi, rohelist ja beeži paberist pindu.
works.de: Pieces of textile and paper glued onto a corrugated cardboard base. Above, an almost circular shape of paper, beige, on the left a silky beige and grayish-white, thicker fabric, on the right two horizontal strips of dark brown fabric, a piece of lace, patches of green and beige paper.

works.d: Kujutise keskel kala naturaalne selgroog tumelillakal, sinakas-lillal foonil. Pool kalast kaetud rohelise, karvastatud paberiga.
works.de: In the middle of the image the natural spine of a fish on a dark purplish, bluish-purple background. Half of the fish covered with green, textured paper.

works.d: Beežikashallides, -sinakais toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon: kahel pool kulissidena murtud tüvede motiivid, nende vahel olevat lagedust läbib vasakult must, alt selgepiiriline kujund, mis ühineb tumeda aimatava silmapiiriga. Pastelltoonis ülaosa keskel krhämuliste joontega kujund.
works.de: A semi-abstract composition in beige-grey, bluish tones: on both sides motifs of broken tree trunks like coulisses, between them an open space crossed from the left by a black, sharply outlined form at the bottom, which joins the dark, suggested horizon. In the pastel-toned upper part, in the centre, a form with crumbly lines.

works.d: Valdavalt roostepruunides toonides abstraktne kompositsioon maastikumotiividega.Ees vasakul mäeveeru kujund lillakassinisel taustal, paremal katuse-taoline pind, lõhede-pragude tumedad jooned läbimas.
works.de: Predominantly rust-brown toned abstract composition with landscape motifs. In the foreground on the left the shape of a mountain slope against a purplish-blue background, on the right a roof-like surface, crossed by dark lines of cracks and fissures.

works.dm: laius: 480.0 cm (4-osaline x h 6); kõrgus: 244.0 cm
works.d: Valmiskujundite, aplikatsioonide, valdavalt kofreeritud pleki jm plekitükkidega kaetud ja osaliselt üle värvitud 4-osaline kompositsioon, keskmistel tahvlitel aatomiseene maalitud kujund, mille kohal reljeefsete tähtedega: THE END. Vasakul osal ümarkaareline nišš reljeefse hõbedase naisfiguuriga, viisnurk peaks. Paremal telliseimitatsioonis niššis hõbedane mehe reljeef, viisnurk pea asemel.
works.de: A 4-part composition covered with ready-made shapes, appliqués, mostly embossed tin and other pieces of tin, and partly overpainted; on the middle panels a painted image of an atomic mushroom cloud, above which in relief letters: THE END. On the left part a rounded arch niche with a relief silver female figure, a pentagram for a head. On the right, in a niche imitating brick, a silver relief of a man, a pentagram instead of a head.

works.d: Esiplaanil oleva laua taga istuva sileda, lühikesejuukselise soenguga naise poolfiguur. En face. Sõrmed toetavad alustassi servadele. Laual klaaskauss, leivataldrik, kruus.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman with smooth, short-haired hairstyle sitting behind a table in the foreground. En face. Her fingers rest on the edges of a saucer. On the table a glass bowl, a bread plate, a mug.

works.d: Esiplaanil - ... mäelõhendikult küpressidega oruks muutuv maa-ala. Paremal värvirikas lagendik kividega. Taamal kogu silmapiiril sinetavad kõrgmäed lumiste tippudega.
works.de: In the foreground - ... an area of land changing from a mountain gorge with cypresses into a valley. On the right a colourful clearing with stones. In the distance on the whole horizon, bluish high mountains with snowy peaks.
