works.d: Vasakult paremale suunduvate diagonaaljoontega laual hele linik rohelise kõrvitsa, õuntega taldriku ja kõrvitsalõigu vahel. Linikul kolm sibulat. Laud pehmes pruunis toonis, kõrvitsad intentsiivse-kollase ja rohelisega, õunad punasega maalitud.
works.de: On a table with diagonal lines running from left to right, a light cloth between a green pumpkin, a plate of apples and a piece of pumpkin. On the cloth three onions. The table in a soft brown tone, the pumpkins painted in intense yellow and green, the apples in red.

works.d: Väga kirjudes värvides sügismaastik. Esiplaanil lage nõlvak, keskosas sügisvärvides puud ja põõsad. Taamal kõrgendik metsaga. Metsa ääres paremal väike heledates toonides maja. Taevas sinakates-punakates-lillakates toonides. Maalitud väikese pintsliga, lühikeste tihedate löökidega.
works.de: A very colourful autumn landscape. In the foreground an open slope, in the middle part trees and bushes in autumn colours. Beyond, a hill with forest. At the edge of the forest on the right a small light-coloured house. The sky in bluish-reddish-purplish tones. Painted with a small brush, in short dense strokes.

works.d: Sinistes toonides suvemaastik kasesaluga esiplaanil. Paremal kännu otsas istuv heledas riietuses naine, vasakul kasetüve vastu toetuv mees heledas särgis ja tumedas vestis.
works.de: Summer landscape in blue tones with a birch grove in the foreground. On the right a woman in light clothing sitting on a stump, on the left a man in a light shirt and dark waistcoat leaning against a birch trunk.

works.d: Kirjudes, peamiselt lillakates toonides maalitud lehtmets.
works.de: Colourful, mainly purplish-toned painted leafy forest.

works.d: Prillidega noore mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Lühikesed juuksed, kõrge laup, lühike laiavõitu nina. Seljas hall pintsak, sinine pluus tumeda lipsuga, foon kirju halli põhitooniga. Maalitud laiade, erivärviliste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young bespectacled man, in a slight turn to the right. Short hair, high forehead, short broad nose. Wearing a grey jacket, a blue blouse with a dark tie, background variegated with a grey base tone. Painted with broad, differently coloured brushstrokes.

works.d: Punakais, pruunikais, sinistes toonides värviliseks maalitud tahveluks. Värvid pole kompaktsed, pigem hägusalt markeeritud. Paremal serval keskel pruuniga märgistatud aimatav lingi koht.
works.de: A panel painted in reddish, brownish, blue tones. The colours are not compact, rather hazily indicated. On the right edge, in the centre, marked with brown, the discernible place of a hinge.

works.d: Arhitektuurielementidest kombineeritud ruumilise muljega kompositsioon. Valdavalt gooti arhitektuuri kuuluvad tugipiilarid, kõrged teravkaarelised akna- ja ukseorvad, portaalid, treppide, tahukate motiivid läbisegi. Geomeetriliste kujundite vahele tungivad vasakult valgusvihud, moodustades keskele, aimatavale põrandale valguslaike. Motiivide vahel tagapool kaks figuuridepaari, eespool paremal silinderkübaras fotograafi poolfiguur külgvaates. Kompositsiooni keskmes pruunid, beežid toonid, ülal tagapool hallikassinised kõrgusse pürgivad kujundid.
works.de: A composition combining architectural elements with a spatial impression. Predominantly Gothic architectural buttresses, tall pointed-arch window and door openings, portals, motifs of stairs and blocks intermingle. Beams of light penetrate from the left between the geometric shapes, forming patches of light in the centre on a suggested floor. Behind the motifs, two pairs of figures, and in front on the right the half-figure of a photographer in a top hat, seen from the side. In the centre of the composition brown, beige tones, above in the background greyish-blue shapes striving upward.

works.t: Hr. Laurentsius onu Tommy onnikese soolaleivapeol - parajasti käib maailmalõpp e. HOME I.
works.d: Viilkatusega maja läbilõike sürrealistlik kujutis. Pildil ees keskel abielupaari poolfiguurid vaataja suunas, külgedel seinakõrgused lapsenäod piiravad ruumi. Majas sümmeetriliselt neli väikeste ruutudega akent kirka maastikuvaatega. Ees vasakul ümar laud praega, tagapool paremal olevustest ümbritsetud trumm-klaver. Tumeda lae keskel viilu tipus kujutatud pärani suu, hambad paljad, aplikatsiooni kujul lihaseline käsi-tiib paremal, skeletiosa vasakul. Kahel pool lae ja seina piiril liigutatavad mõõka hoidva käe kujutised. Pildil veel hulk joonistatud/maalitud, ruumilisi detaile. Kompositsioon ümbritsetud puitlattidega, aluspaber kinnitatud kleeplindiga.
works.de: A surrealist depiction of a cross-section of a gable-roofed house. In the picture, in the front centre, the half-figures of a married couple face the viewer, on the sides wall-height children's faces bound the space. In the house, symmetrically, four small-paned windows with a bright landscape view. In front on the left a round table with a roast, further back on the right a drum piano surrounded by beings. In the centre of the dark ceiling, at the tip of the gable, a wide-open mouth is depicted, teeth bared, a muscular hand-wing in the form of an appliqué on the right, a skeletal part on the left. On both sides, at the border of the ceiling and wall, movable depictions of a hand holding a sword. The picture also contains a number of drawn/painted, three-dimensional details. The composition is bordered with wooden strips, the backing paper is fastened with adhesive tape.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane mererand nelja paadiga. Taamal meri.
works.de: Sandy seashore with four boats in the foreground. The sea beyond.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane mererand, millele tõmmatud paat. Tagapool paremal vees kaks paati inimestega.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy sea shore with a boat pulled up onto it. Further back on the right in the water two boats with people.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage lumine väli, tagaplaanil puude vahel rida hooneid. Paremal inimfiguure.
works.de: In the foreground an open snowy field, in the background a row of buildings among the trees. Human figures on the right.

works.d: Hallil ümmargusel laual sale tume vaas valgete nartsissidega. Foon maalitud pruunide ja ookerjate pindadena.
works.de: A slender dark vase with white narcissi on a grey round table. Background painted as brown and ochre surfaces.

works.d: Esiplaanil sileda pinnaga veekogu, all, paremal tükike lagedat randa, kus profiilis paremale astuv, pikas rõivas naisfiguur. Paremal, keskel, üle veekogu maismaa-riba. Ülal sinakas-hallikas-rohekas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with a smooth surface, below, on the right, a strip of open shore, where a female figure in a long garment steps in profile to the right. On the right, in the middle, a strip of land across the water. Above, a bluish-grayish-greenish sky.

works.d: All, esiplaanil, horisontaalne rida värvilistest põõsastest, millede seas, vasakul, peenikese võraga ja väheste, kollakate lehtedega, üksik puu. Keskel lehe laiuses horisontaalne rida tumepunastes ja lillades toonides, madalaid maju valgete korstendega. Taevas tumesinine-rohekas-lilla.
works.de: Below, in the foreground, a horizontal row of colourful bushes, among which, on the left, a solitary tree with a thin crown and few yellowish leaves. In the middle, spanning the width of the sheet, a horizontal row in dark red and purple tones, low houses with white chimneys. Sky dark blue-green-purple.

works.dm: kõrgus: 93.0 cm (arm); laius: 80.5 cm; kõrgus: 85.5 cm; laius: 87.5 cm (arm)
works.d: Avatud aknalaual savivaas helepunaste moonidega. Aknast avaneb vaade suvisele tänavale.
works.de: A clay vase with light red poppies on an open windowsill. The window opens onto a summer street view.

works.d: Vaikelu motiiv. Esiplaanil laual ja kausis asetseva puuviljaga. Keskel lillevaas kahe tulbiõiega.
works.de: Still life motif. In the foreground fruit on a table and in a bowl. In the middle a flower vase with two tulip blossoms.

works.d: Ühtlasel heledal sinakasrohelisel taustal fragmente interjöörist: paremal vana õmblusmasin, tooli seljatugi selle tagant paistmas, paremal ülal raaminurk mööbli kaunistusmotiiv, vasakul ülal jalaga õmblusmasina väike kujutis. Maali keskosas leentoolis istuvad heledapäine noor naine ja naerusuine tüdruk, kass süles. Naisel seljas täpiline pluus, jalas pikad püksid, hoiab käevangus tüdrukut ja kassi, pilk neile suunatud. Nende taga taburetitaolisel alusel mehe pea, kaabu silmadel. Kasutatud slaidi, refleksid, varjud selgepiiriliste toonilaikudega pinnaliselt maalitud.
works.de: Against an even, light bluish-green background, fragments of an interior: on the right an old sewing machine, the back of a chair visible behind it, in the upper right corner of a frame a furniture decoration motif, in the upper left a small depiction of a treadle sewing machine. In the centre of the painting, a fair-haired young woman and a laughing girl with a cat in her lap are sitting in an armchair. The woman is wearing a spotted blouse and long trousers, holding the girl and the cat in her arms, her gaze directed at them. Behind them, on a stool-like stand, a man's head, hat over his eyes. A slide has been used, reflections, shadows painted flatly with clearly delineated patches of colour.

works.d: Kõrge, ühtlaselt helesinise taeva taustal, ererohelisel, üksikute põõsastega niidul naerunäoga neiu istumas. Noorikul seljas tumesinine, punaste natide, tikitud käiste, punase põllega setu rahvarüiivad, peas pärg. Kasutatud slaidi, jätab suurendatud värvifoto mulje.
works.de: Against a background of a high, evenly light blue sky, a smiling-faced girl sits on a bright green meadow with solitary bushes. The young woman wears dark blue Setu folk costume with red details, embroidered sleeves, a red apron, a wreath on her head. A slide has been used, giving the impression of an enlarged colour photograph.

works.d: Ees meresopp kividerühmaga paremal, ja kitsa kaldaribaga ees ja vasakul. Vasakul, kalda lähedal poolküljeli paat. Kaugemal, merre tungival maaninal linn (Tallinn).
works.de: In front, a sea inlet with a group of rocks on the right, and a narrow strip of shore in front and on the left. On the left, near the shore, a boat seen sideways. Further away, a town (Tallinn) on a headland jutting into the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil, suunaga eest taha, vanadest, poolraagus puudest ääristatud tee. Puude vahelt näha avatud uksega kirikut (külgvaates).
works.de: In the foreground, running from front to back, a road lined with old, half-bare trees. Through the trees a church with an open door is visible (in side view).

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannariba, taga kuni madala horisondini laiuv meri üksiku purjekaga. Paremal kaks kolmandikku pildipinnast pilves taevaga.
works.de: In the foreground a rocky strip of shore, behind it the sea extending to a low horizon with a single sailboat. On the right two-thirds of the picture surface is a cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannik, paremal lahesopp paljude purjekatega tagaplaanil. Taamal Tallinna panoraam Kadrioru poolt.
works.de: In the foreground a rocky coast, on the right a bay inlet with many sailboats in the background. In the distance, a panorama of Tallinn from the Kadriorg side.

works.d: Vaade viljapuuaiale: raagus puud piiratud tumedate kontuuridega, okste vahelt paistavad majad.
works.de: A view of an orchard: bare trees bounded by dark contours, houses visible through the branches.

works.d: Ümberringi hulgaliselt kastanilehti ja õisi. Nende keskel paremal sinine vaas ja vasakul punakas kann. Foon punakas-roheline.
works.de: All around numerous chestnut leaves and blossoms. In their middle on the right a blue vase and on the left a reddish jug. The background is reddish-green.

works.d: Tumedal taustal neli kummardavat figuuri kartulikorvidega, piiritletud musta üldistava kontuuriga.
works.de: Four bowing figures with potato baskets against a dark background, delineated by a black generalising contour.

works.d: Laual kaks vaasi tulpidega ja kauss. Esemed piiratud musta kontuuriga, foon rahutu.
works.de: On the table two vases with tulips and a bowl. Objects bounded by a black contour, restless background.

works.d: Neljanurgelisel laual pudel ja pokaal punase veiniga, pirnid ja mingi roheline taim. Maalitud pastoosselt, kontuurid musta värviga tugevalt toonitatud.
works.de: On a four-cornered table a bottle and a goblet with red wine, pears and some green plant. Painted pastily, contours strongly accentuated with black paint.

works.d: Avatud ukse juures, küljega vaataja poole seisev naisefiguur, kaenlas mingi nõu, jalgade juures kass. Paremal puupliit, selle peal oleva metallnõuga. Värvigamma tume, üksikute kollakate refleksidega. Läbi maalikihi kumab paberi roosa toon.
works.de: Beside an open door, a female figure standing sideways to the viewer, holding some vessel under her arm, a cat at her feet. On the right a wood stove with a metal vessel on top. Dark colour scheme, with occasional yellowish reflections. The pink tone of the paper shows through the paint layer.

works.d: Ees keskel poolitavad pildi kaheks paar peenikest puutüve. Paremas servas puudeoksi, vasakus maja nurk. Rohekas-hallist foonist oranžikas toonis kolmnurkne laik. Maalitud säpsivate, lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the front centre, a pair of thin tree trunks divide the picture in two. In the right edge tree branches, on the left the corner of a house. Against a greenish-grey background, a triangular patch in an orangish tone. Painted with jerky, short brushstrokes.

works.d: Punasel riidel istuv tiibadega, alasti mehefiguur. Pea pöördes paremale; parem käsi vasakul reiel, vasak toetumas taha. Vasakus servas samba kapiteeli ning ülaosa kujutis. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
works.de: A winged, nude male figure sitting on red fabric. Head turned to the right; right hand on the left thigh, left hand resting behind. In the left margin the depiction of a column capital and its upper part. Painted in an étude-like manner.

works.d: Kompositsioon inimfiguuridest, keskmega töö ülemises vasakus neljandikus. Esiplaanil vasakul seljaga vaataja poole pruunis rüüs naine. Koloriit hele. Maalitud suures osas pahtli või maalinoaga. Värvipind osaliselt faktuurne.
works.de: A composition of human figures, with the centre of the work in the upper left quarter. In the foreground on the left a woman in a brown robe seen from behind facing the viewer. Light coloration. Painted largely with a palette knife or painting knife. The paint surface partly textured.

works.d: Laiade pahtlitõmmetega roosakas-kollakas toonis kaetud pinda kraabitud istuva, noore naise täisfiguur. Ülakeha ette kummarunud. Parem käsi hoiab kinni vasaku, kõverdatud jala pahkluust. Vaade suunatud alla, käele.
works.de: On a surface covered in pinkish-yellow tones with broad palette-knife strokes, the full figure of a young seated woman scratched into it. Upper body bent forward. Right hand holds the ankle of the bent left leg. Gaze directed downward, at the hand.

works.d: Keskplaanis, valgetel linadel lamav naisakt, põlved kõverdatud, parem käsi niudeil, vasak küünarnukist kõverdatult voodil, pea kuklasse heidetud. Vasakult langeb valgus naise kõhule. Foon rohekashall, esiplaan maalitud pastoosses värvilises pintslikirjas.
works.de: In the central plan, a female nude lying on white sheets, knees bent, right hand on hip, left arm bent at the elbow on the bed, head thrown back. Light falls on the woman's belly from the left. Background greenish-grey, foreground painted in a pastose, colourful brush stroke.

works.d: Pruunis vestis ja särgis istuva prillidega mehe poolfiguur, kehaga kerges pöördes paremale, pea kallutatud veidi vasemale, poolprofiilis paremale, terav pilk suunatud vaatajale; käed vabalt süles. Sirge lühike, veidi esiletungiv nina, taha kammitud hallikassegused juuksed, kortsuline nägu tahtejõulise lõuaga, alaspidiste suunurkadega huultega, kõik modelleeritud teravate sirgete joontega. All vasemal, lauanurgal väike lapik pudel tumeda korgiga. Hallikasroheline neutraalne foon ülalpool, all geometriseeritud tumerohelised ja pruunid pinnad.
works.de: Half-figure of a bespectacled man sitting in a brown waistcoat and shirt, his body slightly turned to the right, head tilted slightly to the left, in three-quarter profile to the right, a sharp gaze directed at the viewer; hands resting loosely in his lap. A straight, short, slightly protruding nose, grayish-mixed hair combed back, a wrinkled face with a determined chin, lips with downturned corners of the mouth, all modelled with sharp straight lines. At lower left, at the corner of the table, a small flat bottle with a dark cork. A greyish-green neutral background above, below geometricised dark green and brown surfaces.

works.d: Kollakasbeežil alusel, mida katab pruun draperii, mis moodustab tagaplaanil fooni maali laiuse enamiku osas ning mille äär langeb vabalt üle aluse esiserva, asetsevad keskteljest veidi paremal kõrge laia kaelaga klaaskann, vasakul vormileib paberil, selle ees, vasakus kuldlõikes kaks suurt sibulat. Paremal väikesel supitaldrikul suur glasuuritud hele hallikassinine kruus.
works.de: On a yellowish-beige base covered by a brown drapery, which forms the background across most of the width of the painting and whose edge falls loosely over the front edge of the base, slightly right of the central axis stand a tall, wide-necked glass jug, on the left a loaf of bread on paper, in front of it, in the left golden section, two large onions. On the right, on a small soup plate, a large glazed light greyish-blue mug.

works.d: Heledates teravates värvitoonides ning kontrastsetes hele-tumedusastmeis olustikuliste jutustavate detailiderikas kompositsioon. Keskplaanil maali keskel roheline metsatransportöör paremast äärest keskpaigani diagonaalselt kulgevate vagunite kõrval. Paremal esiplaanil poolprofiilis paremale palke siduv mees paljastatud ülakehaga, paremal mees profiilis paremale pootshaagiga, temast paremal ja veidi eespool poolprofiilis paremale ette kummardunud mees käsimootorsaega. Vasemal äärel keskplaanil väike palgivirn, kütusepaagid ning sara. Tagaplaanil keskpaigast parema servani ning vasakul äärel maali veerandi laiuse osas mets. Vorme lihtsustav modelleerimine.
works.de: A composition rich in narrative, genre-scene detail, in bright, sharp tones and contrasting light-dark gradations. In the middle ground, at the centre of the painting, a green forest conveyor beside wagons running diagonally from the right edge to the middle. In the right foreground, in half-profile facing right, a man with a bared upper body binding logs; to the right a man in profile facing right with a boat hook; to his right and slightly further forward, in half-profile, a man bent forward facing right with a hand-held chainsaw. On the left edge, in the middle ground, a small pile of logs, fuel tanks and a shed. In the background, from the middle to the right edge, and on the left edge over a width of a quarter of the painting, forest. Simplifying modelling of forms.

works.d: Kompositsioon kööginõudest ja -tarvetest pruunil alusel ning teravalt kontuuridega modelleeritud voldistikuga kollase draperii taustal,  milles esinevad beežikad, sinepikollased, helepruunid, lillad teravalt piiritletud varjundid. Esiplaanil keskel gaasipliidi küttekolde nõudealus, paremal äärel spiraalvahusti. Tagaplaanil vasakul emaileeritud roheline teekann, selle kõrval seebitoos roosaka seebiga, nende ees suur sinise triibuga valge kruus. Paremas kuldlõikes tagaplaanil valgel paberilehel priimus, sellest paremal tagapool suur klaaspurk.
works.de: A composition of kitchen dishes and utensils on a brown base, against the background of a sharply contoured, modelled folded yellow drapery in which sharply delineated beige, mustard-yellow, light brown, and lilac shades appear. In the foreground, in the centre, a pot stand from a gas stove burner, on the right edge a spiral whisk. In the background at left, an enamelled green teapot, next to it a soap dish with pinkish soap, in front of them a large white mug with a blue stripe. In the background, in the right golden section, on a white sheet of paper, a primus stove, to the right and behind it a large glass jar.

works.d: Istuva mehe rinnafiguur, pea ja ülakeha kergelt vasemale pööratud, vasak käsi toetub kõrgemale alusele. Pruunid juuksed, sinakashall pintsak, pruun vest ja beež pullover. Eriti mehe nägu ning käsi on modelleeritud tihedate erivärviliste pintslilöökidega. Elektri- ja hallikassinine foon.
works.de: Half-length figure of a seated man, head and upper body turned slightly to the left, left hand resting on a raised support. Brown hair, bluish-grey jacket, brown waistcoat and beige pullover. Especially the man's face and hand are modelled with dense brushstrokes of varying colours. Electric and greyish-blue background.

works.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon, milles domineerivad punane, kollane, külm roheline ja hall toon. Esiplaanil on selgemini eristatav mehe figuur ja pasunad. Mehe selja taga rahvamass lippudega. Tagaplaanil loosungite ja lippudega ehitatud majad, ülaservas tükike erksinist kevadist taevast.
works.de: Composition of coloured geometric shapes, in which red, yellow, cold green and grey tones dominate. In the foreground a man's figure and trumpets are more clearly distinguishable. Behind the man's back a crowd with flags. In the background buildings built with slogans and flags, in the upper edge a piece of bright blue spring sky.

works.d: Geomeetriliste kujundite ja joonte kombineerimisel saadud kompositsioon, kasutatud külmi siniseid ja rohelisi toone, halli, kollast ja ookrit. Silmapiiril tugev tumesinine aktsent kõrgust ja kaugust rõhutamas, all esiplaanil järvesilm.
works.de: A composition obtained by combining geometric shapes and lines, using cold blue and green tones, grey, yellow and ochre. On the horizon a strong dark blue accent emphasising height and distance, at the bottom in the foreground a patch of lake water.

works.d: Tallinna panoraamvaade. Esiplaanil vasakul jämedad kanalisatsioonitorud ja lage tühermaa, keskplaanis väikeste majade katusteräga, tagaplaanil eralduvad foonil hotell "Viru" ja Oleviste kiriku siluetid. Maalitud pastelltoonides joonte, geomeetriliste värvipindade kombinatsioonina kohati krunti paista lastes.
works.de: Panoramic view of Tallinn. In the foreground on the left thick sewage pipes and bare wasteland, in the middle ground the roof ridges of small houses, in the background the silhouettes of the hotel "Viru" and St. Olaf's Church stand out against the background. Painted in pastel tones as a combination of lines and geometric colour surfaces, with the ground occasionally allowed to show through.

works.d: Linnavaade, maalitud vaatega ülalt alla katustele, mille tagant paistavad kirikute ja linnamüüri tornid. Esiplaanil õu nelja raagus puuga, lõuendi ülaosas kitsas riba halli taevast. Maalitud sinakashallides toonides mõne üksiku pruuni aktsendiga.
works.de: A city view, painted with a view from above down onto the roofs, behind which the towers of churches and the town wall appear. In the foreground a yard with four bare trees, at the top of the canvas a narrow strip of grey sky. Painted in bluish-grey tones with a few isolated brown accents.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinine tõstuk. Sellest ülalpool autod ja kaubavagunid, paremal paat. Keskplaanis vasakul suure kraana alumine osa, paremal suur laev kai ääres. Ülaservas hooneid ja hele taevas. Joonte ja väikeste värvipindade geometriseerimine vaheldub maalilisusega.
works.de: In the foreground a blue lift/hoist. Above it cars and freight wagons, on the right a boat. In the middle ground, on the left, the lower part of a large crane, on the right a large ship at the quay. At the top edge buildings and a bright sky. The geometrisation of lines and small colour surfaces alternates with painterliness.

works.d: Esiplaanil hallides pükstes ja särgis tööline masinat lükkamas. Temast vasakul ja all servas masinad, paremal suur paberirull. Pildi ülaosas vabriku sisseseade, kraana punast tala tõstmas, viis inimfiguuri. Hallides, pruunides ja rohelistes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a worker in grey trousers and shirt pushing a machine. To his left and at the lower edge machines, on the right a large paper roll. In the upper part of the picture factory equipment, a crane lifting a red beam, five human figures. In grey, brown and green tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks mehe- ja kaks naisefiguuri. Figuuri üksikelemente markeeriv nurgeline joonistus selgelt näha. Vasakus ülanurgas veekogu, keskel hooned, pildi ülaosas silmapiiril rohelistes, sinistes ja ookritoonides mägine maastik. Kogu kompositsioon geomeetriliselt liigendatud ning värviga kaetud.
works.de: In the foreground two male and two female figures. The angular drawing marking the individual elements of the figures is clearly visible. In the upper left corner a body of water, in the centre buildings, at the top of the picture on the horizon a mountainous landscape in green, blue and ochre tones. The whole composition articulated geometrically and covered with colour.

works.d: Hallis ülikonnas mees toolil istumas, mõtlik näoilme, käed ristatud sõrmedega põlvedel. Helehall foon. Käed, nägu, püksisäär ja pintsaku varrukad hoolikalt läbi maalitud. Valdavalt hallid ja pruunid toonid.
works.de: A man in a grey suit sitting on a chair, pensive expression, hands crossed with fingers on his knees. Light grey background. Hands, face, trouser leg and jacket sleeves carefully painted through. Predominantly grey and brown tones.

works.d: Istuv heledapäine naisakt, käed diivanile peopesadega toetatud, lopsakas figuur. Foonil paremal aken, vasakul sein pildiga. Hallides, pruunides ja kollastes toonides, pinnad jaotatud üksikuteks värvikildudeks.
works.de: A seated fair-haired female nude, hands resting palms-down on the sofa, a voluptuous figure. In the background, a window on the right, a wall with a picture on the left. In grey, brown and yellow tones, the surfaces divided into individual patches of colour.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm mehefiguuri: vasakpoolsel hallipäisel ja hallis riides mehel käes mõõdulatt, keskmisel siniste pükstega mehel kott üle õla, parempoolsel peas nokkmüts ja jalas hallid püksid. Tagaplaanil raskesti eristatavate üksikasjadega maastik. Kõik pinnad killustatud väikesteks geomeetrilisteks kujunditeks ja hallide, pruunide, siniste, kollaste, roheliste toonidega täidetud.
works.de: In the foreground three male figures: the man on the left, grey-haired and dressed in grey, holds a measuring rod, the man in the middle, wearing blue trousers, has a bag over his shoulder, the man on the right wears a peaked cap and grey trousers. In the background a landscape with details that are difficult to distinguish. All surfaces fragmented into small geometric shapes and filled with tones of grey, brown, blue, yellow, and green.

works.d: Esiplaanil seadeldis õunte ja kannuga natüürmordi maalimiseks. Paremal ja vasakul servas molbertid, ülemises servas mitu erinevas skemaatilisuse astmes antud figuuri, keskel üksik inimene molberti taga. Kogu maali ulatuses on joonistus nähtaval, näod ja esemed vaid tükati värviga kaetud, rõhutatult lõpetamata.
works.de: In the foreground an arrangement for painting a still life of apples and a jug. Molberts (easels) at the right and left edges, at the top edge several figures given in varying degrees of schematisation, in the centre a single person behind an easel. Throughout the entire extent of the painting the drawing is visible, faces and objects are only partly covered with paint, emphatically unfinished.

works.d: Otsevaates, istuva hallipäise mehe portree. Mõlemad käed toetuvad põlvedele, seljas mereroheline kindralimunder aumärkidega rinnal ja pagunitega õlal. Kortsuline nägu sinakashallil foonil, mis vasakul läheb üle helesiniseks ja paremal kollaseks, all vasakus servas on foon pruun. Maalitud kunstnikule tüüpilises värvilaikudest ja -joontest tervikut kombineerides.
works.de: A frontal-view portrait of a seated grey-haired man. Both hands rest on the knees, wearing a sea-green general's uniform with decorations on the chest and epaulettes on the shoulders. A wrinkled face against a bluish-grey background, which turns light blue on the left and yellow on the right, and in the lower left corner the background is brown. Painted in the artist's typical manner of combining the whole from patches and lines of colour.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollased, pooleldi raagus, väga skemaatiliselt antud puud. Tagaplaanil vanalinna siluett paari kirikutorniga. Maalitud etüüdilikult, pintslilööke ja püstjooni rõhutades. Hallikaspruun üldkoloriit, üksikute roheliste värvilaikudega.
works.de: In the foreground, yellow, half-bare, very schematically rendered trees. In the background, the silhouette of the old town with a couple of church towers. Painted in an étude-like manner, emphasising brushstrokes and vertical lines. Greyish-brown overall colour scheme, with isolated patches of green.

works.d: Lühikeste juuste ja sirge ninajoonega tütarlapse kolmveerandportree otsevaates ja istuvas asendis. Seljas revääridega jakk ja seelik, käed kokkupandult põlvedel. Maalitud geometriseeritult, värvilised tahud moodustavad struktuuri, mis üldistub kujutiseks. Foonil vasakul kiirtevihku meenutavad tahud, paremal suuremad helepruunid pinnad. Kasutatud halle, külmi rohelisi ja ookritoone, kohati ka paberit peale kleebitud, kohati ka riiet.
works.de: A three-quarter portrait, front-facing and seated, of a girl with short hair and a straight nose line. Wearing a jacket with lapels and a skirt, hands folded on the knees. Painted in a geometricised manner, coloured facets form a structure that is generalised into an image. In the background on the left facets reminiscent of a bundle of rays, on the right larger light brown surfaces. Greys, cold greens and ochre tones are used, in places paper is also glued on, in places also fabric.

works.d: Naise kolmveerandportree otsevaates: jalg üle põlve asetatud, käed kokkupandult põlvedel. Figuur antud geomeetriliselt, tahkudena, mis moodustavad ruumilise struktuuri. Kollakaspruunides, lillades ja hallides toonides. Foon hall.
works.de: Three-quarter portrait of a woman in direct view: leg placed over the knee, hands folded on the knees. The figure is rendered geometrically, in facets, forming a spatial structure. In yellowish-brown, purple and grey tones. Background grey.

works.dm: kõrgus: 78.1 cm (km); laius: 65.2 cm; kõrgus: 79.8 cm; laius: 63.0 cm (km)
works.d: Valkjashallides, pruunides toonides geometriseerivalt lahendatud ateljee vaade. Paremal molbert kireva paletiga, vasakul lauanurk. Tagapool ja seinal vasakul värvikamad maalid.
works.de: A geometrically resolved view of a studio in whitish-grey and brown tones. On the right an easel with a colourful palette, on the left the corner of a table. Behind and on the wall on the left, more colourful paintings.

works.d: Heleda draperiiga punakaspruunil foonil paremal natüürmordi seadeldis piimanõu, kruusi ja kannuga, põllulilled anumates. Vasakul molbertile paigutatud osa lõuendist, mille paremasse nurka markeeritud kruusi kujutis. Maal kohati akvarellilikult õhuke, värve tugevasti lahustatud.
works.de: Against a light drapery on a reddish-brown background, on the right a still-life arrangement of a milk vessel, a mug and a jug, field flowers in vessels. On the left, a portion of the canvas placed on an easel, in the right corner of which the depiction of a mug is marked. The painting is in places watercolour-like thin, the paints heavily diluted.

works.d: Esiplaani keskel kõrge, haruliste okstega puu, kroomroheline puukroon heleda taeva taustal. Tagapool madalad pruunikashallid taluhooned.
works.de: In the centre of the foreground a tall tree with branching boughs, chromium-green treetop against a light sky background. Behind it, low brownish-grey farm buildings.

works.d: Väikese kapi pealsel klaaspurk mitmesuguste õitsvate taimede ja rohtudega. Purk taimedega peegeldub vastu kapipealsel. Foon beež, kohati papi pind värvidega katmata. Taimede taha foonile on pruuni värviga markeeritud nelinurk, siia-sinna on foonile tõmmatud püstjooni. Valitsevad pruunid, rohelised ja sinised värvitoonid, lopsakas maalimisviis.
works.de: On top of a small cabinet a glass jar with various flowering plants and herbs. The jar with the plants is reflected on the cabinet top. The background is beige, in places the surface of the cardboard is left uncovered with paint. Behind the plants a rectangle is marked on the background in brown paint, and here and there vertical lines are drawn on the background. Brown, green and blue tones predominate, a lush manner of painting.

works.d: Suur kompositsioon esiplaanilt sügavusse suunduvate lillelettidega, mida ülalt varjavad kirevad päevavarjud. Lillelettide vahel suures dekoratiivses üldistuses antud inimesed. Lettidel lillekimbud, gladioolide puhmad, tagaplaanil uusehitused ja kraana. Taevas helesinine, ere päikesevalgus annab kõigele teravad varjud. Figuuridest esiplaanil tütarlaps ja naine ning paremal valge kotiga naine ning mees. Maalitud kirevate, dekoratiivsete värvipindadena.
works.de: A large composition with flower stalls receding from the foreground into the depth, shaded above by colourful parasols. Between the flower stalls, people rendered in a large decorative generalisation. On the stalls, bouquets of flowers, clumps of gladioli, in the background new buildings and a crane. The sky is light blue, bright sunlight casting sharp shadows on everything. Among the figures in the foreground, a girl and a woman, and on the right a woman with a white bag and a man. Painted as colourful, decorative colour surfaces.

works.d: Värvilise joontesäbruga antud lillekimp. Foon vasakult hall, paremal koobaltsinine, erepunane, allosas punakaspruun ja akvarellilikult sulav. Maalikiht õhuke, kohati papp värviga katmata.
works.de: A bouquet of flowers rendered with colourful curling lines. Background grey on the left, cobalt blue and bright red on the right, reddish-brown at the bottom and blending in a watercolour-like manner. The paint layer is thin, the cardboard in places left uncovered by paint.

works.d: Õrna värvikihiga, akvarellilikult, peamisi detaile markeerivalt antud tänavapilt. Keskel pildi sügavusse suunduv tänav rohelise auto ja pruuni, kuuri meenutava majaga vasakul. Paremal hele kolmekorruseline, punakaspruuni katusega maja, mille aknad ja uksed värviliste joontega tähistatud. Maja ees roheline sõiduauto. Silmapiiril elektri- ja telefoniposte, puuderohelust. Taevas helehall, üksikute helesiniste laikudega. Papp suures osas värviga katmata.
works.de: A street scene rendered with a thin layer of colour, in a watercolour-like manner, marking the main details. In the centre, a street receding into the depth of the picture, with a green car and a brown house resembling a shed on the left. On the right, a light-coloured three-storey house with a reddish-brown roof, whose windows and doors are marked with coloured lines. In front of the house, a green motor car. On the horizon, electricity and telephone poles, greenery of trees. The sky is light grey, with isolated light blue patches. The cardboard is largely left uncovered with paint.

works.d: Õhukesel värvikihil ja joontemängul põhinev lillekompositsioon. Pastelsel vanaroosal, hallil, ookerkollasel foonil virtuoosse joonekäsitlusega lillekimp kirevais toonides.
works.de: A floral composition based on a thin layer of paint and play of lines. On a pastel old-rose, grey, ochre-yellow background a bouquet of flowers in vivid tones rendered with virtuoso linework.

works.d: Esiplaanilt kaarega pildi sügavusse suunduv tänav, mida kahelt poolt palistavad puud. Tänaval vasakul rida vanamoelisi sõidukeid, paremal suur käru. Keset tänavat üks jalgrattur ja tänavat ületav inimene. Vasakul tänava servas ülestõstetud tõkkepuu ning rida maju. Taevas helesinine. Maalikiht väga õhuke, kohati aluspappi paljaks jättev, maalimisviis etüüdlik, toonid pastelsed.
works.de: A street curving from the foreground into the depth of the picture, lined on both sides by trees. On the street to the left a row of old-fashioned vehicles, on the right a large cart. In the middle of the street a cyclist and a person crossing the street. On the left edge of the street a raised barrier pole and a row of houses. The sky light blue. The paint layer very thin, in places leaving the underlying cardboard bare, the manner of painting sketch-like, the tones pastel.

works.d: Paremas servas suur punane muna meenutav geomeetriline kujund, mille alumine parem osa läheb üle täisnurkseks. Muna vasakpoolses osas suur valge laik. Kujund toetub mustale pinnale, foon sidrunikollane.
Hallid, punased, lillad ja mustad geomeetrilised kujundid ja neid kompositsiooniks organiseerivad jooned all vasakus nurgas, foon vasakul servas ja ülal kollastes toonides.
Nurgelistest mitmevärvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest peaaegu abstraktne kompositsioon, milles kohati aimata inimfiguure.

Istuva vanema mehe põlvportree. Mehel seljas lahtise kaelusega helesinine särk ja hallid püksid, käed puhkavad põlvedel. Nägu tõmmu, kergelt kongus ninaga, kitsa suu ja esileulatuva lõuaga. Hallid lühikesed juuksed, juustepiir meelekohtadelt taandunud. Fooniks majade, trammi ja bussiga skematiseeritud linnavaade. Maalitud joonte ja värvipindade räguna heledates pastelsetes toonides.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated elderly man. The man is wearing a light blue open-collared shirt and grey trousers, his hands resting on his knees. His face is swarthy, with a slightly hooked nose, narrow mouth and a protruding chin. Short grey hair, hairline receded at the temples. The background is a schematised cityscape with houses, a tram and a bus. Painted in a jumble of lines and colour surfaces in light pastel tones.

works.d: Paremalt ookrikarva, vasakult taevasinisel foonil soliidne hallis ülikonnas vanem mees käetugedega toolis istumas. Mehel hallid lühikesed juuksed, kolmnurgaks kokkupigistatud suu ja otsast punetav nina. Vasak käsi puhkab tooli käetoel, parem põlvel. Figuuriosa antud väikeste värvikildude kombinatsioonina.
works.de: Against an ochre-coloured background on the right and a sky-blue background on the left, a solid elderly man in a grey suit sitting in an armchair. The man has short grey hair, a mouth pressed into a triangle, and a reddening tip of the nose. Left hand resting on the armrest, right hand on the knee. The figure part rendered as a combination of small patches of colour.

works.d: Tihedatest, küllastunud toonides abstraktsetest värvilaikudest kompositsioon. Beežikashalli taeva all aimatav kupliline maastik. Vasakul summutatud pruunikates toonides, paremal nõlv erksamas, heledamas gammas. Esiplaanil osa veekogust. Jõuline pintslikäik, küllalt pastoosne maal.
works.de: A composition of dense, saturated abstract colour patches. Under a beige-grey sky, a domed landscape is suggested. On the left in muted brownish tones, on the right a slope in a brighter, lighter range. In the foreground part of a body of water. Vigorous brushwork, a rather pastose painting.

works.d: 3/4 alumisest maaliosast kujutab osalt selgepiirilisi geometriseeritud, osalt abstraktseid kollase-rohelise-halli kooskõlas pindu. Vasakul puutüve motiiv. Selle kohal arhitektuuridetailidega linnavisioon. Paremal ülal, vesihalli taeva foonil Niguliste tornikiiver.
works.de: 3/4 of the lower part of the painting depicts partly clear-outlined geometricised, partly abstract surfaces in a harmony of yellow-green-grey. On the left a tree-trunk motif. Above it a city vision with architectural details. At the upper right, against a watery-grey sky background, the spire of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste).

works.d: Poolenisti erksinise taeva ja roheluse taustal keskel kaks puud. Paremal joonterägastikuga oksi markeeriv kuuse motiiv, vasakul lehtpuu. Maal rohelistes-sinistes toonides rahutu pintslikäiguga.
works.de: Against a background half bright blue sky and half greenery, in the centre two trees. On the right a fir motif marking branches with a tangle of lines, on the left a deciduous tree. The painting is in green-blue tones with a restless brushstroke.

works.d: Merepiir jagab kahvatu taeva ja liivaranna pildipinnal põigiti pooleks. Esiplaanil hoogsate laiade tõmmetega markeeritud beežikaspruun kallas, triibuna järgnev rohekassinine meri. Silmapiir pisut kaarjas.
works.de: The sea horizon divides the pale sky and the sandy beach diagonally across the picture surface. In the foreground a beige-brown shore marked with vigorous broad strokes, followed by a strip of greenish-blue sea. The horizon is slightly curved.

works.d: Kollase, punase, musta, halli ja sinise tooniga värvilaikudest kompositsioon. Peen joontesõrestik jagab pinnad kohati geomeetriliselt selgeteks kujunditeks. Paremas alumises nurgas punane ruut, vasak alumine neljandik valdavalt neutraalne hall pind.

Ülaltvaade poolabstraktsele maastikule Tallinna panoraamiga. Ligi pool alumisest maaliosast kujutab kirgast kollase-rohelise-pruuni, üksteise sisse hajuvate värvilaikudega pinda. Selle kohal katuseviile, torne heleda mere ja hallide pilvetriipudega taeva taustal.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of a semi-abstract landscape with a panorama of Tallinn. Nearly half of the lower part of the painting depicts a bright surface of yellow-green-brown colour patches diffusing into one another. Above it roof gables, towers against the background of a light sea and a sky with grey cloud stripes.

works.d: Kahvatusinise taeva taustale markeeritud hõreda lehestikuga puud. Tüvede taga silmapiiril paistab pastellroheline mets. Keskpäevane valgus muudab toonid õrnaks. Maalikiht õhuke, laseb aluspinnal läbi kumada.
works.de: Trees with sparse foliage marked against a pale blue sky background. Behind the trunks, on the horizon, a pastel green forest is visible. The midday light makes the tones soft. The paint layer is thin, allowing the ground to shine through.

works.d: Esiplaanil muru üksikute põõsapuhmastega. Keskel hooneid. Nende taga puude grupid.
works.de: In the foreground grass with single bushes. In the middle buildings. Behind them groups of trees.

works.d: Rohekaspruunil taustal, punasel alusel pruunikas ümar vaas suure buketi kirevate põllulilledega (karikakrad, kellukesed, ohakad jm.). Maalitud väga pastoosselt, iga õit värviga plastiliselt vormides.
works.de: On a greenish-brown background, on a red base, a brownish round vase with a large bouquet of colourful field flowers (daisies, bluebells, thistles etc.). Painted very pastosely, each flower plastically shaped with colour.

works.dm: lehe laius: 26.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 26.5 cm
works.d: Lokkispäise, põskhabemega, sinises ohvitseri trentšis noormehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Üle vasaku õla visatud kasukas.
works.de: Half-figure of a curly-haired, side-whiskered young man in a blue officer's trench coat, in half-profile to the right. A fur coat thrown over his left shoulder.

works.dm: lehe laius: 26.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 26.3 cm
works.d: Punases, õlgu vabaks jätvas sügavadekolteelises kleidis noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Taustaks pilvine taevas.
works.de: Bust of a young woman in three-quarter profile to the left, in a red, deep-décolleté dress leaving the shoulders bare. Background of cloudy sky.

works.d: Valges parukas keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in a white wig, in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal avatud tiibuksed, seinal peegel, laes kroonlühter.
works.de: Open double doors on the left and right, a mirror on the wall, a chandelier on the ceiling.

works.d: Esiplaanil plangu taga  majade vaheline õu lahtise trepi ja pumbaga. Taamal majad ja Pauluse kiriku torn.
works.de: In the foreground, behind a fence, a courtyard between houses with an open staircase and a pump. In the distance houses and the tower of St. Paul's Church.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrge kuusk ja põõsad, taamal majad.
works.de: Tall spruce and bushes in the foreground, houses in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil osa pargist kõrgete raagus puude ja üksikute inimfiguuridega. Taga lumiste katustega majad.
works.de: In the foreground part of a park with tall bare trees and a few human figures. Behind, houses with snowy roofs.

works.d: Tuhmile temperaga alusmaalile kantud puhta värvi plekkidega sõudjate figuurid ja veepinna läiked.
works.de: Figures of rowers and the gleam of the water's surface applied in patches of pure colour over a dull tempera underpainting.

works.d: Avar kupliline maastik üksikute lumelaikudega pruunikatel põldudel. Küngaste vahel puudegrupid majadega, veesilmad. Kaugemal metsaga kaetud nõlvad. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: Wide domed landscape with single patches of snow on brownish fields. Between the hills groups of trees with houses, small bodies of water. Further away slopes covered with forest. Expressive painting style.

works.d: Otsevaates naise rinnaportree: naisel pisut puhevil sõõrmetega nina ja tugeva ülahuulega suu, tumedad kitsad kulmukaared, kõrge laup. Hallisegused satäänid juuksed kuklasse rullidesse seatud. Seljas tume, valge pitskraega kleit, rinnal rahvuslikus laadis sõlg.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a woman: the woman has a slightly flared nose and a mouth with a full upper lip, dark narrow eyebrow arches, a high forehead. Greyish satin hair arranged in rolls at the nape. Wearing a dark dress with a white lace collar, a brooch in national style on the chest.

works.d: Värvilistest stiliseeritud kujunditest kombineeritud dekoratiivne lõvipea kujutis, kelle nina ja näoosa moodustab seisev naisfiguur. Valdavalt punased, pruunid, kollased toonid, must kontuurjoon lainjaid pindu eraldamas.
works.de: A decorative image of a lion's head composed of coloured stylised forms, whose nose and facial area are formed by a standing female figure. Predominantly red, brown, yellow tones, with a black contour line separating the wavy surfaces.

works.d: Kolme tööriietuses mehe rinnapilt - kaks otsevaates, keskmine profiilis paremale. Näovärv tume, riietus väviline, foonil geomeetrilised kujundid.
works.de: Bust portraits of three men in work clothes - two in frontal view, the middle one in profile to the right. Dark facial colouring, colourful clothing, geometric shapes in the background.

works.d: Kahe mehe rinnafiguurid - vasakpoolne heledapäine ja sinises särgis, parempoolne tumedajuukseline pruunis pintsakus.
works.de: Chest figures of two men - the one on the left fair-haired and in a blue shirt, the one on the right dark-haired in a brown jacket.

works.d: Punakajuukselise, terava lõuahabemega mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis vasakule. Vasak käsi mõõga käepidemel, parem kübarat hoidev käsi toetumas vasakul asuva laua nurgale. Rikkaliku tikandiga 17. sajandi riietuses pitskrae ja kätistega. Vasakul üleval asuva vapi all kiri.
works.de: Full figure of a reddish-haired man with a pointed chin beard, in half profile to the left. His left hand rests on the hilt of a sword, his right hand, holding a hat, rests on the corner of a table located on the left. He wears richly embroidered 17th-century dress with a lace collar and cuffs. Below a coat of arms located upper left, an inscription.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, tagapool veepinnal peegelduv sild, ebamäärane ratsamonumendi siluett ja pargipuud.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, behind it a bridge reflecting on the water surface, an indistinct silhouette of an equestrian monument and park trees.

works.d: Põlvpilt, peaaegu enface, pea kallutatud paremale, punases pitsidega kleidis, vasakus käes liilia; taustal Keila-Joa mõisa vaade.
works.de: Knee-length portrait, almost en face, head tilted to the right, in a red lace dress, a lily in her left hand; in the background a view of Keila-Joa manor.

works.d: Gooti aknaga võlvitud kabelis kuus vanemat meest leinamas, pead paljastatud, käed kõhul. Paremal, nende ees alusele asetatud sark - siniste nuppudega hiiglaslik mobiiltelefon. Maalil tumedad toonid, kohmakas kujutamisviis.
works.de: In a vaulted chapel with a Gothic window, six older men mourning, heads bared, hands on their stomachs. On the right, in front of them, placed on a stand - a giant mobile phone with blue buttons. Dark tones in the painting, clumsy manner of depiction.

works.d: Raudtee ääres, vaguni taustal keskmest vasakul naise 3/4 figuur veidi pöördes paremale. Punane seelik ja pearätt, roheline pluus seljas. Vasakus tõstetud käes videokaamera, paremas automaatrelv. Taamal, helesinise taeva taustal kaks ratsanikku ületamas raudteed, esimesel punalipp käes, tagumisel tõstetud mõõk. Tahtlikult kohmakas maalilaad.
works.de: By the railway, against the background of a railway carriage, left of centre a woman's 3/4 figure slightly turned to the right. Red skirt and headscarf, green blouse. In her raised left hand a video camera, in her right an automatic weapon. In the background, against a light blue sky, two horsemen crossing the railway, the first with a red flag in hand, the one behind with a raised sword. Deliberately clumsy painting style.

works.d: Esiplaanil lopsakas rohi, paremal mitmetes värvides puid-põõsaid. Vasakul madal talumaja, mille tagant paistab kaevukook. Pintslitõmme lai, laineline.
works.de: In the foreground lush grass, on the right trees and bushes in various colours. On the left a low farmhouse, behind which a well-sweep is visible. The brushstroke is broad, wavy.

works.d: Esiplaanil raagus puud ja lumised katused. Taga Toomkiriku torn, kõrval paremal kõrgem punase katusega maja.
works.de: Bare trees and snowy roofs in the foreground. Behind, the tower of the Dome Church, beside it on the right a taller house with a red roof.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul savikruus, paremal õunu; tagapool laastukorv valge riidetükiga (paberiga?)
works.de: In the foreground on the left an earthenware jug, on the right apples; behind a wood-shaving basket with a piece of white cloth (paper?).

works.d: Kitsa kaelaga sinises savikruusis kõrgevarrelised tuliliiliad; vasakul raamat. Foon roosa.
works.de: Tall-stemmed tiger lilies in a blue clay jug with a narrow neck; on the left a book. The background is pink.

works.d: Paremal meri liigendatud rannajoonega; kaldal maju ja üksikuid puid.
works.de: On the right the sea with an articulated coastline; on the shore houses and scattered trees.

works.d: Kogu maali pinnal üksteise kõrval asuvad punaste katustega majad; ülal paremal üksikult seisvad, ümbritsetud roheliste aedadega. Värv kohati pastoosne.
works.de: Over the whole surface of the painting houses with red roofs stand next to one another; above on the right, standing alone, surrounded by green gardens. The paint is in places pastose.

works.d: Ees ja keskel punaste katustega mitmekorruseliste majade grupp rohelises.
works.de: In front and in the middle a group of multi-storey houses with red roofs amid greenery.

works.d: Erksates toonides maalitud vaade madalatele kuuridele ja nende taga asetsevate majade katuseviiludele. Vasakul, majade vahel raagus puu võra, paremal, taeva taustal kaks puud. Maalitud punakais, oranžides toonides tumedate kontuuridega.
works.de: View painted in bright tones of low sheds and the gable roofs of houses behind them. On the left, between the houses, the bare crown of a tree, on the right, against the sky, two trees. Painted in reddish, orange tones with dark contours.

works.d: Lumine tänav. Mõlemal pool kahekorruselised, punaste viilkatustega majad. Tänava servas kased, Kaetud paksult valge härmatisega. Kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud; maalipind osaliselt faktuurne.
works.de: A snowy street. On both sides two-storey houses with red gable roofs. Birches at the edge of the street, thickly covered with white frost. Contours slightly emphasised; the paint surface partly textured.

works.d: Ovaalse näoga noore naise portree otsevaates, lõigatud õlgade kohalt. Naisel pikad tumedad juuksed seljal, kõrvas ripatsiga kõrvarõngad, seljas erkpunane ovaalse dekolteega kleit.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman with an oval face, in frontal view, cropped above the shoulders. The woman has long dark hair on her back, earrings with pendants in her ears, wearing a bright red dress with an oval décolletage.

works.d: Tumeda, sangadega vaasi foonil esiplaanil kitsas, kaela poole kergelt laienev, punane vaas. Selle kõrval vasakul üks ning paremal kaks madalat keraamilist nõud. Taust kollane, alus kirju.
works.de: Against the background of a dark vase with handles, in the foreground a narrow red vase, slightly widening towards the neck. Beside it, on the left one and on the right two shallow ceramic vessels. Background yellow, the stand mottled.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline aas, kaugemal põõsariba, millest üle paistavad lumiste tippudega kõrgmäed.
works.de: In the foreground a green meadow, farther away a strip of bushes, above which snow-capped high mountain peaks are visible.

works.d: Laual punakas vaas valgete ja kollaste lilledega; selle ees elektripirn ja küljel sinine kann.
Eest tahapoole tõusev trepp-tänav kõrgete kivimajadega vasakul ja paremal. Üle tänava nöörid kuivava pesuga. Trepistikul üksikuid inimesi ja inimgruppe.
works.de: A stepped street rising away with tall stone houses on the left and right. Lines with drying laundry across the street. Individual people and groups of people on the steps.

works.d: Maali keskmest vasakul ülalt valgustatud kera punaka omavarjuga piimjal sinkjashallil taustal, millel mustaga noolemärk kirjaga "valgus" osutamas alla kerale. Kuulist alumine pind ebaühtlaselt must üles suunatud noole ja valge kirjaga "horisont". Ülal- ja allääre keskel neljakandiline templimärk.
works.de: Left of the centre of the painting, a sphere lit from above with a reddish self-shadow on a milky bluish-grey background, on which in black an arrow marked "valgus" [light] points down to the sphere. The lower surface of the sphere is unevenly black, with an upward-pointing arrow and the white inscription "horisont" [horizon]. In the middle of the top and bottom edges, a rectangular stamp mark.

works.d: Paremal eest taha suunduv veekogu, mille vasakul kaldal hoone puudega, paremal kivimüür, selle taga puid.
works.de: On the right a body of water running from front to back, on the left bank of which a building with trees, on the right a stone wall, behind it trees.

works.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt en face, valge kraega pruunikas punases kleidis, pitstanu ja krae, kullast kellakett. Kaelas ja vöö külge kinnitatud.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older woman en face, in a brownish red dress with a white collar, a lace bonnet and collar, a gold watch chain. Attached to the neck and waist.

works.d: Tumesinises ülikonnas keskealine mees otsevaates valge linaga laua taga, vasak käsi toetub lauale. Laual taldrik, karahvin, kaks pitsi. Mehel ovaalne nägu, täidlased huuled, pisut tõstetud kulmud. Tumedad juuksed ülepea kammitud. Taustaks laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud sein, vasakul ukseava, paremal pilt seinal.
works.de: A middle-aged man in a dark blue suit, seen frontally, behind a table with a white cloth, his left hand resting on the table. On the table a plate, a carafe, two small glasses. The man has an oval face, full lips, slightly raised eyebrows. Dark hair combed straight back. The background is a wall painted with broad brushstrokes, a doorway on the left, a picture on the wall on the right.

works.d: Lühikeste, tumedate juustega noore mehe rinnaportree; pea kerges pöördes paremale. Kulmude vahel sügav kurd, keskendunud pilk suunatud enda ette. Seljas tume kuub, vasakul sinise-musta lindiga rinnale kinnitatud medal.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man with short, dark hair; head slightly turned to the right. A deep furrow between the brows, concentrated gaze directed ahead. Wearing a dark coat, with a medal fastened to the chest on the left with a blue-black ribbon.

works.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud suvemaastik, mille esiplaanil paremal põõsad, allservas rohi ja roosad lilled. Keskel punakaspruun põld, mis tagaplaanil läheb üle järk-järguliselt silmapiirini tõusvaks põõsastikuks ja metsamassiiviks. Taevas helesinine, üksikute pilvetuttidega.
works.de: A summer landscape painted with lush brush strokes, in the foreground on the right bushes, at the bottom edge grass and pink flowers. In the middle a reddish-brown field, which in the background gradually turns into shrubbery and a forest mass rising towards the horizon. The sky light blue, with a few tufts of clouds.

works.d: Keskosas, vasakult kahe tünni, paremalt palgivirna vahel kastil istub sonimütsis mees veerandpöördes vasakule, jalad harkis, käed toetuvad põlvedele. Tema selja taga punases seelikus naine selgvaates, pisut vasakule kummargil. Tagapool vasakul kolme istuva noormehe figuurid. Esiplaanil kail suur kala, ümberlükatud ämber, põrandahari. Tagaplaanil meri tumeda kaldatriibuga silmapiiril. Maal pastelseis roosakas-sinistes toonides.
works.de: In the middle section, between two barrels on the left and a woodpile on the right, a man in a sailor's cap sits on a crate in a quarter turn to the left, legs apart, hands resting on his knees. Behind him a woman in a red skirt, in full view, bending slightly to the left. Further back at left, the figures of three seated young men. In the foreground on the pier a large fish, an overturned bucket, a floor brush. In the background the sea with a dark strip of shore on the horizon. The painting is in pastel pinkish-blue tones.

works.d: Abstraktsetest kujunditest värvikas kompositsioon. Roosad-rohekad pinnad, üksikud pruunid pintslitõmbed heledate pindade vahel. Kohati väga pastoosne.
works.de: A colourful composition of abstract shapes. Pink-greenish surfaces, occasional brown brushstrokes between light surfaces. In places very pastose.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad lühikesed juuksed, punane barett, must ilma varrukateta sviiter.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in slight turn to the left. Dark short hair, red beret, black sleeveless sweater.

works.d: Pikisuunaline vaade gooti kiriku hämarasse interjööri. Paremal kolm piilarit, kõrged võlvid ülal. Vasakult kahest aknaorvast langeb nappi valgust. Otse ja paremal paistmas kaks heledat akent. Üksikuid figuure ruumis. Rohekashall, pruun gamma, arhitektuuridetaile selgelt välja modelleeriv laad.
works.de: A longitudinal view into the dim interior of a Gothic church. On the right three pillars, high vaults above. From two window niches on the left scant light falls. Straight ahead and on the right two bright windows are visible. Individual figures in the space. Greenish-grey, brown gamut, a style clearly modelling architectural details.

works.d: Ees paremal telk. Taga üle oru sild, puud ja hooned.
works.de: A tent in front on the right. Behind, a bridge over a valley, trees and buildings.

works.d: Rinnapilt, enface, pikkade õlgadele laskuvate juustega. Nägu paremalt poolt teravalt valgustatud.
works.de: Bust portrait, en face, with long hair falling onto the shoulders. The face is sharply lit from the right side.

works.d: Keskel noor tumedajuukseline naine, seljas punane pihik ja triibuline seelik valge põllega, peas valge tanu. Vasaku käe kõrval väike tüdruk, paremas käes korv. Paremal tüdruku poole vaatav koer. Tagapool vasakul känd ja põõsaid, paremal põõsapuhmas. Taevas pilves.
works.de: In the centre a young dark-haired woman, wearing a red bodice and a striped skirt with a white apron, a white cap on her head. Next to her left hand a small girl, in her right hand a basket. On the right a dog looking towards the girl. Behind on the left a stump and bushes, on the right a bush clump. Sky cloudy.

works.d: Noore sinises vormikuues mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Half-figure of a young man in a blue uniform coat, in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Korovonlikult impressionistlikus laadis maalitud rahvarohke stseen: esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal inimesed, hobused, kõik antud võbelevate värvilaikude kõrvuti asetamisega. Ülal vasakul kaks suurt maja (ühel neist valge korsten). Tagumise maja kõrval mõned puud ja põõsad. Ülal beež taevas. Maalitud kollakaspruunides toonides.
works.de: A crowd scene painted in a Korovin-like impressionistic manner: in the foreground on the left and right people, horses, all rendered through the juxtaposition of flickering patches of colour. Upper left two large houses (one of them with a white chimney). Beside the rear house some trees and bushes. Upper part beige sky. Painted in yellowish-brown tones.

works.d: Eskiiskavand paljufiguurilisele kompositsioonile: esiplaanil oleval rannaribal moodustavad kalurid ja valgetes rättides rannanaised kompositsioonilisi gruppe. Rannal mõned vankri ette rakendatud hobused, neli väikeste purjedega paati on kaldale tõmmatud. Paremal servas rookatustega kalurihütid üksikute puudega nende taga. Silmapiiril tume meri, ülal pilvine taevas. Hallikaspruunis üldkoloriidis on kõik detailid antud skitseerivalt.
works.de: A sketch for a multi-figure composition: on the strip of beach in the foreground, fishermen and beach women in white headscarves form compositional groups. On the beach a few horses harnessed to carts, four small-sailed boats have been pulled ashore. At the right edge fishermen's huts with reed roofs, with individual trees behind them. On the horizon a dark sea, above a cloudy sky. In an overall greyish-brown colouring all details are rendered sketchily.

works.d: Heledates toonides suvine maastik suurte lehtpuude ja kahe väikese inimfiguuriga.
works.de: A summer landscape in light tones with large deciduous trees and two small human figures.

works.d: Pruunikal laual klaaskann lopsakate siniste, punaste ja kollaste lilledega, sinine sulega kübar ja üksik kollane õis. Samas sinine draperii.
works.de: On a brownish table a glass jug with lush blue, red and yellow flowers, a blue feathered hat and a single yellow bloom. In the same place a blue drapery.

works.d: Vaade Emajõele ja selle vasakule kaldale. Kõrgete pruunikas-lillakate puude all hooneid ja paadisild kirevate paatidega.
works.de: View of the Emajõgi river and its left bank. Buildings under tall brownish-purple trees and a boat landing with colourful boats.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrged raagus puud ja tarad, taga hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground tall bare trees and fences, buildings behind.

works.d: Hallipäise, heledas särgis vanema mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Foon pruunikates-rohekates-punakates toonides.
works.de: Half-figure of an elderly, grey-haired man in a light shirt, half-turned to the left. Background in brownish-greenish-reddish tones.

works.d: Tumeda, rohekaspruuni draperii taustal helepruun kann ja madal hall vaas lilledega, kaks kaussi puuviljadega ja neli pudelit.
works.de: Against a dark, greenish-brown drapery background a light brown jug and a low grey vase with flowers, two bowls with fruit and four bottles.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage lumine väljak üksikute puudega. Eemal majad, nende taga kõrged puud.
works.de: In the foreground a bare snowy square with solitary trees. In the distance houses, behind them tall trees.

works.d: Kollasel, punutud põhjaga toolil kollane korv, helesinine draperii ning punane vaas punaste ja kollaste lilledega.
works.de: On a yellow chair with a woven seat a yellow basket, light blue drapery and a red vase with red and yellow flowers.

works.d: Tumedates toonides suvine maastik. Esiplaanil kõrged lehtpuud, nende tagant paistavad hooned milledest üks punase katusega.
works.de: A summer landscape in dark tones. In the foreground tall deciduous trees, behind them buildings can be seen, one of which has a red roof.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kõrgete lehtpuude taustal kaks tumedates toonides maalitud naisakti.
works.de: In the foreground, against a background of tall deciduous trees, two female nude figures painted in dark tones.

works.d: Pildi keskel suur, roosa seosega lillekorv, mitmesuguste aialilledega. Vasakul esiplaanil väiksem korv lilledega. Paremal nurgas suur roheline leht maasikatega.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, a large pink woven flower basket with various garden flowers. In the foreground on the left, a smaller basket with flowers. In the right corner, a large green leaf with strawberries.

works.d: Keskel kolm lehtpuud. Vasakule ja paremale jäävad majad. Foonil mets.
works.de: Three deciduous trees in the centre. Houses on the left and right. Forest in the background.

works.d: Mitmevärviliste abstraktsete kujundite ja pindade kompositsioon.
works.de: Composition of multicoloured abstract shapes and planes.

works.d: Mitmevärvilised, põhiliselt rohelistes toonides, abstraktsed kujundid ja pinnad.
works.de: Multicoloured, mainly in green tones, abstract shapes and surfaces.

works.d: Punakas toonis, peene kontuuriga väikesteks värvilisteks pindadeks jaotatud kompositsioon. All kaarjas avause kujutis.
works.de: Composition in reddish tones, divided by fine contours into small coloured areas. Below, depiction of an arched opening.

works.d: Õitsvate põõsaste ja puude keskel istub kirjus kleidis otsevaates naine, jalg üle põlve. Vasakul valge puudel, paremal lillekorv, reha ja kastekann. Tagapool vasakul molberti taga selgvaates kunstnik maalimas.
works.de: Amid blossoming bushes and trees sits a woman in a patterned dress, frontal view, leg crossed over knee. On the left a white bench, on the right a flower basket, a rake and a watering can. Behind, on the left, an artist seen from the back, painting at an easel.

works.d: Punaste eesriiete taustal viis baleriini, üks neist otsevaates, kolm seljaga, üks istub, seljas rohekates, kollastes ja lillakates toonides kostüümid. Punased ja pruunikad toonid tihedad ja rasked.
works.de: Against a background of red curtains, five ballerinas, one of them shown frontally, three with their backs turned, one seated, wearing costumes in greenish, yellow and lilac tones. The red and brownish tones are dense and heavy.

works.d: Paremal horisontaalsel keskjoonel jõgi halli suure paadiga. Sellest vasakul kaldapealne lõikuvate raudteerööbastega, millel sõidab must vedur. Vasakus servas kolm maja, üks neist erepunane, ning elektripostide rida. Pilvisest taevast paistab keskosas tükike helesinist. Maalitud puhastes toonides impressionistlikus maalitehnikas.
works.de: On the right on the horizontal centre line, a river with a large grey boat. To the left of it, a bank with crossing railway tracks, on which a black locomotive is running. In the left edge three houses, one of them bright red, and a row of electric poles. From the cloudy sky, a patch of light blue shows through in the middle section. Painted in clean tones in an impressionistic painting technique.

works.d: Ateljees asuvate esemete taustal (sirm, pesukauss, kann, ahi, büst), pruuni draperii foonil vasakul toolile nõjatuv naisakt otsevaates, ülakeha pööratud vasakule. Pea toetub tõstetud kõverdatud kätele. Parema, pisut tõstetud kõverdatud jala juures kerratõmbunud musta-valge kirju kass. Maalitud pruunikates summutatud toonides lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Against the background of objects in a studio (screen, washbasin, jug, stove, bust), on a brown drapery background, on the left a female nude leaning on a chair, frontal view, upper body turned to the left. The head rests on raised bent arms. Beside the right, slightly raised bent leg, a black-and-white patched cat curled up. Painted in muted brownish tones with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Noore ümaranäolise blondi naise rinnaportree, pea veidi pööratud vasakule, pilk suunatud ette alla. Naisel seljas pruunikas kleit suure heleda reväärkraega, maalitud sinakas-kollakas-pruunis koloriidis õhuliselt.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young round-faced blonde woman, head turned slightly to the left, gaze directed forward and down. The woman is wearing a brownish dress with a large light-coloured lapel collar, painted airily in a bluish-yellowish-brown colour scheme.

works.d: Vaade taraga piiratud raagus puudega lumisele aiale. Vasakul ja tagaplaanil läbi puuvõrade paistmas lumiste katustega pruunikad majad. Maalitud hoogsalt, õhuliselt sinakais, pruunides toonides.
works.de: View of a snowy garden with bare trees enclosed by a fence. On the left and in the background, brownish houses with snowy roofs showing through the tree crowns. Painted vigorously, airily, in bluish, brown tones.

works.d: Ümaranäolise, kõrge kumera laubaga noore naise portree. Pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Pilk langetatud. Heledad juuksed kõrvade juures rõngasse keeratud. Koloriit hele. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: Portrait of a round-faced young woman with a high convex forehead. Head in a slight turn to the left. Gaze lowered. Light hair twisted into a ring near the ears. Light coloration. Sketch-like painting manner.

works.d: Rohekate voltidega valgel draperiil külgvaates paremale istuv naisakt. Parem jalg kõverdatud, selles allarullitud sukk (lõigatud pöia, vasaku sääremarja kohalt). Kõverdatud seongus käed ees, vasak toetub toolileenile, millele langetatud vaatajalt ärapööratud pea. Foon vasakul hallikaspruun, paremal sinakas. Akt maalitud valkjashallides, beežides toonides kohati varje ja vorm laiema kontuurjoonega toonitades.
works.de: A female nude sitting in side view facing right on a white drapery with greenish folds. Right leg bent, on it a rolled-down stocking (cut off at the foot, above the left calf). Bent, intertwined arms in front, the left resting on the back of a chair, on which the lowered head, turned away from the viewer, rests. Background on the left greyish brown, on the right bluish. The nude is painted in whitish grey, beige tones, with shadows and forms at times accentuated with a broader contour line.

works.d: Kireval foonil tumedapäise pikajuukselise noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Pea veidi pööratud vasakule, pilk ette alla suunatud. Parem kõverdatud käsi risti üle rinna vasaku õla juures. Naisel seljas lühikeste varrukatega sinakas kleit. Maalitud sinakas-pruunikas-ookertoonides kergete hoogsate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Against a colourful background, a bust portrait, in frontal view, of a young woman with dark hair and long hair. Head slightly turned to the left, gaze directed forward and down. Right bent arm crossed over the chest near the left shoulder. The woman is wearing a bluish dress with short sleeves. Painted in bluish-brownish-ochre tones with light, vigorous brushstrokes.

works.d: Sompus talvepäev. Pildi eesääres raagus puud. Taamal avardub lumine maastik, vasakule jääva paari madala taluhoonega. Koloriit hallikas.
Künklik, lumine maastik raagus puudega. Vasakus servas, taamal üksik maja. Paremas ääres ees kahar kuusk. Üldkoloriit hallikas-sinine. Maalitud peente pintslitõmmetega.

Ülaltvaade talvisele puukuuridega hoovile õhtuhämaruses. Paremal viilkatusega maja ots, aia piiril raagus puud. Kaugemal väikesed majad, tulekuma aknais. Silmapiiril, nõlvakul aimatavad puud ja majade siluetid. Maalitud tumedas hallikas-, rohekassinises, punakaspruunis kooriidis kohati värvi pühkivalt, kohati pastoosselt.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of a winter yard with woodsheds at dusk. On the right, the gable end of a gabled-roof house, bare trees at the fence line. Further off, small houses, the glow of light in their windows. On the horizon, trees and house silhouettes suggested on a slope. Painted in dark greyish-, greenish-blue, reddish-brown tones, in places with sweeping strokes, in places impasto.

works.d: Rohekashallides pastelsetes toonides maalitud ülaltvaade linnale. Vasakul punakad viilkatused, puukroonid, keskel silmapiiri suunas ahenev tänav aimatavate sõidukite ja inimestega. Taamal ja paremal servas kollakate valguslaikudega majasein, ülaosas karniis. Maalitud lühikese pintslilöögiga, puude osas pastoossemalt.
works.de: A view of a town from above, painted in greenish-grey pastel tones. On the left reddish gable roofs, tree crowns, in the centre a street narrowing towards the horizon with vaguely discernible vehicles and people. In the distance and on the right edge a house wall with yellowish patches of light, a cornice at the top. Painted with short brushstrokes, more impasto in the trees.

works.d: Pildi allääres punaste katustega, kõrgete korstendega majad, taustaks suur lehtpuude grupp. Vasakul paistab puude vahelt valge, helerohelise katusega hoone. Paremal suubub maali sügavusse lai, sirge tänav. Koloriit hele, hallika üldtooniga.
Vaade linnulennult üle esiplaanis asuvate põldude, vasakul ja silmapiiril asuvate metsatukkade ja järve. Ülal lillakassinine taevas. Valitsevad sinised ja rohelised toonid.
works.de: Bird's-eye view over fields in the foreground, groves of trees on the left and on the horizon, and a lake. Above, a purplish-blue sky. Blue and green tones dominate.

works.d: Pruunil, massiivsel, pisut nikerdatud laual, mille sahtlid osalt välja tõmmatud, on hulgast erinevatest esemetest koostatud seadeldis. Vasakul servas helepruun lillepott lopsaka kaktusega, poti ees kaks vartega redist ja pooleldi veega täidetud klaas. Potist paremal, tagaplaanil, pika kaelaga pooleldi täidetud veepudel, ažuursete sangadega metallist liud kahe kollase sidruniga ja potsaka vormiga pruun savist kann. Loetletud esemete ees, roosakaspunasel kirjul draperiil, üks tumeda, teine valge sulestikuga lastud lind. Neist paremal valgel draperiil kimp rediseid ja kaks sibulat. Laua ees, pildi esiservas ümmargune taburet, millel valge linik ja suur lõik kollast kõrvitsat. Ülal foonil tume,
works.de: On a brown, massive, slightly carved table, with its drawers partly pulled out, an arrangement composed of a number of different objects is set up. On the left edge a light brown flowerpot with a lush cactus, in front of the pot two radishes with stems and a glass half filled with water. To the right of the pot, in the background, a half-filled water bottle with a long neck, a metal tray with openwork handles holding two yellow lemons, and a brown clay jug of a squat shape. In front of the listed objects, on a pinkish-red patterned drapery, one bird with dark plumage, another with white plumage, both shot. To the right of them, on white drapery, a bunch of radishes and two onions. In front of the table, at the front edge of the picture, a round stool with a white cloth on it and a large slice of yellow pumpkin. Above, in the background, dark,

works.d: Esiplaanil jõesopp, mille kallas upub pisut nagu mäkke tõusvaisse põõsastesse ja puudesse. Puude kollakaspruunid toonid peegelduvad vees. Ülaservas helesinine taevas. Maalitud tuhmides, soojades rohelistes toonides, kohati pikkade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground a river bend, whose bank is somewhat submerged, as it were, in bushes and trees rising up a hill. The yellowish-brown tones of the trees are reflected in the water. At the upper edge, a pale blue sky. Painted in muted, warm green tones, in places with long brushstrokes.

works.d: Musta-valgetriibulisel linikul ja taustal lihtne klaasvaas roosade lillhernestega.
works.de: On a black-and-white striped cloth and background a simple glass vase with pink sweet peas.

works.d: Punasekirju salliga keskealise brüneti naise portree otsevaates.
works.de: Frontal portrait of a middle-aged brunette woman with a red-patterned scarf.

works.d: Heledas pluusis noore brüneti naise portree otsevaates.
works.de: Frontal portrait of a young brunette woman in a light-coloured blouse.

works.d: Pruun lillevaas kahe roosa ja ühe valge krüsanteemiga. Vaasi all ja vasakul foonil musta- ja valgetriibuline riie.
works.de: Brown flower vase with two pink and one white chrysanthemum. Below the vase and to the left in the background a black-and-white striped fabric.

works.d: Istuva naise 3/4 figuur en face rohelise-mustatriibulise riide taustal. Peakatteta, seljas sinakas-must mantel, roosa kleit, mustad kindad.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a seated woman en face against a green-and-black striped fabric background. Without a headdress, wearing a bluish-black coat, a pink dress, black gloves.

works.d: Tütarlapse rinnaportree otsevaates, pea ülaosa servaga lõigatud. Juuksed tumedad, kleit punane. Foon mustriline.
works.de: Bust portrait of a girl in frontal view, the top of the head cut off by the edge. Hair dark, dress red. Background patterned.

works.d: Tumedal palkseinal ripub pommidega seinakell ja kolme valge luigega vaip. Esiplaanil vana, puust kirst.
works.de: On a dark log wall hangs a pendulum wall clock and a rug with three white swans. In the foreground an old wooden chest.

works.d: Keset rohelist välja rohtusöövate lammaste kari. Silmapiiril tumesinine viirg. Taevas kaks suurt valget pilve.
works.de: A flock of grazing sheep amid a green field. On the horizon a dark blue stripe. In the sky two large white clouds.

works.d: Linnavaate esiplaanil paremal lagunenud voodi lumes, keskel kõrgepinge liini raudsõrestikposte. Taamal majad.
works.de: In the foreground of the city view, on the right a dilapidated bed in the snow, in the middle steel lattice poles of a high-voltage line. Houses in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduv jõekäär. Jõekaldal rida raagud puid. Taamal keskosas silla kontuurid.
works.de: A river bend running from left to right in the foreground. A row of bare trees on the riverbank. In the middle background, the outlines of a bridge.

works.d: Ees lage kivine rand üksikute põõsastega, rohu ja lillelaikudega. Kaugemal kuni horisondini laiuv meri.
works.de: In front, a bare stony shore with occasional bushes, patches of grass and flowers. Farther away the sea extending to the horizon.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise kabimütsis ja rahvarõivais poolfiguuris vasakule noore naise põlvpilt.
works.de: A knee-length portrait of a dark-haired young woman in a bonnet and folk costume, in half-figure view to the left.

works.d: Tugitoolis istuva vanema sõjaväelase põlvpilt. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Pea en face. Seljas sinine kindrali esindusmunder. Rinnas aurahad.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of an older military man sitting in an armchair. Body slightly turned to the left. Head en face. Wearing a blue general's dress uniform. Medals on his chest.

works.d: Esiplaanil tööpingi taga seisev töötav naine kolmveerand vasakule, üleskääritud varrukatega, tööpõlles, sinise pluusiga ja punase pearätikuga, tagaplaanil ääsi ees töötavad mehed.
works.de: In the foreground a working woman standing at a workbench, three-quarters turned to the left, with rolled-up sleeves, in a work apron, with a blue blouse and a red headscarf, in the background men working in front of a forge.

works.d: Noore mehe pea poolprofiilis paremale (üleloomulikus suuruses).
works.de: Head of a young man in half-profile to the right (in larger-than-life size).

works.d: Suur pea tumesinisel taustal.
Suur pea poolprofiilis paremale, helesinisel taustal.
Esiplaanil aia taga maja nurk (vasakul), keskel tee, taamal puud.
works.de: In the foreground behind a fence the corner of a house (on the left), in the middle a path, trees in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil tara ääres kaks kurniviskavat ja kaks puhkavat poissi. Vasakult taha suunduv latt-tara.
works.de: In the foreground, by a fence, two boys turning somersaults and two boys resting. A lath fence running back from the left.

works.d: Murul vasemal selgvaates Kalevipoeg - valges vöötatud särgis - ja Sorts paremal vägikaigast vedamas.
works.de: On the grass on the left, in clear view, Kalevipoeg - in a white striped shirt - and Sorts on the right, pulling a tug-of-war pole.

works.d: Esiplaanil rand kividega, kaluripaatidega, võrkudega ja kaluri figuuriga, taamal meri.
