works.de: In the foreground a shore with stones, fishing boats, nets and a fisherman's figure, sea in the distance.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule, valges riietuses, parem käsi viinamarjakobaraga rinnale kallutatud pea peal.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in profile facing left, dressed in white, her right hand holding a bunch of grapes tilted toward her head.

works.d: Triibulise riidega kaetud diivanil istuva, maani ulatuvas purpurses kleidis, raamatut lugeva noore naise poolprofiilis vasemale täisfiguur. Peas tume punane kübar.
works.de: Full figure in half-profile facing left of a young woman seated on a sofa covered with striped fabric, reading a book, wearing a purple dress reaching to the floor. A dark red hat on her head.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi, millest keskel ulatuvad välja üksikud raagus puud. Tagaplaanil auva metsa veerel näha lund.
works.de: Water in the foreground, from which solitary bare trees rise in the middle. In the background snow can be seen at the edge of a dense forest.

works.d: Seisva mehe poolfiguur, kolmveerandis paremale, täishabeme ja vuntsidega, püstkraes, pikas kuues, helehalli kaelasidemega. Taust mustades ja hallides toonides.
works.de: Half-figure of a standing man, in three-quarter view to the right, with full beard and moustache, in a stand-up collar, a long coat, and a light grey neckcloth. Background in black and grey tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, millel kolm lootsikut. Taamal mõlemal pool veekogu kallastega piiratud. Parempoolset rohtunud kaldalt paistavad majade katused. Vasakpoolne järsk kallas kaetud metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with three boats on it. Beyond, the water is bordered by banks on both sides. On the grassy right bank the roofs of houses are visible. The steep left bank is covered with forest.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur pöördega vasakule seljas must kleit eest sügava dekolteega. Kaelas sametpael medaljoniga, vasakul õlal orden lindiga.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman turned to the left, wearing a black dress with a deep décolletage in front. A velvet ribbon with a medallion around her neck, an order with a ribbon on her left shoulder.

works.d: Vanema mehe rindportree, kerges pöördes paremale. Vuntsid, habe ja üle pea kammitud hallid juuksed. Sinine, punase püstkrae ja kuldtikandiga kuub. Valge kuldnööpidega vest ja krae. Taust tume pruun.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man, in a slight turn to the right. Moustache, beard, and grey hair combed over the head. Blue coat with a red stand-up collar and gold embroidery. White vest and collar with gold buttons. Dark brown background.

works.d: Ees paremal näha istuva naise nägu ja jalgu. Istuja kõrval lähker ja riidesse seotud pamp. Taga põllul viljakoristajad.
works.de: In front on the right, the face and legs of a seated woman are visible. Beside her a canteen and a bundle tied in cloth. Behind, harvesters in a field.

works.d: Ees paremal mere ääres kaks pesu loputavat naist. Taga rannaviirg, vasakul äärel avameri.
works.de: In front on the right, by the sea, two women rinsing laundry. Behind, the coastline, on the left edge the open sea.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 35.0 cm; laius: 30.0 cm; kõrgus: 37.0 cm; kujutise laius: 28.0 cm
works.d: Ees vasakul rohumaal suur kivi. Kivist paremal (keskel) sihvakas kasetüvi. Taga mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on grassland, a large stone. To the right of the stone (in the middle), a slender birch trunk. Behind, forest.

works.d: Ebamäärases, värvilistest valgustest täidetud ruumis keskel vertikaaljoonel mannekeenitaoline inimene sinise nelinurga taga. Sellest eespool suurt küpsist meenutav kujund ning üks lillas, teine oranžis valguses saabas. All vasakus nurgas pika antenniga raadiovastuvõtja. Vasakus ülemises neljandikus lendavat taldrikut või kosmoseaparaati meenutav ese. Ruumi markeerivad värvilised pinnad.
works.de: In an indeterminate space filled with coloured lights, in the centre on a vertical line a mannequin-like figure behind a blue quadrangle. In front of it a shape resembling a large biscuit, and one boot in purple light, another in orange light. In the lower left corner a radio receiver with a long antenna. In the upper left quarter an object resembling a flying saucer or spacecraft. Coloured surfaces mark the space.

works.d: Esiplaanil roosal laual üleskerkinud servaga avaldus, mille all sinine pliiats. Vasakul pruun, punase servaga meeste rahatasku dokumentidega. Osalt viimase all teine avaldus. Sinisel foonil keskel metallist, kollase helgiga konstruktsioon. Ruum pime, kogu kompositsiooni valgustab vasakult tulev valgus.
works.de: In the foreground on a pink table, a document with an upturned edge, under which a blue pencil. On the left, a brown men's wallet with a red edge, containing documents. Partly under the latter, another document. In the centre against a blue background, a metal construction with a yellow gleam. The room is dark, the whole composition is lit by light coming from the left.

works.d: Keskosas potsakas triikraud, mida ümbritseb reaalsuse elementidest kombineeritud sürrealistlik kaos. Esiplaanis ja vasakus servas kirkatooniliste, spontaanselt pinnale kantud värvilaikude stiihia. Ülaosas beež foon.
works.de: In the central part a squat flatiron, surrounded by surrealist chaos composed of elements of reality. In the foreground and along the left edge an elemental play of brightly toned, spontaneously applied patches of colour. Beige background at the top.

works.d: Ülaosas punase-, all siniselaigulisel foonil üle lõuendi allosa kalligraafilises sinises kirjas tekst: "Elamine on mitteelamine kriisiperiood.Pleyn". Teksti taga fotorealistlikult maalitud terase vaatega kortsus vana mehe nägu.
works.de: In the upper part on a red-, below on a blue-patched background, across the lower part of the canvas, text in calligraphic blue writing: "Elamine on mitteelamine kriisiperiood.Pleyn". Behind the text, the photorealistically painted, sharp-gazed face of a wrinkled old man.

works.d: Tihedalt rahutute pintslilöökidega risti-rästi läbimaalitud foonilt eraldub valgates lühikestes spordipükstes, oranžis särgis ja hallides botastes jooksja, lihased pingul. Foon alt vasakult sinine, ülalt vasakult sinepikollane, paremast ülanurgast lillakashall.
works.de: From a background densely painted with restless crisscrossing brushstrokes emerges a runner in white short sports trunks, an orange shirt and grey boots, muscles taut. The background is blue from the lower left, mustard-yellow from the upper left, purplish-grey from the upper right corner.

works.d: Mitmesuguste värviliste kujundite taustal kaks väikest tüdrukut: vasakpoolne poolselgvaates väikeste patsijuppidega, rohekas mantlis laps ust avamas, seljas avatud roheline ranits. Parempoolne tüdruk istumas, vaatab üle õla, käe all avatud vihik. Nende vahel hüppav kass.
works.de: Against a background of various coloured shapes, two small girls: the one on the left, seen in semi-profile with small pigtail ends, in a greenish coat, opening a door, wearing an open green backpack. The girl on the right sitting, looking over her shoulder, an open notebook under her arm. Between them a leaping cat.

works.d: Esiplaanil palgil istuv eesti rahvarõhvais naine lapsega. Tagapool, paremal humalad. Keskel ja vasakul vaade üle lagendiku kaugusse.
works.de: In the foreground an Estonian woman in folk costume sitting on a log with a child. Behind, on the right, hops. In the centre and on the left a view across a clearing into the distance.

works.d: Rehe all eesti rahvarõivais (sinine seelik) naine istuvas asendis. Vasemas käes nõu, parem aga poetab teri.
works.de: Woman in Estonian folk costume (blue skirt) seated under the threshing barn. A vessel in her left hand, scattering grain with her right.

works.d: Tumerohelises vormikuues mehe põlvpilt - keha poolprofiilis paremale, pea vasakule. Vasakus, küünarnukiga barjäärile toetuvas käes mõõk; parem asetatud barjäärile laotatud paberile.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a man in a dark green uniform coat - body in three-quarter profile to the right, head to the left. In his left hand, resting elbow on the barrier, a sword; the right hand placed on paper spread on the barrier.

works.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis, kerge pöördega paremale, hallikassinises valge pitskraega kleidis, valges kogu nägu ümbritsevas tülltanus, õlgadel kirju rätik. Käed vaheliti süles.
works.de: Half-figure of an older woman in a seated position, with a slight turn to the right, in a greyish-blue dress with a white lace collar, in a white tulle bonnet surrounding the whole face, a patterned shawl on the shoulders. Hands crossed in the lap.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, hallide kammitud juustega, paljakspöetud näoga; käed rinnal ristatud; seljas punakas kuub karusnahkse kraega; kaelas hele, lõuani mähitud sõlmside. Kujutis ovaalis.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in half-profile to the right, with combed grey hair, a clean-shaven face; arms crossed on the chest; wearing a reddish coat with a fur collar; a light-coloured cravat wound up to the chin around the neck. The depiction is in an oval.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur tugitoolis istuvana. Kehapööre paremale, pea pööratud vasemale. Helesinises rõivastuses ja samavärvilises peakattes, vasemas käes lüüra. Taustaks vasemal sein, paremal maastik.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman sitting in an armchair. Body turned to the right, head turned to the left. Dressed in light blue with a headdress of the same colour, a lyre in her left hand. Background on the left a wall, on the right a landscape.

works.d: Heledajuukselise sinisilmse lapse poolfiguur, pea poolprofiilis vasemale. Valge üle õlgade lahti vajunud kleit seotud keskelt sinise šärbiga. Rinnale tõstetud parema käe vangus korvike puuviljaga.
works.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired, blue-eyed child, head in half-profile to the left. White dress slipped off the shoulders, tied at the middle with a blue sash. The bend of the right arm, raised to the chest, holds a small basket with fruit.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur veerandprofiilis paremale. Silmad sinakad, nägu täidlane. Seljas tume, eest lahtine kuub ja eest kinninööbitud (5 nööpi) vest. Valge kaelus, tume kaelaside, mille üle nähtav valge krae äär.
works.de: Half-figure of a bearded man in three-quarter profile facing right. Bluish eyes, full face. Wearing a dark coat open at the front and a waistcoat buttoned at the front (5 buttons). White collar, dark necktie, over which the white edge of the collar is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal itaalia rahvarõivastes neiu nõjatumas kaevu äärisele, lopsakate lehtpuude varjus asuvast lõvipea kujulisest fontäänist suuga veejuga püüdes, taga paremal Rooma Peetri kiriku siluett.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a girl in Italian folk costume leaning on the rim of a well, catching a jet of water with her mouth from a lion-head-shaped fountain set in the shade of lush deciduous trees, behind on the right the silhouette of St. Peter's Church in Rome.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnapilt, kõrge punase krae ja rinnaesisega munderkuues.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, in a uniform coat with a high red collar and chest piece.

works.d: Valges pitstanus ja -kraega keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Üle õlgade punane rüü.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged woman in a white lace bonnet and collar, in half-profile facing left. A red robe over her shoulders.

works.d: Vasakul Kristuse istuv täisfiguur, paremal seisev noor naine kruusiga paremal õlal. Taustaks kaljud ja taevas.
works.de: On the left the seated full figure of Christ, on the right a standing young woman with a jug on her right shoulder. Background of cliffs and sky.

works.d: Vanema naise portree kerge pöördega vasakule. Seljas oliivroheline samet kleit pitskraega. Peas pitstanu. Ülevaku õla punane rätt. Kujutis ovaalis.
works.de: Portrait of an elderly woman with a slight turn to the left. Wearing an olive green velvet dress with a lace collar. On her head a lace cap. Over her shoulder a red shawl. The image is in an oval.

works.d: Kaljukoopas keskel inglifiguur valges pikas rüüs, ovaal ümber pea, üle vasaku õla heidetud drapeeritud kangas. Keha profiilis paremale, pea otsevaates, pilk suunatus vasakule. Parem käsi otsustavalt kõrgele tõstetud. Ees paremal, kivil, valge linariba. Vasakul taga paistab läbi koopasuu taevas, all väikest vegetatsiooni. Kujutus ebakindla kontuuriga ovaalis.
works.de: In the middle of a rock cave, an angel figure in a long white robe, an oval around the head, draped fabric thrown over the left shoulder. The body in profile to the right, the head in frontal view, the gaze directed to the left. The right hand decisively raised high. In front, on the right, on a stone, a white strip of linen. Behind on the left, the sky can be seen through the mouth of the cave, below some small vegetation. The depiction is in an oval with an uncertain contour.

works.d: Mehe rinnakujutis en face, pea kibuvitsakrooni ja oreooliga vasemale kallutatud, seljas punane rüü.
works.de: Frontal bust of a man, head tilted to the left with a crown of thorns and a halo, wearing a red robe.

works.d: Mehe rinnakujutis, kibuvitsakrooniga pea pööratud vasemale. Taga paremal näha osa ristist. Detail maalist "Kristus risti kandmas".
works.de: A man's bust, head with a crown of thorns turned to the left. Behind on the right part of a cross is visible. Detail from the painting "Christ Carrying the Cross".

works.d: Noore naise täisfiguur otsevaates, pea kerge pöördega paremale; peas laia äärega küber, millel sulg ja paremas käes lehvik. All kitsas maastiku riba.
works.de: Full figure of a young woman in a frontal view, her head slightly turned to the right; on her head a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, and in her right hand a fan. Below, a narrow strip of landscape.

works.d: Noore naise täisfiguur läbi portaalehituse paistva maastiku taustal. Naisel käes vaas. Pea ümber valgusoreool. Kordustöö Moskva Lunastaja kiriku jaoks maalitud teosest.
works.de: Full figure of a young woman against a landscape visible through a portal structure. The woman holds a vase in her hand. A halo of light around her head. A repeat of a work painted for the Church of the Redeemer in Moscow.

works.d: Keskel grupp inimesi Kristust ristilt maha võtmas Kristuse ristilt vabastamise momendil. Surnukeha haaravad mitmed käed, vasemast käest hoiavad ülal redelil seisvad kaks mehefiguuri. Paremal grupp inimesi, kes toetavad kokkuvarisevat Mariat. Vasemal surilina laotavad naised. Ees selgvaates mehefiguur. Hele valgus kaugel maali keskel - Kristuse kehale ja seda hoidvale mehefiguurile.
works.de: In the centre a group of people taking Christ down from the cross, at the moment of Christ's release from the cross. Several hands grasp the body, on the left hand two male figures standing on a ladder hold it up. On the right a group of people supporting the collapsing Mary. On the left women spreading a shroud. In front, a male figure in clear view. Bright light far in the centre of the painting - on Christ's body and the male figure holding it.

works.d: Seitse mängivat ja tantsivat putot. Ees vasemal puuvili, tagapool suureleheline taim. Taamal mägine maastik.
works.de: Seven putti playing and dancing. On the left in front, fruit, behind it a large-leaved plant. In the distance a mountainous landscape.

works.d: Keskel puu all istuv noor naine jälgimas tema ees kivil magavat last, vasakul kaks putot, paremal Joosepi figuur, kelle kõrval eesel.
works.de: In the centre a young woman sitting under a tree, watching a child sleeping on a rock in front of her, on the left two putti, on the right the figure of Joseph, beside whom a donkey.

works.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale. Lühikesed lokkis juuksed, vurrud. Seljas lahtise kaelusega valge särk ja punase ääristusega must vest.
Lühikest põskhabet kandva mehe rinnapilt, peaaegu otsevaates en face. Frakil metallnööbid.
works.de: A bust portrait of a man with a short side-beard, almost in a direct en face view. Metal buttons on the tailcoat.

works.d: Esiplaanil kalmistu - paremal rist hauamonumendiga ja tumedasse rõivastatud naine paevavarjuga; keskosas avatud surnuaiaväravad ees ootava kahehobuselise sõidukiga. Taga paremal puud, vasemal laiub tasandik üksikute hoonete ja metsasaludega.
works.de: In the foreground, a cemetery – on the right a cross with a grave monument and a woman in dark clothing with a parasol; in the middle section, open cemetery gates with a two-horse carriage waiting in front. Behind on the right, trees, on the left a plain stretches with isolated buildings and groves.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv jõgi. Ees paremal ja tagapool vasemal rohtunud jõekaldad. Tagapool vasakul üksikuid puid, keskel kivisild, sellest üle sõitva leinakoormaga. Taga paremal künkad ja mäed.
works.de: A river running from front left to back right. In front right and further back left grassy riverbanks. Further back on the left a few solitary trees, in the middle a stone bridge, with a funeral procession crossing over it. Further back on the right hills and mountains.

works.d: Eest taha suunduv jõgi kollane loojuvast päikesest. Vasakul ja paremal kuldne lehtpuu.
works.de: A river running from front to back, yellow from the setting sun. Golden deciduous tree on the left and right.

works.d: Ees küngaste vahel allapoole laskuv tee. Üle tiheda põõsastiku vaade linnakatustele ja valgele kirikule.
works.de: In front, a road descending among hills. Over dense shrubbery a view of city rooftops and a white church.

works.dm: kõrgus: 22.1 cm (vm); lehe laius: 33.8 cm (lm); lehe kõrgus: 24.8 cm (lm); laius: 33.8 cm (vm)
works.d: Esiplaanil künkal kiviehitise varemed, taamal vasakul  asuva hoone kontuurid. Taevas pilvistatud - all keskel tindikirjas: "Die Marienkapelle bei Maholm ...
works.de: In the foreground on a hill the ruins of a stone structure, in the distance on the left the outlines of a building. Sky clouded - at the bottom centre in ink writing: "Die Marienkapelle bei Maholm ...

works.d: Kaljul istuv mungarõivais mees, kellele linnud ulatavad toitu. Paremal oja.
works.de: A man in monk's robes sitting on a rock, to whom birds bring food. A stream on the right.

works.d: Eest paremalt taga vasakule kulgeval põldude vahelisel teel XIX s. riietuses (maani rüüs paeltega kübaras) naine ja kaabus mees - selgvaates. Nende juures kaks koera. Kaugemal naine tütarlapsega. Tagapool üle põlde palistava põõsastikus näha kiriku katust ja torni ning hoonete katuseid.
works.de: On a path between fields running from front right to back left, in 19th-century dress (a floor-length gown and a ribboned bonnet) a woman and a man in a top hat - seen clearly. Two dogs beside them. Further away a woman with a girl. Further back, in bushes bordering the fields, the roof and tower of a church and the roofs of buildings can be seen.

works.d: Halli habeme ja tumedate, kohevil juustega mehe rinnapilt, ümbritsetud ovaaliga.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man with a grey beard and dark, tousled hair, surrounded by an oval.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi madala kaldaga ja üksiku suure puuga. Taga paremal sild. Fooniks mets.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a low bank and a single large tree. Behind it on the right a bridge. Forest as background.

works.d: Paremal käredavooluline jõgi veskitammiga, vasemal kaks suurt puud ja üksik figuur teerajal. Tagapool õlgkatusega hooned. Kauguses mets ja pruunikas toonis kõrgustiku siluett.
works.de: On the right a fast-flowing river with a mill dam, on the left two large trees and a solitary figure on a path. Behind, buildings with straw roofs. In the distance a forest and, in brownish tones, the silhouette of a highland.

works.d: Esiplaani kitsal kaldaribal naine lapsega paadi kõrval. Vasemal tormine meri, kalda ääres vahutavate lainetega. Paremal merre ulatuv palkidest paadisadam ankrus purjepaatidega, tagapool majad. Taevas tumedais pilveis.
works.de: In the foreground on a narrow strip of shore a woman with a child beside a boat. On the left a stormy sea, with foaming waves along the shore. On the right a log-built boat harbour extending into the sea with anchored sailboats, houses further behind. Sky in dark clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaldariba madalate põõsastega, sellest tagapool kõrgem kallas puudega. Paremal meri paljude kividega. Keskel purjekas. Madal horisont, õhtune valgustus.
works.de: In the foreground at left a strip of shore with low bushes, behind it a higher bank with trees. At right the sea with many stones. In the centre a sailboat. Low horizon, evening lighting.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrgel nõlval jämeda tüvega lehtpuu all noor habemik mees maalimas, maalikast põlvel. Temast tagapool vasakul roosas kleidis noor  naine tegevust jälgimas, raamat süles, jalgade juures kübar, lamav kirju koer. Valgus langeb vasakult naise seljale ja puu alumistele okstele. Taamal paremal mägede vaheline org veekoguga sinakas vines. Detailitäpne viimistletud maalilaad.
works.de: In the foreground, on a high slope, under a leafy tree with a thick trunk, a young bearded man is painting, with a paint box on his knee. Behind him on the left, a young woman in a pink dress watches the activity, a book in her lap, a hat by her feet, a spotted dog lying down. Light falls from the left onto the woman's back and the lower branches of the tree. In the distance on the right, a valley between mountains with a body of water in a bluish haze. A detailed, refined, polished painting style.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud kallaste vahel veekogu. Taga punetava õhtutaeva taustal antiiksete sammastemplite varemed.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water between overgrown banks. Behind, against a reddening evening sky, the ruins of antique columned temples.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannal kirevates riietes rahvahulk, tagaplaanil sünge meri ja hoonete katused.
works.de: In the foreground on the beach a crowd in colourful clothes, in the background the gloomy sea and roofs of buildings.

works.d: Keskealise tumedajuukselise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, sinakas kuues.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged, dark-haired man in three-quarter profile facing right, wearing a bluish coat.

works.d: Esiplaanil põõsastik, keskel järve kaldal taluhooned, taamal künklik maastik metsatukkadega.
works.de: In the foreground, shrubbery, farm buildings in the centre on the lakeshore, a hilly landscape with groves of trees beyond.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul maastikukallakul maju, keskel järv, taamal kõrgeneval maastikul talumaja ja mets.
Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv põldudevaheline külatänav, piiratud kivitaraga; tänaval rühm inimesi. Taamal taluhooneid ja puid.
works.de: In the foreground a village street between fields, leading into the depth, bordered by a stone fence; a group of people on the street. In the distance farm buildings and trees.

works.d: Kivises rannamaastikus grupp naisi ja mehi aerudega õlgadel.
works.de: In a rocky coastal landscape, a group of women and men with oars on their shoulders.

works.d: Esiplaanil põllud, taamal all orus järve ääres grupp maju. Selle taga künklik maastik metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground fields, in the distance below in a valley by a lake a group of houses. Behind it a hilly landscape with forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul lumise okaspuu metsa all meeste figuure laasimas, saagimas. Paremal puude all lõkketule ääres istuvaid inimfiguure.
works.de: In the foreground on the right and left, under a snowy coniferous forest, figures of men pruning branches, sawing. On the right, under the trees, figures of people sitting by a campfire.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine lagendik. Vasakult keskelt taha suunduva roigastara taga õlgkatusega hooneid ja üksikuid suuri lehtpuid. Paremal taga kitsas riba põlde. Horisondil taluhooneid ja tuulik.
works.de: In the foreground a stony open ground. Behind a pole fence running from the left centre towards the back, thatched-roof buildings and single large deciduous trees. On the right in the background a narrow strip of fields. On the horizon farm buildings and a windmill.

works.d: Ees rannaliivale laotatud linal naised lambaid pügamas. Vasakul vee ääres naisi ja mehi lambaid pesemas. Taga paremal rannamaastik taluhoonetega, vasakul meri.
works.de: In front, women shearing sheep on a sheet spread on the beach sand. On the left by the water women and men washing sheep. Behind on the right a coastal landscape with farm buildings, on the left the sea.

works.d: Lumisel jääl mehi jääplaate murdmas. Tagapool hobuseid koormatega. Taamal mets, vasakult paistab kõrge vabrikuhoone suitseva korstnaga. Koloriit hall, tume.
works.de: On the snowy ice, men breaking ice plates. Behind them horses with loads. In the distance a forest, on the left a tall factory building with a smoking chimney is visible. Colouring grey, dark.

works.dm: kõrgus: 43.5 cm (vm); laius: 37.5 cm (vineeri mõõt); kõrgus: 46.2 cm (vineeri mõõt); laius: 35.5 cm (vm)
works.d: Ees puude vahel lumised pargiteed üksikute figuuridega. Taga kõrged majad.
works.de: In front, among trees, snowy park paths with solitary figures. Behind, tall buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil tasandik, keskel mäenõlvak põõsaste ja puudega, taamal künklik maastik.
works.de: In the foreground a plain, in the middle a mountain slope with bushes and trees, in the distance a hilly landscape.

works.dm: kõrgus: 29.7 cm (vineeri mõõt); laius: 18.9 cm (vm); kõrgus: 25.8 cm (vm); laius: 23.0 cm (vineeri mõõt)
works.d: Tumedajuukselise keskealise mehe pea kerge pöördega paremale.
works.de: The head of a dark-haired middle-aged man turned slightly to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil 6-nurksel laual valge emaileeritud kann, milles suur kimp valgeid lopsakaid pojenge. Kannu kõrval punase-halli triibulisel linikul klaasist vaasis punased lilled, vaasi ees puukauss lakkmaalinguga.
works.de: In the foreground on a hexagonal table a white enamelled jug with a large bouquet of lush white peonies. Next to the jug, on a red-grey striped cloth, red flowers in a glass vase, in front of the vase a wooden bowl with lacquer painting.

works.d: Kõrge horisondiga lage maastik. Diagonaalselt vasakule suunduv tee. Taga vasakul rühm hooneid.
works.de: Bare landscape with a high horizon. A road leading diagonally to the left. Behind on the left a group of buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil valge linaga kaetud lamandil tekiga kaetud lamav figuur selgvaates. Katmata pea padjal. Vasakul tool riietega. Foon valkjas, tekk beežikas-sinisega. Foon ja teki osa õhukese värvikihiga, lina tugevate pintslitõmmetega maalitud.
works.de: In the foreground, on a couch covered with a white sheet, a reclining figure covered with a blanket, seen from the front. The uncovered head rests on a pillow. On the left a chair with clothes. The background whitish, the blanket beige-blue. The background and part of the blanket are painted with a thin layer of paint, the sheet with strong brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul noor heledajuukseline tütarlaps valge pikakäiselise pluusi ja tumeda seelikuga, vemmal käes, tema kõrval raagus lehtpuud. Kaugemal kollendavate puudega ääristatud lagendikul kari söömas. Silmapiiril tume sinine metsamüür. Taevas sügiseselt pilves. Maastik luituvate värvitoonidega.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a young fair-haired girl in a white long-sleeved blouse and a dark skirt, with a stick in her hand, beside her bare deciduous trees. Further away, in a clearing bordered by yellowing trees, a herd is grazing. On the horizon a dark blue wall of forest. The sky autumnally overcast. The landscape in fading colour tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil suur kartuliväli lahtiaetud vagudega, vasakul vagusid lahtiajav mees hobusega, kartulivõtjad grupeerunud vasakul 3-kesi, keskel 2-kesi ja paremal äärel üks kummardunud korvi kohale. Ülal sünkjais pilvis keerlevad linnud, paremal silmapiiril hoonete ähmased kontuurid, mets, avar lage väli selle ees. Inimfiguurid ja maapind maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega rohekais-pruunides toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a large potato field with opened-up furrows, on the left a man with a horse opening up the furrows, potato pickers grouped in threes on the left, in twos in the middle, and on the right edge one bent over above a basket. Above, in gloomy clouds, birds circling, on the right on the horizon the hazy contours of buildings, a forest, a wide open field in front of it. The human figures and the ground are painted with broad brushstrokes in greenish-brown tones.

works.d: Vaade ühekorruselistele agulimajadele. Esiplaanil puutaraga ümbritsetud õunapuuaed, kaugemal pruunikad ja luitunud puumajad lumiste katustega. Pehmed värvitoonid nüanssidega, maalitud kergelt.
works.de: View of single-storey suburban houses. In the foreground an apple orchard enclosed by a wooden fence, further away brownish and faded wooden houses with snowy roofs. Soft colour tones with nuances, painted lightly.

works.d: Väga kõrge horisondiga lage maastik, mille keskosas riba küntud põldu, kus paremal mees valge habemega alustab uue vao kündmist.
works.de: A flat landscape with a very high horizon, in the middle part of which a strip of ploughed field, where on the right a man with a white beard begins ploughing a new furrow.

works.d: Paremal kõrge kuusemets, selle taga ja vasakul roosa taevas. Esiplaanil lõkke ümber istuvad inimesed, vasakul seisab valges pluusis ja punases seelikus tütarlaps käed hõikamiseks suu juurde tõstetud.
works.de: On the right, a tall spruce forest, behind it and on the left a pink sky. In the foreground, people sitting around a campfire, on the left a girl stands in a white blouse and red skirt with her hands raised to her mouth as if calling out.

works.d: Esiplaanil raagus puude vahelt vaade lumistele linnamajadele. Tagant paistavad suitsevad tehase korstnad.
works.de: In the foreground, a view through bare trees of snowy town houses. In the background smoking factory chimneys are visible.

works.t: ENSV teenelise kunstniku Stalini preemia laureaadi Martin Tarase portree
works.d: Otsevaates istuv mees. Peas hele kaabu, seljas tume mantel, mille hõlmad eest lahti. Kaelas valge krae punase ristlipsuga. Parem käsi toetub parema jalale, vasak puusas. Kuue servadel Stalini preemia medal. Temast paremal paistab osaliselt töödel lebav portfell.
works.de: A man sitting in a frontal view. On his head a light-coloured hat, wearing a dark coat with the flaps open in front. Around his neck a white collar with a red cross-tie. His right hand rests on his right leg, the left on his hip. On the edges of his coat the Stalin Prize medal. To his right a briefcase lying on papers is partly visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage, määrdunud lumega kaetud org. Tagapool pikk madal rehehoone. Paremal, hoone ees, naine punases seelikus, ämber vasakus käes.
works.de: In the foreground an open valley covered with dirty snow. Behind it a long low threshing barn. On the right, in front of the building, a woman in a red skirt, a bucket in her left hand.

works.d: Noore naise rinnaportree. Tume juus, lilla hallikasruuduline rõivastus. Pea pööratud veidi vasakule.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman. Dark hair, purple greyish-checked clothing. Head turned slightly to the left.

works.t: Kalurikolhoosi “Nõukogude partisan” eesrindlik töötaja A. Oade
works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur seisvas asendis, keha pöördes vasakule. Käes kast kaladega. Peas roosa rätik, seljas lilleline pluus, käes presentkindad.
works.de: The half-figure of a young woman in a standing position, body turned to the left. In her hands a box with fish. On her head a pink kerchief, wearing a floral blouse, on her hands tarpaulin gloves.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnakujtuis vasakule. Hallid juuksed, prillid, tume ülikond.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man, turned to the left. Grey hair, glasses, dark suit.

works.d: Hallipäise mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Valge krae, punasekirju lips, must kuub, rohekas foon.
works.de: Portrait of a grey-haired man in half-profile to the right. White collar, red-patterned tie, black jacket, greenish background.

works.d: Istuva vanamehe 3/4 figuur kerges pöördes paremale, kaabu peas, tumepunane kampsun, must vest. Piip vasakus käes. Vana talutuba, taadi selja taga väike aken.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated old man, slightly turned to the right, wearing a hat, dark red jumper, black waistcoat. A pipe in his left hand. An old peasant room, a small window behind the old man's back.

works.d: Lainetest üleuhutud lauter suunaga diametraalselt paremast nurgast vasakule poole. Telefoniliin, mootorpaat.
works.de: A boat washed up by waves, oriented diametrically from the right corner towards the left. A telephone line, a motorboat.

works.d: Seisva noore naise 3/4 figuur sinise mantli ja laiaäärse kübaraga, käed taskus, vaade üle vasaku õla. Mantli hõlmad avatud - valge pluus, hall seelik, pluus lilla sidusega. Foon hele. Vasakul altäärest ja paremalt nurgast näha lõuend.
works.de: A 3/4 figure of a standing young woman with a blue coat and a wide-brimmed hat, hands in pockets, gaze cast over the left shoulder. The coat's front open - a white blouse, a grey skirt, the blouse with a purple trim. Background light. On the left from the lower edge and from the right corner the canvas is visible.

works.d: Nelja seisva mehe poolfiguurid mererannas. Keskmine mees topib piipu, parempoolsel köiepundar õlal.
works.de: Half-figures of four standing men on a seashore. The middle man is filling a pipe, the one on the right has a coil of rope on his shoulder.

works.d: Vanema istuva naise kolmveerand figuur otsevaates. Käed süles koorib kartulit. Valge rätt, sinine pluus, punakas põll. Tume pruunikas foon, paremal lauanurk.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an elderly seated woman, frontal view. Hands in her lap, peeling a potato. White kerchief, blue blouse, reddish apron. Dark brownish background, a table corner at right.

works.d: Esiplaanil laual vasakul kõrge kaelaga valge kann, paremal madal vaas. Taga pildiraamide külge drapeeritud punase ja mustaruuduline riie, mille üks ots voltidena lauale ulatuv.
works.de: In the foreground on a table, on the left a tall-necked white jug, on the right a low vase. Behind, a red and black checkered cloth draped over picture frames, one end of which reaches the table in folds.

works.d: Sügisene pargivaade. Esiplaanil keskel tee, mis kaardub paremale ja kaob puutüvede taha. Teest vasakul ja paremal sirgete tüvedega, kauguses hajuvad, maali ülaservani ulatuvad puud. Kaugemal teel punases riides naisfiguur ja meesfiguur.
works.de: Autumn park view. In the foreground in the centre a path curving to the right and disappearing behind tree trunks. To the left and right of the path, straight-trunked trees reaching to the top edge of the painting, thinning out in the distance. Further along the path a female figure in red clothing and a male figure.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskealise mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule. Taga vasakul meri ja paadid, paremal kaldaäär.
works.de: In the foreground a bust portrait of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the left. Behind on the left the sea and boats, on the right the shoreline.

works.d: Esiplaanil paadisadamas võrkudest kalakorjamine: seljaga kaks meest ja üks naine, vastaspoolel samuti kaks meest ja naine. Taga vasakul sinetav meri, kajakad ja valge torn roosa katusega, paremal ehitus.
works.de: In the foreground, at a boat harbour, collecting fish from nets: two men and one woman with their backs turned, on the opposite side likewise two men and a woman. In the background on the left the bluish sea, seagulls and a white tower with a pink roof, on the right a building.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm seisvat naisefiguuri, keskel suur, kogu pildipinda haarav lehtpuu. Taamal põõsaste ja puude kontuure.
works.de: In the foreground on the right three standing female figures, in the middle a large deciduous tree covering the whole picture surface. In the background contours of bushes and trees.

works.dm: kõrgus: 86.0 cm; kujutise laius: 93.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 80.0 cm; laius: 97.0 cm
works.d: Interjöör. Esiplaanil paremal taburet ja püstiseisev naine selgvaates. Vasakul seina ääres kartuli korv, keskel raiepakk, kirves. Aknaesisel pingil õllekann. Läbi akna paistab mehe figuur.
works.de: Interior. In the foreground on the right a stool and a woman standing, seen frontally. On the left by the wall a potato basket, in the middle a chopping block, an axe. On the bench by the window a beer jug. Through the window a man's figure is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtmaal kaks põõsast, keskel üle pildipinna ulatuv roigastara, mille taga segametsa taustal kelpkatusega talumaja.
works.de: In the foreground on grassland two bushes, in the middle a pole fence extending across the picture plane, behind which a farmhouse with a hipped roof against a background of mixed forest.

works.d: Lumivalgete juuste ning täishabeme ja vurrudega vana mehe pea, otsevaates. Juuksed kammitud vasakule lahku. Alumised silmalaud tugevalt kottis. Foon sinine.
works.de: Head of an old man with snow-white hair and a full beard and moustache, frontal view. Hair combed parted to the left. Lower eyelids heavily baggy. Background blue.

works.d: Alläärest, keskelt kaob loogeldes pildisügavikku, männimetsa tee. Metsa kohal laik taevast, üksiku laotuse sinasse hajuva pilveribaga.
works.de: From the bottom edge, in the middle, a road through a pine forest winds away into the depth of the picture. A patch of sky above the forest, with a cloud streak dissolving into the blue of the lone expanse.

works.t: a) Kalevipoeg laudu kandmas; b) Meri
works.d: Vee piiril taeva taustal astuv Kalevipoeg selgvaates, lauakoorem vasakul õlal, kirjatud tupes mõõk vööl. Paremal jändriku männi latv, silmapiiril metsaviirg. Maal dekoratiivselt värvikas, figuuri ümbritseb pruun kontuurjoon.
works.de: At the water's edge against the sky Kalevipoeg striding, seen frontally, a load of boards on his left shoulder, an ornamented sword in its sheath at his belt. On the right the crown of a gnarled pine, a strip of forest on the horizon. The painting decoratively colourful, the figure surrounded by a brown contour line.

works.d: Metsaveerel istuv Kalevipoeg külgvaates vasakule, ristatud käed põlvedel. Paremal, tema selja taga lähenemas hulk sõjamehi kilpide ja mõõkadega. Taamal maastik veekoguga, rünkpilvine taevas. Maal erksavärviline, kujundid ümbritsetud peene tumeda kontuurjoonega.
works.de: Kalevipoeg sitting at the edge of a forest, in side view facing left, arms crossed on his knees. On the right, behind him, a host of warriors with shields and swords approaching. In the distance a landscape with a body of water, a sky with cumulus clouds. The painting is brightly coloured, the figures outlined with a fine dark contour line.

works.d: Vasakul seisev Kalevipoeg otsevaates, jalad harkis, langetatud mõõk paremas käes. Tema taga vana kandlemängija, juuksed tuules ja rida seisvaid sõdalasi, piigid püsti. Taamal muistne linnus.
works.de: Kalevipoeg standing on the left in a frontal view, legs apart, lowered sword in his right hand. Behind him an old kannel player, hair in the wind, and a row of standing warriors, spears upright. In the distance an ancient stronghold.

works.d: Rannal istuva muistse eestlase /Kalevipoeg/ 3/4 figuur külgvaates vasakule. Mees kätest-jalust köidetud jämeda ketiga kalju külge. Pea rinnal, käed toetuvad taha, jalad ette sirutatud. Taga vasakul tema kohale kummarduva alasti naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Taustaks kivine mererand.
works.de: 3/4 figure of an ancient Estonian sitting on the shore /Kalevipoeg/, in side view facing left. The man bound hand and foot with a thick chain to a cliff. Head on chest, arms resting behind, legs stretched forward. Behind on the left, the half-figure of a naked woman bending over him, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Background a rocky sea coast.

works.d: Kolm otsesuunas sõitvat täispurjedes viikingite laeva tähistaeva foonil. Laevadel seisvad sõdalased. Purjedel ornament. Maal sinakas koloriidis, kujundid tugeva kontuurjoonega piiritletud.
works.de: Three fully-sailed Viking ships sailing straight ahead against a starry sky background. Warriors standing on the ships. Ornament on the sails. The painting in bluish tones, the shapes delineated with a strong contour line.

works.d: Lagendikul grupp mände, tüvedel päikeselaigud. Puude varjud maapinnal. Tüvede taga helesinine taevas, kaugem metsaviirg. Maalil erksad sinised-rohelised toonid.
works.de: A group of pines in a clearing, sunspots on the trunks. Shadows of the trees on the ground. Behind the trunks, a light blue sky, a distant strip of forest. The painting is in bright blue-green tones.

works.d: Sopiliste kallastega veekogu ääres esiplaanil vasakul kolm, paremal kaks pikavarrelist punase kobaraõisikuga taime. Silmapiiril kahvatu kuu, peegeldus vees. Maal sinakais toonides täppivalt, paralleelsete pintslilöökidega maalitud.
works.de: By the shore of a body of water with indented banks, in the foreground on the left three, on the right two long-stemmed plants with red clustered inflorescences. On the horizon, a pale moon, reflected in the water. The painting is executed in bluish tones, dabbed with parallel brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil maapind üksikute lumelaikudega. Keskel tee. Vasakul taluhoone ja raagus puud. Eemal künkad, mis kaovad sinisesse uduvinesse.
works.de: In the foreground the ground with isolated patches of snow. In the middle a road. On the left a farm building and bare trees. In the distance hills that disappear into a bluish haze.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi. Selle taga tumedad künkad metsaga. Kollakalt hõõguv taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, water. Behind it, dark hills with forest. A yellowishly glowing sky.

works.d: Väike-Munamägi ja Tedremägi. Kaks kõrvutiasetsevat tumerohelise metsaga kaetud madalat mäekuplit. Mägede jalamil kollakas-pruunikas sügismaastik, mis esiplaanil muutub erinevate varjunditega roheliseks. Paremal heleroheline põld. Horisondil tume mets. Kollakas kiudpilvedega kaetud taevas silmapiiri kohal lillaka varjundiga.
works.de: Väike-Munamägi and Tedremägi. Two adjacent low hill domes covered with dark green forest. At the foot of the hills a yellowish-brownish autumn landscape, which in the foreground turns green with various shades. On the right a light green field. Dark forest on the horizon. A yellowish sky covered with cirrus clouds, with a purplish tinge above the horizon.

works.d: Künklik maastik, esiplaanil keskel järv. Taevas hall, silmapiiril sinetavad metsad.
works.de: Hilly landscape, a lake in the middle of the foreground. Grey sky, bluish forests on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelised põllud ja väike järv. Taamal sinised mäed.
works.de: In the foreground green fields and a small lake. Blue mountains in the distance.

works.d: Lõuna-Eesti künklik panoraam: ees heledad põllud, mis vahelduvad tumedate viirgudega, taga metsased nõlvakud.
works.de: A hilly panorama of South Estonia: in front, light fields alternating with dark strips, behind forested slopes.

works.d: Esiplaanil Emajõgi. Paremalpoolsel kaldal suured mullahunnikud; pildi servaga osaliselt äralõigatud turuhoone. Kaugemalt paistab sild ning linn. Koloriit tume - hallid, pruunid toonid.
works.de: In the foreground the Emajõgi river. On the right-hand bank large piles of earth; the market hall, partly cut off by the edge of the picture. In the distance a bridge and the town can be seen. The colouring is dark - grey, brown tones.

works.d: Panoraamvaade Lõuna-Eesti maastikule. Eespool roosakad-rohekad põllusiilud vaheldumisi rõheliste metsadega. Keskel helesinine veekogu. Silmapiiril, taeva ja maa vahel sinine viirg.
works.de: Panoramic view of a South Estonian landscape. In the foreground pinkish-greenish field strips alternating with green forests. In the middle a light blue body of water. On the horizon, between sky and land, a blue streak.

works.d: Süngetes sinistes-rohelistes toonides Lõuna-Eesti kuppelmaastik. Ees keskel sinine, taevast peegeldav veekogu. Taga sinavate kuplite vahel rohetamas siin-seal põllud.
works.de: Sombre blue-green tones of a South Estonian hilly landscape. In the centre foreground a blue body of water reflecting the sky. Behind, among bluish hills, fields showing green here and there.

works.d: Laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud järvevaade tagapool piirava kaldaga, mille kohal rasketes hallikas-sinistes toonides taevas peegeldub veepinnal. Vastaskallas tumerohelise koloriidiga.
works.de: A lake view painted with broad brush strokes, with a bounding shore behind, above which a sky in heavy greyish-blue tones is reflected on the water's surface. The opposite shore is in a dark green colouring.

works.d: Vaikne panoraamne järvevaade sinakas-tumedale kaldale, mis peegeldub siledal veepinnal. Taevas hallikas-helesinine, keskel üksik väike pilvetomp, mille kujutist on näha ka järvepinnal.
works.de: A quiet panoramic view of a lake with a bluish-dark shore, reflected on the smooth water surface. The sky is greyish-light blue, with a single small tuft of cloud in the centre, whose image can also be seen on the lake's surface.

works.d: Rohelises glasuuritud savivaasis kolm valget gladiooli. Lopsakad, veidi jämedalt maalitud õied on kergelt hallikad. Taust vaarikapunane, paremal kitsam laid puhas punane. Vaas asetatud helehallile pinnale.
works.de: In a green glazed clay vase three white gladioli. The lush, somewhat coarsely painted flowers are slightly grayish. The background is raspberry red, on the right a narrower strip pure red. The vase is placed on a light gray surface.

works.d: Ookertoonides Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Taamal tumedad metsad, eespool punakad, ookerjad põllusiilud. Kuppelmaastikus looklevad roosakad teed. Eespool all sinine veekogu, mille servas valget jääkirmet.
works.de: South Estonian landscape in ochre tones. Dark forests in the distance, reddish, ochre-coloured field strips in the foreground. Pinkish roads winding through the rolling landscape. Below in the foreground a blue body of water, with white ice glaze at its edge.

works.d: Vaade järvele ja kahele ümarikule rohelisele saarele. Hoogsalt maalitud sinistes, rohelistes toonides Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Taamal sinavad kõrgendikud.
works.de: A view of a lake and two roundish green islands. A South Estonian landscape painted vigorously in blue and green tones. Highlands loom bluish in the distance.

works.d: Pastoosselt maalitud maastik. All ees järv mis peegeldab kõrget metsaga kaetud kallast. Markeeritud puud on kirjud - punased, kollased, rohelised, pruunikad. Metsa kohal sinakas-hallikas pilvine sügistaevas. Nii mets kui taevas peegelduvad järves.
works.de: A landscape painted in a pastose manner. In the foreground below a lake reflecting a high forested bank. The marked trees are variegated - red, yellow, green, brownish. Above the forest a bluish-grey cloudy autumn sky. Both the forest and the sky are reflected in the lake.

works.d: Põhjamaiselt sinistes toonides lopsakas järvevaade. Horisondil paremal saar. Taga vastaskaldal kuppelmaastik. Taamal suured rünkpilved, peamiselt vertikaalsed, moodustades nii omalaadse triibustiku. Pilved peegelduvad ees järves.
works.de: A lush lake view in northerly blue tones. On the horizon to the right an island. Behind, on the opposite shore, a domed landscape. In the distance large cumulus clouds, mainly vertical, thus forming a peculiar striping. The clouds are reflected in the lake in front.

works.d: Hallikas-sinistes toonides staatiline järvevaade. Vasakul tumedatest metsamassiividest kallas, taamal laugjad sinised mäed, ees pruunikas liivariba. Sinakashall veepind peegeldab kaldaid. Taevas hall.
works.de: A static lake view in greyish-blue tones. On the left a shore with dark forest masses, in the distance gently sloping blue mountains, in the foreground a brownish strip of sand. The bluish-grey water surface reflects the shores. The sky is grey.

works.d: Murul istuva tumedajuukselise tütarlapse täisfiguur otsevaates. Seljas valge seelik ja punane pluus. Vasak käsi toetub maha, parem parema jala säärele. Heleroheline foon kollaste ja valgete laikudega.
works.de: Full figure of a dark-haired girl sitting on grass, seen frontally. Wearing a white skirt and red blouse. Left hand resting on the ground, right hand on her right shin. Light green background with yellow and white patches.

works.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise figuur suunaga vasemale. Paremas käes mõõk, vasemas Holofernese pea. Paremal taga teine naise figuur.
works.de: The figure of a young dark-haired woman facing left. A sword in the right hand, Holofernes's head in the left. Behind on the right another female figure.

works.d: Keskel ristilt võetud Kristuse figuur, haavadega kätel, jalgadel ja küljes, pooleldi istuvas asendis teda selja tagant toetava naisfiguuri najal. Paremal, Kristuse figuuri kõrval ingli figuur tema vasakut kätt hoidmas. Vasakul all nurgas kibuvitsa kroon.
works.de: In the centre the figure of Christ taken down from the cross, with wounds on his hands, feet and side, in a half-sitting position, supported from behind by a female figure. On the right, beside the figure of Christ, an angel figure holding his left hand. In the lower left corner a crown of thorns.

works.d: Keskel istuv heledajuukseline nainepaljastatud ülakeha otse vaates, pea pöördega paremale, peegli suunas, mida hoiab väike Amor.
works.de: In the middle a seated fair-haired woman with bared upper body seen frontally, head turned to the right, towards a mirror held by a small Cupid.

works.d: Toolil istuva noore naise figuur, laps (jeesus) süles, taga paremal teine poisikene (Johannes).
works.de: Figure of a young woman seated on a chair, a child (Jesus) in her lap, behind on the right another boy (John).

works.d: Antiikses rõivastuses noore, heledajuukselise naise põlvpilt vasakul asuvale härjale nõjatumas. Naise nägu poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles. Härjal sarvede ümber lillepärg.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young, fair-haired woman in antique dress leaning against a bull on the left. The woman's face is in three-quarter profile to the right, gaze directed upward. The bull has a wreath of flowers around its horns.

works.d: Vanema tumedajuukselise naise põlvpilt harmooniumi ees istuvana. Keha kerge pöördega paremale nägu poolprofiilis vasakule. Must taftkleit kitsa valge pitskaeluse ja kätistega.  Peas valge pitstanu. Süles käte vahel avatud raamat. Paremal harmooniumi nurgal vaas lilledega; vasakul, laual väike skulptuurigrupp loomadega.
works.de: A knee-length portrait of an older dark-haired woman sitting in front of a harmonium. The body slightly turned to the right, the face in three-quarter profile to the left. A black taffeta dress with a narrow white lace collar and cuffs. On the head a white lace cap. In her lap, between her hands, an open book. On the right corner of the harmonium a vase with flowers; on the left, on a table, a small sculpture group with animals.

works.dm: diameeter: 140.0 cm (tondo); laius: 148.0 cm; kõrgus: 148.0 cm
works.d: Keskel pilvist ümbritsetud troonistmel istuv ingel eestvaates, tiivad laiali. Nägu pöördega vasemale. Parem käsi toetub raamatut hoidvana põlvele, vasemas käes lüüra. Vasemal tiivuline poisike kannab käes plaati tekstiga: NVMINE. Paremal asuval putol käes plaat tekstiga: AFFLATVR. Taust kuldmosaiik imitatsioonis. Kujutatud sõõris.
works.de: In the centre, an angel seated on a throne surrounded by clouds, in frontal view, wings spread. The face turned to the left. The right hand rests on a knee, holding a book, the left hand holds a lyre. On the left a winged little boy carries a tablet with the text: NVMINE. On the putto on the right, a tablet with the text: AFFLATVR. The background is an imitation of gold mosaic. Depicted within a circle.

works.d: Laua ääres istuva noore naise põlv pilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas valge lihtsajooneline tanu, seljas tumedast riidest kleit laia sileda valge krae ja kätistega. Vasak käsi nõjatub küünarnukiga lauale, paremas käes punane nelgiõis. Ermitaažis asuval originaalil ülal paremal signatuur: Rembrandt f. 1656.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman sitting at a table, in half-profile to the right. On her head a white, simply shaped bonnet, wearing a dark cloth dress with a broad smooth white collar and cuffs. Left hand resting elbow on the table, in the right hand a red carnation flower. On the original, located in the Hermitage, upper right, the signature: Rembrandt f. 1656.

works.d: Istuva naise figuur põlvini, poolprofiilis vasemale 16. saj. riietuses. Naise kõrval all vasakul laps.
works.de: Figure of a seated woman to the knees, in half-profile to the left, in 16th-century dress. A child beside the woman at lower left.

works.d: Vasakul noore, punasesse riietatud, tumedajuukselise naise süles lapsuke valges särgis, pilk suunatud ema näole. Paremal kollakat tooni rõivastuses helefajuukseline, ümber pea keeratud patssoenguga noor naine langetatud pilgul last silmitsemas. Paremas käes palmioks. Taustaks mägimaastik.
works.de: On the left, in the lap of a young dark-haired woman dressed in red, a small child in a white shirt, its gaze directed at the mother's face. On the right, a young woman with light hair braided and wound around her head, wearing yellowish clothing, looking down at the child. In her right hand a palm branch. Background a mountain landscape.

works.d: Keskealise habemiku mehe rinnapilt, õlal rist.
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged bearded man, a cross on the shoulder.

works.d: Noore sammuva naise täisfiguur, suunaga vasemale, jalas sandaalid, seljas roheline seelik, roosakas pluus. Üleval taga romantiline maastik.
works.de: Full figure of a young walking woman, facing left, wearing sandals, a green skirt, a pinkish blouse. In the background above, a romantic landscape.

works.d: Rinnapilt en face. Pea pisut kallutatud, ümbritsetud punase linikuga ja kroonitud sinise, tipulise krooniga; pilk langetatud. Foon kuldne, millel pruunikas toonis poolsõõris kulgev  ruudustik.
works.de: Bust portrait en face. Head slightly tilted, surrounded by a red cloth and crowned with a blue, pointed crown; gaze lowered. Golden background, on which a brownish-toned grid runs in a semicircle.

works.d: Rinnapilt peapöördega poolprofiilis vasemale. Juustes lauba kohal mingi ehe, seljas avara kaelusega kleit. Foon kuldne, millel pruunikas toonis poolsõõris kulgev ruudustik.
Pilvedes kaks inglikest maalimistarvetega büsti ees; kõrval lüüra ja palett, taga molbert. Kordustöö.
works.de: In the clouds two little angels with painting implements in front of busts; beside them a lyre and a palette, behind an easel. Repeat work.

works.d: Keskel kolm pilvedes hõljuvat inglikest, käes pikk valge lint. Paremal ja vasemal inglipaarid. Kordustöö.
works.de: In the middle three angels hovering in the clouds, holding a long white ribbon. On the right and left, pairs of angels. A repeat work.

works.d: Viis putot ja kaks delfiini laineharjadel. Üks putodest istub delfiini turjal, teised lamavais asendeis. Kordustöö.
works.de: Five putti and two dolphins on wave crests. One of the putti sits on the back of a dolphin, the others in reclining poses. A repeat work.

works.d: Istuv Põhja- Eesti rahvarõivais neiu. Sinine seelik, põiki triipudega allosas, valge pluus ja kaelas suur sõel. Parema väljasirutatud käega raputab kanadele teri; vasakus, põlvele toetatud käes väike kausike. Ees vasakus nurgas viljavihk ja sirp. Neiu taga seinal rippumas mitmeid tööriistu.
works.de: A seated maiden in North Estonian folk costume. A blue skirt with diagonal stripes at the lower part, a white blouse and a large sõel (breast ornament) at the neck. With her outstretched right hand she scatters grain to the hens; in her left hand, resting on her knee, a small bowl. In the front left corner a sheaf of grain and a sickle. Behind the maiden, several tools hang on the wall.

works.d: Vasak käsi: peopesa välja pööratud, sõrmed kergelt kõverdatud.
works.de: Left hand: palm turned outward, fingers slightly bent.

works.d: Parem käsi randmeni, sõrmed kergelt kõverdatud.
Parem käsi selgvaates. Sõrmed kõverdatud. Kavand.
works.de: Right hand in clear view. Fingers bent. Sketch.

works.d: Ristatud käed randmeni. Kavand.
works.de: Crossed arms to the wrist. Sketch.

works.d: Vasak käsi rusikasse tõmbunult. Õlikavand.
works.de: Left hand clenched into a fist. Oil sketch.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 71.0 cm; laius: 81.5 cm; kõrgus: 74.5 cm; kujutise laius: 74.0 cm
works.d: Magav lapsefiguur lamavas asendis, poolkaetult. Figuuri paigutus diagonaalselt vasemalt üles paremale.
works.de: Sleeping child figure in a lying position, half-covered. The figure is placed diagonally from lower left to upper right.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 67.0 cm; laius: 60.0 cm; kõrgus: 65.5 cm; kujutise laius: 56.5 cm
works.d: Habemiku mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale, pilk suunatud üles.
works.de: Chest portrait of a bearded man with his head turned to the left, gaze directed upward.

works.d: Kolm putofiguuri pasunatega.
works.de: Three putto figures with trumpets.

works.d: Kolme mängiva lapse ebamäärased figuurid.
works.de: Vague figures of three playing children.

works.d: Triibulisel vaibal istuv paljastatud ülakehaga noor, tumedajuukseline naine, suunaga profiilis paremale, kusjuures pea on pööratud vaatega parema õla suunas. Naisel peakatteks turban, kõrvas kõrvarõngas. Põlvil lebavas vasakus käes paabulinnusulgedest lehvik, paremal käel ümber randme kaks pärlkäevõru; jalas idamaise lõikega tuhvlid. Vasakul naise kõrval gitarrilaadne keelpill.
works.de: A young, dark-haired woman with a bared upper body sits on a striped rug, facing right in profile, with her head turned looking towards her right shoulder. The woman wears a turban as headwear, an earring in her ear. In her left hand, resting on her knee, a fan of peacock feathers, on her right wrist two pearl bracelets; on her feet slippers of oriental cut. To the woman's left a guitar-like stringed instrument.

works.d: Naise täisfiguur kolme lapsega. Üks alasti laps süles; teine parema käe kõrval; kolmas laps valge lühikese särgiga paremal, profiilis vasakule. Grupist paremal taamal kaks puud.
works.de: Full figure of a woman with three children. One naked child in her lap; a second beside her right hand; a third child wearing a short white shirt on the right, in profile to the left. To the right of the group, in the distance, two trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil puupakul istuv rahvarõivais naine lapsega. Triibuline seelik, sinisega tikitud käised, kollane pottmüts.
works.de: A woman in folk costume sitting on a wooden block in the foreground, with a child. Striped skirt, sleeves embroidered with blue, yellow pot-shaped cap.

works.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur pöördes paremale, nägu pööratud otse vaataja poole. Sügava kaelusega roheline kleit, õlgadel lopsakate voltidena kukkuv hall ülevise. Paremal laual avatud raamat ja karikas ussiga. Naise vasakus käes pärgamendi rull. Vasakus ülanurgas kotkas.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman turned to the right, face turned directly towards the viewer. Green dress with a deep neckline, a grey overgarment falling in lush folds on the shoulders. On a table to the right an open book and a chalice with a snake. In the woman's left hand a parchment scroll. In the upper left corner an eagle.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja kaldal kaks rahvariides istuvat naisfiguuri. Nende seljataga jämeda puutüve tagant vasakul piilub kaabus noormees. Paremal tagaplaanil järv paadiga kaldal ning suur kask.
works.de: In the foreground on the bank of a stream two seated female figures in national costume. Behind them, from behind a thick tree trunk on the left, a young man in a hat peeks out. In the background on the right a lake with a boat on the shore and a large birch.

works.d: Fragment: tumedasse ovaali maalitud naisepea ülestõstetud pilguga, pikkadel juustel lillevanik.
works.de: Fragment: a woman's head painted into a dark oval, with an upturned gaze, a wreath of flowers on long hair.

works.d: Suure kaarvärava juures kaks eesti rahvuslikes seelikutes ja käistes naist. Parempoolne, sirbiga käes, seisasb eredas päikesevalguses, vasakpoolne istub varjus.
works.de: By a large arched gate, two women in Estonian national skirts and sleeves. The one on the right, holding a sickle, stands in bright sunlight; the one on the left sits in shadow.

works.d: Tondoformaadis maal kahe lendleva putoga. Neil käes avatud raamatud, parempoolsel tiivad kirjud.
works.de: A tondo-format painting with two flying putti. They hold open books, the one on the right has spotted wings.

works.d: Tondoformaadis maal kahe lendleva putoga. Neil käes avatud raamatud, vasakpoolsel tiivad kirjud.

Jämedal puutüvel istub külgvaates noor blond naine Põhja-Eesti rahvariietes (sini-puna-beeži pikitriibuline seelik, valge põll, sinise tikandiga pluus, kullaga tikitud pottmüts), pea pööratud vaatajale. Parem käsi lapse seljal, kes teiseltpoolt puutüve toetub naise najale, vasakuga hoiab lapse kätt süles. Laps heledajuukseline, punapõskne, seljas valge särk, peas pärg. Vasakul pool figuuri osa suurema puu tüvest, paremal ronitaimed. Silmapiiril, sinakas udus Tallinna siluett.
works.de: On a thick tree trunk sits, in profile, a young blonde woman in North Estonian folk costume (blue-red-beige longitudinally striped skirt, white apron, blouse with blue embroidery, gold-embroidered pot-shaped cap), her head turned towards the viewer. Her right hand is on the back of a child, who leans against the woman from the other side of the trunk; with her left hand she holds the child's hand in her lap. The child is fair-haired, rosy-cheeked, wearing a white shirt, a wreath on its head. To the left of the figure, part of the trunk of a larger tree; on the right, climbing plants. On the horizon, in a bluish haze, the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Keskelt lahku, üle pea kammitud juustega noore naise rinnapilt poolprof. paremale. Seljas hall, eest nööbitud kleit.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman with her hair parted in the middle and combed over the head, in half-profile to the right. Wearing a grey dress buttoned in front.

works.d: Näpitsprillidega tugitoolis istuva mehe poolfiguur. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Käed asetatud sülle.
works.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in an armchair with pince-nez. Head turned slightly to the right. Hands placed in his lap.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivirahnudega tasandik. Kärestikulise ojaga, taga mets ja silmapiiril lumised mäetipud.
works.de: In the foreground a plain with boulders. With a rapid stream, behind it a forest and snowy mountain peaks on the horizon.

works.d: Realistlikus laadis maal. Esiplaanil paremal noor naine väikese tüdrukuga. Naisel on peas ja õlgadel punane rätt, käes hoiab korvi. Maali keskel heledas kleidis astuv tüdruk, kellel on käevangus mõned oksaraod, peas hele rätik. Naise pea veidi kaldu vasakule, lapsel kerges pöördes paremale. Tüdrukust vasemal aiakatkend, vasakul tagapool seljaga seisev mees kahe hobusega põllutöid tegemas. Koloriidilt on maal pastelne, pruunikais toonides. Taevas sinakas, maapind pruunikas-rohekas.
works.de: A painting in a realistic style. In the foreground on the right, a young woman with a small girl. The woman has a red kerchief on her head and shoulders, and holds a basket. In the middle of the painting, a girl in a light-coloured dress is walking, with a few twigs in the crook of her arm, a light-coloured kerchief on her head. The woman's head is tilted slightly to the left, the child in a slight turn to the right. To the left of the girl, a fragment of a garden, further back on the left a man standing with his back turned, working the fields with two horses. The colouring of the painting is pastel, in brownish tones. The sky is bluish, the ground brownish-greenish.

works.d: Keskel esiplaanil munk mustas mantlis taga müür gooti värava arkaadiga. Müüri nurk vasakul lõpeb ümartorniga. Õues paremal vaate ja tünne.
works.de: In the centre foreground a monk in a black cloak, behind him a wall with a Gothic gate arcade. The corner of the wall on the left ends in a round tower. In the yard on the right a vat and barrels.

works.d: Interjöör punases sametkleidis seisva naisfiguuriga paremal, vasemal tool vaibaga, ees põrandal tapetud linnud.
works.de: Interior with a female figure standing in a red velvet dress on the right, on the left a chair with a rug, in front on the floor dead birds.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivimüüris trepiga uks, astmeil punases riietuses vanamehe figuur hellebardiga käes, kõrval kruus. Treppiastmeil vallatlevaid rotte.
works.de: In the foreground a door with steps in a stone wall, on the steps the figure of an old man in red clothing holding a halberd, with a jug beside him. Rats frolicking on the steps.

works.d: Ees lumine lagendik, vasemal üksikuid kaski. Taga raagus lehtpuumets.
works.de: A snowy clearing in front, single birches on the left. Bare deciduous forest behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil 3 suurt puud. Nende vahelt vaade ehitavalae kivihoonele. Hoone ees hobused veovankritega.
works.de: In the foreground 3 large trees. Between them a view of a stone building under construction. In front of the building horses with carts.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja tammiga. Oja kaldal üksikuid raagus puid. Keskel tammi ääres vesiveski ja teisi hooneid. Taamal kõrgeneval künklikul maastikul okasmets.
works.de: In the foreground a stream with a dam. On the bank of the stream isolated leafless trees. In the centre by the dam a water mill and other buildings. In the distance, on a rising hilly landscape, coniferous forest.

works.d: Künklik varakevadine maastik. Esiplaanil lahtist vett ja raagus põõsaid. Mõlema ääre suunas kerkivail nõlvakuil kuuski. Taamal keskel hooneid.
works.de: Hilly early-spring landscape. In the foreground open water and bare bushes. On the slopes rising towards both edges, spruces. In the background, buildings in the middle.

works.d: Esiplaanil, paralleelselt pildipinnal kitsas tee ja madalad kiviaiad, mille taga pikad madalad hooned. Paremal majade vahel üksikud puud. Madal horisont, lage taevas valgete pilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground, running parallel to the picture plane, a narrow road and low stone walls, behind which long low buildings. On the right, solitary trees among the houses. Low horizon, open sky with white clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõe ääres kummuli keeratud paat ja palgid. Üle jõe näha linna panoraamne vaade.
works.de: In the foreground by the river a capsized boat and logs. Across the river a panoramic view of the town can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine mererand. Vasakul ja paremal õlgkatustega hooneid, keskel latt-tara, taamal meri.
works.de: A rocky seashore in the foreground. Thatched-roof buildings on the left and right, a slat fence in the middle, the sea beyond.

works.d: Keskel istuv mees lõõtspilliga, tema ümber seisvad ja istuvad lapsed. Maalitud tumedais, pruunides toonides.
works.de: A seated man with an accordion in the centre, surrounded by standing and sitting children. Painted in dark, brown tones.

works.d: Talvine mets kahe metsatöölise- ja lõkkega esiplaanil.
works.de: Winter forest with two forest workers and a campfire in the foreground.

works.d: Madala silmapiirini ulatuv põld. Vasakule jäävad nelja kartulinoppija figuurid, paremale hobune.
works.de: A field reaching to a low horizon. To the left the figures of four potato pickers, to the right a horse.

works.d: Esiplaanil külavahetee, mida vasakult poolt ääristab kiviaed ja talumajad. Paremal pool tee ääres kaks tuulikut.
works.de: In the foreground a village road, bordered on the left by a stone wall and farmhouses. On the right, beside the road, two windmills.

works.d: Sinise riidega kaetud toolis tumedas kleidis noore naise kolmveerandfiguur, süles roosa päevavari. Parem käsivars toetub tooli seljatoele, pea kergelt langetatud, pilk suunatud ette.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman in a dark dress seated in a chair covered with blue fabric, a pink parasol in her lap. Right arm resting on the back of the chair, head slightly lowered, gaze directed forward.

works.d: Sinisel foonil tumedas kleidis istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur, poolpöördes paremale. Peas valge barett, käes ovaalne peegel.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman sitting in a dark dress on a blue background, in a half-turn to the right. A white beret on her head, an oval mirror in her hand.

works.d: Tumehallil foonil, mille ülaserv ookrivärvi, istub noor naine, en face, labajalad pildiservaga ära lõigatud. Ilme mõtlik, seljas hele värvikate läigetega kleit musta vööga ja musta eest avatud mantliga. Käed osaliselt riide voltidega varjatud.
works.de: Against a dark gray background whose upper edge is ochre-colored, a young woman sits en face, feet cut off by the edge of the picture. Pensive expression, wearing a light dress with colorful sheens and a black belt and a black coat open at the front. Hands partly hidden by the folds of the fabric.

works.d: Lillakal foonil istub noor naine kehapöördega vasakule, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Nägu korrapäraste näojoontega, siledad juuksed taha kammitud. Küünarnukkideni paljastatud käed tugevad, parem käsi ovaalsel toolikorjul, vasakus avatus raamat. Kleit sinise-punase-halli kirju, maalitud täppivalt krobelise faktuuriga.
works.de: Against a purple background a young woman is seated with her body turned to the left, her gaze directed at the viewer. Face with regular features, smooth hair combed back. Arms bare to the elbows are strong, the right hand on the oval armrest of the chair, an open book in the left. Dress in blue-red-grey pattern, painted with a dotted, rough texture.

works.d: Ees keskel eest taha suunduv lumine tänav. Vasakul ees plankaia taga üksik raagus puu ja kahekordne hoone. Tagapool madalamate hoonete rida. Paremal plangu taga kaks kasvuhoonet kõrgete korstnatega. Taga majad.
works.de: In the middle foreground, a snowy street leading from front to back. On the left in front, behind a plank fence, a lone bare tree and a two-story building. Further back, a row of lower buildings. On the right, behind a fence, two greenhouses with tall chimneys. Houses in the back.

works.d: Roheka tausta foonil valgel alusel lamav naisakt. Vasak käsi ning jalg kõverdatud. Ülakeha toetumas padjale, pea pööratud vasakule, vaatajast ära. Maalitud laiade, vabade pintslitõmmetega; figuuri modelleerimisel kasutatud värvipinda sissekraapimist.
works.de: A female nude lying on a white base against a greenish background. Left arm and leg bent. Upper body resting on a pillow, head turned to the left, away from the viewer. Painted with broad, free brush strokes; scraping into the paint surface was used in modelling the figure.

works.d: Linal ees vasakul klaaskann vedelikuga. Paremal leivapäts taldrikul, kaks klaasi ja ümmarik savikann.
works.de: On the canvas in front, on the left a glass jug with liquid. On the right a loaf of bread on a plate, two glasses and a round clay jug.

works.d: Tumerohelistes ja pruunides toonides läbimaalitud foonil grupp helepruunides keraamilistes pottides erinevat liiki kaktusi ülaltvaates.
works.de: On a background painted in dark green and brown tones, a group of various kinds of cacti in light brown ceramic pots, seen from above.

works.d: Hallide seintega toa nurgas pruun neljakandiline taburet, millel beež rätik, valge, musta servaga emailkauss, viimase taga kõhukas, peenikese kaelaga peaaegu täis veepudel. Pudeli ja kausi kõrval esiplaanil kaks roheliste vartega sibulat (varred ripuvad üle tabureti serva), tagaplaanil suur roheline kapsapea. Tabureti taga paremal valge emailämber.
works.de: In the corner of a room with grey walls, a brown square stool with a beige towel on it, a white enamel bowl with a black rim, behind which stands a bulbous, thin-necked, almost full water bottle. Next to the bottle and bowl in the foreground two onions with green stalks (the stalks hanging over the edge of the stool), in the background a large green cabbage head. Behind the stool on the right a white enamel bucket.

works.d: Pruunis jakis, beežis pluusis daam, sigaretiga käsi suu juurde tõstetud. Daami nägu heledasti valgustatud, lühikeseks lõigatud juuksed, tilluke pruun kübar viltu peas. Rohelised silmad tillukesed ja pilukil, nina vormikas. Daami ees kõrge klaas ja valge tass. Foon kollakaspruun.
works.de: A lady in a brown jacket and beige blouse, her hand with a cigarette raised to her mouth. The lady's face is brightly lit, her hair cut short, a tiny brown hat tilted on her head. Her green eyes are tiny and narrowed, her nose shapely. In front of the lady a tall glass and a white cup. The background is yellowish-brown.

works.d: Punakalt kumava näoga naise portree: seljas ookrikarva kolmnurkse kaelaväljalõikega pluus, väikesed silmad ja suu, juuksed langevad sirgelt seljale. Ülestõstetud parema käe sõrmede vahel hoiab kergelt pea kohal kätele ja õlgadele langevat valget linikut. Vasak käsi toetab õla ümber mähkunud liniku serva. Foon rohekates ja hallides toonides.
works.de: Portrait of a woman with a reddish glowing face: wearing an ochre-coloured blouse with a triangular neckline, small eyes and mouth, hair falling straight down her back. Between the fingers of her raised right hand she holds a white cloth slightly above her head, falling onto her hands and shoulders. Her left hand supports the edge of the cloth wrapped around her shoulder. Background in greenish and grey tones.

works.d: Vaade läbi avatud uste kolme ruumi. Esiplaanil paremal lauanurk virna ajakirjadega. Keskel vaataja poole avatud kahe poolega valge tahveluks, millest avaneb vaade järgmistesse tubadesse. Keskmises toas vasakul, akna all valge linaga kaetud, sirelibuketiga laud, kõrge seljatoega kolm tooli ümber selle. Paremal paistab osa valgest kahhelahjust. Läbi lahtise ukseava paistab järgmisest ruumist kapinurk ja peegel seinal. Vasakul pool paiknevate akende kaudu langeb päikeselaike põrandale. Detailitäpne sile maalilaad.
works.de: View through open doors into three rooms. In the foreground on the right the corner of a table with a stack of magazines. In the middle, opening towards the viewer, a white two-leaf panel door, through which a view opens into the next rooms. In the middle room on the left, under the window, a table covered with a white cloth, with a bouquet of lilac, three high-backed chairs around it. On the right part of a white tiled stove is visible. Through the open doorway a cabinet corner and a mirror on the wall are visible in the next room. Through the windows located on the left side patches of sunlight fall on the floor. Detailed, smooth painting style.

works.d: Samblarohekal, diagonaalsete pintslitõmmetega maalitud foonil kaks kõrvuti asetsevat pruuni lillepotti piklike lehtedega kaktustega. Parempoolsel kaktusel kaardunud varre küljes lopsakas punakas-roosa roosõieline õis. Vorme peene kuiva pintsliga markeeritud.
works.de: Against a moss-green background painted with diagonal brushstrokes, two brown flowerpots side by side with cacti of elongated leaves. On the cactus on the right, on a curved stem, a lush reddish-pink rose-like blossom. Forms marked with a fine dry brush.

works.d: Pildil keskel ning vasakus ääres kolm mahajäetud taluhoonet; keskmise maja ees kaev. Poole pildipinnast võtab enda alla pilvitu taevas. Maapind ja majade katused faktuursed.
works.de: In the middle and on the left edge of the picture, three abandoned farm buildings; in front of the middle house a well. Half of the picture surface is taken up by a cloudless sky. The ground and the roofs of the houses are textured.

works.d: Esiplaanil, keset viljapõldu, suur punane vilja koristav kombain vaataja poole sõitmas. Kombaini katusel punane lipp, juhisillal seisab mees. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest kõrgemal helesinine taevas üle selle ulatuva pilvesäbruga. Kombain vaarikpunane, viljapõld pruunikaskollane, väga pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle of a grain field, a large red combine harvester harvesting grain, driving towards the viewer. A red flag on the roof of the combine, a man standing on the driving platform. Above the horizontal centre line, a light blue sky with a fringe of clouds extending across it. The combine raspberry-red, the grain field brownish-yellow, painted very impasto.

works.d: Pastoossetes, lopsakates, võbisevates vormides rohuaed katkeva puittaraga keskplaanil ning selle taga kõrgete lehtpuudega. Vasemas ülemises nurgas, teineteise peal, kaks abstraktset, ristkülikukujulise tahveldisega toaseina, nendel rippuvate kahe pruunikaspunase, raamitud pildiga. Paremal äärel, rohu seest väljaarenev, kliiverpurje kujuline, valge, vormitute rohekate ja roosakate varjunditega pind ning selle juures väike, kollane, peen mastike ühe vandiga. Faktuurne pintslikäsitlus. Ülal valkjas-helesinine, horisondi kohal hallikas-valge taevas.
works.de: A pasty, lush, quivering vegetable garden with a broken wooden fence in the middle ground, and behind it tall deciduous trees. In the upper left corner, one above the other, two abstract room walls with rectangular panelling, on which hang two brownish-red framed pictures. On the right edge, emerging from the grass, a jib-sail-shaped, white surface with formless greenish and pinkish shades, and beside it a small, yellow, slender mast with one shroud. Textured brushwork. Above, a whitish light-blue sky, greyish-white above the horizon.

works.d: Väga heledal õhulisel foonil hoogsate pintslitõmmetega visandatud abstraktsed punakad, oranžid ja pruunikad kujundid.
works.de: Abstract reddish, orange and brownish shapes sketched with vigorous brushstrokes on a very light, airy background.

works.d: Ees vasakul kärestikuline jõgi, paremal kaldal järsk kaljumassiiv mille taga lehtpuumets.
works.de: In front on the left a rapids river, on the right bank a steep rock massif behind which a deciduous forest.

works.d: Noormehe rinnapilt peapöördega poolprofiilis paremale. Peas parukas, tumedale ülikonnale pööratud pruunikas toonis krae, ees kaks samavärvilist nööpi.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man with his head turned in half-profile to the right. Wearing a wig, a brownish-toned collar turned over a dark suit, with two buttons of the same colour in front.

works.d: Väga pastoosne, tumeroosade, roheliste ja kollaste pintslitõmmetega kujund. Markeerivalt aimatav portree-nägu, mis toetub vasakule käele. Värvikiht kohati ulatub ka raamile.
works.de: A very pastose shape with dark pink, green and yellow brushstrokes. A portrait face is markingly discernible, resting on the left hand. The paint layer at places extends onto the frame as well.

works.d: Tugevatele tugisammastele toetuvate lavade võlvkaartega ruumis kireb seltskond. Ees vasakul keelpillidega ja üks laulja ettekandel; keskel, kaetud laua ümber istuvaid ja seisvaid mehi veini rüüpamas; paremal ees pingil istuv tüse naine juurvilja koorimas, tema kõrval mustas mungarüüs mees. Paremal äärel rida aame püsti, nende ees tütarlaps ja noormes. Kõigil isikuil 17. sajandi rõivastus.
works.de: A lively company in a room with vaulted arches resting on sturdy supporting pillars. In front on the left, a performance with string instruments and a singer; in the middle, men sitting and standing around a set table sipping wine; on the right in front, a stout woman sitting on a bench peeling vegetables, next to her a man in a black monk's robe. Along the right edge a row of barrels standing upright, in front of them a girl and a young man. All persons wear 17th-century clothing.
