works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal paekivi, paremal merd vaatlev selgvaates naisfiguur pikas kleidis. Keskplaanil vasakul kaljurahn, paremal veepind kividega. Veel üksik paat kahe sõitjaga. Keskplaanil keskel üksik puu. Puu taga horisondil mets. Taeva allosas paremal pilvede tagant osalt nähtav kuuketas.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, limestone; on the right, a female figure in full view, in a long dress, looking at the sea. In the middle ground on the left, a rocky boulder, on the right a water surface with stones. Also a single boat with two passengers. In the centre of the middle ground a solitary tree. Behind the tree, forest on the horizon. In the lower part of the sky on the right, the moon disc partly visible behind clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduval teel rändur; paremal kivirahnud, tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: In the foreground on a road leading from left to right a wanderer; on the right boulders, in the background a forest.

works.d: Noore naise, peaaegu enface, laiaäärelises mustas kübaras ja mustas mantlis. Kõrvas kõrvarõngas.
works.de: A young woman, almost en face, in a wide-brimmed black hat and a black coat. An earring in her ear.

works.d: Ees kaljuküngaste vahel poollamavas asendis püssi sihtiv kasakas. Tema taga, vasakul, seisev vana habemik kasakas, püss käes.
works.de: In front, between rocky hills, a Cossack in a half-lying position aiming a rifle. Behind him, on the left, a standing old bearded Cossack, with a rifle in hand.

works.d: Dekoratiivsete, peaaegu geomeetriliselt mõjuvate pindadega maastik: esiplaanil künkale viiv tee, keskplaanis põõsapuhmad küngastega vaheldumisi, ülal hall taevas. Ülemine serv valge. Koloriit hele ja pastelne.
works.de: A landscape with decorative, almost geometrically effective surfaces: in the foreground a road leading up a hill, in the middle ground bushes alternating with hillocks, above a grey sky. The upper edge is white. The colouring is light and pastel.

works.d: Valkjashalli ja kahkjaskollase pinna piiril siluetselt lahendatud pikajuukseline istuv naisakt. Jalad istmiku all, parem käsi toetub jalale, vasak olematule alusele. Pastelsed beežid toonid, selgepiiriliselt jälgitud vormid, valguslaigud kehal.
works.de: Reclining nude woman with long hair, rendered as a silhouette on the boundary of a pale grey and pale yellowish surface. Legs beneath the seat, right hand resting on the leg, left hand on a non-existent support. Pastel beige tones, sharply outlined forms, patches of light on the body.

works.d: Rohekal alusel must kõhukas pudel. Paremal redised. Taga keskel kaks sidrunit.
works.de: A black-bellied bottle on a greenish base. Radishes on the right. Two lemons in the middle behind.

works.d: Ees paremal ja vasakul oleva roigasaia vahelt suundub tee järsu kurviga paremale. Kurvil, roigasaia taga kivihunnik, paremal rohumaa. Veidi tagapool, keskel tuuleveski. Veski taga põllud. Horisondil mets. Sünge, pilves taevas.
works.de: In front, between a picket fence on the right and the left, a road leads with a sharp curve to the right. At the curve, behind the picket fence a pile of stones, on the right grassland. A little further back, in the centre a windmill. Behind the mill fields. Forest on the horizon. Gloomy, cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumelagendik, keskel ja taamal raagus puuderühmi.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy expanse, in the middle and beyond groups of bare trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal sügavalt vetteulatuval neemikul rühm puid ja üksikuid põõsaid. Taamal kõrgenev kallas üksikute põõsastega.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, on a headland extending deep into the water, a group of trees and individual bushes. In the background a rising shore with individual bushes.

works.d: Esiplaanil punaka linaga laual sinakas vaasis mitmesuguses värvis lilli. Taustaks poolavatud aken.
works.de: In the foreground on a table with a reddish cloth, a bluish vase with flowers of various colours. In the background a half-open window.

works.d: Esiplaanil mäenõlvak puudega, taga vaade linnamajadele.
works.de: In the foreground a hillside with trees, behind a view of city houses.

works.d: Esiplaanil metsatukk küüniga, taamal lumeväljade keskel majad, mets.
works.de: In the foreground a copse with a barn, in the distance houses and forest amid snowy fields.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kollendavate ranna-äärsete saartega veelahe, keskel laiub tumedapinnaline järv ranna- ja metsavarjudega veepinnal. Järvekaldalt keskel metsaga kaetud mägi. Taevas pilves. Maalitud soojade hallide pruunide toonidega, laia pintslitõmbega.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a watershed with yellowish coastal islands, in the centre a dark-surfaced lake spreads with shadows of shore and forest on the water's surface. From the lakeshore in the centre a forest-covered mountain. Sky cloudy. Painted in warm grey-brown tones, with a broad brushstroke.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage kollane küngas, mis tõuseb pildipinnas 2/3 kõrgusel oleva silmapiirini. Künka tipul kollakas kasetukk.
works.de: In the foreground a bare yellow hillock rising to the horizon at 2/3 of the picture's height. On the top of the hillock a yellowish clump of birches.

works.d: Esiplaanil valged künkad madalate pruunikate põõsastega. Kõrge horisont, taeval valged pilved.
works.de: In the foreground white hills with low brownish bushes. High horizon, white clouds in the sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kai laevadega, selle ääres domineeriv punakas toon, eriti punane on veoauto. Laht rohekalt sillerdav. Tagapool maju, laevu, kaarsildu.
works.de: In the foreground a quay with ships, along it a dominant reddish tone, especially red is the delivery truck. The bay shimmering greenish. In the background houses, ships, arch bridges.

works.d: Paremal pildipoolel jõgi, järsu pöördega keskkohal, samas suitsev laev, kalda ääres paate, taga sillakaared. Vasakul puiestee ja mitmekorruselised majad. Kauguses linna panoraam. Domineerivad pruunikad toonid, kontrasteeruvad erksad sinised.
works.de: On the right side of the picture, a river with a sharp bend in the middle, at the same spot a smoking ship, boats along the shore, bridge arches behind. On the left, a boulevard and multi-storey houses. A panorama of the city in the distance. Brownish tones dominate, contrasted by bright blues.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, keskplaanilt kõrge silmapiirini laiub metsaga kaetud nõlvak. Maalitud pastoosselt, rohekaspruunikates ja roosakates üksteisesse sulatatud toonides, milles helendavad puutüved.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, from the middle ground up to the high horizon a forest-covered slope extends. Painted pastosely, in greenish-brown and pinkish tones blended into one another, in which the tree trunks glow.

works.d: Hallika taeva all suviselt roheline, põllusiilude ja metsaga kaetud, kupliline maastik. Paremal üksik, vasakul, künka taga kaks talumaja. Maalitud hoogsalt rohekais- ja ookertoonides.
works.de: Under a grey sky a summery green, domed landscape covered with field patches and forest. On the right a single farmhouse, on the left, behind a hill, two farmhouses. Painted vigorously in greenish and ochre tones.

works.d: Sünge, hallipilvise taeva all hoonetega ümbritsetud mäenõlvak. Mäel vasakul, puude vahelt paistab kiriku punakaspruun katus ja tornikiiver, paremal üle mäe viiv loogeline maantee. Koloriit hallikas-, kohati mustjasroheline, üksikud kollakad põllulaigud vahel. Pintslilöök jõuline.
works.de: A gloomy mountain slope surrounded by buildings under a grey-clouded sky. On the mountain on the left, through the trees, the reddish-brown roof and spire of a church are visible; on the right a winding highway leads over the mountain. The colouring is greyish, in places blackish-green, with occasional yellowish field patches. The brushwork is vigorous.

works.d: Valge draperiiga kaetud taburetil, keskteljest vasakul istuv naisakt selgvaates, alakeha pööratud paremale. Pisut ette kummargil, käed toetuvad ette taburetile. Vasak jalg rippu, parem toetub põrandale. Ühtlasel helehallil foonil paremal tumedam modelli vari. Maal valkjashallis, beežis koloriidis.
works.de: On a stool covered with white drapery, a female nude sitting to the left of the central axis, seen from behind, the lower body turned to the right. Slightly bent forward, hands resting on the stool in front. Left leg hanging, right leg resting on the floor. On an even light grey background, the model's darker shadow on the right. The painting is in whitish-grey, beige tones.

works.d: Kolmveerand pildipinnast rohelistes toonides rannaäär, mida lõikavad sinised veeõõned, tagapool mereriba, taevas rohekas.
works.de: Three-quarters of the picture surface is a shoreline in green tones, cut by blue pools of water, behind it a strip of sea, the sky greenish.

works.d: Erksavärviline dekoratiivne kompositsioon mitmesugustest kujunditest, figuuridest. Maali alumisel poolel: valdavalt ultramariinsinisel roheliste, kollaste, punaste täpikeste, oonekeste, tähtede krähmuga kaetud pinnal pealtvaade sinisele härjataolisele olevusele, jäsemed laiali. Tema kohal lendkala peapoole kujutis kaetud roheliste tähtede, sõnajuppidega. Ülaosas paremal kollase joonega markeeritud kaks istuvat inimfiguuri. Vasakus ülemises neljandikus oranž-kollane tiivuline kujund mehepeaga külgvaates.
works.de: Brightly coloured decorative composition of various figures and shapes. On the lower half of the painting: a predominantly ultramarine-blue surface covered with a scattering of green, yellow and red dots, ovals, stars, showing a top view of a blue bull-like creature with limbs spread apart. Above it, a depiction of a flying fish, head-first, covered with green stars and fragments of writing. In the upper right, two seated human figures marked with a yellow line. In the upper left quarter, an orange-yellow winged shape with a man's head, in profile.

works.d: Tühjal lagedal rannal väikesed õlgkatustega kalurimajad, nende vahel kitsas teerada. Vasemal tükike merd, kaldal paadid. Koloriit tume.
works.de: On an empty open shore small thatched-roof fishermen's houses, with a narrow path between them. On the left a piece of sea, boats on the shore. Dark colouring.

works.d: Pruunikates ja hallikates toonides maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul suur puu, eemal hooned.
works.de: Landscape in brownish and greyish tones. In the foreground on the left a large tree, buildings in the distance.

works.d: Panoraamne talvemaastik. Esiplaanil vasakul all puude vahel kolmest hoonest koosnev talumajapidamine; lääbakil tara taga üks naine pumbakaevust vett võtmas, teine kahe ämbriga käes lauta suundumas, allservas paremal väike saun. Kõrgemal küngaste vahel madalad metsatukad ja võsad ning üksikuist puudest ümbritsetud lummemattunud talumajad. Ülal hall, sume talvine taevas. Domineerivad hallid ja pruunid toonid.
works.de: A panoramic winter landscape. In the foreground on the lower left, among trees, a farmstead consisting of three buildings; behind a low fence one woman drawing water from a pump-well, another heading to the barn with two buckets in hand, at the bottom right a small sauna. Higher up, among the hills, low patches of forest and scrub, and farmhouses buried in snow surrounded by solitary trees. Above, a grey, hazy winter sky. Grey and brown tones dominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal külavahetee kivide ja kadakatega kahel pool. Vasakul ja paremal suurte puude keskel tumedad madalad talumajad. Madala silmapiiri kohal suurte valgete pilvedega tumesinine taevas. Pruunikasroheline üldkoloriit, maalitud lopsakalt, kohati spaatliga.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a village road with stones and junipers on both sides. On the left and right, among large trees, dark low farmhouses. Above the low horizon a dark blue sky with large white clouds. General colouring brownish-green, painted lushly, in places with a palette knife.

works.d: Vaade rõduga siseõuele. Paremal rõdu all 2 kattega kaarikut.
works.de: View of an inner courtyard with a balcony. On the right, under the balcony, 2 covered carts.

works.d: Vaade siseõuelt hoone sisemusse.
works.de: View from the inner courtyard into the interior of the building.

works.d: Dekoratsioonikavand "Juudit" II vaatus. Esiplaanil punase draperii all paremal naise, vasakul mehe figuur.
works.de: Stage design sketch "Juudit" Act II. In the foreground under a red drapery, a woman's figure on the right, a man's figure on the left.

works.d: Dekoratsioonikavand "Juudit" IV vaatus. Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul sambad, keskel 4 figuuri. Taamal vaade maastikule.
works.de: Set design sketch for "Juudit", Act IV. In the foreground columns on the right and left, 4 figures in the centre. A view of a landscape in the distance.

works.d: Vaade heledalt valgustatud õuest tumedasse võlvialusesse. Võlvialusel astmestikul inimfiguure.
works.de: View from a brightly lit courtyard into a dark vaulted passage. Human figures on the steps under the vault.

works.d: Vooremaastik kahe järvega keskel, voorte harjadel metsatukad. Taevas sinirohelistes ja roosades toonides.
works.de: A hilly ridge landscape ("voor") with two lakes in the middle, clumps of forest on the ridges. Sky in blue-green and pink tones.

works.dm: lehe laius: 40.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm
works.d: Maastik teivasaiaga ja kuuskedega. Eest vasakult veidi tahapoole paremale suunduv teivasaed. Selle taga vasakul grupp suuri kuuski. Paremal üks suurem ja grupp väiksemaid puid. Tagapool keskel järve kaldal väike heinaküün. Taga vasakul metsatukk.
works.de: A landscape with a stake fence and spruces. In front, a stake fence running from the left slightly backward to the right. Behind it on the left a group of large spruces. On the right one larger tree and a group of smaller trees. In the background in the middle a small hay barn on the shore of a lake. In the background on the left a patch of forest.

works.t: Casa del Greco. Toledo. Tuba Greco majas
works.d: Tuba Greco majas Toledos: paremal ja vasemal asemed, keskel laud, tagaseinas 2 akent.
works.de: A room in Greco's house in Toledo: beds on the right and left, a table in the middle, two windows in the back wall.

works.d: Linnavaade. Esiplaanil müüride vahel sügavusse suunduv tänav. Taamal läbi väravakaare paistev uks.
works.de: City view. In the foreground a street running into the depth between walls. In the distance a door visible through an archway gate.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha kulgev tee, paremal karjavärav ja teelahk, mis suundub vasemale. Tee palistatud kõrgeist lehtpuist. Vasemal taga meri.
works.de: In the foreground a road running from front to back, on the right a cattle gate and a fork in the road leading to the left. The road is lined with tall deciduous trees. In the background on the left, the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand. Taamal lahesopi taga kaldal ehitusel olev kaljas, selle lähedal üksik mänd. Paremal madal hoone.
works.de: Rocky shore in the foreground. In the distance, beyond an inlet, a schooner under construction on the shore, a solitary pine near it. A low building on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil künkal suurte kivide vahel katkine paat. Paremal grupp jändrikke, üksteise ümber põimunud mände. Taga meri.
works.de: In the foreground on a hillock among large stones a broken boat. On the right a group of gnarled pines intertwined with one another. Behind, the sea.

works.d: Eest keskelt taha vasakule kulgev tee äärestatud suurtest lehtpuudest. Paremal tee ääres kiviaed. Taga keskel karjavärav ja lehtpuid.
works.de: A road running from the centre foreground to the back left, lined with large deciduous trees. On the right along the road a stone fence. Behind in the centre a pasture gate and deciduous trees.

works.d: Paremal rõduga aida ees teel töövankur. Vasakpoolsel tee äärsel muruplatsil 3 suurt lehtpuud. Nende taga taluhoone. Taga risti üle tee karjavärav.
works.de: On the right a work-cart on the road in front of a barn with a balcony. On the left side of the road, on a lawn, 3 large deciduous trees. Behind them a farm building. Further back a cattle gate across the road.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine mererand. Paremal kaks üksikut mändi, keskel lootsikuid ja võrgumaju. Taamal kõrgel kaldal männimets, vasakul avameri.
works.de: In the foreground a rocky sea shore. On the right two solitary pines, in the middle boats and net-sheds. Beyond, on a high bank, a pine forest, on the left the open sea.

works.d: Keskel ristilöödud Kristus, vasakul pikas rõivastuses mehe ja naise figuurid.
works.de: In the centre the crucified Christ, on the left figures of a man and a woman in long garments.

works.d: Töö kujundatud poolringil. Esiplaanil keskel suure õunapuu all seismas mees ja rahvarõivais viljavihuga parema kaenla all naine. Nende ees poisikene õunu korjamas. Paremal kündja, vasakul 2 meest kändu kangutamas. Tagapool paremal heinavedu, vasakul kari. Taamal kollendavad põllud.
works.de: The work is composed in a semicircle. In the foreground in the middle, under a large apple tree, a man standing and a woman in folk costume with a sheaf of grain under her right arm. In front of them a boy picking apples. On the right a ploughman, on the left 2 men prying out a stump. Further back on the right hay hauling, on the left a herd. Beyond, yellowing fields.

works.d: Töötoas vasakul akende all pika laua ääres nais- ja meestöölised vaatamas savinõusid põrandal. Taga (paremal) laeni ülatuv riiul savinõudega. Selle kõrval avatud uks kõrvalruumi.
works.de: In the workshop, on the left under the windows, along a long table, male and female workers looking at pottery on the floor. Behind (on the right) a shelf reaching to the ceiling with pottery. Next to it an open door to an adjoining room.

works.d: Võlvitud laega ruumi sisemus, rikkaliku laemaaliga, paremal seinal maal ja keskel sammas.
works.de: The interior of a vaulted room, with a rich ceiling painting, on the right wall a painting and in the middle a column.

works.d: Mägimaastik suurte kaljurahnudega.
works.de: Mountain landscape with large boulders.

works.d: Esialal vasemal tahapoole suunduv looklev tee, paremal üksik kask. Keskel nõos väike järv, tagapool kurrulisel maastikul hilissuvises värvuses põldusid ja metsatukki.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a winding road leading backwards, on the right a solitary birch. In the centre, in a hollow, a small lake, behind it in a undulating landscape fields and small groves in late-summer colouring.

works.d: Kloostri õue sisekäik hoonetega vasakul ja paremal. Vasaku hoone taga näha neli kiriku kuplit.
works.de: Interior passage of a monastery courtyard with buildings on the left and right. Behind the left building four church domes are visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil valg hoone suvepäikese valguses. Vasakul kaarja ukse kohal ikoon, paremal kaks kellatorni ja trepiga sissekäik. Hoonel väike sinise kupliga torn.
works.de: In the foreground a white building in summer sunlight. On the left above an arched door an icon, on the right two bell towers and an entrance with stairs. The building has a small tower with a blue dome.

works.d: Esiplaanil kitsas tänavalaik, mis läbi võlvialuse suundudes teeb käänaku vasemale. Vanade majade keskelt tõuseb torn, mille tipu lõikab maali ülaserv. Katused kaetud lumega. Rohekas üldgamma.
works.de: In the foreground a narrow strip of street which, passing through an archway, turns to the left. Among the old houses a tower rises, its tip cut off by the upper edge of the painting. Roofs covered with snow. Overall greenish gamut.

works.d: Kitsa teeraja ääres tugevatüveliste puude grupp.
works.de: A group of thick-trunked trees beside a narrow path.

works.d: Järve rand üksikute hoonete ja suurte kividega. Eemal vasakul saar.
works.de: Lake shore with individual buildings and large stones. In the distance on the left an island.

works.d: Vaade  üle esiplaanil asuvate vanalinna majade pruunjaspurpursete katuste Niguliste kirikule kagust. Pikihoone astmeline katus vaskplekiga, Antoniuse kabel punaste katusekividega. Paremal äärel raekoja torn.
works.de: View over the brownish-purple roofs of the old town houses in the foreground toward St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) from the southeast. The stepped roof of the nave is covered with tin sheeting, the Anthony Chapel has red roof tiles. On the right edge, the tower of the Town Hall.

works.d: Esiplaanil pildi sügavusse pöörduv jõekäär, millest paremal väike saareke või maanukk põõsaste ja kahe lehtpuuga. Jõe vasak, liivane kallas tõuseb mäkke, mis kaetud mändidega. Esiplaanil vasakul, pea otse veepiirilt välja kasvav lepp, mille peegeldus paistab vees. Taamal keskel, mändide vahel valge viilkatusega maja. Ülal sinine, pisut pilvine taevas. Maalitud väikeste, lopsakate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground a river bend turning into the depth of the picture, to the right of which a small island or spit of land with bushes and two deciduous trees. The left, sandy bank of the river rises into a hill covered with pines. In the foreground on the left, an alder growing almost right out of the waterline, its reflection visible in the water. Further back in the centre, among the pines, a house with a white gable roof. Above, a blue, slightly cloudy sky. Painted with small, lush brushstrokes.

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal asuvate pooleliolevate puuehituste vahel saevad, kopsivad, raiuvad mehed laudu. Vasakul ja paremal kaks meest tellingutel. Tagaplaanil traktor, mis sõidutab lauakoormat ning ülestõstetud puuhaamriga mees traktori taga lauahunnikul. Lauavirnade taga, maja sarikatel lehvib kaks punast lippu. Ülal helesinine, valgete pilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: Between the unfinished wooden buildings on the left and right, men are sawing, knocking and chopping boards. Two men on scaffolding on the left and right. In the background a tractor hauling a load of boards, and a man with a raised wooden hammer behind the tractor on a pile of boards. Behind the stacks of boards, on the rafters of the house, two red flags are flying. Above, a light blue sky covered with white clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kujutise laiuselt raagus puid, vasakul üks puu teistest jämedam, ülal hargneb kaheks. Puude taga Niguliste kiriku pikihoone osaliselt ja torn, mille ülaosa kujutise servaga ära lõigatud. Taevas helesinine.
works.de: In the foreground, across the width of the image, bare trees, on the left one tree thicker than the others, branching into two above. Behind the trees the nave of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) partially visible and the tower, whose upper part is cut off by the edge of the image. Sky pale blue.

works.d: Suvine vaade taluhoovi. Keskel vasakul kohati ammaldunud õlgkatusega ristpalkidest ait. Aida uks on avatud. Paremal tagapool paiknev elumaja on heledas pruunikas koloriidis. Taamal väravad ning aed. Ees paremas servas kõrge vinnaga kaev. Taustaks pilvine suvetaevas. Ees all keskel tolmune tee. Paremal ja vasakul näha maakividest aeda.
works.de: Summer view of a farmyard. In the middle left a cross-log barn with a partly bare thatched roof. The barn door is open. The dwelling house situated further right in the background is in a light brownish colour scheme. In the distance gates and a garden. In the right foreground a tall well sweep. The background is a cloudy summer sky. In the foreground centre a dusty road. On the right and left a fieldstone fence can be seen.

works.d: Kõrgete müüride vaheline kitsas tänav suundub kaugusse, eredast päikesest valgustatud parem pool, vasakul lillakad varjud. Maali keskosas üle müüri upitavad kaharad puukroonid, nende vahel hele hoone kolme kaarja aknaorvaga paremal. Türkiissinine, kerges pilvevines kirgas taevas.
works.de: A narrow street between high walls recedes into the distance, the right side lit by bright sunlight, purplish shadows on the left. In the middle of the painting, bushy treetops rise above the wall, and between them a light-coloured building with three arched window niches on the right. The turquoise-blue sky is bright, with a slight haze of clouds.

works.dm: lehe laius: 49.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 62.5 cm
works.d: Avatud pildiraamatu ees kükitav poisike. Parem käsi asetatud pallile.
works.de: A boy crouching in front of an open picture book. Right hand placed on a ball.

works.d: Inglikese poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale küllusesarvest rahasid puistamas.
works.de: A half-figure of a little angel in profile to the left, scattering coins from a cornucopia.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 43.3 cm; kujutise laius: 49.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 34.4 cm; lehe laius: 56.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjais veekogu, tagapool paremal paadis õngitseja. Taamal näha kaldariba.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with reeds, behind it on the right an angler in a boat. In the distance a strip of shore is visible.

works.d: Üks püsti ja teine kummargil naine mere ääres jalgupidi vees pesu loputamas. Lillas, oranžis ja rohekas toonis.
works.de: One woman standing and another bent over, rinsing laundry by the sea with their feet in the water. In purple, orange and greenish tones.

works.d: Eest taha suunduv kõrgete kivimajade vaheline talvine tänav. Taga kuppelkatustega kiriku tornid. Tänaval inimfiguure.
works.de: A winter street between tall stone houses, receding from front to back. In the background towers of a church with dome roofs. Human figures on the street.

works.dm: kõrgus: 25.3 cm (vm; laius: 37.8 cm (lm); kõrgus: 27.2 cm (lm)
works.d: Vaade ülalt alla: ees metsa keskel paar üksikut hoonet. Keskel järv metsarohke vastaskaldaga. Taamal veekogu (järv). Silmapiiril maajoon.
works.de: View from above: in front, a couple of isolated buildings in the middle of a forest. In the middle a lake with a forested opposite shore. In the distance a body of water (lake). A land line on the horizon.

works.d: Vasakpoolne tiib: Osa veduridepoost, mida valgustab kõrge aken tagaseinas. Keskel vedurirataste ümber töötavaid meesfiguure.
works.de: Left wing: Part of a locomotive depot, lit by a tall window in the back wall. In the middle, male figures working around locomotive wheels.

works.d: Valge lume taustal reas suured tõukekelgud. Kelkude juures tumedates talirõivastes inimesed. Paremal erepunane lõke, mille kohale on kummardunud üks figuur. Ülaosas regi ja neli äralõigatud figuuri.
works.de: Against a white snow background, large push sledges in a row. People in dark winter clothing beside the sledges. On the right, a bright red bonfire over which one figure is bent. In the upper part, a sledge and four cropped figures.

works.d: Raamatutega kaetud pika laua taga istub esiplaanil noor, keskelt lahkukammitud, kergelt lokkis juustega naine kirju riidega kaetud punakaspruunil toolil. Paremas käes hoiab musta sulepead, millega toetub valgele paberile, vasak käsi hoiab tooli seljatoest. Keha pööratud pisut paremale, parem jalg tõstetud üle vasaku põlve. Seljas tume seelik ja pisut kõrgema kaelusega pluus. Laua taga vasakul, otsevaates punase mütsiga ja tumedas riides mees, küünarnukkidega lauale toetumas. Foon tumepunane.
works.de: Behind a long table covered with books, in the foreground sits a young woman with slightly curly hair parted in the middle, on a reddish-brown chair covered with patterned fabric. In her right hand she holds a black pen holder, with which she rests on white paper, her left hand holds the back of the chair. Her body is turned slightly to the right, right leg raised over the left knee. She is wearing a dark skirt and a blouse with a slightly higher collar. Behind the table on the left, in frontal view, a man with a red cap and in dark clothing, leaning on the table with his elbows. Background dark red.

works.d: Kergelt paremale pöördunud istuv vana naine, juuksed keskelt lahku kammitud ja kuklasse seotud, nägu kortsuline, käed puhkavad kokkupandult süles heledal põllel. Seljas tumesinine kraeta kleit või pluus. Foon punakaspruun.
works.de: A seated old woman turned slightly to the right, hair parted in the middle and tied at the back of the neck, wrinkled face, hands resting folded in her lap on a light apron. Wearing a dark blue collarless dress or blouse. Background reddish-brown.

works.d: Halli riidega kaetud laual keskplaanis pruun, viltu asetatud kauss, valge riie peale visatud. Sellest vasakul tume nõu. All, sinaka draperiiga kaetud pingil valge, kõrge, ülalt ahenev kann ja kibu. Töö hallikassinises üldtoonis, maalitud kohati pikkade nähtavate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a table covered with grey cloth, in the middle plane a brown, obliquely placed bowl with a white cloth thrown over it. To its left a dark vessel. Below, on a bench covered with a bluish drapery, a white, tall jug narrowing towards the top and a pitcher. The work is in an overall greyish-blue tone, painted in places with long visible brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil rühib vasakult paremale grupp tumedates riietes ja mütsides mehi, kellest mõnedel seljas kott. Vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut vasakul pruuni hobuse seljas mees, kes näo ja kehaga on vaataja poole pöördunud. Meeste näod antud individualiseerimata, laikudena. Tagaplaanil tuulest tugevasti painutatud puud, nende kohal tume, hallikassinine taevas üksiku valge pilvega vasakul. Koloriit tume, õhuke värvikiht laseb kohati lõuendil paista.
works.de: In the foreground, a group of men in dark clothes and caps, some carrying bags, push forward from left to right. Slightly left of the vertical centre line, a man on a brown horse, turned toward the viewer with his face and body. The men's faces are rendered without individualization, as patches. In the background, trees strongly bent by the wind, above them a dark, greyish-blue sky with a single white cloud on the left. The colouring is dark, with the thin paint layer letting the canvas show through in places.

works.d: Esiplaanil kuni horisontaalse keskjooneni rohelised ja hallid põllulapid. Rõhtteljel kiviaed, mille taga jätkuvad põllud. Silmapiiril vasakul punase katuse ja kõrge torniga kirik puude keskel, paremal mõned kuused ja üksik mänd. Taevas ülal sinine, üksikute pilvekiududega. Peamiselt rohelistes ja hallides toonides, iga värvipind tumeda joonega ümbritsetud.
works.de: In the foreground, up to the horizontal midline, green and grey patches of farmland. On the horizontal axis a stone wall, behind which the fields continue. On the horizon, on the left a church with a red roof and a tall tower among the trees, on the right a few spruces and a solitary pine. The sky above is blue, with a few wisps of cloud. Mainly in green and grey tones, each colour area outlined with a dark line.

works.d: 4/5 maali ülemisest osast kujutab tihedat põõsaste-puudega metsa, vasakul puukroonide vahel paistmas tükike taevast. Esiplaanil, metsaservas ridamisi istumas-lebamas 9 inimest: paremal istuv ja lamav naisfiguur, keskel kaabuga lõõtspillimängija, vasakul neli meest ja naine. Maal rohekaspruunides toonides, erineva faktuuriga, kohati pastoosne, sissekraapeid värvipinnas.
works.de: 4/5 of the upper part of the painting depicts a dense forest of bushes and trees, on the left a patch of sky visible between the treetops. In the foreground, at the edge of the forest, 9 people sitting-lying in a row: on the right a sitting and a lying female figure, in the center an accordion player wearing a hat, on the left four men and a woman. The painting is in greenish-brown tones, of varying texture, in places pastose, with scratched-in paint surface.

works.d: Hõbehallides ja tuhmides rohelistes toonides künklik maastik. Keskel väike, metsatukaga kaetud mägi, mille ümber madalate põõsatuttidega kaetud maastik. Esiplaanil suundub tee alt vasakust nurgast paremale pildi sügavusse. Paremal servas üksik kuusk. Silmapiiri kohal hallikas, tihedalt valgete pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud väikeste, kuid pastoossete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: A hilly landscape in silvery-gray and dull green tones. In the center, a small hill covered with a patch of forest, surrounded by a landscape covered with low bush clusters. In the foreground, a path leads from the lower left corner into the depth of the picture on the right. On the right edge, a solitary spruce. Above the horizon, a grayish sky densely covered with white clouds. Painted with small but pastose brushstrokes.

works.d: Tumehalli draperiiga kaetud diivanil hele lina ja roosa padi, millele toetub poollamavas asendis noor naine, ülakeha vaataja suunas. Naisel lühikesed, sirged juuksed, üks käsi puhkab padjal, teine rinnal. Naisel seljas lühikeste käistega suurte valgete nööpidega sinine kleit, avatud kaelusest paistab helekollane särk. Jalgade juures roosa vihmavari.
works.de: On a sofa covered with a dark grey drape, a light-coloured sheet and a pink pillow, against which a young woman reclines in a half-lying position, upper body toward the viewer. The woman has short, straight hair, one hand resting on the pillow, the other on her chest. She is wearing a blue dress with short sleeves and large white buttons, a light yellow shirt showing through the open collar. A pink umbrella lies at her feet.

works.d: Kolm stseeni Saaremaa külaelust. Keskmisel osal on kujutatud kiviaiaga ääristatud külavaheteed teelistega vaataja suunas astumas. Taamal taluhooned puude taustal. Vasakpoolsel kiigeplats kiikujate ja uudistajatega esiplaanil. Parempoolsel kujutatud külatänav kahe üle aia vestlejaga. Tagapool talud puude vahel.
works.de: Three scenes of village life in Saaremaa. In the middle part a village lane bordered by a stone fence is depicted, with travellers walking toward the viewer. Further away farm buildings against a background of trees. On the left side a swing ground with swingers and onlookers in the foreground. On the right side a village street with two people conversing over a fence. Behind them farms among trees.

works.d: Lokkis juustega põskhabemega mehe portree peaaegu en face (rinnapilt). Seljas tume kuub. Plastron kaelasidemega.
works.de: Portrait of a man with curly hair and sideburns, almost en face (bust). Wearing a dark coat. Plastron with a necktie.

works.t: Vabahärra Johann Christoph von Campenhauseni portree
works.d: Mehe rinnapilt peaga en face. Peas hall parukas. Sinise kuue vasakpoolne hõlm ulatub üle rinnal asuva punase paela. Vasakul rinnal aumärk.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man, head en face. Grey wig on the head. The left flap of the blue coat extends over a red ribbon on the chest. A medal on the left breast.

works.d: Pruunil laual hele kann paljude mitmevärviliste astrite ja leekivpunaste gladioolidega. Kannu kõrval kaks õuna ja astriõit. Foon hallikas-sinine.
works.de: A light-coloured jug on a brown table with many multicoloured asters and flaming red gladioli. Beside the jug two apples and an aster blossom. The background greyish-blue.

works.d: Sinakaslillades tumedates toonides maalitud kahe tuulikuga suvemaastik. Maakividest aed ja tee koonduvad silmapiirile maalitud taluhoonete ning siluetina antud metsaviiru suunas. Erksinises taevas pilvedesse on maalitud loojangukuma ning maastiku hõõguvates toonides pindu.
works.de: A summer landscape with two windmills, painted in bluish-purple dark tones. A stone-walled garden and a road converge towards the horizon, painted towards farm buildings and a strip of forest given as a silhouette. In the bright blue sky, sunset glow is painted into the clouds, and glowing tones are painted onto surfaces of the landscape.

works.d: Paremal puude-põõsaste puhmastik, üks puu ülaservani ulatuv. Mõned põõsad õitsevad. Puude vahelt paistab punane katus. Vasakul majanurk, ülaservaga lõigatud; ümber nurga jookseb heledavärviline tee. Tume taevas, allosas helenev. Värv kantud pinnale kohati laiade korrapäraste lüketega.
works.de: On the right a thicket of trees and bushes, one tree reaching to the upper edge. Some bushes in bloom. Through the trees a red roof is visible. On the left the corner of a house, cut off at the upper edge; a light-coloured road runs around the corner. Dark sky, glowing at the bottom. Paint applied to the surface in places with broad regular strokes.

works.d: Üle pildipinna grupp sügisesi kolletavaid kaski, ülaservaga ladvad ära lõigatud. Maapind ees kolletav, läbi puude paistab sinetav taevas.
works.de: Across the picture plane a group of autumnal yellowing birches, their crowns cut off at the upper edge. The ground in front is yellowing, and a bluish sky is visible through the trees.

works.d: Hõredas täppivas laadis maalitud sügismaastik. Esiplaanil erkpunastes ja -kollastes toonides, juba hõrenenud lehestikuga puud. Vertikaalsest keskjoonest vasakul voolab käänuline jõeke pildi sügavusse, millest kahel pool jõeorg. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest ülalpool paistab läbi puuvõrade helesinine taevas.
works.de: An autumn landscape painted in a sparse, dotted manner. In the foreground, trees in bright red and yellow tones, foliage already thinned. To the left of the vertical centre line a winding river flows into the depth of the picture, with a river valley on both sides of it. Above the horizontal centre line, a light blue sky is visible through the treetops.

works.d: Valge, pika täishabemega ning vuntsidega vana mehe portree. Pea kummardatud ette alla, silmalaud kuldraamidega prillide taga langetatud. Valgus langeb vasakult.
works.de: Portrait of an old man with a white, long full beard and moustache. His head is bowed forward and down, his eyelids lowered behind gold-framed spectacles. The light falls from the left.

works.d: Ookerkollasel foonil punases pluusis ja kübaras keskealise naise põlvportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Vasaku käega hoiab süles rohelist rätti, parem käsi põlvel. Maalitud ühtlaste, laiemate pinstlilöökidega.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged woman in a red blouse and hat against an ochre-yellow background, in a quarter-turn to the left. With her left hand she holds a green scarf on her lap, her right hand rests on her knee. Painted with even, broader brush strokes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 31.4 cm (km); laius: 35.0 cm (lm); kõrgus: 40.0 cm (lm); laius: 23.0 cm (km)
works.d: Hallipäise, keskelt lahku kammitud juustega vana naise portree. Pea kummardatud ette alla; laud langetatud. Näo veidi kandiline joon rõhutatud valge kraega. Koloriit tume.
works.de: Portrait of an old woman with grey hair parted in the middle. Head bowed forward and down; gaze lowered. The slightly angular line of the face is emphasized by a white collar. Dark colouring.

works.d: Samblarohelistes toonides täppivalt maalitud kaldapealne, vasakul käharad puudepuhmad, paremal pruunikas nõlvak. Esiplaanil vesi peegelduva kaldarohelusega.
works.de: A moss-green-toned, dabbed painting of a waterside, on the left curly clumps of trees, on the right a brownish slope. In the foreground water with reflecting green of the bank.

works.d: Keskosas, õunapuu all, istub pikas rohelises rüüs naine, põlvedel valge lina, sellel istuv laps. Nende ees maas punane õun. Kahel pool ema-last nende poole kummarduvaid, vaatavaid figuure, vasakul kuus, paremal kaheksa inimest. Tagaplaanil kirev maastikuline foon. Maalitud intensiivsetes rohelistes, punastes, pruunides toonides.
works.de: In the central part, under an apple tree, sits a woman in a long green robe, a white cloth on her knees, a child sitting on it. In front of them on the ground a red apple. On both sides of the mother and child, figures bending toward them and looking, on the left six, on the right eight people. In the background a colourful landscape backdrop. Painted in intense green, red and brown tones.

works.d: Sinakasrohelises toonis maastiku taustal kuuest alasti seisvast naisest grupp valgete linadega. Kahel vasakpoolsel lina tõstetud peade kõrgusele, ulatub maani. Paremal, naiste jalgade juures pikajalgne pruun koer. Paremal ülemises nurgas diagonaalselt puu tüvi. Figuurid maalitud beežides-pruunides toonides kohati kontuure rõhutades.
works.de: Against a landscape background in bluish-green tones, a group of six naked standing women with white sheets. On the two left ones the sheet is raised to the height of the head, reaching to the ground. On the right, near the women's feet, a long-legged brown dog. In the upper right corner a tree trunk diagonally. The figures are painted in beige-brown tones, in places emphasising the contours.

works.d: Vasakul roosakas-punakais ning paremal oleva valkjais-rohekas koloriidis stiliseeritud puu vahelt avaneb vaade künklikule, erksates värvides maastikule.
works.de: Between a stylised tree, pinkish-red on the left and whitish-greenish on the right in colouring, a view opens onto a hilly landscape in bright colours.

works.d: Lillakas toonis taeva all paremal kõrge kallas tumerohelise metsatukaga, selle ees punase katusega maja. Vasakul lillakasroosal veel viis purjekat. Maalitud hoogsalt, diagonaalsete pintslilöökidega kohati tugeva faktuuriga.
works.de: Under a purplish-toned sky, on the right a tall shore with a dark-green clump of forest, in front of it a house with a red roof. On the left, on purplish-pink [water], five more sailboats. Painted spiritedly, with diagonal brushstrokes, in places with strong texture.

works.d: Erksavärvilise maastiku foonil noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates, pea veidi pööratud paremale, tumedad juuksed seatud tumepunase paelaga. Seljas pidulik mürkroheline õlapaelteta kleit. Parem kõverdatud käsi hoiab õhukest salli ümber õlgade. Maalitud siledalt, diagonaalsete pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: Against the background of a brightly coloured landscape, a bust portrait of a young woman in a direct view, her head turned slightly to the right, dark hair arranged with a dark red ribbon. She wears a festive poison-green strapless dress. Her bent right arm holds a thin shawl around her shoulders. Painted smoothly, with diagonal brushstrokes.

works.d: Laia äärega lillas kübaras, punase dekolteeritud kleidis noore naise rinnaportree. Keha poolpöördes vasakule, pea täisprofiilis, parema käega hoiab kübara servast. Taustaks rohekaslilla taeva all tumedas toonis maastik.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in a wide-brimmed lilac hat, in a red low-cut dress. Body in half-turn to the left, head in full profile, holding the brim of the hat with her right hand. Background a dark-toned landscape under a greenish-lilac sky.

works.d: Värvilistest püramiididest ja teistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest mägedemotiiv. Maalitud kujundite selgeid vorme rõhutades.
works.de: A mountain motif made of colourful pyramids and other geometric shapes. Painted emphasising the clear forms of the shapes.

works.d: Rohekal maastikulisel taustal, tumedates toonides, peaaegu siluetselt lahendatud noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates, pea veidi pööratud paremale. Lahkukammitud pikad juuksed seljal, käed seongus kõhul. Seljas, hõlmad lahti, rohekaspunakas mantel. Maalitud siledalt, pinnaliselt.
works.de: Against a greenish landscape background, in dark tones, a half-figure of a young woman rendered almost as a silhouette, in a frontal view, head turned slightly to the right. Long, combed-back hair on her back, hands clasped over her stomach. She wears an open greenish-red coat. Painted smoothly, flatly.

works.d: Rohekashallis koloriidis maalitud kõrgete majadega kaldapealne. Esiplaanil vees, kaarsilla ees punane suitseva korstnaga laev. Maalitud lühikeste tihedate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Riverside with tall houses painted in a greenish-grey colour scheme. In the foreground in the water, in front of an arched bridge, a red ship with a smoking chimney. Painted with short dense brushstrokes.

works.d: a)Hämarusest kerkib Notre-Dame´i siluett. Ees sillakaaristu nelja, tuhmilt helendava laternaga.
works.de: a) The silhouette of Notre-Dame rises from the dusk. In front, a row of bridge arches with four dimly glowing lanterns.

works.d: Eesääres noored okaspuud ja säravsinine veesilm. Taamal künklik maastik valgete, punakate katustega majade gruppidega. Koloriit hele.
works.de: In the front, young conifers and a sparkling blue patch of water. In the distance a hilly landscape with groups of houses with white, reddish roofs. Light colouring.

works.d: Otsevaade kupliga ja kolme väikese torniga hoonele. Maja ees rikkalikult treppe. Maalitud sumedates rohekashallides toonides pastoosselt.
works.de: Frontal view of a domed building with three small towers. In front of the house, numerous flights of steps. Painted pastosely in soft greenish-grey tones.

works.d: Rohekashallides summutatud toonides maalitud vaade allpool hämaruses asetsevatele väikestele majadele puude vahel.
works.de: View, painted in muted greenish-grey tones, of small houses lying below in the dusk among trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline veidi künklik maapind; selle taga samavärvilised madalad majad. Taamal Tallinna vanalinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground green, slightly hilly ground; behind it low houses of the same colour. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn's Old Town.

works.d: Suure, pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud puu all kumera katusega kiosk. Selle ees kõnniteel 3 jalakäijat, kaks meest ning üks naine. Esiplaanil roheline tänavalatern. Maalitud summutatud koloriidis.
works.de: Under a large tree cut off by the upper edge of the picture, a kiosk with a curved roof. In front of it on the pavement 3 pedestrians, two men and one woman. In the foreground a green street lamp. Painted in a muted colour scheme.

works.d: Autori nimi, töö nimetus ja mõõdud Asukoht objektil: pöördel keskel pliiatsiga autorikäaekirjas
works.de: Author's name, title of the work and dimensions. Location on the object: on the verso, in the centre, in pencil, in the author's handwriting

works.d: Talvine, sombuse ilmaga linnavaade: esiplaanil paremal kolm raagus puud. Taamal paistavad majade tagant tornikiivrita Niguliste ja temast vasakule jääv Oleviste kirik.
works.de: Winter city view in gloomy weather: in the foreground on the right three bare trees. In the distance, behind the houses, St. Nicholas' Church without its spire and, to its left, St. Olaf's Church can be seen.

works.d: Rohelistes ja hallides toonides vihmane sügispäev: esiplaanil raudtee tõkkepuu, piirete ja telefonipostidega. Keskplaani paremal kaks puumaja, taamal udus Toompea siluett.
works.de: In green and grey tones a rainy autumn day: in the foreground a railway barrier with fences and telephone poles. In the middle ground at right two wooden houses, in the distance the silhouette of Toompea in the mist.

works.d: Vaade talvisele puumajade ja telefonipostidega ääristatud tänavale. Tänaval kaks hobust regedega, inimesi. Paremal, tänavanurgal kahekorruseline ereroheline maja, selle ees lumel kollakas päikeselaik. Roosaka taeva foonil vasakul suure puu oks. Maalitud lühikeste tihkete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: View of a winter street lined with wooden houses and telephone poles. On the street two horses with sledges, people. On the right, on the street corner, a bright green two-storey house, in front of it a yellowish patch of sunlight on the snow. Against a pinkish sky background on the left, a branch of a large tree. Painted with short dense brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunide seinte ja lumiste katustega väikesed majad. Keskplaanis raagus, akvarellilike pintslilöökidega antud puud. Taamal, puude taga pastelseis toonides vanalinn kahe kirikutorniga. Ülal valkjassinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground small houses with brown walls and snowy roofs. In the middle ground bare trees, rendered with watercolour-like brushstrokes. Beyond, behind the trees, the old town in pastel tones with two church towers. Above, a whitish-blue sky.

works.d: Paremal vesi, vasakul paadisild. Tagapool hooned ja puud.
works.de: On the right water, on the left a boat pier. Behind, buildings and trees.

works.d: Diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule kulgev tänav. Keskel heledasti valgustatud akendega maja, millest nelinurkne valguslaik langeb tänavale. Tänava kahelpool ääres mustad raagus puud. Esiplaanil vasakul inimsiluetid.
works.de: A street running diagonally from right to left. In the centre a house with brightly lit windows, from which a rectangular patch of light falls onto the street. Black bare trees line both sides of the street. In the foreground on the left, human silhouettes.

works.d: Majadegrupp, millede vahel puitmaterjali kuhjad. Vasakpoolse kuuri otsauksest paistab saekaater. Esiplaanil töötavaid mehefiguure. Maalitud hallikas üldtoonis, siin-seal lund valgete laikudena.
works.de: A group of houses, among which piles of timber. Through the end door of the shed on the left a sawmill is visible. In the foreground figures of working men. Painted in a greyish overall tone, here and there snow in white patches.

works.d: Tumedate, kuklasse kammitud juustega naise rinnapilt pooprofiilis vasakule. Krae asemel kaela seotud valge rätik.
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman with dark hair combed into a bun, in half profile to the left. Instead of a collar a white scarf tied around her neck.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise noore naise poolfiguur selgvaates. Pea täisprofiilis vasakule. Üle õlgade sügavalt selga paljastav karusnahaga servistatud punane rüü.
works.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired young woman seen from the front. The head in full profile to the left. Over the shoulders a red robe trimmed with fur, deeply baring the back.

works.d: Hallide juuste ja vurrudega vanema mehe rinnapilt en face. Seljas eest avatud karusnahkse kraega mantel.
works.de: Bust portrait en face of an older man with grey hair and moustache. Wearing a coat open at the front with a fur collar.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelised põõsad ja roheline kallas. Keskel väike helesinine veekogu. Selle taga vasakul sügisvärvides tõusev kallas, mitmevärviliste katustega majade rida. Paremal rohelise- ja kollasekirjud puud ja sinetavad metsad. Taevas hallikas-sinine, kohati roosa varjundiga.
works.de: In the foreground, green bushes and a green bank. In the middle, a small light blue body of water. Behind it on the left, a rising bank in autumn colours, a row of houses with multicoloured roofs. On the right, trees mottled with green and yellow, and bluish forests. The sky is greyish-blue, with a pinkish tinge in places.

works.d: Paremal kivine mererand, tagapool künkal varemed, mille otsaküljel mehefiguurid lõkke ümber. Vasemal purjedega kaluripaadid ankrus, taamal meri. Ülal vasemal kuu (pastoosne), kust langeb valgushelk merele. Tumedad, sünged värvitoonid.
works.de: On the right a rocky seashore, further back on a hillock ruins, on the end wall of which are men's figures around a bonfire. On the left fishing boats with sails at anchor, beyond them the sea. Upper left the moon (pastose), from which a gleam of light falls onto the sea. Dark, sombre colour tones.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha keskele künka taha kaduv tee hoonetegrupiga vasakul. Paremal, lagendikul grupp inimesi ja üksik kits. Tagapool üksiku palkhoone katus ja otsviil. Selle taga põõsastik. Taustaks järsuküljelised mäed. Keskelt vaade kaugemalolevale veekogule.
works.de: A road disappearing from the front left to the back center behind a hill, with a group of buildings on the left. On the right, in a clearing, a group of people and a solitary goat. Further back, the roof and gable end of a single log building. Behind it, shrubbery. In the background, steep-sided mountains. In the center, a view of a distant body of water.

works.d: Ees paremal tallipoiss hoidmas keskel latrite ees seisvat tumehalli hobust, taga latrites kolm hobust; vasakul ees hobuste tekke.
works.de: In front on the right a stable boy holding a dark grey horse standing in the middle in front of the stalls, behind in the stalls three horses; in front on the left horse blankets.

works.d: Esialal lage nõlvas, keskalal vasakul suured rändrahnud, paremal lohk väikeste mändidega, taamal männimets.
works.de: Bare slope in the foreground, large erratic boulders on the left in the middle ground, a hollow with small pines on the right, pine forest in the distance.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt, en face, sõjaväelase riietsuses.
works.de: Bust of a man, en face, in military uniform.

works.d: Vaade Rannamäelt Tallinna Stalingradi Väljaku suunas kulgevale linnamüürile. Vasakult nurgast diagonaalselt sügavusse suunduv tornide rida. Nende vahel linnamüüri najale toetuvaid maju. Paremal puid ja põõsaid Rannamäe nõlvakul. Tornide taga paistab Toompea nõlvak. Üle majakatuste paistva Toomkiriku torni kiivriga. Taevas pilves.
works.de: View from Rannamäe towards the town wall running toward Stalingrad Square in Tallinn. A row of towers running diagonally into the depth from the left corner. Between them, houses leaning against the town wall. On the right, trees and bushes on the slope of Rannamäe. Behind the towers, the slope of Toompea can be seen. Above the rooftops, the spire of Toomkirik (the Dome Church) with its helmet roof is visible. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Noore naise pea profiilis, vaatega paremale. Peas kirju lilleline rätik. Taamal mets.
works.de: Head of a young woman in profile, looking to the right. On her head a colourful floral scarf. In the distance, forest.

works.d: Erksinise taeva all liivapruun kaldajärsak heledate madalate majadega. Järsaku all teel kihutav sinine limusiin, paar jalakäijat. Esiplaanil, teisel pool kallast kaks antiikskulptuuri: vasakpoolne kätetu, ühel põlvel põlvitav naisfiguur, parempoolne lamav meesfiguur.
works.de: Under a bright blue sky, a sandy-brown steep bank with light-coloured low houses. At the foot of the bank, a blue limousine speeding along the road, a couple of pedestrians. In the foreground, on the other side of the bank, two antique sculptures: on the left an armless female figure kneeling on one knee, on the right a reclining male figure.

works.d: Suurejooneline panoraamne ehitusmaastik õhetava taeva ja mustade suitsupilvedega. Esiplaanil kraanade ja tellingute rõhutamise abil saavutatud horisontaalsete ja vertikaalsete rütmide tasakaal. Esiplaanil all tumepunase seinaga pikk pooleliolev ehitus. Roosas, tumepunases ja mustas värvigammas. Kohati pastoosselt ja spaatliga maalitud.
works.de: A grand panoramic construction landscape with a glowing sky and black smoke clouds. In the foreground a balance of horizontal and vertical rhythms achieved through the emphasis of cranes and scaffolding. In the foreground below a long unfinished building with a dark red wall. In a colour range of pink, dark red and black. In places painted in impasto and with a palette knife.

works.d: Esiplaanil rühm mände, tagaplaanil soomaastik üksikute puudega, veeloikudega; madal horisondijoon, taevas valgustatud paremast servast.
works.de: In the foreground a group of pines, in the background a marshland landscape with isolated trees, pools of water; low horizon line, the sky lit from the right edge.

works.d: Varasügisene maastik. Esiplaanil kitsas jalgrada, mis viib taamal paistva veekogu äärde. Kahelpool teed lehtpuude grupp. Vasakpoolse puudegrupi vahelt paistab väike punase katusega maja.
works.de: Early autumn landscape. In the foreground a narrow footpath leading to a body of water visible in the distance. On both sides of the path a group of deciduous trees. Between the trees of the left-hand group a small house with a red roof can be seen.

works.d: Sinise, punase ja valge kominatsioonis abstraktne kompositsioon. Keskel helesinise ja valkjasroosaga laialivalguva risti motiiv laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud. Vasak ülemine neljandik valdavalt ühtlane meresinine, parem alumine tumeroosa pind.
works.de: An abstract composition in a combination of blue, red and white. In the centre, a motif of a spreading cross in light blue and whitish pink, painted with broad brush strokes. The upper left quarter predominantly uniform sea-blue, the lower right a dark pink surface.

works.d: Vaade poolelioleva maja kahte ruumi läbi ukseavade, milles seisavad sinistes tööriietes mehed: vasakpoolsel punakaspruunid juuksed ja habe, tööriiete taskust paistab kruvikeeraja pea; parempoolsel mehel kergelt krässus juuksed ja vuntsid. Mõlemad mehed töötavad ukse kõrval asuvate lülitite kallal. Taga, pooleliolevates tubades, pukk, mitmes toonis juhtmepuntraid. Maalitud slaidimaali võttmestikku kasutades sinistes toonides.
works.de: View through doorways into two rooms of an unfinished house, in which men in blue work clothes are standing: the one on the left has reddish-brown hair and beard, a screwdriver head visible from his work clothes pocket; the man on the right has slightly curly hair and a moustache. Both men are working on switches located beside the door. In the back, in the unfinished rooms, a trestle, coils of wire in several colours. Painted in blue tones using the visual vocabulary of painted slide art.

works.d: Turuplatsi vaade. All vasakus nurgas osa rohelisest plangust. Ees kaks, seljaga vaataja poole seisvat meest, taamal väiksemad turuliste grupid ning hobuveokid. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: View of a marketplace. In the lower left corner part of a green fence. In front two men standing with their backs to the viewer, in the distance smaller groups of market-goers and horse carts. Sketch-like painting style.

works.d: Ülaltvaade Vabaduse platsil toimuvale demonstratsioonile. Keskel inimeste kolonnid lippude ja loosungitega liikumas üle väljaku. Paremal väljaku ääres raagus puud, tagapool kõrged hooned üle puude paistmas. Vaba käsitluslaad, sinkjas-hall koloriit.
works.de: Bird's-eye view of a demonstration taking place on Vabaduse Square. In the centre, columns of people with flags and slogans moving across the square. On the right, at the edge of the square, bare trees, behind which tall buildings appear above the trees. Free handling, bluish-grey colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu paadisillaga. Tagapool poolsaar puudega ja mets.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with a boat landing. Beyond it a peninsula with trees and forest.

works.d: Paremale pöördega, vasak jalg ees kivil, muistse sõjamehe figuur, valges lühikeses vöötatud kuues, kirjatud kõrgeis saabastes, paremas käes mingisugune puuvarras; ees kivil ohvritule leek.
works.de: Turned to the right, left foot forward on a stone, the figure of an ancient warrior in a short white belted garment, patterned high boots, in his right hand some kind of wooden staff; before him on a stone the flame of a sacrificial fire.

works.d: Valkjas-hall lõuend horisontaalsete läbilõigete ning augukestega üle kogu maali pinna. Mustjas-hallid vaba käejoonega tõmmatud triibud maalil on samuti horisontaalsed. Taotluslikud rebendid asetsevad suurema kogumina maali paremal poolel ning alaosas. Vasakul ning ülal esineb neid vähem ning mõõtmetelt on need väiksemad.
works.de: A whitish-grey canvas with horizontal cuts and small holes across the entire surface of the painting. The blackish-grey freehand-drawn stripes on the painting are likewise horizontal. Deliberate tears are concentrated in a larger group on the right side and lower part of the painting. There are fewer of them, and they are smaller in size, on the left and upper part.

works.d: Valges kitlis mehe otsevaates figuur tehaseinterjööris.
works.de: Frontal figure of a man in a white coat in a factory interior.

works.d: Pildil keskel kirjutuslaua taga istuva vanema mehe täisfiguur, kerges pöördes paremale. Käed lebamas laual, vasak jalg tõstetud üle põlve. Figuuri ebakorrapäraste siniste värvipindade rahutule rütmile on kontrastseks fooniks ruumi sisustust markeerivate korrapäraste hall-pruunide geomeetriliste pindade rahulik rütm.
works.de: In the centre of the picture, the full figure of an older man sitting behind a writing desk, in a slight turn to the right. Hands resting on the desk, left leg raised over the knee. The restless rhythm of the figure's irregular blue colour surfaces is contrasted by the calm rhythm of the regular grey-brown geometric surfaces marking the furnishing of the room as background.

works.d: Hallil, pintsliga tihedalt läbitöötatud foonil all paremas nurgas geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon, mis koosneb mustast jämedast vertikaalsest joonest, hallist punase piirjoonega munast, segmendist ja kollakast aluspinnast.
works.de: On a grey background densely worked with a brush, in the lower right corner a composition of geometric shapes, consisting of a thick black vertical line, a grey egg with a red outline, a segment, and a yellowish base surface.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon enamasti selgepiirilistest, valdavalt musta-halli-valge-kollase kombinatsioonis pindadest. Keskel mustale liitub paremalt kaarja piirjoonega valge, sidrunkollased, rohelised laigud. Hoogsalt maalitud, pintslilöögid nähtavad.
works.de: Abstract composition consisting mostly of sharply defined planes in a combination of black-grey-white-yellow. In the centre, joined to the black from the right, white, lemon-yellow and green patches with a curved outline. Painted vigorously, brushstrokes visible.

works.d: Kitsa triibu pilvevines taeva all keskpäevavalguses sädelev meri. Veeosa akvarellilikult läbipaistev, lainesäbru markeerivate värviliste täpikestega. Esiplaanil, allosas tükike erkoranži adrust randa.
works.de: Sea sparkling in midday light under a sky with a narrow strip of clouds. The water area is watercolour-like transparent, marked with colourful dots indicating the ripple of waves. In the foreground, at the bottom, a piece of bright orange seaweed on the shore.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt  poolprofiilis vasemale, paljaste õlgadega, valges õhulises kleidis. Portreed ümbritseb ovaal.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the left, bare-shouldered, in a light, airy white dress. The portrait is surrounded by an oval.

works.d: Dekoratsioonikavand "Juudit" I vaatusele. Esiplaanil kahe samba vahel kolme astmeline trepp. Keskel kaarvõlvi all seisva ja põlvitava naise figuur. Nende taga ruum kolme kaarja ukseavaga.
works.de: Set design sketch for Act I of "Juudit". In the foreground, between two columns, a three-step staircase. In the centre, under an arched vault, the figure of a standing and a kneeling woman. Behind them a room with three arched doorways.

works.d: Interjöör koldeasemega keskel. Tagaseinas laud tarbeesemetega, vasemal ukseava.
works.de: Interior with a hearth in the centre. In the back wall a table with household items, on the left a doorway.

works.d: Keskel Pirita kloostri varemed, millest vasakul  ja paremal mõned hooned. Lumine maastik.
works.de: In the middle the ruins of Pirita Convent, to the left and right of which some buildings. A snowy landscape.

works.d: Rohekashallides toonides maalitud vaade talvisele väikelinnale, puude vahel lumiste viilkatustega majad. Esiplaanil paremal lage lumine aed. Maalitud lopsakalt, laiema pintslilöögiga.
works.de: Painted in greenish-grey tones, a view of a small town in winter, houses with snowy gable roofs among trees. In the foreground on the right a bare snowy garden. Painted luxuriantly, with a broader brushstroke.

works.d: Üle terve lõuendi tugeva võraga suured puud, nende vahel tee, tagapool põõsad. Läbi okste paistab helesinine taevas, keskosas selgvaates naine. Maalitud kollakasrohelistes, pruunikassinistes toonides, kohati laiade spaatlitõmmetega.
works.de: Across the entire canvas, large trees with strong crowns, a path between them, bushes further back. Through the branches a light blue sky is visible, in the middle a woman in clear view. Painted in yellowish-green, brownish-blue tones, in places with broad palette-knife strokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil jääga kaanetatud jõekäär, mille keskel sinine veejoom. Lumisel kaldal, mõlemal pool pildiservades mändidegrupid, nende vahel keskel üksik mänd. Siin-seal pruunid maapinna laigud. Taevas kahvatusinine.
works.de: In the foreground, an ice-covered bend of a river, in the middle of which a blue stretch of open water. On the snowy bank, on both sides at the edges of the picture, groups of pines, between them in the middle a solitary pine. Here and there brown patches of ground. The sky is pale blue.

works.d: Tuhmhallides toonides kompositsioon erinevais asendeis neljast naisaktist maastikul. Esiplaanil olev naine külgvaates poollamavas asendis, toetub küünarvarrele.
works.de: A composition in dull grey tones with four female nudes in various poses in a landscape. The woman in the foreground, seen from the side, in a half-reclining position, leaning on her forearm.

works.d: Soojades pruunides toonides maapind kahe suure valkja laiguga pildi keskosas. Ülaservas õrnalt rohetav metsaviirg.
works.de: Ground painted in warm brown tones with two large whitish patches in the centre of the picture. In the upper edge a faintly greening strip of forest.

works.d: Kahel pool kõrged majad. Keskel, väljaku ääres fassaadiga vaataja poole kolmekorruseline sinaka kuplilise katusega hoone. Maalitud kollakashallides rohekais toonides piirjooni hajutades.
works.de: On both sides tall buildings. In the middle, at the edge of the square, a three-storey building with a bluish domed roof, its façade facing the viewer. Painted with contours diffused in yellowish-grey, greenish tones.

works.d: Ülevalt vaade heledatele punakate viilkatustega majadele. Taamal Tallinna vanalinna tornid. Maalitud kohati tugeva faktuuriga sinakaisvalkjais-rohekais toonides.
works.de: A view from above of light-coloured houses with reddish gable roofs. In the distance, the towers of Tallinn's Old Town. Painted in places with a strong texture in bluish-whitish-greenish tones.

works.d: Veekogu madalatel kallastel kõrguvad sirgetüveliste rohekate ja pruunikas-oranžide lehekroonidega kaskede grupid. Taevas kaetud tiheda valkjas-hallika pilvesäbruga.
works.de: On the low banks of a body of water rise groups of straight-trunked birches with greenish and brownish-orange foliage crowns. The sky covered with a dense whitish-grey curl of clouds.

works.d: Hallides, rohelistes summutatud toonides maalitud lagendiku äärsed suured puud hämaruses, paremal väikese viilkatusega maja ots, aknas põleb oranžikas tuli. Pintslilöök laiem, lopsakas.
works.de: Large trees at the edge of a clearing painted in gray, muted green tones in twilight, on the right the gable end of a small house with a gabled roof, an orange light burning in the window. The brushwork is broader, lush.

works.d: Vaade pruunikas toonis metsaga kaetud kuplilisele maastikule. Keskosas heledamad põllud, mida läbib sikk-sakitav maantee ja paremal diagonaalselt kulgev jõgi. Nõlval üksikud majad. Maalitud lühikeste tihkete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: View of a domed landscape covered with forest in brownish tones. In the middle section lighter fields, crossed by a zigzagging highway and, on the right, a diagonally running river. Isolated houses on the slope. Painted with short, dense brushstrokes.

works.d: Majade taustal heledas rätis vanema naise rinnaportree otsevaates, pea veidi pööratud vasakule. Maalitud hallikasbeežis gammas.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in a light headscarf, in frontal view, head slightly turned to the left, against a background of houses. Painted in a grayish-beige range.

works.d: Kahkjates kollakas-pruunikais toonides kaks kasesalu. Nende vahel paar erksinist järvesilma. Ülaservas kitsas taevariba. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne. Koloriit hele.
works.de: In pale yellowish-brownish tones two birch groves. Between them a couple of bright blue lake-eyes. In the upper edge a narrow strip of sky. The painted surface slightly textured. The colouring light.

works.d: Tumedas, rohelises üldkoloriidis maalitud veekogu kõrge liivakalda ning sellel kasvava tiheda metsaga. All paremas nurgas tuules rasitud kõrkjapuhmas.
works.de: A body of water painted in a dark, green overall colour scheme, with a high sandy bank on which a dense forest grows. In the lower right corner a clump of sedge battered by the wind.

works.d: Kollakates-punakates toonides maastik, maalitud looklevate ja ringlevate pintslilöökidega. Esiplaanil erksinine oja, vasakul maja. Taevas lillades toonides.
works.de: Landscape in yellowish-reddish tones, painted with winding and circling brushstrokes. In the foreground a bright blue stream, on the left a house. Sky in purple tones.

works.d: Maastik lehtpuugruppide ja helesinise ojaga. Esmal üksikud punased katused.
works.de: Landscape with groups of leafy trees and a light blue stream. In the foreground a few red roofs.

works.d: Tee ääres kahes tihedas reas valgetüvelised kased. Ladvaosad pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Allee lõpus paistab madal hoone. Maalitud hallikas-pruunides toonides.
works.de: Along the road, in two dense rows, white-trunked birches. The tops are cut off by the upper edge of the picture. At the end of the avenue, a low building can be seen. Painted in greyish-brown tones.

works.d: Vaade madalatele punakate viilkatustega majadele. Esiplaanil kolm raagus kaske, taamal keskel kirikutorn. Maalitud valkjates rohekaspunastes toonides, kohati pastoosselt.
Esiplaanil looklev tee lagedal maastikul. Paremal metsatukk, selle ees üksikud majad, taamal veetriip. Maalitud heledates hallikasrohelistes, beežides, tumepunastes toonides laiade spaatlitõmmetega.
works.de: In the foreground a winding road in an open landscape. On the right a copse, individual houses in front of it, a strip of water further away. Painted in light grayish-green, beige, dark red tones with broad spatula strokes.

works.d: Vaade puudega kaetud mäekuplile, puuvõrad peente heledate joontena tumedasse pinda kraabitud. Mäe jalamil vasakul heledalt valgustatud ala ja kaks madalat hoonet. Eespool hele mäekülg, sinine taevas. Üldistav kujutamisviis.
works.de: View of a tree-covered hilltop, the tree crowns scratched as fine light lines into the dark surface. At the foot of the hill on the left a brightly lit area and two low buildings. In front a light hillside, blue sky. A generalising manner of depiction.

works.dm: kõrgus: 31.2 cm; kujutise laius: 21.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 29.7 cm; laius: 23.5 cm
works.d: Vanamehe pea poolprofiilis paremale. Pikk blond habe ja juuksed. Pead ümbritseb pruunikas toonis ovaal mustal taustal.
works.de: Head of an old man in half-profile to the right. Long blond beard and hair. The head is surrounded by a brownish oval on a black background.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kadale kinnitatud lootsik. Vasakul puudesalk. Tagaplaanil paremal meri pilvedega selle kohal.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a boat tied to a juniper. On the left a grove of trees. In the background on the right the sea with clouds above it.

works.d: Lainetevahus ees keskel purjelaev nelja inimfiguuriga. Taustaks rohekashall taevas, vasemal kauge laeva kontuurid, paremal kolm lendavat lindu.
works.de: In the middle of the foam of the waves in front, a sailing ship with four human figures. In the background a greyish-grey sky, on the left the contours of a distant ship, on the right three flying birds.

works.d: Esiplaanil osaliselt veetaimedega kinni kasvanud tiik või jõgi. Vasakul ja paremal kõrged puudegrupid. Keskel üksik kuusk.
works.de: In the foreground a pond or river partly overgrown with water plants. On the left and right tall groups of trees. In the middle a solitary spruce.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul muru, paremal põld. Murul kolm inimest, põllu paremas osas viis inimest. Taga puude vahelt näha keskel kahte suurt valget maja ja vasakul ühe väikese majakese katust korstnaga.
works.de: In the foreground on the left grass, on the right a field. Three people on the grass, five people in the right part of the field. Behind, among the trees, two large white houses can be seen in the middle and the roof with a chimney of one small house on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil panoraamina hoonete grupp. Tagaplaanil künklik maastik.
works.de: In the foreground a group of buildings as a panorama. In the background a hilly landscape.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduvad põlluribad. Nende taga puude vahel punaste ja hallide katustega majadegrupp. Taga silmapiiril sinakad künkad.
works.de: In the foreground strips of field running from left to right. Behind them, among trees, a group of houses with red and grey roofs. Behind, on the horizon, bluish hills.

works.d: Toolil istuva keskealise naise poolfiguur, keha kerge pöördega vasemale, pea en face. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Seljas valge pitskaelusega kleit, peas valge pitstanu siniste paeltega.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman sitting on a chair, body slightly turned to the left, head en face. Hands crossed on the chest. Wearing a white dress with a lace collar, on her head a white lace bonnet with blue ribbons.

works.d: Toolil istuva vana mehe poolfiguur en face. Kaelas valge kaelarätt. Seljas kaherealine sinine metallnööpidega kuub.
works.de: Half-figure of an old man sitting on a chair, en face. White neckerchief around his neck. Wearing a double-breasted blue coat with metal buttons.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 14.9 cm (lm); laius: 8.6 cm (vm); kõrgus: 12.8 cm (vm); lehe laius: 10.7 cm (lm)
works.d: Rullsoenguga heledapäise tütarlapse poolfiguur - peaaegu en face. Pea kallutatud kergelt paremale. Seljas hele, sügavalt dekolteeritud kleit. Kaelas kaherealine kee.
works.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired girl with a rolled hairstyle - almost en face. The head tilted slightly to the right. Wearing a light, deeply décolleté dress. On the neck a double-row necklace.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree vasakule, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Mehel laubale kammitud helepruunid juuksed, põskhabe, sinised silmad, veidi paotatud suu. Seljas reväärkraega pruun kuub, kõrge kaelusega liivapruun vest, valge kaelarätt kaelas. Foon hallikas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man facing left, gaze directed at the viewer. The man has light brown hair combed onto the forehead, side whiskers, blue eyes, mouth slightly open. Wearing a brown coat with lapel collar, a sand-brown waistcoat with a high collar, a white neckerchief at the throat. Background greyish.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kalapaat nelja kaluriga. Merel paremal kolm purjekat. Taamal Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a fishing boat with four fishermen. At sea on the right three sailboats. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Vasakul rand, paremal meri. Rannal ja vees kivid. Rand lõpeb maali serva keskkohas kaljuseinaga. Ranna ääres üksik paat inimfiguuriga. Maali paremal serval keskel merel kaljurahn. Ees mere kohal lendavaid kajakaid. Taga veepinnal purjekaid ja laevade siluette. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: On the left, the shore, on the right, the sea. Stones on the shore and in the water. The shore ends in the middle of the edge of the painting with a rock wall. By the shore, a lone boat with a human figure. On the right edge of the painting, in the middle of the sea, a rocky boulder. In front, seagulls flying over the sea. Further back on the water's surface, sailboats and silhouettes of ships. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas must kleit, kaelas kuldkett.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a young woman in three-quarter profile facing right. Wearing a black dress, a gold chain around her neck.

works.d: Vanema hallipäise mehe rinnapilt peaaegu otsevaates. Ristsideme tagantulatuvad krae nurgad vastu lõuga.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older grey-haired man, almost in a direct view. The corners of the collar, coming from behind on a cross-tie, touch the chin.

works.d: Esiplaanil olevate puutüvede vahelt paistab punase kivikatusega, valgete seintega kabel roheliste lehtpuude taustal.
works.de: Through the tree trunks in the foreground a chapel with a red tiled roof and white walls is visible against a background of green deciduous trees.

works.d: Ees rohuribal keskel ringis tantsivate naiste figuurid. Neist vasemal kännul istuv mees kannelt mängimas, tema ees poolalasti mees nooleotsaga. Seljataga kolm poolalasti meest vibudega. Tantsijaist paremal kaks odadega, kolm vibuga meest ja rahvarõivas neiu. Tema kõrval meesfiguur, käsi ümber neiu piha.
works.de: In front, on a strip of grass, figures of women dancing in a circle in the middle. To their left, a man sitting on a stump playing a kannel, in front of him a half-naked man with an arrowhead. Behind him three half-naked men with bows. To the right of the dancers, two men with spears, three with bows, and a maiden in folk costume. Beside her, a male figure with an arm around the maiden's waist.

works.d: Esiplaanil aia ääres seisva tütarlapse põlvpilt profiilis paremale; peas rätik, käes vits, vasem küünarnukk toetub tara latile, paremal äärel sügavasse suunduv tee, tee ääres lehm ja lehtpuid, taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a knee-length portrait, in profile to the right, of a girl standing by a fence; a kerchief on her head, a switch in her hand, left elbow resting on a fence rail, on the right edge a road leading into the distance, by the road a cow and deciduous trees, a forest in the distance.

works.d: Vasakul koerteajaja nelja koeraga. Keskel ratsanik pasunat puhumas. Paremal kolm jahimeest lastud põdraga. Nende taga järv marjakobarais pihlakas ja kasetüved. Taamal vasakul kirik, keskel lossivaremed.
works.de: On the left a dog handler with four dogs. In the centre a horseman blowing a horn. On the right three hunters with a shot elk. Behind them a lake, a rowan tree with clusters of berries and birch trunks. In the distance on the left a church, in the middle castle ruins.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis, pöördes vasakule. Helehall juus, kollakad vurrud. Käed põlvedel, vasakus käes sinine raamat. Tume ülikond, valge püstkraega, roheline lips.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in a seated position, turned to the left. Light grey hair, yellowish moustache. Hands on his knees, a blue book in his left hand. Dark suit, white stand-up collar, green tie.

works.d: Istuva vanema naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Parem käsi toetatud lauale. Pruunid juuksed, sinine valge kirjaga pluus, tume seelik, õlgadel roheline rätik. Tugevasti toonitatud kontuur. Parema õla taga sinine pind, foon rohekas.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated older woman in profile to the left. Right hand resting on a table. Brown hair, blue blouse with white lettering, dark skirt, green shawl on the shoulders. Strongly toned contour. Blue surface behind the right shoulder, background greenish.

works.d: Heledas, pehmes viltkübaras mehe rinnaportree, kerges pöördes paremale. Nägu kujult piklik, silmad lähestikku asetsevad, kergelt pungis; ninajoon peen; suu väike. Seljas hall kuub ja sviiter. Taust hele.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in a light, soft felt hat, in a slight turn to the right. Face elongated in shape, eyes set close together, slightly bulging; nose line thin; mouth small. Wearing a grey coat and a sweater. Background light.

works.d: Pildi allosas kaks madalat taluhoonet nende ümber kasvavate puude-põõsastega. 2/3 maalipinnast võtab enda alla sinine, valgete pilvekaharatega taevas.
works.de: In the lower part of the picture two low farm buildings with trees and bushes growing around them. 2/3 of the painting's surface is taken up by a blue sky with fluffy white clouds.

works.d: Sinise-pruunikirju draperii foonil keskosas seisev naisakt otsevaates, pisut langetatud pea pööratud vasakule. Kõverdatud käed rinnal. Valkjas toonis figuur ümbritsetud tugeva tumesinise kontuuriga.
works.de: Against a background of blue-brown patterned drapery, a standing female nude in the center in frontal view, head slightly lowered and turned to the left. Bent arms on the chest. The whitish-toned figure surrounded by a strong dark blue outline.

works.d: Jämedate puutüvede vahel kolm alasti mehefiguuri. Keskmisel, esiplaanil oleval mehel käes õlakõrgusele tõstetud kepp. Tema juures, paremal valgepruuni laiguline koer. Figuurid tahtlikult teostatud disproportsionaalsetena; kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud. Maastiku juures kasutatud stiliseerivat laadi. Värvikiht õhuke.
