works.de: Three nude male figures among thick tree trunks. The middle man, in the foreground, holds a stick raised to shoulder height. Next to him, on the right, a white-brown spotted dog. The figures are deliberately rendered disproportionate; contours slightly emphasised. A stylising manner is used for the landscape. Thin paint layer.

works.dm: kõrgus: 43.3 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 22.6 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 28.8 cm; laius: 37.3 cm (lm)
works.d: Kooguga kaevu juures kolme seisva naise täisfiguurid. Neist parempoolne selgvaates.
works.de: Full figures of three standing women by a well with a sweep. The one on the right seen from the back.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise, vurrudega, valges ohvitserimundris noore mehe rinnapilt. Poolprofiil vasakule. Taust õrn-sinine.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young brown-haired man with a moustache, in a white officer's uniform. Half-profile to the left. Background gentle blue.

works.d: Laugjate kaldakäärudega, lamedate kivirahnude ja muruga kaetud mererand. Vasakul nõlval sügiseselt kirjud ja  poolraagus lehtpuude tuules. Paremal, all ranna pool madal rookatusega taluhoone. Üleni kohevas rünkpilves taevas. Sageli tumeda kontuuriga ümbritsetud, selgepiiriliste vormidega maal.
works.de: A sea coast with gently sloping banks, covered with flat boulders and grass. On the left slope, autumnally colourful and half-bare deciduous trees in the wind. On the right, below near the shore, a low farmhouse with a thatched roof. The sky entirely filled with fluffy cumulus clouds. A painting with clearly defined forms, often surrounded by dark contours.

works.dm: kõrgus: 32.7 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 20.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 27.5 cm; laius: 24.0 cm (lm)
works.d: Lõunamaine maastikumotiiv: esiplaanil kaks lõikuvat kitsast teed, ristumiskohal jalgratta toetamiseks mõeldud post. Vasakul kaks raagus okstega puud. Keskplaanis kaks valget, madalat, punaste katustega maja. Ülaosas rohelusega kaetud mäed ja kollane taevas.
works.de: A southern landscape motif: in the foreground two narrow intersecting roads, at the crossing point a post meant for propping up a bicycle. On the left two trees with bare branches. In the middle ground two low white houses with red roofs. In the upper part mountains covered with greenery and a yellow sky.

works.d: Kuuest inimesest grupp sinakasrohelises maastikus. Vasakul, õitsva põõsa ees seisab noor naine kolmveerandpöördesvasakule, sinakas seelik-pluus seljas, õlgade ümber roosa jakk. Tema kõrval koer. Keskel kaks pingil istujat, patsijuppidega tüdruk vasakul ja vanem naine üle õla kiikamas. Pildil paremal seisev noormees otsevaates, käsi taskus. Tema taga paremal noormees ja helesinises suvekleidis neiu noormehe vastu nõjatumas. Figuurid suure üldistusega maalitud, kohati kontuurjoonega vorme rõhutades.
works.de: A group of six people in a bluish-green landscape. On the left, in front of a flowering bush, stands a young woman turned three-quarters to the left, wearing a bluish skirt-blouse with a pink jacket around her shoulders. A dog beside her. In the centre, two people sitting on a bench, a girl with braid ends on the left and an older woman glancing over her shoulder. On the right of the picture a young man stands facing forward, hand in pocket. Behind him on the right a young man and a girl in a light blue summer dress leaning against him. The figures are painted with great generalisation, in places emphasising forms with a contour line.

works.d: Keskjoonest pisut paremal istuva naise otsevaates poolfiguur, nägu veidi vasemale pööratud, vasak käsi toetub küünarnukiga toolileenile, parem puhkab süles. Tugeva, pisut lihava ninaga nägu, hallid juuksed. Seljas kirju pluus ning tumesinine seelik. Vasakus servas keskjoonest kõrgemal aimatav tehaseinterjöör. Foon ja kogu pilt lahendatud peamiselt siniste, punaste ja roheliste värvilaikude kõrvutamise ja põimimisega.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman slightly to the right of the centre line, viewed frontally, her face turned slightly to the left, her left hand resting with the elbow on the chair's armrest, her right hand resting in her lap. A face with a strong, somewhat fleshy nose, grey hair. Wearing a colourful blouse and a dark blue skirt. In the left edge, above the centre line, a factory interior is faintly suggested. The background and the whole picture are rendered mainly through the juxtaposition and interweaving of patches of blue, red and green colour.

works.d: Sinakasrohelistes ja punastes toonides portreekompositsioon: hoolikalt läbimaalitud pindadest aimub vasakul arhitektoonilisi konstruktsioone. Paremal niššis (või kaare all) punaste juuste, siniste silmade, lopsaka suu ja püstja ninaga noor naine profiilis. Naise käed rinnal vaheliti, vasakus käes hele õiekujuline sõrmus.
works.de: A portrait composition in bluish-green and red tones: carefully worked surfaces suggest architectural constructions at left. At right, in a niche (or under an arch), a young woman in profile with red hair, blue eyes, full lips and an upturned nose. The woman's hands are crossed on her chest, and on her left hand there is a light flower-shaped ring.

works.d: Samblarohekast, roostepruunist foonist eradlub vasakul lillekimbu kujutis, paremal pikajuukselise seisva noore prillidega naise poolfiguur, pilk vaataal, käed vaheliti rinnal. Figuur ja selle ümbrus maalitud kirevate diagonaalsuunaliste pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: From a moss-green, rust-brown background emerges on the left the image of a bouquet of flowers, on the right the half-figure of a young, long-haired standing woman wearing glasses, her gaze on the viewer, hands crossed on her chest. The figure and its surroundings are painted with vivid diagonal brushstrokes.

works.d: Maali ülapoolel, helesinisel taustal suur värvitriibuline kala lennus. Allosas värvipindadega, -triipudega markeeritud hoonetegrupp kirikutorniga keskel. Hoogsa laadiga maal. Kohati pind pastoosne, kohati (kala kujul) katmata lõuend.
works.de: In the upper part of the painting, against a light blue background, a large multicoloured striped fish in flight. In the lower part, a group of buildings marked with colour surfaces and stripes, with a church tower in the centre. A painting of a vigorous manner. In places the surface is impasto, in places (in the shape of the fish) the canvas is left uncovered.

works.d: "Järveäärses linnas" 1989
works.de: "Järveäärses linnas" 1989

works.d: Ees, ühel hobusel ratsutavad mees ja naine. Taga vaade alla orus olevale kirikutornile ja metsale.
works.de: In front, a man and a woman riding on one horse. Behind, a view down into a valley with a church tower and forest.

works.d: Ees jõgi millest vasakul üks haru paremale veski taha suundub. Vastaskaldal, keskel veski koos kõrvalhoonetega, vasemal sild; silla juures sõudepaat.
works.de: In front a river, on the left one branch turns right behind the mill. On the opposite bank, in the centre a mill with outbuildings, on the left a bridge; by the bridge a rowing boat.

works.d: Ees veekogu. Keskel veski koos rea kõrvalhoonetega. Vasemal paadisild. Sillal kaks poisikese figuuri. 2/3 tööst pilvist taevast.
works.de: In front a body of water. In the middle a mill with a row of outbuildings. On the left a boat bridge. On the bridge two boy figures. 2/3 of the work cloudy sky.

works.d: Vasakul, ees oleva lagendiku serval kindlusehituse varemed. Taamal, paremal üksik hoone. Taustaks mäed.
works.de: On the left, at the edge of a clearing in front, the ruins of a fortification. In the distance, on the right, a single building. Mountains as the background.

works.d: Ees lage künklik maastik. Tagapool vasakul, keskel ja paremal puude ja põõsastike vööndi vahel hooned.
works.de: In the foreground a bare hilly landscape. Behind, at left, centre and right, buildings between a belt of trees and shrubs.

works.d: Ees lõunamaa taimedest ja väänkasvudest ümbritsetud terrassil kükitav naine väikese lapsega. Vasakult, terrassilt avaneb vaade merele.
Teekurvil kaldapervele toetuv seljapaunaga kaabus mees (autor). Mehe ees kaks väikest seisvat tüdrukukest.
works.de: A capped man with a knapsack (the author) leaning on the bank edge at a bend in the path. In front of the man, two small standing little girls.

works.d: Ees keskel sügavale merre tungiv kai inimgruppidega ja randuva sõudepaadi ja purjekaga. Vasakul näha järsuseinalise kaljuse kalda serva. Paremal, suunaga taha keskele vulkaaniliste mägede ahelik.
Esiplaanil veekogu ääres lõkketule ümber grupp mehi ja hobuseid, taamal mäed.
works.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, a group of men and horses around a campfire, mountains in the distance.

works.d: Liivasel mäestikurajal kolm kasakarõivais, relvastatud ratsanikku. Taustaks roosaka helgiga mäeahelik.
works.de: On a sandy mountain path three armed horsemen in Cossack dress. In the background a mountain range with a pinkish glow.

works.d: Sinerdava veekogu kaldal pehmetes pruunides toonides, rohekate varjunditega põõsastik. Taevas kaetud valkjate pilvesagaratega.
works.de: On the shore of a bluish body of water, shrubbery in soft brown tones with greenish shades. The sky is covered with whitish cloud masses.

works.d: Hõberoheliste käharate lehtpuudega kaetud mäe ees lagedate kallastega jõekäär. Maalitud tugeva faktuuriga, taeva osas täiesti reljeefsena.
works.de: A river bend with bare banks in front of a hill covered with silvery-green curly-leaved deciduous trees. Painted with strong texture, the sky area completely in relief.

works.d: Keskplaani jäävate rohekat veekogu ümbritsevad igast küljest lumistel kallastel oranžikalt kumavate tüvedega mändide grupid. Maalipind pastoosne. Koloriit hele.
works.de: In the middle ground, groups of pines with trunks glowing orange surround on all sides a greenish body of water on snowy banks. The paint surface is impasto. The colouring is light.

works.d: All servas punakates värvirefleksides virvendav veepind sellel ujuva kahemastilise laevaga. Keskplaanis läbi punase tulekuma aimatavad hoonete kontuurid.
works.de: Water surface flickering at the edges in reddish colour reflections, with a two-masted ship floating on it. In the middle ground, contours of buildings discernible through the red glow of fire.

works.d: Tumehalli taeva all jõgi kaarsillaga. Esiplaanil paremal kaks inimest purjekal, vasakul pikk sõudepaat, väiksemaid paate. Maalitud tumedates sinakates, hallides toonides pastoosselt.
works.de: A river with an arched bridge under a dark gray sky. In the foreground on the right two people in a sailboat, on the left a long rowboat, smaller boats. Painted in dark bluish, gray tones, impasto.

works.d: Valkjas-roosades õites viljapuud ning õrnrohelised põõsaste puhmad. Nende vahelt paistavad kaks punaste katustega maja. Värvipind faktuurne. Värvigamma hele.
works.de: Fruit trees with whitish-pink blossoms and soft green clumps of bushes. Between them two houses with red roofs are visible. The paint surface is textured. The colour range is light.

works.d: Jõekalda ääres kaks purjekat figuuridega, taamal kaarsild ja linna siluett. Maalitud kirevalt, lopsakate lühemate pintslilöökidega, kohati tugeva faktuuriga.
works.de: Two sailboats with figures by a riverbank, in the distance an arch bridge and the city silhouette. Painted colourfully, with lush, shorter brushstrokes, in places with strong texture.

works.d: Beežides toonides lage maastik üksikute oranžide põõsatuttidega hallika taevatriibu all. Kaugemal heledad väikesed majad. Maalitud siledalt, värvi pühkivalt.
works.de: An open landscape in beige tones with occasional orange bushy tufts under a greyish strip of sky. In the distance, small light-coloured houses. Painted smoothly, with sweeping colour.

works.d: Beežides, hallides toonides lumine maastikumotiiv. Vasakul nõlvak kasesaluga, esiplaanil pruunikas veelomp. Maalitud hoogsalt, jõuliselt, kohati väga pastoosselt.
works.de: A snowy landscape motif in beige and grey tones. On the left a slope with a birch grove, in the foreground a brownish puddle of water. Painted vigorously, forcefully, in places very pastose.

works.d: Sulavates ookrites-oranžides toonides maalitud metsatukk. Vasakul väike lagendik kahe punasekatuselise majaga metsaservas. Maalipind kohati faktuurne.
Esiplaanil raagus puude grupid. Nende vahel sulanud lumelaigud ning suured veelombid. Taamal paistavad ühekorruselised elamud. Taevas kahvatusinine. Üldkoloriit pastelne.
works.de: In the foreground, groups of bare trees. Between them, melting patches of snow and large puddles of water. In the distance, single-storey dwellings can be seen. The sky is pale blue. The overall colouring is pastel.

works.d: Tumedate, tinaraskete pilvede all lage maastik esiplaanil oleva üksiku põõsa ning taamal kollakas valgusvines seisva viie punasekatuselise hoonega. Maalimisel kasutatud pahtlit.
works.de: Under dark, leaden clouds, an open landscape with a solitary bush in the foreground and, in the distance, five red-roofed buildings standing in yellowish light haze. Putty knife used in painting.

works.d: Kollakaspruunis toonis maastiku taustal istuva keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Mehel piklik nägu, sirge nina, kõrge laup, juuksed kammitud ülepea. Seljas tume ülikond, rohekas lips kaelas. Parem käsi toetub pildiraamile, vasakus hoiab kolme pintslit. Maalitud tihkelt.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man sitting against a yellowish-brown landscape background, turned half-way to the left, gaze directed at the viewer. The man has an elongated face, straight nose, high forehead, hair combed back over the head. He wears a dark suit, a greenish tie at the neck. His right hand rests on the picture frame, in his left he holds three brushes. Painted densely.

works.d: Pruunikasrohelise mägise maastiku taustal istub punases lühikeste puhvvarrukatega, ovaalse dekolteega kleidis noor naine otsevaates. Pea pööratud vasakule, pilk suunatud alla. Keskelt lahkukammitud pikad tumedad juuksed suljal. Käed kõrval ees, toetuvad lauaservale.
works.de: Against a background of a brownish-green mountainous landscape sits a young woman in frontal view, in a red dress with short puffed sleeves and an oval décolletage. Head turned to the left, gaze directed downward. Long dark hair parted in the middle, loose. Hands in front to the side, resting on the edge of a table.

works.d: Valkjashallis toonis maalitud pealtvaade lumiste puudega kaetud nõlvakule. Esiplaanil üle lagendiku metsa viiv tee. Maalitud pastoosselt.
works.de: Top view painted in whitish-grey tones of a slope covered with snowy trees. In the foreground a road leading through a clearing into the forest. Painted pastosely.

works.d: Sikk-sakina paigutatud värviline lillelett, selle vahel heledais rõivais naisfiguurid. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks istuvat naist kollases, vasakpoolne külg-, parempoolne otsevaates. Maalitud kirevalt, roosades-rohelistes-pruunides toonides kohati täppivalt pastoosselt, kohati spaatliga.
works.de: A zigzag-arranged colourful flower bed, among it female figures in light-coloured clothing. In the foreground on the left two seated women in yellow, the left one in profile, the right one in frontal view. Painted vividly, in pink-green-brown tones, in places stippled and impasto, in places with a palette knife.

works.d: Väljakut ümbritsevate hoonete ees heledad varikatused. Esiplaanil vasakul seisvate hobuste rida vankritega, nende vahel ja paremal värvikalt maalitud inimgrupid. Maalitud summutatud pruunis-beežis toonis üksikute erksate punakasroheliste laikudega.
works.de: Light-coloured awnings in front of the buildings surrounding the square. In the foreground on the left a row of standing horses with carts, between them and on the right colourfully painted groups of people. Painted in muted brown-beige tones with occasional bright reddish-green patches.

works.d: Tumehallides toonides maalitud vaade metsale. Esiplaanil lumise lagendiku serv aimatavate kuuskedega. Ülaosas kitsas triip kollakat taevast. Maalitud laiade spaatli tõmmetega.
works.de: A view of a forest painted in dark grey tones. In the foreground the edge of a snowy clearing with faintly discernible spruces. At the top a narrow strip of yellowish sky. Painted with broad strokes of a palette knife.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kaldal kaks veoautot, inimeste grupid. Merel hulk purjekaid, eespool väiksemaid paate. Tagaplaanil paremal suitsevad korstnad. Maalitud värvikalt, pastoosselt.
works.de: In the foreground, on the shore two trucks, groups of people. On the sea a number of sailboats, smaller boats in front. In the background at right smoking chimneys. Painted colourfully, in impasto.

works.d: Kirevais, lillakas-oranžides toonides täppivas laadis maalitud rannaäärne. Esiplaanil purjekad vees, kaldal mitmekorruselised majad. Taamal, keskel kirikutorn.
works.de: A seaside scene painted in a colourful, lilac-orange pointillist manner. In the foreground sailboats on the water, on the shore multi-storey houses. Further away, in the centre, a church tower.

works.d: Ees keskel kolm kaske, ladvad pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Lagedal lumisel maastikul üksikud noored kuused. Taamal metsasalu. Värvipind kergelt faktuurne. Maalimisel kasutatud pahtlit.
works.de: In front in the center three birches, their tops cut off by the upper edge of the picture. In an open snowy landscape solitary young spruces. Beyond, a small grove. The paint surface is slightly textured. Putty was used in painting.

works.d: Pehmetes pruunides toonides maalitud varakevadine maastik, suurte valkjate lumelaikudega. Kontuurid hajuvad. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
works.de: Early spring landscape painted in soft brown tones, with large whitish patches of snow. Contours diffuse. The paint surface slightly textured.

works.d: Lumine maastik roosaka kasesaluga, siniste varjudega. Esiplaanil keskel lagendik, üksik väike kuusk keskel, tagapool madal punase viilkatusega maja. Maalitud heledates, roosades-sinistes toonides lühikese pintslilöögiga.
works.de: A snowy landscape with a pinkish birch grove, with blue shadows. In the foreground centre a clearing, a single small spruce in the middle, further back a low house with a red gable roof. Painted in light, pinkish-blue tones with short brushstrokes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 38.0 cm (km); laius: 55.2 cm (lm); kõrgus: 53.5 cm (lm); laius: 46.5 cm (km)
works.d: Roosakas-rohelistes toonides täppivas laadis maalitud ülaltvaade avarale kuplilisele maastikule, keskel looklev tee. Üksikud majad küngaste vahel. Paremal, silmapiiril aimatav kirikutorn.
works.de: Painted in pinkish-green tones in a dotted manner, a bird's-eye view of an expansive domed landscape, with a winding road in the centre. Individual houses among the hills. On the right, on the horizon, a church tower can be discerned.

works.d: Keskosas talvine väikelinna puiestee, kahel pool oranžide, hallide viilkatustega majad. Esiplaanil vasakul astuv inimene, paremal kaks figuuri selgvaates. Maalitud lühikese pintslilöögiga heledates sinakates toonides.
works.de: In the middle section a wintery small-town boulevard, on both sides houses with orange, grey gable roofs. In the foreground on the left a walking figure, on the right two figures seen frontally. Painted with short brushstrokes in light bluish tones.

works.d: Erksinisel foonil väänlevate okstega kolm männipuu tüve. Nende ees roheluses lopsakate erepunaste õitega moonid. Maalitud hoogsalt, pikemate pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: Against a bright blue background, three pine trunks with twisting branches. In front of them, amid lush greenery, poppies with vivid red blooms. Painted vigorously, with longer brushstrokes.

works.d: Peaaegu kogu pildi pinna võtavad enda alla kaks kergelt S-kujulise tüvega siugjalt väänlevate jämedate okstega puud. Ladva osad ning oksad pildi servadega äralõigatud. Tüved rohelised. Taustaks sinine taevas.
works.de: Almost the entire surface of the picture is taken up by two thick-branched, slightly S-shaped trunked trees winding snake-like. The tops and branches are cut off by the edges of the picture. The trunks are green. The background is a blue sky.

works.d: Rünkpilvise taeva all pastelsetes rohekais-roosades toonides põllud, kasesalud. Esiplaani keskel lillakasroosa looklev veekogu. Kaskede osas maal väga pastoosne.
works.de: Under a sky with cumulus clouds, fields and birch groves in pastel greenish-pink tones. In the centre foreground, a lilac-pink winding body of water. The birches are painted very pastosely.

works.d: Tumedal taustal ovaalne naisenägu veerandpöördes paremale, pilk suunatud alla heledatele õitele. Maalitud siledalt, tumepruunides toonides.
works.de: On a dark background, an oval female face turned a quarter to the right, gaze directed down towards light-coloured flowers. Painted smoothly, in dark brown tones.

works.d: Valgete rünkpilvedega taevatriibu all kollakas-pruunikas põld, esiplaanil hakid. Taamal vasakul, metsatuka ees kolm maja.
works.de: Under a sky-band of white cumulus clouds, a yellowish-brown field, jackdaws in the foreground. In the distance on the left, three houses in front of a small wood.

works.d: Pea-aegu pildi ülaservani tihedalt üksteise kõrval lumiste viilkatustega, kahkjates kollastes, roosades toonides majad. Esiplaanil veelomp ja kaks raagus puud. Koloriit hele; maalipind faktuurne.
works.de: Almost up to the upper edge of the picture, houses with snowy gable roofs, in pale yellowish and pink tones, closely set side by side. In the foreground a puddle of water and two bare trees. Colouring light; painted surface textured.

works.d: Helerohelistes toonides, täppivas laadis maalitud lehtpuusalu, esiplaani keskosas madalamad põõsad. Tagaplaani keskel, taeva foonil hele torniga hoone.
works.de: A grove of deciduous trees painted in light green tones, in a pointillist style, in the centre of the foreground lower bushes. In the centre background, against the sky, a light-coloured building with a tower.

works.d: 1/3 tööst lageda välja all. Silmapiiril metsad. 2/3 pilvine taevas.
works.de: 1/3 of the work is open field below. Forests on the horizon. 2/3 cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa keskel tiik, selle taga vasakul puudesalu, paremal lahesopp purjekatega, silmapiiril rannaviirg. Osaliselt pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a pond in the middle of a meadow, behind it on the left a grove, on the right a bay inlet with sailboats, on the horizon a coastline. Partly cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine nõlvak. Taga puud, keskel kõrgem mänd. Puude vahelt paistab punakas majakatus.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy slope. Behind, trees, in the middle a taller pine. Through the trees a reddish roof of a house is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil heinamaad läbistav jõgi, tagapool jõe teisel kaldal, paremal kasemets, vasakul eespool lage künkanõlv, taga mets.
works.de: In the foreground a river crossing a meadow, further back on the other side of the river, on the right a birch forest, on the left in front a bare hillside slope, forest behind.

works.d: Kivise ranna juures paat. Teisel pool paati punase särgiga, rohelise vestiga nokkmütsiga mees. Paadist paremale ranna poole sammuv mees. Vasaku käega hoiab pütti, paremaga toetab õlal kandvat esey. Merel kolm purjekat.
works.de: A boat by a stony shore. On the other side of the boat a man with a red shirt, green waistcoat and a peaked cap. A man walking from the boat towards the shore. He holds a pail in his left hand, supports a shoulder-carried burden with his right. Three sailing boats at sea.

works.d: Kahel pool äärtel kõrged puud, mille vahelt viib tee kabelini. Paremal kellatorn, kabeli seinas suur värvilisest klaasist aken gooti teravkaarega. Paremal kabeli kõrval varemed. Tee kaetud kollaste langenud lehtedega.
works.de: On both edges tall trees, between which a path leads to a chapel. On the right a bell tower, in the chapel wall a large stained-glass window with a Gothic pointed arch. On the right beside the chapel ruins. The path covered with fallen yellow leaves.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjatega veepind. Tagapool rohelised kaldad puudegruppidega.
works.de: In the foreground a water surface with sedges. Behind it green banks with groups of trees.

works.d: Varakevadine maastik: esiplaanil kitsas looklev oja, mille kallastel lund, maalitud siniste varjudega. Maapinnal kollaseid toone. Tagapool mets, mille servas sild.
works.de: Early spring landscape: in the foreground a narrow winding stream, with snow on its banks, painted with blue shadows. Yellow tones on the ground. Beyond, a forest with a bridge at its edge.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal vanamees koeraga, keskel torn ja vana linnamüür.
works.de: In the foreground on the right an old man with a dog, in the middle a tower and an old town wall.

works.d: Mehe rinnakujutis peaaegu en face. Peas puuderdatud parukas. Üle parema õla sinine lai pael, kaelas valge šaboo ordeniga, teine orden rinnas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man almost en face. Powdered wig on his head. A broad blue ribbon over his right shoulder, a white jabot with an order at the neck, a second order on the chest.

works.d: Ees vasakul kivimüüri nurk, millest üle paistab okaspuulatvu. Keskel ja paremal lage rohtunud maa. Kaugemal üksikud puude salgad. Taamal mets.
works.de: In front on the left a corner of a stone wall, over which conifer treetops can be seen. In the middle and on the right open grassy land. Further away isolated groups of trees. In the background a forest.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Peas laiaääreline kübar, seljas pikk kuub, käte vahel kitarr mängimise asendis.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in half-profile facing right. On his head a broad-brimmed hat, wearing a long coat, holding a guitar between his hands in playing position.

works.d: Esialal keskel tüse, jändrik kadakas, selle kõrval üksikuid kive. Taamal üle lageda rohumaa võsaviirg.
works.de: In the middle of the foreground a stout, gnarled juniper, beside it a few stones. In the distance a strip of scrub across open grassland.

works.d: Esiplaanil org, paremal künkal puu, vasakul org puudega ja meri.
works.de: In the foreground a valley, on the right a hill with a tree, on the left a valley with trees and the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõgi, paremal mets, keskel tee kahe naisratsutaja ja ühe jalakäijaga. Taustaks mäed ja keskel loss kaljul.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a river, on the right a forest, in the middle a road with two female riders and one pedestrian. In the background mountains and in the middle a castle on a cliff.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kaks meesfiguuri, paremal kuusemets, vasakul järsult kõrgele tõusev kaljusein mille taustaks mäed. Alumises osas näha koopasuu. Selle kõrval viltu vajunud puuriit krutsifiksiga.
works.de: In the foreground, centre, two male figures, on the right a spruce forest, on the left a steeply rising rock wall with mountains in the background. In the lower part a cave mouth can be seen. Beside it a crookedly leaning woodpile with a crucifix.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Juuksed, habe  ja vurrud hallid. Ümbritseb rohekas ovaal pruunis toonis taustal.
works.de: Bust of an elderly man in three-quarter profile to the right. Hair, beard and moustache grey. Surrounded by a greenish oval on a brown-toned background.

works.d: Mustas, laiaäärelises kübaras vana, kortsusnäolise, apelsinikorvi süles hoidva naise rinnapilt (en face).
works.de: Bust portrait (en face) of an old woman with a wrinkled face, wearing a black, wide-brimmed hat, holding a basket of oranges in her lap.

works.d: Toolil istuva tumedajuukselise poisi põlvpilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Poisil seljas punane musta kaeluse ja varruka äärestusega, läikivate metallnööpidega kuub. Süles käte vahel apelsin.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a dark-haired boy sitting on a chair, in half-profile facing right. The boy is wearing a red coat with a black collar and sleeve trim, with shiny metal buttons. An orange held in his hands in his lap.

works.d: Keskealise habemiku mehe rinnapilt, täisprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged bearded man, in full profile to the right.

works.dm: kõrgus: 76.0 cm (arm); laius: 56.2 cm (lm); kõrgus: 72.3 cm (lm); laius: 60.0 cm (arm)
works.d: Poisikese alasti täisfiguur istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule.
works.de: Full nude figure of a boy in a seated position, in three-quarter profile turned to the left.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise noore naise rinnapilt täisprofiilis vasakule. Ümber õlgade kaela ja osaliselt rinda paljaks jättev õhuline valge rüü.
works.de: Bust of a young brown-haired woman in full profile to the left. An airy white robe around her shoulders, leaving her neck and part of her breast bare.

works.d: Pea peale kammitud juustega noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas tume, kõrge kaelusega kleit. Taust tumepruun.
Pruunide juustega, otsaesisele kammitud tukaga noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas kõrge kaelusega tume kleit.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with brown hair combed into a fringe on the forehead, in three-quarter profile to the right. Wearing a dark dress with a high collar.

works.d: Hallipäise habemiku mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas tume ülikond.
works.de: Bust of a grey-haired bearded man in half-profile facing right. Wearing a dark suit.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasakule langeval nõlvakul üksikud männid, orus okaspuumets ja kaks järvepeeglit, horisonti palistab metsaveerg.
works.de: In the foreground, on a slope descending from right to left, isolated pine trees, in the valley a coniferous forest and two lake mirrors, the horizon bordered by the edge of the forest.

works.d: Ees teekurv suunaga vasakule. Vasakule suunduva tee ääres aiaga piiratud taluhooned, (paremat kätt teed ja vasakul pool) puuderida. Horisondil metsad.
works.de: In front, a bend in the road heading to the left. Along the road leading to the left, farm buildings enclosed by a fence, (on the right side of the road and on the left) a row of trees. Forests on the horizon.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur, pea pööratud pisut vasemale, pilk vaatlejal, näol leebe naeratus. Parem käsi paigutatud kergelt vasemale. Romantiline, salapärane maastikufoon.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman, head turned slightly to the left, gaze on the viewer, a gentle smile on her face. Right hand placed slightly to the left. Romantic, mysterious landscape background.

works.dm: kõrgus: 80.0 cm (lm); laius: 60.5 cm; kõrgus: 80.7 cm; laius: 59.5 cm (lm)
works.d: Vaheliti kätega rinnal, poolprofiilis paremale istuva mehe poolfiguur, hallide juuste ja põskhabemega pea peaaegu en face, oliivrohekal foonil, tumedas kuues.
works.de: With arms crossed on his chest, the half-figure of a man seated in half-profile facing right, his head with grey hair and side-whiskers almost en face, against an olive-green background, in a dark coat.

works.d: Kolmveerandis paremale mehe poolfiguur, kurrude ja habemesalguga alumise huule all, lühikeste vastu pead pruunide juustega, kollakas-pruunil foonil mustas kuues.
works.de: A three-quarter view to the right of a man's half-figure, with wrinkles and a beard growth beneath the lower lip, with short brown hair against his head, on a yellowish-brown background, in a black robe.

works.d: Käharpäise, pöördega paremale noore naise poolfiguur, tumedal kleidil valge rüüžkaelus, õlgadel punane sall, vasak käsi põlvedel; kollakaspruunil foonil.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman with curly hair, turned to the right, wearing a dark dress with a white ruffled collar, a red shawl on her shoulders, left hand on her knees; against a yellowish-brown background.

works.d: Vanema mehe rindportree kerges pöördes vasakule. Hall habe ja vurrud. Pruunikas foon.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man in a slight turn to the left. Grey beard and moustache. Brownish background.

works.d: Noormehe portree 3/4 pöördes paremale. Väiksed vurrud, valge püstkrae, punasekirju vest. Tume foon.
works.de: Portrait of a young man in 3/4 turn facing right. Small moustache, white stand-up collar, red patterned vest. Dark background.

works.d: Naise rindportree otsevaates. Must-valge pitsiga ääristatud kleit. Kollakas foon.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a woman. Dress trimmed with black-and-white lace. Yellowish background.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane mererand kaldale uhutus tsisterniga. Taga meri. Horisondil vasakul maariba.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy seashore with a cistern washed up on the shore. Behind it the sea. On the horizon on the left a strip of land.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal ja paremal jämedad puud. Tagapool vasemal mets, paremal lagendik mäesiluettidega kauguses.
works.de: In the foreground, on the left and right, thick trees. Behind, on the left a forest, on the right a clearing with mountain silhouettes in the distance.

works.d: Pikkade juustega, vurrude ja habemega keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Üle õlgade keebitaoline mantel ristiga vasakul hõlmal, puusal mõõk.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with long hair, moustache and beard, in half-profile to the left. A cloak-like mantle over the shoulders with a cross on the left flap, a sword at the hip.

works.d: Violetselt helendava maastiku taustal mäeveerel karvamütsiga tšigiti riietuses ja relvastuses ratsanik hobuste kõrval.  Lipul on rippumas kaks tupsu. Nurgas poolkuu. Detailitäpne kujutamisviis.
works.de: Against a background of a violet-glowing landscape on a mountain slope, a rider in fur hat and Chiguit dress and armament next to horses. Two tassels are hanging from the banner. A crescent moon in the corner. A detailed manner of depiction.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine lagendik üksiku madala põõsaga vasakul. Taga roosakad ja valged mäed. Vasakul taeval lindude kolmnurk.
works.de: Rocky clearing in the foreground with a single low bush on the left. Pinkish and white mountains behind. A triangle of birds in the sky on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil tagurpidi pööratud pingist "kelgul" istuv poiss ja teda vedav tütarlaps. Nende taga lumememm. Pisut kaugemal lumine müür ja üle müüri paistvad puudekroonid.
works.de: In the foreground a boy sitting on an upturned bench as if on a "sledge", pulled by a girl. Behind them a snowman. A little further off a snowy wall and treetops visible above the wall.

works.d: Vanema, rüüžidega tanus ja kraega, naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Üle õlgade punane sall.
works.de: Bust of an older woman in a ruffled cap and collar, in half-profile to the left. A red shawl over her shoulders.

works.d: Püti otsas istuv eesti talumees, torupilli puhumas.
works.de: An Estonian peasant man sitting on a barrel, playing the bagpipes.

works.d: Toas avatud akna all voodis magav laps. Vasakul, ukse juures elektrit väljalülitav naine.
works.de: In the room, under an open window, a child sleeping in bed. On the left, by the door, a woman switching off the electricity.

works.d: Akna all voodis (selgvaates) istuv tütarlaps. Aknast sissepaistval kuukiirel lillas kleidis imeväike tüdrukuke.
Vasakul värav ja värava juurest ette paremale suunduv tee. Tee äärest kuni silmapiirini, kus on mäed, rohuväli üksikute karikakarde ja kurekelladega. Taevas täiskuu.

Realistlikult maalitud otsevaates seisva mehe täisfiguur. Pea kergelt pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud alla. Mehel on peas hall sonimüts, seljas hall kuub, mille lahtiste hõlmade alt paistab erkpunane särk. Vasak käsi toetub värvlile, parem on sirgelt kõrval. Jalas on mehel hallid püksid ning hallides toonides kingad. Paremal pool seisab suurem pruunika karvaga koer 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Maali foon hallides toonides.
works.de: Full figure of a man standing, viewed frontally, painted realistically. His head is turned slightly to the left, his gaze directed downward. The man wears a grey slouch hat, a grey coat, from under the open lapels of which a bright red shirt is visible. His left hand rests on a walking stick, his right hand hangs straight at his side. The man wears grey trousers and shoes in grey tones. On the right stands a larger dog with brownish fur, in a 3/4 turn to the left. The background of the painting is in grey tones.

works.dm: kõrgus: 33.2 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 31.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 23.8 cm; laius: 42.2 cm (lm)
works.d: Ees kolm pearätikus naist. Vasakpoolsel ja keskmisel süles viljavihk. Parempoolne kummardunud vihuköidiku keerutamiseks.
works.de: Three women in headscarves in front. The left and middle ones hold a sheaf of grain in their laps. The right one is bent over, twisting a sheaf-binding.

works.d: Värvikas kompositsioon naiivses-karikeerivas laadis stiliseeritud naisekeha vormidest, geomeetrilistest dekoratiivsetest kujunditest paigutatuna pildipinnale kaarjalt vasakult poolelt paremale alla. Allosas külili triibuliste reitega nukulik torso. Paremal all väiksem maskiga, naiserinnaga kuju. Vasakul ülal silmaava kujund ja rinnad koonusena suunaga paremale. Üksikud kujundid-vormid ülal paremal hõljumas lillakaspruunis avaruses. Selgepiiriliselt eraldatud, enamasti ruumiliselt kujutatud vormid.
works.de: A colourful composition in a naive-caricature style of stylised female body forms and geometric decorative shapes arranged across the picture plane in an arc from the upper left to the lower right. Below, a doll-like torso lying on its side with striped thighs. Lower right, a smaller figure with a mask and female breasts. Upper left, an eye-opening shape and breasts as cones pointing to the right. Individual shapes-forms floating in the upper right in a lilac-brown expanse. Sharply delineated forms, mostly depicted with volume.

works.d: Suvine vaade piki mereäärt kõrge rünkpilvise taevaga. Vasakul kivine rand, valge lainesäbru veepiiril, silmapiiril meri. Paremal kõrge liivane kallas, üleval roheline murukamar.
works.de: Summer view along the seashore with a high cumulus sky. On the left, a stony beach, white wave foam at the water's edge, sea on the horizon. On the right, a high sandy bank, green turf above.

works.d: Ees pruunikate põldude vaheline tee veeloikude ja lumelaikudega selle ääres. Tagapool metsaveerg roosakaspruunide põõsastega tumeda kuusemetsa taustal. Puude kohal kollakas õhtukumas taevas.
works.de: In front, a road between brownish fields with puddles of water and patches of snow along it. Further back the edge of a forest with pinkish-brown bushes against the background of a dark spruce forest. Above the trees a yellowish evening glow in the sky.

works.d: Ülalt vaade metsaga piiratud lumisele lamedale nõlvale, millel punaste viilkatustega majade grupp. Vasakul õues kaks kuuske, õunapuud, jupike roigasaeda. Päikesest kirgas lumi kõikjal, külmsinised varjud nõgudes.
works.de: View from above of a snowy flat slope enclosed by forest, with a group of houses with red gabled roofs. On the left in the yard two spruces, apple trees, a piece of pole fence. Sun-bright snow everywhere, cold-blue shadows in the hollows.

works.d: Ees paremal väikesest müürinurgast osaliselt varjatud väljak. Vasakul müür mida katkestab taga keskel kõrgemale terrassile viiv trepp. Taga hooned. Üle hoonete näha ümartorni.
works.de: In front, on the right, a square partially hidden by a small corner of a wall. On the left a wall interrupted in the back centre by a staircase leading up to a higher terrace. Buildings behind. Above the buildings a round tower is visible.

works.d: Eest paremalt taha vasakule kaljude vahele voolav jõeke. Tagapool kaljuseid vastaskaldaid ühendav puust kaarjas sild suunaga vasakult paremalt. Üksikute inimfiguuridega sellel ja ees. Paremal vastakaldal üksikuid kuuski.
works.de: A stream flowing from front right to back left between cliffs. Further back, a wooden arched bridge connecting the rocky opposite banks, running from left to right. With individual human figures on it and in front. On the right bank a few solitary spruces.

works.d: Natüürmort torukübara, jalutuskepi, kinnaste ja valge salliga.
works.de: Still life with a top hat, a walking stick, gloves and a white scarf.

works.d: Õhuliste kardinate taustal istumas kaks heledas, napi ülaosaga volangidega kleidis noort naist. Vasakpoolne otsevaates, pea tõstetud, silmad suletud. Parempoolne külgvaates, pisut ette kallutatud ülakehaga, mõttesse vajunud ilmega tütarlaps. Helesinakad õrnad toonid, õhuline visandlik laad.
works.de: Against a background of airy curtains, two young women sit in light-coloured dresses with sparse, flounced upper parts. The one on the left is frontal, head raised, eyes closed. The one on the right is in profile, upper body leaning slightly forward, a girl with a pensive expression. Delicate light-blue tones, an airy, sketch-like style.

works.d: Värvikas kompositsioon dekoratiivsetest kujunditest põimituna nukulike naisekeha vormidega. Allosas keskel stiliseeritud torso otsevaates. Pildi keskel ruudukujulist pinda piiravad dekoratiivsed sektorid jm. Selgepiiriliselt eraldatud kujundid enamasti ruumiliselt kujutatud, valdavalt punased, pruunid ja türkiisi toonid.
works.de: A colourful composition interwoven with decorative figures and doll-like female body forms. At the bottom centre, a stylised torso seen frontally. In the middle of the picture, a square-shaped surface bordered by decorative sectors and the like. The clearly delineated figures are mostly rendered with volume, predominantly in red, brown and turquoise tones.

works.d: Madala laua ümber neli istuvat naist kanu kitkumas. Vasakpoolne naine seljaga, nägu profiilis, sinises põlles ja pearätis, teisel pool lauda kolm naist, keskmisel prillid, aknapoolsel heleroheline pluus.
works.de: Around a low table, four women sitting plucking hens. The woman on the left with her back turned, face in profile, in a blue apron and headscarf; on the other side of the table three women, the middle one with glasses, the one by the window in a light green blouse.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käed (osaliselt servaga lõigatud) hoiavad raamatut, seljas sinine kuun ja lillakas särk.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in frontal view, hands (partly cut off by the edge) holding a book, wearing a blue kuub coat and a purplish shirt.

works.d: Paadis neli mõrda tõmbavat kalurit, kelledest üks selgvaates.
works.de: Four fishermen pulling a fyke net in a boat, one of them seen frontally.

works.d: Lehtmets kahe valgetes õites puuga. Esiplaanil kullerkupud. Lillakas taevas suur kollane täiskuu.
works.de: Deciduous forest with two trees in white blossom. In the foreground marsh marigolds. Purplish sky with a large yellow full moon.

works.d: Talvise väikelinna vaatega aknal kaks lillepotti valgeõieliste amarüllistega, nende vahel väike pott kaktusega. Maalitud heledas, valkjassinises, pruunikas koloriidis.
works.de: Winter view of a small town through a window with two flowerpots of white-blossomed amaryllis, between them a small pot with a cactus. Painted in a light, whitish-blue, brownish colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi, tagapool kiravalt maalitud kõrgem kaldapealne suurte puude grupiga vasakul, mis peegeldub vette. Maalitud lühikese pintslilöögiga.
works.de: In the foreground water, behind it a colourfully painted higher riverbank with a group of large trees on the left, reflected in the water. Painted with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Lagedal lumisel maastikul tumeda taeva foonil kaks kaskede gruppi. Puude ladvaosad pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Värvigamma sinistes toonides.
works.de: In an open snowy landscape against a dark sky background, two groups of birches. The tops of the trees are cut off by the upper edge of the picture. Colour scheme in blue tones.

works.d: Keskosas, roheluse vahel roosakas-sinakas kääruline jõgi. Ülaosas, roosade pilvedega taevas helenduv päikeseketas. Maalitud pastoosselt, lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the central part, amid the greenery, a pinkish-bluish winding river. In the upper part, a glowing sun disc in a sky with pink clouds. Painted pastosely, with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Eresinisel foonil suur pruun vaas pruunikate lehtedega. Selle ümber kolm lillepotti punaste alpikannidega. Maalitud hoogsalt, laiemate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Against a bright blue background a large brown vase with brownish leaves. Around it three flowerpots with red columbines. Painted vigorously, with broader brushstrokes.

works.d: Liivasel rannal, vasakul kolm kõrget mändi. Puude vahelt paistab rohekas-halli taeva all madalas laines meri.
works.de: On a sandy beach, on the left three tall pines. Between the trees, under a greenish-grey sky, the sea is visible in low waves.

works.d: Rünkpilvise taeva all erksinine meri valgete purjekatega. Esiplaanil, vee piiril inimestegrupid, vasakul kõrged männid, päremal rohekad põõsatutid. Maalitud sinakaisrohelistes, beežides toonides.
Vasakul, kirevaleheliste puude vahelt paistab erksinine veepind ning looklev rannajoon. Maalitud tihedate, täppivate pintslilöökidega. Puutüvede kontuur kergelt rõhutatud.
works.de: At left, between colourful-leaved trees a bright blue water surface and a winding shoreline are visible. Painted with dense, dabbing brushstrokes. The contour of the tree trunks is slightly emphasized.

works.d: Värvikalt, roosades-rohelistes-helesinistes toonides täppivalt maalitud vaade sadamale mere poolt. Ranna ääres rida purjekaid, väiksemaid paate. Kaldal vasakul suurte puude taustal heledad majad. Maalitud pastoosselt.
works.de: Colourfully, in pink-green-light blue tones, painted in dots, a view of a harbour from the sea. Along the shore a row of sailboats, smaller boats. On the shore on the left light-coloured houses against a background of large trees. Painted pastosely.

works.d: Täppivate pintslilöökidega rohekas-hallikas koloriidis maalitud lage, veidi lainjas maastik. Esiplaanil kuus kadakat. Ülaservas kitsas helehall, kitsas taevaviirg.
works.de: A bare, slightly undulating landscape painted in a greenish-grey palette with precise brushstrokes. Six junipers in the foreground. A narrow pale grey strip of sky along the upper edge.

works.d: Täppivas laadis maalitud meremotiiv. Heledate pilvede all türkiissinine kolmnurk merest, paremal oranžikate, beežide kõrkjatega rand.
Valkjassinistes toonides maalitud vaade lumiste okstega metsaalusele. Keskosas väike lagendik siniste varjudega. Maalitud pastoosselt lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Painted in whitish-blue tones, a view of a forest floor with snowy branches. In the middle, a small clearing with blue shadows. Painted pastosely with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Säravates - oranžid, punased, rohelised, sinised, valkjad - värvides maastikupilt. Paremas servas kaks puud. Silmapiirijoonel õrnroosakas viirg.
works.de: A landscape in radiant - orange, red, green, blue, whitish - colours. Two trees at the right edge. A pale pink streak on the horizon line.

works.d: Erksinise, roosade pilvedega taeva all rannamotiiv. Keskosas, luidete vahel kolm kõrgemat puud. Esiplaanil ja vasakul vesi. Maalitud kirevalt, täppivas laadis.
works.de: Beach motif under a bright blue sky with pink clouds. In the middle part, among the dunes, three taller trees. In the foreground and on the left, water. Painted colourfully, in a dotted manner.

works.d: Kollakaspruunides toonides, impressionistlikus valguse- ja värvimängus antud metsatukk. Esiplaanil kollastes lehtedes kaskede grupp, keskplaanis vasakul ja paremal samasugused puudegrupid.

Panoraamne küngasmaastik: esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal kaks punaste katustega valget maja, keskplaanis kolm samasugust hoonet. Esiplaanilt suundub tee pildi sügavusse. Majade vahel, küngastel, metsatukad. Ülal tume hallikassinine taevas. Maalitud värvipindadega pisut vorme toonitades.
works.de: Panoramic hilly landscape: in the foreground on the left and right two white houses with red roofs, in the middle ground three similar buildings. From the foreground a road leads into the depth of the picture. Between the houses, on the hills, clumps of forest. Above, a dark greyish-blue sky. Painted with colour surfaces, forms slightly emphasised with shading.

works.d: Kollakasroosades toonides, kõrgele pildi serva tõstetud silmapiiriga maastik: esiplaanilt keskelt suundub pildi sügavusse väike oja, mille kaldal esiplaanil laugjad, tagaplaanis järsumat kallakut moodustavad. Esiplaanil vasakul, aga ka tagapool silmapiiril ookerkollaste puude grupid. Maalitud hajusate pintslilöökidega, kontuure igati ähmastada püüdes.
works.de: A landscape in yellowish-pink tones, with the horizon raised high toward the edge of the picture: from the centre foreground a small brook runs into the depth of the picture, its banks gentle in the foreground and forming a steeper slope in the background. On the left in the foreground, as well as further back on the horizon, groups of ochre-yellow trees. Painted with diffuse brushstrokes, striving throughout to blur the contours.

works.d: Vaade hoovi. Keskel punase katusega majad. Vasakul ja paremal heledad seinad, neist vasakpoolse küljes latern.
works.de: View of a courtyard. In the middle houses with red roofs. On the left and right pale walls, with a lantern on the left-hand one.

works.d: Laiade ekspressiivsete pintslilöökidega maalitud abstraktne kompositsioon. Allosas rohekaspruun varjundirikas pind, millesse tungib paremalt hele kolmnurk ja üksikud mustad-valged pintslitõmbed. Ülemine maaliosa heledas gammas, tumedamad risti-rästi jooned läbi kumamas.
works.de: An abstract composition painted with broad expressive brushstrokes. In the lower part a greenish-brown surface rich in nuance, into which a light triangle intrudes from the right along with isolated black-and-white brushstrokes. The upper part of the painting in a light range, with darker criss-crossing lines shining through.

works.d: Ruudukujulistel, erivärvilistel alustel, ajalehtedest välja lõigatud ja riidele kleebitud kujundid siluettidena: 1. Kollasel foonil, keskel, vertikaalselt nool, teravikuga ülesse.
works.de: On square bases of various colours, shapes cut out of newspapers and glued onto fabric as silhouettes: 1. On a yellow background, in the centre, a vertical arrow, point upwards.

works.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise põlcportree, käed vaheliti rinnal. Tumeda kleidi kaelus ja varrukad kitsa valge pitsääristusega. Sõrmeküüned punased.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young dark-haired woman, hands crossed on her chest. The collar and sleeves of the dark dress trimmed with narrow white lace. Fingernails red.

works.d: Ees paremal näha suure kuuse tüvi ja alumine osa oksastikust vasakul vana kase tüve osa.
works.de: In front on the right the trunk of a large spruce and the lower part of its branches; on the left part of the trunk of an old birch.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik pikkade madalate koertega. Taga hallikas-sinised mäed.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing with long low dogs. Behind, grayish-blue mountains.

works.d: Suured lillad kivid rohekas-sinise taeva taustal.
works.de: Large purple stones against a greenish-blue sky background.

works.d: Lopsakate pastoossete pintslilöökidega maalitud väike maastik. Esiplaanil keskel pildi sügavusse suunduv väike jõgi. Silmapiiril tuhedalt üksteise kõrval pruunide katustega majad, rohelised puukroonid katuste kohal. Ülal  lillakashall, üksikute pilvekiududega taevas.
works.de: A small landscape painted with lush pastose brushstrokes. In the foreground in the center, a small river receding into the depth of the picture. On the horizon, brown-roofed houses standing close together, green treetops above the roofs. Above, a purplish-grey sky with a few wisps of cloud.

works.d: Laual pruun savivaas eredavärviliste lilledega. Vaasi kõrval grupp rohelisi seenekesi. Fooniks roosakas tapeet ja rohekas kardin.
works.de: On the table a brown clay vase with brightly coloured flowers. Beside the vase a group of green mushrooms. Background of pinkish wallpaper and a greenish curtain.

works.d: Laual suur punane vaas valgete ja kollaste krüsanteemidega. Raamat ja õunad. Vasakul aknast vaade linnale.
works.de: On the table a large red vase with white and yellow chrysanthemums. A book and apples. On the left, a view of the city through the window.

works.d: Ees künka harjal kännustik seenelistega. Paremalt alla vasakule suunduva teega. Horisondil mäed.
works.de: In front, on the crest of a hill, a cluster of tree stumps with mushroom pickers. With a path leading from the right down to the left. Mountains on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil taraga ümbritsetud muruplats üksikute vanade puudega, millede vahelt paistab mansartkorrusega ja kõrge eestrepiga suvila. Maja viilul pärjastatud nimi ja daatum: LYBERTY 1798. Vasemal majake, mille kõrvalt näha tükike merd Tallinna siluetiga. Taga paremal pargipuud.
works.de: In the foreground, a fenced lawn with a few old trees, between which a summer house with a mansard storey and a tall front staircase can be seen. On the gable of the house, a wreathed name and date: LYBERTY 1798. On the left, a small house, beside which a piece of sea with the silhouette of Tallinn is visible. In the background on the right, park trees.

works.dm: kõrgus: 47.5 cm (maal "Matuselised" mõõdud); laius: 47.5 cm; kõrgus: 60.0 cm (maal "Sirelid" mõõdud); laius: 60.0 cm
works.d: Pruunil poleeritud ja ümbritsevat oma pinnal peegeldaval laual sinine ümar vaas suure lillade sireliokste kimbuga. Foon rohekaskollane. Maalitud kergete säpsivate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a brown polished table reflecting its surroundings on its surface, a blue round vase with a large bunch of lilac lilac branches. The background yellowish-green. Painted with light, brisk brushstrokes.

works.d: Lapse rinnapilt otsevaates, vasak õlg ettepoole pööratud, peal kerge kallak paremale.
works.de: Chest portrait of a child in frontal view, left shoulder turned forward, head slightly tilted to the right.

works.d: Vaade Pikale tänavale. Kollaka ja pruunikas-oranži viilkatusega maja fassaadid. Nende ees tänaval inimesi ja kass.
works.de: View of Pikk Street. Facades of houses with yellowish and brownish-orange gable roofs. In front of them, on the street, people and a cat.

works.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur - en face. Peas valge, rüüžidega tanu. Käed vaheliti rüpes.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman, en face. On her head a white bonnet with ruffles. Hands crossed in her lap.

works.d: Majade taustal, lagedal platsil, monument. Taga paremal jõgi purjekaga. Platsil grupp inimesi. Monumendil tekst: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814
works.de: Against a background of houses, on an open square, a monument. Behind, on the right, a river with a sailboat. A group of people on the square. Text on the monument: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814

works.d: Ees keskel veekogu. Vasakul, kergelt kõrgenev kallas põõsastiku ja puude reaga. Kaugemal väike osmik. Keskel ja paremal viljapõllud koristajatega. Taamal, horisondil, üksik tuuleveski.
works.de: In the front centre a body of water. On the left, a slightly rising bank with a row of bushes and trees. Further away a small hut. In the centre and on the right grain fields with harvesters. In the distance, on the horizon, a solitary windmill.

works.d: Esiplaanil müüriäärsel rohuplatsil kaks figuuri koeraga, tagapool tõusval maapinnal puud ja punaste kivikatustega majad ning keskaegne ümmarik kindlustorn, kaugemal kerkib Oleviste kiiver.
works.de: In the foreground on a grassy plot by the wall two figures with a dog, further back on rising ground trees and houses with red tile roofs and a medieval round fortification tower, further away the spire of Oleviste rises.

works.d: Ees ja vasakul kivine, lage rand haokubu kandva vanamehe ja väikese lapsega. Taamal, silmapiiril, vastaskaldal linnavaade.
works.de: In the front and on the left a stony, bare shore with an old man carrying a bundle of brushwood and a small child. In the distance, on the horizon, a townscape on the opposite bank.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane rand, kaks kaldale tõmmatud paati ja paremal paljajalu paatide suunas sammuv mehefiguur, kandam seljas; taga avameri.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy shore, two boats pulled up onto the shore, and on the right a barefoot male figure walking towards the boats, a burden on his back; behind, the open sea.

works.d: Ees keskel vahuste laineharjade vahel purjelaeva vrakk. Vasemal läbi laintevahu näha sadamamuul. Teos lõuni viimata
works.de: In the centre foreground, a wreck of a sailing ship among foaming wave crests. On the left, a harbour mole visible through the foam of the waves. The work is unfinished

works.d: Vasakul rannaliival suuri kive. Paremal, merel, üksik purjekas. 2/3 tööst pilvise, loojuva päikesega taeva all.
works.de: On the left large stones on the beach sand. On the right, at sea, a lone sailboat. 2/3 of the work a cloudy sky with a setting sun.

works.d: Kolme väikese tüdruku poolfiguurid grupina istumas. Parempoolsel süles pikakarvaline koer.
works.de: Half-figures of three small girls sitting as a group. On the right one's lap a long-haired dog.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal jõekallas puude, paadi ja figuuridega, keskel jõgi kaluritega, taga mäed ja loss, loojuva päikese valguses.
works.de: In the foreground left a riverbank with trees, a boat and figures, in the middle a river with fishermen, behind mountains and a castle, in the light of the setting sun.

works.d: Lillelise vaiba ja roosa seina foonil istuva, hallis riietuses vana mehe kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an old man dressed in grey, seen frontally, against a background of a floral carpet and a pink wall.

works.d: Kasukas ning sõdurimütsis mehe poolfiguur, vasak käsi risti üle kõhu.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in a fur coat and soldier's cap, left hand crossed over the stomach.

works.d: Esiplaanil töökitlis ja valges särgis mees pintsli ja paletiga käes. Lühikesed sirged juuksed liibuvad vastu pead, sirge nina, prillid. mehest vasakul laual liivakell, selja taga aken, millest paistab kirikutornide ja katustega Tallinna vanalinn. Maalitud pastelsetes roosades, sinistes ja hallides toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a man in a work smock and white shirt, holding a brush and palette. Short straight hair combed close to the head, straight nose, glasses. To the man's left on a table an hourglass, behind him a window through which the Tallinn Old Town with its church towers and roofs can be seen. Painted in pastel pink, blue and grey tones.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Istuva mehe lühikesed juuksed on hallid, seljas kollakaspruun pintsak ja erksinine särk, käed põlvel ristatud, vasakus käes kaks pintslit. Foon sinine, vasakust servast rohelistes toonides.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the left. The seated man's short hair is grey, he wears a yellowish-brown jacket and a bright blue shirt, his hands crossed on his knee, two brushes in his left hand. The background is blue, in greenish tones from the left edge.

works.d: Sinistes ja lillakaspunastes toonides ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinnale Niguliste kiriku kiivrita torniga paremal. Ülal tume pilvine taevas.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of Tallinn's Old Town in blue and purplish-red tones, with the spireless tower of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) on the right. Above, a dark cloudy sky.

works.d: Kõrgest vaatepunktist antud rannamaastik, kus esiplaanil liivariba üksiku põõsapuhmaga keskel ning taamal tumesinine meri. Ülal sinakasrohelistes ja kollastes toonides taevas. Maaliline, pintslilöök lopsakas ja selgesti eristatav.
works.de: A coastal landscape given from a high viewpoint, with a strip of sand with a single bush in the middle of the foreground and the dark blue sea further away. Above, sky in bluish-green and yellow tones. Painterly, the brushstroke lush and clearly distinguishable.

works.d: Esiplaanil, paralleelselt alumise servaga jõgi, mille ääres, vert. keskjoonest pisut vasakul punakaspruun, veevaadi ette rakendatud hobune. Hobuse ja vaadi juures valges pluusis naine jõest vett ammutamas ja sonis mees vett vaati valamas. Hobuse juurest viib kitsas liivane tee mäkke, mäel teest paremal elektripost, vasakul suured rohelised puud ja põõsad. Jõe ääres, teel, heledapäine naine, temast paremal kolm jões sulistavat last. Mäe otsas, silmapiiril keskel, kaks valget torni või korstent, vasakul serval puudetukk. Ülal helesinine, kiudpilvedega taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, parallel to the lower edge, a river, by which, slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, a reddish-brown horse harnessed to a water barrel stands. By the horse and the barrel a woman in a white blouse draws water from the river, and a man in a cap pours water into the barrel. From the horse a narrow sandy path leads up the hill; on the hill, to the right of the path, an electricity pole, to the left large green trees and bushes. By the river, on the path, a fair-haired woman, to her right three children splashing in the river. At the top of the hill, in the centre of the horizon, two white towers or chimneys, on the left edge a clump of trees. Above, a light blue sky with cirrus clouds.

works.d: Tinahallides toonides merevaade kahe väikese paadiga paremal serva ees ja hulga suuremate kalapaatidega (purjepaatidega) keskplaanis. Silmapiiril tumehall viirg. Ülal helehallide pilvedega kaetud kahvatusinine taevas.
works.de: In tin-grey tones a sea view with two small boats at the front edge on the right and a number of larger fishing boats (sailboats) in the middle ground. On the horizon a dark grey streak. Above, a pale blue sky covered with light grey clouds.

works.d: Väikestest põimuvatest ja üksteist katvatest värvilaikudest (sinised, kollakad ja punased toonid) koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: An abstract composition consisting of small interweaving and overlapping patches of colour (blue, yellowish and red tones).

works.t: Kunstnikud, J. Pulitzeri preemia laureaat Edmund Valtman ja Juhan Hennuste Metropolitan Muuseumis 1988. a
works.d: Hämaras interjööris Vana-Egiptuse vaaraoskulptuuride ees kaks keskealist meest seismas-vestlemas. Näitusesaalis vasakul kaks istuvas asendis vaaraofiguuri poolkülgvaates paremale. Nende kohal, taustast joonistub välja kolme skulptuuri pead. Skulptuuride ees paremal kahe prillidega mehe kolmveerandfiguurid:vasakpoolne külgvaates, süvenenult vaatlemas skulptuure, käed püksitaskus, tema kõrval veidi lühem habemik mees pöördunud vaataja poole, žestiks tõstnud vasaku käe. Rohekashallid, ookertoonid, markeeriv laad.
works.de: In a dim interior, in front of Ancient Egyptian pharaoh sculptures, two middle-aged men standing and conversing. In the exhibition hall on the left two seated pharaoh figures in semi-profile facing right. Above them, against the background, the heads of three sculptures stand out. In front of the sculptures on the right, three-quarter figures of two bespectacled men: the left one in profile, engrossed in observing the sculptures, hands in trouser pockets, beside him a slightly shorter bearded man turned towards the viewer, raising his left hand in a gesture. Greenish-grey, ochre tones, sketchy style.

works.d: Sajandialguse perekonnapilti meenutav maal, maja ees pingil istuv ja fotograafile poseeriv pere. Vasakul pereisa tumedas ülikonnas, hoiab põlvedel lamedat ovaalset eset, tema kõrval suurem poiss, kelle ees pikkade heledate juustega laps väikesel pingil, madruseülikond seljas, poisi kõrval pereema, valges kleidis beebi süles, ema kõrval seisab madruseülikonnas väike poiss, vasak käsi mänguhobusel. Taustal vasakul, valge majaseina ääres punakad tellised, virn torusid, lillepõõsas ja hulk mitmesuguseid keraamilisi nõusid. Maali ülemisel poolel kujutatud vaadet maakohale, kus kaks talumaja kahe kõrge korstnaga valge hoone vahel. Valdavalt kahvaturohelised toonid.
works.de: A painting reminiscent of a family portrait from the turn of the century, depicting a family sitting on a bench in front of a house, posing for the photographer. On the left the father of the family in a dark suit, holding a flat oval object on his knees, next to him a larger boy, in front of whom a long fair-haired child sits on a small bench, wearing a sailor suit; next to the boy the mother of the family, in a white dress, with a baby in her lap; next to the mother stands a small boy in a sailor suit, his left hand on a toy horse. In the background on the left, along the white wall of the house, reddish bricks, a pile of pipes, a flowering bush and a number of various ceramic vessels. The upper half of the painting depicts a view of a rural area, with two farmhouses between a white building with two tall chimneys. Predominantly pale green tones.

works.d: Ees rida õitsevaid tulpe. Vasakult nurgast diagonaalselt paremale suunduv tee üksikute roheliste põõsastaimedega servadel. Teest vasakul ja paremal peenramaa. Taga paremal väike helesiniseks võõbatud hoone üksikute suurte puudega, vasakul roheline madal puuhoone. Taga keskel kollane hoone. Lilla taevas.
works.de: In front, a row of blooming tulips. A path leading diagonally from the left corner to the right, with individual green shrubby plants at its edges. To the left and right of the path, a flower bed. Behind, on the right, a small building painted light blue with individual large trees, on the left a green low wooden building. In the middle at the back, a yellow building. Purple sky.

works.d: Ees paekivipõrand, paremal akna all nurgas puukapp. Ülal rida portreid. Keskel trepp balustraadiga vasakul. Vasakul seljaga vastu trepi käsipuud kapp, selle juures tool ja pikas kleidis naise figuur.
works.de: In front, a limestone floor, on the right under the window in the corner a wooden cabinet. Above, a row of portraits. In the middle a staircase with a balustrade on the left. On the left, with its back to the staircase handrail, a cabinet, next to it a chair and the figure of a woman in a long dress.

works.d: Vaipadega kaetud põrandaga toa nurk: ees paremal ümmargune laud. Samas seinas kahe tooli vahel raamaturiiul, sellel lilli, kell ja keraamikat. Nurgas kapp. Seinal maalid.
works.de: A corner of a room with a carpeted floor: in front, on the right, a round table. On the same wall, between two chairs, a bookshelf with flowers, a clock and ceramics on it. A cupboard in the corner. Paintings on the wall.

works.d: Kirjul kattel asuvas tumedas kõrvaga kruusis kirevad (heledais punastes, kollastes, lillades toonides) lilled. Kõrval vasakul pokaal. Värv kohati väga pastoosne.
works.de: On a mottled saucer, in a dark jug with a handle, colourful flowers (in light red, yellow, lilac tones). To the left, a goblet. The paint is in places very pastose.

works.d: Tallinna vaade "Paksu Margarite" juures, esiplaanil end. Rosengarteni küngas, taga linnamajad Paksu Margareta ja Bremeni torniga, keskel Oleviste kirik.
works.de: A view of Tallinn near "Paks Margareeta", in the foreground the former Rosengarten hill, behind city buildings with Paks Margareeta and the Bremen Tower, in the middle St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Eest taha suunduva jõe künklikel kallastel vasakul: üksikuid hooneid, mägede taustal, paremal asula kirikuhoonega. Keset jõge neem kindluse müüride ja torniga. Taevas pilvistatud.
works.de: On the hilly banks of a river receding from front to back, on the left: individual buildings, against a background of mountains, on the right a settlement with a church building. In the middle of the river a headland with fortress walls and a tower. The sky is clouded.

works.d: Rohke rüüžiga äärestatud tanus keskealise naise poolfiguur peaaegu en face. Taga vasakul ja paremal stiliseeritud kuused.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman almost en face, in a bonnet trimmed with abundant ruching. Behind, on the left and right, stylised spruces.

works.d: Lumme mattunud surnuaia vaade: esiplaanil vasakul kaks lumist risti ja raagus puud. Paremal servas, sepisaiaga piiratud hauaplatsil üks suurem rist. Madalat silmapiiri jumestab loojuva päikese puna. Ülalpool taevas hall.
works.de: A view of a snow-covered cemetery: in the foreground on the left two snowy crosses and bare trees. On the right edge, on a grave plot enclosed by a wrought-iron fence, one larger cross. The low horizon is tinged with the red of the setting sun. Above, the sky is grey.

works.d: Ees, pargis, fontääni kõrval jalutav neiu ja noormees. Taustaks suured lehtpuud.
works.de: In front, in a park, beside a fountain, a strolling girl and young man. Large deciduous trees in the background.

works.d: Ees paremal kõrge kaljurahn. Keskel ja vasakul rohtunud maa-ala hiigelsuure kiviga vasakpoolses osas. Taga kaljuahelik.
works.de: In front on the right a tall rocky crag. In the middle and on the left a grassy area with a huge stone in its left part. Behind, a mountain range.

works.d: Vasakul esiplaanil kolm tugevat mändi - lillakashallis toonis tagaplaanis päikesest valgustatud mets paremal ees valguslaikudega teerada.
works.de: On the left in the foreground three sturdy pine trees - in the background a sunlit forest in lilac-grey tones, on the right in front a forest path with patches of light.

works.d: Eest taha paremale suunduv ja tõusev teekurv ääristatud kivimüüriga. Üle vasakpoolse müüri näha kellatorni. Taamal kõrged mäed.
works.de: A road curve, walled with stone, running from front to back and rising to the right. Over the wall on the left a bell tower is visible. High mountains in the distance.

works.d: Paremal kivihoone sein uksega, millest tagapool eendub väljaehitus. Vasakul plank, millest üle ulatuvad õitsevad sireli puhmad. Risti üle õue nöör kuivava pesuga. Pisut eespool, keset õue korv pesuga.
works.de: On the right a stone building's wall with a door, behind which an extension projects. On the left a fence, over which blooming lilac bushes reach. A line with drying laundry stretched across the yard. A little further forward, in the middle of the yard, a basket with laundry.

works.d: Ees keskel pruun rohtu sööv lammas. Fooniks põõsastik.
works.de: In the front center, a brown sheep grazing. Bushes in the background.

works.d: Molberti ees istuva keskealise, tumedajuukselise habemiku mehe põlvpilt, veerandprofiilis paremale. Vasakus käes palett ja pintsleid, parem pintsliga värvi segamas.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged, dark-haired bearded man sitting in front of an easel, in quarter-profile to the right. A palette and brushes in his left hand, the right hand mixing paint with a brush.

works.d: Eest paremalt nurgast taha, keskel läbi teivasaia värava suunduv, rohumaasse tallatud teerada. Keskel, paremal, aia ääres kaks suurt puud.
works.de: In front, from the right corner, a footpath trodden into the grass leads towards the back through a gate in a pole fence in the centre. In the centre, on the right, by the fence, two large trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane küngas kolme suurema männiga selle keskel. Taga männik.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy hill with three large pines in its middle. Behind, a pine forest.

works.d: Interjööris laua ümber istuv perekond isa, ema ja kolm tütart. Taga seinal tumedajuukselise noormehe portree istuvas asendis.
works.de: In the interior a family sitting around a table: father, mother and three daughters. On the wall behind, a portrait of a dark-haired young man in a sitting position.

works.d: Keskel kahe suure puu all istumas grupp inimesi. Vasakul naine rehaga üle õla sammumas grupi poole, pisut kaugemal naine riisumas. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the middle, under two large trees, a group of people sitting. On the left a woman walking with a rake over her shoulder towards the group, a little further away a woman raking. On the horizon a forest.

works.d: Kuus ukraina rahvarõivais last esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes profiilis paremale istuva, karusnahkse mütsiga ja pikka pruuni mantlisse riietatud jutustava ja žestikuleeriva meje ümber. Tema ees, kompositsiooni paremal poolel, istuvad kaks tumesinisesse riietatud tütarlast, nende selja taga seisavad vitstest punutud aiale toetuv valges pluusis vanem, ja kompositsiooni paremas servas väravapostile nõjatuv pika patsiga noorem tütarlaps. Jutustaja vasakul käel kaks poissi pruunides poolpikkades kuubedes, karusnahksetes mütsides. Nende taga avaneb jõemaastik.
works.de: Six children in Ukrainian folk costume in the foreground, on the left in golden section, around a narrator gesturing while seated in profile facing right, wearing a fur cap and a long brown coat. In front of him, on the right side of the composition, sit two girls dressed in dark blue, behind them stand an elder in a white blouse leaning on a wicker fence, and at the right edge of the composition a younger girl with a long braid leaning against a gatepost. To the narrator's left hand are two boys in brown half-length coats and fur caps. Behind them a river landscape opens up.

works.d: Esiplaanil nõlvaku all lehtpuude keskel kahe hoone katused. Tagapool laiad lagedad aasad. Taamal üle vee mets ja hoonete grupp. Maastik kujundatud ovaali.
works.de: In the foreground, under a slope, amid deciduous trees, the roofs of two buildings. Further back, broad open meadows. In the distance, across the water, a forest and a group of buildings. The landscape is composed in an oval.

works.t: Tehase "Võit" vormija stahhaanovlase sm. Ivanovi portree
works.d: Noorema mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasemale. Hoiab käes hammasratast.
works.de: Half-figure of a younger man, slightly turned to the left. Holding a gear wheel in his hand.

works.d: Tütarlaps otsevaates toolil, rohelise lehestiku taustal istumas. Süles avatud raamat. Sinisekirju kleit, kaks patsi roosa paelaga.
works.de: A girl in frontal view sitting on a chair, against a background of green foliage. An open book in her lap. A blue-patterned dress, two braids with a pink ribbon.

works.d: Lõuendi parempoolses osas valge kitli ja mütsikesega noore naise istuv poolfiguur. Vasakul hele ümmargune arstimite lauake pudelite ja riistadega. Üldkoloriit hele.
works.de: In the right-hand part of the canvas, a seated half-figure of a young woman in a white smock and cap. On the left a light round medicine table with bottles and instruments. The overall colouring light.

works.d: Perspektiivselt pildi sügavusse suunduv avar tehase interjöör üldvaates. Paremal põlev ahi, vasakul mitmesugused seadmed, millede juures mitmed töölisfiguurid.
works.de: Perspectival view of a spacious factory interior receding into the depth of the picture, in a general view. On the right a burning furnace, on the left various installations, with several worker figures near them.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm kraanat, mõned laevad ja paadid. Nende taga heledates toonides virvendav vesi laevadega. Silmapiiril sinetavad mäed. Taevas sinine valgete pilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground three cranes, some ships and boats. Behind them shimmering water in light tones with ships. On the horizon bluish mountains. The sky blue with white clouds.

works.d: Istuva vanema mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Paljas lagipea, prillid, tume ülikond, helesinine särk musta lipsuga. Vasak käsi toetatud laual. Taga vasakul raamaturiiul. Foon tumedates toonides.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated older man in profile to the left. Bald crown, glasses, dark suit, light blue shirt with black tie. Left hand resting on the table. Behind on the left a bookshelf. Background in dark tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil lõkke kohale riputatud teekann. Paremal vanamees kõrvikmütsis, vasakul kaks naist, kelledest parempoolsel süles laps. Kujutatavad kuuluvad mongoloidsesse rassi. Foon tume.
works.de: In the foreground a teakettle hung above a campfire. On the right an old man in a fur cap, on the left two women, one of whom has a child in her lap. The figures belong to the Mongoloid race. Background dark.

works.d: Prillidega mehe istuv põlvportree, parem käsi toetub põlvele, vasak on lõua juurde viidud, ilme mõtlik. Fooniks teatriafišš.
works.de: Sitting knee-length portrait of a bespectacled man, right hand resting on the knee, left brought up to the chin, pensive expression. Background a theatre poster.

works.d: Keskealise tüseda mehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Parem käsi toetub vaadile, vasak hoiab põlletraksidest. Foon heleroheline.
works.de: Half-figure of a stout middle-aged man in frontal view. Right hand resting on the easel, left hand holding his apron straps. Light green background.

works.d: Sinise draperii taustal lillakas-valge krüsanteem pruunis potis.
works.de: Against a blue drapery background a purplish-white chrysanthemum in a brown pot.

works.d: Voodil istuva roosakas triibulises pidžaamas poisikese täisfiguur. Foon rohekas.
works.de: Full figure of a boy sitting on a bed, in pinkish striped pyjamas. Greenish background.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides maastik: esiplaanil pisut künklik maapind pooleldi raagus põõsaste ja puudega tuule käes. Keskplaanis kahvatusinine meri, mis ülal läheb üle kollaseks, valkjas-siniste, kohati pastoosselt antud pilvedega taevaks.
works.de: Landscape in gray and brown tones: in the foreground somewhat hilly ground with half-bare bushes and trees in the wind. In the middle ground a pale blue sea, which above turns into a yellow, whitish-blue sky with clouds rendered at places impasto.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel setu rahvarõivais (sõba ja suure rinnasõlega) vana naine, kass süles, istumas. Naisest vasakul esiplaanil tormilatern, 5 lehmakella ja nöörile aetud kalad. Naisest paremal kimp lillasid ja valgeid lilli. Taamal lattidest aiad, karjamaad ja taluhooned puudega vaheldumisi. Ülal roosakashall taevas.
works.de: In the centre foreground an old woman in Setu folk costume (with a sõba shawl and a large breast brooch), a cat in her lap, sitting. To the left of the woman in the foreground a storm lantern, 5 cowbells and fish strung on a string. To the right of the woman a bunch of purple and white flowers. Beyond, fences of poles, pastures and farm buildings alternating with trees. Above, a pinkish-grey sky.

works.d: Suvine vaade merele. Alumine pool maalipinnast kujutab rohtu kasvanud, liivalaikudega randa. Vee piiril kive, kõrkjaid. Kitsal rohekal mereosal valged lainevahu triibud. Õrn kollakassinine taevas silmapiiri kohal kaetud pilvedega. Maalitud hoogsalt, suure üldistusega.
works.de: Summer view of the sea. The lower half of the painting depicts a grassy shore with patches of sand. Stones and rushes at the water's edge. On the narrow greenish sea area, white streaks of wave foam. A delicate yellowish-blue sky above the horizon covered with clouds. Painted vigorously, with great generalisation.

works.d: Tihedalt hallide ja pruunide pintslilöökidega läbitöötatud abstraktne kompositsioon, millest kirkaina eralduvad üksikud kollased ja punased laigud.
works.de: A densely worked abstract composition of grey and brown brushstrokes, from which individual yellow and red patches vividly stand out.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille foon on diagonaalis jaotatud kaheks: vasakult foon valge, paremalt hall. Üle töö pinna värvilised erikujulised pintslilöögid, kohati väga pastoossed.
works.de: Abstract composition, the background of which is divided diagonally in two: from the left the background is white, from the right grey. Over the surface of the work coloured brushstrokes of various shapes, in places very impasto.

works.d: Kollastest, rohelistest, pruunidest ja sinistest suurtest värvipindadest koosnev peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuv kompositsioon, millesse tumedate joontega on vaevu aimatavalt joonistatud profiilis pea ja ülakeha.
