works.de: On the left a dense pine forest, in the centre a ditch buried in snow. On the right sparsely spaced tall pines, between them in the background houses.

works.d: Võlvikäigust avanev vaade kitsale õuele väikeste hoonetega kahel pool. Hallid, roosad toonid.
works.de: View opening from a vaulted passage onto a narrow courtyard with small buildings on both sides. Grey, pink tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil kividega ja rauatükkidega pommidest lõhestatud maapind. Eemal suurte ja väiksemate hoonete varemete vahel 3 väikest tervemat hoonet. Keskosas suure beeži kivimaja varemed. Üldkoloriit sinkjas-hall.
works.de: In the foreground, ground torn apart by bombs with stones and pieces of iron. In the distance, among the ruins of larger and smaller buildings, 3 small intact buildings. In the middle section, the ruins of a large beige stone house. Overall colour scheme bluish-grey.

works.d: Ülaltvaade kitsale tänavale. Ees paremal majakatus ja osa seina kahe aknaga. Vasakul müür, mille taga paistavad puud ja majad. Taga kuni silmapiirini kaugenevad hooned ja katused.
works.de: A top view of a narrow street. In front on the right a roof and part of a wall with two windows. On the left a wall, behind which trees and houses are visible. Behind, buildings and roofs receding into the distance to the horizon.

works.d: Valgete katustega ja üksikute valgustatud akendega majad. Paremal televisioonimast, taamal ähmased majade siluetid.
works.de: Houses with white roofs and a few lit windows. On the right a television mast, in the background blurred silhouettes of houses.

works.d: Maastik kõrgete hallide tehasehoonetega heleda taeva taustal.
works.de: A landscape with tall grey factory buildings against a light sky.

works.d: Vaade Pirita jõele Jahtklubi juurest. Esiplaanil jõgi purjekatega, keskel hooneid ja puid.
works.de: View of the Pirita River from the Yacht Club. In the foreground the river with sailboats, in the middle buildings and trees.

works.d: Toomkiriku esine väljak pärnadega, millede kroonid pildi ülaservaga läbi lõigatud, puudest tumedad varjud roosatoonilisel väljakul. Toomkirikust näha vaid nurgake. Taga Kreutzwaldi nim. Raamatukogu heleroheline hoone.
works.de: The square in front of the Cathedral (Toomkirik) with lime trees, whose crowns are cut off by the upper edge of the picture, dark shadows from the trees on the pinkish-toned square. Of the Cathedral only a corner is visible. Behind it the light green building of the Kreutzwald Library.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine, üksikute väikeste kadakapõõsastega maapind, tagapool nõlvakul tornikiivrita punase katusega kirik, mida piiravad puud-põõsad, vasakult paistab vana talumaja katus. Sinises taevas, mis võtab enese alla 2/3 maali pinnast, kergeid heledaid pilvesagaraid. Koloriidilt hele. Kullatud raam.
works.de: In the foreground, stony ground with a few small juniper bushes, behind on a slope a church with a red roof and no tower spire, surrounded by trees and bushes, on the left the roof of an old farmhouse is visible. In the blue sky, which takes up 2/3 of the painting's surface, light bright cloud wisps. Light in colour scheme. Gilded frame.

works.d: Ülaltvaade järvede ja metsatukkadega kuplilisele maastikule. Esiplaanil punakad põllud, vasakul ja paremal kääruliste kallastega järved. Tagapool keskel poolenisti metsaga kaetud ümar mägi, selle taga paistmas majad. Silmapiir kõrgel. Maal sinakas-hallikasrohelises koloriidis.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of a hilly landscape with lakes and clumps of forest. In the foreground, reddish fields, lakes with winding shores on the left and right. Further back in the middle, a round mountain half-covered with forest, with houses visible behind it. The horizon is high. The painting is in a bluish-greyish-green colouring.

works.d: Tumedates hallides ja pruunides toonides keskealise naise portree: naine antud istuvana, kuni põlvini, otsevaates, käed teineteise peal süles. Naisel seljas hall, tagasipööratud käistega kleit, kaelas valge rätik, ees valge põll. Naise heledasti valgustatud laubalt on juuksed üle pea taha kammitud. Foon tume.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged woman in dark grey and brown tones: the woman is shown seated, to the knees, in frontal view, hands folded one over the other in her lap. The woman wears a grey dress with turned-back cuffs, a white kerchief at the neck, a white apron in front. The hair on the woman's brightly lit forehead is combed back over the head. The background is dark.

works.d: Pargivaade tagapool olevate majadega. Esiplaanil raagus puude tumedad tüved, varjud langevad maapinnale. Puude taga kraavi kaldal erksavärvilised majad, kuurid õrnsinise taeva all.
works.de: View of a park with houses behind. In the foreground the dark trunks of bare trees, shadows falling on the ground. Behind the trees, on the bank of a ditch, brightly coloured houses, sheds under a pale blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagedal palgihunnikud. Tagapool rannaäärne puudesaluga, heleda katusega maja puude vahel. Vasakul puude vahelt paistab veekogu. Kõrge taevas.
works.de: In the foreground on open ground, piles of logs. Beyond, a coastal grove with a house with a light-coloured roof among the trees. On the left a body of water is visible through the trees. High sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud kärbseseened. Paremal suure kännu ümber suurem seente pesakond. Taamal puutüved.
works.de: Individual fly agaric mushrooms in the foreground. A larger cluster of mushrooms around a large stump on the right. Tree trunks in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud hauakünkal suur raudrist BEHREND von MAIDELLi nimega. Tagapool puude vahel näha üksikuid riste.
works.de: In the foreground a large iron cross with the name BEHREND von MAIDELL on a grassy grave mound. Behind, individual crosses visible among the trees.

works.d: Keskplaanil kolm puud, nendest keskmine ja parempoolne raagus. Vasakpoolne lehtes. Keskmise puu taga suitseva korstnaga hoone, parempoolse puu taga viilkatusega hoone. Puudest vasakul jõgi. Jõel üksik lootsik. Jõe vasakpoolsel kaldal üksik lehispuu. Taevas loojuva päikese kumaga.
works.de: In the middle plane three trees, of which the middle and right ones are bare. The left one is leafy. Behind the middle tree a building with a smoking chimney, behind the right tree a building with a gabled roof. To the left of the trees a river. A single boat on the river. On the left bank of the river a single larch tree. The sky glows with the setting sun.

works.d: Осенняя Выставка "Товарищ. художников"
works.de: Осенняя Выставка "Товарищ. художников"

works.dm: kõrgus: 96.5 cm; kujutise laius: 135.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 90.0 cm; laius: 140.0 cm
works.d: Kõrge tumeda, ehapunas silmapiiriga taeva all vasakul lumiste katustega tukkuv rannaküla. Keskel, rannajoonel pragunenul jääl paate ja paati kaldale tõmbav mees. Paremal tinahall meri. Realistlikult, elava pintsliga maalitud.
works.de: Under a high dark sky red with sunset glow on the horizon, on the left a drowsy coastal village with snowy roofs. In the centre, on the shoreline on cracked ice, boats and a man pulling a boat to shore. On the right a tin-grey sea. Painted realistically, with a lively brush.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea otsevaates. Peas lai must barett. Sinine avatud kaelusega särk ja lambanahast vest.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man in a direct view. On his head a wide black beret. A blue open-collared shirt and a sheepskin waistcoat.

works.d: Esiplaanil akna all laual tume vaas lilledega. Lauale pudenenud üksikuid suuri punaseid õisi.
works.de: In the foreground under the window on the table a dark vase with flowers. Individual large red blossoms scattered on the table.

works.d: Laua ümber istub viis inimest. Nendest laua paremas otsas istuv mees kõnelemas, vasakus poisike põlvedega taburetil. Seinal Stalinit kujutav plakat.
works.de: Five people sit around a table. Of these, the man sitting at the right end of the table is speaking, and on the left a boy sits on a stool with his knees drawn up. On the wall a poster depicting Stalin.

works.t: Kalinin Tallinna vedurite ja vagunite remonditehases
works.d: Seltsimees Kalinin, prillidega, nooremas eas, "ИСКРА" vasakus käes, tööstusruumis tööpingi taga, ümbritsetud teda kuulavatest kaastöötajatest, kellest kolm istuvad esiplaanil. Nendest paremal pildi serval üksik seisev tööline. Taamal tööstusruumis kaksa vastassuunas liikuvat töölist,  kellest üks paljaihuga selgvaates, teine särgiväel üle õla köitpidi midagi tirimas. Esiplaanis vasakul tööpingi ees tööriistadega laud. Vasakpoolses seinas inimgruppide tagant paistab aken.
works.de: Comrade Kalinin, wearing glasses, at a younger age, with "ИСКРА" in his left hand, in an industrial room behind a workbench, surrounded by co-workers listening to him, three of whom are sitting in the foreground. To the right of them, at the edge of the picture, a lone standing worker. Further back in the industrial room, two workers moving in opposite directions, one of them bare-bodied seen clearly, the other in his shirt pulling something with a rope over his shoulder. In the foreground on the left, a table with tools in front of the workbench. In the left wall, behind the groups of people, a window can be seen.

works.d: Mehe kolmveerand figuur seisvas asendis, kerges pöördes paremale. Valges kitlis, käed seljataga. All paremal näha kirjutuslaua nurk.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man in a standing position, in a slight turn to the right. In a white coat, hands behind his back. In the lower right the corner of a writing desk can be seen.

works.d: Mereväelase poolfiguur, seisvas asendis poolpöördes vasakule. Seljas munder, ilma mütsita. Kokkupandud käed süles. Taga vasakul laeva mudel. Tume foon.
works.de: Half-figure of a naval officer, standing in a half-turned position to the left. Wearing a uniform, without a cap. Hands folded in his lap. Behind on the left a model ship. Dark background.

works.d: Tallinna Toomkiriku põhjapoolse külglöövi vaade ida suunas. Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal pingistiku nurgad, vasakpoolsel seinal ja tagaseinas lippude rivi.
works.de: View of the north side aisle of Tallinn Cathedral towards the east. In the foreground on the left and right the corners of the pew rows, on the left wall and back wall a row of flags.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kirev vaas, keskel taburett, tool ja madal laud mitmesuguste tarbeesemetega. Tooli taga molbert pooleli teosega. Tagaseinas kõrge raamaturiiul, seinal pilte ja vaip.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a colourful vase, in the centre a stool, a chair and a low table with various household objects. Behind the chair an easel with an unfinished work. On the back wall a tall bookshelf, on the wall pictures and a rug.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur en face; terav lõuahabe, avatud särgikaelus, paremas käes ajaleht "Kommunist", vasemas piip. Temast vasemal istuv mees (sekretär) poolprofiilis (peaaegu selgvaates) kirjutamisvalmis.
works.de: Half-figure of a man en face; sharp goatee, open shirt collar, newspaper "Kommunist" in his right hand, pipe in his left. To his left a seated man (secretary) in half-profile (almost full view) ready to write.

works.d: Laua taga seisva mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasakule, hallide juuste, pügatud vurrude ja väikse lõuahabemega enface näoga, vasak käsi püksitaskus, parem hoiab kuuerevääri rinna kohal; vasakul esiplaanil Lenini büst, paremal raamatud.
works.de: Half-figure of a man standing at a table, slightly turned to the left, with grey hair, trimmed moustache and small chin beard, face en face, left hand in trouser pocket, right hand holding the coat lapel at chest level; on the left in the foreground a bust of Lenin, on the right books.

works.d: Esialal vasakul lahesopp, mida paremalt ja tagant piirab madal rand. Lahesopis ankrus rida ühe- ja kahemastilisi purjekaid-kaljaseid; enamik allalastud purjedega. Paremal kaldale veetuna üks kahemastiline kaljas ja paate. Nende ees kaks meest väikese aerupaadi juures. Keskel vabal veepinnal üksik sõudja.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a bay, bordered on the right and behind by a low shore. In the bay a row of one- and two-masted sailing boats-galliots at anchor; most with sails lowered. On the right a two-masted galliot and boats pulled up onto the shore. In front of them two men by a small rowing boat. In the middle, on the open water, a solitary rower.

works.d: Keskealise naise täisfiguur istumas terastorust painutatud toolil 3/4 pöördes paremale. Nägu otsevaates. Tooli ees molbert. Naise seljas must pihikkleit ja beež pluus. Joonistusvahend paremas käes.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged woman sitting on a bent steel-tube chair, turned 3/4 to the right. Face shown frontally. An easel in front of the chair. The woman is wearing a black pinafore dress and a beige blouse. A drawing implement in her right hand.

works.d: Paremas nurgas leentool, sellest vasemal kirjutuslaud, millel lebavad paremal pool tuhatoos piibuga, raamat ja telefoniaparaat; vasakul pool vaas pintslitega, statuett, pudelikene ja sinise draperii peal palett. Draperii ulatub maani. Aknalaual laevamudel. Laua taga näha raadioaparaat, millel seisab küünlajalg. Selle taga raamatukapp, millel seisab gloobus. Vasakul seinal ripuvad kaks kullaraamis maali, millest ülemine kujutab seltsimees Lenini portreed; alumisel kunstniku autoportree.
works.de: In the right corner an armchair, to the left of it a writing desk, on which lie, on the right side, an ashtray with a pipe, a book and a telephone apparatus; on the left side a vase with brushes, a statuette, a small bottle and a palette on a blue drapery. The drapery reaches to the floor. On the windowsill a ship model. Behind the desk a radio apparatus is visible, on which stands a candlestick. Behind that a bookcase, on which stands a globe. On the left wall hang two gilt-framed paintings, of which the upper depicts a portrait of comrade Lenin; the lower one the artist's self-portrait.

works.d: Keskel rohelise linaga laua taga paremal seisab Viktor Kingisepp toetudes vasaku käega lauale, lahtise valge kraega. Ta parem käsi on ettesirutatud sama laua vastasäärel asuva kirjutusmasina suunas. Vasakul istub näpitsprillidega, triibulise salliga mees, kes paremas käes hoiab valget paberit. Temast vasakul, laua vasakul otsal istub vanamees profiilis prillidega. Ta vasak käsi, milles sonimüts, lebab laual, teine käsi paremal põlvel. Kingisepa vastassuunas selgvaates tütarlaps sinises pluusis kirjutamas masinal. Laua paremal otsal oleva tooli leeni najale toetub mõlema küünarnukiga valge kraega mees, kellel paremas käes valge paber. Samal toolil lebavad portfell ja mantel, millel kaabu. Esi
works.de: In the middle, behind a table with a green cloth, Viktor Kingisepp stands on the right, leaning with his left hand on the table, with an open white collar. His right hand is stretched out toward a typewriter located at the opposite end of the same table. On the left sits a man with pince-nez glasses and a striped scarf, holding a white sheet of paper in his right hand. To his left, at the left end of the table, an old man in profile, wearing glasses, is seated. His left hand, holding a fur cap, rests on the table, the other hand on his right knee. Opposite Kingisepp, in full view, a girl in a blue blouse is typing. Leaning with both elbows on the back of a chair at the right end of the table is a man with a white collar, holding a white sheet of paper in his right hand. On the same chair lie a briefcase and a coat, with a hat on it. In the fore

works.d: Esiplaanil hoov vanalinnas kahe sirelipõõsaga, mille vahel nööridel kirjupesu kuivamas. Sirelipõõsast paremal madal ühekordne kivimaja, selle juures puust kuur. Kaugemal kahekordne katuseta kõrge telliskivi korstnaga maja sarikatega. Vasakul vana-aegse punase kõrgekatuselise maja ees kuurid ja hütid. Päikesepaiste.
works.de: In the foreground a courtyard in the old town with two lilac bushes, between which colourful laundry is drying on lines. To the right of the lilac bush a low single-storey stone house, next to it a wooden shed. Further away a two-storey roofless building with a tall brick chimney and rafters. On the left, in front of an old-fashioned red house with a high roof, sheds and huts. Sunshine.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal - paberil kalad, nuga, väike juustupakk. Vasakul - piip ja tuhatoos. Sinisel linal juusturatas, selle kõrval piimakann, klaas ja konservikarp.
works.de: In the foreground on the right - fish, a knife, a small package of cheese on paper. On the left - a pipe and an ashtray. On a blue cloth, a wheel of cheese, next to it a milk jug, a glass and a tin can.

works.d: Ees paremal valgel paberil viis roosades ja sinistes toonides kala. Vasakul pisut kaugemal suur roheline pudel. Selle ees taldrik lillkapsastega. Paremal taga kõrvits, millest tükk välja lõigatud ja suur arbuus. Foon sinine, vasakus nurgas ja ülaäärel tumelilla.
works.de: In front, on the right, on white paper, five fish in pink and blue tones. On the left, a little further away, a large green bottle. In front of it a plate with cauliflowers. On the right, further back, a pumpkin with a piece cut out, and a large watermelon. The background is blue, dark purple in the left corner and along the upper edge.

works.d: Kogu pildi pinnal ülalt alla tihedalt üksteise kõrval kujutatud demonstrantide rivi: esiplaanil valges pluusis ja pikas punakas sallis noor helepäine naine, käed rusikas, suu avatud; tema kõrval sinises ülikonnas mees samas poosis; nende taga vanem mees kaabus, noormehed, kaks punast lippu hoidvat meest; taga heledates rätikutes naisi ja mehi.
works.de: Over the entire surface of the picture, from top to bottom, a row of demonstrators is depicted tightly side by side: in the foreground a young fair-haired woman in a white blouse and a long reddish scarf, hands clenched into fists, mouth open; beside her a man in a blue suit in the same pose; behind them an older man in a hat, young men, two men holding red flags; behind them women and men in light-coloured headscarves.

works.d: Nurk kunstniku ateljeest akna all: ees kirjutuslaud, toolil kirju hommikumantel, aknalaual vaasides pintsleid, vasakul kapikesel lühter, laest ripub laevamudel. Paremal pilte, molbert.
works.de: A corner of the artist's studio by the window: in front a writing desk, on the chair a colourful dressing gown, on the windowsill vases with brushes, on the left on a small cabinet a chandelier, from the ceiling hangs a ship model. On the right pictures, an easel.

works.d: Noore, heledapäise tugitoolis istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur tumesinisel foonil. Keha poolpöördes vasakule, pea en face, seljas hall seelik ja helesinine pluus.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a young, fair-haired woman sitting in an armchair against a dark blue background. Body in half-turn to the left, head en face, wearing a grey skirt and a light blue blouse.

works.d: Tugitoolis istuva heledanahalise naise täisfiguur, parem käsi nõjatab pead, vasak toolitoel. Tumesinisel foonil roheline kostüüm, valge krae, punane džemper, tool lillakas.
works.de: Full figure of a fair-skinned woman sitting in an armchair, her right hand supporting her head, her left on the armrest. Green costume against a dark blue background, white collar, red jumper, purplish armchair.

works.d: Tumeda kaabu ja prillidega mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates punasel foonil.
works.de: Bust of a man with a dark hat and glasses in frontal view on a red background.

works.d: Suvehommikune inimtühi tänavaristmik. Esi- ja keskplaanil perpendikulaarselt kulgevasse tänavasse suubuv klassitsistlike hoonetega ääristatud kitsas tänavalõpp. Esiplaanil vasakul kahekorruseline kitsas maja ärkliga, selle kõrval keskplaanil nurgamaja: kõrge järsu katusega kolekordne hoone varahommikusest päikesest valgustatud ülakorrusega. Paremal kolmekorruselised majad, neist üks balkoniga. Tagaplaanil Toompea nõlv ookerkollaste, kõrgete katustega ja korstnatega päikesest valgustatud hoonetega.Tagaplaanil all künka jalamil, lehtpuudemass sellest esilekerkiva punase majakatusega. Tumedam erksinine taevas.
works.de: A people-free early summer street crossing. In the foreground and middle ground, a narrow street end lined with classicist buildings leading into a street running perpendicular. In the foreground on the left, a narrow two-storey house with an oriel window; next to it in the middle ground, a corner house: a tall, steep-roofed three-storey building with its upper floor lit by the early morning sun. On the right, three-storey houses, one of them with a balcony. In the background, the slope of Toompea with ochre-yellow, tall-roofed and chimneyed buildings lit by the sun. In the background below, at the foot of the hill, a mass of deciduous trees with a red house roof rising above it. A darker bright blue sky.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale, pilk otse vaatajale suunatud. Mehel hallid juuksed ja lühikesed vurrud, seljas roheline kuub. Näo ja kaela paremale poolele langeb valgus. Foon tumedates toonides. Maalitud pikkade lopsakte pinstlilöökidega.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man in a half-turn to the right, gaze directed straight at the viewer. The man has grey hair and short moustaches, wearing a green coat. Light falls on the right side of his face and neck. Background in dark tones. Painted with long, lush brushstrokes.

works.d: Hallides puhvpükstes ja mürkrohelises pluusis noor mees istumas vöödilise tekiga kaetud toolil. Mehel rõõsk jume, pügatud vurrud ja šatäänid, pisut taandunud piiriga juuksed. Mehe parem küünarnukk toetub tooli seljatoele. Figuurist paremal laud värvituubide ja lahustipudelitega, läikival metallkandikul väike valge vaas märtsikellukestega ja tumerohelisest klaasist veinipudel. Foon rohekashall.
works.de: A young man in grey puffed trousers and a poison-green blouse sitting on a chair covered with a striped blanket. The man has a ruddy complexion, trimmed moustache and side-whiskers, hair with a slightly receded hairline. The man's right elbow rests on the back of the chair. To the right of the figure a table with paint tubes and solvent bottles, on a shiny metal tray a small white vase with snowdrops and a wine bottle of dark green glass. Background greenish-grey.

works.d: Sinistes toonides geomeetrilistest kujunditest taustal paremalt keskmest vasakule mõlemasse nurka koonduv hall sõrestik-konstruktsioon. Paremal keskmes must-valgega kujutatud pundar noori inimesi. Üle pinna musti ja valgeid pritsmeid.
works.de: Against a background of geometric shapes in blue tones, a grey trellis-like construction converging from the right centre towards both corners on the left. In the right centre a cluster of young people depicted in black and white. Black and white splashes across the surface.

works.d: Nikerdatud selja- ja käetugedega punasest puust toolis istub profiilis, jalad välja sirutatud, vanem mees. Mehe vasak käsi toetub käsipuule, vasakus käes raamat, sõrm järge hoidmas. Parem käsi on küünarnukist kõverdatud ja toetab pead. Mehe pealagi paljas, külgedel lühikesed, tugevasti hallisegused juuksed, ninal kuldsete sangadega prillid. Mehel seljas must ülikond ja kingad, valge särk ja punaste triipudega hall lips. Fooniks tumehallide seintega toanurk. Seinal vasakul ripub maastikupilt, paremal ülanurgas on näha neljandik seinal rippuvast pildist.
works.de: An elderly man sits in profile in a red wooden chair with carved back and armrests, legs stretched out. The man's left hand rests on the armrest, in his left hand a book, a finger keeping the place. His right arm is bent at the elbow and supports his head. The man's crown is bald, with short, heavily greying hair at the sides, and gold-rimmed glasses on his nose. The man wears a black suit and shoes, a white shirt and a grey tie with red stripes. The background is a room corner with dark grey walls. On the wall to the left hangs a landscape picture, in the upper right corner a quarter of a picture hanging on the wall is visible.

works.d: Keskjoonest vasakul ümar mitmekorruseline kaaristuga hoone, mida ülal kroonib väljasirutatud tiibadega kotkas. Hoonest paremal madalam ja väiksem ümar torn. Esiplaanil roheline vesi, hele kaldarinnatis ja kaartega sild.
works.de: To the left of the centre line a round multi-storey arcaded building, crowned above by an eagle with outstretched wings. To the right of the building a lower and smaller round tower. In the foreground green water, a light-coloured bank parapet and an arched bridge.

works.d: Keskplaanis nelinurkse põhiplaani, barokse (rohelise kiivriga) kupli ja nurgatornidega kirik. Esiplaanil jõgi, uhkete laternapostidega kaarsild. Taevas helesinine.
works.de: In the middle ground, a church with a square ground plan, a baroque dome (with a green helmet) and corner towers. In the foreground, a river, an arched bridge with splendid lamp posts. Sky pale blue.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides linnavaade: esiplaanil paremal ažuursete käsipuudega väike sild üle sinise veega väikese kanali, tagaplaanis kuplite ja tornidega ehitised.
works.de: A cityscape in pastel tones: in the foreground on the right a small bridge with openwork handrails over a small canal with blue water, in the background buildings with domes and towers.

works.d: Tumesinisel laual esiplaanil valge lina, mille taga vasakul tumelilla potsakas keraamiline nõu ja kolm granaatõuna. Tagaplaanil tumeroosa piklik, kaanega pott. Foon ülal mustjaspruun.
works.de: On a dark blue table in the foreground a white cloth, behind which on the left a dark purple squat ceramic vessel and three pomegranates. In the background a dark pink elongated pot with a lid. The background above is blackish-brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks kõhukat tumerohelist veinipudelit, parempoolne korvis. Tagapool kõrgemal alusel suur kaanega korv, kirsipunane draperii langeb pudelile, purk mahlaga ja sangadega vaskne kauss, erkkollasel taustal. Hoogne maalilaad.
works.de: In the foreground, two bulbous, dark green wine bottles, the right one in a basket. Behind, on a higher stand, a large basket with a lid, cherry-red drapery falling onto a bottle, a jar with juice and a copper bowl with handles, against a bright yellow background. Vigorous painting style.

works.d: Vaade Tallinna vanalinna (Tolli) tänavale. Kitsaste, punaste viilkatustega majade tagant paistab väike osas Oleviste kiriku tornist. Majade varjud langevad sõiduteele. Paremal, paistamas ristuva Laia tänava päikesest valgustatud heledad hooned.
works.de: View of (Tolli) Street in Tallinn's Old Town. Behind the narrow, red gable-roofed houses a small part of the tower of St Olaf's Church (Oleviste) is visible. The shadows of the houses fall onto the roadway. On the right, the sun-lit bright buildings of the intersecting Lai Street are visible.

works.t: Kristuse sündimine. Eskiis Kaarli kiriku altarimaalile
works.d: Iisaku kiriku altarimaali kavand, ees keskel Madonna Kristuslapsega ja rätikut hoidev Joosep, ümber karjused, taga vasakul hoone nurk.
works.de: Sketch for the altarpiece of Iisaku Church, in the centre foreground the Madonna with the Christ Child and Joseph holding a cloth, shepherds around, the corner of a building at the back left.

works.d: Erkroosas seelikus tütarlaps unelevas poosis nõjatumas aknalauale. Taustal heleda täiskuuga koobaltsinine öötaevas.
works.de: A girl in a bright pink skirt in a dreamy pose, leaning on a windowsill. In the background a cobalt-blue night sky with a bright full moon.

works.d: Portreteeritu kujutatud ateljees töökitlis. Figuur on energiliselt ettepoole kallutunud, käed toetuvad lauale, paremas pintsel. Näo profiil joonistub teravalt heledale foonile. Seinal pilte, vasakpoolne Okase "Vaen".
works.de: The sitter is depicted in the studio wearing a work smock. The figure is energetically leaning forward, hands resting on the table, a brush in the right hand. The profile of the face stands out sharply against the light background. Pictures on the wall, on the left Ott's "Vaen".

works.d: Esiplaanil pildi sügavusse suunduv tänav; kahelpool madalad majad. Tänaval kaks inimfiguuri ja koer.
works.de: In the foreground a street receding into the depth of the picture; on both sides low houses. On the street two human figures and a dog.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 36.8 cm; kujutise laius: 41.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 33.7 cm; lehe laius: 46.0 cm
works.d: Diagonaalselt paigutatud rohelise-neoonroosatriibuline ovaalne optiline kujund.
works.de: Diagonally placed oval optical figure with green and neon-pink stripes.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 47.0 cm; kujutise laius: 36.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 42.5 cm; lehe laius: 40.0 cm
works.d: Optiline kompositsioon: üksteise all  8-sse ritta korrapäraselt paigutatud 7 tumedat, lilla kaldtriibuga ruutu. Alumise rea eelviimane kroomrohelist värvi ruut poolviltu rivis. Ruutude
works.de: Optical composition: 7 dark squares with a purple diagonal stripe, arranged regularly in 8 rows one below the other. In the bottom row, the second-to-last square, coloured chrome green, stands slightly askew in the row. The squares

works.d: Vurrude ja lühikese punase habemega mehe rinnapilt. Pea poolprofiilis vasakule, juukselahk vasakul pool, seljas must, eestlahtine kuub ja must vest. Kõrge kaelaside, valge rinnaesine.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man with a moustache and a short red beard. Head in half-profile to the left, hair parted on the left, wearing a black coat with an open front and a black waistcoat. High cravat, white shirt front.

works.d: Väikeses klaasvaasis kimp kirevais värves aia- ja põllulilli.
works.de: A bunch of brightly coloured garden and field flowers in a small glass vase.

works.d: Mere kaldal paremal kõrge kivirist, selle vastu toetub noor naine punases pihikus ja triibulises seelikus. Naise kõrval paremal väike tüdruk, paremal istuv koer. Vasakul vaade lainetavale merele, mille kohal lendlemas kajakaid.
works.de: On the shore of the sea, on the right a tall stone cross, against which a young woman in a red bodice and striped skirt leans. Beside the woman on the right a little girl, on the right a sitting dog. On the left a view of the undulating sea, above which gulls are flying.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal tugitool linnuga käsipuul. Vasemal gloobus, kaste. Kõrval kapinurk, millel mitmesuguseid esemeid (kann, kolp). Tumedal seinal suur punase paelaga seotud bukett.
works.de: In the foreground on the right an armchair with a bird on the armrest. On the left a globe, a box. Beside it the corner of a cabinet with various objects on it (a jug, a skull). On the dark wall a large bouquet tied with a red ribbon.

works.d: Poolpikkade tumedate juustega noore naise rindportree poolpöördes vasakule rohelise puudesalu taustal. Vasakul paar lilleherne õit. Detailitäpne kujutamisviis.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with dark, half-length hair, in a half-turn to the left, against the background of a green grove. On the left a pair of sweet pea flowers. Precisely detailed manner of depiction.

works.d: Lumiste puude vahel rehielamu päikselise talveilmaga. Taluhoonete vahel teel naine valge põllega. Realistlik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A threshing barn dwelling among snowy trees in sunny winter weather. On the path between the farm buildings a woman in a white apron. Realistic manner of depiction.

works.d: Tumeda juukselise vurrudega vanema mehe rinnapilt täisprofiilis paremale. Seljas triibuline särk ja vest.
works.de: Bust portrait in full profile facing right of an older man with dark hair and a moustache. Wearing a striped shirt and vest.

works.d: Neli stiliseeritud relvastatud ratsanikku, taustaks kuldne foon värviliste sõõridega.
works.de: Four stylised armed horsemen, against a golden background with coloured circles.

works.d: Vanema naise rinnafiguur rohelises kleidis, käes sinised lilled. Taamal veekogu ja stiliseeritud maastik. Paremal alumises nurgas hundinuiad.
works.de: Bust of an elderly woman in a green dress, holding blue flowers. In the distance a body of water and a stylised landscape. In the lower right corner, cattails.

works.d: Pruunikas silindrikujulises vaasis kanarbikukimp. Foon beežikas.
works.de: A bunch of heather in a brownish cylindrical vase. Beige background.

works.d: Heledas silindrikujulises vaasis kimp väikeste heleroheliste õitega taimi. Foon roheline.
works.de: In a light-coloured cylindrical vase a bunch of small light green flowering plants. Background green.

works.d: Sinises vaasis lilled karuohakad. Foon pruunika, sinise ja punase triibuline.
works.de: Flowers, thistles, in a blue vase. Background striped in brownish, blue and red.

works.d: Pruunis vaasis kimp sinililli, paigutatud vöödilisele alusele.
works.de: In a brown vase a bouquet of blue anemones, placed on a striped base.

works.d: Helesinistes toonides geomeetrilistest kujunditest taustal vasakul keskmest paremasse üla- ja alanurka suunduvad teravatipulised hallid sõrestik-konstruktsioonid. Vasakul keskel must-valge puntrana kujutatud kaks lapsefiguuri. Üle maalipinna musti ja valgeid pritsmeid.
works.de: Against a background of light-blue geometric shapes, grey pointed lattice-like constructions extend from the centre-left towards the upper and lower right corners. In the middle left, two child figures depicted as a black-and-white tangle. Black and white splashes across the surface of the painting.

works.d: Mäekuplite vahel kääruline sünkhall veekogu, mille vahel sügisvärvides puudega poolsaar. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
works.de: A winding, dark grey body of water between hill domes, with a peninsula with trees in autumn colours between them. Expressive manner of depiction.

works.d: Öine suurlinna vaade trammitee käänakuga. Tuled ja tulikirjad ümberringi, ees mustjad inimsiluetid. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
works.de: Night view of a big city with a tram line curve. Lights and neon signs all around, dark human silhouettes in front. Expressive manner of depiction.

works.d: Otsevaade rongiga raudteesillale üle linnatänava. Ees lumine tee, silla taga heledad majaplokid. Ekspressiivne laad.
works.de: Frontal view of a railway bridge with a train over a city street. A snowy road in front, light-coloured blocks of houses beyond the bridge. Expressionist style.

works.d: Noore tütarlapse rinnapilt: õlad külgvaates, pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Lahtsitel juustel turbanitaoliselt seotud rätik.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young girl: shoulders in side view, head in three-quarter profile to the left. A kerchief tied turban-like over loose hair.

works.d: Diagonaalselt üle pildi kaugusse suunduv sõudepaaditaoline konveier, hallid figuurid paarikaupa aerude asemel pintsleid hoidmas ja vikerkaarevärvi maalitahvleid võõpamas. Ees paremal kaks rohelist koonilistes kübarates, sõudjate-maalijate vahel üks piitsaga järelvaataja. Metafüüsiline must ruum sõrestikaknaga laes.
works.de: A conveyor resembling a rowboat running diagonally across the picture into the distance, grey figures in pairs holding brushes instead of oars and painting rainbow-coloured painting panels. In front on the right two figures in green conical hats, among the rowers-painters an overseer with a whip. A metaphysical black space with a lattice window in the ceiling.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 9.6 cm; kujutise laius: 10.2 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 6.8 cm; lehe laius: 11.1 cm
works.d: Voodis lamav särgi väel naisfiguur.
works.de: A female figure in a shirt lying in bed.

works.dm: lehe laius: 20.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.0 cm
works.d: Noore naise alasti põlvfiguur, kerge pöördega paremale. Pea profiilis. Käed seljal.
Lõuend ilma alusraamita ja kortsunud. Murdekohtade ümber värv varisenud. Määrdunud.
works.de: Canvas without a stretcher and creased. Paint has flaked around the fold marks. Soiled.

works.d: Sammastega interjööris, astmestikul, jüngritest ümbritsetud Kristus, vasemas käes karikas. Tagaplaanil avaneb vaade maastikule. Eskiis Peterburi Iisaku katedraali teostatavale maalingule.
works.de: In a columned interior, on a set of steps, Christ surrounded by disciples, a chalice in his left hand. In the background a view opens onto a landscape. Sketch for a mural to be executed for St. Isaac's Cathedral in St. Petersburg.

works.d: Kavand Peterburi Lunastaja kirikule maalitavale maalile. Kaljuse maastiku taustal ees keskel ristilt võetud Kristus, kelle juures kaks leinalises ilmes naist ja neli meest.
works.de: Sketch for a painting to be painted for the Church of the Saviour on Blood in Petersburg. Against the background of a rocky landscape, in the centre foreground Christ taken down from the cross, with two women with grieving expressions and four men beside him.

works.d: a) Lillakaspunaste ja roosade ruutudega suurel, narmastega rätil pruun, ülalt ahenev ja avause kohal jälle laienev kann. Selle ees kaks kollast sidrunit, kaks apelsini, sibul, kaks kurki, üks tomat. Esiplaanil viinamarjad ja poolik sidrun. Foon lillakashall.
works.de: a) On a large fringed cloth with purplish-red and pink squares, a brown jug narrowing at the top and widening again above the opening. In front of it two yellow lemons, two oranges, an onion, two cucumbers, one tomato. In the foreground grapes and a half lemon. Background purplish-grey.

works.d: Vee piiril suurte puude grupp hallina taeva taustal
works.de: At the water's edge a group of large trees against a grey sky.

works.d: Rohelise metsa foonil sihvakad valged kasetüved
works.de: Slender white birch trunks against a green forest background

works.d: Tormine mererand öösel. Tuules kaardunud kuused kõrgel kaldal, murtud puu
works.de: Stormy seashore at night. Wind-bent spruces on a high bank, a broken tree

works.dm: lehe laius: 37.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 22.3 cm
works.d: Ees poollumine lagendik. Taga paremal asula. Horisondil loojuva päikese kuma.
works.de: In front a half-snowy clearing. Behind on the right a settlement. On the horizon the glow of the setting sun.

works.d: Vasakul kuust valgustatud jõgi. Kaugemal üksik sõudja. Paremal madalal kaldal üksikute jändrikute puude vahel madal taluhoone.
works.de: On the left a moonlit river. In the distance a lone rower. On the right on a low bank, among a few gnarled trees, a low farmhouse.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud kased ristlevate teeradade ääres. Eemal vasemal üksik hoone, pearemal mets lattaiaga. Kauguses ebamäärane figuur.
works.de: In the foreground isolated birches beside crossing paths. In the distance on the left a single building, on the right a forest with a plank fence. A vague figure in the distance.

works.d: Vasakul jõekaldal asetsev väike palkehitis, mille kohal kalda veerel seisev mehefiguur punases särgis, õngeritv käes. Käänuna paremale suunduva jõe vasakul kaldal rida madalaid taluhooneid puusalu ja pilvedega taeva taustal.
works.de: On the left riverbank a small log building, above which, standing at the water's edge, a male figure in a red shirt, a fishing rod in hand. On the left bank of the river, which curves to the right, a row of low farm buildings against a background of a birch grove and clouded sky.

works.dm: lehe laius: 26.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 60.5 cm
works.d: Eest paremalt taha vasakule suunduva tee parempoolses servas üksikud raagus lehtpuud ja okaspuud. Taga vasakul näha talumaja lumistunud katust.
works.de: On the right edge of a road leading from front right to back left, individual bare deciduous trees and conifers. In the background on the left, the snow-covered roof of a farmhouse is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagedal veteväljal lootsik võrku asetava mehega ja sõudjaga. Tagapool vasaku kalda ääres vaiadele ehitatud maja signaliseerimisseadisega katusel. Maja ees teine lootsik sõudjatega. Paremal, kuni silmapiirini laiuval veteväljal üksik purjekas kauguses liuglemas. Keskel majast paremal kauguses näha veidi metsa. Taevas loojuva päikese punas.
works.de: In the foreground, on an open expanse of water, a small boat with a man setting a net and an oarsman. Further back, by the left bank, a house built on piles with a signalling device on the roof. In front of the house another small boat with oarsmen. On the right, on the water's expanse stretching to the horizon, a lone sailboat gliding in the distance. In the middle, a little forest is visible to the right of the house, in the distance. The sky is red with the setting sun.

works.d: Ees madalate mättaliste kallaste vahel taha paremale suunduv jõgi kalamehega parempoolsel kaldal. Taga paremal okaspuumetsaga kaetud järsunõlvaline mägi, vasakul puisniit.
works.de: In front, between low tussocky banks, a river running back to the right, with a fisherman on the right-hand bank. Behind at right a steep-sloped mountain covered with coniferous forest, at left a wooded meadow.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi paadiga ja üksikud puutüved, taamal mets onniga. Metsa vahelt, pildi keskel, langeb loojunud päikese punakat valgust.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a boat and single tree trunks, in the distance a forest with a hut. Through the trees, in the centre of the picture, falls the reddish light of the setting sun.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine raagus puu ja paat; vasemal jäätunud jõgi; paremal lummeuppunud majakesed ja kasesalu. Taamalt jõe kohalt langeb maastikule loojuva päikese  punakas helk.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy leafless tree and a boat; on the left a frozen river; on the right small houses sunk in snowdrifts and a birch grove. From above the river a reddish glow of the setting sun falls on the landscape.

works.d: Keskel tee, teel üksik naise figuur selgvaates; vasemal raagus puude vahelt paistab maja. Maapinnal kolletunud puulehti.
works.de: In the middle of the road, a solitary female figure in profile view; on the left a house is visible among bare trees. Yellowed leaves on the ground.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjatega läbikasvanud veekogu. Taga vasemal madal rohumaa üksikute puudega; paremal madala taluhoone ja lehtpuudega.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water overgrown with sedge. Behind on the left low grassland with solitary trees; on the right a low farm building and deciduous trees.

works.dm: lehe laius: 13.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 9.0 cm
works.d: Ees paremal, järsul kaldal lumine metsatukk. All (vasakul) orus jõgi. Taamal kõrge vastaskallas puudega.
works.de: In front on the right, a snowy patch of forest on a steep bank. Below (on the left) a river in the valley. In the distance a high opposite bank with trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil osa laeva laest, üksiku, kuust valgustatud merd vaatava naise figuuriga reelingu ääres.
works.de: In the foreground part of a ship's ceiling, with the figure of a lonely woman lit by the moon, looking at the sea by the railing.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel veekogu (jõgi), mida vasakult ja paremalt piiravad kaldad. Vasakul kaldal üksikud madalad pajud, paremal õlgkatusega maja ja lehtpuude salu. Veel lootsik üksiku inimkoguga. Taustaks ehapunas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a body of water (a river) bordered on the left and right by banks. On the left bank isolated low willows, on the right a straw-roofed house and a grove of deciduous trees. Also a boat with a lone group of people. Background of a sky glowing red at sunset.

works.dm: lehe laius: 8.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 14.0 cm
works.d: Eest taha suunduv tee, kollaseks tõmbunud kaskedega vasemal ja paremal. Vasemal puude vahel väike maja.
works.de: A road running from front to back, with birches turned yellow on the left and right. On the left, among the trees, a small house.

works.d: Ees, eest taha suunduva jõe kaldal (vasemal), üksik kuivanud raagus puu; pisut tagapool paat. Kaugemal väikene maja. Paremal oleval kaldal salkkond puid. Üle maastiku öine poolpilves taevas.
works.de: In front, on the bank of a river running from front to back (on the left), a lone withered leafless tree; a little further back a boat. Further away a small house. On the right bank a group of trees. Over the landscape a night sky, partly cloudy.

works.dm: lehe laius: 14.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 9.0 cm
works.d: Paremal veekogu väikese saarekesega. Vasakul kaldal poolraagus puu, paat ja tagapool lehtpuude all väike maja suitseva korstnaga.

works.dm: lehe laius: 25.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 35.4 cm
works.d: Eest kerges kaares vasakule taha suunduv tee. Teed palistab kolletav kasemets.
works.de: In front, a road curving slightly to the left leading into the background. The road is lined by a yellowing birch forest.

works.d: Eest taha suunduv oja. Kahel pool pooleldi lumistunud kaldail suured raagus puud.
works.de: A stream running from the front backwards. On both sides half-snow-covered banks with large bare trees.

works.dm: lehe laius: 50.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.4 cm
works.d: Ees paremal kooguga kaev. Kaevu kõrval küna juures kükitav naine. Tagapool paremal taluhoone roigasaiaga. Taamal, vasakul hooneid.
works.de: In front on the right a well with a sweep. Beside the well a woman crouching by a trough. Behind on the right a farm building with a pole fence. In the distance, on the left, buildings.

works.d: Eest taha paremale suunduva jõe kaldal, paremal, õnge otsa sööta panev mees. Taga paremal mets, vasakul põõsasmaastik.
works.de: On the bank of a river running from front to back to the right, on the right a man baiting a fishing line. Behind on the right a forest, on the left a bushy landscape.

works.d: Paremal jääkattes veekogu paadiga kalda äärel, taga metsaserv. Vasemal naisfiguur puude vahel, taga lumiste katustega talumajad, ümbritsetud lumiste kuuskedega. Taevas linnuparv. Kogu maastik õhetavas päikeseloojangus.
works.de: On the right an ice-covered body of water with a boat by the shore, behind it the edge of a forest. On the left a female figure among trees, behind her farmhouses with snowy roofs, surrounded by snow-covered spruces. A flock of birds in the sky. The whole landscape is in a glowing sunset.

works.d: Ees lumine maapind ja jäätunud veekogu. Vasemal ja paremal kõrged kuused. Taevaserv tugevalt punane, muu osa kollakais toonides.
works.de: In front, snowy ground and a frozen body of water. Tall spruces on the left and right. The horizon strongly red, the rest in yellowish tones.

works.d: Keskel liivane metsatee, vasemal mets, paremal tee ääres üksikud puud, tagapool mets.
works.de: In the middle a sandy forest path, on the left forest, on the right by the road solitary trees, forest behind.

works.d: Tihe kuuse-paplimets, keskel päikeseloojangust valgustatud; esiplaanil kuivanud oja metsa ja valgust peegeldava veelaiguga. Toon punakaspruun ja hall.
works.de: Dense spruce-poplar forest, lit in the centre by the sunset; in the foreground a dried-up brook with a patch of water reflecting the forest and light. Tone reddish-brown and grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaljude vahel sügav kaluripaat, vasemal meri purjekaga keskel. Õhus kajakateparv. Kuu valgustab kõrgelt merepinda maali keskel. Koloriit must-pruunikas (kuu kollane), esiplaan teostatud musta värviga, laiade pastoosete pintslitõmmetega.
works.de: In the foreground among cliffs a deep-set fishing boat, on the left the sea with a sailboat in the middle. A flock of gulls in the air. The moon shines high over the surface of the sea in the middle of the painting. The colouring is black-brownish (the moon yellow), the foreground executed in black paint, with broad pastose brushstrokes.

works.d: Esialal vasakult kerges kaares keskosa poole suunduva oja kaldal puude vahel lumetunud katusega taluhoone suitseva korstnaga. Hoone lähedal jäässe külmunud lootsik. Oja teisel kaldal esialal jändrikke raagus kaski, tagapool segamets. Kogu ala ilmestab loojenevast päikesest punetav taevas ja selle refleksid oja jäisel peegelpinnal.
works.de: On the foreground, on the bank of a stream curving gently to the left toward the middle, among trees, a farmhouse with a snow-covered roof and a smoking chimney. Near the building a boat frozen into the ice. On the other bank of the stream in the foreground, gnarled bare birches, further back mixed forest. The whole area is enlivened by a sky reddened by the setting sun, and its reflections on the icy surface of the stream.

works.d: Esialal lumisel lausikul peaaegu keskel jändrik raagus puu, sellest paremal looklevalt sügavusse suunduv jalgrada, millel kaugemal näha keppi käes hoidvat naisekuju selgvaates. Pildi paremal äärel teine raagus puu. Kaeugemal, hämarusse kaduva metsa taustal näha kahte suitsva korstnaga talumaja, millede lumistunud õlgkatuseil helgib metsa taha vajuva päikese kiirte kuma.
works.de: In the foreground on a snowy flat area, almost in the center, a gnarled leafless tree, to the right of it a footpath winding into the depth, on which, further away, a female figure holding a stick is visible in profile view. On the right edge of the picture, another leafless tree. Further away, against the background of a forest fading into dusk, two farmhouses with smoking chimneys can be seen, on whose snow-covered thatched roofs the glow of the rays of the setting sun shimmers.

works.d: Esiplaanil künkal suur, lumega kaetud puu. Taamal mets. Üle maastiku kaardub hämar taevas. Paremal pool taevas lind lendamas.
works.de: In the foreground on a hillock a large, snow-covered tree. In the background a forest. A dim sky arches over the landscape. On the right side of the sky a bird flying.

works.d: Lagendik lumises kuusemetsas, mille keskel maja kahe valgustatud aknaga. Taevas loojuva päikese kuma.
works.de: A clearing in a snowy spruce forest, with a house in the middle with two lit windows. In the sky the glow of the setting sun.

works.d: Vasakul pildi sügavusesse suunduv jõgi. Selle paremal kaldal tee, mida mööda sõidab hobune vankriga. Tagapool majad ja õitsvad puud.
works.de: On the left a river receding into the depth of the picture. On its right bank a road along which a horse is drawing a cart. Behind, houses and blossoming trees.

works.d: Keskel valge, verandade ja rõdudega maja, mida kroonib kuuetahuline torn. Maja taga on aimata tumedates toonides antud pargipuid ja-põõsaid. Esiplaanil liivatatud teed, puupink, viimasest paremal muruplats lillepeenraga. Vasakult langev päikesevalgus valgustab torni ja katuseviilu.
works.de: In the centre, a white house with verandas and balconies, crowned by a hexagonal tower. Behind the house, park trees and bushes are suggested in dark tones. In the foreground, sanded paths, a wooden bench, and to the right of the latter a lawn with a flower bed. Sunlight falling from the left illuminates the tower and the gable roof.

works.dm: lehe laius: 21.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 15.0 cm
works.d: Seente grupp 8-st puravikust.
works.de: Group of mushrooms consisting of 8 ceps.

works.d: Ülalt allapoole rippuv küpsete viljadega ploomioks.
works.de: A plum branch with ripe fruit hanging down from above.

works.d: Laual kaks roosakat roosi, taga kuldrandiga tass.
works.de: Two pinkish roses on the table, behind them a cup with a gilded rim.

works.dm: lehe laius: 11.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.2 cm
works.d: Öises kuuvalges maastikus ees keskel laialehelised taimed. Taamal järve kaldal puid ja põõsaid.
works.de: In a nocturnal moonlit landscape, broad-leaved plants in the centre foreground. In the distance, trees and bushes on the lakeshore.

works.d: Ees vasakul joonia stiilis monumendi vare. Selle juures 3 inimfiguuri. Paremal, poollängu kasvanud lehtpuu- Keskel, järve kaldal kitse kari ja üksik ratsanik. Taamal kaljuplatool sammasehitiste (templite) varemed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, the ruin of an Ionic-style monument. Beside it 3 human figures. On the right, a deciduous tree grown at a slant. In the centre, on the lake shore, a herd of goats and a lone rider. In the distance on a rocky plateau, the ruins of columned buildings (temples).

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal põõsastikuga maariba, keskel veekogu saartega, taga maastik pilvede ja metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a strip of land with bushes, in the middle a body of water with islands, behind a landscape with clouds and forest.

works.d: Vaade talumajale ja õuele, taustal suured puud eresinises taevas
works.de: View of a farmhouse and yard, large trees in the background against a bright blue sky

works.d: Restaureeritud, alusraamil must liist
works.de: Restored, black strip on the stretcher

works.d: Restaureeritud. Alusraamil must liist
works.de: Restored. Black strip on the stretcher

works.de: Warped, with paint losses at the edges

works.d: Määrdunud, mustjas raam
works.de: Dirty, blackish frame

works.d: Ääred muljunud ja määrdunud. Väikeseid pinnakahjustusi

works.t: A) Ema portree. B) Suvine maastik veekoguga

works.d: Väga halvas seisus. Värvivaringud üle kogu maali pinna
works.de: In very poor condition. Paint losses across the entire surface of the painting

works.d: Väga halvas seisukorras. Üleni krakelüüridega kaetud, värv lahti, värvivaringud. Ülal keskel rebend
works.de: In very poor condition. Entirely covered with craquelure, paint loose, paint losses. A tear at the top center

works.t: Nuttev Amor. Veenus lohutab mesilasest nõelatud Amorit
works.d: Antiikses rõivastuses naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule, süles nuttev Amor.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in antique dress, in profile facing left, a weeping Amor in her lap.

works.d: Esiplaanil, köögiviljadega kaetud laua ümber istub rõõmsameelne seltskond mehi, naisi, lapsi, ahv nende vahel. Tagapool läbisegi üksteise vahel vasakult veis, traktor, lõvi pojaga, mees papagoiga, eesli- ja põdrapea. Paremas nurgas kähar puu eksootilise linnuga. Dekoratiivne laad, rohelised, punakaspruunid toonid.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, a cheerful group of men, women and children sits around a table covered with vegetables, with a monkey among them. Further back, intermingled with each other from left to right, are a cow, a tractor, a lion with a cub, a man with a parrot, and a donkey's and an elk's head. In the right corner, a curly tree with an exotic bird. Decorative style, green and reddish-brown tones.

works.t: Vana fort ja Tahkuna majakas (Möödunud sõja säilmed Hiiumaal)
works.d: Esiplaanil puud ja majad rohekates toonides. Nende taga, vasakul, paistab meri majakaga.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground trees and houses in greenish tones. Behind them, on the left, the sea with a lighthouse is visible.

works.d: Erksates punastes, sinistes ja rohelistes toonides lendav objekt. Foonil vasakul kollane kaar, millel hulk roosasid ovaalseid laike.
works.de: A flying object in vivid red, blue and green tones. In the background on the left a yellow arc with a number of pink oval spots on it.

works.d: Pisut ülalpool keskjoont paiknevale silmapiirile koonduvad ähvardav-punane rünkpilvedega kaetud taevas ja hekkide ning puudega pargimaastik. Esiplaanil bassein heleda draperiitaolise kujundiga. Maalitud akvarellilikult punastes, rohelistes, valkjates toonides.
works.de: Slightly above the centre line, a threatening reddish sky covered with cumulus clouds converges at the horizon with a park landscape of hedges and trees. In the foreground a pool with a light drapery-like shape. Painted in a watercolour-like manner in red, green and whitish tones.

works.d: Istuva tütarlapse täisfiguur pruunis kleidis, valge pitskraega. Pea kallutatud vasakule. Parem käsi lebeb tooli käetoel, vasak roosa salliga süles. Foon pruun.
works.de: Full figure of a seated girl in a brown dress with a white lace collar. Head tilted to the left. Right hand resting on the chair's armrest, left in her lap with a pink shawl. Background brown.

works.d: Lage maastik. Silmapiiril keskel üksik hoone, ees paremal väike kuusk. Pool maalipinnast taevas. Koloriit hele.
works.de: An open landscape. On the horizon in the middle a solitary building, in front on the right a small spruce. Half of the painting's surface is sky. Light coloring.

works.d: Pruunil foonil rohekas alus, millel üksteisest erineva suuruse ja kujuga sened; kübarad punased, kollased ja pruunid. Maalitud laia pintsliga, kohati pastoosselt, kohati kumab läbi lõuend.
works.de: On a brown background a greenish base, on which mushrooms of differing size and shape; caps red, yellow and brown. Painted with a broad brush, in places pastose, in places the canvas shows through.

works.d: Terashalli seina ääres taburetil istuv halli habeme ja pikkade juustega vana mees veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel väsinud-tõsine pilk, selg veidi kühmus. Parem, sigaretti hoidev käsi toetub küünarnukkidega põlvele; vasak, rusikas käsi teisel põlvel. Seljas tume vest, pikk kuub, jalas pruunid püksid, mustad säärsaapad. Maalitud hallides-pruunides toonides, nägu valgus-varjudega modelleerides.
works.de: An old man with a grey beard and long hair, sitting on a stool by a steel-grey wall, in a quarter-turn to the right. The man has a tired-serious gaze, back slightly hunched. His right hand, holding a cigarette, rests with the elbow on the knee; his left hand, in a fist, is on the other knee. Wearing a dark waistcoat, a long coat, brown trousers, black high boots. Painted in grey-brown tones, the face modelled with light and shadow.

works.d: Hallikate rünkpilvedega kaetud taeva all pruunikasroheline lagendik, selle taga käharate, tuuled kooldunud kroonidega lehtpuud. Vasakul, rohelusest paistab kaks majakatust. Maalitud hoogasalt, taeva osas vineer kohati värviga katmata.
works.de: Under a sky covered with greyish cumulus clouds, a brownish-green clearing, behind it curly deciduous trees with wind-bent crowns. On the left, two house roofs are visible through the greenery. Painted vigorously, in the sky area the plywood is in places left uncovered by paint.

works.d: Kollase ja sinakasrohelisega markeeritud toasisustuse foonil istuv keskealine mees. Tumedad juuksed, prillid, seljas roheline särk, pruunid püksid ja vest, tumesinine lips, rohelised sokid, mustad läikivad kingad, ees pikk valge põll. Mees kerges pöördes vasakule, parem jalg üle põlve.
works.de: A middle-aged man sitting against a background of an interior marked in yellow and bluish-green. Dark hair, glasses, wearing a green shirt, brown trousers and waistcoat, dark blue tie, green socks, black shiny shoes, a long white apron in front. The man turned slightly to the left, right leg crossed over the knee.

works.d: Ridamisi istuvad kolm ümaranäolist pikkades punastes rüüdes naist, rätid peas. Kõigil naistel lapsed süles, keskmine toidab last rinnaga. Vasakul äärel osa naljandast figuurist. Maal punakaspruunides toonides siledalt maalitud.(eesti)
works.de: Sitting in a row, three round-faced women in long red robes, with kerchiefs on their heads. All the women have children in their laps, the middle one is breastfeeding a child. On the left edge, part of a jester figure. The painting is smoothly painted in reddish-brown tones.

works.d: Ees rohekas-pruunikas rohumaa ning kollane viljapõllu riba. Taamal tumeroheline metsaviirg. Silmapiir madal. Taevas ühtlaselt kahkjashall.
works.de: In front a greenish-brown meadow and a yellow strip of grain field. Beyond it a dark green strip of forest. Low horizon. The sky an even pale grey.

works.dm: kõrgus: 36.2 cm (km); laius: 31.2 cm (lm   ); laius: 29.3 cm (km   ); kõrgus: 39.2 cm (lm   )
works.d: Kolmnurgale ülesehitatud kahefiguuriline kompositsioonigrupp, esiplaanil naise kuju. Pead pöörates üleõla paremale. Sinisel foonil kaheksa tähte.
works.de: A two-figure composition group built on a triangle, in the foreground the figure of a woman. Turning her head over her shoulder to the right. Eight stars on a blue background.

works.d: Tiik, paremal laugjalt tõusva kõrge kaldapealsega. Taamal puude allee. Koloriit hele, valdav roheline toon.
works.de: A pond, on the right a high bank rising gently. An avenue of trees in the distance. Colouring light, predominant tone green.

works.dm: kõrgus: 36.3 cm (lm); laius: 36.3 cm (lm   ); laius: 25.9 cm (lm  ); kõrgus: 25.9 cm (lm)
works.d: a) Jõemaastik kevadel.
works.de: a) River landscape in spring.

works.d: Ees keskel pilvedel kaarik, mille ees neli hobust. Kaarikus seisev naise täisfiguur, ohjad käes ja kaks lapsefiguuri. Paremal kolme mehe figuurid lippudega.
works.de: In the centre foreground a chariot on clouds, drawn by four horses. In the chariot the full figure of a standing woman, holding the reins, and two child figures. On the right the figures of three men with flags.

works.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe rinnafiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehe riietus: sinine särk, must pintsak ja lips. Taust tume.
works.de: Bust figure of a bald middle-aged man in a half-turn to the left. The man's clothing: a blue shirt, a black jacket and a tie. Dark background.

works.d: Ees künkaline rohumaa, keskel oleva puude ja põõsaste rea vahelt ja üle paistmas hoonete grupid.
works.de: In front, hilly grassland, in the middle groups of buildings visible through and above a row of trees and bushes.

works.d: Keskel paljukäelise ja paljujalalise tantsijanna alasti figuur tantsimas. Tema ümber hiiglasuured tumerohelised lehed ja kasvud. Paremal pool ees hallil lausel jumaluse pea punases toonis rohelise peakattega. Vasakul pool ees sinisel alusel kaks tumedat alasti naisfiguuri. Foon helekollane.
works.de: In the centre, a nude figure of a dancer with many arms and many legs, dancing. Around her, gigantic dark-green leaves and growths. On the right in front, on a grey slab, the head of a deity in a red tone with a green headdress. On the left in front, on a blue pedestal, two dark nude female figures. The background is light yellow.

works.d: Ees, sammastikule toetuva kaaristu ees grupp rooma sõdureid ja kaks seisvat naisfiguuri. Läbi parempoolse kaarestiku näha Kristuse kohtumõistmise stseeni; läbi vasakpoolse lagedat maastiku palmiga.
works.de: In front, before an arcade resting on a colonnade, a group of Roman soldiers and two standing female figures. Through the right-hand arch the scene of Christ's judgement is visible; through the left-hand one an open landscape with a palm tree.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 24.0 cm; lehe laius: 30.3 cm
works.d: Ees jõgi kahe paadiga. Vastakallas lage, üksikute põõsastikega lauskmaa. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In front a river with two boats. The opposite bank bare, flat land with occasional bushes. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Noore, käed puusadel seisva naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad lühikesed juuksed, lillakas - punane jakk.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman standing with hands on hips, in a slight turn to the left. Dark short hair, purplish-red jacket.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal istub punastel patjadel kuldsel toolil naisfiguur, keha 1/4 pöördes vasakule. Vasak käsi tõstetud. Naisel seljas pruunikas drapeeritud rõivas, pea kohal kuldne nimbus, millesse kirjutatud kirillitsas Maria. Vasakul seisab 3/4 pöördes paremale hoogsas poosis ingel. Ingel hoiab ühes käes peenikest saua, teine on tõstetud õnnistamaks Maarjat. Ingli nimbusesse on kirjutatud kirillitsas Gabriil. Seljas on tal punane mantel, mille all rohekas rüü, tiivad punase ja rohelisega. Figuuride taustaks on kaks hoonet, vasakul punane, paremal roheline, taust pruunikas - kuldne. Ülaosas Püha Vaimu sümbol - väike valge tuvi suundumas tuvi poole.
works.de: In the foreground on the right sits a female figure on red cushions on a golden chair, the body in a 1/4 turn to the left. The left hand is raised. The woman is wearing a brownish draped garment, above her head a golden halo, on which is written in Cyrillic "Maria". On the left stands an angel in a 3/4 turn to the right, in a dynamic pose. The angel holds a thin staff in one hand, the other is raised to bless Mary. On the angel's halo is written in Cyrillic "Gabriil". He wears a red cloak, under which a greenish robe, wings in red and green. The background to the figures consists of two buildings, on the left red, on the right green, the background brownish-gold. In the upper part the symbol of the Holy Spirit – a small white dove heading towards the dove.

works.d: Pruunides, rohelistes ja ookritoonides mererand, toikaid ja adruseid kivisid täis. Nende kohal kõrguvad kolm fantastilistes voolavates vormides valget kändu. Tagaplaanil kalda ääres tumesinine, taamal pruunides toonides meri. Ülal, kõrge silmapiiri kohal helesinine taevaviirg.
works.de: In brown, green and ochre tones, a seashore full of driftwood and seaweed-covered stones. Above them rise three white stumps of fantastic flowing forms. In the background by the shore, dark blue, and further away the sea in brown tones. Above, over the high horizon, a light blue strip of sky.

works.d: Istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur en face rohekal-pruunikal foonil. Heledad juuksed sinise paelaga taga. Helesinine kroogetega kleit, kaela ümber valge ääris.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated girl en face against a greenish-brownish background. Light hair tied back with a blue ribbon. Light blue dress with gathers, a white edging around the neck.

works.d: Lõhendik kõrgete, järskude kaljude vahel. Keskel ülal langev veejuga, mis esiplaanil voolab käärulise ojana. Taevas kaks lindu.
works.de: A gorge between high, steep cliffs. In the middle above, a waterfall falling, which flows as a winding stream in the foreground. Two birds in the sky.

works.d: Aknal istuva noore naise figuur. Käed põlvede vahel. Taustaks vaade muruväljakule, puudele ja majade reale.(eesti)
works.de: Figure of a young woman sitting at a window. Hands between her knees. Background a view of a lawn, trees and a row of houses.

works.d: Naise portree: selg vaataja suunas, pea pööratud profiilis vasakule. Kõrge soeng, pärlikee, kõrvarõngas, kleit sügava väljalõikega seljal. Maalitud valge, ookri ja mustaga alusmaalina. (eesti)
works.de: Portrait of a woman: back turned toward the viewer, head turned in profile to the left. High hairstyle, pearl necklace, earring, dress with deep neckline at the back. Painted as an underpainting in white, ochre and black. (Estonian)

works.d: a) Esiplaanil keskel valge ümar vaas tiheda lillekimbuga, milles alumised valged, keskmised kõrgemad lilled on lillakad. Foon sinistes toonides.
works.de: a) In the foreground, centre, a white round vase with a dense flower bouquet, in which the lower white flowers, and the higher middle ones, are purplish. Background in blue tones.

works.d: Istuva mehe poolfiguur, pöördega paremale. Tumedad juuksed, habe ja vurrud. Vasak käsi paremal põlvel.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated man, turned to the right. Dark hair, beard and moustache. Left hand on right knee.

works.d: Keskel rohekas-halli metsaga kaetud nõgu, mida ümbritseb külgedel ja tagaplaanil hall mäeahelik.
works.de: In the middle a hollow covered with greenish-grey forest, surrounded on the sides and in the background by a grey mountain range.

works.d: Kollakasroheliste põllusiiludega avara maastiku taustal grupp unelev-tõsiseid inimesi. Esiplaanil lauanurk kruusi, kausi, selle ümber noored einestamas: vasakul valges särgis noormehe, selgvaates tumedajuukselise naise, otsevaates nokkmütsis mehe, paremal tõstetud kätega naise ja mehe poolfiguurid. Tagapool vasakul külitav naine ja istuv mees. Säravad toonid, tihke vorme üldistav, pehmelt modelleeriv maalilaad.
works.de: Against the background of a spacious landscape with yellowish-green field strips, a group of dreamy-serious people. In the foreground the corner of a table with gravel, a bowl, around which young people are dining: on the left the half-figures of a young man in a white shirt, a dark-haired woman seen frontally, a man in a peaked cap seen frontally, on the right a woman and a man with raised hands. Further back on the left a reclining woman and a sitting man. Bright tones, a painting style generalising dense forms, softly modelling.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks figuuri alusservaga poolenisti lõigatud; parempoolne alasti en face, vasakpoolne rohelises pluusis seljaga. Nende taga rand geometriseeritult pindadeks maalituna, domineerib heleroheline, vasakus servas intensiivset oranži, sinist. Tagaplaanil sügavates rohelistes toonides meri ja kitsas taevariba.
works.de: In the foreground two figures cut off at the lower edge; the one on the right nude en face, the one on the left in a green blouse, seen from the back. Behind them a beach painted in a geometricised manner as planes, dominated by light green, with intense orange and blue in the left edge. In the background, the sea in deep green tones and a narrow strip of sky.

works.d: Rohekates, sinakates toonides foonil kaheksa naist eredavärviliste lillenuppudega.
works.de: Against a background in greenish, bluish tones eight women with brightly coloured flower buds.

works.d: Keskealise naise pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Juuksed patsina keeratud pealaele, seljas kõrge kaelusega pruun kleit.
Osa tänavast viilkatustega majadega selle ääres. Ärklikorrusega kollase kivimaja tagant paistmas koonusekujuline katus ristiga otsas.

Vaade avarale merele: esiplaanil vasakul merest väljakasvanud kaljud kahe stafaažse figuuriga kaljudel istumas. Paremas kuni silmapiirini helesinine meri üksiku purjepaadiga. Ülal silmapiiri kohal kollane, kõrgemal tuhmsinine taevas.

works.de: On a grey shimmering background marked with whitish brushstrokes, and on a base painted in light nuanced tones and impasto, a pink vase holding a narrow, upward-directed bouquet of red flowers and green leaves.

works.de: On a windowsill an azalea pot with pink flowers, on the left a platter and a bottle. Painted thinly with long brushstrokes, leaving the canvas bare in places. Bluish and brownish tones, yellow tones in the window opening.

works.d: Vasakul kolm mehe poolfiguuri ääsitule valguses. Neist parempoolne en face, keskmine ja vasakpoolne profiilis. Keskmisel käes pikad pihid. Paremal punav ahjuavavus, mille ees mehe poolfiguur selgvaates.
works.de: On the left three half-figures of men in the light of a forge fire. Of these the one on the right en face, the middle one and the one on the left in profile. The middle one holds long tongs in his hand. On the right a reddish furnace opening, in front of which a half-figure of a man in clear view.

works.d: Esiplaanil seisva mehe kolmveerandfiguur toetumas tooli najale. Paremas käes piip, vasak toetub tooli korjule. Vasakul laud paberite ja trükilaokastidega. Taga vasakul varjus näha seisva mehe figuur pruunis kitlis seljaga vaataja poole.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man standing in the foreground, leaning on the back of a chair. In his right hand a pipe, his left hand resting on the chair frame. On the left a table with papers and printer's type-cases. In the background on the left, in shadow, the figure of a standing man in a brown smock, his back to the viewer.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides kompositsioon, mille horisontaalsel keskteljel punakaspruunidest kividest linnamüür. Paremal servas keskel on viis väheldast meest ametis kivide kandmise ja ladumisega. Müüri taga tumehallist paekivist vanalinna majad, tornid ja kirikud. Kompositsiooni alumises nurgas, linnamüüri ees neli meest (ühel neist kollane turban, teisel baretid) kuulamas punase laubapaela ja viipeks tõstetud parema käega ookrikarva rüüs meest.(eesti)
works.de: A composition in grey and brown tones, with a city wall of reddish-brown stones along the horizontal central axis. On the right edge, in the middle, five smallish men are occupied with carrying and laying stones. Behind the wall, old-town houses, towers and churches of dark grey limestone. In the lower corner of the composition, in front of the city wall, four men (one of them with a yellow turban, another with berets) are listening to a man in an ochre-coloured robe with a red headband, gesturing with his raised right hand.

works.d: Punasel foonil keskealise, tugevate näojoontega mehe rinnaportree. Paksud, tumedad juuksed laubalt taha kammitud. tihedate, ülemist laugu katvate kulmude alt suunatud vaatajale uuriv pilk; huuled veidi avatud. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Seljas tumepruun pallon ning valge kittel. Allääres lai punakaspruun horisontaalne pind.(eesti)
works.de: On a red background, a bust portrait of a middle-aged man with strong facial features. Thick, dark hair combed back from the forehead. From beneath dense eyebrows covering the upper eyelid, an inquiring gaze directed at the viewer; lips slightly parted. Hands crossed on the chest. Wearing a dark brown paletot and a white smock. A broad reddish-brown horizontal surface at the lower edge.

Esiplaanil kaks karahvinide, pitside ja taldrikutega kaetud lauda. Parempoolse laua taga istub mustas ülikonnas valge särgiga mees, käsi toetub tema kõrval asuvale punase sametiga kaetud tooli või diivani seljatoele. Mehe pea on kergelt pööratud paremale, pisut väljakutsuv pilk vaataja poole pööratud. Foonil kaks portreed, üks narri -, teine klounikostüümis.
works.de: In the foreground, two tables covered with carafes, lace and plates. Behind the table on the right sits a man in a black suit with a white shirt, his hand resting on the back of a chair or sofa covered in red velvet beside him. The man's head is turned slightly to the right, his gaze somewhat provocatively turned toward the viewer. In the background two portraits, one of a jester, the other in a clown costume.

works.d: Otsekui lavale, dekoratsioonide vahele on asetatud kaks jalutut (puujalgadega) karnevalikostüümides figuuri. Vasakpoolsel punase põhjaga müts, kellukesed servas, must mask, lai pitsiline krae, punane hõlst, valge põll, kaelas must rätik, käes puust mõõk. Parempoolsel kuldkollane parukas, näo asemel tohutu suu, valge pitsiline krae, sinine pluus, punane kuub ja püksid. Kuue varrukas suure haaknõelaga dekoratsiooni külge kinnitatud. Paremas nurgas vineerist välja lõigatud valge hani ratastel; keskel dekoratsiooni serval seemnetega kaetud sai.
works.de: As if placed on a stage, among the scenery, are two legless (with wooden legs) figures in carnival costumes. On the left one, a hat with a red base, bells on the edge, a black mask, a wide lace collar, a red doublet, a white apron, a black scarf around the neck, a wooden sword in hand. On the right one, a golden-yellow wig, an enormous mouth instead of a face, a white lace collar, a blue blouse, a red coat and trousers. The sleeve of the coat is attached to the scenery with a large safety pin. In the right corner, a white goose on wheels cut out of plywood; in the centre, at the edge of the scenery, a loaf of bread covered with seeds.

works.d: Lamava tütarlapse poolfiguur, pea üleval vasakus nurgas, rinnale kokku pandud käed all paremal. Punane jakk, käte all valge vaiba äär.
works.de: Half-figure of a reclining girl, head at the upper left corner, hands folded on her chest at the lower right. A red jacket, the edge of a white blanket under the hands.

works.d: Neljaosaline, igal osal erivärvilises lahenduses sarnastest kujunditest kompositsioon: keskel lainelise äärega ülalt ahenev kujund, selle tipus ring.
works.de: Four-part composition, each part in a different colour solution of similar forms: in the centre a shape narrowing upward with a wavy edge, a circle at its tip.

works.d: Keerulise pinna- ja ruumistruktuuriga abstraktne geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille peamisteks elementideks erinevas suuruses nelinurgad ja triibud. U. vertikaalse kesktelje kohal ülal vaba käega tõmmatud hall spiraaljoon. Töö keskel, must-hall abstraktne kujund. Värviline, hoolikalt omavahel tasakaalustatud värvipinnad.
works.de: An abstract geometric composition with a complex surface and spatial structure, whose main elements are rectangles and stripes of varying sizes. Above the approximately vertical central axis, a freehand-drawn grey spiral line. In the centre of the work, a black-and-grey abstract shape. Colourful, carefully balanced colour surfaces.

works.d: Koosneb neljast võrdsest kõrvuasetatud tahvlist, kruntimata lõuend. Maali alumisel osal, valdavalt valgel taustal musta kontuuriga mitmesuguse suurusega ruudud, rombid, vabakäejooned. Maali ülapoolsel, puhtal lõuendil mustad, kollased, sinised abstraktsed pinnad vaheldumisi väiksemate geomeetriliste kujundite ja märkidega. Nelja tahvlit läbib keskpaigast lainekujuline põikisuunaline, tuubist vajutatud valge värviga väga reljeefne pind.
works.de: Consists of four equal side-by-side panels, unprimed canvas. In the lower part of the painting, predominantly on a white background, black-outlined squares, rhombi and freehand lines of various sizes. In the upper part of the painting, on clean canvas, black, yellow, blue abstract surfaces alternating with smaller geometric shapes and signs. Through the middle of the four panels runs a wave-shaped transverse, highly relief surface pressed from a tube in white paint.

works.d: Punases kleidis tütarlapse rinnafiguur heledal, soojades toonides foonil. Pea kerges pöördes paremale, pilk langetatud, pikad juuksed kuklasse kokku kammitsetud.
works.de: A bust portrait of a girl in a red dress against a light, warm-toned background. The head slightly turned to the right, gaze lowered, long hair combed together at the back of the head.

works.d: Tuba, tagaservas lai aken, mille ees seisev naine maalib. Vasakul klaver, paremal laud, selle ääres vanem istuv naine. Akna lähedal kolm last.
works.de: A room, at the back a wide window, in front of which a standing woman is painting. On the left a piano, on the right a table, beside it an older sitting woman. Near the window three children.

works.d: Vasakul kaks apelsini, paremal kann valgete ja kollaste õitega.

works.de: In front, in the centre, a naked male figure kneeling at the feet of a man in a red robe with his hand raised for blessing. Behind the one giving the blessing, three female figures. In the background, flowering trees.

works.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, the figure of a naked child on the back of a drinking goat. Behind, among large trees, a woman hurrying forward.

works.d: Esiplaanil avar rohuväli. Taamal lehtpuumets.
Esiplaanil muru. Vasemal hekk ja lehtpuid. Paremal põõsastiku taga hoone katus.
Murul kuus lamavat pruuni jahikoera.
works.de: Six lying brown hunting dogs on the grass.

works.d: Kaks alasti ratsurit lillakatel hobustel (profiilis). Taustaks rohelisel aasal lehtpuid.
works.de: Two nude riders on purplish horses (in profile). Deciduous trees on a green meadow in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks supelpükstes ratsurit valgetel hobustel. Taustaks metsaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground two riders in swimming trunks on white horses. Forest strip in the background.

works.d: Aiapingil istuva naise põlvpilt. Käed ristamisi rüpes.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman sitting on a garden bench. Hands crossed in her lap.

works.d: Valkjal taustal kolm banaani, nende taga kaks apelsini. Apelsinide vahel õun. Taga banaan.
works.de: Three bananas on a whitish background, behind them two oranges. An apple between the oranges. A banana behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik, taga puude vahel kahekordne hoone.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing, behind among trees a two-storey building.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks neljakandilist palkidest ehitust, paremal laevad. Taevas kollane.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground two square log constructions, ships on the right. Yellow sky.

works.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas sõduripluus, peas punase tähega pilotka.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man, turned slightly to the right. Wearing a soldier's blouse, on his head a garrison cap with a red star.

works.d: Peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina mõjuv rannavaade: esiplaanil rohttaimedega kaetud luited, keskel kergelt lainetav meri. Ülal sinine, üksikute valgete pilvedega taevas, mis silmapiiril merega kokku puutudes roosalt kumab. Erksates toonides, lopsakate pintslilöökide ja kohati spaatliga maalitud.
works.de: A beach view that appears as an almost abstract combination of colour patches: in the foreground dunes covered with grass, in the middle a slightly rippling sea.
