works.de: Bust portrait en face of a dark-haired bearded man with hair combed apart in the middle. Head tilted down.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv kõnnitee jalgrattaga, paremal hooned, vasemal kaldaäär. Vihmane päev.
works.de: In the foreground a footpath running into the depth with a bicycle, on the right buildings, on the left a riverbank. A rainy day.

works.d: Öine merevaade. Esiplaanil rannaäärsete kivide vahel paadinina püsti vahuses vees. Vasakul pimeduses aimatav paat kahe tulega pardal. Üle vee rannatuled peegeldumas merre. Tume, mustjassinine koloriit tugevasti lakitud pind.(eesti)
works.de: Night seascape. In the foreground, among coastal rocks, the bow of a boat standing upright in foamy water. On the left, in the darkness, a boat with two lights on board can be discerned. Shore lights reflecting into the sea across the water. Dark, blackish-blue colour scheme, heavily varnished surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage plats üksikute suurte mändidega; aia taga puude ja põõsaste vahel üksikud majad. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground an open area with individual large pines; behind a fence, among trees and bushes, individual houses. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Eest vasakult kerge pöördega paremale alla orgu laskuval teel seljakoti ja kepiga mehe figuur (en face); paremal künka harjal grupp puid. Kaugemal org ja järsud kaljuahelikud. Mägede jalamil lahtpuude vöönd kahe madala hoonega vasakul.
works.de: In front, on a path descending with a slight turn from left to right into a valley, the figure of a man with a backpack and a stick (en face); on the right, on the crest of a hillock, a group of trees. Further away a valley and steep rocky ridges. At the foot of the mountains a belt of deciduous trees, with two low buildings on the left.

works.d: Sürrealistlik rannamotiiv. Esiplaanil liival lebab akti poolfiguur. Sinakais-roosakais toonides naisaktist on näha lopsakate vormidega torso. Naise parema käe sõrmed hoiavad meresinise "rätiku" serva. Taamal pruunikas-sinises meres hulbib vasakul üksik kõrv.
works.de: A surrealist beach motif. In the foreground, a half-figure nude lies on the sand. The female nude in bluish-pink tones shows a torso with lush forms. The fingers of the woman's right hand hold the edge of a sea-blue "kerchief". In the background, in a brownish-blue sea, a single ear floats on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal on aimata suurt, kaarduvajunud okstega puud, mille fooniks abstraheeritult antud künklik ja puudesaludega kaetud maastik. Erksates sinistes, punastes, kollastes toonides. Maalitud laia ekspressiivse pintslilöögiga.
works.de: In the foreground on the right one can discern a large tree with drooping, curving branches, against a background of an abstractly rendered hilly landscape covered with groves of trees. In bright blue, red and yellow tones. Painted with broad, expressive brushstrokes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 34.7 cm (lm. kuni aluspapi servani); laius: 24.4 cm (lm. kuni aluspapi servani)
works.d: Ees laua ääres kaks täisprofiilis kaarte mängivat munka. Nende taga kaks seisvat munka.
works.de: In front, at a table, two monks in full profile playing cards. Behind them two standing monks.

works.d: Sinise veekogu ääres murul telgid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
works.de: Tents on the grass by a blue body of water. The opposite shore is gently sloping.

works.d: Ees lumisel künkakaldal kaks maani seelikus tütarlast (en face). Taga keskel torn ja okasmets. Taamal kõrged mäeahelikud.
works.de: In the foreground on a snowy hillside two girls in floor-length skirts (en face). Behind in the middle a tower and coniferous forest. In the distance high mountain ranges.

works.d: Klaasist vaas roosade tulpidega. Vaasi kõrval vasemal banaanid. Tagapõhi sinepikollane.
Paremal Raekoja hoone nurk Harju tänavalt. Taga majade rida. Platsil voorimehi ja üksikuid inimfiguure.
works.de: On the right the corner of the Town Hall building from Harju Street. Behind it a row of houses. On the square coachmen and single human figures.

works.d: Peamiselt hallides ja valgetes, pastelltoonides abstraktne, ekspressiivsetest veiklevatest värvilaikudest kompositisoon.
works.de: An abstract composition, mainly in grey and white pastel tones, of expressive flickering patches of colour.

works.d: Siniste seintega toas, väikesteks ruutudeks jaotatud suure akna all rohelisel toolil istub naine, magav laps süles. Naisel seljas heleroosa kleit, langetatud peas kuklasse sõlme seotud hele rätik. Lapsel seljas valge särgike. Naise jalgade ees korv ja väike jalapink. Aknalaual lillepott.
works.de: In a room with blue walls, under a large window divided into small squares, a woman sits on a green chair with a sleeping child in her lap. The woman wears a light pink dress, a light kerchief tied in a knot at the nape on her lowered head. The child wears a white shirt. In front of the woman's feet a basket and a small footstool. A flowerpot on the windowsill.

works.d: Otsevaates maalitud poisi portree rinnust saadik. Seljas hall, pealeõmmeldud rinnataskutega pintsak ja valge särk, mille krae langeb revääridele. Vasaku käsi hoiab pintsaku kraest, näole maalitud valgushelke, juuksed kergelt lokkis. Foon hall.
works.de: Portrait of a boy painted in frontal view down to the chest. Wearing a gray jacket with sewn-on breast pockets and a white shirt whose collar falls onto the lapels. The left hand holds the collar of the jacket, light reflections painted on the face, hair slightly curly. Background gray.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline muru, millel paremal valge koer lamamas, pea käpale toetatud. Tema kõrval vasakul seisev punakaspruun koer, pea nuhutamiseks all lastud ning vasak esikäpp tõstetud. Silmapiirist kõrgemal hallikas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground green grass, on which on the right a white dog lies, head resting on its paw. Beside it on the left a reddish-brown dog standing, head lowered for sniffing, and its left forepaw raised. Above the horizon a greyish sky.

works.d: Esialal lausik rohtmaa, mida taustana piirab lehtpuumets.
works.de: In the foreground flat grassland, bordered in the background by deciduous forest.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise, hõreda, pügatud habemega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas punane kuub.
works.de: Bust portrait of an elderly man with brown hair and a sparse, trimmed beard, in half-profile to the right. Wearing a red coat.

works.d: Osa tänavast madalate majadega ääres. esiplaanil raagus puu. Selle taga taraga ümbritsetud punane kollase otsafassaadiga maja. Taevas terashall.
works.de: Part of a street lined with low houses. In the foreground a bare tree. Behind it a red house with a yellow end façade, surrounded by a fence. Sky steel-grey.

works.d: Ees lumine maa, keskel üksiku suure puu kõrval skulptuur; taga telliskivist hoone. Paremalt vaade linnamajadele.
works.de: In front, snowy ground, in the middle a sculpture beside a single large tree; behind, a brick building. On the right a view of city houses.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree: pea ja silmavaade kergelt paremale pööratud, juuksed taha kammitud, nina all väikesed vurrud. Seljas tumehall pintsak, valge särk ja bordoopunane lips. Ristatud, ebaloomulikult suured käed toetuvad millelegi. Foon tumepruun.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man: head and gaze slightly turned to the right, hair combed back, small moustache under the nose. Wearing a dark grey jacket, white shirt and burgundy-red tie. Crossed, unnaturally large hands rest on something. Background dark brown.

works.d: Laual prantsuse ajaleht, pudel ja klaas punase draperii taustal.
Naise pea poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule, peas kirju tanu.
works.de: A woman's head in half-profile turned to the left, wearing a colourful bonnet.

works.d: Vaade vanalinna katustele, millede keskelt töö keskosas kerkib esile kirikutorn. Taga meri. Ees vasakul üksiku kõrge puu tüvi ja osa krooni.(eesti)
works.de: A view of the roofs of the Old Town, from the middle of which a church tower rises in the central part of the work. Behind, the sea. In front on the left, the trunk of a single tall tree and part of its crown.

works.d: Osa tänavast roosas - pruunis - kollases koloriidis madalate majade ja heleda taevaga.
works.de: Part of a street in pink-brown-yellow colouring with low houses and a light sky.

works.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt profiilis paremale, valges rüüžidega tanus ja samasuguse kraega.
works.de: Bust of an older woman in profile to the right, in a white ruffled bonnet and matching collar.

works.d: Hämar, hallide seinte ja madala laega kõrtsituba kuueruudulise aknaga tagaseinas. Ruumi keskel pruun kõrtsilett pudelitega. Leti taga heledas valguses kõrtsmik ja kaks klaasustega kappi. Vasakul uks, mille kohal pilt. Uksest vaatab sisse talumees. Paremal madal uks pildiga selle kohal, ukse ees istuvad üks vana mees kepiga ja noorem laiaäärelises kübaras mees jutuhoos. Keskel vestlevad seljaga kõrtsiletile toetudes kaks kuubedes talumeest, vestlejaist vasakul olev talumees on küljega ja toetub küünarnukkidega letile. Vasakul allservas puupink riiete ja puunõuga. Akna all üksteise otsa laotud korvid pudelitega. Laes põleb suure ümmarguse kupliga õlilamp.
works.de: A dim tavern room with grey walls and a low ceiling, with a six-paned window in the back wall. In the middle of the room a brown tavern counter with bottles. Behind the counter, in bright light, the innkeeper and two glass-doored cupboards. On the left a door, above which hangs a picture. A peasant is looking in through the doorway. On the right a low door with a picture above it; in front of the door sit an old man with a cane and a younger man in a wide-brimmed hat, engaged in conversation. In the middle two peasant men in coats converse leaning with their backs against the tavern counter; of the two conversing, the one on the left is shown side-on, leaning on the counter with his elbows. In the lower left corner a wooden bench with clothes and a wooden vessel. Under the window, baskets with bottles stacked on top of one another. From the ceiling hangs a burning oil lamp with a large round shade.

works.d: Vanema mehe näopilt kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel tumedate raamidega prillid. Juustepiir laubal kahel pool taandunud, pikas kitsas näos ninast suuni pikad sügavad kortsud. Näoilme tõsine. Maalitud rohelistes, roosades ja kollastes toonides. Foon hallikasroheline, vasakus servas kollane.
works.de: A facial portrait of an older man in a slight turn to the right. The man wears dark-framed glasses. The hairline receded on both sides of the forehead, in the long narrow face deep long wrinkles from nose to mouth. Serious facial expression. Painted in green, pink and yellow tones. Background greyish-green, yellow in the left edge.

works.d: Tänavanurk kolme raagus puu  ja rohelise katusega kuulutuste tulbega. Kaugemal kollased mitmekorruselised majad.
works.de: A street corner with three bare trees and a green-roofed advertisement pillar. Further away, yellow multi-storey houses.

works.d: Peamiselt sinistes, kollastes ja lillakasroosades toonides antud panoraamne maastik: paremal servas kaarjas rannajoon, vasakul liivane järsak valge majaga selle serval. Silmapiiri kohal ülal roosalt kumav taevas. Maastik on visandatud peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina.
works.de: Panoramic landscape rendered mainly in blue, yellow and pinkish-lilac tones: on the right edge a curved coastline, on the left a sandy bluff with a white house at its edge. Above the horizon a sky glowing pink. The landscape is sketched as an almost abstract combination of patches of colour.

works.d: Laual vasakul punutud korvis joogikarhvin, selle kõrval pokaal tumepunase veiniga. Nende ees paremal poolenisti kooritud sidrunile toetuv taldrik, millel erkpunane vähk. Taldriku serva alt paistab noa pea, paremal sidrun. Maal pruunikashallis koloriidis, üksikud heledad valguslaigud taldrikul, karhvinil, klaasil.
works.de: On the table, on the left, a drink carafe in a woven basket, next to it a goblet with dark red wine. In front of them, on the right, a plate resting on a half-peeled lemon, on which a bright red crayfish. The head of a knife is visible under the edge of the plate, a lemon on the right. The painting in brownish-grey colouring, individual light patches of light on the plate, the carafe, the glass.

works.d: Esiplaanil punakal pinnal pundar üksteisest läbipõimunud rohelisi angerjaid. Tagaplaanil sinine veekogu selle kaldal kasvavate puudega ning roosa taevas. Värvipind faktuurne. Kontuurid rõhutatud.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, on a reddish surface, a bundle of green eels intertwined with one another. In the background a blue body of water with trees growing on its shore and a pink sky. The paint surface textured. The contours emphasised.

works.d: Laual natüürmort: kaks vaasi nelkidega, sinine taldrik, vaas, klaas, puuviljad ja raamat.
works.de: Still life on a table: two vases with carnations, a blue plate, a vase, a glass, fruits and a book.

works.dm: kõrgus: 150.0 cm (III osa   ); kõrgus: 150.0 cm (II osa   ); laius: 75.0 cm (I osa   ); laius: 75.0 cm (III osa   )
works.d: Sinkjasmustal valgete ringidega kolme erinevat doominoklotsi kujutav maal.
works.de: A painting depicting three different domino tiles with white circles on a bluish-black background.

works.d: Esiplaanil all trepi ja roosakaspunaste rõdurinnatistega hoone osa. Rõdu külge on kinnitatud pikksilm. Rõdult avaneb vaade jääväljale, mille serva on kuhjunud jääpanku. Jääpankade ees inimeste grupid jääle kogunenud purjekaid jälgimas. Silmapiiri kohal romantiline helesinistes ja roosades toonides taevas, mõni murtud servaga pilvesagar.
works.de: In the foreground below, part of a building with a staircase and pinkish-red balcony parapets. A telescope is attached to the balcony. From the balcony a view opens onto an ice field, at whose edge ice floes have piled up. In front of the ice floes, groups of people gathered on the ice watching sailing boats. Above the horizon a romantic sky in light blue and pink tones, with a few clouds with broken edges.

works.d: Talutoas seisev valges pearätikus naine, seelik ja jakk seljas, käed vöö kohale kõverdatud. Naisest vasakul põrandal korv. Selja taga lahtine ukseava vaatega taluõuele, kust paistab läveesine kivi, kaev ja jupike lattidest aeda. Tumedad pruunid toonid, figuuri juures kasutatud pisut punast.
works.de: A woman standing in a farmhouse room, in a white headscarf, wearing a skirt and jacket, hands bent above her belt. To the woman's left, a basket on the floor. Behind her, an open doorway with a view of the farmyard, where a doorstep stone, a well and a bit of a slatted fence are visible. Dark brown tones, with a little red used near the figure.

works.d: Keskealise naise poolfiguur täisprofiilis paremale. Peas triibuline rätik, mille alumine serv ripub lihtsalt üle õlgade seljale. Üle halli jaki punane pihik.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman in full profile facing right. A striped kerchief on her head, its lower edge simply hanging over her shoulders onto her back. A red bodice over a grey jacket.

works.d: Punastest, sinistest ja kollastest väljavenitatud kolmnurkadest jt. geomeetrilistest kujunditest moodustunud keeristest abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: An abstract composition formed of whirls of elongated triangles and other geometric shapes in red, blue and yellow.

works.d: Lillakal foonil kollane sõõr. Selles tilaga kell, millel inimese nägu.
works.de: On a purplish background a yellow disc. In it a clock with a winding stem, on which there is a human face.

works.d: Kõrge pilvise taeva all taluõu. Esiplaanil paremal palkidest sild, sellele läheneb kahehobuseregi, eit-taat peal. Neist paremal seisab naine lapsega, naisel komps käes. Tagaplaanil paremal lumise katusega taluhoone, vasakul suitseva korstnaga talumaja ots. Vasakul, roigasaia taga tuulik, silmapiiril lumine mets.
works.de: A farmyard under a high cloudy sky. In the foreground on the right a log bridge, which a two-horse sledge with an old man and old woman on it is approaching. To their right stands a woman with a child, the woman holding a bundle. In the background on the right a farm building with a snowy roof, on the left the gable of a farmhouse with a smoking chimney. On the left, behind a pole fence, a windmill, a snowy forest on the horizon.

works.d: Osa valge riidega kaetud kirstust. Rüüžidega padjal, roosakaist õitest pärjaga ümbritsetud noore naise pea.
works.de: Part of a coffin covered with white cloth. On a ruffled pillow, the head of a young woman surrounded by a wreath of pinkish flowers.

works.d: Keskteljest pisut paremal pikliku näoga keskealise mehe pea veerandpöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud otse ette, huuled kokku pigistatud, kulmud veidi kergitatud, tumedad juuksed üle pea, kulmud veidi kergitatud, tumedad juuksed üle pea, kaeluses laiema sviitri krae. Maalitud hallides - pruunikates beežides toonides lopsakalt.
works.de: Slightly right of the central axis, the head of a middle-aged man with an elongated face, in a quarter-turn to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead, lips pressed together, eyebrows slightly raised, dark hair combed over the head, eyebrows slightly raised, dark hair combed over the head, a wider sweater collar at the neckline. Painted richly in grey - brownish beige tones.

works.d: Heledas koloriidis, etüüdilikult maalitud vaade Tallinna all - linnast. Kitsas tänav, hoonetega kahel pool. Otse ees avaneb vaade kõrgete viilkatustega majade rivile.
works.de: A view of Tallinn's Lower Town, painted in a light colour scheme in a sketch-like manner. A narrow street, with buildings on both sides. Directly ahead a view opens onto a row of houses with tall gable roofs.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ja kaks hobust. Kõrvil pea langetatud; valgel ratsul alasti mehefiguur. Taustaks lage maastik; paremal ja vasakul põõsad. Koloriit tume.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water and two horses. One with head lowered; on a white steed a nude male figure. Background an open landscape; bushes on the right and left. Dark colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil, poollamavas asendis, vasakule käele toetuv mees ning paremasse serva jääv kerra tõmbunud valge koer. Nende taga kolm mehefiguur. Vasakul mees valgel hobusel, seljaga vaataja poole. Taamal merel üksik valge purjekas.
works.de: In the foreground, in a half-reclining position, a man leaning on his left hand, and on the right edge a white dog curled up. Behind them three male figures. On the left a man on a white horse, his back to the viewer. In the distance on the sea a solitary white sailboat.

works.d: Vasakule avaneva kaljukoopa suus väikesel, paremalt järsult tahapoole langeval platool, suunaga koopast välja astuvas asendis, täishabemega, alasti mehekuju - Herakles. Peas ja turjal peakatet ja lahtiselt rippuvat mantlit moodustav suur lõvinahk. Tugeva muskulatuuriga vägilase tõstetud paremas käes õlale toetuvana suur puust sõjanui; vasak, allapoole sirutatud käsi rebib enese järele tulema suurt, tõrksat, paljastatud kihvadega kolmepäist koera - Kerberost. Taustaks koopa seinad ja lagi - ülaosas tumedais toonides, mis allapoole helenevad kaljujärsaku serva tagant paistvaks punaseks põrgutule kumaks. Vasakul nähtavast koopasuust paistab hämarduv taevas.
works.de: In the mouth of a cave opening to the left, on a small plateau falling steeply backward on the right, in a pose of stepping out of the cave, a bearded, naked male figure - Heracles. On his head and shoulders a large lion skin forming a headcover and a loosely hanging cloak. In the raised right hand of the strongly muscled hero, resting on his shoulder, a large wooden war club; his left hand, stretched downward, drags after him a large, resistant, three-headed dog with bared fangs - Cerberus. The background consists of the cave's walls and ceiling - dark in tone at the top, lightening downward into a red glow of hellfire visible beyond the edge of the cliff. Beyond the visible cave mouth on the left, a darkening sky can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri paatidega. Tagaplaanil tõusvale kaldaäärsele mäerinnakule tihedalt üksteise kõrvale ehitatud majad. Neist vasakul tagaplaanil mägi, ülal helesinine taevas. Maalitud sinistes, roosades ja kollastes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground the sea with boats. In the background, densely built houses standing side by side on a rising mountain slope along the shore. To the left of them in the background a mountain, above a light blue sky. Painted in blue, pink and yellow tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik põõsastega, selle keskel jõgi. Üle jõe hooned ja Pirita kloostri varemed. Koloriit hall-rohekas, tugevad pintslitõmbed.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing with bushes, with a river in its centre. Across the river, buildings and the ruins of Pirita Convent. Colouring grey-greenish, strong brushstrokes.

works.d: Ees meri - vasakul aurik ja paremal sõudepaat. Tagapool keskel purjekas. Tagaplaanil silmapiiril Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In front, the sea - on the left a steamer and on the right a rowing boat. In the middle background a sailing boat. In the far background on the horizon the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Kolm embuses paari, äärmised seljaga vaataja poole. Maalitud pehmete, lainjate joontega, rõhutades figuuride paindes siluette. Valdavalt sinised toonid.
works.de: Three embracing couples, the outer ones with their backs to the viewer. Painted with soft, wavy lines, emphasising the curved silhouettes of the figures. Predominantly blue tones.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.2 cm (km); laius: 54.2 cm (lm); laius: 52.0 cm (km ); kõrgus: 29.2 cm (lm)
works.d: Töö jaotatud kolmeks osaks. Vasakul: lõke, selle ümber istuva kolme figuuriga. Keskel väravast kinnihoidev heledajuukseline mees. Seljas ripub märss, vööl lähker. All, paremas nurgas kaks puunõud. Paremal: rahvariietes istuv naisefiguur, poolpöördes vasakule. Tagaplaanil seinal ripuvad mõõk ning laiaääreline kübar.
works.de: The work is divided into three parts. On the left: a campfire, with three figures sitting around it. In the centre a fair-haired man holding onto a gate. A knapsack hangs on his back, a flask on his belt. Below, in the right corner, two wooden vessels. On the right: a seated female figure in folk costume, in a half-turn to the left. In the background on the wall hang a sword and a wide-brimmed hat.

works.d: Vaade Toompea lossile alt Schnelli tiigi juurest. Allääres vesi, peegelduva kaldapealsega. Ülal paremal paistab vana müüri tagant mitmekorruseline lossihoone. Koloriit hele, valgusküllane.
works.de: View of Toompea Castle from below, by Schnelli Pond. At the bottom water, with a reflecting embankment. Above on the right, behind an old wall, a multi-storey castle building is visible. The colour scheme is light, full of light.

works.t: a) Kärumehed. Etüüd; b) Neli visandit kompositsioonidele figuuridega
works.d: a) "Kärumehed" Etüüd
works.de: a) "Kärumehed" Study

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 26.2 cm; lehe laius: 35.2 cm
works.d: Ees kaljusel teekurvil vanamees ja poisike koormat kandva eesliga. Taamal naine lapsega. Ümberringi kõrged mäed. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In front, on a rocky bend of the road, an old man and a boy with a load-carrying donkey. In the distance a woman with a child. High mountains all around. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Ees, paremalt taha keskele suunduva jõe ääres naised pesu loputamas. Vasakul hobune reega. Taga kõrgeneval kaldal raagus metsatukk. Paremal jõekallas hõreda metsaga.
works.de: In front, along a river leading from the right to the centre background, women rinsing laundry. On the left a horse with a sledge. Behind, on a rising bank, a bare clump of forest. On the right a riverbank with sparse forest.

works.d: Vasakul kõrgendikult laskuv palgikoorem hobuse, varsa ja mehega. Paremal oja kividega. Taga männid ja mets.
works.de: On the left a load of logs descending from a height with a horse, a foal and a man. On the right a stream with stones. Behind, pines and forest.

works.d: Valgete lillede keskel vana haraline tamm. Taustaks põõsastik.
works.de: Among white flowers an old gnarled oak. Shrubbery as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil fantastilised figuurid. Taustaks mitmesugust värvi tornid.
works.de: Fantastic figures in the foreground. Towers of various colours as background.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 15.8 cm; kujutise laius: 14.7 cm
works.d: a) Noore mehe poolfiguur rohelises pintsakus. Istuv asend. Vasak käsi toetub toolikorjule. Pea poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: a) Half-figure of a young man in a green jacket. Seated position. Left hand resting on the back of a chair. Head in half-profile to the left.

works.d: Brüneti tõmmunahalise valges särgis istuva naise põlvpilt. Pea ja õlad en face. paremal roheline - punane draperii.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a dark-haired, swarthy-skinned woman sitting in a white shirt. Head and shoulders en face. A green-red drapery on the right.

works.d: Tumedas kuues pikkade, üle pea kammitud juustega keskealise mehe rinnapilt (poolprofiilis paremale).
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in a dark coat with long hair combed back over the head (in half-profile to the right).

works.t: Vaade üle Tallinna sadama poole (Tallinna vaade)
works.d: Esiplaanil katuseid ja vabrikukorstnaid; taga meri.
works.de: In the foreground roofs and factory chimneys; behind, the sea.

works.d: Ees järv piiratud vasemalt ja paremalt kõrgete järskude mägedega. All, järvekaldal maju, pisut kõrgemal nõlval puid.
works.de: In front, a lake bordered on the left and right by high steep mountains. Below, on the lakeshore, houses, and slightly higher on the slope, trees.

works.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Vasakus käes palett pintslitega. Hallid juuksed, pruun kuub.

Peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuvatest kujunditest koostatud kompositsioon: keskel mees hobuse seljas odaga esiplaanil lamavat sinist lohet tapmas. Foon meenutab maastikku, ülal väikeste pilvedega kaetud taevas. Mürgistes sinistes-lillades-rohelistes toonides, keskel horisontaalne erkpunane fooniosa.(eesti)
works.de: A composition made up of almost abstractly rendered shapes: in the centre a man on horseback with a spear killing a blue dragon lying in the foreground. The background resembles a landscape, above a sky covered with small clouds. In poisonous blue-lilac-green tones, in the centre a horizontal bright red section of the background.

works.d: Vasakul avatud ahjuuks, kus põlevad puuhalud. Ahi hallidest kividest. Paremal ahjuroop seina najal.
works.de: On the left an open stove door with burning firewood logs. Stove of grey stones. On the right a poker leaning against the wall.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. paremas käes pintsel, vasakus hanesulg.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile to the right, a brush in the right hand, a goose quill in the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, vasakul madal kallas kalurionni ja puudega. Onni juures kaks inimkogu. Paremal paistab üle vee sinav kaldaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, on the left a low shore with a fisherman's hut and trees. By the hut two human figures. On the right a bluish strip of shore is visible across the water.

works.d: Kiilaspäise mehe profiilportree suunaga paremale. Kaela ümber ja õlgadel paistab pruuni mungarüü kaelus ja peakate.
works.de: Profile portrait of a bald man facing right. Around the neck and on the shoulders, the collar and headgear of a brown monk's habit are visible.

works.d: Keskel meres kaks putot ratsutamas delfiinidel. Parempoolse puto pea on kallutatud vasakule ja vasakus käes on ohjaharu. Vasakpoolse puto väljasirutatud paremas käes on teine ohjaharu. Putode vahel on punane rätik.
works.de: In the centre, in the sea, two putti riding on dolphins. The head of the right putto is tilted to the left and in his left hand is a rein. In the outstretched right hand of the left putto is another rein. Between the putti is a red scarf.

works.t: Tsarskoje Selo lossikiriku keisrilooži laemaali eskiis
works.d: Esiplaanil keskel põlvili naine, kelle ümber neli last. Nii paremal kui vasakul üks naisefiguur. Taevas inglid ja putod. Keskel Maria Jeesus-lapsega. Nurgad pronksitud.
works.de: In the front centre a kneeling woman, surrounded by four children. On both the right and the left, one female figure. In the sky, angels and putti. In the centre, Mary with the infant Jesus. Corners bronzed.

works.d: Laual mitmesuguseid köögivilju - rediseid, tomateid, kapsaid, porgandeid, kurke, üks sidrun. Keskel kauss lillkapsastega. Vasakul lähker ja klaas, paremal pudel ja taldrik.
works.de: Various vegetables on the table - radishes, tomatoes, cabbages, carrots, cucumbers, one lemon. In the middle a bowl with cauliflowers. On the left a flask and a glass, on the right a bottle and a plate.

works.d: Valge pearätikuga naise pea 3/4 pöördes vasakule.
works.de: Head of a woman with a white headscarf, in 3/4 turn to the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil saan kihutavate hobustega (must, roosa, kaks punast - külgvaates). Saanis pukis ja tagaistmel heledas riietuses figuurid.
works.de: In the foreground a sledge with galloping horses (black, pink, two red - seen from the side). Figures in light-coloured clothing on the sledge's box seat and in the back seat.

works.dm: kõrgus: 20.5 cm (vm.); laius: 51.5 cm (pm.); laius: 39.5 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 33.0 cm (pm.)
works.d: Esiplaanil mererand jalutajatega ja sõidukitega; paremal meri, vasakul hooneid. Tagaplaanil Tallinna siluett.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, a sea shore with strollers and vehicles; sea on the right, buildings on the left. In the background, the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Laual ümarik vaagen roheliste ja siniste viinamarjadega. Vaagna taga vaas roosidega. Ees laua serval aprikoosid ja kimp roosasid ja punaseid nelke.
works.de: On a table a round platter with green and blue grapes. Behind the platter a vase with roses. In front, at the edge of the table, apricots and a bouquet of pink and red carnations.

works.d: Ees paremal rohtunud jõekäär liivase kaldaga. Vasakul ja tagapool keskel mättaline rohumaa põõsastega. Taga paremal kõrgel nõlvakul lehtpuumetsa siluett. Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the front right a grassy river bend with a sandy shore. On the left and behind in the center a tussocky meadow with bushes. Behind on the right on a high slope the silhouette of a deciduous forest. A cloudy sky over the landscape.

works.d: Ees vasakul kivine kiduva taimestikuga mäenõlvak. Paremal kitsas orus üksikud okspuud. Üle puude latvade näha teist nõlvakut lossi siluetiga selle harjal. Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
works.de: In front on the left a stony mountain slope with sparse vegetation. On the right, in a narrow valley, solitary branchy trees. Above the treetops another slope is visible with the silhouette of a castle on its ridge. A cloudy sky over the landscape.

works.d: Ees (2/5 tööst) meri arvukate purjepaatidega. 3/5 tööst pilvist taevast.
works.de: In front (2/5 of the work) sea with numerous sailing boats. 3/5 of the work cloudy sky.

works.d: Profiilis istuva naise poolfiguur heledas pluusis, tumedas seelikus.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman sitting in profile, in a light blouse, dark skirt.

works.d: Esiplaanil vanalinna punased viilkatused, paremal paistab raekoja torn ja televisioonimast. Vasakul taga lahesopp sadama ja kraanadega.
works.de: In the foreground the red gable roofs of the old town, on the right the town hall tower and a television mast are visible. On the left in the background a bay with a harbour and cranes.

works.d: Esiplaanil grupp istuvaid ja seisvaid figuure ähmaste majade kontuuride taustal.
works.de: In the foreground a group of seated and standing figures against a background of blurred house contours.

works.d: Pildipinda diagonaalselt läbivat jõge ääristavad tasased kaldapealsed, mis seejärel tõusevad järsult kõrgeks kaldaks. Tasasel alal inimesi, kaldapealsel sild, mida ületavad trammid.
works.de: The river running diagonally across the picture surface is bordered by flat riverbanks, which then rise steeply into a high bank. People on the flat area, a bridge on the bank, crossed by trams.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille vasak pool erkpunane, paremal pool mustades, roosades, sinistes toonides pinnad. Väga pastoosne maalifaktuur, kohati on maalikihti vormitud.
works.de: Abstract composition, the left side bright red, on the right side surfaces in black, pink, blue tones. Very pastose painting texture, in places the paint layer has been shaped.

works.d: Punaste õitega suvinelgi oks.
works.de: Branch of summer carnation with red flowers.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremale suunduv tänav madalate majade ja inimestega. Taga paistab tornidega kirik. Vasakult paremale telefoni postid traatidega.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a street running diagonally to the right, with low houses and people. Behind, a church with towers can be seen. From left to right, telephone poles with wires.

works.d: Rannal, võrgukuuri nurga juures viiest inimesest grupp: paremal hoogsalt sammuv naine selgvaates, toidukorv vasakus käes, paremas rätt lehvituseks tõstetud; tema kõrval selgvaates mees ja väike tüdruk kaugemal rannajoonel paistvale purjekale järele vaatamas. Esiplaanil vasakul külgvaates põlvitav poiss ja tüdruk võrke parandamas. Küpsed beežid, pruunid, sinised toonid, ümarselgselt vorme välja maaliv laad.(eesti)
works.de: On the beach, by the corner of a net shed, a group of five people: on the right a briskly walking woman seen frontally, a food basket in her left hand, a kerchief raised in her right hand for waving; next to her a man seen frontally and a small girl, further along the shoreline, watching a sailboat that is visible. In the foreground on the left a kneeling boy and girl seen in profile, mending nets. Mature beige, brown, blue tones, a style painting forms out with rounded clarity.

works.d: Maastiku esiplaanil paremast nurgast üle jõe diagonaalselt vasakule mäkke suunduval teel kaks muistses relvastuses meest, mäest all astumas. Nendele vastu suundub salk mehi suure palgiga. Mäe jalal, üle jõekärestiku viival sillal härjarakenduses vanker palgikoormaga. Keskel linnamäe järsul nõlval näha mehi palke linnuse poole veeretamas. Ees vasakul, linnamäe jalal, muistne asula; selle tagant paistab jõekäär.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground of the landscape, on a road leading diagonally from the right corner across the river to the mountain on the left, two men in ancient armament are descending the mountain. Towards them moves a group of men with a large log. At the foot of the mountain, on a bridge leading over the river rapids, a cart with a load of logs drawn by oxen. In the centre, on the steep slope of the hill fort, men can be seen rolling logs towards the stronghold. In the foreground on the left, at the foot of the hill fort, an ancient settlement; behind it a bend of the river is visible.

works.d: Neljavärviline geomeetriline kompositsioon põigiti üksteise alla paigutatud kahest ühesuurusest ristkülikust. Vaarikapunasel foonil ülaosas pisut paremale nihutatud lillakassinine, selle all rohekassinine nelinurk veidi vasakul. Kujundite taga heledam punane, vahel peen triip.
works.de: A four-coloured geometric composition of two rectangles of equal size placed diagonally one below the other. On a raspberry-red background, a purplish-blue quadrangle shifted slightly to the right at the top, below it a greenish-blue quadrangle slightly to the left. Behind the shapes, a lighter red, with a thin stripe in between.

works.d: Diagonaalselt kaheks jaotatud maalipind: alumine osa ja parempoolne serv sidrunkollased, ristuvate kollaste joonte abil nelinurkadeks jaotatud. Ülaosas sirelililla pind, mida jaotavad nelinurkadeks kuldsed ja roosakaslillad ristuvad jooned.
works.de: Painted surface divided diagonally into two: the lower part and the right-hand edge lemon yellow, divided into rectangles by intersecting yellow lines. In the upper part a lilac surface, divided into rectangles by intersecting golden and pinkish-lilac lines.

works.d: Ühest silmitust ja laialivalguva figuuriga ookrikarva naisest ja roosast, ühe silmaga mehest koosnev kompositsioon. Mõlema väljasirutatud käe pihus valge nelinurk. Roosa figuuri ees kolmest kaarest koosnev ehituskonstruktsioon. Vasakust servast sirutub pilti käsi. Foonil sipelgapesakujulised pruunid kuhilad, ülal erksinine taevas.(eesti)
works.de: A composition consisting of an eyeless, dissolving-figured ochre-coloured woman and a pink, one-eyed man. Both have a white rectangle held in an outstretched hand's palm. In front of the pink figure a construction consisting of three arches. From the left edge a hand reaches into the picture. In the background brown mounds shaped like anthills, above them a bright blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil, punasel, valge linaga kaetud pingil külitab roosa, priskete vormidega aktifiguur. Kõrgele tõstetud käest upitab suhu punast kirssi. Foonil vasakul sarlakpunane draperii, paremal ookrikarva, tõrjuvalt käed kokku pannud silmitu ja näotu figuur. Viimase selja taha jääva fooni osa taevasinine.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, on a red bench covered with a white cloth, reclines a pink, plump-formed nude figure. From a raised hand she lifts a red cherry to her mouth. In the background on the left a scarlet-red drapery, on the right an ochre-coloured, eyeless and faceless figure with hands clasped together defensively. The part of the background behind the latter's back is sky-blue.

works.d: Keset kollast maad stiliseeritud lill. Ümber lille lendlevad liblikad.

works.d: Esiplaanil kiriku interjööris avatud haud. Ees paremal ja taga vasakul inimgrupid.
works.de: In the foreground, in a church interior, an open grave. Groups of people in front on the right and behind on the left.

works.d: Tumeda lõuahabemega, tumedas rõivastuses istuva mehe figuur, käed põlvede vahel. Foon tumepunane.
works.de: Figure of a seated man with a dark chin beard, in dark clothing, hands between his knees. Background dark red.

works.d: Istuva vanema mehe kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes paremale. Hallid juuksed, prillid, sinine ülikond, hall vest, hele särk. Vasak käsi põlvedel, paremas ajakiri.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an older seated man, in a half-turn to the right. Grey hair, glasses, blue suit, grey vest, light shirt. Left hand on his knees, a magazine in his right.

works.d: Rahvarohke linnaväljak ülaltvaates. Väljaku keskel roheline skväär pinkidega, seda ümbritsevate laternapostide ja hallide kuulutustulpadega. Skvääri taga suur sammaste ja skulptuuridega kaunistatud ühiskondlik hoone. Paremal esiplaanil halli kivimaja nurk. Vasakul, valgustatumas servas majade ja puudega ääristatud tänav ühiskondliku hoone nurga taha kadumas. Vasakul all rahvahulgast ümbritsetud sõdurid aerostaadiga. Ülal sinine taevas, milles lendavad aerostaadid.(eesti)
works.de: A crowded city square seen from above. In the centre of the square a green square [skväär] with benches, surrounded by lamp posts and grey advertisement pillars. Behind the square a large public building decorated with columns and sculptures. On the right in the foreground, the corner of a grey stone house. On the left, in the more illuminated part, a street lined with houses and trees disappearing behind the corner of the public building. Lower left, soldiers with an aerostat surrounded by a crowd. Above, a blue sky in which aerostats are flying.

works.d: Punakaspruunist foonist otsekui ilmutusena eralduv mehe pea: pikad pruunid juuksed, sirge nina, väikesed vuntsid ja habe, terane puuriv pilk, kulm kergelt kortsus. Pildi pind kohati pastoosne, maalitud ühe punakaspruuni tooni astmestikku kasutades.(eesti)
works.de: A man's head emerging as if an apparition from a reddish-brown background: long brown hair, straight nose, small moustache and beard, a keen piercing gaze, brow slightly furrowed. The surface of the picture is in places pastose, painted using a gradation of a single reddish-brown tone.

works.dm: laius: 45.0 cm (parem tiib   ); laius: 50.0 cm (keskosa   ); kõrgus: 22.0 cm (vasak tiib   ); kõrgus: 47.0 cm (parem tiib   )
works.d: Maal koosneb ristkülikukujulisest lõuendist keskosas ja hingede abil kinnitatud eri suuruse ja kujuga puust tiibadest mõlema külje ülaosas. Tiibu saab liigutada allääres paikneva varda abil. Kroomrohelistes, punakais toonides mustade sik-sak joonte ja kontuuridega kompositsioon. Ülaosas aimatav katuseviil sünge lillakassinise, kuusirbiga taeva foonil. All vasakul stiliseeritud kuusk. Roosakaspunastel tiibadel jõulised tumedad sik-sak-jooned. Maalitud ekspressiivselt laia, näiliselt lohaka pintsliga.(eesti)
works.de: The painting consists of a rectangular canvas in the central part and wooden wings of various sizes and shapes attached with hinges at the top of both sides. The wings can be moved with the help of a rod located at the lower edge. A composition in chromium green, reddish tones with black zigzag lines and contours. In the upper part, a gable roof is discernible against a gloomy purplish-blue sky with a crescent moon. Lower left, a stylised spruce. On the pinkish-red wings, forceful dark zigzag lines. Painted expressively with a broad, seemingly careless brush.

works.de: At the top of the work, above the water, a naked woman lies on a thick tree branch, her gaze directed at the crocodile-bodied, human-headed creatures beneath the tree.

works.d: Lehestiku taustal paljastatud õla ja rinnaga istuv naine, keha poolprofiilis paremale, pea vaatega vasakule. Seljatagant embab teda alasti mehefiguur.
Vasakul mererannikul kasvava jämedatüvelise puu otsas niuete ümber mähitud punase rätikuga alasti naisfiguur. Ülakeha all kummardatud. All paremal tumedanahalise mehe poolfiguur. Paremal taga meri.

works.d: Naise pea alt üles vaadatuna profiilis vasakule. Pea osas taust tumepruun.
Mehe rinnapilt peaaegu profiilis paremale. Peas loorberipärg, suu pisut avatud. Paremas käes sulg kirjutamisasendis.
works.de: Chest portrait of a man almost in profile to the right. A laurel wreath on his head, mouth slightly open. A quill in his right hand in writing position.

works.d: Faktuursele aluspinnale pikkade pintslitõmmete ja selgelt eristavate värvipindadega maalitud vaikelu: keskpunktis kollane, sangaga anum, mille ees paremal pealtvaates kauss puuviljadega. Nõusid ümbritsevad igast küljest värviliste kaantega raamatud. Et värv pole kõiki pinnareljeefi õnarusi täitnud, kumab paiguti alt läbi hele krunt.
works.de: A still life painted on a textured ground with long brushstrokes and clearly distinct areas of colour: in the centre a yellow vessel with a handle, in front of which, on the right, seen from above, a bowl with fruit. The vessels are surrounded on all sides by books with colourful covers. As the paint has not filled all the cavities of the surface relief, the light-coloured ground shines through in places.

works.d: Maapind ja puude grupp, millest tõuseb üks mänd teistest kõrgemale kuni maali ülaservani, maalitud pruunikates ja tumerohelistes toonides ja lahtiste pintslilöökidega, osaliselt lõuendit katmata jättes. Tagapoolne järvepind antud hallides toonides, peegeldused rohekad. Eemal metsaviirg ja riba hallikat taevast. Meeleolu melanhoolne.
works.de: The ground and a group of trees, from which one pine rises higher than the others up to the upper edge of the painting, painted in brownish and dark green tones with loose brush strokes, in places leaving the canvas uncovered. The lake surface behind is rendered in grey tones, the reflections greenish. In the distance a strip of forest and a band of grey sky. The mood is melancholic.

works.d: Keskplaanis pastelltoonides metsamassiiv. Esiplaanil kohati sulanud ja maa paljastanud lumi. Ülal sinine taevas. Maalitud tihedate, nähtavate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the middle ground a forest massif in pastel tones. In the foreground, snow partly melted and revealing the ground. Above, blue sky. Painted with dense, visible brush strokes.

works.d: Sinisel toolil istuv noor naine profiilis vasakule. Kõrges soengus tumedad juuksed, hall seelik, kollane džemper.
works.de: A young woman sitting on a blue chair, in profile facing left. Dark hair in a high hairstyle, grey skirt, yellow jumper.

works.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur otsevaates, pea kergelt vasakule pööratud. Käed süles. Sinisekirju pluus, roosakirju põll.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman in frontal view, head turned slightly to the left. Hands in her lap. Blue-patterned blouse, pinkish-patterned apron.

works.d: Ülaltvaade lillakas ööhämaruses tänavale. Eespool kõrged puud, nende all vasakul punakad kioskid, kuulutustepost, üksikute jalakäijate siluetid kõnniteel. Tagapool paremal suure heleda hoone ees autoteel kolm sõiduautot. Kaugemal tumelillad katused, linna tuledekuma. Maal rohekaslillas gammas, ühtlaselt sile pintslikäsitlus. (Vaade Kunstihoone aknast Pärnu maanteele).
works.de: A view from above onto a street in purplish nightfall dusk. In front, tall trees, under them on the left reddish kiosks, an advertising post, silhouettes of solitary pedestrians on the pavement. Further back on the right, in front of a large light-colored building, three cars on the road. Further away, dark purple roofs, the glow of city lights. The painting is in a greenish-purple range, with an evenly smooth brush handling. (View from the window of the Art Hall onto Pärnu maantee).

works.d: Keskealise, prillidega, tumesinises baretis ja mantlis mehe poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Foon oranž.
works.de: The half-figure of a middle-aged man with glasses, in a dark blue beret and coat, slightly turned to the left. Orange background.

works.d: Kõrge taeva taustal astumas kollase juuksepahmakuga sinisilmne mees, paremas käes vilepill, vasakus kelluke. Mehel seljas lopsaka kraega ooker-oranž arlekiinikuub, jalas põlvpüksid, peas tuttmüts. Paremal tema ees lõvi poolfiguur, pilk vaatajal. Silmapiiril paistmas helesinised mäed. Dekoratiivsed sinised-oranžid toonid.(eesti)
works.de: Against a background of high sky, a blue-eyed man with a shock of yellow hair is striding forward, a pipe in his right hand, a small bell in his left. The man wears an ochre-orange harlequin coat with a lavish collar, knee breeches, and a tasselled cap. On the right, a half-figure of a lion faces the viewer with its gaze. Light blue mountains are visible on the horizon. Decorative blue-orange tones.

Valged, kollased ja roosad krüsanteemiõied.
Kasvuhoone katuse all punased ja valged õied rohelises lehestikus.
works.de: Red and white flowers in green foliage under a greenhouse roof.

works.d: Esiplaanil veeloik ja lagendik karjaga. Keskel antiikse akvedukti varemed, mis pika sammastereana ulatuvad  tagaplaanil asuvate sinetavate mägedeni.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a puddle and a clearing with a herd. In the middle the ruins of an antique aqueduct, which extend as a long row of columns in the background to bluish mountains.

works.d: Tänavapilt Toompealt. Vasakult tänavaäärse aiamüüri nurk laternaga, üle müüri ulatuvate lehtpuuokstega, paremal tänavaäärseid maju. Tänaval inimesi. Taamal üle risttänavat piiravate majade katuste paistab Niguliste kiriku torni ülemine osa kuni kiivri poole kõrguseni.
works.de: Street view from Toompea. On the left, the corner of a garden wall along the street with a lantern, with leafy tree branches extending over the wall, on the right houses along the street. People on the street. In the distance, above the roofs of the houses bordering the cross street, the upper part of St. Nicholas' Church tower is visible up to about the height of its spire.

works.d: Noor tütarlaps otsevaates istuvas asendis, käed asetatud põlvedele, käte vahel raamat. Tumedad käharad juuksed lahuga keskel, hallikassinine pluus ja kootud vest.
works.de: A young girl seated, in frontal view, hands placed on her knees, a book between her hands. Dark curly hair parted in the middle, a greyish-blue blouse and a knitted vest.

works.d: Trellitatud avause taustal seisva mehe poolfiguur. Paremal peopesal sakilise servaga ese. All ääres sakiliste servadega ketaste riba.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a man standing against the background of a barred opening. On the right palm a jagged-edged object. Along the bottom edge a strip of jagged-edged discs.

works.d: Väikesel pruunil laual keraamiline vaas kimbu lillade, punaste ja oranzikate gladioolidega. Fooniks rohelistes - pruunides toonides pinnad.(eesti)
works.de: On a small brown table a ceramic vase with a bunch of purple, red and orangey gladioli. Background surfaces in green-brown tones.

works.d: Väike, ümaravormiline vaas sinistest, lillakatest ning oranžikaist väikeõielistest lilledest buketiga. Foon pruun.(eesti)
works.de: A small, roundish vase with a bouquet of small blue, purplish and orangish flowers. Brown background.

Vasakult paremale liikuv kolmik: vana, halli habemega mees kahe tütarlapse vahel.
works.de: A trio moving from left to right: an old man with a grey beard between two young girls.

works.de: In the upper part of the work, separated by a brown line, a woman leaning against a cliff, her lower body wrapped in a black veil. In the lower part of the work, a sailboat floating on a river.

works.d: Punakas, vasakus servas siniste varjunditega taustal diagonaalselt üle kogu pildi pinna kaheharuline, valgete õitega kirsipuu oks.(eesti)
works.de: Against a reddish background with bluish shades in the left margin, a two-branched cherry-tree bough with white blossoms diagonally across the entire picture surface.

works.d: Viis ühenäolist noormeest lillakates särkides ja rohelistes pükstes paremalt vasemale jooksmas.(eesti)
works.de: Five identical-faced young men in purplish shirts and green trousers running from right to left.

Esiplaanil rohumaa. Tagapool tihe võsa.
Esiplaanil liivane maa; selle taga, kõrge põõsastiku taga, okaspuid.
Puisniidul paremal üks lamav, tagapool seisev lehm. Taga vasemal kolm puud.
works.de: In a wooded meadow on the right one lying, behind it one standing cow. Behind on the left three trees.

works.d: Paremal punane, vasakul valge hobune võidusõidukaariku ja juhiga.
works.de: On the right a red, on the left a white horse with a racing cart and driver.

works.d: Esiplaanil tasane niit. Taga mets.
works.de: Flat meadow in the foreground. Forest behind.

works.d: Vikerkaarevärviliste horisontaalsete, omavahel sulavate värviviirgudega (tumesinine, punane, kollane, helesinine, roheline, roosa) taeva foonil ning tumerohelises kollakasroheliste laikudega vees keskplaanil maali vasakust servast peaaegu parema servani ümarate liigendatud vormidega roheline laid, lillakasroosade värviaktsentidega põõsastikus, üksiku puuga. Paremas kuldlõikes ees vees jämedatüviline sihvakas, lopsaka krooniga puu. Pastoosne, faktuurne maalikäsitlus.(eesti)
works.de: Against a sky background of rainbow-coloured horizontal, blending colour stripes (dark blue, red, yellow, light blue, green, pink) and in the middle ground in dark green water with yellowish-green patches, a green islet with rounded articulated forms stretching from the left edge of the painting almost to the right edge, with shrubbery in purplish-pink colour accents and a solitary tree. In the golden section on the right, in the foreground in the water, a slender tree with a thick trunk and lush crown. Pastose, textured painting technique.

works.d: 9 alasti meesfiguuri allservast kuni ülaservani punasel taustal ruudulisel põrandal. Vasakul avaneb kitsast aknast vaade maastikule puu ja kõrgete lumiste mägedega.(eesti)
works.de: 9 naked male figures from the bottom edge to the top edge on a red background on a chequered floor. At left a view opens through a narrow window onto a landscape with a tree and high snowy mountains.

works.d: Kollakais-punakais toonides kompositsioon sidrunkollase taeva foonil. Keskel neli meest ringis, kolm istumas, üks seismas. Nende ees hülged.(eesti)
works.de: A composition in yellowish-reddish tones against a lemon-yellow sky background. In the middle four men in a circle, three sitting, one standing. In front of them, seals.

works.d: Tumedal ultramariinsel kergelt lainetaval merel 9 kalapüügileva. Taevas sinakas-hallides pilvedes, paremal silmapiiri lähedal kollane.(eesti)
works.de: On a dark ultramarine, slightly rippling sea, 9 fishing boats. Sky in bluish-grey clouds, yellow near the horizon on the right.

works.d: Metsalagendikul seisva noore sõdurivormis mehe poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a young man in soldier's uniform standing on a forest clearing, in a slight turn to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelisse rõivastatud inimesi metsatööl, tagapool heleda katusega maja, mille ees seisab punane hobune veokiga.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground people dressed in green at forest work, behind a house with a light-coloured roof, in front of which stands a red horse with a cart.

works.d: Künklik maastik veekoguga paremal. Maapind kollakas-rohekates toonides, majad heledad. Tagaplaanil puid. Maalitud pastoosselt.
works.de: Hilly landscape with a body of water on the right. Ground in yellowish-greenish tones, houses light-coloured. Trees in the background. Painted pastosely.

works.d: Erksavärviline abstraktne kompositsioon. Ühtlaselt erekollast alumist osa läbib keskelt sinine, punakasoranzide krähmudega kaarjas vööt, mis laieneb ülalpool peene pintslikirjaga maalitud aimatavaks maastikuks. Ülal vasakul arvatavad heledad mäetipud rohekal, paremal roosakaspunasel taustal.
works.de: A vividly coloured abstract composition. The uniformly bright yellow lower part is crossed in the middle by a blue, arching band with reddish-orange scrawls, which widens above into a suggested landscape painted with fine brushwork. At upper left, presumed light mountain peaks against a greenish background, at right against a pinkish-red background.

works.d: Järve kaldal keskel ja paremal metsa ääres talumajad sinatavate korstendega. Keskplaanil nõlvak, silmapiiril mets. Hele koloriit.
works.de: On the shore of a lake, in the middle and on the right at the edge of a forest, farmhouses with bluish chimneys. In the middle ground a slope, on the horizon a forest. Light colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kahe künka vahel, puudega kaetud nõgu. Paremal künkal kasvavad puud; vasakul kaks talumaja. Tagaplaanil soo taga linnakese panoraam. Taevas pilves.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, between two hills, a hollow covered with trees. On the right hill trees growing; on the left two farmhouses. In the background, beyond the marsh, a panorama of a small town. The sky cloudy.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel diagonaalselt vasakult paremale suunduv kivide rida. Nendest vasakul tagaplaanil ranna ääres järsu kalju jalal kivid.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a row of stones running diagonally from left to right. To their left in the background, at the foot of a steep cliff by the shore, stones.

works.d: Esiplaanil küngas. Keskosas parv lendavaid linde. Taustaks äikseline taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a hill. In the middle a flock of flying birds. Background a stormy sky.

works.dm: laius: 71.5 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 60.0 cm; kõrgus: 58.0 cm (vm.   ); laius: 73.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil mitmekesine taimestik, tagaplaanil üksikud puud, tara ja paremal majanurk. Kaugemal puid.
works.de: In the foreground varied vegetation, in the background single trees, a fence and on the right the corner of a house. Trees further away.

works.d: Keskel eest tahapoole suunduv tänav. Vasakul müür ja majad, paremal majad ja nende tugev vari langemas tänavale.
works.de: In the middle a street running from front to back. On the left a wall and houses, on the right houses and their strong shadow falling onto the street.

works.d: Vaade sadamale hämaruses. Pildi ulatuses laevu, kraanasid, töölisi. Ees suures plaanis tööline, pilk ülespoole suunatud. Kauguses vasakul paistab Oleviste torn.
works.de: View of the harbour at dusk. Ships, cranes, workers throughout the picture. In front, in large scale, a worker with gaze directed upward. In the distance on the left the tower of Oleviste is visible.

works.d: Mustal foonil üks punakaspruun ja üks rohekas pudel ning kaks klaasi.
works.de: One reddish-brown and one greenish bottle and two glasses on a black background.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud suured puud. Nende vahelt paremal näha üksik roosakas hoone. Taga vasakul puud.
works.de: In the foreground solitary large trees. Between them on the right a single pinkish building is visible. Behind on the left, trees.

works.d: 1/4 kujutatud künklik maastik üksikute hoonetega. 3/4 ulatuses pilvine taevas.
works.de: 1/4 depicts a hilly landscape with individual buildings. 3/4 cloudy sky.

works.t: V. Kingissepa konspiratiivkorteri perenaine A. Reinfeldt
works.d: Naise portree 3/4 profiilis vasakule. Seljas sile must kleit kraega. Juuksed siledalt kammitud.
works.de: Portrait of a woman in 3/4 profile to the left. Wearing a smooth black dress with a collar. Hair combed smoothly.

works.d: Hämaras talutoas, vasakul profiilis paremale voki taga istuv ja ketrav keskealine naine paljajalu, peas lõua alt seotud hele rätik, seljas tumedad rõivad ja hele põll. Paremal, tulekolde ees, profiilis paremale, pea tagantvaates kükitav, paljasjalgne figuur. Interjööris, taga keskel lauduks, mille kõrval paremal seinal suur kulp. Maalitud tumedates, pruunides-hallides toonides.
works.de: In a dim farmhouse room, on the left in profile facing right, a middle-aged woman sits spinning behind a spinning wheel, barefoot, her head covered with a light-coloured kerchief tied under the chin, wearing dark clothing and a light apron. On the right, in front of the hearth fire, in profile facing right, seen from behind, a crouching, barefoot figure. In the interior, at the back in the centre a table, beside which on the right wall a large ladle. Painted in dark, brown-grey tones.

works.d: Rohekas-sinine ümmarguna vaas, milles suur kimp roosakas-lillasid krüsanteeme. Foon kergelt pruunikas-beež.
works.de: A greenish-blue round vase with a large bunch of pinkish-purple chrysanthemums. Background slightly brownish-beige.

works.d: Seisva naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Prillid, seljas hall kittel. Paremas käes kimp pintsleid.
works.de: Half-figure of a standing woman in frontal view. Glasses, wearing a grey smock. In her right hand a bundle of brushes.

works.t: Krimmi maastik. Mšatka mõis Baidaari väravatega
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, pildi äärel kuni silmapiirini ulatuv meri, millest keskel, kalda läheduses, ulatub välja kaljutippe; paremal kivine rannariba, mille läheduses suurem lehtpuu. Puu otsas karusnahkse mütsi ja põhitoonis punase särgiga noormees puu ümber põimunud viinamarja väätidelt korjatud kobaraid korviga alla laskmas; korvile vastu sirutuva puu all oleva heledapäise lapse käed. Läheduses noor, punast pihikuga seelikut ja valget pluusi kandev pikkade, seljal lahtiselt rippuvate juustega naine puu küljest allarippuvat viinamarjavääti haaramas. Keskel, vasakule mere poole kalduv mäeveerg lopsaka taimestikuga, mille hulgas palju küpresse. Taga paremal pildi ülemisest äärest välja ulatuv kal
works.de: In the foreground on the left, at the edge of the picture, the sea extends to the horizon; in the middle of it, near the shore, rocky peaks rise up; on the right a rocky strip of shore, near which stands a larger deciduous tree. At the top of the tree, a young man in a fur cap and a shirt predominantly red in tone is lowering a basket down with bunches of grapes gathered from the vine tendrils twined around the tree; below, a fair-haired child under the tree stretches out its hands toward the basket. Nearby, a young woman with a red bodice and skirt and a white blouse, with long hair hanging loose over her back, is grasping a vine tendril hanging down from the tree. In the middle, a mountain slope sloping to the left toward the sea, with lush vegetation, among which many cypresses. Further back on the right, a cl[iff] extending beyond the upper edge of the picture

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivine rand. Vasakul kaldavesi, milles kaks paati kaluritega. Tagaplaanil paremal väikesel künkal varemeis linnusemüürid ja ühekordne õlgkatusega hoone. Silmapiiril vasakul ähmane rannaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a stony shore. On the left, coastal water with two boats with fishermen. In the background on the right, on a small hill, ruined fortress walls and a single-story straw-roofed building. On the horizon on the left, a hazy coastline.

works.d: Lapse rinnapilt poolpöördega vasakule. Peas kübar, seljas hele jakk tumeda kraega.
works.de: Chest-portrait of a child, half-turned to the left. A hat on the head, a light-coloured jacket with a dark collar.

works.dm: laius: 31.8 cm (aluspapi mõõt); kõrgus: 19.8 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 28.7 cm (aluspapi mõõt); laius: 20.5 cm (lm.)
works.d: Keskel Pikk Hermann tsaaririigi trikolooriga lipumastis (poolvardas); ümber majad. Ees paremal müüriäärsel teel üksik naisfiguur. Vasemal majakatus, puuladvad; taga meri purjekatega.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre Pikk Hermann with the tricolour flag of the tsarist empire on the flagpole (at half-mast); houses around it. In front on the right a solitary female figure on the road along the wall. On the left a roof of a house, treetops; behind, the sea with sailboats.

works.d: Pikemate juuste, kitsa näoga istuva noormehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, parem käsi põlvel, vasakus kõverdatud käes sigaret. Seljas sinine särk, tume pintsak, liivpruunid püksid. Taga vasakul osa aknast, selle ees rohekas lauanurk tumerohelise pokaaliga. Erksad värvitoonid, selgepiirilised vormid.
works.de: A half-figure of a seated young man with longer hair and a narrow face, in a half-turn to the left, right hand on the knee, a cigarette in the bent left hand. Wearing a blue shirt, a dark jacket, sand-brown trousers. Behind on the left part of a window, in front of it a greenish table corner with a dark green goblet. Vivid colour tones, sharply defined forms.

works.d: Paremal istuva, raamatut lugeva noore mehe kolmveerandfiguur. Vasakul noore naise istuv kolmveerandfiguur, nägu pöördes lugeja poole, pilk suunatud raamatusse; käed vabalt süles. Töö maalitud erksates oranžides toonides.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a young man sitting on the right, reading a book. On the left a three-quarter figure of a young woman sitting, her face turned toward the reader, her gaze directed at the book; hands resting loosely in her lap. The work is painted in vivid orange tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal pruunid kaljurahnud, keskel lagendik asulaga, taga lumiste tippudega mäeahelik.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 38.3 cm; lehe laius: 49.5 cm
works.d: Ees paremal mägedevaheline org. Vasakul ees mäeahelik üksikute puukestega, selle taga kaljuplatool varemed. Silmapiiril mäed.
works.de: In front on the right a valley between mountains. On the left in front a mountain range with individual small trees, behind it ruins on a rocky plateau. On the horizon mountains.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 39.5 cm; lehe laius: 58.8 cm
works.d: Ees meri kivise kaldaribaga. Merel sõudepaadid ja purjekas. Kaugemal merest kerkiv koonusekujuline, tipust suitsu välja ajav mägi.
works.de: In the foreground the sea with a rocky shoreline strip. Rowing boats and a sailboat on the sea. Farther away a cone-shaped mountain rising from the sea, emitting smoke from its top.

works.d: Krähmuliste joonte, täppide ja kuldse joonega piiratud tumedas aknaavas punase kleidiga, unistava ilmega noore naise kuju. Käed toetuvad ette aknalauale. Ekspressiivses laadis naivistlikult kujutatud.
works.de: The figure of a young woman with a dreamy expression, in a red dress, in a dark window opening bordered by scrawly lines, dots and a golden line. Her hands rest on the windowsill in front of her. Depicted in an expressive, naivistic manner.

works.d: Üle kogu pildi pinna vanalinna majade rägastik, vaatega ülalt katustelt. Ülal vasakus nurgas Vene katedraal, selle kõrval Niguliste äralõigatud torn.
works.de: Across the whole surface of the picture a maze of old-town houses, viewed from above the rooftops. In the upper left corner the Russian cathedral, next to it the cut-off tower of Niguliste.

works.d: Hõõguvates soojades toonides panoraammaastik: esiplaanil punane küngas ja üksikud puutüved, kesk- ja tagaplaanil hoogsate pintslilöökidega antud küngastik ja tume, lehtedeta kevadine mets. Ülal kollane taevas.
works.de: A panoramic landscape in glowing warm tones: in the foreground a red hillock and solitary tree trunks, in the middle and background a hilly terrain rendered with vigorous brushstrokes and a dark, leafless spring forest. Above, a yellow sky.

works.d: Summutatud pruunides, rohelistes, kahkjas-kollastes ja sinakais toonides mets taeva taustal. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
works.de: A muted forest in brown, green, pale-yellow and bluish tones against a sky background. The painted surface is slightly textured.

works.d: Otsevaates tumedajuukselise, suurte tumedate silmadega noormehe portree. Seljas lahtise kaelusega valge särk. Maalitud piimjates toonides.
works.de: Portrait of a young man with dark hair and large dark eyes, in frontal view. Wearing a white shirt with an open collar. Painted in milky tones.

works.d: Abstraktsetest voolavatest kujunditest komponeeritud pilt mõnede vihjetega tegelikkusele: keskel sinine, tooli meenutav iste, millel rohelistes ja pruunides toonides "naiseks" nimetatud kujund. Foon allosas ookrikarva, ülal väikestest sinistest ja rohelistest rombidest koosnev.(eesti)
works.de: A picture composed of abstract flowing shapes with some hints of reality: in the centre a blue seat resembling a chair, on which a shape called "the woman", in green and brown tones. The background at the bottom is ochre-coloured, above made up of small blue and green rhombi.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Õlgadel punane, kirju lillemustriga linik. Taustaks maastik.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in half-profile to the left. On her shoulders a red, patterned kerchief with floral design. Landscape in the background.

works.d: Paremal ja vasemal valkja taeva taustal suured majad. Keskel madalam garaazisarnane ehitus.
Lopsakalt maalitud kollastes, mustades, punastes ja sinistes toonides peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina antud kaks figuuri valgel, roosa ja halliga varjutatud foonil.
works.de: Painted luxuriantly in yellow, black, red and blue tones, two figures given as a combination of almost abstract patches of colour, on a white background shaded with pink and grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumedal taustal poolviltu asendis klaviatuuriga muusikariist, selle taga musitseerib ovaalse deformeerunud inimnäo ja sopilise peaga kuju. Vasakul rombikujuliselt paigutatud neli figuuri, maskid ees, mille tagant paistavad sopilised pead. Kõik figuurid maalitud hõõguvpunastes, pruunides toonides.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, against a dark background, a keyboard instrument set at an angle, behind which a figure with an oval, deformed human face and a hunched head is making music. On the left, four figures arranged in a rhombus, masks in front, from behind which hunched heads show. All figures are painted in glowing red and brown tones.

works.d: Vasakul elektrisinise ja paremal punastes toonides, kollase käe siluetiga taustal roosades toonides maalitud üleelusuurune noormehe nägu, poolpöördes vasakule. Teineteisest kaugel asetsevate erksiniste silmade vaade suunatud vaatajale. Kollakaspruunide vuntside ning lõuahabeme vahelt paistavad täidlased huuled. Kõrva piiril punakaspruunid lainelised pinnad.(eesti)
works.de: On the left in electric blue and on the right in red tones, against a background painted in pink tones with the silhouette of a yellow hand, an over-life-size face of a young man, in a half-turn to the left. The gaze of the bright blue eyes, set far apart, is directed at the viewer. Full lips show through between the yellowish-brown moustache and the chin beard. Reddish-brown wavy surfaces at the edge of the ear.

works.d: Purpurroosal alusel ja madala horisondiga, alt punaka, läbi kollase ülal valgeks ja roosakaks muutuval foonil kaks sopiliste peadega abstraktset pooltorsot, vasemal tumedamas, paremal heledamas pruunis toonis. Nende vahel kaks ebamäärase kujuga vormi heldamas ja tumedamas punases toonis, millede ees lebab oranž käsi sidrunikollase sigaritaolise esemega sõrmede vahel.(eesti)
works.de: On a purple-pink base with a low horizon, on a background reddish at the bottom, turning through yellow to white and pink at the top, two abstract half-torsos with lobed heads, the one on the left in a darker, the one on the right in a lighter brown tone. Between them two vaguely shaped forms in lighter and darker red tones, in front of which lies an orange hand with a lemon-yellow cigar-like object between the fingers.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm mehekuju, kaks kividel istumas, üks püsti. Keskel vasakul rannale tõmmatud paate. Vasakul äärel üksik purjepaat. Tagaplaanil kaks õlgkatusega hoonet ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground three male figures, two sitting on stones, one standing. In the middle on the left, boats pulled up onto the shore. On the left edge a single sailboat. In the background two thatch-roofed buildings and trees.

works.d: Keskealise daami poolfiguur en face toolil istumas. Õlal kollane-valgekirju kass, süles must kass roheliste silmadega. Pross, sõrmused ja käevõru türkiisidega.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged lady sitting on a chair, en face. On her shoulder a yellow-and-white patterned cat, in her lap a black cat with green eyes. Brooch, rings and a bracelet with turquoises.

works.d: Vanema inimese ja noore kollasejuukselise tütarlapse rinnafiguurid otsevaates. Lapsel seljas punane kleit, käes lilleõis. Vanema inimese riietus roheline.
works.de: Bust figures of an elderly person and a young girl with yellow hair, in full-face view. The child wears a red dress, holding a flower blossom in her hand. The elderly person's clothing is green.

works.d: Noore ruugejuukselise naise rinnapilt otsevaates. Kõrvu vabaks jättev soeng otselahuga keskel. Riietuseks tumedat tooni rüüzkaunistusega kleit valge mahapööratud krae ja tumepunase ristsõlmes kaelasidemega.
works.de: Frontal half-length portrait of a young reddish-haired woman. Hairstyle leaving the ears free with a straight parting in the middle. Dressed in a dark-toned dress decorated with a frill, a white turned-down collar and a dark red neck tie in a cross-knot.

works.d: Interjööris istuv keskealine tumedajuukseline naine profiilis vasakule, pea pööratud üle vasaku õla, pilk vaatajal. Figuur lõigatud pahkluude kohalt. Naisel seljas punasekirju, lopsakate varrukatega ja punase volangiga kittelkleit. Vasak kõverdatud käsi õla kõrgusel tema ees oleval kollakasrohelisel vaibataolisel esemel. Maalitud pastoosselt jõulise, tihke pintslilöögiga.
works.de: A middle-aged dark-haired woman sitting in an interior, in profile to the left, head turned over the left shoulder, gaze directed at the viewer. The figure cut off at ankle level. The woman wears a red-patterned smock dress with full sleeves and a red flounce. Her left bent arm at shoulder height rests on a yellowish-green carpet-like object in front of her. Painted pastosely with a vigorous, dense brushstroke.

works.d: Männimetsa ees liivalagendik üksikute roheliste põõsatuttidega paremal. Metsaserval ruugel hobusel tumedasse riietatud ratsanik külgvaates liikumas vasakule.
Vaade hilissuvistele põldudele.
works.de: View of late-summer fields.

works.d: Keskel ülalpool valges rõivais Kristus kiirtevihus. Temast paremal ja vasakul üks Vana Testamendi pühak, kes kummarduvad kergelt Kristuse pool (Elijas ja Mooses?). All mägede taustal kolm Jeesuse jüngrit põlvitamas (Peetrus, Johannes, Jakobus?).
works.de: In the centre above, Christ in white robes in a burst of rays. To his right and left, one Old Testament saint each, bowing slightly towards Christ (Elijah and Moses?). Below, against a background of mountains, three of Jesus' disciples kneeling (Peter, John, James?).

works.d: Värviplekkide virvenduses eraldub ristilöödu figuur ja näod - üks üleval, teine keskel vasemal, kolmas all paremal.
works.de: Amid the flickering of colour patches, the figure of the crucified one and faces emerge - one at the top, another in the centre left, a third at the bottom right.

works.d: Eest keskelt taha suunduv suurte lehtpuudega palistatud tee. Vasakpoolsete puude vahelt näha veekogu.
works.de: A road lined with large deciduous trees leading from the front centre into the depth. A body of water visible between the trees on the left.

works.d: Hall veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Esiplaanil tükike rohuga kaetud kallast. Samas, paadisilla ääres, seismas allalastud purjedega paadid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
Esiplaanil mererand muuli ja paatidega, taga kindlus. Taevas kahvatu kuusirp.
works.de: In the foreground a seashore with a breakwater and boats, behind a fortress. In the sky a pale crescent moon.

works.d: Beežides ja pruunides toonides pikkade sirgete juustega neiu rinnaportree. Neiu näoosa otsekui helendaks seestpoolt, silmad suletud, tugevad huuled ja nina. Neiu vasak käsi tõstetud õla kohale. Värvipind tugeva faktuuriga.(eesti)
works.de: A bust portrait of a girl with long straight hair, in beige and brown tones. The girl's face seems to glow from within, eyes closed, strong lips and nose. The girl's left hand is raised above shoulder level. The paint surface has strong texture.

works.d: Keskel seisab terrakotakarva pikas kuues habemega mees. Mehel süles pruunide, pea- ja kaelaosas hallide sulgedega kull. Fooni ülaosa must, allosa tihedate värviliste pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre stands a bearded man in a long terracotta-coloured coat. The man holds in his lap a hawk with brown feathers, grey on the head and neck. The upper part of the background is black, the lower part is painted through with dense colourful brushstrokes.

works.d: Istuva mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Hele rohekas foon.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated man in profile facing left. Light greenish background.

works.d: Visand kahest õunast ja kahest banaanist.
Kõrges vaasis lillakad ja valged õied.
works.de: Purplish and white flowers in a tall vase.

works.d: Talvemaastik üksikute mändidega.
works.de: Winter landscape with solitary pines.

works.d: Valge põllega naine istuvas asendis. Pea kerge pöördega paremale.
works.de: Woman in a white apron in a sitting position. Head slightly turned to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil lillepott kolme valge tulbiga, taga männioks.
Ettpoole kummardunud sõduri täisfiguur profiilis paremale vintpüssist sihtimas.(eesti)
works.de: Full figure of a soldier bent forward, in profile to the right, aiming with a rifle.

works.d: Võlvitud ruumis riiulil ja ümarikul laual igasuguseid raamatuid, dokumente, ürikuid. Põrandal avatud raamat. Vasemal riiulile toetuv mees profiilis paremale, mustas kuues, raamatut lugemas, kõrval taburetil silinder.
works.de: In a vaulted room, on a shelf and on a round table all kinds of books, documents, deeds. An open book on the floor. On the left a man leaning on the shelf, in profile facing right, in a black robe, reading a book, beside him on a stool a top hat.

works.dm: lehe laius: 32.5 cm (lm.   ); kujutise kõrgus: 35.0 cm (km.); lehe kõrgus: 39.2 cm (lm.   ); kujutise laius: 28.7 cm (km.)
works.d: Kaljune mägimaastik, paremal järsk kalju pööretega üleval, vasakul kaljupragudest jooksvad veeojad, tagaplaanil kõrged puud, keskel kolm inimfiguuri kitsedega. Pruunikais toonides.
works.de: A rocky mountain landscape, on the right a steep cliff with turns above, on the left streams of water running from cracks in the rock, in the background tall trees, in the middle three human figures with goats. In brownish tones.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Mustad, keskelt lahku kammitud juuksed. Punane kleit, õlgadel läbipaistev tikitud tüll-sall. Kaelas valged helmed. Vasak käsi toetumas tamburiinile.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in a seated position, head slightly turned to the right. Black hair combed apart in the middle. Red dress, on the shoulders a transparent embroidered tulle shawl. White beads around the neck. Left hand resting on a tambourine.

works.d: Punases mütsikeses habemiku vanamehe rinnapilt. Pea kummardatud alla. Seljas tumepruun mungarüü.
works.de: Bust portrait of a bearded old man in a red cap. Head bowed down. Wearing a dark brown monk's robe.

works.d: Horisontaalidele üles ehitatud maastikukompositsioon: esiplaanil rohuriba ja täiskülvamata põld, sellest kõrgemal pikkade värviliste täppivate pintslilöökidega maalitud taluhooned, puud ja põõsad. Ülal helesinine taevas. Domineerivad eredad rohelised ja sinised värvitoonid, maalitud väga pastoosselt.
works.de: A landscape composition built up in horizontals: in the foreground a strip of grass and an unsown field, above it farm buildings, trees and bushes painted with long, colourful, dotted brushstrokes. Above a light blue sky. Bright green and blue colour tones dominate, painted very impasto.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage väli, paremal madalad talumajad. Vasakul kiviveski. Taga silmapiiril lage maastik.
works.de: In the foreground an open field, on the right low farmhouses. On the left a stone mill. Behind, on the horizon, an open landscape.

works.d: Ees noor tumedajuukseline naine, kes paljast ihu varjab rindadeni tõstetud valge riidega. Keskse kuju kõrval ja taga tema poole vaatavad inimfiguurid. Foon oranžikas-kollane.
works.de: In front, a young dark-haired woman covering her bare body up to the breasts with a white cloth. Beside and behind the central figure, human figures looking toward her. The background is orangish-yellow.

works.d: Keskel seisev Kristuse poolfiguur pöördes vasakule, tema ees tumedanahaline Juudas peaaegu selgvaates. Kristusel pruunid, õlgadele langevad juuksed, parem käsi rinnal, roheline rüü. Juudal tume juus ja habe, punane rüü.
Ees kaljud, neist vasakul kõrgemad, keskmisel rahnul istuv kotkas, taga keskel mägine maastik, millest paremal ja vasemal silmapiirini laiuv meri, kaugustes paistvate purjekatega. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In front, rocks, of which the ones on the left are higher, on the middle boulder an eagle sitting, behind, in the centre, a mountainous landscape, from which, on the right and left, the sea stretches to the horizon, with sailing boats visible in the distance. The sky cloudy.

works.d: Esiplaanil suur kala, Taga vasakul pruun tünn, keskel ja paremal sinakas draperii ja kast. Ees paremas nurgas pruun anum.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a large fish. Behind on the left a brown barrel, in the middle and on the right a bluish drapery and a box. In the front right corner a brown vessel.

works.d: Künklik maastik jõega: paremal künkaharjal puude vahel väike maja ja tamm kukkuva veega. Sellest tagapool künkal tuuleveski varemed.
works.de: A hilly landscape with a river: on the right, on a hill ridge among trees, a small house and an oak with falling water. Beyond it on a hill the ruins of a windmill.

works.d: Vaade lumisele kitsale tänavale. Keskel ees voorimees.
works.de: View of a narrow snowy street. A cabman in the center foreground.

works.d: Tumedate, pea ligi kammitud juustega keskealise naise rinnapilt; keha kerge pöördega vasakule, pea paremale. Seljas tume, sügavalt dekolteeritud kleit. Ümber õlgade punane sall.(eesti)
