Left hand in his lap. The man's clothing consists of grey knee breeches of a furry fabric, a reddish coat and a red waistcoat, and a broad-brimmed hat decorated with a colourful ribbon as headgear.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha järve äärde suunduv tee kahe inimfiguuriga selgvaates. Kahel pool teed suured puud. Vastaskaldal põõstastiku ja veest tõusva udu läbi paistmas hoone kuppelkatus.
works.de: In the foreground a road leading from front to back toward a lake, with two human figures in clear view. Large trees on both sides of the road. On the opposite shore, through the bushes and mist rising from the water, the domed roof of a building is visible.

works.d: Sangprillidega, kolmveerandpöördes paremale, istuva noormehe poolfiguur, käed põlvedel, vasakus käes põlev pabeross. Põhitoon: karmiin, sinakas - hall.
works.de: Half-figure of a young man with dark glasses, seated in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands on his knees, in his left hand a burning cigarette. Main tone: carmine, bluish-grey.

works.d: Vasakul akna all laud ja tool. Samas vasakul nurgas voodi.(eesti)
works.de: On the left under the window a table and chair. In the same left corner a bed.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas palgivirnadega. Tagapool vasakul müüri taga maju ja kirikutorne. Paremal üle puuplangu paistmas ühekordseid äärelinna maju ja paljude sibulakujuliste kuplitega tornidega kirik.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a riverbank with piles of logs. Further back on the left, houses and church towers behind a wall. On the right, above a wooden fence, single-storey suburban houses and a church with towers of many onion-shaped domes can be seen.

works.dm: kõrgus: 96.0 cm (vm   ); laius: 200.0 cm (arm); laius: 199.0 cm (vm   ); kõrgus: 97.0 cm (arm   )
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakule kihutavat kaks meeskondadega varustatud tanki, vasakul teeääres süttinud saksa tank. Tagaplaanil vahutavais laines lahesopp, millest vasemal kolletav mets. Tagaplaanil Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground two tanks equipped with crews racing to the left, on the left by the roadside a burning German tank. In the background a bay inlet in foaming waves, to the left of which a yellowing forest. In the background the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Kaks tütarlast ja kolm noormeest neljanurgelise laua ümber seismas või istumas. Maalitud kollakais ja punakais toonides, vaid äärmisel parempoolsel noormehel on smaragdrohelised püksid.
works.de: Two girls and three young men standing or sitting around a four-cornered table. Painted in yellowish and reddish tones, only the young man on the far right has emerald green trousers.

works.d: Üle lihtsate pintslitõmmetega vihjamisi antud madala horisondiga maastiku, millel paremal aimata varemeid ja põõsapuhmast, laiub rünkpilvis taevas, kattes ca 85% pildipinnast.
works.de: Over a landscape with a low horizon, suggested by simple brush strokes, on the right ruins and a bush can be discerned, spreads a sky of cumulus clouds, covering about 85% of the picture surface.

works.d: Noore, tumedajuukselise, vurrudega mehe pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Ümber kaela näha valge kraeääris, altpoolt näha katmata krunti. Taust antud rohekas toonis, ebamääraselt kaarja piirjoonega.
works.de: Head of a young, dark-haired man with a moustache, in half-profile to the left. A white collar edge visible around the neck, uncovered ground visible from below. Background given in a greenish tone, with a vaguely arched outline.

works.d: Hallijuukselise, pika täishabeme ja sorakil vurrudega vanamehe pea poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles.
works.de: Head of a grey-haired old man with a long full beard and unkempt moustache, in half-profile to the right, gaze directed upward.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul rahvariides istuv naisefiguur, pea pööratud paremale. Keskel võlvitud värava all seisev rahvariides naisefiguur, paremas käes sirp, vasak käsi toetub väravale. tagaplaanil näha heledalt valgustatud rukkipõld ja maastik kaugete metsadega.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a seated female figure in folk costume, head turned to the right. In the middle, under an arched gate, a standing female figure in folk costume, a sickle in her right hand, left hand resting on the gate. In the background a brightly lit rye field and a landscape with distant forests can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule rannajoon. Kaldaäärses vees suured kivid. Vasakult paistev Tallinna panoraam. Merel laevad ja üksikud lendavad kajakad.
works.de: In the foreground a shoreline running diagonally from right to left. Large stones in the water by the shore. The panorama of Tallinn visible from the left. Ships at sea and scattered flying gulls.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 43.8 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm
works.d: Ees paremal rohtunud kaljuplatoo üksikute põõsaste ja puudega eespool, kahe hoone ja varemetega tagapool kaljujärsakutel. Vasakul ja taga mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a grassy rocky plateau with sparse bushes and trees, further back two buildings and ruins on rocky cliffs. Mountains on the left and in the background.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 20.0 cm; lehe laius: 29.9 cm
works.d: Ees, keset lagendikku paremal oleva veekogu ääres kõrge kaljurahn. Lagendikulk hajutatult üksikuid hoonete gruppe. Tagaplaanil mäed.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 26.6 cm; lehe laius: 36.0 cm
works.d: Järsuseinalised kaljurahnud põõsastikuga parempoolses kaljulõhes.
works.de: Steep-walled rocky boulders with shrubbery in the crevice on the right.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 23.4 cm; lehe laius: 31.5 cm
works.d: Vaade alt üles lõhenenud kaljukaldale. Ülal servas näha rippumas üksikuid rohututte.
works.de: View from below upward at a cracked rocky bank. At the top edge solitary tufts of grass can be seen hanging.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõekallas laudadest teega ja puudega tagapool. Jõe keskel saareke puuga. Paremal kaldal puud ja künkal kaks mehefiguuri. Taga mets ja kirik.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a riverbank with a path of planks and trees further back. In the middle of the river a small island with a tree. On the right bank trees and on a hillock two male figures. Behind, forest and a church.

works.d: Taamal rida hooneid, kust väljub inimparv täites kogu pildi esiplaani.
works.de: In the distance a row of buildings, from which a crowd of people emerges, filling the entire foreground of the picture.

works.d: Pildi pind jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks musta pinnaga, mida läbib pikuti hele triip. Vasakul sinise ning punase horisontaaljoonega lõhestatud roheline kvadraat; paremal ülal tumedast, rohelise ringiga lõppevast diagonaaljoonest läbistatud punane, all kollane nelinurk. Kogu töö pinnal kahes suuruses punased, mustad, kollased, sinised, rohelised ja pruunid ringid. Puhtad lokaaltoonid; ühtlane maalipind. Üldmulje dekoratiivne.
works.de: The surface of the picture is divided vertically into two black areas, through which a light stripe runs lengthwise. On the left a green quadrangle split by a blue and a red horizontal line; on the upper right a red quadrangle pierced by a dark diagonal line ending in a green circle, below a yellow quadrangle. Across the whole surface of the work, red, black, yellow, blue, green and brown circles in two sizes. Pure local tones; even paint surface. Overall impression decorative.

works.d: Kahel pool tänavat, mis suundub paremast servast maali sisse, madalad majad mändide all. Vasakpoolne telefonipost ristub tänavaga.
works.de: On both sides of a street that leads into the painting from the right edge, low houses under pine trees. The telephone pole on the left crosses the street.

works.d: Valdavalt soojades kollastes toonides pargivaade. Kollased teed ümbritsevad põõsaste ja raagus puude gruppe. Tagaplaanil tumepunased ja kollased roheliste katustega majad. Taevas kollane.
works.de: A park view predominantly in warm yellow tones. Yellow paths surround groups of bushes and bare trees. In the background dark red and yellow houses with green roofs. The sky yellow.

works.d: Toolil istuva valges särgis mehe portree poolpöördes vasakule, käed põlvedele toetatud. Foon tumepruun.
works.de: Portrait of a man in a white shirt sitting on a chair, in half-turn to the left, hands resting on his knees. Background dark brown.

works.d: Naivistlikult lahendatud erksatoonilise ojaga maastiku taustal keskaelise habeme ja vuntsidega mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Mehel peas sügavpunane barett, seljas kollane särk.(eesti)
works.de: A naively rendered frontal bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a beard and moustache, against the background of a landscape with a brightly toned brook. The man wears a deep red beret on his head and a yellow shirt.(eesti)

works.d: Pruuni- ja ookrikarva ruudulisel väikesel laual kõrge, ülalt laienev klaasist vaas punaste, roosade ja kollaste roosidega. Kogu pildi ulatuses paistab hõreda värvikihi alt lõuend. Foon kaetud lillakaspunaste hõredate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a small brown and ochre chequered table a tall vase widening towards the top, of glass, with red, pink and yellow roses. Throughout the picture the canvas shows through the sparse layer of paint. The background covered with sparse brushstrokes of purplish-red.

works.d: Vitstest punutud korvis kolm leekivpunaste õitega mooni. Foon tume.
works.de: Three poppies with flaming red blossoms in a wicker basket. Dark background.

works.d: Pruunikal tähnilisel foonil pisut paremal tume, ümar, ajaga vaas, milles bukett neljast valgest roosiõiest.(eesti)
works.de: On a brownish speckled background, slightly to the right, a dark, round, antique vase with a bouquet of four white rose blossoms.

works.d: Vasakul, puude vahelt paistas taraga ümbritsetud madal kollase otsafassaadiga elumaja. Paremal majapidamishooned.

works.t: Parun Edward III (Ned) James Archibald Percival von Ungern-Sternbergi portree
works.d: Noore mehe portree valgel hobusel pöördega paremale, kaardiväelase mundris, paljastatud mõõk õlal, taustaks mägimaastik linnustega.
works.de: Portrait of a young man on a white horse turned to the right, in a guardsman's uniform, a drawn sword on his shoulder, against a background of mountain landscape with birds.

works.d: Esiplaanil Neeva kai üksikute jalakäijate ja hobusõidukitega. Keskel, vasakult taha keskele suunduv (üle Neeva) valgustatud sild. Taga, vastaskaldal majad ja kirik.
works.de: In the foreground the Neva embankment with individual pedestrians and horse-drawn vehicles. In the middle, an illuminated bridge leading from the left to the back centre (across the Neva). Behind, on the opposite bank, houses and a church.

works.d: Hallikaspruunides ja rohelistes toonides suvine agulivaade sillutatamta tänavaga esiplaanil. Sellest vasakul üksteise külge ehitatud hallid agulimajad põõsastega seina ääres ja sinistest lippidest tara eraldamaks väikest aeda. Teest paremal põõsad, otse paar suuremat pruuni maja. Ülal, läbi hõrdeda roheluse paistev kollakashall taevas. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati pintslivart või puupulka kasutades.
works.de: A summer suburban view in greyish-brown and green tones with an unpaved street in the foreground. To its left grey suburban houses built against one another with bushes along the wall and a fence of blue slats separating a small garden. To the right of the road bushes, directly behind them a couple of larger brown houses. Above, a yellowish-grey sky showing through sparse greenery. Painted pastosely, in places using the butt end of a brush or a wooden stick.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik. Tagapool vasakul mansardkatusega elamu, paremal rida hooneid üksikute puudega. Keskel ja paremal servas kuused.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing. Behind it, on the left, a dwelling with a mansard roof, on the right a row of buildings with individual trees. In the centre and on the right edge, spruce trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannariba seisvate figuuridega. Kaks keskset naiskuju valges rõivastuses, nende taga istub pruun koer. Vasakus servas, vees ratsanik hobusel. Silmapiiril tumeroheline metsaviirg. Maalitud hoogsate pintslilöökidega. Koloriit hele.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of beach with standing figures. Two central female figures in white clothing, behind them a brown dog sitting. On the left edge, in the water, a horseman on a horse. On the horizon a dark green strip of forest. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes. Colouring light.

works.d: Lillas turbanis üles suunatud pilguga noore naise rinnapilt. Tema ees laual anum, millest tõstab tangidega mitmesuguseid ebamäärase kujuga tükke.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a lilac turban, gaze directed upward. In front of her on the table a vessel from which she lifts various indeterminately shaped pieces with tongs.

works.d: Vasakul aia taga, sinise taeva taustal hele kirikuhoone. Paremas servas üksik mänd.
works.de: On the left behind a fence, against a blue sky background, a light-coloured church building. In the right edge a solitary pine.

works.d: Kolmefiguuriline grupp lahesoppide, jõesuudme, kanalitega ülaltvaates nähtud maastiku taustal. Ees keskel Maad sümboliseeriv alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, käed tema kõrval seisva kahe külgvaates noore mehe õlal, kaelal. Vasakpoolsel mehel pea püsti, käed vaheliti kõhul, parempoolsel pea langetatud, käed seljal. Figuuride lahendus tinglik. Peade kohal üksikute helenduvate pilvedega roosakas kumas taevas. Maalil ühtlaselt kahvatusinakas, helerohekas koloriit.
works.de: A three-figure group against the background of a landscape with bays, a river mouth, and canals seen from above. In front, in the centre, a three-quarter figure of a naked woman symbolising the Earth, seen frontally, her hands on the shoulder and neck of two young men standing beside her, seen in profile. The man on the left has his head upright, hands crossed on his stomach, the one on the right has his head lowered, hands behind his back. The treatment of the figures is conventional/stylised. Above the heads, a pinkish glowing sky with solitary luminous clouds. In the painting, a uniformly pale bluish, light greenish colouring.

works.d: Roosakas - punase linaga kaetud väikesel ümmargusel laual on kesksel kohal suur ümarik pruun vaas erkoranžide - kollaste saialilledega. Vaasist paremal kaks kollakas toonis karbikest, vasakul väike jalgadega hõbejas toos. Tagaplaanil pruunil seinal ripuvad kolm maali. Kahte alumist varjab peaaegu täielikult lillebukett, keskmine ülal kujutab valget hobust ratsanikuga. All paremas servas on suur rohelise polstriga tooli seljatugi ning näha veidi ka käetuge.
works.de: On a small round table covered with a pinkish-red cloth, a large round brown vase with bright orange-yellow marigolds occupies the central place. To the right of the vase two yellowish-toned little boxes, to the left a small silver footed container. In the background, on a brown wall, three paintings hang. The two lower ones are almost entirely hidden by the flower bouquet, the middle one above depicts a white horse with a rider. In the lower right corner, the backrest of a large chair with green upholstery is visible, along with a bit of the armrest.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: kujutatud kukena, mehe peaga profiilis vasakule. Rinnas lill.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: depicted as a rooster, with a man's head in profile facing left. A flower on the chest.

works.d: Istuvas, avaras rõivastuses naise kolmveerandfiguur kollakal - rohekal foonil. Teostatud vabas, skitseerivas laadis.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated woman in loose clothing against a yellowish-greenish background. Executed in a free, sketch-like style.

works.d: All kaks habemikku mehenägu poolprofiilis paremale; ülal vasakul pruun käsi, paremal vasak käsi.
works.de: Below, two bearded men's faces in half-profile facing right; above, on the left a brown hand, on the right a left hand.

works.d: Tumeroheliste mändidega grupp lumisel lagendikul.
works.de: A group of dark green pines on a snowy clearing.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendikul lambad ja lehm. Üle taevavõlvi vikerkaar.
works.de: In the foreground on a clearing sheep and a cow. A rainbow across the sky.

works.d: Kaks alasti naisratsurit. Vasem - punasel, parempoolne valgel hobusel. Hobused jalgupidi vees.
works.de: Two nude female riders. The left one on a red horse, the right one on a white horse. The horses standing in water up to their legs.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rannaäärne heinamaa üksikute suuremate kividega esiplaanil ja siniste puudega silmapiiril. Vasakul meri, ülal suuremat osa pildist enda alla võttev tihedalt pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud hõredalt, lõuendit alt paista lastes.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, open coastal meadow with a few larger stones in the foreground and blue trees on the horizon. On the left, the sea, above, a densely cloud-covered sky taking up most of the picture. Painted sparsely, letting the canvas show through underneath.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage plats; tagapool puude rea taga nõmmistul üksikud figuurid. Taustaks kõrged kivihooned.
works.de: In the foreground an open square; behind, beyond a row of trees, individual figures on the heath. Background of tall stone buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil kioskid ja materjalivirnad, keskel taastatav Estonia veokite ja inimfiguuridega ees; taamal vaade linnale.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground kiosks and stacks of materials, in the centre the Estonia [theatre] under restoration with trucks and human figures in front; in the distance a view of the city.

works.d: Tumesinisel veekogul neli paati sõitmas, vasakul kalda ääres kaks purjekat seismas. Esiplaanil vasakul purjekas kolme mehega. Keskel punane paadinina ja selle kohale kummarduva mehe pea roosa tuttmütsiga. Vasakul kollane paat naise ja mehega, kellel käes aerud.
works.de: Four boats sailing on a dark blue body of water, two sailboats standing on the shore on the left. In the foreground on the left a sailboat with three men. In the middle a red bow of a boat and above it the head of a man bending over, wearing a pink tufted cap. On the left a yellow boat with a woman and a man holding oars.

works.d: Rohelises kleidis naise põlveportree, käed süles, tumedad langevad juuksed (ülalt servaga lõigatud), punased pärlid kaelas.(eesti)
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman in a green dress, hands in her lap, dark falling hair (cropped at the top edge), red beads around her neck.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rand üksiku kotkaga suurel rahnul, vasemal keskel ja tagaplaanil kaljud, paremal puude vahel hooned, taustaks pilvedesse ulatuvad mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky shore with a lone eagle on a large boulder, on the left in the middle and background cliffs, on the right buildings among trees, background of mountains reaching into the clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinakasroheline merepind, taga pastoossete pintslilöökidega põgusalt markeeritud paadid ja sadamahooned. Ülaservas sinine, valgete kiudpilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a bluish-green sea surface, behind it boats and harbour buildings briefly marked with pastose brushstrokes. In the upper edge, a blue sky covered with white fibrous clouds.

works.d: Nelja sambaga portikusega hoone puude vahel. Paremal taga osa punasest lameda katusega kivimajast.
works.de: A building with a four-column portico among trees. On the right behind, part of a red flat-roofed stone house.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist valgete pearättikutega võrke parandamas. Tagapool vasakul paat, mille poole kaks meest minemas. Üks kannab midagi õlal, teine kaenla all. Taamal tumesinine meri valge purjekaga.
works.de: In the foreground two women with white headscarves mending nets. Further back on the left a boat, towards which two men are walking. One is carrying something on his shoulder, the other under his arm. In the distance a dark blue sea with a white sailboat.

works.d: Lahesopp kahe purjekaga külgvaates. Neist esimesel näha kaks inimfiguuri.Vasakul ees kitsas kaldariba, kaugemal pikalt merre ulatuv neemik, mille tagant paistab laevamaste.
works.de: A bay inlet with two sailboats in side view. On the first of them two human figures can be seen. On the left in the foreground a narrow strip of shore, further away a headland extending far into the sea, behind which a ship's masts appear.

works.d: Esiplaanil valge hobune kahe ahviga seljas. Paremal kloun punases kostüümis, vasakul haukuv koer. Tagaplaanil kaks pruuni hobust tagantvaates.
works.de: In the foreground a white horse with two monkeys on its back. On the right a clown in a red costume, on the left a barking dog. In the background two brown horses seen from behind.

works.d: Helehall veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Esiplaanil liivane kallas. Taamal kallas halli ribana.
works.de: A light-grey body of water with a boat landing and boats. In the foreground a sandy shore. In the distance the far bank as a grey strip.

works.d: Püstjuustega noormehe rindportree, 3/4 profiilis paremale, pilk vasakule suunatud. Seljas tume rõivas, rohelise kaelusega. Pruun taust.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young man with upright hair, in 3/4 profile to the right, gaze directed to the left. Wearing dark clothing with a green collar. Brown background.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Esindusmundris, narmasõlakutega, parem käsi vööl.
works.de: Half-figure of a bearded man in half-profile to the left. In formal uniform with braided epaulettes, right hand on his belt.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm siga ja kaks põrsast aedikus põhkudel lamamas. Seaaia taga paistab kuuri sein väikese aknaga. Osa aedikust ja kuuri seinast päikesevarjus, osa heleda päikese käes. Eriti põhk pastoosselt maalitud. Hallikaspruun koloriit.
works.de: In the foreground three pigs and two piglets lying on straw in a pen. Behind the pig pen the wall of a shed with a small window is visible. Part of the pen and the shed wall in shadow, part in bright sunlight. The straw in particular painted pastosely. Greyish-brown colouring.

works.d: Realistlik varakevadine maastik pildi sügavusse suunduva ojaga esiplaanil paremal. Oja kallastel sulamata lumi, taamal paremal kaks hallikat talumaja. Oja mõlemal kaldal raagus puud, tammedel küljes mullusügisesed lehed. Silmapiiril vasakul väike tammik ja metsaviirg. Ülal selge sinine kevadine taevas.
works.de: A realistic early-spring landscape with a brook running into the depth of the picture in the foreground on the right. Unmelted snow on the banks of the brook, in the distance on the right two greyish farmhouses. On both banks of the brook, bare trees, the oaks still bearing last autumn's leaves. On the horizon on the left, a small oak grove and a strip of forest. Above, a clear blue spring sky.

works.d: Suure habemega mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis poolpöördes paremale. Keha veidi tahapoole kallutatud. Toetudes istme seljatoele paremas käes pintsel, vasakus palett. Paremas servas üleval näha kuldraamis maali vasak serv.
works.de: Half-figure of a man with a large beard, seated, in half-turn to the right. Body leaning slightly backward. Leaning on the back of the seat, a brush in his right hand, a palette in his left. In the upper right corner the left edge of a painting in a gilt frame is visible.

works.d: Linnavaade Tallinna vanalinnast. Diagonaalis vasakult paremale kulgeval vasakul tänavapoolel kõrge terava otsaviilu ja gooti portaaliga kivimaja. Selle kõrval madalamad kivihooned.
works.de: A city view of Tallinn's Old Town. On the street side to the left, running diagonally from left to right, a stone house with a high pointed gable end and a Gothic portal. Next to it lower stone buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud rannaäär. Kaugemal kitsas mereriba kolme paadiga. Taevas kaetud pilvedag. All vasakus nurgas kiri: Hapba.
works.de: In the foreground a grassy shoreline. Further away a narrow strip of sea with three boats. The sky covered with clouds. In the lower left corner an inscription: Hapba.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates, laps kätel. Naisel peas punane rätt, kõrvas kõrvarõngad, kaelas pärlikee. Heledajuukselisel lapsel (otsevaates( käes kaks viinamarjakobarat. Taustaks kahel pool asuvate lehtpuude vahelt paistev pilvine taevas.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in frontal view, a child in her arms. The woman wears a red kerchief on her head, earrings in her ears, a pearl necklace round her neck. The fair-haired child (in frontal view) holds two clusters of grapes in its hands. The background shows a cloudy sky visible between deciduous trees standing on either side.

works.dm: laius: 123.0 cm (osa II (reljeefi kõrgus 5 cm)); kõrgus: 210.0 cm; kõrgus: 210.0 cm; laius: 123.0 cm (osa I (reljeefi kõrgus 5 cm))
works.d: Kaheosaline ruumiline kompositsioon. Osaliselt kortsutatud ja rebitud kirevalt ülemaalitud paberiga kaetud alusele kinnitatud valdavalt pronksivärvi plastikplaadi tükke, metalliosi, sinise köie jupp jms. detaile esemetest. Kinnitatud materjal on alusele paigutatud astmeliselt: vasakul äärel all, horisontaalselt pinna keskel ja ülal paremal äärel.
works.de: A two-part spatial composition. Pieces of predominantly bronze-coloured plastic sheet, metal parts, a piece of blue rope and similar object details are attached to a base covered with partially crumpled and torn, colourfully overpainted paper. The attached material is arranged on the base in steps: at the bottom on the left edge, horizontally in the middle of the surface, and at the top on the right edge.

works.d: Pildi alumises servas patsiga naise rinnafiguur ning roheline vaas. Tagapool kolm mehe poolfiguuri. Tagumisel mehel suitsev piip suus. Koloriit summutatud, ülekaalus sinakad toonid.(eesti)
works.de: At the bottom edge of the picture the bust of a woman with a braid and a green vase. Behind, three half-length figures of men. The rearmost man has a smoking pipe in his mouth. The colour scheme is muted, bluish tones predominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal karjapoiss lammaste ja koeraga, keskel keerudes sügavusse suunatud teel rahvariides naine selgvaates, paremal nõmmemaastik üksikute põõsastega. Nende taga veekogu (järvesopp), mille vastaskaldal lehtpuude rühmi ja üksik taluhoone. Keskel vasemal üksikute tammede taga taluhooneid, nende kohal teel kaks meest. Taamal asuv mets liitub järve tagakaldal asuvate puuderühmadega. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a shepherd boy with sheep and a dog, in the centre on a winding road leading into the depth a woman in folk costume seen in profile, on the right a heath landscape with solitary bushes. Behind them a body of water (a bay of a lake), on whose opposite shore groups of deciduous trees and a solitary farm building. In the centre left, behind solitary oaks, farm buildings, above them on the road two men. The forest in the distance merges with the groups of trees on the far shore of the lake. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Äärelinna tänav nelja jalakäijaga. Keskel roosakates toonides kiviaiaga piiratud hoonetegrupp. Taevas päike.
works.de: A suburban street with four pedestrians. In the centre a group of buildings in pinkish tones enclosed by a stone wall. Sun in the sky.

works.d: Eest paremalt Z-kujuliselt heinamaade keskel taha keskele kulgev oja. Taga vasakul ja taamal paremal mets.
works.de: In the foreground, a stream running in a Z-shape from the right through the middle of the meadows toward the back center. Behind, on the left and in the distance on the right, forest.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt profiilis paremale. Seljas valge, pitsääristusega pluus ja rohekashall pihik, mille õlapael libisenud üle õla. Peakatteks valge rätt. Ehteks korallkõrvarõngad ja kaelakee.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in profile facing right. Wearing a white lace-trimmed blouse and a greenish-grey bodice, the shoulder strap of which has slipped off the shoulder. Headwear a white kerchief. Jewellery consists of coral earrings and a necklace.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur otsevaates, õlgadele rippuvate juustega. Vasakul pott suureõielise lillega.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in frontal view, with hair falling onto the shoulders. On the left a pot with a large-flowered plant.

works.d: Keskealise naise portree visand profiilis paremale. Brünettides juustes roosa ehe.
works.de: Sketch of a portrait of a middle-aged woman in profile to the right. A pink ornament in her brunette hair.

works.dm: laius: 65.7 cm (üle alusraami); kõrgus: 80.0 cm; kõrgus: 82.5 cm (üle alusraami); laius: 63.0 cm
works.d: Keskealise rokokoo parukas mehe poolfiguur 3/4 profiilis paremale, sinises punase vestiga mundrikuues, kaenlas kolmnurkne müts.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in a rococo wig, in 3/4 profile to the right, in a blue uniform coat with a red waistcoat, a tricorn hat under his arm.

works.dm: kõrgus: 52.0 cm (vm. ovaal); laius: 39.0 cm (vm. ovaal)
works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas sinine turban, mille alt ulatuvad välja paksud seljale langevad punased juuksed.
works.de: Bust of a young woman in half-profile to the left. On the head a blue turban, from under which thick red hair falling onto the back emerges.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal jäme jändrik mustjas-pruun puutüvi. Puu taga väike lumine kallak hõreda raagus võsaga. Tagaplaanil keskel väike punaka katusega maja. Ülal erksinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a thick, gnarled blackish-brown tree trunk. Behind the tree a small snowy slope with sparse bare scrub. In the background in the centre a small house with a reddish roof. Above, a bright blue sky.

works.d: Rohekashalli rätiga kaetud sinisel laual paremal pealtvaates valge taldrik kolme kalaga. Vasakul külgvaates roheline pudel. Maalitud üldistavalt, suurte pindadena.
works.de: On a blue table covered with a greenish-grey cloth, a white plate with three fish, seen from above on the right. On the left, a green bottle in side view. Painted in a generalized manner, in large areas.

works.d: Kollakasrohelistes, hallides ja punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon dünaamilises värvilaikude liikumises.
works.de: Abstract composition in yellowish-green, grey and red tones in a dynamic movement of colour patches.

works.d: Pika halli habemega tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, parem käsi põlvel, vasak hoiab prille rinna kohal. Tagaplaanil paremal musta-punase vöödliline drapereering.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a man with a long grey beard sitting in an armchair, his right hand on his knee, his left holding glasses at chest level. In the background on the right, a black-and-red striped drapery.

works.d: Esiplaanil kitsa rohtunud kaldaribaga jõgi punases kuues sõudjatega keset vett asuvas paadis. Tagaplaanil kogu pildi laiust haarav kivist sild. Nelja võlvkaarega sillal üksik naisfiguur, taga paremal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a narrow grassy strip of bank, with a boat in the middle of the water containing rowers in red coats. In the background a stone bridge spanning the full width of the picture. On the bridge, with four arches, a solitary female figure, a forest behind on the right.

works.d: Meri kaljurahnudega paremal. Keskel kaks purjelaeva. Taevas täiskuu.
works.de: The sea with rocky boulders on the right. In the middle two sailing ships. Full moon in the sky.

works.d: Vasakul pildipoolel kõrge künka jalam ülalpool suurte põõsaste, kahe väikese lehtpuu ja liivakivirahnuga. Tagaplaanil kaks lehtpuud ja silmapiiril paremal puudesalu. Helesinine taevas valgete ja hallide pilverüngastega. Künka jalam ulatub järsu, peaaegu püstloodis seinana esiplaanil diagonaalselt voolava madala kivise allikani, mis kaob varjuliste puude ja põõsaste vahele esiplaanil maali paremal poolel. Allikal küljega vaataja poole tütarlaps valges pluusis ja punases vestis, anumaga käes.
works.de: On the left side of the picture the foot of a high hill above large bushes, two small deciduous trees and a sandstone boulder. In the background two deciduous trees and a grove of trees on the horizon to the right. Light blue sky with white and grey cumulus clouds. The foot of the hill extends as a steep, almost vertical wall to a low stony stream flowing diagonally in the foreground, which disappears between shaded trees and bushes in the foreground on the right side of the painting. At the stream, in profile facing the viewer, a girl in a white blouse and red vest, holding a vessel.

works.d: Mustajuukselise, põskhabeme ja prillidega keskealise mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasakule.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with black hair, side-whiskers and glasses, slightly turned to the left.

works.d: Vaas valge sirelioksaga ja kollaste, punaste, roosade tulpidega valgel alusel. Samas vasakul kuldpruun kohvitass, paremal karp. Taust hele.
works.de: A vase with a white lilac branch and yellow, red, pink tulips on a white base. In the same scene, on the left a golden-brown coffee cup, on the right a box. The background is light.

works.d: Vurrude ja lõuahabemega keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule, ninal prillid. Tume pintsak, valge tärgeldatud krae, must kaelaside.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a moustache and chin beard, in half-profile turned to the left, glasses on his nose. Dark jacket, white starched collar, black necktie.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakule pöörduv linnatänav, kõnniteel inimesi. Keskel tänavaäärseid maju, tagaplaanil Olevimäe nõlvakul paremal linnamüüri torn ja rida maju, mille tagant paistab Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: In the foreground a city street turning to the left, people on the pavement. In the middle street-side houses, in the background on the slope of Oleviste Hill on the right a city wall tower and a row of houses, behind which the tower of St. Olaf's Church is visible.

works.d: Kahekorruseline, osaliselt mustaks, osaliselt kollaseks värvitud maja tänava ääres. Paremal tara taga raagus puud.
works.de: A two-storey house, painted partly black, partly yellow, by the roadside. On the right, bare trees behind a fence.

works.d: Laual, vasakul punutud korv siniste viinamarjadega, paremal lahtilõigatud arbuus. Vasakul, laua nurgal nuga.
works.de: On a table, on the left a woven basket with blue grapes, on the right a cut-open watermelon. A knife at the corner of the table on the left.

works.d: Eest taha suunudval kitsal rohtunud kaljuplatool sööv ja mäletsev kari. Paremal näha allapoole laskuval kaldal kasvavate puude latvu. Vasakul künkaline kaljukallas.
works.de: On a narrow grassy rocky plateau receding from front to back, a herd grazing and ruminating. On the right the treetops of trees growing on a bank descending downward are visible. On the left a hilly rocky bank.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Peas sulega ääristatud kübar. Seljas kõrge kaelusega tumepunane kleit.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the left. A feather-trimmed hat on her head. Wearing a high-collared dark red dress.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri, keskel suur purilaev, tagaplaanil rand laevade ja mägedega, pilvede vahel täiskuu.
works.de: In the foreground the sea, in the middle a large sailing ship, in the background a shore with ships and mountains, a full moon among the clouds.

works.d: Ees keskel, veekogu ääres kahe kõrge  (lõuendi alumisest servast ülemiseni ulatuva) kalju seina vahel vesi.
works.de: In the centre foreground, by a body of water, water between two tall cliff walls (reaching from the lower edge of the canvas to the upper).

works.d: Ees taha vasakule suunduv jõgi. Vasakul paat sõudjatega. Vastaskaldal pooldeldi vees põõsastikuriba, mille tagant tõuseb järsk kallas selle harjale viiva trepiga vasakul. Kaldaharjal kirik. Taga vasakul üksik kivihoone.
works.de: In front a river running back to the left. On the left a boat with rowers. On the opposite bank a strip of shrubbery half in the water, behind which rises a steep bank with steps leading up to its ridge on the left. On the ridge of the bank a church. Behind on the left a solitary stone building.
