works.d: Ees kõrgel kaljuplatool varemed. Taamal kõrged mäed.
Kivist lauaplaadil punutud korv täis kannikesi. Korvi kõrval kokku seotutena kaks kannikese kimpu.
works.de: A woven basket full of violets on a stone tabletop. Beside the basket two bunches of violets tied together.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur seisvas asendis, käed rinnal risti, vasakus käes avatud raamat.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in standing position, arms crossed on his chest, an open book in his left hand.

works.d: Mehe põlvportree, kelle profiil paremale tuleb teravalt esile heldal foonil. Parem käsi taskus, vasak, sigaretti hoidev käsi, toetudb küünarvarrega kõrgemale alusele. Ülikond tumehall, särk sinine.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a man, whose profile facing right stands out sharply against a light background. Right hand in pocket, left hand, holding a cigarette, resting with the forearm on a higher stand. The suit is dark grey, the shirt blue.

works.d: Heledal pinnal kaks klaasi ning punakaspruun veinikarahvin. Kontuurid kohati rõhutatud. Maalipind faktuurne.
works.de: Two glasses and a reddish-brown wine carafe on a light surface. Contours emphasised in places. The paint surface is textured.

works.d: Leentoolis istuva sinises kodukuues hallipäise mehe põlvportree poolpöördes vasakule. Mehe kortsuline nägu suunatud vaatajale, parem käsi puhkab süles, vasak toolileenil. Vasakus seinas ava, millest paistab lopsakas roheline maastik dünaamiliste alastifiguuridega.(eesti)
works.de: A knee-length portrait, in half-turn to the left, of a grey-haired man seated in a wing chair, in a blue dressing gown. The man's wrinkled face is turned towards the viewer, his right hand rests in his lap, his left on the arm of the chair. In the wall on the left an opening, through which a lush green landscape with dynamic nude figures is visible.

works.d: Lillades toonides mügarike taustal deformeerunud inimpeadega sinised olendid läbisegi, nende vahel erkpunased haralised moodustised. Keskel otsevaates kehale poole haruliselt väljavenitatud sopilise näoga monstrum.(eesti)
works.de: In purple tones, against a bumpy background, blue beings with deformed human heads intermingled, between them bright red branching formations. In the centre, seen frontally, a monster with a body stretched halfway into branching form and a lobed face.

works.d: Pruuni põrandaga ja erinevates toonides punaste seinte ja laega ruumis lillakates varjundites, kogu ruumi kõrgust täitev astuvas poosis naise torso kerges pöördes vasemale. Vasakus seinas roosade seintega kaarava, millest avaneb vaade üle lehtpuude üksikute pilvedega taevasse, mis horisondile lähenedes muutub kollakaks.(eesti)
works.de: In a room with a brown floor and walls and ceiling in various shades of red, in purplish hues, the torso of a woman in a striding pose, filling the entire height of the room, in a slight turn to the left. In the left wall an arch with pink walls, opening onto a view over deciduous trees to a sky with scattered clouds, turning yellowish as it approaches the horizon.

works.d: Lillakassinisesse laotusesse kõrgub gooti arhitektuurielementidega stiliseeritud tornita kirikuhoone perspektiivis nähtuna. Külgseinas paikneva kitsa gooti akna suunas lõikab maali peen helesinine digonaaljoon. Maalitud pahtli ja pulverisaatoriga.
works.de: A stylised, towerless Gothic church building with architectural elements rises into a lilac-blue sky, seen in perspective. A thin light blue diagonal line cuts across the painting towards the narrow Gothic window on the side wall. Painted with putty and a sprayer.

works.d: 2/3 pildipinnast võtab enda alla esiplaanil olev sirendav veepind. Kaldal, tiheda puudesalu tagant paistavad kaks punast tornikiivrit.
works.de: 2/3 of the picture surface is taken up by the shimmering water surface in the foreground. On the shore, behind a dense grove of trees, two red tower spires can be seen.

works.d: Õrnrohelisel, peenetriibulisel draperiil valge, punase triibuga vaas kirjude lilledega.
works.de: On a light green, finely striped drapery a white vase with a red stripe and colourful flowers.

works.d: Suures sinakasrohelises vaasis kallad, roosid ja tulbid. Samas sinine draperii ja korv nartsissidega.
works.de: Callas, roses and tulips in a large bluish-green vase. Also a blue drapery and a basket with narcissi.

works.d: Heledates kollastes, sinistes, kuldsetes toonides laigulisel taustal paremal noore naise rinnafiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Naisel lühikesed tumedad juuksed, õlgadel valge rõivas.(eesti)
works.de: In light yellow, blue, golden tones against a mottled background, on the right the bust of a young woman in half-turn to the left. The woman has short dark hair, a white garment on her shoulders.

works.d: Tähelise mustriga draperii foonil istuva tütarlapse täisfiguur. Parem käsi toetab järi, vasak lamab süles. Peas hall müts, seljas must džemper ja sinine seelik.(eesti)
works.de: Full figure of a girl sitting against a background of drapery with a starry pattern. Right hand rests on a stool, left lies in her lap. On her head a grey cap, wearing a black sweater and a blue skirt.

works.d: Esiplaanil hobune vankriga, millel istub mees, vankri taga varss. Ees teel lehmad. Keskel suured lehtpuud, vasakul valge maja, selle taga paistab veekogu. Taevas paistab kuu.
works.de: In the foreground a horse with a cart on which a man sits, a foal behind the cart. Cows on the road ahead. In the middle large deciduous trees, on the left a white house, behind it a body of water is visible. The moon is visible in the sky.

works.d: Keskel raagus puud, mille sinakad varjud langevad ees lumele. Taga taluhooned.
works.de: In the middle bare trees, whose bluish shadows fall on the snow in front. Behind, farm buildings.

works.d: Tugitoolis istuv mehe poolfiguur, kerge pöördega vasakule, käed põlvedel. Vasakule laual astrid kerakujulises vaasis.
works.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in an armchair, slightly turned to the left, hands on his knees. To the left on a table asters in a spherical vase.

works.d: Naise rinnaportree, pea poolpöördes vasakule, pilk paremale. Näos tõusevad esile helepunaseks värvitud huuled. Pruunid, lainjas juuksed langevad õlgadele. Peas hallikas kübar, kaelas tume sall, kitsa punase triibuga. Koloriit tume.
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman, head half-turned to the left, gaze to the right. In the face, lips painted bright red stand out. Brown, wavy hair falls to the shoulders. On the head a greyish hat, around the neck a dark scarf with a narrow red stripe. Dark colour scheme.

works.d: Neli meest, seljaga vaataja poole, kannavad õlgadel raami surnuga. Tagaplaanil, vasakul põleb suur lõke.
works.de: Four men, their backs to the viewer, carry a frame with a dead body on their shoulders. In the background, on the left, a large bonfire is burning.

works.d: Krüsanteemid ja õunad laual: keskel laual kaks vaasi krüsanteemidega. Vaaside ees puuviljad.
works.de: Chrysanthemums and apples on a table: in the centre of the table two vases with chrysanthemums. Fruits in front of the vases.

works.d: Ookerpruunil taustal mustjaspruunis kuldse ääristusega rüüs naine Kristuslapsega vasakul käel, parem käsi õnnistuseks tõstetud. Kristuslapsel roheline - kuldne rüü seljas, mõlemal kuldne nimbus ümber pea. Jumalaema pea kõrval vasakul ja paremal ning Kristuse pea kohal valgega maalitud sümbolid kirillitsas. Ikooni külgedel üksteise all kujutatud neli pühakut: vasakul ülal märter Nikita küti atribuutidega, tema all püha Simeon punases - sinises rüüs. Paremal äärel ülal märter Agafia, all püha Marfa tumedas keebis, rohekas rüü selle all. Ääre figuuridel kuldsed nimbused ümber pea, nimed kujutatu kohal.
works.de: On an ochre-brown background, a woman in a blackish-brown robe with a gold border, with the Christ Child on her left arm, her right hand raised in blessing. The Christ Child wears a green-gold robe, and both figures have a gold nimbus around the head. To the left and right of the Mother of God's head, and above Christ's head, symbols painted in white in Cyrillic script. On the sides of the icon, four saints are depicted one below the other: upper left, the martyr Nikita with the attributes of a hunter, below him Saint Simeon in a red-blue robe. On the right edge, upper, the martyr Agatha, below, Saint Martha in a dark cloak with a greenish robe beneath it. The figures on the edge have gold nimbuses around their heads, with their names above the depicted figures.

works.d: Vana mehe poolfiguur en face istuvas asendis. Hall habe, paljas pea, käed ees ristatult. Tagant paistab toolileen.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of an old man en face in a seated position. Grey beard, bald head, hands crossed in front. A chair back visible behind him.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaks hane ja tütarlaps toetumas aiale. Keskel taulpoeg naisega palgikoormal hobust jões jootmas. Maanteel, taamal paremal liikumas hobused talupoegadega. Maantee ääres kõrts peatuvate hobustega. Paremal maali serval keskel asuva üle jõe viiva silla jalal veok, mille koorma otsas istuv naine pingutab lõhkuva hobuse ohje, kuna seisev mees hobuse ees parema käega hoiab aisast kinni. Nende vastu sõidab suure kiirusega kahe hobusega veok kahe talupojaga. Sillast vasakul jõe ääres joodab talupoeg hobust. Hobusest vasakul läheb kari kodu poole.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the left two geese and a girl leaning on a fence. In the centre, a peasant boy with a woman on a load of logs watering a horse in the river. On the road, further back on the right, horses with peasants moving. By the roadside an inn with stopping horses. On the right edge of the painting, at the foot of a bridge crossing the river in the centre, a cart on which a woman sitting on the load pulls at the reins of a bolting horse, while a standing man in front of the horse holds the shaft with his right hand. Coming towards them at great speed is a cart with two horses and two peasants. To the left of the bridge, by the riverside, a peasant waters a horse. To the left of the horse, a herd is heading home.

works.d: Eskiis temaatilisele kompositisoonile: keskel surnukeha ümber koondunud talveriietes inimeste grupp. Meestel peas läkiläkid, püssid õlal või käes, naistel villased rätikud. Esiplaanil vasakus nurgas hauda kaevavad mehed, tagaplaanil talvine mets ja inimesed puude vahel.(eesti)
works.de: Sketch for a thematic composition: in the middle, a group of people in winter clothing gathered around a corpse. The men wear caps with earflaps, rifles on their shoulders or in their hands, the women woollen headscarves. In the foreground in the left corner, men digging a grave, in the background a winter forest and people among the trees.

works.dm: laius: 18.9 cm; kõrgus: 20.3 cm (ovaal   ); kõrgus: 24.2 cm; laius: 17.1 cm (ovaal   )
works.d: Heledajuukselise tüdrukukese poolfiguur kolmveerandprofiilis vasakule; istuvas asendis. Punase kleidi kaelus ja lühikeste varrukate otsad kitsa valge ääristusega.
works.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired little girl in three-quarter profile to the left; in a seated position. The collar of the red dress and the ends of the short sleeves with a narrow white trim.

works.d: Tumesinises rõivastuses langetatud peaga naise rinnafiguur profiilis paremale. Foon sinakas üksikute kollaste aksentidega.
works.de: Bust figure of a woman with a lowered head, dressed in dark blue, in profile to the right. The background bluish with isolated yellow accents.

works.d: Lumine hoov vanalinnas: paremal lai madala katusega maja, mille kõrval varikatuse all vanker. Vasakul tagaplaanil kõrgete teravatipuliste katuste ja pikkade korstnatega kivimajad, mille juurest viib esiplaanil olevast hoovist värav. Väravaavast paistavad kaks lumist puud. Pruunikaskollane üldkoloriit, kohati pastoosne.
works.de: A snowy courtyard in the old town: on the right a wide, low-roofed house, next to which a cart stands under a canopy. In the background on the left, stone houses with high pointed roofs and long chimneys, from which a gate leads out of the courtyard in the foreground. Through the gate opening two snowy trees can be seen. Overall brownish-yellow colour scheme, in places pastose.

works.d: Valge vaas punaste ja kollaste õitega pruunil taustal.
works.de: A white vase with red and yellow flowers against a brown background.

works.d: Vanade kivimüüride vahel, võlvitud avauses kaks figuuri: vasakul punases ääristatud rüüs ja sandaalides pooleldi kiilaspäine mees, pruun kott üle õla, vasak käsi paremal seisva tumedapäise poisikese õlal. Poiss hoiab käes anumat, tema kuue peal ümber õlgade suur punane rätik. Punakaspruunides ja rohelistes toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Between old stone walls, in a vaulted opening, two figures: on the left a half-bald man in a red-trimmed robe and sandals, a brown bag over his shoulder, his left hand on the shoulder of a dark-haired boy standing to the right. The boy holds a vessel in his hands, a large red shawl draped around his shoulders over his coat. In reddish-brown and green tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik, taga lehtpuumets.
works.de: In the foreground an open field, behind it a deciduous forest.

works.d: Mustas pihtseelikus ja valges pluusis vanema naise rindportree otsevaates.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in a black pinafore skirt and white blouse, in frontal view.

works.d: Naise pea etüüd kolmveerandis vasakule, rohelises, lillas ja oranžis toonis prantsuse pastell paberil. /liivatooni/.(eesti)
works.de: A study of a woman's head in three-quarter view to the left, in green, purple and orange tones, French pastel on paper. /sand-toned/.

works.d: Toolil istuva tütarlapse rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, valge tanu otsaesise seosega, pruunid juuksed, paremal all punase polstriga toolikorju.(eesti)
works.de: Bust of a girl sitting on a chair, in three-quarter profile to the left, white cap with a band on the forehead, brown hair, on the right below the red-upholstered chair back visible.(eesti)

works.t: Vanad pärnad Tamme kõrtsi juures Tartu lähedal
works.d: Paremal kõrged, jämeda tüvega ja tiheda krooniga pärnad, mille vahelt paistavab väike palkidest küün. Vasemal kuivanud puu, tagapool madalad talumajad, kõrval põllulapil kari. Taamal sinises vinas tasandil Vooremäega.
works.de: On the right tall lime trees with thick trunks and dense crowns, between which a small log barn is visible. On the left a withered tree, behind it low farmhouses, beside them a herd on a field patch. In the distance, in a blue haze, a plain with Vooremäe.

works.d: Sõjaväelase vormis tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur. Pea en face. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Vasak käsivars toetatud toolileenile. Taustaks tumepunane draperii.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man in military uniform sitting in an armchair. Head en face. Body with a slight turn to the left. Left forearm resting on the armrest. Background of dark red drapery.

works.d: Veekogu paatidega. Vastaskallas laugjas. Maalitud õhukeselt valkjas - sinises koloriidis.
works.de: A body of water with boats. The opposite bank is low-lying. Painted thinly in a whitish-blue colour scheme.

works.d: Vasakul kallas suurte kivirahnudega, paremal jõekäär madala vastaskaldaga, taamal sinavad mäed.
works.de: On the left a bank with large boulders, on the right a river bend with a low opposite bank, in the distance bluish mountains.

works.d: Paremal all istub pika hali habemega vanamees. Vasakul põlvel hoiab kannelt. Pea on 3/4 profiilis vasakule. Ülaosas lamavas asendis seelikus naise keha kuni kaelani.
works.de: Lower right, an old man with a long grey beard is seated. He holds a kannel on his left knee. The head is in 3/4 profile to the left. In the upper part, in a reclining position, a woman's body in a skirt up to the neck.

works.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis, suunaga vasakule. Seljas valge pluus ja punane, rohelise ääristusega pihik. Peakatteks valge rätt.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a girl in a sitting position, facing left. Wearing a white blouse and a red pinafore trimmed in green. Headwear a white kerchief.

works.d: Esiplaanil majade vahel õu. Taamal majade katused ja kirikutornid.
works.de: In the foreground, a courtyard between houses. In the distance, roofs of houses and church towers.

works.d: Pargi vaade hõredalt kasvavate jämedamate ja peenemate lehtpuudega. Ees vasakul suur kivi.
works.de: View of a park with sparsely growing deciduous trees, thicker and thinner. A large stone in front on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil sillerdav hallikassinine veepind. Silmapiiril vasakul purjekas, kauguses veel kahe purjelaeva purjed. Helesinine, silmapiiri kohal rippuvate roosakate pilvedega taevas.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a shimmering greyish-blue water surface. On the horizon to the left a sailboat, in the distance also the sails of two more sailing ships. A light blue sky with pinkish clouds hanging above the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruun ümar vaas suure kimbu kollaste kullerkuppudega, osa kullerkuppude kroonlehtedest pudenemas. Foon tumeroheline, paremalt pisut heledam.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a brown round vase with a large bunch of yellow marsh marigolds, some of the marsh marigolds' petals falling off. The background dark green, slightly lighter on the right.

works.d: Roosakais-lillakais toonides visandlik maastikupilt puudesalu ning lagendikuga. Keskplaanil vasakul lilla puuderühm, paremal üksik roheline puu. Esiplaan oranzides pruunikates toonides. Lillakas-roosas taevas kollased päikeseviirud.
works.de: A sketchy landscape in pinkish-lilac tones with a grove of trees and a clearing. In the middle ground on the left a lilac group of trees, on the right a solitary green tree. Foreground in orange-brownish tones. Lilac-pink sky with yellow streaks of sunlight.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal liivane merekallas suure kiviga ja kõrgendikuga, millel puid. Vasakul kivine rand ja meri.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a sandy sea shore with a large stone and an elevation with trees on it. On the left, a rocky shore and the sea.

works.d: Paremal tormine meri purjekaga, vasakul kaljune rand vanade hoonete ja figuuridega.
works.de: On the right a stormy sea with a sailboat, on the left a rocky shore with old buildings and figures.

works.d: Keset lainetavat merd merelohe pea pöördega paremale. Parem käpp ettepoole sirutatud. Temast paremal taamal teine merelohe. Pilvine taevas heleda horisondiribaga.
works.de: In the middle of a rolling sea the head of a sea dragon turned to the right. Right paw stretched forward. To the right of it, further back, a second sea dragon. Cloudy sky with a light strip on the horizon.

works.d: Toore liha värvi punakaspruunil alusel puust kübarategemise mannekeeni meenutav pea silmalohkude ja teravalt eenduva keskjoonega. Pea oliivikarva ja pruunides toonides, ümber valkjashall aurat meenutav ring. Abstraktsetest hallidest kujunditest komponeeritud foon.
works.de: A wooden head resembling a hat-making mannequin, in the colour of raw meat, on a reddish-brown base, with eye sockets and a sharply protruding centre line. The head in olive and brown tones, surrounded by a whitish-grey ring resembling an aura. Background composed of abstract grey shapes.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Mustade juustega ja prillidega naisel seljas sinine kleit, kaelas kirju rätt. Taust tume.
works.de: Chest-length figure of a middle-aged woman in a slight turn to the right. The black-haired, bespectacled woman is wearing a blue dress, with a colourful scarf around her neck. Dark background.

works.d: Esiplaanil mees märsiga kätel, tema taga lilla hobune.
works.de: In the foreground a man with a knapsack in his hands, behind him a purple horse.

works.d: Kupliga ümarehitis uusgooti laadis.
works.de: A domed round building in Neo-Gothic style.

works.d: Ees vasakul kaks naist viljavihkudega, paremal alasi juures kaks meest ja naisfiguur. Tagaplaanil keskel kai ääres purjekas.
works.de: On the left in front, two women with sheaves of grain, on the right by an anvil two men and a female figure. In the background in the centre, a sailing boat by the quay.

works.d: Heledate, laines üle pea ja õlgade langevate juustega Kristuse pea, helepruunid vuntsid ja habe, kollakad silmad, kitsas kahvatu näoovaal. Seljas tumepunane ja roheline rüü, mille all valge särk, servas ornamenteeritud pael. Kristuse pea ümber nimbus, mille sees punane õis. Kroonlehtede vahel taimelehed. Foon sinine, klaasile maalitud mustad taimemotiivid.
works.de: The head of Christ with light, wavy hair falling over the head and shoulders, light brown moustache and beard, yellowish eyes, a narrow pale oval face. Wearing a dark red and green robe, under which a white shirt, with an ornamented ribbon at the edge. Around Christ's head a nimbus, inside which a red blossom. Plant leaves between the petals. The background is blue, black plant motifs painted on glass.

works.d: Vaade sillutatud siseõuele. Üle majade paistmas koonusekujuline mägi. Taevas sinine. Mäed mererohelises - lillas koloriidis.
works.de: View of a paved courtyard. A cone-shaped mountain visible above the houses. The sky is blue. The mountains in a sea-green - purple coloration.

works.d: Hallis kelidis naise portree kerges pöördes vasakule. Heledates juustes pisut halli, kõrva juurest üles tõstetud ja kinnitatud. Siniste silmade, ümarate põskede, pisut püstja nina ja väikese suuga suu. Kõrvas mererohelise kiviga kõrvarõngas. Foon kollakas-hall, ebaühtlaselt läbi maalitud.
works.de: Portrait of a woman in a grey dress, in a slight turn to the left. Her light hair, slightly grey, is raised and fastened up from behind the ear. Blue eyes, round cheeks, a slightly upturned nose and a small mouth. In the ear an earring with a sea-green stone. The background yellowish-grey, painted unevenly throughout.

works.d: Ees keskel tahaplaanile kulgev tee, taga vasakul linn, majad, keskel ja paremal kauge mägimaastik, taevas foonil kollakaid pilvi.
works.de: In front in the middle a road running into the background, behind on the left a town, houses, in the middle and on the right a distant mountain landscape, in the background sky with yellowish clouds.

works.d: Tumedate keskelt lahku kammitud juustega tütarlapse rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Pilk suunatud alla. Seljas tumepruun kitsa valge kraekesega kleit.
works.de: Bust portrait of a girl with dark hair parted in the middle, in half-profile to the left. Gaze directed downward. Wearing a dark brown dress with a narrow white collar.

works.d: Hallil, alt tumedamaks muutuval foonil vanema eesti talumehe portree. Mehel pikad, üle kõrvade tumekollased juuksed, lühike habe ja vuntsid. Tugev nina punetab pisut. Mehel seljas karusnahast servadega läkiläki, tume vammus üles tõstetud kraega, valge särk ja tumeroheline kuub. Mehe tugevates kätes väike ümar tubakatoos.
works.de: Portrait of an older Estonian farmer on a grey background that darkens towards the bottom. The man has long, dark-yellow hair over his ears, a short beard and moustache. His strong nose is slightly reddened. He is wearing a fur-trimmed läkiläki (sheepskin cap-like garment), a dark waistcoat with a raised collar, a white shirt and a dark green coat. In the man's strong hands, a small round tobacco box.

works.d: Põõsastega ääristatud rohuplatsil vanaaegses rõivastuses meeste ja naiste poolringi keskel sulgedega kübaras naise ja kaabut kergitava mehe figuur.
works.de: In the middle of a semicircle of men and women dressed in old-fashioned clothing on a grass plot bordered by bushes, the figures of a woman in a feathered hat and a man lifting his hat.

works.d: Kolm üksteise kõrval seisvat täisfiguuri. Keskmine neist naine valgetes pikkades pükstes ja puusadelt kohevas sinises kuues. Kahel pool tumedas rõivas mehed.
works.de: Three full figures standing next to one another. The middle one is a woman in white long trousers and a fluffy blue coat from the hips down. On both sides men in dark clothing.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine väljak. Rannavärava kohal sõiduautosid ja jalakäijaid. Rannavärava ja paremal künkal kasvavate puude vahelt paistab kollase hoone taga Oleviste kirik.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a snowy square. Above the beach gate, cars and pedestrians. Between the beach gate and the trees growing on a hillock to the right, behind a yellow building, St Olaf's Church can be seen.

works.d: Sinisel, tumelillal, all paremal roosakal foonil, kolmnurkne, abstraktne kompositsioon teravikuga alla, sinistest, punastest, roosakatest, valgetest diagonaalsetest ja kaarjatest joontest.
works.de: On a blue, dark violet, at the bottom right pinkish background, a triangular, abstract composition with the point downward, made of blue, red, pinkish, white diagonal and curving lines.

works.d: Pruunil laual, silindrilise kujuga ülalt avarduvas nõus kirju kimp: suured valged õiepallid ning lillad ja oranzid õied. Vaasist paremal ja taga ümmargune nõu pruuni sanga ja kaanega. Kaanel valge ümmargune nupp. Vasakul hall madal alustass. Foon sinine.
works.de: On a brown table, in a cylindrically shaped vessel widening upwards, a colourful bouquet: large white flower-balls and purple and orange flowers. To the right of and behind the vase a round vessel with a brown handle and lid. On the lid a white round knob. On the left a low grey saucer. Background blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil, üle kogu pildi laiuse ulatuselt, väeüksus ratsa. Enamik mehi täishabemega. Relvastus koosneb piigist, püssist ja mõõgast. Taustaks mäed.
works.de: In the foreground, spanning the entire width of the picture, a mounted military unit. Most of the men are fully bearded. Armament consists of a pike, a rifle and a sword. Mountains as background.

works.d: Pärnu vanalinna hoov: esiplaanil ümara kangialusega maja, mille külgedel paremal väikesed ümarate kaartega uksed. Kangialuses seisab vanker ja hobune. Foonil paistab läbi kangialuse päikesepaisteline õu, punase katuse ja uksega maja ning valged palakad õues nööril rippumas.
works.de: A courtyard in Pärnu Old Town: in the foreground a house with a round gateway passage, with small round-arched doors on the right side. A cart and a horse stand in the gateway passage. In the background, through the gateway passage, a sunlit yard can be seen, a house with a red roof and door, and white pieces of cloth hanging on a line in the yard.

works.d: Ees paremal lillelisel niidul suure kase tüve najal istuv tütarlaps, vasemal suur pikakarvaline koer. Kase taga tihe kuusk, mille oksad koos kase oksastikuga katavad kogu pildi ülemise osa. Okste alt vaade päikeselisele puisniidule.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a girl sitting leaning against the trunk of a large birch in a flowery meadow, on the left a large long-haired dog. Behind the birch a dense spruce, its branches together with the birch's branches covering the entire upper part of the picture. View of a sunny wooded meadow beneath the branches.

works.d: Tumesinise tähistaeva taustal, laineliste leekidega alasi kõrval seisab harkisjalu noormees selgvaates. Vasakus tõstetud käes hoiab viieharulist tähte, parem vasaraga löögivalmis. Mehel heledad pikad juuksed seljal, seljas kääritud käistega hele särk, puss vööl, jalas viisud. Valdavalt erksad sinised-kollased toonid, dekoratiivne kujutamislaad.
works.de: Against the background of a dark blue starry sky, beside an anvil with wavy flames, stands a young man with legs apart, seen frontally. In his raised left hand he holds a five-pointed star, his right hand with a hammer ready to strike. The man has long light hair down his back, wears a light shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a knife at his belt, and bast shoes on his feet. Predominantly bright blue and yellow tones, decorative manner of depiction.

works.d: Istuvas asendis vanamehe 3/4 figuuri poolprofiilis paremale; prillid ninal, tikitud müts peas, sabaga kuub seljas, paremas käes kotike, vasem toetub rahakapi uksele. Taga kappriiul kotikeste ja raamatutega. Seinal ülal par. osalt nähtav pilt ja pildiraam.(eesti)
works.de: A sitting old man depicted in a three-quarter figure, in semi-profile facing right; spectacles on his nose, an embroidered cap on his head, wearing a tailed coat, a small pouch in his right hand, his left resting on the door of a strongbox. Behind him a cupboard shelf with pouches and books. On the wall above, a partly visible painting and picture frame.

works.d: Ees keskel, keset jõge väikesel saarel linnud. Taga, vastaskaldal hoonete rida, mille tagant algab järsuseinaline kaljumäestik kindluslinnuse varemetega keskmisel kaljuplatool.(eesti)
works.de: In front, in the middle, birds on a small island in the middle of a river. Behind, on the opposite bank, a row of buildings, behind which begins a steep-walled rocky mountain range with the ruins of a fortress-town on the middle rocky plateau.(eesti)

works.d: Esiplaanil asuvate väikeste küngaste taga kahe maja pruunid katused ja järvevesi, mille keskel paistab väike, puudega kaetud saar. Tagaplaanil puudemassiivid. Silmapiir suhteliselt madalal, taevas kaetud pilvedega. Koloriit ühtlaselt hallikasroheline. (eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, behind small hills, the brown roofs of two houses and lake water, in the middle of which a small island covered with trees can be seen. In the background, masses of trees. The horizon is relatively low, the sky covered with clouds. The coloring is uniformly grayish-green.

works.d: Vanema daami poolfiguur, veerandprofiilis vasakule, mustas kleidis valge krae ja tanuga, vasakul käel punasekirjaline rätik.
works.de: Half-figure of an elderly lady, in three-quarter profile to the left, in a black dress with a white collar and bonnet, in her left hand a scarf with red writing.

works.d: Naivistlikus-realistlikus laadis maalitud vaade läbi avatud ukse taraga piiratud hoovi. Heledas päikesesäras mängib keksu sinises kleidis pruunijuukseline tüdruk. Tüdruk külgvaates, seisab ühel jajal, samal ajal kummardudes ette kivikest haarama. Tüdruku taga ripub nöörile kuivama pandud pesu.
works.de: A view painted in a naivistic-realistic manner through an open door into a yard enclosed by a fence. In bright sunshine a brown-haired girl in a blue dress plays hopscotch. The girl is seen in profile, standing on one leg, while bending forward to grab a small stone. Behind the girl laundry hangs drying on a line.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul vanad kõrged puud. Keskel käänuline jõgi veskitammiga ja veskihoonetega paremal kaldal. Samas näha ka teisi hooneid osalt varjatuna puudetukast. Paremal kallast pidi üles viiv teerada naise figuuriga. Esiplaanil jõel tühi paat. Taeval valkjas - hallikad pilved. Keskosas paistab kauge silmapiir.
works.de: In the foreground on the left old tall trees. In the middle a winding river with a mill dam and mill buildings on the right bank. Also visible are other buildings, partly hidden by a clump of trees. On the right a path leading up along the bank with a woman's figure. In the foreground an empty boat on the river. Sky whitish-greyish clouds. In the central part a distant horizon is visible.

works.d: Avar maastikuvaade: esiplaanil kollakates ja punakaspruunides toonides ülesküntud põld, mille taga keskel kasesalu ja üksikuid puudegruppe viimasest vasakul ja paremal. Silmapiiril sinakasroheline metsaviirg, mille kohal erksinine taevas kollastes ja roosades toonides antud väikeste madalate pilvedega. Tihe säpsiv pintslitehnika.(eesti)
works.de: A broad landscape view: in the foreground a ploughed field in yellowish and reddish-brown tones, behind it in the middle a birch grove and isolated groups of trees to the left and right of it. On the horizon a bluish-green strip of forest, above which a bright blue sky in yellow and pink tones is rendered with small low clouds. A dense, choppy brush technique.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Keskplaanil paremal puud, vsakul muruga kaetud nõlvak. Puude all naisfiguur punases kleidis päikesevarjuga.
works.de: A body of water in the foreground. In the middle ground, trees on the right, a grass-covered slope on the left. Under the trees a female figure in a red dress with a parasol.

works.d: Vertikaalselt lõhestab pildi pinda sinine kujund, mis allservas kasvab üle punaseks, mannekeeni õlapartiid meenutavaks osas. Sinise kujundi ülaosas piiravad seda punane, kollane ja valge triip. Vertikaalsest keskjoonest paremal kollane, ühe musta silmaga ja oranži juuksepahmakaga nägu. Foon tumehall.
works.de: A blue shape vertically splits the surface of the picture, which at the bottom grows over into a red section resembling the shoulder part of a mannequin. At the top of the blue shape it is bordered by a red, yellow and white stripe. To the right of the vertical centre line, a yellow face with one black eye and a tousled orange mop of hair. The background is dark grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil roigastara, mille mulgu kohal mees aeruga õlal. Vasemal, diagonaalis pildi keskääreni ulatuv jõgi, mis keskalal ühineb suurema, järvetaolise veekoguga. Jõe kõrgemal tagakaldal lehtpuid ja torniga kivihoone. Sellest paremal, madalikul, gooti stiilis kirik. Paremal järve kaldal puude vahel rida taluhooneid. Kauguses paistab teise kiriku torni siluett. Järve pinnaleespool sõudepaat kolme sõitjaga, kaugemal purjekaid. Öises taevas täiskuu.
works.de: In the foreground, a pole fence with a man carrying an oar over his shoulder above a gap in it. On the left, a river running diagonally to the middle edge of the picture, which in the middle area joins a larger, lake-like body of water. On the higher far bank of the river, deciduous trees and a stone building with a tower. To the right of it, on lower ground, a Gothic-style church. On the right, along the lake shore, a row of farm buildings among trees. In the distance, the silhouette of another church tower is visible. On the surface of the lake, a rowing boat with three passengers, and sailing boats further away. A full moon in the night sky.

works.d: Rohelusega kaetud laugjate mägede vahel jõekäär. Esiplaanil kaldaveerel sopiline maja lagunenud aiaga puude-põõsaste taustal. Paremal sillaksesel pesu loputav naine, kaldal paat. Silmapiiril paremal mäe otsas loss rünkpilvise taeva taustal.
works.de: A river bend among gently sloping mountains covered with greenery. In the foreground on the shore an irregularly shaped house with a dilapidated fence against a background of trees and bushes. On the right at the footbridge a woman rinsing laundry, a boat on the shore. On the horizon on the right, on top of a mountain, a castle against a background of a cumulus-clouded sky.

works.d: Pildil umbes viisteist astmeliselt kerkivat hoonet. Esiplaanil vasakul raudkividest müür ja trepp, paremal palm.

Esiplaanil ruudulises puhvis pükstes ja palja ülakehaga mees põdra seljas vilepilli puhumas. Vasakul lillad kaljud, millelt voolab peenike juga. Paremal roosad kaljurahnud, tagaplaanil lillakasroosad mäed, rohelised järved ja helerohelises lõõmas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a man in checked puffy trousers and bare torso rides on a deer's back, playing a whistle. On the left, purple cliffs from which a thin stream flows. On the right, pink rocky boulders, in the background purplish-pink mountains, green lakes and a bright green glowing sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul lillakas kleidis, paremal rooskaskleidis tütarlaps, taustaks meri ja mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a girl in a purplish dress, on the right a girl in a pink dress, with the sea and mountains as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Teisel pool veekogu maastik üksikute lehtpuude ja taluhoonetega. Horisondil mets ja üksik krikutorn vasakul.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water. On the other side of the water, a landscape with individual deciduous trees and farm buildings. On the horizon a forest and a solitary wooden watchtower on the left.

works.d: Hallide seintega toa nurgas istub tumedal toolil punakaspruunis kleidis, valge põllega tütarlaps. Tüdruku juuksed on sirged ja langevad kõrvadele, käed puhkavad teineteise kõrval süles. Tüdruku jalas mustad sukad ja kingad, kurbade silmadega pilk vastasnurka suunatud. Tüdrukust paremalt näha osa seina äärde lükatud lauast, mille kohal seinal ripub arvatavasti pilt.
works.de: In the corner of a room with grey walls sits a girl in a reddish-brown dress with a white apron, on a dark chair. The girl's hair is straight and falls to her ears, her hands rest side by side in her lap. The girl wears black stockings and shoes, her gaze with sad eyes directed at the opposite corner. To the right of the girl, part of a table pushed against the wall is visible, above which a picture presumably hangs on the wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi, vasakul hoone puudega, tagapool tornidega loss, taamal kõrged mäetipud.
works.de: In the foreground water, on the left a building with trees, behind it a castle with towers, in the distance tall mountain peaks.

works.d: Osa tänavast viilkatusega majadega, nende tagant paistab Oleviste torn.
works.de: Part of a street with gabled houses, behind which the tower of Oleviste is visible.

works.d: Noorepoolse mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale; parukas, kuldnööpidega kuues pits žabooga.
works.de: Bust portrait of a youngish man, half-profile to the right; wig, coat with gold buttons, lace jabot.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates, pea pöördes vasakule, pruunis kelidis pitsrüüžiga kaelaväljalõike ümber. Kaelas peene ketiga medaljon. Kõrvas kõrvarõngas.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in frontal view, head turned to the left, in a brown pelisse with a lace ruche around the neckline. A medallion on a fine chain around the neck. An earring in the ear.

works.d: Ees kaldaribal kaks suurt puud. Taga meri millesse paremalt ulatub kitsas rohtunud neem.
works.de: In front, on a strip of shore, two large trees. Behind, the sea, into which a narrow grassy headland extends from the right.

works.d: Veekogu, esiplaanil kaks paati ja väike laev, kaugemal sillakaared.
Vasakul Tallinna linnamüür tornidega. Toompea veerul bastionid. All keskel paremale suunduv tee ja põõsad. Hallis taevas napilt markeeritud pilvekuhilad. Roosades ja rohekashallides toonides. (eesti)
works.de: On the left, the Tallinn town wall with towers. Bastions on the slope of Toompea. Below in the middle a road leading to the right and bushes. In the grey sky sparsely marked cloud masses. In pink and greenish-grey tones. (Estonian)

works.d: Kallakuga katuseateljee akna taustal, valgel alusel keskplaanil diagonaalselt reastatult lillepottides kasvavad krüsanteemid, keskel maali ülemise ääreni ulatuv roosakasvalge, sellest paremal veidi lühem sinakasvalge krüsanteem. Esiplaanil vasakul maali alaääre poolt äralõigatud potis mitu väikest valget õit.
works.de: Against the background of a window in a sloped-roof studio, in the middle ground on a white base, chrysanthemums growing in flowerpots arranged diagonally, in the centre a pinkish-white one reaching to the upper edge of the painting, to its right a slightly shorter bluish-white chrysanthemum. In the foreground on the left, in a pot cut off by the lower edge of the painting, several small white blossoms.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, mille kõrkjatega kaldavetes vasakul üksik lootsik. Kaldaäärne maa võsastunud. Veekogu parema kalda maastik järsult tõusev. Samas mägiloss ja selle taga roosakas valguses püstloodis kerkivad kaljud.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, with a lone rowboat in the reed-lined shore waters on the left. The shore land overgrown. The landscape on the right bank of the water rising steeply. There too a mountain castle and behind it, in pinkish light, vertically rising cliffs.

works.d: Pruunil, tumeda kontuurjoonega markeeritud laual natüürmort: vasakult alates valge tass, sai, kaelast katkine vaas, punakaspruun peeker, must pudel ja sidrun paremal esiplaanil. Fooniks vasakul sinakashall draperii, paremal helehall sein.
works.de: On a brown table marked with a dark contour line, a still life: from the left, a white cup, bread, a vase broken at the neck, a reddish-brown mug, a black bottle and a lemon in the right foreground. The background on the left is a bluish-grey drapery, on the right a light grey wall.

works.d: Ees vasemal üksik, tagapool paremal grupp jaanalinde.
works.de: In front on the left a single ostrich, behind on the right a group of ostriches.

works.d: Kollakashall raam
works.de: Yellowish-grey frame

works.d: Värvimänguline kompositsioon nelinurkadest, mis osaliselt kattuvad. Moduleeritud nelja põhitooniga: roheline, kollane, sinine, punane. Värviruutude taust valkjaskollane.
works.de: A colourful composition of quadrilaterals, some overlapping. Modulated with four basic tones: green, yellow, blue, red. The background of the colour squares is whitish-yellow.

works.d: Noore naise põlvpilt poolprofiilis vasakule, istuvas asendis. Looriga kübaras ja karusnahkse kraega mantlis.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the left, in a sitting position. Wearing a veiled hat and a coat with a fur collar.

works.d: Vana naise portree poolprofiilis vasemale, valge kraega tumepruunis kleidis, musta jämedakoelise pitsiga kaela ümber ja varrukal õla juures. Peas valge õhuke kroogetega tanu, mis paljastab eest keskelt lahku kammitud hallikad juuksed, rohelise paelaga lõua alt kinni kuldne pross. Tumeroheline foon.
works.de: Portrait of an old woman in half-profile to the left, in a dark brown dress with a white collar, with coarse black lace around the neck and at the shoulder of the sleeve. On her head a thin white pleated bonnet, revealing greyish hair parted in the middle at the front, a golden brooch fastened under the chin with a green ribbon. Dark green background.

works.d: Hallide seinte ja pruuni põrandaga toa nurgas sinine, kõrge seljatoega pöördtool, millel kollane, pika musta lindiga kübar. Tooli ees kõrges klaaspurgis lillad gladioolid. Paremal ülal aken, aknalaual pika looriga naise statuett.
works.de: In the corner of a room with grey walls and a brown floor, a blue swivel chair with a high back, on which lies a yellow hat with a long black ribbon. In front of the chair, in a tall glass jar, purple gladioli. Above right a window, on the windowsill a statuette of a woman with a long veil.

works.dm: kõrgus: 28.2 cm (vm.; laius: 33.0 cm; laius: 20.7 cm (vm.)
works.d: Esiplaanil muru, vasemalt viib kitsas tee lossivaremete juurde, varemete ees üksikud puud - põõsad.(eesti)
works.de: Grass in the foreground, on the left a narrow path leads to castle ruins, solitary trees and bushes in front of the ruins.

works.d: Veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Vastaskaldal roosad majad roheliste puude vahel.
works.de: A body of water with a boat pier and boats. On the opposite bank pink houses among green trees.

works.d: Palja lagipeaga ja prillidega mehe rinnafiguur profiilis vasakule. Taust hele.
works.de: Bust of a bald, bespectacled man in profile facing left. Light background.

works.d: Esiplaanil poolummistunud külatänav hoonete reaga vasakul ja paremal.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a half-blocked village street with a row of buildings on the left and right.

works.d: Talvine hoovi vaade lumiste majadega. Vasakul raagus puu.
works.de: Winter view of a yard with snowy houses. On the left a bare tree.

works.d: Pruunil laual ja beezil foonil madalas klaasis lillad, punased ja valged levkoid.
works.de: On a brown table and beige background, in a low glass, purple, red and white stocks.

works.d: Keskel laastudest korv õunte ja viinamarjadega, paremal klaas punase mahlaga, taustaks punane drapeering.
works.de: In the middle a basket of shavings with apples and grapes, on the right a glass with red juice, background of red drapery.

works.d: Keskel helendava veepinnaga, kalda ääres türkiisisnise veega järv. Järvest tõusevad kaljused sinised mäed, mis silmapiirini välja vahelduvad orgudega. Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal on kaljude kivine pind antud lähivaates hallides ja pruunides toonides. Ülal kollakasvalgete suurte pilvedega taevas.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle a lake with a glowing water surface, turquoise-blue water near the shore. From the lake rise rocky blue mountains, alternating with valleys all the way to the horizon. In the foreground on the left and right the rocky surface of the cliffs is given in close view in grey and brown tones. Above, a sky with large yellowish-white clouds.

works.d: Lumises talvemaastikus paremalt taha vasakule sõitvad kaks rege. Paremal teeääres okaspuumets.
works.de: In a snowy winter landscape two sledges driving from right to back to left. On the right by the roadside a coniferous forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil valkjashall helklev veepind, milles vasakul peegelduvad liivasel kaldapealsel kasvavad männid. Paremal laugjaks muutunud maapind lõpeb silmapiiril metsaviiruga. Ülal valkjaskollaste pilvedega tihedalt kaetud taevas. Tuhmilt pastelne üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the foreground a whitish-grey shimmering water surface, in which pines growing on a sandy shore are reflected on the left. On the right the land becomes flatter, ending at the horizon in a strip of forest. Above, a sky densely covered with whitish-yellow clouds. Dull pastel overall colouring.

works.d: Rinnapilt en face, õlgadel roheline mantel punase voodriga; rinnas vasakul ordenitäht.
works.de: Bust portrait en face, green coat with red lining on the shoulders; an order star on the left of the chest.

works.d: Trepil istuva noorema heledapäise mehe (Tõnu Mikiver) 3/4 figuur poolpöördes vasakule. Taustaks püramiidjalt paigutatud hallid trepid (redelid). Mehel seljas valge särk, roheline kuub, jalas pruunid püksid. Käed süles, toetumas vasakule reiele.
works.de: 3/4-length figure of a younger fair-haired man (Tõnu Mikiver) sitting on a staircase, in a half-turn to the left. The background shows grey stairs (ladders) arranged in a pyramid shape. The man wears a white shirt, a green coat, and brown trousers. His hands rest in his lap, leaning on his left thigh.

works.d: Noore mehe poolportree: pea kerges pöördes vasakule, kere veerandpöördes paremale, mõlemad käed puusas. Mehel hele lokitud parukas, pruunid silmad, sirge nina, ümarad põsed ja punane pruntis suu. Seljas veinipunane vammus, kulla ja hõbedaga tikitud vest ja seotava kaelusega valge särk. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
works.de: Half-portrait of a young man: head slightly turned to the left, torso in a three-quarter turn to the right, both hands on hips. The man has a light curled wig, brown eyes, a straight nose, round cheeks and a red pursed mouth. He wears a wine-red doublet, a vest embroidered with gold and silver, and a white shirt with a tie-able collar. The background evenly dark.

works.d: Kalad ümmargusel vaagnal, paremal kapsapea. Tagapõhi tume.
works.de: Fish on a round platter, a cabbage head on the right. Dark background.

works.d: Kuulja keskosaga savikannu ümber kuhjatud sinise viinamarja kobaraid, pirne, aprikoose, ploome, oks rohelisi viinamarju.

Esiplaanil rohelistes-sinistes toonides lehtedel grupp neljast kalu vardasse lükkivast tütarlapsest. Kaks neist põlvitavad maas. Tütarlaste taga suur kaluripaat, taamal paistab meri. Kaladel hõbepaberit.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, on leaves in green-blue tones, a group of four girls skewering fish onto sticks. Two of them are kneeling on the ground. Behind the girls a large fishing boat, in the distance the sea is visible. The fish have silver paper on them.

works.d: Paremas ülaservas põld, inimesed kummargil saaki koristamas. Põllu servas suur korv kartulitega. Keskel valges särgikeses imik, kes magab kaarduvate lillakais toonides viljapeade all. Imiku ümber esiplaanil korvid ja kastid aed- ja puuviljadega.
works.de: In the upper right corner a field, people bent over harvesting the crop. At the edge of the field a large basket with potatoes. In the centre, an infant in a white little shirt sleeping under arching grain ears in purplish tones. Around the infant, in the foreground, baskets and crates with vegetables and fruit.

works.d: Keskel vaade loodusesse sinisest ruumist, mida kaunistavad kaks soklil sammast kahel pool aknataolist avaust, milleni viib neljaastmeline trepp. Avausest avaneb maastik sinakasrohelistes ja hõõguvpunastes toonides: pildi sügavusse viib kitsas tee, mida kahelt poolt piirab okastraadist kõrge aed. Teest mõlemal pool mahajäetud looduslikku heinamaad meenutav puude ja põõsaste ala. Ülal sinine, kiudpilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the centre, a view into nature from a blue space, decorated with two columns on pedestals on either side of a window-like opening, reached by a four-step staircase. The opening reveals a landscape in bluish-green and glowing red tones: a narrow path leads into the depth of the picture, bordered on both sides by a high barbed-wire fence. On both sides of the path is an area of trees and bushes reminiscent of an abandoned natural meadow. Above, a blue sky covered with fibrous clouds.

works.d: Kahel pool vertikaalset hallikat arhitektoonilist kujundit kasvuhoonet meenutavad sõrestikud, millest tungib välja hulk fantastilisi taimemotiive. Valitsevas mustjas gammas hõõgub punaseid toone ja üksikuid erkkollaseid, rohelisi laike.
works.de: On either side of a vertical greyish architectonic shape, greenhouse-like frameworks from which a multitude of fantastical plant motifs emerge. In the predominantly blackish colour range, red tones glow along with a few bright yellow and green patches.

works.d: Istuva vanema mehe figuur poolpöördes vasakule. Kuldraamidega prillid, õlgadeni juuksed, vuntsid, tömp hele habe. Peas kõrge valge peakate. Seljas rohekas rüü laiade käistega, valged kätised. Käed süles risti. Kaelas rist ja ovaalne raha. Foon hallikas-lilla.
works.de: Figure of a seated elderly man in a half-turn to the left. Gold-framed glasses, shoulder-length hair, moustache, blunt light beard. On his head a tall white headdress. Wearing a greenish robe with wide sleeves, white cuffs. Hands crossed in his lap. A cross and an oval coin on his neck. Grayish-purple background.

works.d: Agulivaade madalate, viilkatustega majadega. Keskjoonest veidi vasakul, ülemises neljandikus, hoonete vahel kõrge korsten. Paremal, esiplaanil oleva maja juures suur palgivirn, vasakul kolm palki.
works.de: View of a suburb with low, gable-roofed houses. Slightly left of the centre line, in the upper quarter, a tall chimney between the buildings. On the right, by the house in the foreground, a large woodpile of logs, on the left three logs.

works.d: Paremal, sügava dekolteega, õlgu paljaksjätvas kirjus kleidis naise rinnafiguur. Pea pöördes paremale. Pruunid, laines juuksed ulatuvad õlgadeni. Vasakul, varjus, kübaraga naine, käes punakas - roosakad lilled. Üldkoloriit tume.
works.de: On the right, the bust of a woman in a multicoloured dress with a deep décolletage, baring the shoulders. Head turned to the right. Brown, wavy hair reaching to the shoulders. On the left, in shadow, a woman with a hat, holding reddish-pink flowers. Overall colouring dark.

works.d: Pastelses, peenelt nüanseeritud, rohekas-beežis koloriidis, stiliseeriva vormikeelega maastikupilt. Esiplaanil kaharate lehekroonidega puud, taamal mäed. Nende jalamil grupp madalaid maju.
works.de: In a pastel, finely nuanced, greenish-beige colour scheme, a landscape painting with a stylising formal language. In the foreground trees with spreading crowns, beyond mountains. At their foot a group of low houses.

works.d: Mahedates beežikates, kollakates, pruunides toonides vaade poolenisti raagus puudele - põõsastele. Paremal kaks tumedat jändrikku puutüve, okste vahelt paistab roosakassinine taevas. Maalitud lopsakalt, kohati täppivalt, võrdlemisi pastoosselt.
works.de: In soft beige, yellowish, brown tones, a view of half-bare trees and bushes. On the right two dark, stunted tree trunks, with a pinkish-blue sky visible between the branches. Painted lushly, in places with dabs, rather impasto.

works.d: Keset õue kõrge rookatusega ait. Katusealuses vanker ja kolm inimfiguuri. Taga paremal, aida nurga juurest paistab hele hoone. Taevas helesinine, valgete pilvekiududega.
works.de: In the middle of the yard a barn with a tall reed roof. Under the roof a cart and three human figures. Behind on the right, near the corner of the barn, a bright building can be seen. The sky light blue, with white wisps of cloud.

works.d: Valgel ratsul kappamas alasti mehefiguur, jalad põlvede juurest äralõigatud. Parem käsi tõstetud, vasak hoidmas hobuse lakka. Heledad juuksed tuules lehvimas. Paremal kaks vasakule looka paindunud puud. Taust erksates sinistes-oranzides värvides.
works.de: A nude male figure galloping on a white steed, legs cut off at the knees. Right hand raised, left hand holding the horse's mane. Fair hair fluttering in the wind. On the right two trees bent leftward in an arc. The background in bright blue and orange colors.

works.d: Grisais maalitud habemega vanema mehe portree, profiilis paremale. Käed ristatud lõua alla, ees ümarate raamidega prillid.
works.de: Portrait of a bearded older man painted in grisaille, in profile to the right. Arms crossed below the chin, in front round-framed glasses.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 18.9 cm (km); lehe laius: 23.5 cm (lm ); kujutise laius: 21.3 cm (km  ); lehe kõrgus: 18.9 cm (lm  )
works.d: Esiplaanil peegelsile jõepind. Kaldad kaetud metsaga. Keskel, kalda all üksik paat.
works.de: In the foreground a mirror-smooth river surface. The banks covered with forest. In the middle, below the bank, a lone boat.

works.d: Esiplaanil rand, raagus puudega vasakul ja kolme figuuriga keskosas. Keskel paremal üle kitsama lahesopi paistab kaljune rand puude ja majadega. Vasakul avameri. Tagaplaanil keskel paistab üle vee sinetav kaljune rand.
works.de: In the foreground a beach, with bare trees on the left and three figures in the middle section. In the middle, on the right, across a narrower bay inlet, a rocky shore with trees and houses is visible. On the left the open sea. In the background, in the middle, a bluish rocky shore is visible across the water.

works.d: Vaade suvisele, päikesepaistes vanalinnatänavale, mõlemal pool erksate oranzikas-punaste viilkatustega kivimajad. Tumedad varjud esiplaanil ja paremal tänava ääres. Eespool üks, kaugemal kolm hobust vankritega, üksikuid inimesi tänaval. Tagaplaanil paremal, helesinise taeva taustal Niguliste kirik roheka tornikiivriga. Maalitud lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: View of a sunny summer old-town street, with stone houses with bright orange-red gable roofs on both sides. Dark shadows in the foreground and along the street on the right. In front one, further away three horses with carts, a few isolated people on the street. In the background on the right, against a light blue sky, St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) with a greenish spire. Painted with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Kahel pool teed rukkipõld, mille servi palistavad kirevad aasalilled ning kolm valgetes õites põõsast. Tagaplaanil, künkal tuulik, vasakul paistab talumaja katus. Koloriit hele, maalimislaad detailiseeriv.
works.de: On both sides of the road a rye field, whose edges are fringed with colourful meadow flowers and three bushes with white blossoms. In the background, on a hill, a windmill, on the left the roof of a farmhouse is visible. The colour scheme is light, the painting style detailed.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal äärel püstiseisev mees fotoaparaadiga pildistamise asendis, paremal puude all kaks murul istuvat (pildistatavat) naist; taamal veekogu ja hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground on the left edge a standing man with a camera in the pose of taking a photograph, on the right under trees two women (being photographed) sitting on the grass; in the distance a body of water and buildings.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kõrgus: 36.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 27.0 cm; laius: 29.0 cm
works.d: Heledajuukselise noore mehe rinnapilt kerge pöördega paremale. Mokahabe. Kujutis maalitud raamis.
works.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired young man with a slight turn to the right. Moustache. Image painted within a frame.

works.d: Kaks naist istuvad kõrvu, õlad vastamisi ent teineteisest eemale pöördunult. Taga toa interjöör.
works.de: Two women sit side by side, shoulders facing each other yet turned away from one another. Behind, a room interior.

works.d: Võlvitud väravaaval seisev rahvarõivais ja sirbiga naise figuur, kelle ees samuti rahvarõivais istuva naise figuur. Väravat ümbritsevad lilled ja lehestik. Taamal avaneb vaade päikesepaistelisele põllule.
works.de: A figure of a woman in folk costume with a sickle, standing under an arched gate opening, before whom sits another figure of a woman also in folk costume. The gate is surrounded by flowers and foliage. In the distance a view opens onto a sunlit field.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal meri üksikute purjekatega. Vasakul kõrge kaljukallas ehitistega. Taamal mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the right the sea with a few sailboats. On the left a high rocky bank with buildings. Mountains in the distance.

Kaljumaastiku taustal ees vasakul grupp kuldsete nimbustega jüngreid. Ikooni keskel Kristus, parem käsi tõstetud, osundamas ikooni paremas servas olevale valges rüüs kuldse nimbusega mehele, kes astub välja hauakambrist. Mehe taga grupp üllatunud nägudega inimesi. All keskel kaks naist kummardamas Kristust.
works.de: Against a background of rocky landscape, in the foreground on the left a group of disciples with golden nimbi. In the middle of the icon Christ, right hand raised, pointing to a man in a white robe with a golden nimbus on the right edge of the icon, stepping out of the tomb chamber. Behind the man a group of people with astonished faces. Below in the middle two women bowing before Christ.

Vasakul külgvaates põlvistes figuur lõigatud reie kohalt, käed kuklal. Üle kahe maaliosa ülal vasakul kägarasendis naisekuju, jalad seongus enda kohal. Dark greenish colour scheme, vigorous brushwork.

In the foreground on the left a standing long-haired female nude in frontal view, with the raised left hand holding a golden scythe by the cutting blade. To the right of the boat a standing female nude in frontal view, raised hands on the nape. The water is bordered from above by a bright yellowish-orange glow with a jagged upper edge, above which a blue expanse, black at the upper edge, with dimly discernible golden letters.

Esiplaanil vasakul rohumaa, paremal jõgi, taga vasakul jõekaldal üksikud puud ja põõsad, taga paremal maja.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a meadow, on the right a river, behind on the left bank of the river solitary trees and bushes, behind on the right a house.

works.d: Seitse punast õuna ühe kollase õuna ümber.
works.de: Seven red apples around one yellow apple.

works.d: Metsavaheline tee, inimestegrupiga selgvaates.
works.de: A forest path, with a group of people in clear view.

works.d: Kirju riidega kaetud astmelisel alusel rohekas vaas, laualamp rohelise abažuuriga, roosa kauss, kaks pudelit jm. Taustal osa aknast, paksudes voltides langeva eesriidega. Intensiivsed värvid pruunil foonil.
works.de: On a stepped base covered with a patterned cloth, a greenish vase, a table lamp with a green lampshade, a pink bowl, two bottles etc. In the background, part of a window with a curtain falling in thick folds. Intense colours on a brown background.

works.d: Vasakul neljast mehest koosnev grupp. Paremalt esimesel mehel keal välja sirutatud, pea kuklas. Paremalt teisel mehel käes kepp, millega osutab pildi parempoolset osa täitvale maketile. Kaks ülejäänud meest tähelepanelike nägudega eelmist kuulamas. Pildi parempoolset osa täidab mingi suure ala hoonestuse makett. Pilt heledates, akvarelsetes, sinistes-rohelistes-roosades värvitoonides.(eesti)
works.de: On the left a group consisting of four men. The first man from the right has his leg stretched out, head thrown back. The second man from the right holds a stick, with which he points to a model filling the right-hand part of the picture. The two remaining men have attentive faces, listening to the former. The right-hand part of the picture is filled with a model of some large area's buildings. The picture is in light, watercolour-like, blue-green-pink shades.

works.d: Valged ja roosad hortensia õied.
works.de: White and pink hydrangea flowers.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendikul vasakul ja paremal leht - ja okaspuud. Taamal mets.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 26.0 cm; lehe laius: 19.6 cm
works.d: Ees fantastilises sünges ruumis kolm istuvat figuuri. Taga valges rüüs seisev ja punases rüüs istuv naisfiguur.
works.de: In front, in a fantastical gloomy space, three seated figures. Behind, a female figure standing in a white robe and a female figure seated in a red robe.

works.d: Ees vasakul järve kaldal suurel kivil istuv naisfiguur, pea painutatud põlvedele. Tema taga üksikud suured puud. Paremal, vee ääres seisev figuur. Tagaplaanil hobune.
works.de: In the front on the left a female figure sitting on a large stone on the lake shore, head bent to the knees. Behind her solitary large trees. On the right, a figure standing by the water. In the background a horse.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.0 cm; lehe laius: 32.8 cm
works.d: I osa vasakul: vees olev grupp neljast inimesest
works.de: Part I, left: a group of four people in the water

works.d: Kurrulise mägimaastiku ja roosaka taeva taustal seisev alasti naisfiguur.
works.de: A standing nude female figure against a background of a wrinkled mountain landscape and pinkish sky.

works.d: Naise pea poolprofiilis paremale, nägu välja joonistatud kuni juuksepiirini.
Pikkade, tumedate paljale seljale langevate juustega tütarlapse täisprofiil paremale.
works.de: Full profile to the right of a girl with long, dark hair falling onto her bare back.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas kivide ja palkidega. Samas paremal naine pesu pesemas. Temast paremal istub poiss, profiilis vasakule. Nendest vasakul kaks parti. Kalda ääres hobune veevaadiga. Paremal kerkiva liivase jõekalda tagant paistab korstnaga talumaja. Jõel näha paate. Üle jõe puude vahel paistavad hooned.
works.de: In the foreground, a riverbank with stones and logs. There, on the right, a woman washing laundry. To her right sits a boy, in profile facing left. To their left, two ducks. By the shore, a horse with a water barrel. On the right, behind the rising sandy riverbank, a farmhouse with a chimney is visible. Boats can be seen on the river. Across the river, buildings are visible between the trees.

works.d: Pruunist foonist on nõrga kontuuriga eraldatud vaas väikeõieliste, siniste meelespeadega.(eesti)
works.de: Against a brown background, a vase with small-flowered blue forget-me-nots is set off by a faint contour.

works.d: Keskel sfinksi kuju lamavana peata kehal. Selja taga peaga sfinksile toetuv ebamäärane fantastiline elukas.
works.de: In the centre, the figure of a sphinx, headless, lying on a body. Behind it, resting its head on the sphinx, an indeterminate fantastic creature.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohumaa, mida tagapool piirab lehtpuude ja põõsaste vöönd.
Üksikud suured raagus puud kevad  - talvel.
Esiplaanil eest taha suunduv teerada. Tagapool põõsastik ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground a path leading from front to back. Shrubbery and trees behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik ( ? ). Taga lehtpuumets.
Kiilaspäise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Suus suitsev sigarett.
works.de: Bust portrait of a bald man in half-profile to the right. A smoking cigarette in his mouth.

works.d: Kiilaspäise mehe pea en face. Suus suitsev piip. Ebamäärastes rohekaspruunides toonides.
works.de: The head of a bald man, en face. A smoking pipe in his mouth. In indeterminate greenish-brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil nõmm; taga männid ja mets; taevas rünkpilved.
Mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale, halli põskhabemega, mundris, paremas käes kiri, taga paremal maal ja raamatuid.
works.de: Half-length portrait of a man in semi-profile to the right, with grey side-whiskers, in uniform, a letter in his right hand, a painting and books behind on the right.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise, vurrude ja täishabemega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Tume ülikond, kaelaside.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man with brown hair, moustache and full beard, in half-profile to the right. Dark suit, necktie.

works.d: Noormehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, valge krae ja musta kuuega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man in half-profile to the right, with a white collar and black coat.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv linnatänav (Müürivahe tn.) majadega mõlemal küljel. Paremal pool üle katuste näha linnamüüri, mille lõpp - punktiks kaitsetorn. Tänaval näha kahte inimkogu. Esiplaanil paremal maja küljes silt "Söögimaja".
works.de: In the foreground a city street receding into depth (Müürivahe tn.) with houses on both sides. On the right, above the roofs, the town wall is visible, ending in a point - a defence tower. On the street two groups of people are visible. In the foreground on the right, on the side of a house, a sign "Söögimaja".

works.d: Peamiselt hallides ja sinistes toonides värvilaikudest kujundatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Osa kompositsiooni kuuluvatest värvilaikudest ja -pritsmetest on kantud klaasile ja raamile.
works.de: An abstract composition formed mainly of grey and blue tone patches. Some of the colour patches and splashes belonging to the composition have been applied to the glass and the frame.

works.d: Tihedalt läbimaalitud, üksteisesse sulavates kollastes, pruunides ja sinistes toonides peaaegu abstraktse pildina mõjuv, vaid aimatavate viidetega reaalsusele komponeeritud maastik. Ülal keskel kollase plahvatusena mõjuv kujund.
works.de: A densely painted landscape, appearing almost as an abstract picture in yellow, brown and blue tones merging into one another, composed with only barely perceptible references to reality. At the top centre a shape resembling a yellow explosion.

works.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, pea kergelt pööratud, üks käsi toetub lauale, teine põlvele, pisut käharduvad hallisegused juuksed, väikese kühmuga nina. Pruun ülikond, valge särk, tumesinine valge kitsa triibuga lips.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man, head slightly turned, one hand resting on a table, the other on the knee, slightly curling greyish hair, nose with a small hump. Brown suit, white shirt, dark blue tie with a narrow white stripe.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumehanged, paremal maja, vasakul kõrge müür, mille taga raagus puud. Vasak osa kaetud sinaka varjuga, parem valgustatud.
works.de: In the foreground snowdrifts, on the right a house, on the left a high wall behind which bare trees stand. The left part is covered in a bluish shadow, the right is illuminated.

works.d: Esiplaanil rukkiväli, mida läbib keskelt sügavusse suunduv tee. Keskplaanil mõlemal pool teed lehtpuud. Paremal pool teed, esiplaanil rukkikoorem, mille otsas kaabuga mees. Sellest kaugemal paremal kasvavast rukkist pooleldi kaetud põllul tee poole sammuva hobusega rukkikoorem; vasakul heinakuhi. Keset maali, lehtpuude vahelt paistavad sinetava metsaga kaetud mäed.
works.de: In the foreground a rye field, crossed in the middle by a road leading into the depth. In the middle ground, deciduous trees on both sides of the road. On the right side of the road, in the foreground, a load of rye with a man in a hat on top. Further away on the right, on a field half covered by growing rye, a load of rye with a horse walking toward the road; on the left a haystack. In the middle of the painting, mountains covered with bluish forest are visible between the deciduous trees.

works.d: Alasti profiilis vasakule noor naine tumedate lahtiste juustega lehtpuu varjus. Paremas käes granaatõun. Vasaku käega hoiab pea kohal oleva puu oksast kinni. Nägu naeratusega otsevaates.
works.de: A nude young woman in profile facing left, with dark loose hair, in the shade of a deciduous tree. A pomegranate in her right hand. With her left hand she holds on to a branch of the tree above her head. Her face, shown frontally, is smiling.

works.d: Lapse rinnaportree. Siledad, sirged, laubale langevad juuksed ja sinised silmad. Rõivaste osas jäetud valgeks, maalimata. Töö lõpetamata.
works.de: Bust portrait of a child. Smooth, straight hair falling onto the forehead, and blue eyes. The clothing left white, unpainted. The work unfinished.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi hoonestatud kallastega (Tartu motiiv). Keskel paremal sild. Tagaplaanil maju.
works.de: In the foreground a river with built-up banks (a Tartu motif). In the middle on the right a bridge. Houses in the background.

works.d: Ees keskel kirjutiivaline liblikas lilleõiel. Selle taga küljeli vajunud puudest üles kistud pinnase kamar juurtega. Taustaks tihe segametsa tüvestik.
works.de: In the centre foreground a butterfly with patterned wings on a flower. Behind it a clump of soil with roots pulled up from trees fallen sideways. Background a dense mixed-forest trunk stand.

works.dm: laius: 69.4 cm; kõrgus: 49.0 cm ( vasak külg 48.8)
works.d: Esiplaanil põld kolme rukkihakiga. Tagapool keskel kaks hoonet; paremal puud ja põõsad, vasakul mitmetüviline puu.
works.de: In the foreground, a field with three shocks of rye. Behind, in the middle, two buildings; on the right, trees and bushes, on the left a multi-trunked tree.

works.d: Poolabstraktne värvikas kompositsioon figuuridega. Ülalpool sinakasroheliste, kollaste geomeetriliste kujundite taustal lendlevad rahvariides figuurid, pead, pasun, lillekimp, sini-must-valge lipu motiive. Allosas paremal hulk pasunatorusid, vasakul juubeldav-tantsiv rahvamass.
works.de: A semi-abstract colourful composition with figures. Above, against a background of bluish-green, yellow geometric shapes, figures in folk costume floating, heads, a trumpet, a bouquet of flowers, motifs of the blue-black-white flag. Below on the right a number of trumpet horns, on the left a jubilant, dancing crowd.

works.d: Tihedasti üksteise kõrvale surutud inimestest figuraalne kompositsioon, mille peamine raskuspunkt jääb horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremale, sest peamine osa inimmassist on koondunud sinna. Inimeste näod kas ähmaselt antud või puuduvad üldse. Iseloomustuseks on antud kas erksas toonis või iseäralik riietusese (barett, džemper, kübar). Vasakul tumedasse riietatud, hallide pükstega mees, ajaleht käes. Foon vasakult valge lubjatud seina meenutav, paremalt tumehall. Valitsevad tuhmid, väljasuretatud toonid.
works.de: A figural composition of people pressed tightly against one another, whose main point of gravity falls slightly to the right of the horizontal centre line, since the main part of the mass of people is gathered there. The faces of the people are either given vaguely or are entirely absent. Characterisation is given either through bright tone or a peculiar item of clothing (beret, jumper, hat). On the left a man dressed in dark clothing, with grey trousers, a newspaper in hand. The background resembles a white limewashed wall on the left, dark grey on the right. Dull, faded tones predominate.

works.d: Sügavates sinistes toonides natüürmort: esiplaanil raamatud, tiigripilt, joonistused. Nende keskel tohutusuur lillekimp, millest eristuvad erksate laikudena valged ja punased õied.
works.de: A still life in deep blue tones: in the foreground books, a tiger picture, drawings. In their midst an enormous bouquet of flowers, from which white and red blossoms stand out as bright patches.

works.d: Talvemaastik sinakates toonides. Esiplaanil kaks valgesse riietatud lamavat inimest saksa sõduri kiivrites. Samas vasakul murdunud puutüvi, eemal tank.
works.de: Winter landscape in bluish tones. In the foreground two people dressed in white lying down in German soldier's helmets. Also on the left a broken tree trunk, in the distance a tank.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumel lamavad hukatud talupoegade kehad. Tagaplaanil neli seisvat sõjaväelast. Taevas tumesinine, lumi heledam.
works.de: In the foreground the bodies of executed peasants lying on the snow. In the background four standing soldiers. The sky dark blue, the snow lighter.

works.d: Järv. Paremal kallas (Sõsarsaare serv) lehestikuga ja haralise vana pajuga, mille üks haru ulatub horisontaalsuunas veepinna kohale. Vasakult paistab Kloostrisaar.
works.de: A lake. On the right, a shore (the edge of Sõsarsaar) with foliage and a branching old willow, one branch of which extends horizontally above the water surface. Kloostrisaar can be seen on the left.

works.d: Sinisilmse tütarlapse pea en face karmiinpunases pluusis erepunaste nööpidega.
works.de: Head of a blue-eyed girl en face in a carmine-red blouse with bright red buttons.

works.d: Esiplaanil käärdus paremalt vasakule sügavusse suunduv jõgi, kallastel vees peegelduvaid lehtpuid ja põõsaid, tagaplaanil künklik maastik puudesaludega.
works.de: In the foreground a river winding from right to left into the depth, on its banks deciduous trees and bushes reflected in the water, in the background a hilly landscape with groves.

works.d: Keskealise daami portree, kolmveerandfiguur, peaaegu en face, keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Taustaks kirju vaip.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged lady, three-quarter figure, almost en face, body slightly turned to the left. Background a patterned carpet.

works.d: Ees keskel vasakul varemete ees tänaval kaks inimfiguuri. Taustaks majad Kinga tänava nurgalt.
works.de: In front in the middle-left, in front of ruins on the street, two human figures. Background houses from the corner of Kinga Street.
