works.de: A scene in light tones of a row of children holding hands. The middle child stands with one foot on one side and the other foot on the other side of a small stream. In the foreground and on the left margin a grey surface with dots and dashes, in the background a strip of forest and sky.

works.d: Abstraktne hallides toonides kompositsioon, mida ilmestavad tumerohelised värvilaigud. Üle terve pildi pinna väiksemaid punaseid, rohelisi ja siniseid laike ning korrapärases paigutuses valged mummud.
works.de: An abstract composition in grey tones, enlivened by dark green patches of colour. Smaller red, green and blue patches are scattered over the entire surface of the picture, along with white dots arranged in a regular pattern.

works.d: Esiplaanil soisel maastikul tihedat võsa, mille üle näha soojärvi tiheda metsa taustal. Vasakul liivaseljandikul põgenev hunt, metsas puude vahel kolm jahimeest.
works.de: In the foreground, on a marshy landscape, dense scrub, above which a marsh lake can be seen against the background of a dense forest. On the left, on a sandy ridge, a fleeing wolf, in the forest among the trees three huntsmen.

works.d: Udune mägimaastik üksiku valgel hobusel ratsaniku ja tema kohal kõrguva tumeda kaljuga. Maastikus vasakul kõrgemaid ja paremal kaljunukil kiduramaid kuusepuusid.
works.de: A hazy mountain landscape with a lone rider on a white horse, and above him a dark cliff rising up. In the landscape on the left taller spruce trees and on the right, on a rocky outcrop, sparser spruce trees.

works.d: Pruunikates-rohekates toonides stseen lapsi süles hoidvate naiste ja kaluriga paadis. Esiplaanil kaks naist, kellest üks hoiab suuremat last ja teine imetab väiksemat last. Tagaplaanil paadi otsas köit hoidev kalur, taustaks tume lainetav meri.
works.de: A scene in brownish-greenish tones showing women holding children in their laps and a fisherman in a boat. In the foreground two women, one of whom holds a larger child while the other is nursing a smaller child. In the background a fisherman at the end of the boat holding a rope, with a dark, wavy sea as backdrop.

works.d: Tugevasti abstraheeritud prillidega mehe portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Mehel suus pastapliiatsiga joonistatud sigar, seljas V-kaelusega pluus, taust helehall.
works.de: Strongly abstracted portrait of a man with glasses, in a quarter-turn to the left. The man has a cigar drawn with a ballpoint pen in his mouth, wearing a V-neck blouse, background light grey.

works.d: Maaliliselt teostatud hallipäise mehe portree veerandpöördes paremale. Mehe näos lõpuni maalimata silmad ja suu, nina esiletükkiv. Kujutataval seljas helehall riideese, taust tumeroheline.
works.de: A pictorially executed portrait of a grey-haired man in a three-quarter turn to the right. In the man's face the eyes and mouth are left unfinished, the nose prominent. The subject wears a light grey garment, the background dark green.

works.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, mille vasakust äärest kulgevad must-valged triipud, neile lisanduvad keskosas eri variatsioonides hallid toonid ning paremalt lõpeb musta ja tumehalliga.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped barcode, with black-and-white stripes running from its left edge, joined in the middle section by grey tones in various variations, and ending on the right with black and dark grey.

works.dm: kõrgus: 11.0 cm; sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, mille vasakul musta ja eri tooni lillaga antud triipudesse lisanduvad valged, lõppedes mustvalgena.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code band, on the left of which the stripes given in black and various shades of purple are joined by white ones, ending in black and white.

works.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat mille must-valgele osale lisanduvad keskosas eri toonides kollased ja oranžid triibud. Paremal lõpeb must-valgena.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code strip, to whose black-and-white section yellow and orange stripes of various shades are added in the middle section. Ends in black-and-white on the right.

works.dm: kõrgus: 11.0 cm; sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, millel vasakul valge ja eri tooni sinisega antud triipudesse lisanduvad keskosas mustad, muutudes ositi mustvalgeks ning keskel ja paremal taas musta- ja punasetriibuliseks.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code strip, on which on the left white and blue of various tones stripes are joined in the middle section by black ones, partly turning black-and-white, and in the centre and on the right becoming black-and-red striped again.

works.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, millel must-valged triibud vaheldumas mustale pinnale maalitud eri variatsioonides antud roheliste triipudega.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code band, with black-and-white stripes alternating on a black surface painted with green stripes given in various variations.

works.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, mille vasakul musta ja eri tooni punasega antud triipudesse lisanduvad valged, muutudes keskosas mustvalgeks ning paremal taas musta- ja punasetriibuliseks.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped barcode, in which on the left, black and various shades of red stripes are joined by white ones, turning into black-and-white in the middle section, and again into black-and-red striped on the right.

works.dm: kõrgus: 11.0 cm; sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm
works.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, millel vasakul musta ja tumepruuniga antud triipudesse lisanduvad valged. Keskel ja paremal musta ja valge vahel eri toonides pruunid triibud. Paremal lõpeb värvipind musta- ja pruunitriibulisena.
works.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code strip, on which, on the left, white stripes are added to the black and dark brown stripes given. In the middle and on the right, between black and white, brown stripes of various tones. On the right the coloured surface ends in black and brown stripes.

works.d: Maalilise üldistusega edasi antud maastikuvaade järve ja künklike maastikuvormidega. Esiplaanil järv, mille kaldaäärsel kaks punast maja. Taamal tumedad künklikud maastikuvormid ja heledad majad.
works.de: A landscape view rendered with painterly generalization, with a lake and hilly landforms. In the foreground a lake, on whose shore stand two red houses. Further back, dark hilly landforms and light-coloured houses.

works.d: Vaade neljast hoonest koosnevale talukompleksile. Vasakul ja paremal pool talukompleksi kasvavad männid. Talu poole kõnnivad kaks naist, mõlemal peas valge rätik, seljas must pluus ja  punane seelik. Taustal hele taevas ja metsaviirust koosnev horisont.
works.de: A view of a farm complex consisting of four buildings. Pine trees grow on the left and right of the farm complex. Two women are walking toward the farm, both with white kerchiefs on their heads, wearing black blouses and red skirts. In the background a light sky and a horizon made up of a strip of forest.

works.d: Istuva naise portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel tukk ja õlgadeni pruunid juuksed, huuled punased. Seljas tumesinine kostüüm, kaelas roheline sall ja sõrmes rohelise vääriskiviga sõrmus. Vasakus pildiservas peegel, mis peegeldab naise  juukseid ja diivani äärele toetuvat kätt.
works.de: Portrait of a seated woman, three-quarter turned to the left. The woman has a fringe and shoulder-length brown hair, red lips. She wears a dark blue costume, a green scarf around her neck and a ring with a green gemstone on her finger. On the left edge of the picture a mirror, reflecting the woman's hair and the hand resting on the edge of the sofa.

works.d: Roosal foonil eri mõõdus ja toonides dekoratiivsed fallosed.
works.de: Decorative phalluses of various sizes and tones on a pink background.

works.d: Punakaspruunil foonil sinise kontuuriga markeeritud kolm figuuri (kaks poolprofiilis ja pead teineteise vastas asetsevat meesfiguuri, nende kõrval paremal keskel selili lamav sinisega maalitud naisfiguur). Taustal siin-seal lehestikku imiteeriv eri toonides dekoratiivne pind.
works.de: Against a reddish-brown background, three figures marked with a blue outline (two male figures in half-profile with their heads facing each other, and beside them on the right in the middle, a reclining female figure painted in blue, lying on her back). In the background, here and there, a decorative surface in various tones imitating foliage.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kahe naisterahva rindportree veerandpöördes vasakule.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, bust portrait of two women in a quarter-turn to the left.

works.d: Oranžil taustal keskel sinised siksakis kulgevad abstraktsed kujundid.
works.de: On an orange background, in the middle, blue abstract shapes running in a zigzag.

works.d: Pruunil, oranžikal ja sinakas-rohelisel taustal antud teravatipulised ekspressiivsed abstraktsed kujundid.
works.de: Against a brown, orange, and bluish-green background, sharp-pointed expressive abstract forms are depicted.

works.dm: kõrgus: 200.0 cm; laius: 110.0 cm; kõrgus: 170.0 cm; laius: 142.0 cm
works.d: Kahest osast koosnev, must-valgetes toonides antud, pead käte vahele toetuva vana naise portree. Pildipinnal valgeid abstraktseid, teineteist läbistavaid jooni.
works.de: A two-part portrait, given in black-and-white tones, of an old woman resting her head between her hands. On the picture surface white abstract lines intersecting one another.

works.d: Noore mehe portree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas triibuline hommikumantel ja suure kaelusega särk. Taust akvarellitud pruunikaks.
works.de: Portrait of a young man in a slight turn to the right. Wearing a striped dressing gown and a shirt with a large collar. Background watercoloured brownish.

works.d: Noore mehe ekspressiivne portree otsevaates. Nägu maalitud lillades, sinistes ja roosades toonides, seljas punane särk ja pruun üleriie. Taust jaotatud horisontaalselt kollaseks ja siniseks pinnaks.
works.de: Expressive portrait of a young man in frontal view. The face painted in purple, blue and pink tones, wearing a red shirt and a brown overcoat. The background divided horizontally into a yellow and a blue field.

works.d: Heledapäise naise portree veerandpöördes paremale. Naisel tuka ja õlgadeni ulatuvate lokkis juustega soeng, seljas valge äärisega sinine pluus. Taust erkroheline.
works.de: Portrait of a fair-haired woman in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman has a hairstyle with a fringe and curly hair reaching to the shoulders, wearing a blue blouse with white trim. Background bright green.

works.d: Heledapäise naise portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel tuka ja õlgadeni ulatuvate lokkis juustega soeng, seljas valge pluus ja helekollane jakk. Taust tumesinine.
works.de: Portrait of a fair-haired woman in a quarter turn to the left. The woman has a hairstyle with a fringe and curly hair reaching to the shoulders, wearing a white blouse and a light yellow jacket. Dark blue background.

works.d: Istuva väikese tüdruku portree otsevaates. Tüdrukul seljas valge kleit ja sinine vest, käed süles.
works.de: Frontal portrait of a seated little girl. The girl is wearing a white dress and a blue vest, hands in her lap.

works.d: Suvine mereäärne maastik, mille keskmes tühi trepiga ukseraam. Taamal mahajäetud arhitektuurseid objekte, taustal sinine taevas.
works.de: Summer seaside landscape, in the centre of which an empty door frame with steps. In the distance abandoned architectural objects, blue sky in the background.

works.d: Rohekates toonides, tinglikult antud maastikuvaade. Keskel kulgevat koske palistavad puud ja põõsad.
works.de: A landscape view rendered in greenish tones, conventionally depicted. In the centre a waterfall bordered by trees and bushes.

works.d: Maalipind jaotunud kolmeks vertikaalseks osaks. Keskmisest tumedast pinnast paremal heleda, pilvise taeva taustal fotorealistlikult antud maastikuvaade kaljul asuva majakaga. Vasakul merevaade.
works.de: The painted surface is divided into three vertical parts. To the right of the dark middle surface, against a light, cloudy sky, a photorealistically rendered landscape view with a lighthouse on a cliff. On the left a sea view.

works.d: Hallikassinises vaasis suur bukett erivärvilisi lilli. Vaasist vasakule lauale asetatud üksik suure kollase õiega taim.
works.de: In a greyish-blue vase, a large bouquet of multicoloured flowers. To the left of the vase, on the table, a single plant with a large yellow flower.

works.d: Punakates ja rohekates toonides ekspressiivne kompositsioon voolavate värvijugadega. Vasakul tahapoole nõjatuv inimfiguur, paremal abstraktsest värvipinnast esile tulev inimnägu.
works.de: An expressive composition in reddish and greenish tones with flowing streams of colour. On the left a human figure leaning backward, on the right a human face emerging from an abstract field of colour.

works.d: Tumedates rohekates ja punakates toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes heledatest värviniredest moodustuvad kaks figuuri. Taevast markeeriv osa tumeroheline, maad markeeriv osa tumepunane, all vasakus nurgas linnupesa kolme munaga.
works.de: A semi-abstract composition in dark greenish and reddish tones, in the center of which two figures are formed from light streaks of color. The part marking the sky is dark green, the part marking the earth is dark red, in the lower left corner a bird's nest with three eggs.

works.d: Punakates, rohekates ja roosades toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes ettepoole kallutatud inimfiguure meenutavad värvipinnad. Taevast markeeriv osa punakates-roosakates ning maad markeeriv osa sinakates-rohekates toonides, maalilaad kohati pastoosne, kohati laseeriv.
works.de: A semi-abstract composition in reddish, greenish and pink tones, at the centre of which are colour surfaces reminiscent of human figures leaning forward. The part marking the sky is in reddish-pinkish tones and the part marking the earth in bluish-greenish tones, the painting technique is at times pastose, at times glazed.

works.d: Türkiissinistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon pastelsete lillade ja kollaste pindadega. Teose keskel ümaramad, servades kandilisemad vormid.
works.de: An abstract composition in turquoise-blue tones with pastel purple and yellow surfaces. In the centre of the work rounder forms, more angular at the edges.

works.d: Teose keskmes beežis, pruunis ning türkiissinises koloriidis abstraktne ebasümmeetriline ruudustik, mida ümbritseb servadest beež pind. Kompositsioonist joonistuvad tinglikult välja inimfiguuri rindportree piirjooned.
Maal jaotatud erinevas laadis antud pildipindadeks, vasakul keskel ja all ääres hüperrealistlikud motiivid.  Paremal kollane ristkülik, mis jätkub teose külgedel. Keskel eskiislikud ruumilahendused.
works.de: The painting divided into picture surfaces rendered in different styles, hyperrealistic motifs at the center left and along the bottom edge. On the right a yellow rectangle, which continues on the sides of the work. In the center, sketch-like spatial solutions.

works.d: Turussteeni kujutav, visandlikult antud figuraalkompositsioon. Vasakul rohekate lillelettide kohal ümarad varjud, esiplaanil vasakul maas lillevaasides lilled, keskel ja paremal mitmeid figuurigruppe.
works.de: A sketchily rendered figural composition depicting a market square. On the left, round shadows above greenish flower stalls, in the foreground on the left flowers in vases on the ground, in the middle and on the right several groups of figures.

works.d: Roosades ja sinistes toonides antud stseen laadaplatsil erinevate tegevustega hõivatud figuuridest. Esiplaanil paremal laps koeraga, taga vasakul napis riietuses meeste- ja naisterahvas. Taamal paistavad fragmendid hoonetest.
works.de: A scene given in pink and blue tones at a fairground with figures engaged in various activities. In the foreground on the right a child with a dog, behind on the left scantily dressed men and women. In the distance fragments of buildings are visible.

works.d: Pruunikasrohelisel taustal tumesinises ülikonnas meesterahva rindportree poolpöördes paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in a dark blue suit against a brownish-green background, in half-turn to the right.

works.d: Maal on jaotatud erinevas laadis pildipindadeks, domineerib kastanpruun värvipind. Ülemises vasakus ja paremas nurgas hall ja valge pind, paremal mõned kuuseladvad. Keskmist osa läbib valge-pruuni-valge trikoloor koos abstraktsete mustade ja pruunide elementidega ning miniatuurse figuuriga valgel pinnal.
works.de: The painting is divided into picture surfaces of different character, dominated by a chestnut-brown colour field. In the upper left and right corners a grey and white surface, on the right a few spruce tops. The middle section is crossed by a white-brown-white tricolour with abstract black and brown elements and a miniature figure on a white surface.

works.d: Keskel veekogu kaldal viilkatusega maja, millele mööda teed lähenemas figuur. Taamal künkal paistmas kaks hoonet, paremal kuusepuu. Käsitlusviis ekspressiivne.
works.de: In the middle, by the shore of a body of water, a house with a gable roof, approached along a road by a figure. In the distance on a hillock two buildings can be seen, on the right a spruce tree. Expressive manner of treatment.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon heledate pastelsete kollaste ja roheliste pindadega.
works.de: Abstract composition with light pastel yellow and green planes.

works.d: Kompositsiooni all keskel suur kauss ja lusikas. Paremal istub valge figuur ja vasakul seisab sinine. Kausi kohal mustade ja lillade pindadega vorm.
works.de: At the bottom centre of the composition a large bowl and a spoon. On the right a white figure sits and on the left a blue one stands. Above the bowl a form with black and purple surfaces.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon punaste, siniste, mustade ja valgete pindadega.
works.de: Abstract composition with red, blue, black and white surfaces.

works.d: Tumedal taustal mehe rindportree, silmavaatega vasakule, üks käsi rinnale tõstetud.
works.de: Chest portrait of a man on a dark background, gaze to the left, one hand raised to the chest.

works.d: Helesinisel foonil, heledas riietuses tumeda peaga naisterahva rindportree.
works.de: On a light blue background, bust portrait of a woman with a dark head, in light clothing.

works.d: Tumedas koloriidis, visandlikku ja fotorealistlikku maalilaadi sünteesivad värvipinnad, milledel aimatavad erinevas perspektiivis kujutatud ruumivaated. Vasakul nurgas paistmas puude ladvad.
works.de: In a dark colour scheme, colour surfaces synthesising a sketch-like and photorealistic painting style, on which spatial views depicted in different perspectives can be discerned. In the left corner the tops of trees are visible.

works.d: Tumedal foonil kiilaneva mehe rindportree. Pilk suunatud alla, käsi toetamas lõuga.
works.de: Chest portrait of a balding man on a dark background. Gaze directed downward, hand supporting the chin.

works.dm: laius: 87.0 cm; kõrgus: 97.5 cm (Mõõdud raamita. Raamiga mõõdud: 104x95 cm)
works.d: Istuva heledas kleidis naise poolfiguurportree pöördega vasakule. Naisel heledad juuksed, tukaga soeng, käes pikad kindad. Käsitluslaad üldistav, tumedate kontuuridega, taust rohekas.
works.de: Half-figure portrait of a seated woman in a light-coloured dress, turned to the left. The woman has light hair, a hairstyle with a fringe, and holds long gloves in her hand. Treatment style generalising, with dark contours, background greenish.

works.dm: laius: 82.5 cm; kõrgus: 155.0 cm (Mõõdud raamita. Raamiga mõõdud 162 x 89,5 cm.)
works.d: Rohekates toonides geometriseeritud abstraktsioon. Kompositsioon jaotatud vertikaalseteks värvipindadeks, teostatud osaliselt pahtelmaali tehnikas.
works.de: A geometricized abstraction in greenish tones. The composition is divided into vertical colour planes, partly executed in the impasto technique.

works.d: Poolringi kujuline pannookavand mütoloogilise stseeniga. Maastikus kolm alasti inimfiguuri: kaks kaks lamavat või nõjatuvat naist vasakul ja istuv lüüraga mees paremal. Taustal veekogu, puud ja roosakas taevas.
works.de: Semicircular sketch for a panel with a mythological scene. In the landscape three nude human figures: two reclining or leaning women on the left and a seated man with a lyre on the right. In the background a body of water, trees and a pinkish sky.

works.d: Visandlik rindportree paremale vaatavast noormehest halli pintsaku ning punase särgiga.
works.de: Sketchy bust portrait of a young man looking to the right, wearing a grey jacket and a red shirt.

works.d: Vasakus ülemises ääres maja fragment rohelise akna ja katusega, paremal tähniline hallikas pind, maali alumist osa katab paks tumeroheline värvikiht.
works.de: In the upper left edge a fragment of a house with a green window and roof, on the right a mottled greyish surface, the lower part of the painting is covered by a thick dark green layer of paint.

works.d: Reljeefne kompositsioon seitsmest naisest koos sirpide, reha ja heinahangiga. Taustal sinine taevas ja samblikku meenutav maastik.
works.de: Relief composition of seven women with sickles, a rake and a hay fork. In the background a blue sky and a landscape resembling lichen.

works.d: Täisportree istuvast noorest naisest rahvariietes.
works.de: Full portrait of a seated young woman in folk costume.

works.d: Otsevaates rindportree noorest naisest heleda lühikese soenguga. Figuuril seljas valge kampsun, taust koosneb tumedatest pindadest.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a young woman with light-coloured short hairstyle. The figure wears a white jumper, the background consists of dark planes.

works.d: Otsevaates rindportree noorest naisest pruunide silmade ja õlgadeni juustega. Taust on beež.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a young woman with brown eyes and hair reaching to the shoulders. The background is beige.

works.d: Visandlik otsevaates rindportree noorest naisest. Tausta parem pind koosneb vahelduvatest sinistest ja mustadest joontest.
works.de: Sketchy frontal bust portrait of a young woman. The right surface of the background consists of alternating blue and black lines.

works.d: Kahest maalist, kahest külgpannoost ning päikesest koosnev installatsioon. Kaido Ole "Kenotaafi" maalil on kujutatud murukatte ja paksu mullakihi all lamavat meest külgvaates. Maali peale on asetatud Andres Toltsi teos "Maamõõtjad" (M 7579) ning omakorda selle kohal on päike. Kahelt poolt ümbritsevad kompositsiooni külgpannood, vasakpoolsel kujutatud "A" täht, parempoolsel "T".
works.de: An installation consisting of two paintings, two side panels and a sun. Kaido Ole's painting "Kenotaaf" depicts a man lying in profile under a grass cover and a thick layer of soil. Placed on top of the painting is Andres Tolts's work "Maamõõtjad" (M 7579), and above that in turn is the sun. The composition is flanked on both sides by side panels, the left one depicting the letter "A", the right one "T".

works.d: Pruunides toonides naise portree pearätikuga. Pilk suunatud alla, alumises servas paistab figuuri parem käsi.
works.de: A portrait in brown tones of a woman with a headscarf. Gaze directed downward, the figure's right hand visible at the lower edge.

works.d: Teose keskel paikneb kaks pikkade pintslitõmmetega kujutatud abstraktset figuuri, mis sulanduvad kokku kollase-sinise-lilla triibulisse tausta.
works.de: In the centre of the work are two abstract figures depicted with long brushstrokes, merging into a yellow-blue-purple striped background.

works.d: Portree vasakul pool on kujutatud otse vaates hallipäist vanemat meest ning paremal profiilvaates blondi naist punase huulepulgaga.
works.de: On the left of the portrait an older grey-haired man is depicted in a frontal view, and on the right a blonde woman with red lipstick is depicted in profile.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.0 cm; sügavus: 15.0 cm; laius: 96.0 cm
works.d: Pikemal küljel seisev ruumiline valge kuusnurkne objekt, mille sees on erineval tasandil kuus väiksemat kuusnurka.
works.de: A three-dimensional white hexagonal object standing on its longer side, inside which are six smaller hexagons at different levels.

works.t: Punakas-violeti essents, segatuna magentaga. Hommikune sära
works.d: Üle terve maalipinna (välja arvatud servad) kulgeb ruudustik domineerivalt lillades toonides, siin-seal leidub ka kolleseid, rohelisi ja siniseid aktsente.
works.de: Across the entire painted surface (except the edges) runs a grid predominantly in purple tones, here and there also yellow, green and blue accents.

works.d: Rindportree veerandpöördes paremale naisest, kes kannab sini-valge triibulist särki ja valget baretti. Taust tuhm roosa.
works.de: Bust portrait in a quarter-turn to the right of a woman wearing a blue-and-white striped shirt and a white beret. Dull pink background.

works.d: Rindportree heledapäisest mehest veerandpöördes vasakule. Mees kannab kandilisi musta raamiga prille. Taust sinakates-hallides toonides.
works.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired man turned a quarter to the left. The man wears square black-framed glasses. Background in bluish-grey tones.

works.d: Rindportree mehest veerandpöördes paremale vaates. Mehel on blondid juuksed, musta raamiga prillid, seljas sinine pullover. Taust kollane.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a man in a quarter-turn view to the right. The man has blond hair, black-framed glasses, and is wearing a blue pullover. Background yellow.

works.d: Noore naise pea otsevaates. Maali näo piirkond on välja joonistatud ja viimistletud, see-eest õlgu ja pead kattev rätt on visandlikus laadis.
works.de: Head of a young woman, en face. The facial area of the painting is delineated and finished, whereas the shawl covering the shoulders and head is done in a sketchy manner.

works.d: Heledapäise poisi en face poolfiguur. Seljas linased valged rõivad; sinakas taust.
works.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired boy en face. Wearing white linen clothes; bluish background.

works.t: Kostüümikavand näidendile "Enne kukke ja koitu" (Karl Fabian - Paul Pinna)
works.dm: lehe laius: 25.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.4 cm
works.d: Mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale jalutamispoosis. Paremas käes jalutuskepp, vasem puusal. Seljas frakk valge šabooga, jalas mahapööratud säärtega lakksaapad. Paremal varjukujutis.
works.de: Full figure of a man in profile facing left, in a walking pose. In his right hand a walking stick, left hand on hip. Wearing a tailcoat with a white jabot, on his feet patent leather boots with turned-down tops. On the right a silhouette.

works.t: Kostüümikavand näidendile "Enne kukke ja koitu" (Hofmeister - Olev Eskola)
works.d: Mehefiguur kerge pöördega vasemale. Seljas roheline frakk valge šabooga, peas kõrge kaabu. Käed piitsaga vaheliti rinnal. Nõjatub vasemale jalale, parem pisut kõverdatult ees. Paremal varjukutis.
works.de: Male figure with a slight turn to the left. Wearing a green tailcoat with a white jabot, on his head a tall top hat. Hands crossed on the chest holding a whip. Leaning on the left leg, the right slightly bent in front. On the right a shadow silhouette.

works.t: Kostüümikavand näidendile "Enne kukke ja koitu" (Made - Mari Möldre)
works.dm: lehe laius: 25.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.4 cm
works.d: Noorema naise figuur kerge pöördega vasemale. Pea õlgade vahel, käed hoiavad ees õlgadel asetsevat pikka salli. Taga varjukujutis.
works.de: The figure of a younger woman with a slight turn to the left. Head between the shoulders, hands holding a long shawl lying across the shoulders in front. A silhouette behind.

works.t: Kostüümikavand näidendile "Enne kukke ja koitu" (Maugu - Elts Kausi)
works.dm: lehe laius: 25.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.4 cm
works.d: Vana, küürus naise figuur profiilis vasemale. Seljas pikk rüü; õlgadel, kätelt alla rippuv punakas toonis rätt. Paremas käes kepp, vasak ees kobavas asendis. Taga tume varjukujutis.
works.de: Figure of an old, stooped woman in profile facing left. Wearing a long robe; on her shoulders a reddish-toned shawl hanging down from her arms. In her right hand a stick, left hand extended in a groping gesture. Behind her a dark silhouette.

works.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
works.d: Naisfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale tantsimas. Riietatud avarasse seelikusse, pihik kitsas. Parem käsi asetatud ümber pea, vasem kõrval, õla kõrgusel, leht käes. Jalgade kõrgusel maastiku piirjooni, paremal lillekorv.
works.de: A female figure dancing in half-profile to the left. Dressed in a wide skirt, tight bodice. Right hand placed around the head, left hand at the side, at shoulder height, holding a leaf. At the level of the legs the outlines of a landscape, on the right a flower basket.

works.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
works.d: Baleriinifiguur hüppe-poosis, pea pööratud vasemale. Kerges, õhulises kostüümis, tumedail juustel pärg. Parem jalg sirutatult vasemal, käed ristasendis rinnal.

works.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
works.d: Mehe tantsiv figuur poolprofiilis vasemale, hüpp-poosis - vasem jalg sirutatult ees, parem taga. Käed laiades varrukates, vasem puusas.

works.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
works.d: Naise tantsiv figuur, pea profiilis paremal. Pikad patsid kõrval lehvimas, parem käsi lehega ülal, vasem üle rinna parema käe kõrval. Seljas lai seelik, kitsas pihik ja puhvitud varrukatega pluus. All maastiku piirjooned.
works.de: Dancing figure of a woman, head in profile on the right. Long braids fluttering to the side, right hand raised with a leaf, left hand across the chest next to the right hand. Wearing a wide skirt, a narrow bodice and a blouse with puffed sleeves. Below, the outlines of a landscape.

works.d: Pikas punasega äärestatud sinakashalli tooniga vammuses hallijuukselise vanamehe täisfiguur otsevaates, pea pöördega vasakule. Kuuehõlm rinnale kinnitatud suure hoburaudsõlega, keskelt nahkrihmaga, mille küljes suur puss nahktupes. Varustuse juurde kuuluvad veel: krõllidega kee, käevõru ja karusnahast püstkõrvadega müts.
works.de: A full-length frontal figure of a grey-haired old man in a long bluish-grey waistcoat trimmed with red, his head turned to the left. The coat's front is fastened at the chest with a large horseshoe-shaped brooch, and at the waist with a leather belt, from which hangs a large knife in a leather sheath. His attire also includes: a necklace with curls, a bracelet and a fur cap with upright ears.

works.d: Laiaäärelist kübarat kandva kongusninalise mustaverd mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Riietuseks erinevate rinnapooltega, sakilise alläärega kuub, erinevat värvust säärtega püksid, teravaninalised, kannustega varustatud, pööratud säärega säärikud ja lai "tooga" tüüpi mantel. Käed kinnastatud, parem toetub puusale, vasem peos oleva piitsaga pisut ette sirutatud.
works.de: Full figure of a dark-skinned man with an aquiline nose, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, in three-quarter profile facing right. His attire consists of a coat with differently shaped breast sides and a jagged lower hem, trousers with legs of different colours, sharp-toed spurred boots with turned-down tops, and a wide "toga"-type cloak. His hands are gloved, the right resting on his hip, the left slightly extended forward holding a whip.

works.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
works.d: Pruuni ääristusega halli tooni umbkuues ja sama värvust pükstes mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Kaelus kinnitatud vitssõlega, ümber keha metallnaastudega nahkvöö, mille küljes pussitupp. Peakattena murumüts, jalas pööratud säärtega säärikud.
works.de: Full figure of a man in profile to the right, wearing a gray overall with brown trim and trousers of the same color. The collar fastened with a twisted-wire clasp, around the body a leather belt with metal studs, from which hangs a knife sheath. Headgear a sedge cap, on his feet boots with turned-down tops.

works.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
works.d: Pruuni pronksnaastudega täiendatud ääristusega pihikut, hallpruuni tooni seelikut ja heledamat tooni pikavarrukalist särki kandva naistantsija kuju tantsupoosis, astuvana. Ülakeha kallutatud vasakule. Pihiku õlapaelad kinnitatud kolmekordset pronksist rinnakeed hoidvate rinnanõeltega; kaelusel suur hoburaudsõlg. Nahkvöö küljes rippumas tupes nuga ja nõelakoda.
works.de: The figure of a female dancer in a dance pose, striding, wearing a bodice trimmed with an edging adorned with brown bronze studs, a greyish-brown skirt and a lighter-toned long-sleeved shirt. The upper body is tilted to the left. The bodice's shoulder straps are fastened with breast pins holding a triple bronze necklace; on the collar a large horseshoe brooch. Hanging from the leather belt is a sheathed knife and a needle case.

works.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
works.d: Punaka ääristusega halli tooni umbkuube ja sama värvi pikki pükse kandva mehe täisfiguur profiilis, sammuvana paremalt vasakule. Umbkuub keskelt kinnitatud nahkvööga, kaeluse juurest suure vitssõelaga. Mehel ettesirutatud paremas käes laiateraline kirves.
works.de: Full figure, in profile, of a man wearing a grey overcoat with a reddish trim and trousers of the same colour, striding from right to left. The overcoat fastened in the middle with a leather belt, at the collar with a large wattle brooch. In the man's outstretched right hand a broad-bladed axe.

works.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
works.d: Pikas pruuni tooni vammuses, millele on tõmmatud rõngassärk harkisjalu seisva mehe täisfiguur eestvaates, pea pööratud parema õla suunas. Mehel paremas käes paljastatud kaheteraline mõõk, kuna rohekat tooni laia sõbataolise mantli varju jääv  vasak käsi hoiab sõõrjat puukilpi, metallist pideme ja sõrmekaitsega tsentrumis.
works.de: The full figure, in frontal view, of a man in a long brown-toned tunic, standing with legs apart, over which is drawn a ring-mail shirt, his head turned toward his right shoulder. In his right hand the man holds a bared double-edged sword, while his left hand, falling into the shadow of a wide, wolf-like cloak of a greenish tone, holds a round wooden shield with a metal handle and finger-guard at the centre.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel puude varjus kuus inimfiguuri. Nendest vasemal lamav naisfiguur. Tema taga vasakul lahtine päikesevari. Taamal asuva veekogu kaldal üksikud puud.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle, six human figures in the shade of trees. Of these, a reclining female figure on the left. Behind her on the left, an open parasol. Solitary trees on the shore of a body of water in the background.

works.d: Kollakaspruunides toonides mäkke tõusva linna vaade: esiplaanil jõe vesi, keskplaanis vasakul kahe suure kaarega sild, mille kohal tihedalt fassaadi katvate akendega majad. Ülal kollakas taevas. Kohati, eriti taeva piirkonnas värvikiht õhuke, lõuendi kudet alt paista.
works.de: View of a city rising up a hill in yellowish-brown tones: in the foreground river water, in the middle ground on the left a bridge with two large arches, above which houses with facades densely covered with windows. Above, a yellowish sky. In places, especially in the sky area, the paint layer is thin, the canvas weave visible beneath.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise naise rinnapilt en face, mustas valge pitskraega kleidis. Kujutatud ovaalis.
works.de: Chest portrait of a dark-haired woman en face, in a black dress with a white lace collar. Depicted in an oval.

works.d: Suurte rohekate kivirühmadega kaldalõik. Tagapool türkiisjas, rohekas meri, taevas suured pilved, millede vahelt tungivad läbi päikesekiired. Maali üldtonaalsus on rohekas-hallikas.
works.de: A stretch of shore with large greenish groups of rocks. Beyond, a turquoise, greenish sea, the sky with large clouds through which sunbeams break through. The overall tonality of the painting is greenish-grey.

works.d: Kikkhabemega istuva mehe kolmveerand figuur. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Parem käsi tooli külgleenil, vasak süles.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man with a goatee. Head slightly turned to the right. Right hand on the armrest of the chair, left in his lap.

works.d: Vana naise põlvpilt otsevaates. Naisel suurrätt õlgadel, käed ristamisi asetatult toetumas kepile.
works.de: Frontal knee-length portrait of an old woman. The woman has a large shawl on her shoulders, hands crossed and resting on a cane.

works.d: Viljapõllul esiplaanil kaks rõuku. Keskplaani keskel kolm taluhoonet, mille ees kolm rõuku. Paremal punase katusega taluhoone. Taga uduvinesse uppuvad kaugused.
works.de: In the foreground of a grain field, two haystacks. In the middle ground, in the centre, three farm buildings, in front of which three haystacks. On the right a farmhouse with a red roof. Behind, distances sinking into haze.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage väli teerajaga, keskel metsatukk, tagaplaanil meri.
works.de: An open field with a path in the foreground, a clump of forest in the middle, sea in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm suurt kivi, keskel põld rukkihakkidega ja taga kaks taluhoonet ja puid.
works.de: In the foreground three large stones, in the middle a field with sheaves of rye, and behind two farm buildings and trees.

works.d: Pildipinna ulatuses puuderühm, millede taga sinab veekogu. Kauguses paistab maapinda ja metsa; silmapiir kõrge.
works.de: A group of trees spanning the picture surface, behind which a body of water shows blue. In the distance ground and forest are visible; high horizon.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 37.2 cm; kujutise laius: 28.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 34.3 cm; lehe laius: 31.3 cm
works.d: Tumedal foonil klaasist vaas kahe punase roosiga.
works.de: A glass vase with two red roses against a dark background.

works.d: Keskel rohelistes toonides kaks ovaalideks stiliseeritud teineteist embavat inimfiguuri, kehaliikmed üksteisesse sulavad. Foon roheline, figuuride ümber kollakalt helendav.
works.de: In the centre, in green tones, two human figures stylised into ovals embracing each other, their limbs merging into one another. Background green, glowing yellowish around the figures.

works.d: Allservas kolmnurksete ogadega kaetud rull, millest (nagu kangas kangarullilt) keerdub spiraalselt üles tee-kujund. Hoogsalt keerduva spiraali lõpetab kolme tolmukaga õiekrooni meenutav kujund. Maalitud sügavates pruunides toonides, siin-seal heledamaid toone läbi kumada lastes.
works.de: At the lower edge a roller covered with triangular spikes, from which (like fabric from a loom's roller) a road-shaped form spirals upward. The vigorously coiling spiral ends in a form resembling a flower crown with three stamens. Painted in deep brown tones, allowing lighter tones to shine through here and there.

works.d: Hõõguval punasel taustal keskel palvetav, põlvili laskunud figuur. Käed näo ette tõstetud, küünarnukid põlvede kohal koos. Figuur tumedates rohelistes toonides. Fooni servades markeeritakse mõne tumeda joonega interjööri.
works.de: On a glowing red background, in the centre, a praying figure kneeling down. Hands raised before the face, elbows together above the knees. Figure in dark green tones. At the edges of the background, an interior is indicated with a few dark lines.

works.d: Keskel hallides ja pruunides toonides pöörist meenutav kujund, milles on vaevu aimata kaht teineteisesse sulanud figuuri. Foon pruun.
works.de: In the centre, in grey and brown tones, a whirl-like form in which two figures merged into one another can barely be discerned. Brown background.

works.d: Keskel kaks tugevasti stiliseeritud teineteist embavat inimfiguuri tantsiskleval sammul astumas. Kummagi figuuri pead meenutavas kehaosas üks silm, jalad ja käed vormitud, kaani meenutavad. Foon hoogsate pintslilöökidega maalitud, kollastes toonides. Figuurid tumepruunid.
works.de: In the middle, two strongly stylised human figures embracing each other, stepping in a dancing motion. In the body part resembling a head of each figure, one eye, the legs and arms formed resembling flippers. The background painted with vigorous brushstrokes, in yellow tones. The figures dark brown.

works.d: Keskel spiraalina ülespoole keerduv roosakais toonides suitsuvinet meenutav kujund. Hallist foonist kumab läbi roosa alusvärv.
works.de: In the middle a spiral shape twisting upwards, resembling smoke haze in pinkish tones. A pink base colour shines through the grey background.

works.d: Keskel ovaalideks stiliseeritud põlvitav inimfiguur. Vormitud käed lõpevad meandri-kujundiga. Vasakult figuurile langev valgus tekitab figuuri taga väikese ovaalse varju. Foon lillakashall, alt kumavad läbi roosad toonid.
works.de: In the centre a kneeling human figure stylised into ovals. The moulded hands end in a meander-shaped form. Light falling on the figure from the left creates a small oval shadow behind the figure. Background lilac-grey, pink tones shimmering through from below.

works.d: Keskel pruunides toonides kaks teineteist embavat stiliseeritud inimfiguuri. Kehavormid ovaalsed, üksteisesse sulavad. Foon hall, alt kumab läbi roosa toon.
works.de: In the centre, in brown tones, two stylised human figures embracing each other. Body forms oval, merging into one another. Background grey, a pink tone shining through from below.

works.d: Lühikeste hallide juustega vanema naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Naisel seljas punase-kollasekirju pluus või kleit, millel vabalt langev valge jakk, peas punase-rohelisekirju väike müts. Näoosa tihedalt ihutoonides läbi maalitud, jakk modelleeritud pikkade roheliste pintslilöökidega, foon antud rohelistes ja kollakates toonides lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of an older woman with short grey hair. The woman wears a red-and-yellow patterned blouse or dress, over which a loosely falling white jacket, and on her head a small red-and-green patterned cap. The facial area is densely painted through in skin tones, the jacket is modelled with long green brushstrokes, the background is rendered in green and yellowish tones with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Valged, roosad ja lillad, pikliku kellukese kujulistest õitest koosnevad õiekobarad mitmes rohelises toonis antud lopsaka roheluse foonil.
works.de: White, pink and purple clusters of flowers shaped like elongated bells, rendered in several shades of green against a background of lush greenery.

works.d: Kollakasrohelistes toonides suletud silmadega kahvatu tüdruku rinnaportree. Kogu figuur on otsekui tuulehoost haaratud, heledad juuksed lehvivad, ülestõstetud käsi on rinna kohal peopesaga vaataja poole pööratud.
works.de: Bust portrait of a pale girl with closed eyes, in yellowish-green tones. The whole figure appears as if seized by a gust of wind, the light hair fluttering, a raised hand above the chest turned palm towards the viewer.

works.d: Lühikeste tumedate juustega noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates: naisel seljas sinise kraega pluus ja punakaspruun jakk, pilk pisut vaatajast mööda ja alla suunatud, väike punane hästi vormitud suu. Foon rohekaskollastes ja ookritoonides.
works.de: A frontal chest portrait of a young woman with short dark hair: the woman wears a blouse with a blue collar and a reddish-brown jacket, her gaze directed slightly past the viewer and downward, a small, well-formed red mouth. The background is in greenish-yellow and ochre tones.

works.d: Vaikelu kahe lipu ja trofeega.  Objektid on valgustatud vasakult poolt ja heidavad seinale tugeva varju. Lauale on lisaks asetatud kaks palli, hüppenöör ja kirjad.
works.de: Still life with two flags and a trophy. The objects are lit from the left and cast a strong shadow on the wall. Two balls, a skipping rope and letters are also placed on the table.

works.d: Istuva hallipäise vanema daami kolmveerandfiguur poolpöörde vasakule, pilk vaatajal, käed süles. Naisel pidulik sallkraega tumesinine kleit seljas, pärlid kaelas. Taust figuuri ümber kollakas, kaugemalt kirsipunane. Rahutu ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a seated grey-haired elderly lady, turned half to the left, gaze on the viewer, hands in her lap. The woman wears a formal dark blue dress with a scarf collar, pearls around her neck. The background around the figure is yellowish, cherry-red further away. A restless, expressive painting style.

works.d: Kaks pikakaelalist suurte silmaaukudega õnnistuseks tõstetud kätega valget olendit teineteise taga. Figuuride kaarjaid jooni kordavad tausta dekoratiivsed abstraktsed kujundid. Hallikad, beežid toonid.
works.de: Two long-necked white beings with large eye sockets, hands raised in blessing, one behind the other. The curved lines of the figures are echoed by decorative abstract shapes in the background. Greyish, beige tones.

works.d: Tumedal lillakal taustal istuv stiliseeritud naisfiguur otsevaates. Paremale küünarvarrele toetuv ülakeha, vasak käsi üle teise. Pea viltukallutatud, kurblik pilk suunatud üles. Tumeda kontuurjoonega ümardatud pehmed vormid.
works.de: A stylised female figure seated against a dark purplish background, in frontal view. Upper body resting on the right forearm, left hand over the other. Head tilted to the side, sorrowful gaze directed upward. Soft rounded forms with a dark contour line.

works.d: Punase padjaga leentoolis istuv väike tüdruk otsevaates, vasak jalg istmiku all, pea viltu. Tüdrukul heledad pikad juuksed seotud sabasse, seljas helekollased põlvpüksid ja sviiter. Nõtke skitseeriv maalilaad.
works.de: A small girl sitting in an armchair with a red cushion, seen frontally, left leg tucked under her, head tilted. The girl has light-coloured long hair tied in a ponytail, wearing pale yellow knee-length trousers and a sweater. Supple, sketch-like painting style.

works.d: Roheluse taustal põlvitav stiliseeritud figuur roosas kleidis, neljal käelabal valged linnud, lind õlal ja veidi kallutatud peas. Vormid siugjad, ümardatud.
works.de: Against a green background a kneeling stylised figure in a pink dress, white birds on four hands, a bird on the shoulder and on the slightly tilted head. Forms sinuous, rounded.

works.d: Spiraalist moodustuvas keras poolduva raku motiiv, mis kujutab ka kaht embuses figuuri. Kujund ümbritsetud värviliste kaleidoskoobi killukestega.
works.de: The motif of a dividing cell forming a sphere of a spiral, which also depicts two figures in an embrace. The image is surrounded by coloured kaleidoscope fragments.

works.d: Leentoolis istuva keskealise prillidega mehe figuur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel ülepea kammitud juukse, pilk suunatud ette. Seljas tumesinine ülikond, valge särk, lips ees. Üks jalg üle teise, käed lebavad toolileenil.
works.de: Figure of a middle-aged, bespectacled man sitting in an armchair, in a half-turn to the left. The man's hair is combed straight back, his gaze directed forward. Wearing a dark blue suit, a white shirt, a tie in front. One leg crossed over the other, hands resting on the armrests of the chair.

works.d: Kompositsioon istuva naise ja mehega. Figuurid on moodsalt riietatud - naisel peas kübar ja seljas  punakas kleit siniste sukkadega, mehel kaela seotud roheline sall. Taust koosneb killustunud pindadest.
works.de: Composition with a seated woman and man. The figures are dressed in a modern manner - the woman wears a hat and a reddish dress with blue stockings, the man has a green scarf tied around his neck. The background consists of fragmented planes.

works.d: Pruunikale paberile teostatud abstraktne kompositsioon sinistes, pruunides, rohelistes, oranžides ja kollastes toonides. Musta tuššiga lisatud detailsemad jooned.
works.de: An abstract composition executed on brownish paper in blue, brown, green, orange and yellow tones. More detailed lines added with black ink.

works.d: Tumedates rohelistes ja pruunides toonides sürrealistlik, moonutatud inimfiguur. Pea ja kõht stiliseeritud neerukujulisteks, jalad puuduvad. Üsast paiskub välja tohutu sooniline, kõverdatud sõrmadega käsi. Kujutisele ülalt vasakult langev valgus kumab vastu käel ja kehal, jätab paremale väikese varju. Foon alt roheline, ülalt soojades toonides pruun.
works.de: A surrealist, distorted human figure in dark green and brown tones. Head and belly stylized into kidney-like shapes, legs missing. A huge sinewy hand with curved fingers bursts out of the womb. Light falling on the image from upper left gleams on the hand and body, leaving a small shadow on the right. Background green from below, warm brown tones from above.

works.d: Tumepruunides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon. Keskel istub tumedas rüüs habemik noor mees, käelabad põlvedele toetatud. Jeesuse ümber hulk lapsi, kaks neist põlvedel (parampoolne katsub Jeesuse nägu). Ülal foonil kollastes toonides kiudpilvedega taevas.
works.de: A figural composition in dark brown tones. In the middle sits a bearded young man in dark robes, hands resting on his knees. Around Jesus a number of children, two of them on his knees (the one on the right touching Jesus's face). Above, in the background, a sky in yellow tones with fibrous clouds.

works.d: Tumedates pruunides toonides kiriku interjöör: keskel, ristilöödupildiga altari ees pastor, parem käsi kõnehoos välja sirutatud, suu lahti. Altariruumi piiravatel pinkidel kirikulised, osa neist (allservas) seljaga, teised küljega vaataja poole. Altaril kaks põlevat küünalt. Paremal, kooriruumi seinal kõrge kitsa akna kõrval kolme küünlaga seinabraa.
works.de: A church interior in dark brown tones: in the centre, a pastor in front of an altar with a crucifixion image, right hand outstretched in a speaking gesture, mouth open. Churchgoers on the pews bordering the altar area, some of them (in the lower edge) with their backs turned, others sideways to the viewer. Two burning candles on the altar. On the right, next to a tall narrow window on the chancel wall, a three-candle wall sconce.

works.d: Kompositsiooni keskmeks on end konksu tõmmanud
works.de: The centre of the composition is a figure that has curled itself into a hook.

works.d: Teose keskseks motiiviks on abstraktsed kaks labajalga ja käsi. Maalitud tumehallides, mustades ja punastes toonides hoogsate pintsilöökidega.
works.de: The central motif of the work is two abstract feet and a hand. Painted in dark grey, black and red tones with vigorous brushstrokes.

works.d: Kompositsiooni keskseks motiiviks on kägarasse positsiooni tõmbunud abstrakne figuur tumehallides toonides. Taust helehall, paremal alumises servas verepritsmeid meenutavad jäljed.
works.de: The central motif of the composition is an abstract figure drawn into a curled-up position, in dark grey tones. The background light grey, in the lower right corner marks resembling blood splatters.

works.d: Töö keskel on pabernukku meenutav figuur, keda on kujutatud alla kallutatud ülakehaga ning tõstetud kätega. Kompositsiooni taust on jagatud diagonaalselt tumehalliks seinaks ja helehalliks põrandaks.
works.de: In the middle of the work is a figure resembling a paper doll, depicted with the upper body tilted downward and raised hands. The background of the composition is divided diagonally into a dark grey wall and a light grey floor.

works.d: Istuva noore naise portree. Keha veerandpöördes paremale, nägu vaatab otse. Figuur kannab valget avatud kitlit, sinist seelikut ja värvilist pluusi. Taustal lilla draperii.
works.de: Portrait of a seated young woman. Body in a quarter-turn to the right, face looking straight ahead. The figure wears a white open smock, a blue skirt and a coloured blouse. In the background, a purple drapery.

works.d: Uduses hallika-kollasel taustal kujutatud täisprofiilis seisvat krantsi. Koer seisab telliskividele toetuval palgil.
works.de: A horse depicted in full profile against a hazy grayish-yellow background. A dog stands on a log resting on bricks.

works.d: Rannikuvaade, mida piirab paremalt poolt kaks neoonoranži kaljut. Taamal näha merepiiri, maastik on künklik. Kompositsiooni vasakus servas seisab seljaga vaataja poole mehike.
works.de: A coastal view bordered on the right by two neon-orange cliffs. In the distance the sea's edge can be seen, the landscape is hilly. In the left edge of the composition stands a small man with his back to the viewer.

works.d: Türkiissinistes ja rohekates toonides kompositsioon, mis kujutab vaadet ovaalsete vormidega ümbritsetud järvemaastikule.
works.de: A composition in turquoise-blue and greenish tones depicting a view of a lake landscape surrounded by oval forms.

works.d: Värvikirev abstraktne kompositsioon, maalitud lühikeste tihedate pintslilöökidega - üksikud kontuurid on välja toodud musta peene pintslijoonega.
works.de: A colourful abstract composition, painted with short dense brushstrokes - individual contours are brought out with a thin black brush line.

works.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule.  Portreteeritul lühike tume soeng, seljas tumesinine pullover. Taust teostatud tumesinakates, rohekates ja hallikates toonides.
works.de: Bust of a woman in half-profile facing left. The subject has short dark hair, wearing a dark blue pullover. The background is executed in dark bluish, greenish and greyish tones.

works.d: Kirgas kompositsioon sürrealistlikust taevalaotusest ja pilvedest. Teose koloriit koosneb peamiselt lillakatest ja sinakatest toonidest koos kollaste ja fuksjate aktsentidega.
works.de: A vivid composition of a surrealistic sky and clouds. The work's colour scheme consists mainly of purplish and bluish tones with yellow and fuchsia accents.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 24.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 25.0 cm
works.d: Kompositsioon abstraktsete figuuride ja loomadega. Figuuride kontuurid teostatud peene tindipliiatsi joonega; osad pinnad kaetud pruunide, hallide, sinakate ja roheliste toonidega.
works.de: A composition with abstract figures and animals. The contours of the figures executed with a fine ink pencil line; some surfaces covered with brown, grey, bluish and green tones.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 20.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 25.0 cm
works.d: Abstraktsed punased lilled kitsas vaasis. Taust jaguneb punasteks-, rohelisteks- ja hallideks värvipindadeks. Kimbu kohal lampi meenutav kujund.
works.de: Abstract red flowers in a narrow vase. The background is divided into red, green and grey colour areas. Above the bouquet a shape resembling a lamp.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 34.0 cm
works.d: Abstraktselt kujutatud naise ja mehe portree. Parempoolne figuur istub laua taga ja vasakpoolsem seisab suits suus. Laua vasakus nurgas seisab pudel.
works.de: Abstractly depicted portrait of a woman and a man. The right-hand figure sits at a table and the one on the left stands with a cigarette in his mouth. In the left corner of the table stands a bottle.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 26.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 31.0 cm
works.d: Kaks abstraktset figuuri kirkas neoonses maastikus. Paremal pool on kujutatud otse vaates mehe täisfiguuri, vasakul pool ronka meenutavat lindu heinahanguga.
works.de: Two abstract figures in a bright neon landscape. On the right, a full figure of a man is depicted in frontal view, on the left a bird resembling a raven with a pitchfork.

works.d: Abstraktne naisfiguur istumas kohvilaua taga. Laual taldrik pirnidega, kann ja roheline linik. Taustal kahe pooliku figuuri piirjooned. Naise taga punane ristkülik, sini-hallid triibud.
works.de: An abstract female figure sitting behind a coffee table. On the table a plate with pears, a jug and a green cloth. In the background the outlines of two partial figures. Behind the woman a red rectangle, blue-grey stripes.

works.d: Laua peal seisab musta-punase värvi kannus lillekimp karikakrate ja moonidega. Laual kirgas kollane-sinine linik ja kaks õuna meenutavat objekti. Taustal aken.
works.de: On the table stands a black-and-red vase with a bouquet of flowers of daisies and poppies. On the table a bright yellow-and-blue cloth and two objects resembling apples. In the background a window.

works.d: Kompositsiooni paremas servas seisab punasesse ja valgesse riietatud abstraktne naisfiguur. Naist ümbritseb maastik veekoguga, liivaga, puudega ning sinise taevaga.
works.de: On the right edge of the composition stands an abstract female figure dressed in red and white. The woman is surrounded by a landscape with a body of water, sand, trees and a blue sky.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon- domineerivad värvid ooker, heleroosa, türkiissinine, pruun ja valge.
works.de: Abstract composition - dominant colours ochre, light pink, turquoise blue, brown and white.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 34.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 43.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil kirkad lilled vaasides. Lillede taga seisab abstraktne naisfiguur roosa pea ja valge rüüga. Taust koosneb kollakatest, punakatest ja sinakatest värvipindadest.
works.de: In the foreground, bright flowers in vases. Behind the flowers stands an abstract female figure with a pink head and a white robe. The background consists of yellowish, reddish and bluish colour surfaces.

works.d: Kolm alasti stiliseeritud figuuri kandmas seljal risti. Foon sinakates toonides.
works.de: Three stylised nude figures carrying a cross on their backs. Background in bluish tones.

works.d: Mustal taustal looklevad geomeetrilised punased vormid.
works.de: Winding geometric red shapes on a black background.

works.t: Kunstniku õe Adelheid von Kügelgeni portree
works.d: Noore daami rindportree poolprofiilis vasakule. Portreteeritu pruunid juuksed on sätitud tihedate lokkidega soengusse, otsmikul paistab punakas peapael. Seljas must kõrge kaeluse ja puhvis varrukatega kleit. Taustal rannamaastik ja sinakas-lillakas taevahorisont.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young lady in half-profile to the left. The sitter's brown hair is arranged in a hairstyle of dense curls, a reddish headband shows on the forehead. Wearing a black dress with a high collar and puffed sleeves. In the background a coastal landscape and a bluish-purple horizon sky.

works.t: Kas valgust on veel alles. Magenta andis märku, et seal puude vahel midagi kumab
works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes kaadmiumpunane värvipind. Selle taustal roosakas värvipind, millesse lõikuvad lillad piklikud kujundid. Vasakul vertikaalne värvipind, millel gradatsioon erkkollasest tumesiniseni.
works.de: An abstract composition, in the centre of which is a cadmium red area of colour. Behind it a pinkish area of colour, into which lilac elongated forms cut. On the left a vertical area of colour, with a gradation from bright yellow to dark blue.

works.d: Keskel kaks naiviseerivas laadis maalitud naisfiguuri: vasakul mitme pärlikeega, pikas seelikus, groteskselt mingitud vana naine; paremal valge kraega triibulises kelidis toatüdruk, krahvinna käevangus. Foon alt rohelist muru meenutav, ülaosas helesinine.
works.de: In the centre two female figures painted in a naivist manner: on the left an old woman grotesquely depicted, wearing several strings of pearls and a long skirt; on the right a chambermaid in a striped dress with a white collar, on the countess's arm. Background resembling green grass at the bottom, light blue at the top.

works.d: Allservas keskel võimas tumepruun härg, pea maas, pisut rannamaastiku meenutaval abstraktsel foonil. Ülaosa katab peaaegu tervenisti järve-kujund.
works.de: At the bottom centre a powerful dark-brown bull, head lowered, against an abstract background somewhat reminiscent of a coastal landscape. The upper part is almost entirely covered by a lake-like shape.

works.d: Allservas tumedates sinistes ja rohelistes toonides puuvõra. Keskel, okste vahel, suurte silmadega helesinine öökull. Foonil roosakaspruun mäenõlv, kaarjas silmapiir ja rohekassinine taevas. Ülaservas vasakul piklik, lillade servadega valge pilvemassiiv.
works.de: In the lower part, a tree crown in dark blue and green tones. In the middle, among the branches, a light blue owl with large eyes. In the background, a pinkish-brown mountain slope, a curved horizon and a greenish-blue sky. In the upper left corner, an elongated white cloud mass with purple edges.

works.d: Vasakul valgesse pilve mähkunud kuuriosas. Riiulitel värvilised purgid, pudelid, karbid, ämber, klaasist poid. Paremal servas helesinine taevas.
works.de: On the left, part of a shed wrapped in a white cloud. On the shelves coloured jars, bottles, boxes, a bucket, a glass buoy. On the right edge a light blue sky.

works.d: Paremal ülal, rohelisel foonil, punaste silmadega must ronk. Keskel ja allservas pruunides toonides reljeefideha kaetud arhitektuuridetailid. Vasakus ülanurgas valge büst, nägu profiilis.
works.de: Above right, on a green background, a black raven with red eyes. In the centre and lower edge architectural details covered with relief in brown tones. In the upper left corner a white bust, face in profile.

works.d: Stiliseeritud mere ja taeva foonil ülaservas värvilistest keradest ja kolmnurkadest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: Stylised abstract composition against a background of sea and sky, with colourful spheres and triangles in the upper edge.

works.d: Lillakaspunasel merel kolm valget kolmnurkset purje. Esiplaanil tumesinised kivimürakad, ülaservas kitsas riba oranži taevast.
works.de: Three white triangular sails on a purplish-red sea. In the foreground dark blue rock masses, in the upper edge a narrow strip of orange sky.

works.d: Keskel hallikas pikas rüüs mees, parem käsi välja sirutatud, pilk taevasse suunatud. Mehe vasakul õlal ja käsivarrel istuvad linnud, pea ümber värviline linnuparv. Vasakul all värviline põõsas, milles istub neli kirjut lindu.
works.de: In the centre a man in a long greyish robe, right arm outstretched, gaze directed toward the sky. On the man's left shoulder and arm sit birds, around his head a colourful flock of birds. Lower left a colourful bush, in which four speckled birds sit.

works.d: Allservas keskel stiliseeritud, laialisirutatud kätega inimfiguur poolringi meenutavat raskust hoidmas. Poolringikujundi allservas mustad kolmnurgad, nende kohal punastes ja sinistes toonides poolfiguuridest komponeeritud ornament.
works.de: In the lower middle, a stylised human figure with outstretched arms holding up a weight resembling a semicircle. At the bottom of the semicircular shape, black triangles; above them, an ornament composed of half-figures in red and blue tones.

works.d: Lillades, roosades, mustades toonides allservas soopinda meenutav abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülaosa roosakaspruun, ülaservas sinine triip.
works.de: An abstract composition in violet, pink and black tones, the lower edge resembling a bog surface. The upper part pinkish-brown, with a blue stripe at the top edge.

works.d: Kummalistest, maskitaoliste nägudega figuuridest tantsuring. Osa mütoloogilistest olevustest lendleb õhus, pildi alumistes nurkades tillukesed figuurid.
works.de: A dance circle of strange, mask-like faced figures. Some of the mythological creatures float in the air, tiny figures in the lower corners of the picture.

works.d: Klaasesemetest komponeeritud natüürmort: vasakul klaasist puuviljavaas, milles sinised ja oranžid pallid, paremal kaks pokaali (ühes rohelised oksad). Sügavsinisel foonil ülal paremas nurgas kollase ja oranžiga maalitud kuu.
works.de: A still life composed of glass objects: on the left a glass fruit vase containing blue and orange balls, on the right two goblets (in one, green branches). Against a deep blue background, in the upper right corner, a moon painted in yellow and orange.

works.d: Värvilistest, omavahel põimunud ellipsitest kompositsioon tumedal foonil. Keskel väike helesinine ring.
works.de: Composition of colored, interwoven ellipses on a dark background. A small light blue circle in the middle.

works.d: Pehmes tugitoolis istuva tütarlapse kolmveerand figuur. Pea kerge pöördega vasakule, keha paremale. Peas punane barett.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a girl sitting in a soft armchair. Head turned slightly to the left, body to the right. A red beret on her head.

works.d: Etüüdilik kompositsioon künka peal asetsevast külast. Maa ja majade katused on kaetud lumega, taevas selge.
works.de: A study-like composition of a village situated on a hill. The ground and the roofs of the houses are covered with snow, the sky is clear.

works.d: Haige põetamise olmestseen ajaloolises interjööris. Kompositsiooni keskel kolm naisfiguuri: üks vanem daam lamab voodis, teine istub toolil näoga haige poole ning kolmas seisab profiilis voodi kõrval, käes valge anum.
works.de: A genre scene of nursing a patient in a historical interior. In the centre of the composition three female figures: one older lady lies in bed, another sits on a chair facing the patient, and a third stands in profile beside the bed, holding a white vessel.

works.t: Meie elu. See võiks olla unistamine
works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon erinevat värvi ebakorrapäraste kujunditega. Kompositsiooni ülemises osas lilla ümar kujund, vasakus, paremas ja alumises osas sakiliste servadega kujundid. Kujundite taustal värvigaradtsioon erkoranžist tumelillani.
works.de: Abstract composition with irregular shapes of different colours. In the upper part of the composition a purple round shape, in the left, right and lower parts shapes with jagged edges. Colour gradation from bright orange to dark purple in the background of the shapes.

works.d: Kollase linikuga kaetud laual seisab terrakota-valge teeserviis, peegel, ümbrik ja tagurpidi prillid.
works.de: On a table covered with a yellow cloth stand a terracotta-and-white tea service, a mirror, an envelope and upside-down glasses.

works.d: Pintslit käes hoidva noore naiskunstniku autoportree ekspressiivses laadis. Kujutataval lühikesed pruunid juuksed, seljas kollakas pluus ja roheline seelik.
works.de: Self-portrait of a young female artist holding a brush, in an expressive style. The subject has short brown hair, wears a yellowish blouse and a green skirt.

works.d: Noore naiskunstniku autoportree en face koos Jumalaema ikooniga. Kunstnikul posipea, seljas punane pullover ja taustaks rohekas maaliline värvipind. Laias kuldses raamis Jumalaema ikoon kompositsiooni paremas osas.
works.de: Young female artist's self-portrait en face together with an icon of the Mother of God. The artist has a headscarf, wears a red pullover, against a greenish painterly colour field. In a wide golden frame, the icon of the Mother of God in the right part of the composition.

works.d: Ruutudeks jaotatud sümmeetriline geomeetriline kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskmes punase risti kujund, mille südames kollane romb, taustaks kollased ja sinised pinnad. Tervet kompositsiooni ümbritsevad hõbedased servad.
works.de: Symmetrical geometric composition divided into squares. At the centre of the composition a red cross shape, at its heart a yellow rhombus, against a background of yellow and blue surfaces. Silver edges surround the whole composition.

works.d: Ruutudeks jaotatud sümmeetriline geomeetriline kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskmes kollane ristikujuline kujund, taust sinine, servad hõbedased.
works.de: Symmetrical geometric composition divided into squares. At the centre of the composition a yellow cross-shaped figure, background blue, edges silver.

works.d: Ruutudeks jaotatud sümmeetriline geomeetriline kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskmes kollane risti kujuline kujund, taust koloreerimata, servad hõbedased.
works.de: A symmetrical geometric composition divided into squares. At the center of the composition a yellow cross-shaped figure, background uncolored, edges silver.

works.d: Ruutudeks jaotatud sümmeetriline geomeetriline kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskmes korrapärases asetuses siniste külgedega ruumilised kuubikud. Üle terve kompositsiooni väikesed punased ruudukujulised ja nurkades suuremad kollased ristkülikukujulised kollaažielemendid.
works.de: A symmetrical geometric composition divided into squares. At the centre of the composition, spatial cubes with blue sides arranged in a regular pattern. Small red square-shaped collage elements are spread over the entire composition, with larger yellow rectangular collage elements in the corners.

works.d: Pastelsel sinakas-hallil taustal sümmeetriline heleroosa kujund.
works.de: Against a pastel bluish-grey background a symmetrical light pink shape.

works.d: Heleroosal taustal neli korduvat geomeetrilist vormi, mis on maalitud halli gradiendi pindadena.
works.de: On a light pink background four repeating geometric forms, painted as grey gradient surfaces.

works.d: Helehallil taustal halli gradiendiga abstraktne vorm.
works.de: Abstract form with a grey gradient on a light grey background.

works.d: Maali pind jaotatud sümmeetrilise abstraktse joonega pooleks: ülemine pool valge ja alumine pool heleroosa.
works.de: The surface of the painting is divided in two by a symmetrical abstract line: the upper half white and the lower half light pink.

works.d: Helehallil taustal suurt maalipinda kattev geomeetriline vorm, mis on maalitud roosa gradiendina.
works.de: On a light grey background a geometric shape covering a large painted surface, painted as a pink gradient.

works.d: Heleroosal taustal neli korduvat helehalli gradiendiga vormi.
works.de: Four repeating light grey gradient shapes on a light pink background.

works.d: Õrnal hallikal-rohekal taustal kujutatud gradiendis lehvikut meenutavat vormi.
works.de: Against a delicate grayish-greenish background a fan-like form depicted in gradient.

works.d: Üks roheline ja kaks sinist figuuri paiknevad liivakarva linnuse moodi rajatises. Vasakul laua taga istuv roheline tegelane tegeleb kirjutamisega, tema kõrval ripub punane kardin. Sinised elukad on kujutatud kurvas meeleolus sulatud silmadega.
works.de: One green and two blue figures are located in a sand-colored fortress-like structure. On the left, behind a table, a seated green character is engaged in writing, beside him hangs a red curtain. The blue creatures are depicted in a sorrowful mood with melted eyes.

works.d: Kõrgendikult alla vaatav maastikuvaade järvele ja metsadega kaetud järvakaldale ja saarekestele. Puude lehestik on kergelt kollakas.
works.de: A landscape view looking down from an elevation onto a lake and its forest-covered shore and small islands. The foliage of the trees is slightly yellowish.

works.d: Metsavaheline autotee. Silmapiiril paistab punane-valge buss.
works.de: A road through the forest. A red-and-white bus is visible on the horizon.

works.d: Valge linaga kaetud laual seisab vaas astritega, nõu pirnidega, roheline raamat ja ajakiri Looming.
works.de: On a table covered with a white cloth stands a vase with asters, a vessel with pears, a green book and the magazine Looming.

works.d: Aknalaual seisab kaks vaasi kohevate roosakate kimpudega, kann ja vaagen õuntega. Taamal paistab vanalinn.
works.de: On the windowsill stand two vases with fluffy pinkish bouquets, a jug, and a platter with apples. In the background the old town can be seen.

works.d: Helerohelise linaga kaetud laual kompositsioon kohalikest aedviljadest (kõrvits, punane paprika, sibul, küüslauk. Korvis õunad, kausis porgandid ja kurgid). Taustal draperii.
works.de: A composition of local garden vegetables on a table covered with a light green cloth (pumpkin, red pepper, onion, garlic. Apples in a basket, carrots and cucumbers in a bowl). Drapery in the background.

works.d: Helehallil taustal valge sümmeetriline kujund.
works.de: Against a light grey background, a white symmetrical shape.

works.d: Hallil taustal roosa sümmeetriline kujund, servades tooni viiekordne gradatsioon.
works.de: On a grey background a pink symmetrical form, with a fivefold gradation of tone at the edges.

works.d: Helehallil taustal domineerib sümmeetriline roosa kujund, mille servad astmeliselt gradieeruvad heleroosast tumedamaks. Kujundi alumises osas fragment sarnasest motiivist hallides toonides.
works.de: Against a light-grey background dominates a symmetrical pink form, whose edges gradate stepwise from light pink to darker. In the lower part of the form a fragment of a similar motif in grey tones.

works.d: Halli sümmeetrilise kujundi servades jooksevad astmeliselt tumedamad triibud, mis kujundi kohal jätkuvad roosas gradatsioonis. Vasakus ja paremas servas helehallid jooned.
works.de: At the edges of the grey symmetrical shape run gradually darker stripes, which continue above the shape in a pink gradation. Light grey lines at the left and right edges.

works.d: Helehallil taustal kordub neli sarnast sümmeetrilist kujundit beežikas-hallikas gradatsioonis.
works.de: On a light grey background four similar symmetrical forms repeat in a beige-greyish gradation.

works.d: Helehallil taustal õrnroosa lehvikut meenutav kujund.
works.de: A shape resembling a delicate pink fan on a light grey background.

works.d: Õrnroosal taustal sümmeetriline beež kujund.
works.de: A symmetrical beige shape on a pale pink background.

works.d: Abstraheeritud muuliga järvevaade. Esiplaanil roosakates toonides ümarad muulikivid, tagaplaanil järv ja taevas.
works.de: Abstracted view of a lake with a pier. In the foreground, rounded pier stones in pinkish tones, in the background the lake and sky.

works.d: Helerohelisel taustal noore mehe pea profiilis vasakule.
works.de: On a light green background the head of a young man in profile to the left.

works.d: Stiliseeritud maastikuvaade puudegrupi ja künklike maastikuvormidega. Puudegrupi taustal tume metsaviirg ja ruljate rünkpilvedega taevas.
works.de: Stylised landscape view with a group of trees and hilly landforms. Behind the group of trees a dark strip of forest and a sky with rounded cumulus clouds.

works.d: Sarvilist maski käes hoidva naise portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel peas traditsiooniline peakate, kaelas punase südamega ümmargune ehe.
works.de: Portrait of a woman holding a horned mask, in three-quarter turn to the left. The woman wears a traditional headdress, around her neck a round ornament with a red heart.

works.d: Rätikuga naise portree kolmveerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel seljas valge pluus ja oranžikas pealisriie ning käes sinine lilleõis. Taustal maastik taeva ja puudega.
works.de: Portrait of a woman with a headscarf in a three-quarter turn to the left. The woman is wearing a white blouse and an orangish outer garment and holds a blue flower in her hand. Background a landscape with sky and trees.

works.d: Käsipõsakil poisi portree. Poisil peas punane traditsiooniline müts, seljas valge pluus ja roheline vest.
works.de: Portrait of a boy with his chin resting on his hand. The boy wears a red traditional cap, a white blouse and a green waistcoat.

works.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallika figuuri ülemist kehaosa. Figuuri pea on langetatud ja käed rüppes.
works.de: The upper part of a greyish figure depicted against a background with a light blue gradation. The figure's head is lowered and hands rest in the lap.

works.d: Sinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallikates-sinakates toonides figuuri ülemist kehaosa. Figuur toetab oma küünernukke justkui lauale, hoides käes valget pliiatsit.
works.de: Against a background with blue gradation, the upper part of a figure's body is depicted in greyish-bluish tones. The figure rests its elbows as if on a table, holding a white pencil in its hand.

works.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal žestikuleerib hallikas figuur kätega: vasaku käe laba on pööratud taeva poole, parema käe pöial ja nimetissirm justkui hoiaksid midagi väikest.
works.de: Against a background with a pale blue gradation, a grayish figure gestures with its hands: the palm of the left hand is turned towards the sky, the thumb and index finger of the right hand as if holding something small.

works.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallika figuuri ülemine kehaosa. Figuur hoiab paremat kätt pea juures, hoides püsti nimetissõrme.

Taevalaotuses hõljub kiilakas naisakt punaste kontsakingadega ja veiniklaasiga. Tema kohal avaneb punakas taevavõlv inglitega. Akti vaatlevad maali mõlemas servas seisvad tõbised figuurid roosa rüüga, kelle vahel suitsevad tööstushoonete torud. Maali alumises servas kujutatud punakates ja purpur toonides figuure joomas ja suitsetamas.
works.de: In the vault of the sky a bald female nude hovers, wearing red high-heeled shoes and holding a wine glass. Above her a reddish heavenly vault opens with angels. The nude is observed by sickly figures in pink robes standing at both edges of the painting, between whom smoking industrial building chimneys appear. In the lower edge of the painting, figures in reddish and purple tones are depicted drinking and smoking.

works.d: Ookri taustal figuuri rindportree profiilis vasakule. Mööda kujutatu nägu sibavad kärbseid meenutavad putukad.
works.de: Bust portrait of a figure in profile to the left against an ochre background. Insects resembling flies crawl over the face of the subject.

works.d: Tumerohelisel taustal figuuri rindportree profiilis vasakule. Kiilaka portreteeritu nahk on kaetud rõugeid meenutava naha deformatsiooniga.
works.de: On a dark green background, a bust portrait of a figure in profile facing left. The skin of the bald sitter is covered with a pox-like skin deformation.

works.d: Heleroosal taustal kaheksa figuuri öökimas verd. Kompositsiooni paremas servas fragmenteeritud kehaosad nagu käsi ja rind, mille ümber seisavad omakorda kuus väiksemat sinist figuuri..
works.de: Against a light pink background, eight figures spitting blood. In the right edge of the composition fragmented body parts such as a hand and a breast, around which in turn stand six smaller blue figures.

works.d: Lillakas-roosakal taustal hõljub õhus naisfiguur. Akt on kujutatud mitme jäsemega, rõhutades figuuri liikumist õhus. Karikatuurse silma must iiris on tilga-kujuline.
works.de: A female figure hovers in the air against a purplish-pink background. The nude is depicted with several limbs, emphasising the figure's movement in the air. The black iris of the caricatured eye is drop-shaped.

works.d: Helesinise ja valge gradatsiooniga taustal amorfne valge vorm.
works.de: On a background with a light blue and white gradation an amorphous white form.

works.d: Vasakust servast ülemisse paremasse serva kulgeb rida sarnaste peadega. Kujutatud isikute silmad on sinakad-hallid ja pead kiilakad- nähtaval on vaid pool nägu.
works.de: From the left edge to the upper right edge runs a row of similar heads. The eyes of the depicted persons are bluish-grey and the heads bald – only half of the face is visible.

works.d: Valgel taustal põlvitab pea maas beež amorfne figuur.
works.de: On a white background a beige amorphous figure kneels with its head to the ground.

works.d: Valgel taustal kujutatud tosin figuure rindportrees vasakule. Figuuridel seljas õhulised valged rüüd, mis justkui kulgevad valgetest pudelitest välja. Ühel figuuril jookseb mööda põske pisar.
works.de: Against a white background, a dozen figures depicted in bust portrait facing left. The figures wear airy white robes that seem to emerge out of white bottles. On one figure a tear runs down the cheek.

works.d: Helesinisel taustal abstraktseid figuure meenutavad valged vormid. Kompositsiooni servi ümbritseb punane ääristus.
works.de: On a light blue background, white forms resembling abstract figures. The edges of the composition are surrounded by a red border.
