works.d: Helesinise taustaga töö alumisel poolel hõljuvad üksteise kohal kaks istuvas poosis figuuri: alumine on suurem ja tumedam, ülemine väiksem ja heledam.
works.de: In the lower half of the work, against a light blue background, two seated figures hover one above the other: the lower one is larger and darker, the upper one smaller and lighter.

works.d: Helesinisel taustal hõljumas kolm figuuri: alumine on kõige suurem, heledam ja meenutab enim inimfiguuri ning ülemine kõige tumedam ja väiksem.
Helesinisel taustal hõljub vildakalt kolm figuuri: alumine hallikas on kõige väiksem, keskmine on beežikas ja ülemise pool keha on paremas servas kompositsioonist väljas.
Kompositsioon laua ja sellele asetatud laekaga, mille ümber neli meest. Mehed maalitud popilikus võtmes, taust tumepruun.
works.de: Composition with a table and a chest placed on it, surrounded by four men. The men are painted in a pop-art manner, background dark brown.

works.d: Helesinisel taustal abstraktsed valged figuurid rõhutatud naiselike kehaosadega. Ühest otsast on figuurid deformeerunud pikaks ja kitsaks vormiks, kompositsiooni ülalservas hõljub kera.
works.de: Against a light blue background, abstract white figures with emphasized feminine body parts. At one end the figures are deformed into a long and narrow form, at the top edge of the composition a sphere hovers.

works.d: Mööda rohumaad kõnnib kaks kolmveerandfiguuri: blondi peaga naine kannab poolläbipaistvat kleiti ning tema keha on kujutatud liikuvas olekus, temast paremal seisab helerohelistes riietes žestikuleerivate kätega poiss. Taustast moodustab kolmandiku rohelus ning kaks kolmandikku pilvine taevas.
works.de: Two three-quarter figures walk across a meadow: a blonde-headed woman wears a semi-transparent dress and her body is depicted in a moving state, to her right stands a boy in light green clothing with gesturing hands. Greenery forms a third of the background, and a cloudy sky the other two thirds.

works.d: Kompositsioon kahe teineteist embava naisaktiga. Pildi serv lõikab naisaktid põlvedest kõrgemalt poolfiguurideks. Kujutatavad vaatavad hirmunud ilmel paremale pildist välja. Taustal värvigradatsioon heledamast tumedamaks roheliseks.
works.de: A composition with two female nude figures embracing each other. The edge of the picture cuts the female nudes above the knees into half-figures. The figures depicted look out of the picture to the right with a frightened expression. Background colour gradation from lighter to darker green.

works.d: Naise täisfiguurportree veerandpöördes paremale. Portreteeritul seljas valge-puna triibuline põll ja helesinine särk, juuksed seatud krunni. Ümberringi fragmendid toa mööblist: vasakul lauanurk, paremal riiul.
works.de: Full-figure portrait of a woman in a three-quarter turn to the right. The sitter wears a white-and-red striped apron and a light blue shirt, hair arranged in a bun. Around her, fragments of room furniture: a table corner on the left, a shelf on the right.

works.d: Figuraalkompositsioon, mille keskmes lastest ja üksikutest täiskasvanutest ümbritsetud Jeesus, kes on asetanud käe tema ees seisva lapse pea peale. Stseeni taustal kivist hoone, esiplaanil lambad ja mängiv laps. Kivihoone varjus stseeni pealt vaatav viiuliga mees.
works.de: Figural composition with Jesus at the centre, surrounded by children and a few adults, having placed his hand on the head of a child standing before him. In the background of the scene a stone building, in the foreground sheep and a playing child. In the shadow of the stone building a man with a violin watches the scene from above.

works.d: Hallikas-rohekal taustal mehe rindportree veerandpöördes paremale. Õlgadele langeva punase rätiga portreteeritu hoiab käes pintslit.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man against a greyish-green background, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The sitter, with a red kerchief falling onto his shoulders, holds a brush in his hand.

works.d: Beežil taustal istuva mehe portree veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel seljas pruun mantel, punakas särk, peas kaabu, käes pintsel.
works.de: Portrait of a seated man against a beige background, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man is wearing a brown coat, a reddish shirt, a hat on his head, a brush in his hand.

works.t: Istuva naise portree kübara ja sinise jakiga
works.d: Lühikese blondi soenguga noore naise figuurportree veerandpöördes paremale. Portreteeritu istub taburetil, käed ristis. Tema seljas on sinine jakk, bordoo seelik, valge sall, peas tumepruun kübar.
works.de: Figure portrait of a young woman with short blonde hair, in a quarter-turn to the right. The sitter is seated on a stool, hands crossed. She is wearing a blue jacket, a burgundy skirt, a white shawl, and a dark brown hat on her head.

works.d: Tumesinisel, -punasel taustal naise rindportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Pruunide juuste ja punase huulepulgaga naise sinakas-lillakas kostüüm sulandub tausta sisse.
works.de: Against a dark blue-red background, a bust portrait of a woman in a quarter turn to the left. The woman's bluish-purple costume, with brown hair and red lipstick, blends into the background.

works.d: Kolmeosalisel maalipinnal kujutatud meeletult tormavaid hobuseid lehvivate lakkadega punastes, sinistes, roosades toonides. Nende vahel figuure.
works.de: The three-part painted surface depicts frantically galloping horses with flowing manes in red, blue, pink tones. Figures between them.

works.d: Kolmeosalisel maalipinnal kujutatud meeletult tormavaid hobuseid lehvivate lakkadega punastes, sinistes, roosades toonides. Nende vahel figuure.
works.de: The three-part painted surface depicts frantically galloping horses with flowing manes in red, blue, pink tones. Figures between them.

works.d: Sürrealistlike, üksteisesse põimuvate ja üksteisest väljakasvavate kujunditega keerulise struktuuriga kompositsioon, mille keskosas on aimata tohutusuurt, otsekui tühjade silmakoobastega pead. Vasakul servas ülal mütsiga mehepea peaaegu profiilis. Servades fantaasiakoletisi.
works.de: A composition of complex structure with surrealist images intertwining and growing out of one another, in the centre of which one can discern an enormous head with seemingly empty eye sockets. In the upper left corner a man's head with a hat, almost in profile. Fantasy monsters in the margins.

works.dm: laius: 151.0 cm (kaks osa koos  ); kõrgus: 190.0 cm
works.d: Punasest, kollasest, rohelisest ja sinisest pinnast koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon valgel foonil. Värvilised pinnad ümbritsetud musta kontuurjoonega. Musta joonega on antud fooniosas väikesed ruudud ja abstraktsed pinnad, üksikud jooned ja katkendlikud kriipsud.
works.de: Abstract composition consisting of red, yellow, green and blue surfaces on a white background. The coloured surfaces are surrounded by a black contour line. In the background area small squares and abstract surfaces, individual lines and broken dashes are given with a black line.

works.d: Kolm järjestikku asetsevat kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutavat plaati; vasakpoolne ots puna-musta-oranži triibuline läheb üle monokroomseks must-valgeks ja paremalt lõpeb sügavsinise-mustaga.
works.de: Three narrow striped bar-code-like plates arranged in a row; the left end, striped in red-black-orange, transitions into monochrome black and white, and ends on the right in deep blue-black.

works.d: Kolm järjestikku asetsevat kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutavat plaati; vasakpoolne ots puna-musta-oranži triibuline läheb üle monokroomseks must-valgeks ja paremalt lõpeb sügavsinise-mustaga.
works.de: Three narrow striped bar-code-like plates arranged in a row; the left end, striped in red-black-orange, transitions into monochrome black and white, and ends on the right in deep blue-black.

works.d: Istuva noore naise portree en face. Kujutataval seljas roheline pluus ja punane seelik, õlgadel tume karusnahkne kasukas. Tustal pastelsetes toonides geomeetrilise mustriga kardin.
works.de: Portrait of a seated young woman en face. The subject wears a green blouse and a red skirt, on the shoulders a dark fur coat. In the background a curtain in pastel tones with a geometric pattern.

works.d: Maalipind jaotub horisontaalselt kaheks: domineeriv alumine pool koosneb punastest alpikannidest, mille keskel on sinine käsi ning ülemisel poolel on sinise tausta keskel üks punane alpikann.
works.de: The painted surface is divided horizontally into two: the dominant lower half consists of red alpine gentians, with a blue hand at their centre, and the upper half has a single red alpine gentian at the centre of a blue background.

works.d: Punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon siniste aktsentidega. Töö keskmes on vaataja poole pööratud käelaba, mille peal on kaks liblikat.
works.de: An abstract composition in red tones with blue accents. At the centre of the work is a hand turned towards the viewer, on which are two butterflies.

works.d: Värvikirev kompositsioon abstraktsete vormidega. Domineerivad ookerjad ja rohelised toonid - lilla ja sinine aktsent teose alumises paremas nurgas ja keskosas.
works.de: Colourful composition with abstract forms. Ochre and green tones dominate - a purple and blue accent in the lower right corner and in the middle part of the work.

works.d: Värvikirev kompositsioon abstraktsete vormidega kollakates-, sinakates, rohekates ja punakates toonides.
works.de: A colourful composition with abstract forms in yellowish, bluish, greenish and reddish tones.

works.d: Sassispäise habemiku vanamehe rindpilt. Seljas rohekas vammus. Käte vahel nokkmüts.
works.de: Chest portrait of a tousle-headed bearded old man. Wearing a greenish jerkin. A peaked cap between his hands.

works.d: Vasakul poolenisti kaldale tõmmatud kalapaadid, millede taga heledal liival kolm pikkades seelikutes naist. Kaldal kalakuurid, lipuvarras, keskele jääb kõrge kallas, paremal meri. 3/4 pildipinnast pilvine taevas.
works.de: On the left, fishing boats half-drawn onto the shore, behind which, on light sand, three women in long skirts. On the shore, fish sheds, a flagpole, a high bank remains in the middle, on the right the sea. Three quarters of the picture surface is cloudy sky.

works.d: Toolil istuv noor naine poolkülgvaates, pea pööratud vaataja poole, pilk suunatud alla. Naisel lühikesed helepruunid juuksed, kollakas müts peas. Vasak käsi totub tooli seljatoele, parem süles. Parem jalg sirutatud ette, vasak põlvest kõverdatud. Naisel seljas roosakaspunane nööbitav jakk, jalas pikad tumesinised puhvpüksid. Tagapool, interjööris paremal seina ääres pildid. Modelli nägu ja käed vormitud pehmelt, riietus ja foon maalitud laiade, hoogsate tõmmetega.
works.de: A young woman sitting on a chair in half-profile, her head turned towards the viewer, her gaze directed downward. The woman has short light-brown hair, a yellowish cap on her head. Her left hand rests on the back of the chair, the right in her lap. The right leg is stretched forward, the left bent at the knee. The woman wears a pinkish-red buttoned jacket, and long dark-blue puffed trousers. Behind her, in the interior on the right along the wall, pictures. The model's face and hands are modelled softly, the clothing and background painted with broad, sweeping strokes.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon siniste, roheliste, punaste ja kollaste värvidega. Kompositsiooni keskel on lilla tilga-kujuline vorm.
works.de: An abstract composition in blue, green, red and yellow colours. In the centre of the composition a purple, drop-shaped form.

works.d: Katmata paberilehel abstraktne kompositsioon rohelistes, kollastes ja punastes värvides.
works.de: An abstract composition in green, yellow and red colours on an uncovered sheet of paper.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon rohelise, roosa, oranži ja beeži värviga. Töö alumine osa koosneb juurde kleebitud paberist (circa 10 cm).
works.de: Abstract composition in green, pink, orange and beige colour. The lower part of the work consists of paper glued on (circa 10 cm).

works.d: All, esiplaanil veidi tumedat kaldariba kujutise laiuselt, mille keskel kaarjalt ülesse kasvav, peenike puutüvi. Vähese lehestikuga oksad hargnevad paremale. Taamal helesinine, sile veepind tumesinise taeva all.
works.de: Below, in the foreground, a somewhat dark strip of shore spanning the width of the image, in the middle of which a thin tree trunk grows upward in a curve. Branches with sparse foliage fork to the right. In the distance, a light blue, smooth water surface under a dark blue sky.

works.d: Tartu botaanikaaia suvine vaade. Esiplaanil kolm töötavat inimfiguuri, eemal puid ja paremal kirikutorn.
works.de: Summer view of the Tartu Botanical Garden. In the foreground three working human figures, trees in the distance and a church tower on the right.

works.d: Lõunamaine maastik kogu pildilaiust läbiva väinaga tagaplaanil. Horisondil kitsas rannapiir. Keskplaanil vasakul väike küpressisalu kolme selle seast eralduva küpressiga. Selle ees pildivälja vasakust äärest parema kuldlõikeni madal lubjatud müür. Tagaplaanil üksikud puud (pildivälja paremal poolel)
works.de: A southern landscape with a strait running through the full width of the picture in the background. On the horizon a narrow coastal strip. In the middle ground on the left, a small grove of cypresses with three cypresses standing out from among them. In front of it, from the left edge of the picture field to the right golden section, a low whitewashed wall. In the background, solitary trees (on the right half of the picture field).

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunjas kõrrepõld. Keskel õlgkatusega viltu vajunud talumajad, millest paremal ja vasakul puud.
works.de: In the foreground a brownish stubble field. In the centre thatched-roof farmhouses leaning askew, with trees on the right and left.

works.d: Ees vasakul valge riideesemega süles istuva tütarlapse põlvpilt profiilis paremale. Taustaks aknast vaade majakatusele.
works.de: In front on the left, a knee-length portrait in profile to the right of a girl sitting with a white garment in her lap. In the background, a view from the window onto a roof.

works.d: Ees vasakul tumedas riides ja peakattes naine istumas nõlvakul puu all kirikuaia müüri taga. Maali keskel tagapool terava tornikiivriga hele kirik majade ja sünge taeva taustal. Valdavalt tumedad sinkjasmustad toonid.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a woman in dark clothing and headdress sitting on a slope under a tree behind a churchyard wall. In the centre of the painting, further back, a light-coloured church with a sharp spire against a background of houses and a gloomy sky. Predominantly dark bluish-black tones.

works.d: Varemete taustal istuvad kõrvuti vaataja suunas neli täiskasvanut ja kolm last: vasakult, mustas mantlis kübaraga naine, komps kaenlas; heledas mantlis, pruuni seelikuga pearätis naine, käed süles. Keskel punase kübaraga noor naine heledas riietuses, sülelaps põlvedel; seisab tütarlaps paljajalu, mantlihõlmad lahti; poolkülgvaates mees paljapäi, toasussides, mantel õlgadel, tema taga poisikese kuju. Inimeste ees kööginõude kuhjad, topsid, kontsaking, ämber asjadega.
works.de: Against a background of ruins, four adults and three children sit side by side facing the viewer: from the left, a woman in a black coat with a hat, a bundle under her arm; a woman in a light coat, brown skirt and headscarf, hands in her lap. In the centre a young woman with a red hat in light-coloured clothing, a child in her arms on her knees; a girl stands barefoot, her coat flaps open; a man in half-profile, bareheaded, in house slippers, a coat over his shoulders, behind him the figure of a boy. In front of the people, piles of kitchen utensils, cups, a heeled shoe, a bucket with things in it.

works.d: Noore naise vööni kujutis kerges pöördes vasakule, pea veidi taha kallutatud, pikad pruunid juuksed, mis langevad õlgadele varjates käsi. Kleidi kaelus ääristatud valgega.
works.de: Waist-length depiction of a young woman in a slight turn to the left, head tilted slightly back, long brown hair falling onto the shoulders, hiding the hands. The dress collar is trimmed with white.

works.d: Halli habeme ja juustega mehe rindportree 3/4 pöördes paremale. Tumepruun pintsak.
works.de: Chest-portrait of a man with grey beard and hair, in a 3/4 turn to the right. A dark brown jacket.

works.d: Keskel tee suurte lehtpuude ja põõsaste vahel. Esiplaanil, paremal ja vasakul teest roosipõõsad. Keskplaanil sild teel, mis viib lehtlasse.
works.de: In the centre, a path among tall deciduous trees and bushes. In the foreground, rose bushes on both sides of the path. In the middle ground, a bridge on the path leading to an arbour.

works.d: Esialal vasakult paremale kulgev jõgi kaldaäärse teega. Sellel kaks töömeest jõeäärset kaitsetara parandamas. Keskel kolm ratsanikku, neist kaugemal rühm jalutajaid. Tagaalal, mõlemal pool jõge, järskudest mäenõlvadest piiratud asula.
works.de: In the foreground a river running from left to right with a road along the bank. On it two workmen repairing a protective fence along the riverbank. In the centre three horsemen, further away from them a group of walkers. In the background, on both sides of the river, a settlement bounded by steep mountain slopes.

works.d: Madalal diivanil kaks inimest istumas; paremal tumeda habemega hommikumaalane jalad ristatult ees, vasak käsi põlvedel asuval sooblil. Tema kõrval vasakul noor naine, täisprofiilis, nõjatumas mehele, käed žestikuleerivas poosis. Taustaks paremal drapeering, vasakul läbi arkaadide vaade maastikku.
works.de: Two people sitting on a low sofa; on the right an oriental man with a dark beard, legs crossed in front, left hand on a sable resting on his knees. Beside him on the left a young woman, in full profile, leaning against the man, hands in a gesturing pose. Background on the right drapery, on the left a view of a landscape through arcades.

works.dm: kõrgus: 85.0 cm (lm.); laius: 63.5 cm (arm.); kõrgus: 81.0 cm; laius: 69.0 cm (lm.)
works.d: Põskhabemes tahakammitud juustega, madala püstkraega kuues keskealise mehe poolfiguur pöördega paremale, tagaplaanil park ja paremal sammastega ja skulptuuridega maamõisa taoline hoone, tume sinakashall taevajoon.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with side-whiskers and combed-back hair, wearing a garment with a low standing collar, turned to the right, in the background a park and on the right a manor-house-like building with columns and sculptures, dark bluish-grey skyline.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 22.5 cm; kujutise laius: 31.5 cm

works.d: Tumedates toonides rannamaastik: esiplaanis paremal lookleb kiviaed, mille kohal paremal kaks puud. Vasakul kadakatega ülekülvatud rand, suur jaanituli ja inimesed tule ümber. Taamal kesköises valguses lahesopp, erksinine taevas loojuva päikese punase viiruga silmapiiril.
works.de: A coastal landscape in dark tones: in the foreground on the right winds a stone wall, above which on the right two trees. On the left a shore overgrown with junipers, a large midsummer bonfire and people around the fire. In the distance, in the midnight light, a bay, a bright blue sky with a red streak of the setting sun on the horizon.

works.d: Verevast loojuvast päikesest ülevärvitud merd meenutav abstraktne pilt. Ülaosas domineerivad oranžpunased, vasakul ja all tumesinised toonid.
works.de: An abstract picture resembling a sea overpainted by a blood-red setting sun. Orange-red tones dominate the upper part, dark blue tones on the left and at the bottom.

works.d: Keskel tumesinine, ülalt alla sööstvat lindu meenutav kujund, saba laiali, tiivanukid teravalt püsti. Linnu keha ja tiibade vahel kaks sügavat tumesinist silma. Foon linnu ümber ja allservas rohekas, ülal erksalt oranž. Linnu keha piirkonnas värvikihis kraapimisjäljed.
works.de: In the center, a dark blue shape resembling a bird diving from above, tail spread, wing tips sharply upright. Between the bird's body and wings, two deep dark blue eyes. The background around the bird and at the lower edge is greenish, bright orange above. In the area of the bird's body, scratch marks in the paint layer.

works.d: Tumerohelistes ja kollastes toonides abstraktne pilt, mille keskosas domineerib pisut upakil risti kujund. Töö servad vasakul, all ja paremal tumerohelised. Maalitud väikeste pastoossete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: An abstract picture in dark green and yellow tones, in the central part of which a slightly tilted cross-shaped figure dominates. The edges of the work on the left, bottom and right are dark green. Painted with small pastose brushstrokes.

works.d: Keskel tumesinistes toonides lindu meenutav kujund, teravate tiivanukkidega. Tiivakaartes kaks suurt tumesinist silma. Linnufiguuri värvikihti on tõmmatud risti-rästi kriipsud maalipinna elavdamiseks. Foon pildi servades ja linnu ümber roheline, ülejäänud pildi pinnal oranž.
works.de: In the centre a bird-like figure in dark blue tones, with sharp wing-tips. Two large dark blue eyes in the curve of the wings. Crisscrossing lines have been drawn over the paint layer of the bird figure to enliven the painted surface. The background at the edges of the picture and around the bird is green, the rest of the picture's surface orange.

works.d: Suurte tumedate mandlisilmadega, poolpikkade juustega noore naise portree. Nina ja õlad kontuurjoonega markeeritud, juuksed tumesinisega toonitatud, foon kaela piirkonnas punane. Joonistatud ookerkollasele paberile.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman with large dark almond-shaped eyes, medium-length hair. The nose and shoulders marked with contour lines, hair tinted with dark blue, background in the neck area red. Drawn on ochre-yellow paper.

works.d: Tumesinise öise taeva foonil oranžilt tuledes kumavad pilvelõhkujate siluetid ja ähmaselt aimatav öine tänav esiplaanil.
works.de: Against the background of a dark blue night sky, the silhouettes of skyscrapers glow orange with lights, and a dimly discernible night street in the foreground.

works.d: Maalil kahel pool kulissidetaolised tumedad geomeetrilised pinnad, nende vahel helendub kollakas ruum. Valdavalt kollased, oranžid, sinised toonid, kontuure hajutav maaliline kujutamisviis.
works.de: In the painting, on both sides dark geometrical planes resembling coulisses, between them a yellowish space glows. Predominantly yellow, orange, blue tones, a painterly manner of depiction that diffuses contours.

works.d: Mustjast taustast joonistuvad välja kolm kõrvutiasetsevat oranžikaspunast pead, silmad, suud mustaga markeeritud. Tinglik, kontuure hajutav maaliline kujutamisviis.
works.de: Three orange-red heads placed side by side stand out against a blackish background, eyes and mouths marked in black. A conventional, painterly manner of depiction that diffuses contours.

works.d: Hämaras interjööris paremal neli naist, keskel istuv ja kaks žestikuleerivat meest, vasakul kaks seisvat ja üks põlvitav mees. Seinal ripuvad relvad, paremal ikoon, vasakul aknaava.
works.de: In a dim interior, on the right four women, in the middle a seated man and two gesturing men, on the left two standing men and one kneeling man. Weapons hang on the wall, on the right an icon, on the left a window opening.

works.d: Šatään-juustega, põskhabemega tumedas ülikonnas keskealise mehe rinnapilt. Kuu revääri küljes ordenipael.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with chestnut hair and side-whiskers, in a dark suit. A decoration ribbon on the moon lapel.

works.d: Pingil istuva noore mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis vasakule; ohvitseri mundris. Paremas kinnastatud käes vasaku käe kinnas. Vasak käsivars toetatud pingi külgtoele, sõrmede vahel müts. Taustaks maastik.
Pea ligi, keskelt lahku kammitud juustega tütarlapse poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Close-up half-figure of a girl with hair parted in the middle, in half-profile to the left.

works.d: Keskel Kristus risti kandmas, vasemal kaks meest, paremal kolm naist.
works.de: Christ carrying the cross in the centre, two men on the left, three women on the right.

works.dm: lehe laius: 24.0 cm (lehemõõt); lehe kõrgus: 33.3 cm
works.d: Maani valges kleidis, peas pika seljale langeva looriga peegli ees sisva noore naise põlvpilt, profiilis paremale. Taustaks pruunikas draperii. Vasakul avatud aknast vaade merele.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman in a floor-length white dress, with a long veil falling down her back, dreaming in front of a mirror, in profile to the right. Background a brownish drapery. On the left, from an open window, a view of the sea.

works.d: Vasakul tumedajuukselise tütarlapse poolfiguur punases pluusis, enface, paremal mees profiilis vasakule, teda kergelt tõrjuvat tütarlast põsele suudlemas.
works.de: On the left a half-figure of a dark-haired girl in a red blouse, en face, on the right a man in profile to the left, kissing on the cheek the girl who is lightly resisting him.

works.d: Esiplaanil naise täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas pikk sügavpunane seelik ja valge pluus (itaallanna rahvusrõivais). Ületõstetud kätel laps. Vasemal pingikese kõrval tamburiin. Taustaks maastik, paremal müüriosa.
works.de: In the foreground the full figure of a woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a long deep red skirt and a white blouse (in Italian national costume). A child in her raised arms. On the left next to a small bench a tambourine. Background a landscape, on the right a section of a wall.

works.d: Valge kollakate lontis kõrvadega kollase rinnaesisega koer lamamas punasel padjal.
works.de: A white dog with yellowish floppy ears and a yellow chest, lying on a red pillow.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel lagunenud tara, vasakul loigu ääres seisev naine kõhule asetatud kätega. Keskplaanil jõgi. Jõe parempoolsel kaldal hanekari. Nende taga võsastik. Taamal üle jõe puud. Horisondil mets. Taevas pilves.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle a dilapidated fence, on the left a woman standing by a puddle with her hands placed on her stomach. In the middle ground a river. On the right bank of the river a flock of geese. Behind them scrub. Beyond, trees across the river. On the horizon a forest. Cloudy sky.

works.t: Juliane Charlotte Elisabeth von Moelleri portree
works.d: Vanema täidlase naise rindportree. Peas must tanu, seljas must kleit valge krae ja värvilise kinnitus-nõelaga. Taustaks punane drapeering, mille taga vasakul maastikupilt.
works.de: Bust portrait of an elderly stout woman. A black bonnet on the head, wearing a black dress with a white collar and a coloured fastening pin. Background of red drapery, behind which on the left a landscape picture.

works.d: Ovaalne kompositsioon. Paremal profiilis lokkis juustega noormees, kes hoiab oma käte vahel punases kleidis tütarlast suudeldes teda põsele. Tütarlapse otsevaates pea kallutatud vasakule. Kujutatud antud poolfiguuridena.
works.de: An oval composition. On the right, in profile, a curly-haired young man holding a girl in a red dress between his arms, kissing her on the cheek. The girl's head, seen frontally, is tilted to the left. Depicted as half-figures.

works.d: Väänlevate okstega viigipuude juures istub, keha toetatud paremale käele, valges särgis ning lühikestes pükstes, punase mütsiga noormees. Taamal, silmapiiril sinine merelaht ja mäed.
works.de: By fig trees with twisting branches sits a young man, body resting on his right hand, wearing a white shirt and short trousers, with a red cap. In the distance, on the horizon, a blue sea bay and mountains.

works.d: Mägede foonil terrass, kus vasakul istuvad naine, mees, nende ees laps. Paremal seisab selgvaates naine ja laps. Maal poolik, toonitud vasakpoolne alumine osa.
works.de: Terrace against a background of mountains, where on the left a woman and a man are sitting, with a child in front of them. On the right a woman and a child stand in clear view. The painting is unfinished, the lower left part is toned.

works.dm: lehe laius: 35.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.8 cm
works.d: Mägine maastik kaljuastanguga vasakul. Tagapool ja paremal puud ja kidur taimestik. Maalitud siledalt tumedais pruunides, hallides toonides.
works.de: A mountainous landscape with a rock ledge on the left. Behind and on the right trees and sparse vegetation. Painted smoothly in dark brown and gray tones.

works.dm: lehe laius: 53.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 37.5 cm
works.d: Paremal nõlvakul vanad keerduvate tüvedega lehtpuud, vasakul üksikud puud-põõsad. Taamal lage maastik mägedega silmapiiril. Maal detailitäpne, hallikaspruun, rohekas koloriit.
Kaks visandit Itaalia rahvariietes naistest. Vasakul naise pea valges peakattes. Paremal lillega naise poolfiguur rohelisel foonil.
works.de: Two sketches of women in Italian folk costume. On the left the woman's head in a white headdress. On the right a half-figure of a woman with a flower against a green background.

works.d: Esiplaanil rand, paremal inimeste gruppe, taamal lainetav meri kahe purjekaga.
works.de: In the foreground a beach, on the right groups of people, in the distance a rippling sea with two sailboats.

works.d: Ees paremal puud, vasakul ja taamal vesi ning kõrged mäed.
works.de: Trees in front on the right, water and high mountains on the left and in the distance.

works.dm: lehe laius: 18.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 12.2 cm
works.d: Ees (ca pool kogu tööst) vesi (kanal). Paremal paadisilla nurk. Kanalil paate. Vastaskaldal üksikud hooned, aiad, puud.
works.de: In front (about half of the whole work) water (a canal). On the right, the corner of a boat pier. Boats on the canal. On the opposite bank, single buildings, gardens, trees.

works.d: Meri purjekaga, vasemal ees liivane rannariba, taga rannaviir.
works.de: Sea with a sailing boat, sandy strip of beach in front on the left, shoreline behind.

works.d: Kaluri täisfiguur rannaliival külgvaates paremale. Hoiab õlal püügiriista. Taamal meri. Selge taevas.
works.de: Full figure of a fisherman on the beach sand, in side view to the right. Holding a fishing tool on his shoulder. Sea in the distance. Clear sky.

works.d: Vanema mehe põlvportree istuvas asendis, kerges pöördes paremale. Paljas pealagi, hallid juuksed, vurrud ja habe. Ninal sangadega prillid. Parem käsi püksitaskus, vasakus pabeross. Seljas must kuub. Kuue alt pruuni vesti pääl kuldkett vimpliga. Taustaks roheline sein, millel ripub kolm maali.
works.de: A knee-length portrait of an elderly man in a seated position, in a slight turn to the right. Bare crown of the head, grey hair, moustache and beard. Glasses with temples on the nose. Right hand in trouser pocket, in the left a cigarette. He wears a black coat. Under the coat, over a brown waistcoat, a gold chain with a pendant. The background a green wall on which three paintings hang.

works.d: Maali keskosas ülalt alla suunduv kivine veenire, millest kaldad nõlvakuna üles kerkivad. Vasakul puudesalu, mis ulatub maali ülaservani. Kauguses mäed.
works.de: In the central part of the painting a rocky watercourse running from top to bottom, from which the banks rise as slopes. On the left a grove reaching to the top edge of the painting. Mountains in the distance.

works.d: Mägede astangul paremal astmeliselt asetsevad hooned. Vasakul järsak, taamal lamedad mäed, silmapiir kõrge. Maal hallikasbeežides toonides.
works.de: On a mountain terrace, buildings arranged in tiers on the right. On the left a precipice, in the distance flat mountains, a high horizon. The painting is in greyish-beige tones.

works.dm: lehe laius: 61.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 80.0 cm
works.d: Kerge pöördega vasakule, vasaku käega laua nurgale, paremaga põlvele toetuv, istuv, mehe poolfiguur, põskhabemes, taha kammitud kõrgete juustega, pikas kaherealises kuues.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated man with a slight turn to the left, left hand resting on the corner of the table, right hand on the knee, with sideburns, hair combed back high, wearing a long double-breasted coat.

works.d: Esialal vasakul mere äärest kerkiv paekallas, mille platool leht- ja okaspuude rühmi ning jalutavaid ja puhkavaid ning lõkketule ümber askeldavaid inimfiguure gruppides. Paekalda all vasakul meri, keskel ja paremal madal maastik puudesaludega. Horisondil Tallinna siluett kaugvaates lääne poolt. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a limestone bank rising from the seashore, on whose plateau groups of deciduous and coniferous trees and figures of walking and resting people, and people busying themselves around a bonfire, in groups. Below the limestone bank on the left the sea, in the centre and on the right a low landscape with groves of trees. On the horizon the silhouette of Tallinn in a distant view from the west. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Tervet pinda kattev sürrealistlik inimfiguur-monstrum jooksvas asendis, kuldsete küüntega kämmalde vahel-süles nokk-peaga elukas. Kujundid üksteisest läbi põimunud, osaliselt välja lõigatud ja kleebitud. Taust ülalt sinine laine motiividega.
works.de: A surrealistic human-figure monster covering the entire surface, in a running position, with a beak-headed creature between/on its palms with golden claws. The shapes interwoven with one another, partially cut out and glued on. Background above with blue wave motifs.

works.d: Vanema hallijuukselise daami rinnapilt poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule, helesinises pitsrinna kaunistusega kleidis.
works.de: Bust portrait of an elderly grey-haired lady in half-profile turned to the left, wearing a light blue dress with lace trim on the bodice.

works.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur peaaegu otsevaates. Lahku kammitud mustad juuksed, peas must tanu. Tumepruun kleit valge krae ja kätistega. Käed kõhul risti.
works.de: Half-length figure of an older woman, almost in a frontal view. Black hair combed apart, a black bonnet on her head. Dark brown dress with a white collar and cuffs. Hands crossed on her stomach.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kõrge merekallas lahesoppide ja üksiku männiga, keskel üle järsaku suvilahooned rohelises, paremal puude all lõkketuli lõbutseva seltskonnaga, taeva foonil Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a high sea bank with bay inlets and a solitary pine, in the middle summer cottage buildings above the cliff amid greenery, on the right a bonfire under trees with a merry company, against the sky the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Kahel pool lillakaspruunid talvised puud, lumine nõlvak keskel. Nõlvaku kohal eresinine taevas. Maalitud hoogsalt, kohati väga pastoosselt.
works.de: On both sides, purplish-brown winter trees, a snowy slope in the centre. Above the slope, a bright blue sky. Painted vigorously, in places very impasto.

works.d: Õrnades, murtud toonides maalitud lumise provintsilinna tänavaristmik. Vasemast alumisest nurgast parema ääre alumise kuldlõikeni (kõrguse suhtes) kulgev lumine, lai kaldapealne. Esiplaanil vasakul kummulikeeratud (vaatajapoolsem - õigetpidi) mustad paadid. Esiplaanil paremal fragment kummulikeeratud paadist ning katkend madalast, puust kaitsebarjäärist. Tänavaga paralleelselt, tagaplaanil, ebakorrapäraselt paigutatud rohekad ja hallikaspruunid ühe- ja kahekorruselised majad. Vasakul erkrohelisem mansardkorrusega maja, selle kõrval, vasakul äärel, akendeta roosakaspruun kõrgem kivihoone. Hallikasroheline tumenev taevas.
works.de: A street crossing of a snowy provincial town, painted in delicate, broken tones. From the lower left corner to the golden section point near the bottom of the right edge (in relation to the height) runs a snowy, wide embankment. In the foreground on the left, overturned black boats (the one closer to the viewer right side up). In the foreground on the right, a fragment of an overturned boat and a section of a low wooden protective barrier. Parallel to the street, in the background, irregularly placed greenish and greyish-brown one- and two-storey houses. On the left, a brighter green house with a mansard storey; next to it, at the left edge, a windowless pinkish-brown taller stone building. A greyish-green, darkening sky.

works.d: Läbipaistvalt maalitud ookertoonis tausta keskel vaataja suunas istuv naisakt, vasak jalg kõverdatult ees. Parem käsi toetub alusele, vasak rippu süles. Ülakeha kohal, sellest kasvab välja avatud tiibadega, inimsilmadega linnu kujutis. Hõbedasel pinnal mustjate, roosakaspunaste, kollaste pintslitõmmetega jälgitud vormid. Maalil ees all lamav kägarasendis figuur musta joonega markeeritud.
works.de: A composition painted transparently against an ochre-toned background, in the centre a female nude sitting facing the viewer, her left leg bent in front. Her right hand rests on a base, her left hand hangs in her lap. Above the upper body, growing out of it, a depiction of a bird with open wings and human eyes. On a silvery surface, forms traced with blackish, pinkish-red, yellow brushstrokes. In the painting, at the front bottom, a curled-up reclining figure marked with a black line.

works.d: Kollasel taustal visandlikult maalitud kolm istuvas asendis naisakti. Vasakpoolne ja keskmine istumas parema küljega vaataja poole. Vasakpoolse naise pea on pöördes parema õla suunas, pilk vaatab alla. Naise pea ja käed toetuvad vasakule kõverdatud põlvele, parem jalg madalamal. Keskmine figuur kõige visandlikumalt maalitud. Kuju mõlemad jalad on tõmmatud lõua alla konksu. Parempoolne naine on pigem püstises asendis, vaatega pildi keskplaani suunas. Värvigammalt on maal kollane, tooni annavad mustad kontuurid ning punased, rohekad, mustad värvikontrastid.
works.de: On a yellow background, three seated female nudes painted in a sketchy manner. The left and middle figures are sitting with their right side towards the viewer. The head of the left-hand woman is turned towards her right shoulder, her gaze looking down. The woman's head and hands rest on her left bent knee, her right leg lower. The middle figure is painted in the most sketchy manner. Both of its legs are drawn up hooked under the chin. The woman on the right is in a more upright position, with her gaze directed towards the middle ground of the picture. In terms of colour scheme the painting is yellow, with black contours providing the tone, and red, greenish and black colour contrasts.

works.d: Abstraktne värvilaikudest ja peene musta kontuuriga ümbritsetud kujunditest konstrueeritud värviline kompositsioon, mille keskel diagonaalselt suurem hele pind kirjaga "Vita nostra brevis est". Domineerivad roosad ja tumepunased toonid. Servadest lõuend värviga napilt kaetud.
works.de: An abstract, coloured composition constructed of patches of colour and shapes surrounded by a fine black outline, in the middle of which a larger light surface placed diagonally bears the inscription "Vita nostra brevis est". Pink and dark red tones dominate. The canvas is sparsely covered with paint at the edges.

works.d: Mitmevärvilistest laikudest abstraktne kompisitsioon raskuspunktiga vertikaalsest keskjoonest paremal. Helesinine foon.
works.de: An abstract composition of multicoloured patches with the centre of gravity to the right of the vertical centre line. Light blue background.

works.d: Kirevatest nelinurkadest komponeeritud foonil sinine kauss kaladega, mille ees kalad. Vasakul kolm suurt kala diagonaalselt ülespoole suunatud peadega. Keskel, kaladest pisut kõrgemal valge kann. Fooni plemistes ruutudes vertikaalselt paigutatud kalad. Väga pastoosne, kohati reljeefina mõjuv värvikiht.
works.de: On a background composed of colourful quadrangles, a blue bowl with fish, in front of which are fish. On the left, three large fish with heads pointing diagonally upward. In the centre, slightly higher than the fish, a white jug. In the flattened squares of the background, fish arranged vertically. Very impasto, in places relief-like, paint layer.

Height of figurines 21.5 cm; width 9.5 cm, depth 7 cm. The figurines are placed on a base covered with burgundy-red synthetic plush fabric. The base with the figurines is covered with a plexiglass dome measuring 80x80 x h 70 cm. The entire composition is surrounded by a barrier formed of four brass-toned metal posts and four barrier ropes covered with red plush. A red silk ribbon is tied around the figures.

works.d: Viiest osast koosnev figuuride grupp, mis jäljendab ruumiliselt Eduard Ole maali "Reisijad". Maali otseselt järgiv pool koosneb kahest osast ning kujutabneljafiguurilist, kolmest mehest ja ühest naisest koosnevat istuvate figuuride gruppi, täpsemalt on välja modelleeritud vaid parempoolne mees, ülejäänud figuurid on maalitud pronksi pinnale, eraldi osana on põlv vasaku käe laba ja kübaraga. Neljale figuurile toetuv osa (nagu reisijad rongis, seljad vastamisi) koosneb kolmest eraldi detailist, kujutades meest ja naisi istumas, neist üks naine ja mees on ruumiliselt modelleeritud, lameda modelleerimata näoga naise käes on plaat, mis kujutab E. Ole maali koopiat
works.de: A group of figures consisting of five parts, spatially imitating Eduard Ole's painting "Reisijad". The side directly following the painting consists of two parts and depicts a group of four seated figures, three men and one woman; only the man on the right is fully modelled in the round, the remaining figures are painted onto the bronze surface, with the knee, the left hand and the hat formed as a separate part. The part supporting the four figures (like passengers on a train, backs facing each other) consists of three separate details, depicting a man and women sitting; of these, one woman and the man are modelled in space, while the flat, unmodelled-faced woman holds a plate depicting a copy of E. Ole's painting.

works.d: Kineetiline objekt "Oranž torn II" koosneb tornikujulisest ülespoole järguliselt ahenevast korpusest ja selle kohal paiknevast messingtorust. Korpus kasvab välja 32 cm diameetriga ringjalt aluselt, millele toetub risttahukas mõõtmeteha: h 83,5x19,5x19,5 cm.Sellel omakorda risttahukas mõõtmetega : h 58x7x7 cm, mille  esiküljel kolm võimendit (alumine neist ka valjuhääldaja). Selle risttahuka otsas asub kuubikujuline osa valjuhääldajaga esiküljel. Kuubi külgede pikkus 13,5 cm. Kuubi kohal asub 13,5 cm läbimõõduga ketas, millet väljub üles suunduv poleeritud messingtoru,mille esiküljel põleb 20 lambikest (taskulambi pirnid).
works.de: The kinetic object "Oranž torn II" ["Orange Tower II"] consists of a tower-shaped body that tapers upward in stages and a brass tube positioned above it. The body grows out of a round base with a diameter of 32 cm, on which rests a rectangular block with dimensions h 83.5x19.5x19.5 cm. On top of this, in turn, is a rectangular block with dimensions h 58x7x7 cm, on the front of which are three amplifiers (the lower one also being a loudspeaker). At the top of this block is a cube-shaped part with a loudspeaker on its front. The sides of the cube are 13.5 cm long. Above the cube is a disc with a diameter of 13.5 cm, out of which emerges an upward-directed polished brass tube, on the front of which 20 small bulbs (flashlight bulbs) are lit.

Installatsioon 30 elektrilambiga ümbritsetud lilla sametiga vooderdatud vaatekastis. Vaatekast asetseb jalgadega puidust  raamil. Kastis lamaskleb patjadele toetudes sea keha ja jalgadega naisetaoliseks tuunitud näoga figuur. Tal on rohekad klaassilmad ja seakärss on kujundatud naisesuuks ning ninasõõrmeteks. Lühike seelik ja nööbitud kitsas kampsun, kurgu all seos, lokkis juustel madal ümmargune mütsike. The upper body together with the leg stretched back is cast as a separate part, which is attached to the leg resting on the lower oval base with a metal dowel.

Figuuride aluspind on kergelt kaldu kõrgendik. Kompositsioon on toneeritud.
works.de: Two male figures on a base, one of them, taller, has raised his right hand with a large palm upward, his left hand falling to the side, dressed in a work blouse with rolled-up sleeves, wearing long trousers and robust footwear. The other, shorter, bearded figure is dressed in a jacket and fig-leaf trousers [viigipüksid], is in a crouching position, stepping in the opposite direction from the worker, left leg bent at the knee, making a "hand-striking" gesture with the right hand. The base surface of the figures is a slightly sloping elevation. The composition is toned.

works.d: Teos koosneb neljast osast. 1. Keskmisne osa kujutab endast valget püstjat risttahukat, mille ülaosas asub vana naise kortsudest küntud portreepea, esikülg kaldpinnana ettepoole, selle all ette välja ulatuv avatud sahtel (kõik terviklikult valatud ja läikiv-valgeks värvitud).2. Sahtli põhjal asub laste mänguasi, yrori poolt musta-valgekirjuks maalitud plastikust  lehmake. 3.-4. Kahel pool portreepeaga keskmist osa asuvad lahtiselt stiliseeritud piimamannergu pooled, mille kumerad välisosad on värvitud alumiiniumvärviga.
works.de: The work consists of four parts. 1. The middle part is a white upright cuboid, at the top of which is a portrait head of an old woman furrowed with wrinkles, its front side sloping forward, below it an open drawer protruding forward (all cast as a whole and painted glossy white). 2. On the bottom of the drawer is a child's toy — a plastic cow painted black-and-white by yrori. 3.–4. On either side of the middle part with the portrait head are loosely stylised halves of a milk churn, whose convex outer parts are painted with aluminium paint.

The hairless head is covered up to the eyebrows with a greyish-white wrap ending in a protruding knot at the crown.

works.d: Näha neli mensuuri laste loodetega, viies, vasakus servas näha poolikuna. Paremalt esimene anum on kõige madalam. Selles kokkusurutud lapse loode. Selle kõrval teine, veidi kõrgem anum, milles terve loode nähtav. Kolmandas, veel suuremas nõus olevale lootele on tehtud kõhu piirkonda neljakandiline sisselõige, mis toob nähtavale siseelundid. Käed ja jalad on köndistatud. Vasakpoolseim on kõige kõrgem anum. Selles olevale lootele on sisselõige tehtud keha alapiirkonda.
works.de: Four mensurae with foetuses of children can be seen, a fifth, in the left edge, can be seen partially. The first vessel from the right is the lowest. It contains a contracted foetus of a child. Next to it, a second, slightly taller vessel, in which a whole foetus is visible. In the third, even larger vessel, the foetus has a square incision made in the abdominal area, revealing the internal organs. The arms and legs are truncated. The leftmost is the tallest vessel. The foetus in it has an incision made in the lower part of the body.

At the bottom of the photo, two rubber boots facing each other. In the right corner, a small child peeks out. In the background, forest.

works.dm: kõrgus: 17.0 cm (vm); laius: 38.4 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.0 cm (vm)
works.d: Kahe mehe rinnaportree. Taga vasakul aken, paremal sein. Ees paremal aimatav terjerilaadse koera pea. Vasakpoolne kiilas mees on otsevaates. Kannab hallikat mantlit, tumedat triibulist pintsakut ning valget särki. Aknast tulev valgus langeb vasakule näopoolele, jättes parema poole varuju. Parempoolne tumedas rõivastuses mees on kerges pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud aknast välja.
works.de: Bust portrait of two men. Behind, on the left a window, on the right a wall. In front on the right, the barely discernible head of a terrier-like dog can be made out. The bald man on the left is shown frontally. He wears a greyish coat, a dark striped jacket, and a white shirt. The light coming from the window falls on the left side of his face, leaving the right side in shadow. The man on the right, dressed in dark clothing, is in a slight turn to the left, his gaze directed out of the window.

works.dm: kõrgus: 16.9 cm; laius: 38.4 cm; kõrgus: 29.4 cm; laius: 23.0 cm
works.d: Pankrannikut meenutaval kaldapealsel lebav naine toetub vasakule küünarvarrele, parem käsi süles. Seljas tume kostüüm, valge pluus, kaelas heledad pärlid. Juuksed on tuulesasised. Vasakul ja keskosas aimatav suurem veekogu, taamal näha silmapiiril kaldajoont.
works.de: A woman lying on a cliff-like shore, resting on her left forearm, right hand in her lap. Wearing a dark costume, a white blouse, light pearls at the neck. Hair windswept. On the left and in the middle part a larger body of water can be discerned, in the distance a shoreline visible on the horizon.

works.dm: kõrgus: 17.4 cm (vm); laius: 38.4 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.3 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.4 cm (vm)
works.d: Must-valge foto, mille vasak serv on veidi põletatud. Fotol lage väli kahara tammega. Esiplaanil all keskel seisab poolprofiilis naine pea pöördes vasakule. Naisel on seljas triibuline seelik ja valge pikkade varrukatega pluus. Ehitud mitme preesi ja kaelaehtega.
works.de: Black-and-white photograph, its left edge slightly burnt. In the photo an open field with a spreading oak. In the foreground below in the centre stands a woman in half-profile, head turned to the left. The woman wears a striped skirt and a white blouse with long sleeves. Adorned with several brooches and a necklace.

works.t: Maalikunstnik Imat Suumann, muusik Sass Müller, muusik InBoil
works.dm: laius: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 38.3 cm (raami mõõt)
works.d: Kaks fotot ühes raamis. FV 43/1 Ülemine foto. Paarisfotod kolmest alasti mehest ja ühest naisest interjööris.Vasakus servas istub jalg üle põlve käsi põsakil ning vasakus käes ajakirja hoidev tumedapealine alasti mees. Tema kõrval seisab, kes parema käega toetub riidega kaetud alusele, millel on kaalud. Veidi eespool paremal istub tugitoolil naine, ülakeha kerges pöördes vasakule. Pea on profiilis, peas tume kähar parukas, ees tumedad päikeseprillid, süles hoiab karpi kaaluvihtidega. Naise taga paremal seisab mees, käed selja taga, pilk suunatud diagonaalselt alla - naise suunas.
works.de: Two photographs in one frame. FV 43/1 Upper photograph. Paired photographs of three naked men and one woman in an interior. On the left edge sits a dark-haired naked man, leg crossed over the knee, hand on his cheek, holding a magazine in his left hand. Beside him stands one who leans with his right hand on a cloth-covered stand holding scales. A little further forward on the right sits a woman in an armchair, her upper body turned slightly to the left. Her head is in profile, wearing a dark curly wig, dark sunglasses in front, holding a box with weights in her lap. Behind the woman on the right stands a man, hands behind his back, gaze directed diagonally downward - towards the woman.

works.dm: kõrgus: 16.5 cm (vm); laius: 38.2 cm; kõrgus: 29.4 cm; laius: 22.7 cm
works.d: Luksuslikus interjööris istub tumedas ülikonnas lühikese tumeda habeme ning vuntsidega mees. Paremale poole jääb mustrilise linaga kaetud ümmargune laud, millel seisab kinnine pudel vahuveini ja pikk klaasist vaas ühe roosiga. Mehe parem käsi toetub lauale, vasak on põlvel. Pintsaku all on hele särk ning tume lips lipsunõelaga. Mehe selja taga seisab suur pommidega kell. Paremale ja vasakule jäävad kaks suurt peeglit, milledest on aimatavalt näha ülejäänud ruumi. Parempoolse peegli ees põleb väike valge laualamp.
works.de: In a luxurious interior sits a man in a dark suit with a short dark beard and moustache. To the right is a round table covered with a patterned cloth, on which stands a closed bottle of sparkling wine and a tall glass vase with a single rose. The man's right hand rests on the table, his left on his knee. Under his jacket is a light shirt and a dark tie with a tie pin. Behind the man stands a large pendulum clock. Two large mirrors are on the right and left, in which the rest of the room can be dimly seen. In front of the right-hand mirror a small white table lamp is burning.

works.dm: laius: 38.3 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt)
works.d: Kaks kõrvutiasetsevat fotot ühes raamis. FV 45/1 Siseruum  kahe tooli, kardinate ja väikese raamatukapiga. Foto paremas nurgas on näha laual lillelist lina ning taamal diivaninurka. Foto keskel istub mees. Mehel seljas kirju kampsun, jalas sinakad teksapüksid, heledad sokid ning auguga sussid. Otsevaates mehe käed nõjatuvad tooli käetugedele ning peod on süles. Ülaosas on kirjutatud "Hästikirjutaja Hasso Krull aegunud Ameerika plastpaberil" ning signatuur. FV 45/2 Vasakpoolsel fotol sama interjöör. Ühe tooli asemel valge kolme jalaga taburet, rohkem näha diivanit ning selle kohal olevat pilti. Foto keskel istub mees samas asendis, mis eelmiselgi, seljas roosa kleit, kaelas pärlid, süles hoia
works.de: Two photographs side by side in one frame. FV 45/1 An interior with two chairs, curtains and a small bookcase. In the right corner of the photo a floral cloth is visible on a table and a corner of a sofa can be seen in the background. A man sits in the middle of the photo. The man is wearing a patterned sweater, bluish jeans, light socks and slippers with a hole. Facing forward, the man's hands rest on the armrests of the chair with his palms in his lap. At the top is written "Hästikirjutaja Hasso Krull aegunud Ameerika plastpaberil" and a signature. FV 45/2 The same interior in the left-hand photo. Instead of one chair there is a white three-legged stool, more of the sofa is visible along with the picture above it. A man sits in the middle of the photo in the same pose as in the previous one, wearing a pink dress, pearls around his neck, holding something in his lap

works.d: Interjööris istub prillidega mees. Taustal paremal pool lainelise mustriga kardin, vasakul maale täisriputatud sein. Foto keskel istub tugitoolis hallipäine, heleda särgi ja tumeda vestiga mees,  pea pöördes paremale. Parem käsi toetab lõuga, vasak põlvel. Toa põrandal kaks triibulist kaltsuvaipa, millede peal segipaisatud kortsus ja sirgeid paberilehti. Paremas servas serveerimislaud, millel paberid, tass, klaaskauss jm. esemed. Mehest vasakul väikese tabureti peal suur must kirjutusmasin.
works.de: In an interior sits a man with glasses. In the background on the right a curtain with a wavy pattern, on the left a wall completely covered with paintings. In the centre of the photo sits a grey-haired man in an armchair, wearing a light shirt and dark waistcoat, his head turned to the right. His right hand supports his chin, left hand on his knee. On the floor of the room two striped rag rugs, on which scattered crumpled and straight sheets of paper are lying. On the right edge a serving table with papers, a cup, a glass bowl and other objects. To the left of the man, on a small stool, a large black typewriter.

works.dm: kõrgus: 15.0 cm (vm); laius: 26.1 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 31.2 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 13.7 cm (vm)
works.d: Esiplaanil seisab tumedas ülikonnas kikilipsuga mees otsevaates. Mehe vasak käsi on taskus, parem jalg toetub kastile. Kastil diagonaalselt tekst: Gladiator. Tagapool seisab toa nurgas tumedas rõivais tumedapäine naine. Tuba kaetud lillelise tapeediga, põrand hele.
works.de: In the foreground stands a man in a dark suit with a bow tie, frontal view. The man's left hand is in his pocket, right foot resting on a crate. On the crate diagonally the text: Gladiator. Behind, in the corner of the room, stands a dark-haired woman in dark clothing. The room is covered with floral wallpaper, the floor is light.

works.t: DeStudio fotograafid Herkki E. Merila ja Peeter M. Laurits koos modellidega
works.dm: kõrgus: 17.4 cm (vm); laius: 38.2 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 22.2 cm (vm)
works.d: Fotoateljee interjööris väikesel mustal diivanil istuvad kaks blondi pikajuukselist naist, parempoolsel seljas sinine kleit, jalas mustad kõrgete kontsadega kingad. Tüdruku käed on süles. Vasakpoolsel on seljas kollane kleit, neiu istub jalg üle põlve, jalas mustad nöörsaapad, ühe käega hoiab laubal päikeseprille, teine käsi on süles. Diagonaalselt nõjatub diivanile roosakates pükstes, täpilise särgi, triibulise lipsu ja hallika kaabuga prillidega mees. Paremal pool naisi seisab teine mees. Tema hoiab ülestõstetud käes valgustit, rõivastunud musta, traksid kollakas-rohekad. Mees seisab profiilis pea otsevaates.
works.de: In the interior of a photography studio, two blonde, long-haired women sit on a small black sofa; the one on the right is wearing a blue dress and black high-heeled shoes. The girl's hands are in her lap. The one on the left is wearing a yellow dress, the young woman sits with one leg crossed over the other, wearing black lace-up boots, with one hand holding sunglasses at her forehead, the other hand in her lap. Leaning diagonally on the sofa is a man in pinkish trousers, a spotted shirt, a striped tie and a greyish hat, wearing glasses. To the right of the women stands a second man. He holds a light raised in his hand, dressed in black, with yellowish-greenish suspenders. The man stands in profile with his head facing front.

works.d: Vertikaalasendis käed toetuvad alusele. Vasaku käe sõrmed kõverdatud, parema neljas ja viies sõrm sirgelt, paremale suunatud ülejäänud näpud kõverdatud. Pöial puudutab käe sõrmi. Taust hele.
works.de: Hands resting on a base in a vertical position. Fingers of the left hand bent, the fourth and fifth fingers of the right hand straight, the other fingers, pointing to the right, bent. The thumb touches the fingers of the hand. Light background.

works.d: Kaks soonilist jalalaba. Parempoolsel pöid ja varbad kõverdatud. Taust sinakas ja hele.
works.de: Two veined feet. On the right foot the instep and toes are bent. Background bluish and light.

works.d: Istuv meesakt selgvaates. Vasak käsi sirgelt kõrvale sirutatud, parem diagonaalselt all, sõrmedega toetumas aluspinnale. Pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud ja püsti, parem kõverdatult horisontaalis. Taust valge.
works.de: Seated male nude, seen frontally. The left arm stretched straight out to the side, the right diagonally down, with fingers resting on the base surface. The head slightly turned to the left. The left leg bent at the knee and upright, the right bent horizontally. White background.

works.d: Istuv meesakt selgvaates. Vasak käsi kõverdatud ja toetub põlvele, parem käsi diagonaalis paremale toetub väljasirutatud sõrmedele. Pea rinnal. Taust hele.
works.de: Sitting male nude in back view. Left hand bent and resting on the knee, right hand resting diagonally to the right on outstretched fingers. Head on the chest. Background light.

works.d: Kaks põlvitavat meesakti, kehad taha kallutatud, üks käsi toetub maha, teine tõstetud kuklale. Taust tume.
works.de: Two kneeling male nudes, bodies leaning backward, one hand resting on the ground, the other raised to the back of the neck. Dark background.

works.d: Kaks põlvitavat meesakti, kehad kallutatud kõrvale. Mõlemil üks käsi kuklal, teisega toetuvad maha. Jalapöiad on kõverdatud. Taust tume.
works.de: Two kneeling male nudes, bodies tilted to the side. Each has one hand on the back of the neck, supporting themselves on the ground with the other. Their feet are bent. Background dark.

works.d: Pilvine taevavaade, all ääres ribana võsaga kaetud maastik. Taevas keskel veidi paremal lendab lennuk. Foto keskosas õhupüssi kuulidega tulistamisest tekkinud augukesed. Pinna sisse jäänud kolm tinakuulikest.
works.de: Cloudy sky view, at the bottom edge a strip of landscape covered with scrub. In the middle of the sky, slightly to the right, an airplane is flying. In the central part of the photo there are small holes made by air rifle pellets. Three tiny lead pellets remain embedded in the surface.

works.d: Foto keskjoonest veidi vasakul seisab nõukogude armee vormis sõdur. Paremas käes õla kõrgusel hoiab püstolit. Vasak käsi sirgelt kõrval. Figuur on otsevaates, jalad veidi harkis. Taustal rohumaa, mille taga metsaserv. Paremal pikk ja madal hoone.
works.de: In the photograph, slightly left of the center line, stands a soldier in Soviet Army uniform. In his right hand, held at shoulder height, he holds a pistol. His left hand hangs straight at his side. The figure is seen frontally, legs slightly apart. In the background grassland, behind which the edge of a forest. On the right a long, low building.

works.dm: kõrgus: 61.8 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 46.1 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 40.0 cm (vm); kõrgus: 56.7 cm (vm)
works.d: Helesinisel taustal viis noort naist, riietunud pruutkleitidesse, looride ja lillekimpudega. Taga seisab kolm, vasakul istub üks valgel toolil, kõige ees keskel istub üks naine maas. Kõik otsevaates, pilgud suunatud vaatajale. Bukettides roosad ja valged lilled. Toolil istujal üleni valge kimp. Foto raamitud valge reljeefse raamiga, millel kullaga toonitud profiil, keskel triip marmoreeringut
works.de: Against a light blue background five young women, dressed in bridal gowns, with veils and bouquets of flowers. Three stand behind, one sits on the left on a white chair, in the very front in the middle one woman sits on the ground. All in frontal view, gazes directed at the viewer. In the bouquets pink and white flowers. The one sitting on the chair has an all-white bouquet. The photograph is framed with a white relief frame, on which a gold-toned profile, in the middle a strip of marbling

works.d: Viis lõbutüdrukut, seljas kombineed, jalas sukad istuvad-lösutavad triibulisel kušetil. Toas kollakas triibuline tapeet, tagaseinal neli pilti. Akna ees pitskardin, vasakul toolil vana ventilaator. Ees keskel suur vana kohver, millel on avatud kommikarp ja tuhatoos konidega. Foto ümber roosa paspartuu, mille allosas on kuldse ja valgega kalligraafiliselt kirjutatud F.F.F.F. Raam plastikust, valge väikese kullatud ornamentikaga.
works.de: Five women of easy virtue, wearing combinations, in stockings, sitting-lounging on a striped chaise longue. In the room, a yellowish striped wallpaper, on the back wall four pictures. In front of the window a lace curtain, at left on a chair an old fan. In front in the middle a large old suitcase, on which there is an open box of sweets and an ashtray with cigarette butts. Around the photo a pink mount, at the bottom of which is written calligraphically in gold and white: F.F.F.F. The frame is plastic, white with small gilded ornamentation.

works.dm: kõrgus: 43.0 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 53.1 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 39.9 cm (vm); kõrgus: 30.0 cm (vm)
works.d: Sadamas pingil istub neli reisiootel naist, viies seisab paremal, käes värviline ajakiri, nõjatub metallist barjäärile. Naiste ümber maas erineva suurusega reisikotid. Taustal piletikassad, reklaamid. Rohekas marmorpaberist paspartuu. Hall, kitsa kuldse randiga plastikraam.
works.de: In the harbour four women await travel sitting on a bench, a fifth stands on the right, holding a colourful magazine, leaning against a metal barrier. Around the women on the ground travel bags of various sizes. In the background ticket booths, advertisements. Greenish marbled-paper mount. Grey plastic frame with a narrow gold rim.

works.dm: kõrgus: 49.0 cm (vm); laius: 39.5 cm (vm); sügavus: 1.8 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 52.6 cm (raami mõõt)
works.d: Kompositsioon viie naise ja kuue lapsega. Valges ruumis tumerohelisel diivanil istuvad: šotiruudulise vestiga poiss, tema kõrval sinistes teksades heleda pluusiga naine, kelle käsi toetub diivani käsitoele. Tema kõrval istuval naisel on süles väike kirjus kleidis tüdruk. Paremal istub kahe pika patsiga pidulikult riides tütarlaps. Diivani taga seisavad kolm naist - igal neist väike laps süles.
works.de: A composition with five women and six children. In a white room, sitting on a dark green sofa: a boy in a tartan waistcoat, beside him a woman in blue jeans and a light blouse, whose hand rests on the armrest of the sofa. The woman sitting beside her has on her lap a small girl in a patterned dress. On the right sits a girl with two long braids, dressed festively. Behind the sofa stand three women - each with a small child in her arms.

works.d: Viis rahvarõivais naist Tallinna lauluväljaku taustal. Pilti ääristab rahvariidevööd kujutav raamistik. Alaosas vööga ümbritsetud ristkülikus kiri "Tallinn". Pildi üldtonaalsus punakas-oranžikas, vöökiri punase, musta, kollasega. Üldmuljelt 1980ndate laulupeo plakateid meenutav.
works.de: Five women in folk costumes against the background of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds. The picture is bordered by a frame depicting a folk costume belt. In the lower part, within a rectangle surrounded by a belt, the inscription "Tallinn". The overall tonality of the picture is reddish-orange, the belt inscription in red, black, yellow. Generally reminiscent of song festival posters of the 1980s.

works.d: Heledas, vanaaegses interjööris istuvad viis lillelistes kleitides naist kohvilaua taga. Laud kaetud kuuele. Serviis peenemustriline, kohvikann valge. Laual jalaga vaagen, millel kook. Klaasvaasis tume roos. Foto imiteerib 1930ndate meeleolu. Paspartuu hallikast papist, ümarnurkse avaga. Mustal raamil kullatud siseserv, millel kärbsemusta jälgi.
works.de: Five women in floral dresses sit at a coffee table in a bright, old-fashioned interior. Table set for six. Finely patterned service, white coffee pot. On the table a footed dish with a cake. A dark rose in a glass vase. The photo imitates the mood of the 1930s. Mount of grayish cardboard, with a rounded-corner opening. Gilded inner edge on the black frame, with traces of fly dirt.

works.d: Viis hommikumantlis naist paneelmaja köögis. Paremal kandiline laud, millel teekann, mõned tassid, lilled jm. esemed. Aknast paistab hall paneelmaja. Kolmel naisel on käes tass, kaks on kummardunud lugemismaterjali kohale.
works.de: Five women in dressing gowns in the kitchen of a panel building. On the right a square table, on which a teapot, a few cups, flowers and other objects. Through the window a grey panel building can be seen. Three of the women hold a cup, two are bent over reading material.

works.dm: kõrgus: 31.2 cm; laius: 54.8 cm (vineeri mõõt); kõrgus: 53.3 cm (vineeri mõõt); laius: 42.4 cm
works.d: Hallikas-rohelisele vineertahvlile on rõhknaeltega kinnitatud värviline foto. Foto esiplaanil seisavad rivis viis noort naist, seljas sõduririietus, jalas tumedad nööritavad saapad. Kõik seisavad jalad harkis, käed seljal. Näod maskeerimisvärviga triibutatud. Tagaplaanil suur mustav ümar ava.
works.de: A coloured photograph is fastened with drawing pins to a greyish-green plywood panel. In the foreground of the photo five young women stand in a row, wearing soldier's clothing, dark laced boots on their feet. All stand with legs apart, hands behind their backs. Their faces are striped with camouflage paint. In the background a large blackening round opening.

works.d: Öises miljöös viis nahkriietes noort naist tumeda Fordi ees. Esiplaanil kükakil kaks tugevasti meigitud naist. Keskel auto ees seisab punakate juustega naine, käed värvlil. Tagapool, auto kapotil istuvad kaks naist, vasakpoolsel seljas lühike seelik. Teistel pikad mustad püskid jalas. Iga naise juurde kirjutatud hõbedase markeriga nimi.
works.de: In a night setting, five young women in leather clothing in front of a dark Ford. In the foreground two heavily made-up women crouch. In the middle, in front of the car, stands a woman with reddish hair, hands on the fender. Further back, sitting on the car's bonnet, two women, the one on the left wearing a short skirt. The others wear long black trousers. Each woman's name is written next to her in silver marker.

works.t: Minu miljoni dollariline nägu 1. Berit. Hele Peen Suvi
works.d: Naeratava noore naise portreefoto. Juuksed punakasblondid, kaela ümber tumeroheline sall, taust helesinine. Helikassetil naishääl leob mina-vormis horoskoobilaadset teksti.
works.de: Photographic portrait of a smiling young woman. Hair reddish blond, a dark green scarf around the neck, background light blue. On the audio cassette a woman's voice reads a horoscope-like text in the first person.

works.t: Kolm fotot seeriast "Narcissi" /Three photos from the series "Narcissi"

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 5.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 4.0 minut
works.d: Kirvemees ajab mööda korterit taga tõenäoliselt tema enda naist ja kahte last. Naine ja lapsed proovivad ennast igale poole ära peita -  küll diivani või voodi taha või kapi taha või teki alla, aga kirvemees leiab nad alati üles ja siis juhtub midagi. Ja iga kord peale seda midagi on kirvemees ikka rohkem ja rohkem verega koos. Naine ja kaks last aga näevad järjest paremad välja. Ja nii muudkui lõputult. (Marko Mäetamm)
works.de: An axe-man is chasing through the apartment, probably his own wife and two children. The woman and children try to hide themselves everywhere - behind the sofa or bed, or behind the cupboard, or under the blanket, but the axe-man always finds them and then something happens. And each time after that something, the axe-man is more and more covered in blood. But the woman and the two children look better and better. And so it goes on endlessly. (Marko Mäetamm)

works.dm: kõrgus: 30.1 cm (vm); laius: 60.5 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 70.5 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 27.3 cm (vm)
works.d: Tumedas riietuses noormehe poolfiguur kätega. Väga lühikesed tumedad juuksed, silmad ja kulmud. Sõrmede vahel keskel taim (adru).
works.de: Half-figure of a young man in dark clothing, with hands. Very short dark hair, eyes and eyebrows. A plant (seaweed) held between the fingers in the middle.

works.t: Johnny murtud ingliga (Johnny with Broken Angel)
works.dm: kõrgus: 34.7 cm (vm); laius: 70.5 cm; kõrgus: 80.5 cm; laius: 31.2 cm (vm)
works.d: Noormehe poolfiguur kätega. Pea poolpöördes paremale, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Seljas kirju pluus. Vasak käsi kõverdatud kurgu alla, paremas käes katkise peaga, tiibade ja valge kleidiga nukk, millel vööl valge pärlikee.
works.de: Half-figure of a young man with hands. Head turned half to the right, gaze directed at the viewer. Wearing a patterned blouse. Left hand bent up to under the chin, in the right hand a doll with a broken head, wings and a white dress, with a white pearl necklace at the waist.

works.d: Ülal keskel tekst "All Things Electric". Vahelduvad kaks tehismaastikku kujutavat motiivi ja kaks inglisekeelset tekstiplokki. Ülemisel pildil mees mustas ülikonnas, käes kohver ja kepp. Taevas planeeditaoline objekt. Mehe rinda ja objekti ühendab valge looklev joon. All vasakul draakoni  kujutis. Alumisel pildil tehismaastik, millest tõusevad kaks koonuse kujulist ja üks silinderjas moodustis. Neid ümbritseb puudesalu.  All paremal kõndiv inimfiguur.
works.de: At the top centre, the text "All Things Electric". Two motifs depicting artificial landscapes alternate with two blocks of English text. In the upper image, a man in a black suit, holding a suitcase and a cane. In the sky, a planet-like object. A white winding line connects the man's chest to the object. At the bottom left, a depiction of a dragon. In the lower image, an artificial landscape from which two cone-shaped and one cylindrical formation rise. They are surrounded by a grove of trees. At the bottom right, a walking human figure.

works.d: Interaktiivne video- ja heliinstallatsioon. Videoprojektsioon seinal, mille ees seisab mikrofon. Vaataja peab teose aktiveerimiseks mikrofoni laulma või muul moel häält tegema. Ekraanil liibuvas erksavärvilises spordirõivastuses  naine (Mare Tralla), kes reageerides vaataja häälele hakkab erineval moel laulma, liigutama ja hüppama. Taustaks Tallinna Lauluväljaku lava.
works.de: An interactive video and sound installation. A video projection on the wall, in front of which stands a microphone. To activate the work, the viewer must sing or otherwise make a sound into the microphone. On the screen, a woman (Mare Tralla) in tight brightly coloured sportswear, who, reacting to the viewer's voice, begins to sing, move, and jump in various ways. In the background, the stage of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds.

works.d: Kolmeosaline fotomontaaž moodustab ühtse tervikliku kujundi lamavast mehest pealtvaates. Mehe käed on tõstetud üles, küünarnukkidest kõverdatud. Pea pöördes vasaku õla suunas, silmad suletud. Kasutatud mosaiikseid, ristkülikulaadseid motiive. Kasutatud ka mängukaardimotiivi. Kujutis on must-valge. II ja III osa kergelt koloreeritud punakates-sinistes toonides. III osal sama motiiv, mis I osal, ent tunduvalt tihedam ja suurem.
works.de: A three-part photomontage forms a unified overall image of a reclining man seen from above. The man's arms are raised, bent at the elbows. The head turned towards the left shoulder, eyes closed. Mosaic-like, rectangular motifs are used. A playing-card motif is also used. The image is black-and-white. Parts II and III are lightly coloured in reddish-blue tones. Part III has the same motif as Part I, but considerably denser and larger.

works.d: Fotokollaaž tükkideks lõigatud ja veidi nihestatult kokku pandud ansambel Röövel Ööbiku liikmete (Tõnu Pedaru, Tarvo Hanno Varres, Raul Saaremets, Allan Hmelintski) fotoportreedest. Must-valgete fotoportreede fragmentide vahel trükitud kujutised linnumotiividega joonistustest, fotodest, mosaiikidest ja maalidest.
works.de: Photo collage of an ensemble cut into pieces and assembled somewhat displaced, of photo portraits of the members of the band Röövel Ööbik (Tõnu Pedaru, Tarvo Hanno Varres, Raul Saaremets, Allan Hmelintski). Between the fragments of black-and-white photo portraits printed images with bird motifs from drawings, photos, mosaics and paintings.

works.d: Kuuest paneelist koosnev fotokollaaž, mida eksponeeritakse tervikuna. Kujutis koosneb värvilistest ja must-valgetest fotofragmentidest, millel on kujutatud erinevaid naisenägusid (teiste seas Ly Unt, Ene-Liis Semper) näo- ja kehaosi, kumminuku detaile, rindade mulaaži, triipkoodi. All paremal servas ulatub kujutise serv (naise puus) pildiraamist väljapoole. Fotopaneeli keskosas ripub raamitud hologrammkujutis - heledapäise naise portree (Maria Avdjuško).
works.de: A photo collage consisting of six panels, exhibited as a whole. The image consists of colour and black-and-white photo fragments depicting various women's faces (among others Ly Unt, Ene-Liis Semper), face and body parts, details of a rubber doll, a breast mould, a barcode. In the lower right corner, the edge of the image (a woman's hip) extends beyond the picture frame. In the centre of the photo panel hangs a framed hologram image - a portrait of a fair-haired woman (Maria Avdjuško).

works.d: "Sugar Free" on autori hullumajakogemusel põhinev installatsioon, milles on kesksel kohal metallvardaga ühendatud poolringis liikuv antiikne puidust kapp. Seinal on 18 fotofragmendist koosnev kujutis hoonest. Selle kõrval fotod autorist, millede all sildid "After" ja "Before". Kapi sisemuses on metalltrossidega rippuma kinnitatud tükksuhkruga täidetud metallist linnupuur, mille kohal põleb kaabli otsas rippuv elektripirn. Kapist kõlab helitaust (esimeses versioonis autor lugemas põhiseaduse paragrahve, teises versioonis katkend Gibson Brothersi palast "Paranoia").
works.de: "Sugar Free" is an installation based on the author's experience of a madhouse, in which the central place is occupied by an antique wooden cabinet moving in a semicircle connected by a metal rod. On the wall is an 18-photo-fragment image of a building. Next to it are photos of the author, under which are signs "After" and "Before". Inside the cabinet, a metal birdcage filled with sugar cubes is suspended on metal cables, above which burns an electric light bulb hanging on a cable. A soundtrack sounds from the cabinet (in the first version the author reading paragraphs of the Constitution, in the second version an excerpt from the Gibson Brothers' song "Paranoia").

works.d: Videoinstallatsioon kahest kõrvuti asetsevast videoprojektsioonist, milledest ühel kujutatud alasti lamavat naist, kelle kehal lebavad kutsikad. Teisel videol kujutatud keskmise suurusega koera. Helitaustaks koera niutsumine.

works.de: A site-specific installation consisting of 18 transparent stickers depicting various actions and icons as black symbols. The stickers are intended to be applied to the glass interior and exterior doors of the KUMU building. The authors have specified which stickers are to be placed on which doors. The video is to be displayed according to the KUMU exhibition programme.

works.d: Tiibklaveri kujuline puidust objekt kolmel omavahel ristpuudega ühendatud jalal. Korpuse esikülg avatud, külgedel kolm ümmargust klaasiga kaetud vaateava. Korpuse sees valgustatud Kadrioru lossi mudel.
works.de: A wooden object shaped like a grand piano, on three legs joined to each other by cross-bars. The front of the body is open, on the sides three round glass-covered viewing openings. Inside the body an illuminated model of Kadriorg Palace.

works.t: Kuuldud jutt. Anne Eenpalu (Heard Story. Anne Eenpalu)
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 44.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 11.0 minut
works.d: Videoinstallatsioon "Kuuldud jutt" koosneb kaheksast videost, mis jooksevad kaheksal lameekraanil, ning baldahhiinvoodist. Voodit kattev madrats on kaetud lilla aluslinaga. Madratsil on kaheksa erivärvilist (sidrunikollane, soe kollane, oranž, punane, roheline, helesinine, tumesinine, lilla) puuvillase padjapüüriga patja ja neli erivärvilist (sidrunikollane,  oranž, roheline, helesinine) puuvillase tekikoti sees olevat tekki. Kaheksa patja on asetatud ringikujuliselt voodi keskele. Iga padja peale on asetatud paar kõrvaklappe, mis kannab vastava video numbrit, millega ta on ühendatud. Kaheksa lameekraani on asetatud baldahiinvoodi ülemiste talade külge. Videod mängivad ekraanidel katkematult
works.de: The video installation "Kuuldud jutt" consists of eight videos running on eight flat screens, and a canopy bed. The mattress covering the bed is covered with a purple bottom sheet. On the mattress there are eight cotton pillowcase-covered pillows of different colours (lemon yellow, warm yellow, orange, red, green, light blue, dark blue, purple) and four duvets of different colours (lemon yellow, orange, green, light blue) inside cotton duvet covers. The eight pillows are placed in a circular arrangement in the middle of the bed. On each pillow a pair of headphones is placed, bearing the number of the corresponding video to which it is connected. The eight flat screens are attached to the upper beams of the canopy bed. The videos play continuously on the screens

works.d: Interaktiivne installatsioon. Sinise, kollase ja roosa tekstiiliga kaetud hiiglaslik mobiiltelefon. Esiküljel arvutiekraan, millel kuvatud roosal taustal valge kiri "Astrid". Telefoni klahvid lamineeritud plastikuga. Telefoniga saab klahvidele vajutades helistada riigisisestele telefoninumbritele. Vastuvõtja hääl kostub sisseehitatud kõlaris. Valitud number kuvatakse arvutiekraanil.
works.de: Interactive installation. A giant mobile phone covered with blue, yellow and pink textile. On the front side a computer screen displaying white text "Astrid" on a pink background. The phone's keys are laminated with plastic. By pressing the keys one can call domestic telephone numbers with the phone. The receiver's voice can be heard through a built-in speaker. The dialled number is displayed on the computer screen.

The eight pillows are placed in a circular arrangement in the middle of the bed. On each pillow a pair of headphones is placed, bearing the number of the corresponding video to which it is connected. The eight flat screens are attached to the upper beams of the canopy bed. The videos play continuously on the screens.

Madratsil on kaheksa erivärvilist (sidrunikollane, soe kollane, oranž, punane, roheline, helesinine, tumesinine, lilla) puuvillase padjapüüriga patja ja neli erivärvilist (sidrunikollane, oranž, roheline, helesinine) puuvillase tekikoti sees olevat tekki. Kaheksa patja on asetatud ringikujuliselt voodi keskele. Iga padja peale on asetatud paar kõrvaklappe, mis kannab vastava video numbrit, millega ta on ühendatud. Kaheksa lameekraani on asetatud baldahiinvoodi ülemiste talade külge. Videod mängivad ekraanidel katkematult.
