works.d: Lahkumisstseen lõunamaise maastiku taustal. Keskel naisterahvas valgetes riietes, paljajalu, pruunikas sall õlgadel. Ta on sirutanud käed paremale, tütarlapse poole, kes tema põske silitab. Neiu piha ümbert hoiab kinni noormees, kes teise käega paremale, taamal seisvale purjekale osutab. Vasakult poolt tulevad joostes vanem mees ja naine. Vasakul taga paistab ka maja, paremal laht purjekaga ja teravatipulised mäed.
works.de: A farewell scene against the background of a southern landscape. In the middle a woman in white clothes, barefoot, a brownish shawl on her shoulders. She has stretched out her arms to the right, towards a girl, who is stroking her cheek. Around the girl's waist a young man is holding her, pointing with his other hand to the right, towards a sailboat standing further away. From the left an older man and a woman come running. In the background on the left a house is also visible, on the right a bay with a sailboat and sharp-peaked mountains.

works.t: Graafika, värviline. 18. saj. lõpp. Paul et Virginie (1. leht, Orja tänu)
works.dm: laius: 31.4 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 48.0 cm (leht); laius: 39.6 cm (leht); kõrgus: 40.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Lõunamaise maastiku taustal seisab keskel mees, tõstetud kepp paremas käes ja piip pahemas käes. Tema ees põlvitab neegritar. Tütarlaps ja noormees vaatavad teda hirmunud nägudega, tüdruk tõmbab poissi eemale. Vasakul ees suur puu, taga seisab neeger kepiga. Taamal asuvad palmide all hooned. Paremal, taga kaks neegrit, neist üks kaevab maad, teine kaevab vihke.
works.de: Against the background of a southern landscape, a man stands in the middle, a raised cane in his right hand and a pipe in his left hand. A negress kneels before him. A girl and a young man look at him with frightened faces, the girl pulling the boy away. On the left in front, a large tree, behind it stands a negro with a cane. Further back, buildings under palm trees. On the right, further back, two negroes, one of them digging the ground, the other digging with a hoe.

works.t: Graafika, värviline. 18. saj. lõpp. Paul et Virginie (2. leht, Domingue leiab Pauli ja Virginie)
works.dm: laius: 31.3 cm (plqqt); kõrgus: 40.1 cm (plaat); laius: 40.1 cm (leht); kõrgus: 47.6 cm (leht)
works.d: Lõunamaise kaljumaastiku taustal põlvitavad suure puu all sinises kleidis tütarlaps ja tema käest kinni hoidev poiss. Koera esikäpad on poisi põlvel ja ta püüab lakkuda poisi nägu. Paremalt tormab nende poole neeger, korv seljas ja pudel vööl. Tema kaabu ja kepp on keskplaanile maha langenud.
works.de: Against the background of a southern rocky landscape, under a large tree, a girl in a blue dress kneels together with a boy holding her hand. A dog's front paws rest on the boy's knee and it tries to lick the boy's face. From the right a negro rushes toward them, a basket on his back and a bottle at his belt. His hat and stick have fallen to the middle ground.

works.t: Graafika, värviline. Paul et Virginie (5. leht, Virginie surm)
works.dm: laius: 31.7 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 40.0 cm (plaat); laius: 41.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 48.4 cm (leht)
works.d: Madalal liivarannal lainetava mere foonil lamab noore uppunud neiu laip. Tema ees põlvitab hallipäine vanamees, hoides vasaku käega tütarlapse kätt ja sirutades parema käega esile avatud medaljoni miniatuurportreega. Vasakul seisab seljaga teose vaataja poole neeger, kes on ahastavalt tõstnud ristatud käed üle pea. Taamal paistab lainetes hukkunud purjeka mast. Liivale on uhutud vasakul asetsev tünn ja esiplaanil palk nööriga.(eesti)
works.de: On a low sandy beach, against the background of a rolling sea, lies the body of a young drowned girl. In front of her kneels a grey-haired old man, holding the girl's hand with his left hand and reaching out with his right hand an open locket with a miniature portrait. On the left stands, with his back to the viewer, a black man who has raised his crossed hands above his head in despair. In the distance the mast of a sailing ship wrecked in the waves is visible. Washed up on the sand are a barrel on the left and, in the foreground, a log with a rope.

works.t: Graafika, värviline. Paul et Virginie (6. leht, Palve)
works.dm: laius: 31.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 40.0 cm (plaat); laius: 41.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 48.0 cm (leht)
works.d: Esiplaanil põlvitavad troopiliste puude all kolm meest: vasakul poisiohtu nooruk kokkupandud kätega ja triibulistes pükstes, keskel hallipäine vanamees käed risti, kepp põlve najal, ja temast paremal neeger, korv seljas ja joogipudel vööl. Ees vasakul nuusib koer. Vasakul taga paistab paistab madala lahtise kellatorniga kirik, mille uks on avatud.
works.de: In the foreground, kneeling under tropical trees, three men: on the left a boy on the verge of manhood with clasped hands and striped trousers, in the middle a grey-haired old man with arms crossed, a cane resting on his knee, and to his right a black man with a basket on his back and a drink bottle at his belt. In front on the left, a dog is sniffing. In the background on the left, a church with a low open bell tower can be seen, its door open.

works.t: Graafika. Piiblistseen Ristija Johannesega. 2. mai, 1768.a. St. John Preaching in the Wilderness
works.dm: laius: 42.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 60.0 cm (leht); laius: 43.8 cm (leht); kõrgus: 57.5 cm (plaat)
works.d: Esiplaanil kaljuste kallastega veekogu. Vasakul, kalda ääres seisab jutlustades noor Ristija Johannes kaamelikarvast vöö niuete ümber, paremas käes rist, vasak tõstetud taeva poole. Tagaplaanil istuvad maas ja seisavad mehed ja naised pühakut kuulates. Ees, paremal seisavad samuti kuulajad ning murdunud puu.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with rocky shores. On the left, standing at the shore preaching, is young John the Baptist with a camel-hair belt around his loins, a cross in his right hand, his left raised towards the sky. In the background men and women sit on the ground and stand listening to the saint. In front, on the right, listeners are also standing along with a broken tree.

works.t: Graafika.  Piiblistseen Kristuse kiusatusse meelitamisest. Le Tentateur. 18. saj.
works.d: Piiblistseen Kristuse kiusatusse meelitamisest. Kujutatud on poolfiguuris Kristust veerandpöördega vasemale. Pikad lokkis juuksed, kähar habe, nimbus pea ümber, pahem käsi asetatud rinnale, vaatamas tõsisel pilgul kiusajat. Paremal ees noormees profiilis, palja kaela ja käsivartega, kes pakub Kristusele suurt kullakamakat, mida ta hoiab kahe käega(eesti)
works.de: A biblical scene of the temptation of Christ. Christ is depicted in half-figure, turned a quarter to the left. Long curly hair, a curly beard, a halo around his head, his left hand placed on his chest, looking at the tempter with a serious gaze. In the right foreground a young man in profile, with a bare neck and arms, offering Christ a large lump of gold, which he holds with both hands

works.dm: laius: 19.2 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 15.5 cm (plaat); laius: 27.4 cm (leht); kõrgus: 21.9 cm (leht)
works.d: Piiblistseen Kristuse kroonimisest kibuvitstest pärjaga. Võlvitud ruumis, pildi esiplaanil istub Kristus pikas rüüs, randmed nööriga kokku seotud. Paremal pool seisev noor paljaste jalgadega mees surub Kristusele pähe okaskrooni. Tema liigutus väljendab jõulisust ja ekspressiivsust nii, et Jeesus on surve all kaldunud paremale. Tagaplaanil seisavad turbaniga mees ja vana juut, kes esimesele midagi räägib käega Kristusele osutades. Ees maas asetsevad katki murtud kepi tükid. (eesti)
works.de: A biblical scene of the Crowning of Christ with a crown of thorns. In a vaulted room, in the foreground of the picture, Christ sits in a long robe, his wrists bound together with a rope. A young barefoot man standing on the right presses the crown of thorns onto Christ's head. His movement expresses force and expressiveness such that Jesus is leaning to the right under the pressure. In the background stand a man with a turban and an old Jew, who is saying something to the former, pointing at Christ with his hand. In front, on the ground, lie the broken pieces of a staff.

works.dm: laius: 19.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 22.0 cm (plaat); laius: 23.6 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.0 cm (leht)
works.d: Piiblistseen Iisaku ohverdamisest. Esiplaanil Jakob - pikas rüüs habemik, kes paremas käes hoiab nuga, vasakuga surub alla kivialtaril kõhuli lebava Iisaku pead. Vasakult juurde rutanud lokkis juustega noormees - ingel - on haaranud kinni Jakobi nuga hoidvast käest ja osutab teise käega oinale paremal. Taga suured puud.(eesti)
works.de: A biblical scene of the sacrifice of Isaac. In the foreground Jacob - a bearded man in a long robe, holding a knife in his right hand, pressing down with his left the head of Isaac, who lies face down on a stone altar. Rushing in from the left, a curly-haired young man - an angel - has grasped Jacob's hand holding the knife and points with his other hand to the ram on the right. Large trees in the background.

works.dm: laius: 19.7 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 16.7 cm (plaat); laius: 27.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 21.5 cm (leht)
works.d: Piiblistseen Neitsi Maarja Jeesuslapsega avara maastiku foonil. Maarja on poolfiguuris, keha poolpöördes paremal, nägu en face. Ilme rahulik, pilk langetatud, siledad juuksed lahku kammitud, rüü jätab kaela vabaks, üle pea on heidetud kerge loor. Jeesuslaps on ema käte vahel alasti, laps vaatab otse, pahema käega toetub ema rinnal, keha pöördes vasakule. (eesti)
works.de: A biblical scene of the Virgin Mary with the Christ Child against the background of an expansive landscape. Mary is shown as a half-figure, her body turned half-way to the right, her face en face. Her expression is calm, her gaze lowered, her smooth hair parted, her robe leaves the neck bare, a light veil thrown over her head. The Christ Child is naked in his mother's arms, the child looks straight ahead, leaning with his left hand on his mother's breast, his body turned to the left.

works.dm: laius: 19.0 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 21.0 cm (plaat); laius: 23.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.0 cm (leht)
works.d: Piiblistseen: Kristuse ristilt mahavõtmine. Maastiku foonil paikneva risti jalamil nutavad neli naist hoides Kristuse elutut keha. Laip on poollebavas asendis linal, kätes ja jalgades naelaaugud, küljes haav, pea ümber nimbus. Risti jalami juures istub Neitsi Maarja tumedas rüüs, toetades parema käega Kristuse ülakeha oma põlvede vastu. Keskel hoiab üks naine kahe käega Kristuse vasakut kätt ja suudleb seda. Paremal ees hoiab üks naine põlvedel Kristuse jalgu, ise nuttes rätikut silmadele surudes. Tema taga kaebleb kummargil vana naine, käed ristamisi. Grupi taga, keskel seisab mees käed laiali. Risti taga nutab veel üks naine. Vasakul taga paistab linn. Esiplaanil maas okaskroon ja jämedad
works.de: Biblical scene: the Descent of Christ from the Cross. At the foot of the cross, set against a landscape background, four women weep, holding Christ's lifeless body. The corpse is in a half-suspended position on a cloth, with nail wounds in the hands and feet, a wound in the side, a halo around the head. At the foot of the cross sits the Virgin Mary in a dark robe, supporting Christ's upper body against her knees with her right hand. In the middle one woman holds Christ's left hand with both hands and kisses it. In the foreground on the right one woman holds Christ's feet on her knees, weeping and pressing a cloth to her eyes. Behind her an old woman laments, bent over, hands crossed. Behind the group, in the middle, a man stands with arms spread. Behind the cross another woman weeps. In the background on the left a town can be seen. In the foreground on the ground a crown of thorns and thick

works.dm: laius: 15.8 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 20.8 cm (plaat); laius: 23.6 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.2 cm (leht)
works.d: Esiplaanil risti raskuse all mahavajunud Kristus, kes toetub kahe käega maapinnale ja tõstab okaskrooniga pead, näol valulik ilme. Tagant on juurde astunud mees, kes on haaranud kahe käega ristist, et seda kergitada. Vasakul pool astuv rooma sõjamees soomussärgis? ja kiivris, kepp käes, keelab teda. Teine kiivriga sõdur, paremal, hoiab vasaku käega Kristuse külge kinnitatud köit, mille otsa on ta parema käega tõstnud löögiks. Tagaplaanil mees turbaniga, teine redeliga, üks rooma sõdur ratsa, teine kilbi ja odaga. (eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, Christ sunk down under the weight of the cross, supporting himself on the ground with both hands and raising his head crowned with thorns, his face bearing a pained expression. A man has stepped up from behind and grasped the cross with both hands to lift it. On the left a Roman soldier stepping forward, in armor(?) and helmet, staff in hand, forbids him. Another helmeted soldier, on the right, holds with his left hand a rope attached to Christ, the end of which he has raised with his right hand for a blow. In the background a man with a turban, another with a ladder, one Roman soldier on horseback, another with a shield and spear.

works.dm: laius: 19.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 46.5 cm (plaat); laius: 21.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 27.3 cm (leht)
works.d: Piiblistseen: evangelist Johannesele toob kotkas sule kirjutamiseks. Johannes - ümara näoga, pikkade lokkis juustega noormees - on kujutatud poolfiguuris, käes raamat ja paberirull. Mees vaatab üles kotka poole. Vasakul asetsevas karikas tõstab uss pead.(eesti)
works.de: A biblical scene: an eagle brings a quill to the Evangelist John for writing. John - a round-faced young man with long curly hair - is depicted in half-figure, holding a book and a scroll. The man looks up towards the eagle. In the cup placed on the left, a snake raises its head.

works.dm: laius: 14.8 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 20.8 cm (plaat); laius: 23.8 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.2 cm (leht)
works.d: Pildi keskel linaga kaetud laual hoiab Maarja alasti lapsukest padjal istumas. Laps vaatab rahulikult üles. Pika habemega uhkes mantlis ja triibulises baretis juudi preester toimetab ümberlõikamist. Vasakul Maarja taga seisab veel üks naisterahvas, pilk maha suunatud. Keskel, taga habemik mees - Joosep. Paremal pool hoiab veel üks habetuńud mees mantli hõlma.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle of the picture, on a table covered with a cloth, Mary holds the naked infant sitting on a cushion. The child looks calmly upward. A Jewish priest with a long beard, in a splendid coat and striped biretta, performs the circumcision. On the left, behind Mary, stands another woman, gaze directed downward. In the middle, behind, a bearded man - Joseph. On the right another bearded man holds the hem of the coat.

works.t: Graafika. Piiblistseen: Püha perekond. 18. saj. Sainte Famille
works.dm: laius: 19.6 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 15.0 cm (plaat); laius: 27.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 22.0 cm (leht)
works.d: Alasti Jeesuslaps lebab linaga kaetud asemel, ülakeha toetumas padjale. Ta sirutab käed emale vastu, kes temalt on tõstnud katte. Maarja vaatab hardunud ilmega lapsele, hoides mõlema käega katet. Vasakul taga seisab habemik Joosep nõjatudes kahe käega pikale kepile ja vaadates samuti last. Nii Maarja kui Joosepi pea ümber särab nimbus. Fooniks tume draperii.(eesti)
works.de: The naked Christ child lies on a bed covered with linen, his upper body resting on a pillow. He reaches out his arms toward his mother, who has lifted the cover from him. Mary looks at the child with a devout expression, holding the cover with both hands. On the left in the background stands the bearded Joseph, leaning with both hands on a long staff and likewise looking at the child. Both Mary's and Joseph's heads shine with a halo. The background is a dark drapery.

works.dm: laius: 19.4 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 18.2 cm (plaat); laius: 23.7 cm (leht); kõrgus: 26.2 cm (leht)
works.d: Keskel ees Maarja parempoolses profiilis, parem käsi sirutatud ette. Paremal istub padjal Jeesuslaps, põlvedel avatud raamat, parema käe näpp suus. Johannes poisikesena tagapool profiilis vaatab Jeesust, osutades näpuga lehele raamatust. Fooniks draperii.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle foreground, the Virgin Mary in right profile, her right hand outstretched forward. On the right, sitting on a cushion, the Christ Child, an open book on his knees, the finger of his right hand at his mouth. John as a boy behind, in profile, looking at Jesus, pointing with his finger at the page of the book. The background is a drapery.

works.dm: laius: 15.8 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 26.4 cm (leht); laius: 20.3 cm (leht); kõrgus: 21.8 cm (plaat)
works.d: Maastik suurtest looduslikest kivirahnudest, ümarkaarsete avadega, silindervõlvidega hoone varemetega. Vasakul ees kivirahnude hunnik. Esiplaanil istub maas kaabuga karjane, tema kõrval koer. Ees veel kaks lehma, paremal taga ka kaks lehma. Varemete ees söövad rohtu kolm lammast. Paremal horisondil mäetipp, sellest eespool metsaga künkad ja linnalaadne asula.(eesti)
works.de: A landscape of large natural boulders, with ruins of a building with round-arched openings and cylindrical vaults. On the left in front, a heap of boulders. In the foreground a shepherd with a hat sits on the ground, beside him a dog. In front two more cows, on the right further back also two cows. In front of the ruins three sheep graze on grass. On the right, on the horizon, a mountain peak, in front of it hills with forest and a town-like settlement.

works.t: Graafika. Romulist ja Remust imetav emahunt. 14-leheline sari Romuluse ja Remuse loost (Palazzo Magnani, Bolognas)
works.dm: laius: 43.8 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 45.4 cm (plaat); laius: 58.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 85.0 cm (leht)
works.d: Lehel kujutatakse baroksete arhitektooniliste detailidega piiratud skulptuure ja freskot, millel emahunt imetab Rooma linna asutajaid Romulust ja Remust. Vasakul asub atlant, kes kannab lae kandetala, teda piiravad neli putot. Freskost paremal kaks ülestikku paiknevat putot. Freskol on näha jõemaastik, esiplaanil emahunt ja korvis asetsevad poisikesed. Grupist vasakul ronk laiali tiibadega ja avatud nokaga. Vaatajapoolsel jõekaldal asub küngas üksiku puuga, teisel pool vett aga madal kallas üksikute puudega, tõttav noormees, taamal mäed. (eesti)
works.de: The sheet depicts sculptures bounded by baroque architectural details, and a fresco on which a she-wolf suckles Romulus and Remus, the founders of the city of Rome. On the left is an atlas figure carrying the ceiling's supporting beam, surrounded by four putti. To the right of the fresco two putti positioned one above the other. The fresco shows a river landscape, with the she-wolf and the boys lying in a basket in the foreground. To the left of the group a raven with spread wings and open beak. On the riverbank on the viewer's side is a hill with a solitary tree, while on the other side of the water a low bank with solitary trees, a hurrying young man, mountains in the distance.

works.dm: laius: 44.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 31.0 cm (plaat); laius: 57.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 42.0 cm (leht)
works.d: Lehel kujutatakse baroksete arhitektooniliste detailide vahele paigutatud freskot stseeniga kaigaste ja odadega relvitutele karjastele kallaletungivatest meestest. Vasakul ees veised, kitsed, lambad, keda karjatavad alasti habemik loomanahk õlgadel ja poisike. Paremalt ründab neid atleetliku kehaehitusega, kaikaga varustatud mees. Tema jalge ees lebab tapetuna kolmas karjus. Ründaja tagant tormavad välja veel neli odadega meest. Esiplaanil külili lükatud puust pütt.(eesti)
works.de: The sheet depicts a fresco placed among baroque architectural details, with a scene of men attacking unarmed shepherds with clubs and spears. On the left in the foreground, cattle, goats, sheep, herded by a naked bearded man with an animal hide on his shoulders and a boy. From the right, they are attacked by an athletically built man armed with a club. Before his feet lies a third shepherd, killed. From behind the attacker, four more men with spears are rushing out. In the foreground, a wooden barrel pushed on its side.

works.dm: laius: 14.3 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 84.0 cm (leht); laius: 57.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 44.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Lehel kujutatud freskot piiravad arhitektoonilised kaunistused ja skulptuurid. Vasakul pool kaks ülestikku paiknevat putot, paremal kannab laetalakonsooli atlant nelja puto vahel. Freskol kujutatakse stseeni troonil istuva kuningaga, kelle ette sõdurid toovad võidetud, talle püstipäi otsavaatava ja selja taha köidetud kätega vastase. Taamal hoone, mille ümarkaarsetes niššides paiknevad skulptuurid.(eesti)
works.de: The fresco depicted on the sheet is bordered by architectural decorations and sculptures. On the left two putti placed one above the other, on the right an atlas figure carries a ceiling-beam console between four putti. The fresco depicts a scene with a king sitting on a throne, before whom soldiers bring a defeated adversary who looks straight ahead with head held high and hands bound behind his back. In the background a building, in whose round-arched niches sculptures are placed.

works.dm: laius: 43.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 85.0 cm (leht); laius: 57.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 43.7 cm (plaat)
works.d: Lehel kujutatud freskot piiravad arhitektoonilised baroksed kaunistused ja skulptuurid. Vasakul pool atlant kahe väikese fauniga, kes hoiavad küllusesarvi ja kahe putoga. Paremal ülestikku kaks putot. Freskol kujutatud vägivaldset stseeni. Paremal esiplaanil kolm suletuttidega kiivrites sõdurit ründamas raudrüüs habemega meest, kelle habemest üks sõjamees on kinni haaranud. Teine sõdur on klammerdunud mehe juustesse ja ta hoiab käes lühikest mõõka, kolmas torkab habemikku odaga. Rünnatava jalge ees maas lamab juba üks elutu vanamees. Taamal marsivad sõdurid lippude ja odadega. Vasakul ees kolm sõdurit relvadega.(eesti)
works.de: The fresco depicted on the sheet is bordered by architectural baroque decorations and sculptures. On the left an atlas figure with two small fauns holding cornucopias, and with two putti. On the right two putti, one above the other. The fresco depicts a violent scene. In the right foreground three soldiers in plumed helmets are attacking a bearded man in armour, whose beard one of the warriors has grabbed. A second soldier has clutched the man's hair and holds a short sword in his hand, a third pierces the bearded man with a spear. At the feet of the man being attacked already lies a lifeless old man on the ground. In the background soldiers march with flags and spears. On the left in front, three soldiers with weapons.

works.dm: laius: 52.0 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 42.7 cm (leht); laius: 57.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 29.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Ülevalt ja alt arhitektooniliste kaunistustega piiraval freskol kujutatakse mägismaale ehitatud renessanss-stiili kuuluvat hoonet. Ehitise sammastega flankeeritud peaportaali juurde viib kõrge ülespoole ahenev trepp. Pildi esiplaani paremal küljel on näha kaks noormeest hoone poole siirdumas. Vasakul taga tõttab maja poole ka mees, poisike käekõrval. Trepile on astumas kaks meest, ukselävel ka kaks meest.(eesti)
works.de: On a fresco bordered above and below by architectural ornamentation, a building in the Renaissance style, built in a mountainous area, is depicted. A high, upward-narrowing staircase leads to the main portal of the building, flanked by columns. On the right side of the foreground of the picture two young men can be seen heading towards the building. In the background on the left a man is also hurrying towards the house, a boy at his hand. Two men are stepping onto the staircase, and two men are also at the doorway.

works.t: Graafika. In Urbe Robur et Labor.
works.dm: laius: 43.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 85.5 cm (leht); laius: 57.5 cm (leht); kõrgus: 52.3 cm (plaat)
works.d: Arhitektooniliste detailide ja skulptuuridega piiratud freskot kujutava lehe vasakul küljel kannab tagantvaates atlant laetala konsooli. Tema kõrval, allpool kaks poisikest fauni, nende kohal kaks putot. Paremal taas atlant konsooli kandmas ümbritsetuna neljast putost. Freskol asetseb rooma sõdur väevõimuga peatatud härjapaariga rakendatud vankri ees, mida kaks meest ümber lükkavad. Esiplaanil olev mees haarab maast suurt kivi.(eesti)
works.de: On the left side of the sheet depicting a fresco bordered by architectural details and sculptures, an atlas figure, seen from behind, carries a console of a ceiling beam. Beside him, below, two boy fauns, above them two putti. On the right again an atlas figure carrying a console, surrounded by four putti. On the fresco a Roman soldier stands before a cart harnessed to a pair of oxen, forcibly halted, which two men are pushing around. In the foreground a man grabs a large stone from the ground.

works.dm: laius: 44.3 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 42.8 cm (leht); laius: 57.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 29.3 cm (plaat)
works.d: Vasakul küljel kaks skulptuurset putot. Freskol kujutatakse mütoloogilist stseeni sabiinitaride röövimisest. Kaarjas tagaseinas ümarad arkaadid. Ruumi taustal haaravad roomlased metsikult vastu rabelevaid naisi. Vasakul ees on atleetliku kehaehitusega roomlane õlale tõstnud naise. Ees keskel roomlane haarab paljastatud rindadega rabelevat naist. Paremal ees veab roomlane minema kisendavat naist. Paremal istub rida kinni seotud vanamehi. Paremal ees kõrgemal alusel sulega kiivriga roomlane vaatab võitluspaika üle. (eesti)
works.de: On the left side two sculptural putti. The fresco depicts the mythological scene of the Rape of the Sabine Women. In the curved back wall round arcades. In the background of the space the Romans seize wildly upon the struggling women. On the left in front an athletically built Roman has lifted a woman onto his shoulder. In the centre foreground a Roman grasps a struggling woman with bared breasts. On the right in front a Roman drags away a screaming woman. On the right sits a row of bound old men. On the right in front, on a higher pedestal, a Roman in a feathered helmet looks over the battle scene.

works.dm: laius: 44.3 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 84.0 cm (leht); laius: 57.2 cm (leht); kõrgus: 43.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Lehe pildipinnas kaks väikest kolmnurkset rebestatud auku.
works.de: In the image area of the sheet there are two small triangular torn holes.

works.dm: laius: 44.2 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 42.0 cm (leht); laius: 57.1 cm (leht); kõrgus: 32.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Lehel fresko, mida ümbritsevad arhitektoonilised kaunistused. Pilt kujutab ägedat võitlusstseeni - arvatavasti kättemaksma tulnud sabiinide kallaletungi roomlastele. Vasakul ees on habemik mees surunud vastase selili ja tõstab pistoda tema tapmiseks. Esiplaanil blond naine, väike laps käevarrel, püüdes takistada raudrüüs ja kilbiga meest, kes tahab mõõgaga tappa mahalangenud atleetlikku meest. Esiplaanil maas kehast eraldatud mehepea, kilp, oda ja mõõgad.(eesti)
works.de: On the sheet a fresco, surrounded by architectural ornamentation. The picture depicts a fierce battle scene - presumably the attack of the Sabines, who have come to take revenge, upon the Romans. On the left in front, a bearded man has pinned his opponent on his back and raises a dagger to kill him. In the foreground a blonde woman, a small child on her arm, trying to stop an armoured man with a shield who wants to kill with a sword a fallen athletic man. In the foreground on the ground, a man's head separated from the body, a shield, a spear, and swords.

works.dm: laius: 45.0 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 84.0 cm (leht); laius: 56.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 41.5 cm (plaat)
works.d: Arhitektooniliste detailide ja skulptuuridega piiratud freskot kujutava lehe vasakul küljel kaks ülestikku paiknevat putot. Paremal karüatiid, pats pea ümber, kandmas talastikku ja konsooli. Karüatiidi ümbritsevad neli putot. Freskol kujutatakse nelinurkse altari ees, mille peale on süüdatud lõke, põlvili olevat sõdurit, kes pea maas, toetab üht kätt maha. Paremal seisev mees torkab talle odaga kaela. Teine mees surub teda alla ja tõstab löögiks pistoda. Vasakul põlvitab altari ees kiivris ja toogas sõdur, seisavad kaks relvadega meest. Altarist paremal seisavad liktorid vitsakimpudega. Taga paistavad linnamüürid.(eesti)
works.de: On the left side of the sheet, depicting a fresco bounded by architectural details and sculptures, are two putti positioned one above the other. On the right, a caryatid, with braided hair around the head, supporting an entablature and a console. The caryatid is surrounded by four putti. The fresco depicts a kneeling soldier in front of a square altar, on which a fire has been lit, his head down, supporting himself on the ground with one hand. A man standing on the right is stabbing him in the neck with a spear. Another man is pressing him down and raising a dagger to strike. On the left, a soldier in a helmet and toga kneels before the altar; two armed men are standing. To the right of the altar stand lictors with bundles of rods (fasces). City walls are visible in the background.

works.dm: laius: 44.2 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 42.0 cm (leht); laius: 57.3 cm (leht); kõrgus: 33.5 cm (plaat)
works.d: Arhitektooniliste baroksete kaunististe keskel, kahest küljest putodega ümbritsetud lehe keskele on maalitud suur, nelinurkne, kahe poolega ja väikeste ruutudega aken. Aknast avaneb vaade äikesepilvega taevalaotusele. Akna all lamavad elutud inimesed ja loomad.(eesti)
works.de: In the center of architectural baroque ornaments, surrounded on both sides by putti, a large rectangular two-part window with small panes is painted in the middle of the sheet. Through the window a view opens onto a sky with a thundercloud. Beneath the window lie lifeless people and animals.

works.dm: laius: 44.3 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 85.0 cm (leht); laius: 58.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 45.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Leht kujutab lõiku barokse palee seinapinnast rohkete arhitektooniliste detailidega. Vasakul nelinurkne kahe poolega väikeste ruutudega aken. Paremal tagantvaates atlant toetab kandetala konsooli ja on ümbritsetud kahest noorest faunist ja kahest putost. Akna ja skulptuuride vahel fresko, mille esiplaanil grupp mehi - esimene noormees puhub pasunat, talle järgneb habemik ja veel grupp mehi. Tagaplaanil sammaste ees altar, millele on süüdatud tuli ja mida ümbritsevad mehed. Taamal paistab vaade maastikule. (eesti)
works.de: The sheet depicts a section of the wall surface of a baroque palace with numerous architectural details. On the left a rectangular two-part window with small panes. On the right, viewed from behind, an atlas supports the console of a supporting beam and is surrounded by two young fauns and two putti. Between the window and the sculptures a fresco, in the foreground of which a group of men - the first young man blowing a horn, followed by a bearded man and another group of men. In the background, in front of columns, an altar with a lit fire, surrounded by men. In the distance a view of a landscape opens up.

works.dm: laius: 44.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 85.0 cm (leht); laius: 57.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 44.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Leht kujutab lõiku barokse palee seinapinnast rohkete arhitektooniliste detailidega. Kahe nelinurkse väikeste ruutudega akna vahel fresko, mille keskseks figuuriks väepealik. Mees kannab kiivrit, käes oda ja toogat õlgadel. Vasakul, tema ees sammuvad liktorid vitsakimbud kirvestega õlal. Väepealikust paremal piikidega sõdurid. Taamal paistavad vana kindluse hooned.(eesti)
works.de: The sheet depicts a section of a baroque palace wall surface with numerous architectural details. Between two rectangular windows with small panes, a fresco with a military commander as the central figure. The man wears a helmet, holds a spear, and has a toga over his shoulders. On the left, in front of him, lictors march with bundles of rods and axes on their shoulders. To the right of the commander, soldiers with pikes. In the background, the buildings of an old fortress can be seen.

works.dm: laius: 44.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 37.5 cm (leht); laius: 57.6 cm (leht); kõrgus: 32.0 cm (plaat)
works.d: Leht kujutab lõiku barokse palee seinapinnast rohkete arhitektooniliste detailidega. Ülal, konsoolide karniisi all maskide rida. Vasakul kaks ülestikku asetsevat putot. Paremal nelinurkne väikeste ruutudega aken. Skulptuuridest grupi ja akna vahel fresko, mis kujutab õhus hõljuvat raudrüüs kangelast, kes osutab näpuga üles. Tema ees põlvitab vanamees, käed laiali. Vanamehe figuurist paremal samba alus.(eesti)
works.de: The sheet depicts a section of a baroque palace wall surface with abundant architectural details. Above, under the cornice of the consoles, a row of masks. On the left two putti placed one above the other. On the right a rectangular window with small panes. Between the group of sculptures and the window a fresco depicting a hero in armour hovering in the air, pointing upward with his finger. Before him an old man kneels, arms spread wide. To the right of the old man's figure the base of a column.

works.d: Esiplaanil Pärnu jõgi. Tagaplaanil Sindi pais, vabriku hooned ja korstnad. Taevas 2/3 pildi pinnast.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground the Pärnu river. In the background the Sindi dam, factory buildings and chimneys. The sky takes up 2/3 of the picture surface.

works.t: Graafika. Friedrich Wilhelm III, König von Preussen, am Sterbebette Seiner Gemahlin der Königin Louise zu Hohenzieritz im Herzogsthum Mecklenburg-Strelitz, am 19ten July 1810.. 1811.a.
works.dm: laius: 42.3 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 57.5 cm (plaat); laius: 47.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 58.5 cm (leht)
works.d: Graafiline leht ajaloolise stseeniga: Preisi kuninganna Luise surivoodil. Pildi keskmes lamab ampiirstiili kuuluvas voodis kuninganna, peas valge pitstanu. Peatsis põlvitavad surija kaks poega. Luise vaatab ainiti kroonprintsi. Voodi ees toolil istub kuninganna abikaasa, kes hoiab tema kätt oma mõlema käe vahel. Voodi peatsi taga seisavad kaks kurba daami ja vanem mees. Jalutsis seisab kõrge aumärgiga? riigimees ja seljaga vaataja poole veel üks mees, kellel on kõrge torukübar kaenlas. Vasakul ees laud, millel narmastega lina, kaks lillepotti, üks neist hortensiaga. Seinal kaks maastikumaali. (eesti)
works.de: A print with a historical scene: the Prussian Queen Luise on her deathbed. In the centre of the picture, the queen lies in an Empire-style bed, wearing a white lace cap. At the head of the bed, the dying woman's two sons kneel. Luise gazes fixedly at the crown prince. In front of the bed, on a chair, sits the queen's husband, holding her hand between both of his. Behind the head of the bed stand two sorrowful ladies and an older man. At the foot of the bed stands a statesman with a high decoration(?), and, with his back to the viewer, another man with a tall top hat under his arm. On the left in front, a table with a fringed cloth, two flowerpots, one of them with a hydrangea. On the wall, two landscape paintings.

works.dm: kõrgus: 25.7 cm (plaat); laius: 53.0 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 44.0 cm (leht); laius: 60.3 cm (leht)
works.d: Graafiline leht Milaano Santa Maria delle Grazie kloostris asetseva tuntud fresko Püha õhtusöömaaeg (1495-97) põhjal. Suures hämaras ruumis on heleda linaga kaetud pikk laud, mille taha on istunud Jeesus koos oma kaheteistkümne jüngriga. Keskel, teistest veidi eraldi istub Jeesus mõlemad käed välja sirutatud. Tema mõlemil käel istuvad jüngrid sümmeetriliselt gruppeerituna kolmemehelistesse rühmadesse, nad on omavahel ühendatud pooside ja diskussiooniga. Kõik vestlevad ägedalt, ainult Jeesus on rahulik. Tema vasakul käel asuv Juudas Iskariot hoiab käes hõbeseeklitega koti suud. Laual on leivakesed ja veiniklaasid. Tagaseinas kolm ava, millest avaneb maastikuvaade. (eesti)
works.de: Print based on the well-known fresco The Last Supper (1495-97) located in the monastery of Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan. In a large dim room stands a long table covered with a light-coloured cloth, behind which sit Jesus and his twelve disciples. In the middle, seated slightly apart from the others, is Jesus with both hands outstretched. The disciples on either side of him are seated symmetrically grouped into groups of three, connected to one another by their poses and discussion. All are conversing heatedly, only Jesus is calm. Judas Iscariot, seated on his left, holds the mouth of a bag of silver shekels in his hand. On the table are small loaves of bread and wine glasses. In the back wall three openings, through which a landscape view opens.

works.t: Graafika. Zwei Nymphen im Bade von einem Satyr überrascht. 1836.a.
works.dm: laius: 22.2 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 31.4 cm (plaat); laius: 34.2 cm (leht); kõrgus: 54.4 cm (leht)
works.d: Graafiline leht metsast lookleva ojaga, mis esiplaanil laieneb tiigiks. Pildi keskel on tiigikaldal lahtiriietunult kaks naist suplema minemas. Heledapäine naine, kelle juuksed on pärlitega läbipõimitud, katab rinda looriga, istudes parem jalg vees, teine toetub kaldal asuvale murule ja vaatab hirmunult paremale. Tumedapäine naine kannab keerulist soengut, kummardub kaaslase poole ja vaatab samuti hirmunult paremale. Ta seisab vees ja toetab pahema põlvega kaldal asuvale kivile. Paremalt, metsast tuleb välja sokujalgne sarvedega satüür, pilk suplejail.(eesti)
works.de: A print depicting a forest with a meandering stream, which widens into a pond in the foreground. In the middle of the picture, on the bank of the pond, two undressed women are about to go bathing. The fair-haired woman, whose hair is interwoven with pearls, covers her breast with a veil, sitting with her right leg in the water, while the other leans on the grass by the bank and looks fearfully to the right. The dark-haired woman wears an elaborate hairstyle, bends towards her companion and also looks fearfully to the right. She stands in the water and rests her left knee on a stone on the bank. From the right, out of the forest, comes a satyr with goat legs and horns, his gaze on the bathers.

works.d: Lehe vasakul küljel paigad.
works.de: Patches on the left side of the sheet.

works.d: Graafiline leht allegoorilise stseeniga. Pilvedel istub suurem grupp naisi, igaühel käes embleem, mis iseloomustab üht teadus- või kunstiala. Keskel asuvad allegooriad: skulptuur vasara ja kujuga vapil, maalikunst pintslikimbuga, geomeetria sirkli, kolmnurga ja lineaaliga, muusika kandlega jne. Kõige kõrgemal seisab säravas valguses looriga kaetud naisfiguur, kellelt kroonitud noormees üritab loori ära rebida. Ülal, taga paistab joonia sammastega ümar ehitus. Vasakul ees pilvede all seisab grupp mehi, kes vaatavad üles ja pakuvad kandikul viirukinõud.(eesti)
works.de: A print with an allegorical scene. On the clouds sits a large group of women, each holding an emblem characterising a field of science or art. In the centre are the allegories: Sculpture with a hammer and a figure on a coat of arms, Painting with a bundle of brushes, Geometry with a compass, a triangle and a ruler, Music with a kantele, etc. Highest of all stands, in bright light, a female figure covered with a veil, from whom a crowned young man tries to tear away the veil. Above, in the background, a round building with Ionic columns can be seen. On the left in front, beneath the clouds, stands a group of men who look up and offer a censer with incense on a tray.

works.de: A gloomy interior, in which sits a grey-haired, bearded old man in shabby clothes. A young girl with bare feet, in light-coloured clothes, has come up to him and embraces the man. The old man stretches his arms out to her. In the background a fireplace with a dying fire. In the foreground, on a stone-paved floor, a basket and a jug.

Tagapool sõidab teise delfiini seljas püsti olles puto, kellel rakmed on paremas, kõrkjad vasakus käes. Nümfi seljataga mängib üks puto kalaga.(eesti)
works.de: On an oval picture surface a nude nymph is depicted riding on a dolphin's back at sea. On the nymph's head is a wreath, with her right hand she holds a light shawl on her shoulder, with her left the harness for guiding the dolphin. Behind her a putto rides standing on the back of another dolphin, holding the harness in his right hand, reeds in his left. Behind the nymph's back a putto plays with a fish.

works.d: Noore mehe rinnaportree. Keha otsevaates, nägu veerandpöördes paremale. Noormees on pikemate juuste, bakenbardide, kitsa kühmuga nina ja väikeste vurrudega. Ta kannab suurte kuldnarmastega pagunitega mundrit, mille tikitud kõrge krae alt paistab tume rätik. Kaelas paelte otsas kaks ordenit, neist üks on Püha Georgi rist. Neist vasakul üleni vääriskividega kaetud orden. Paremal pool rinnas medalid: esimene за въру і въркость, teine за службу и храбростъ.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man. Body in frontal view, face in three-quarter turn to the right. The young man has longer hair, sideburns, a nose with a narrow hump, and a small moustache. He wears a uniform with large gold-fringed epaulettes, from under whose embroidered high collar a dark scarf is visible. On the neck, on ribbons, two orders, one of which is the Cross of St. George. To their left an order entirely covered with precious stones. On the right side of the chest medals: the first за въру і въркость, the second за службу и храбростъ.

works.d: Tallinna vaade Väikese Rannavärava poolt. Esiplaanil kinnikasvanud vallikraavi säng, millest viib üle kivist sillake Väikese Rannavärava poole. Taamal Tallinna katuste ja tornide siluetid, paremal taga Oleviste kiriku torn. Olevistest paremal Paks Margareta, selle ees 17. sajandist pärinev bastion.(eesti)
works.de: A view of Tallinn from the side of the Väike Rannavärav (Small Beach Gate). In the foreground the bed of an overgrown moat, across which a small stone bridge leads towards the Väike Rannavärav. Beyond, the silhouettes of Tallinn's roofs and towers, on the right in the back the tower of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). To the right of Oleviste, Paks Margareeta (Fat Margaret), in front of it a bastion dating from the 17th century.

works.d: Tallinna vaade Nunnavärava poolt. Vasakul ees võsastunud rohumaa, paremalt keskele viib sild üle vallikraavi läbi väravate, mille juures paistab ka vahimajake. Vasakul taga linnamüüri ja raekoja tornid. Keskel taga kerkib Toompea nõlv ilma treppide ja teedeta. Ülal keskel klassitsistlik kohtuhoone, sellest paremal Toomkiriku tornikiiver. Esiplaanil linna viival teel liiguvad jalutajate grupid, kahehobusekaless sõitjatega eemaldub linnast.
works.de: A view of Tallinn from the side of Nunna Gate. On the left in front, overgrown grassland, from the right towards the centre a bridge leads over the moat through the gates, near which a guardhouse can also be seen. On the left in the back, the towers of the city wall and town hall. In the middle behind, the slope of Toompea rises without stairs or paths. Above in the middle, a classicist courthouse, to the right of it the spire of the Dome Church. In the foreground, groups of pedestrians moving along the road leading into the city, a two-horse carriage with passengers moving away from the city.

Puu küljes ripub punutud märss. Tagapool ümarkaarne värav, mille küljes ripub latern. Paremal suurelehelised taimed. (eesti)
works.de: A grey-bearded old man in a dark monk's robe, barefoot, wearing a gourd bottle on his belt. Before him, on a clay altar, a large Bible with pictures, a rosary, a human skull, an hourglass and a crucifix. A woven satchel hangs on a tree. Behind, a rounded-arch gate with a lantern hanging on it. On the right large-leaved plants.

works.d: Vaade Vaksali puiestee poolt Falgi teele. Esiplaanil silindriga härra koeraga, kaks rahvarõivas poisikest, naine kahe lapsega, mees vikatiga ja talumees heinakoormaga. Keskel madala müüriga piiratud tühi krunt. Vasakul taga muruplats ja Toompea nõlv, mille peal hooned ning Pikk Herman. Falgi tee puud on noored ja piiratud puust taraga. Kiek in de Kök paistab keskel. Paremal lage Rootsi kants puudega.(eesti)
works.de: A view from Vaksali Avenue towards Falgi Road. In the foreground a gentleman in a top hat with a dog, two boys in folk costume, a woman with two children, a man with a scythe and a peasant man with a load of hay. In the centre an empty plot bounded by a low wall. On the left behind a lawn and the slope of Toompea, on which buildings and Pikk Hermann stand. The trees of Falgi Road are young and enclosed by a wooden fence. Kiek in de Kök is visible in the centre. On the right an open Rootsi kants (Swedish Bastion) with trees.

Taamal raekoja peafassaad, mille ees asub triibuline vahiputka. Paremal madal poehoone ja sellest veidi tagapool vana vaekoda kõrge sadulkatusega ning teise korruse akendevahelisi pindu ilmestavate medaljonidega. Paremal taga paistab Niguliste kiriku barokne tornikiiver.(eesti)
works.de: The square is full of peasants' ladder wagons, each harnessed to a single horse. Around them, peasant men, women in folk costume and townspeople making purchases are busy. In the background the main façade of the town hall, in front of which stands a striped sentry box. On the right a low shop building and, somewhat further back, the old weigh house with a high saddle roof, its second-floor wall surfaces between the windows adorned with medallions. In the background on the right the baroque spire of St. Nicholas' Church is visible.

Vasakul suured vanad puud moodustamas alleed ja puust lahtise kolonaadiga katusealune, samasugune ka paremal taga. Lossi ümbritsevad samuti suured puud. Hoone fassaadi keskel paikneb polügonaalne veranda. (eesti)
works.de: A view of Kadriorg Palace from the rear, from above, from the slope of a hill. In the foreground bushes and young trees, a well-tended lawn with paths, bushes, and young trees stretching up to the palace. On the left large old trees form an avenue, and a roofed area with an open wooden colonnade, likewise on the right in the background. The palace is likewise surrounded by large trees. In the middle of the building's façade is a polygonal veranda.

Paremal ees ujub tünn, mille ümber lendlevad kajakad. Vasakul taga sadam laevade mastide rägastikuga. Keskel Paks Margareta, Suur Rannavärav, Oleviste kirik, nende ees järsult kerkiv Skoone bastion suurte puudega. Linnamüür tornidega jätkub kuni Nunneväravani. Üle müüri paistavad majade kõrged katused ja raekoja, Pühavaimu ja Niguliste tornid. Paremal kerkib järsk Toompea nõlv sellel asetsevate hoonete ja Toomkirikuga. works.de: View of the town of Tallinn from the sea. In the foreground on the left a two-masted sailing boat with lowered sails. In the middle foreground a rowing boat with four sailors in white blouses and an officer at the tiller. In the foreground on the right a barrel floats, around which gulls fly. On the left in the background a harbour with a thicket of ship masts. In the middle Paks Margareeta, the Great Coastal Gate, St. Olaf's Church, in front of them the steeply rising Skoone Bastion with large trees. The town wall with towers continues to the Nunna Gate. Above the wall the tall roofs of houses and the towers of the Town Hall, Church of the Holy Spirit and St. Nicholas's Church can be seen. On the right the steep slope of Toompea rises with the buildings on it and the Dome Church. In the foreground on the right a three-storey old battery building by the sea. In the middle a fortification extending into the sea with three h[arbours]

Esiplaanil murul grupp lapsi ja nende rahvarõivas hoidjad. Teerajal jalutavad linlased. Keskel kõrgel paekaldal kerkib valge tuletorn kahe arkaadkaarega fassaadil. Tuletorni ees paeseina äärel kaitsetõke. (eesti)
works.de: A view of the part of Kadriorg along the Lasnamäe escarpment. A park with a large lawn area with birches and several other deciduous trees. From the right a small footpath runs backward. In the foreground on the lawn, a group of children and their guardians in folk costume. Townspeople stroll on the path. In the centre, on a high limestone bank, a white lighthouse rises with two arcade arches on its façade. In front of the lighthouse, along the limestone wall, a protective barrier.

works.d: Vaade Kadrioru supelasutusele. Esiplaanil muruväljak looklevate jalgradade, põõsaste ja noorte puudega. Jalgradadel jalutavad daamid ja härrad lastega, näha on ka kaks koera. Tagaplaanil maantee, kus on liikumas kärumees, ratsanik ja kahehobusekaless. Vasakul supelsalong - pikk puuhoone sammastega fassaadi ja katuseakendega. Taamal paistab Tallinna laht. Paremal madal pikk puuhoone vannide jaoks. (eesti)
works.de: View of the Kadriorg bathing establishment. In the foreground a lawn with winding footpaths, bushes and young trees. Ladies and gentlemen with children walk along the paths, two dogs are also visible. In the background a road, along which a man with a handcart, a horseman and a two-horse carriage are moving. On the left the bathing salon - a long wooden building with a colonnaded façade and roof windows. In the distance the Bay of Tallinn is visible. On the right a low, long wooden building for baths.

works.d: Vaade Kadrioru lossile mere äärde viivalt alleelt. Keskelt tahapoole kulgeb suur jalgtee, millel mitmed jalutajate grupid: esiplaanil silindriga härra koeraga, daam lapsega, kolmeinimese grupp sh. üks ohvitser. Vasakul tee ääres kindlustatud nõlv muru ja hõreda puudesaluga, mille vahelt paistab lossi tiibhoone. Keskel nurgavaates lossi peafassaad palkoniga. Paremal tiibhoone vastas lustla ja eespool tee ääres kindlustatud kallakul lehtpuud. Hõre puutara piirab lossi territooriumit. (eesti)
works.de: View of Kadriorg Palace from the avenue leading to the sea. A large footpath runs from the centre towards the background, on which several groups of walkers: in the foreground a gentleman with a top hat and a dog, a lady with a child, a group of three people including one officer. On the left side of the path a fortified slope with grass and a sparse grove of trees, through which the palace's wing building can be seen. In the centre, in an angled view, the main facade of the palace with a balcony. On the right, opposite the wing building, a gazebo, and further along the path on a fortified slope deciduous trees. A sparse tree fence borders the palace grounds.

works.d: Vaade Kadrioru supelsalongile mere poolt. Ümara muruväljaku keskel kõrge, ümberringi köitega kinnitatud lipumast. Tipus lehvib terava otsaga pikk vimpel tekstiga, vasakul küljel Vene riigi lipp. Ümarat muruplatsi piirab kõnnitee, kus rohkesti jalutajaid: daame, härrasid, lapsi ja koeri. Inimesed istuvad ka kõnniteed piiravatel pinkidel. Pika salongihoone aiapoolsel lahtisel terrassil palju rahvast. Paremal taga paviljon, kus mängib orkester.(eesti)
works.de: View of the Kadriorg bathing salon from the sea side. In the middle of the round lawn, a tall flagmast secured with ropes all around. At the top flies a long pennant with a pointed end bearing text, on the left side the flag of the Russian state. The round lawn area is bordered by a footpath, where there are many strollers: ladies, gentlemen, children and dogs. People are also sitting on the benches bordering the footpath. On the open terrace facing the garden of the long salon building, there are many people. In the back on the right, a pavilion where an orchestra is playing.

works.d: Vaade rohelisele aasale Kadriorus. Esiplaanil muruväljak heinakuhjaga. Paremast nurgast vasakule kulgeb sõidutee ratsaniku ja koeraga. Vasakul puude vahel kahekorruseline ehisfassaadiga hoone. Keskel suur heinakuhjadega aas, mis sõidutee poolsest küljest on ääristatud põiklattidest piirdega. Teisel pool aasa kahekorruseline hoone kahe ühekorruselise tiivaga - lossivalitseja uus maja. Paremal kulgeb pildi sügavusse sillutamata tänav (Leineri tn), mida aasa poolt ääristavad noored puud, paremalt väikesed puumajad. (eesti)
works.de: View of a green meadow in Kadriorg. In the foreground a grassy field with a haystack. A road runs from the right corner to the left with a rider and a dog. On the left, among the trees, a two-storey building with a decorative façade. In the centre a large meadow with haystacks, bordered on the road side by a cross-bar fence. On the other side of the meadow a two-storey building with two single-storey wings - the new house of the castle keeper. On the right an unpaved street (Leineri tn) runs into the depth of the picture, bordered on the meadow side by young trees, and on the right by small wooden houses.

works.d: Vaade Tallinna nn. Tornide väljakule. Esiplaanil muruplats mängivate lastega. Paremalt tahapoole kulgeb sõidutee ja linnamüür viie torniga. Müüri ääres on kobaras väikesed juurdeehitused, nii, et ainult ümarad tornid esile pääsevad. Nende ees madal puittara. Parempoolse, esiplaanil asetseva torni ülemisel korrusel puust rinnatis, alumised kaks korrust on ehitatud ümber elukorteriteks. Pildi keskel Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: View of the so-called Square of Towers in Tallinn. In the foreground, a lawn with playing children. To the right and towards the back runs a roadway and the town wall with five towers. Along the wall there are clustered small annexes, so that only the round towers protrude. In front of them, a low wooden fence. On the upper floor of the right-hand tower, situated in the foreground, there is a wooden parapet, the lower two floors have been converted into residential apartments. In the centre of the picture, the tower of St Olaf's Church.

works.d: Vaade Tallinna end. keiser Nikolai-nimelise meestegümnaasiumi hoonele Suur-Kloostri tänaval Nunnevärava juures. Esiplaanil kivisillutisega ja kiviplaatidest kõnniteega tänav. Paremale poole sõidavad redelvankris mees ja naine. Tänaval seisavad grupiti vormiriietuses gümnasistid. Gümnaasiumi krunti eraldab tänavast kivist vahepostidega raudaed. Vasakul linnamüür kolme torni ja müüriäärsete hoonetega. Paremal kahekorruseline kivist klassitsistlik gümnaasiumihoone. Näha ka kooli kõrval asuva Issanda Muutmise kiriku torni.(eesti)
works.de: View of the building of the former Tallinn Emperor Nicholas Men's Gymnasium on Suur-Kloostri Street near the Nunna Gate. In the foreground a street with stone paving and a sidewalk of stone slabs. To the right a man and a woman are driving in a ladder-wagon. Groups of gymnasium students in uniform stand on the street. The gymnasium plot is separated from the street by a stone fence with stone posts. On the left the city wall with three towers and buildings along the wall. On the right a two-storey stone classicist gymnasium building. The tower of the Church of the Transfiguration of the Lord, located next to the school, is also visible.

works.d: Vaade Tallinnale mere poolt. Esiplaanil puust kahekordne sillaplatvorm. Vasakul ees kahemastiline purjepaat rehvitud purjedega, sillal neli meest. Paremal viib kaldale kitsas vaiadel sillake. Selle ees veel üks kahemastiline purjekas ja väike pärapaat. Taga keskel paistab Suur Rannavärav Paksu Margareeta torniga ja Skoone bastion paremal. Linnasiluetil domineerib Oleviste kiriku torn. (eesti)
works.de: View of Tallinn from the sea. In the foreground a wooden two-storey bridge platform. On the left in front a two-masted sailboat with reefed sails, four men on the bridge. On the right a narrow bridge on piles leads to the shore. In front of it another two-masted sailboat and a small rowing boat. Behind, in the middle, the Great Coastal Gate with the Fat Margaret tower and the Skåne bastion on the right can be seen. The town silhouette is dominated by the tower of St Olaf's Church.

Keskel viib sissesõidutee müüris paikneva väravani. Tee ääres vahtkonnahoone viie arkaadkaarega fassaadiga. Vasakul taga Nunnevärava tornid, kaks linnamüüri lõiku, mis ulatuvad Toompeani. Paremal taga Toompea nõlv, mille paremal küljel klassitsistlik kohtuhoone.(eesti)
works.de: View of the Nunna Gate and Toompea. In the foreground an elevation, the tunnel top of the bastion gate, on the stone edge of which a soldier sits, at right a gentleman in a top hat walks. In the middle, the entrance road leads to a gate set in the wall. Along the road, the guardhouse with a facade of five arcaded arches. In the background at left, the towers of the Nunna Gate, two sections of the town wall, which extend to Toompea. In the background at right, the slope of Toompea, on the right side of which is the classicist courthouse.

works.d: Vaade Keila joale ja Keila mõisa hoonetele 19. sajandil. Esiplaanil Keila jõe läänekallas üksikute puudega. Vasakul ees kaks härrasmeest. Keskel langeb jõevesi kosena paepangalt alla, näha üksikuid kaljurahne. Vasakul, idakaldal vesiveski kahe tugipiidaga. Idakaldal puude vahel kivist elamu, mille õue piirab kaaravaga kivimüür. Paremal taga ühekorruselised, väikeste akendega teenijate elamud. Kosest ülalpool madalas vees poiss kahe hobusega.(eesti)
works.de: View of the Keila waterfall and the buildings of Keila manor in the 19th century. In the foreground, the western bank of the Keila river with isolated trees. On the left in front, two gentlemen. In the middle, the river water falls as a waterfall from the limestone bank, isolated rock boulders visible. On the left, on the eastern bank, a water mill with two support posts. On the eastern bank, among the trees, a stone dwelling, whose yard is bordered by a stone wall with a gate arch. On the right in the back, single-storey servants' dwellings with small windows. Above the waterfall, in shallow water, a boy with two horses.

works.d: Vaade Pirita kloostri varemetele Kose poolt. Esiplaanil künklik maastik, mis laskub taha jõe poole. Vasakul ees kaks kõrget lehtpuud. Murul mängivad lapsed, kelle juures istub ema. Paremal pool ees seisab kaks meest. Paremal kõrgemal künkal asub balustraadiga rõdu, kust seltskond vaatleb maastikku. Taamal Pirita jõel purjekas ja sõudepaat. Üle jõe paistab järsk liivakivikallas. Kloostri varemed on ümbritsetud kalmistu madala müüriga. (eesti)
works.de: View of the ruins of Pirita Convent from the direction of Kose. In the foreground, a hilly landscape descending toward the river behind. On the left in front, two tall deciduous trees. Children play on the grass, with their mother sitting beside them. On the right in front, two men stand. On a higher hill on the right is a balustraded balcony, from which a company observes the landscape. In the distance, on the Pirita river, a sailing boat and a rowing boat. Across the river, a steep sandstone bank is visible. The convent ruins are surrounded by the low wall of a cemetery.

works.d: Vaade Pirita kloostri varemetele jõe linnapoolselt lõunakaldalt. Esiplaanil künklik karjamaa lammaste ja istuva karjasega. Vasakul paistab mererand. Üle jõe, pildi keskelt tahapoole kulgevast teest vasakul asub madal kivielamu pisikeste akende reaga ja mitu majapidamishoonet, mida piirab madal puutara. Teest paremal kloostri varemete ja kalmistu ala taluhoonete grupiga kloostri idaotsa juures. Kloostri kiriku müürid fassaadi kõrge viiluga kerkivad üle ümbritseva maastiku. Lääneviil gooti dekooriga on terve. (eesti)
works.de: View of the ruins of Pirita Convent from the southern, town-side bank of the river. In the foreground a hilly pasture with sheep and a sitting shepherd. On the left the seashore is visible. Across the river, to the left of the road running from the middle of the picture into the depth, is a low stone dwelling with a row of tiny windows and several farm buildings, enclosed by a low wooden fence. To the right of the road, near the eastern end of the convent, is the area of the convent ruins and cemetery with a group of farm buildings. The walls of the convent church, with the high gable of the façade, rise above the surrounding landscape. The western gable, with its Gothic decoration, is intact.

works.d: Vaade Keila-Joa lossile. Esiplaanil muru ja pargitee. Murul vasakul istub lapsehoidja lapsega, seisab abielupaar. Puu najal loeb noormees raamatut. Keskel Keila jõgi. Üle jõe kivist vesiveski tammiga. Selle taga veidi kõrgem kivihoone. Lossikabeli torn ulatub üle teiste hoonete. Vasakul taga lossi peahoone torniga, kus lehvib lipp. (eesti)
works.de: View of Keila-Joa manor house. In the foreground grass and a park path. On the grass on the left a nanny sits with a child, a married couple stands. A young man leans against a tree reading a book. In the middle the Keila River. Across the river a stone water mill with a dam. Behind it a slightly taller stone building. The tower of the manor chapel rises above the other buildings. In the background on the left the main manor building with a tower, on which a flag flies.

Kalda äärt mööda viib rööbastee ümber lahekääru üles Marienbergile. Ees keskel rannas pink ja paadivrakk, millel tagaosas suplejate riided. Vasakul taga künkal Marienbergi mõisa hooned. Enne Marienbergi viib pikk vaiadel supelsild supelmajani. Paremal taga Suhkrumäe järsk pank, mille ees rohumaa.(eesti)

Along the shore a rail track leads around the bay bend up to Marienberg. In front in the middle on the beach a bench and a wrecked boat, on which at the back the clothes of bathers. On the left at the back on a hillock the buildings of Marienberg manor. Before Marienberg a long bathing bridge on piles leads to the bathhouse. On the right at the back the steep bank of Suhkrumägi, in front of which meadow land.

Teisel pool jõge on üle puude lehestiku näha vabrikuhoonete katuseid. Paremal neljakorruseline katuseakende reaga ja kõrge nurgelise korstnaga vabriku peakorpus.(eesti)
works.de: Sindi cloth factory. View of the ensemble of factory buildings from the northern bank of the Pärnu River. In the foreground on the bank, overturned boats. On the left, a weir on the river. Below the weir, densely placed stakes with fish traps. On the other side of the river, the roofs of the factory buildings can be seen over the foliage of the trees. On the right, the main building of the factory, four storeys high, with a row of dormer windows and a tall angular chimney.

works.d: Tartu Ülikooli aula piduliku aktuse ajal. Saali põhjaseina, paigutatud kõnepuldi mõlemal küljel seisavad palmid. Kõnepuldis kõneleja, temast mõlemal pool kaks üliõpilast auvalves. Puldi vastas, näoga selle poole, istuvad kuulajad. Kümme toolirida, lisaks kohad poolkaares kahel pool kõnepulti. Ukse juures seisab kepiga pedell. Aula külgedel seisavad vormirõivastuses üliõpilased. Puldi kohal tsaar Nikolai I elusuurune barokses kuldraamis portree. Vasakul, ustega varustatud seinal, Aleksander I elusuurune portree. Joonia kapiteelidega sambad kannavad rõdu, mis on täis daame. Sammaste ja rõdu allääre külge on kinnitatud vanikud. (eesti)
works.de: During a festive ceremony in the assembly hall of the University of Tartu. On the north wall of the hall, palms are placed on both sides of the lectern. A speaker at the lectern, with two students standing guard of honour on either side of him. Facing the lectern, the audience is seated. Ten rows of chairs, plus seats arranged in a semicircle on both sides of the lectern. A beadle with a staff stands by the door. Uniformed students stand along the sides of the assembly hall. Above the lectern, a life-size portrait of Tsar Nicholas I in a baroque gilded frame. On the left, on a wall fitted with doors, a life-size portrait of Alexander I. Columns with Ionic capitals support a balcony full of ladies. Garlands are attached to the columns and to the lower edge of the balcony. (eesti)

Tänava mõlemal poolel kõrged laiade niššidega müürid. Vasakul majade rida, mille vastas ülikool oma kuue sambaga fassaadiga. Ülal kolmnurkses frontoonis Venemaa keiserlik sümbol kahepäine kotkas.(eesti)
works.de: A print with a view of Jaani Street and the main building of the University of Tartu. In the foreground, on a cobblestone-paved street, students in uniforms, gentlemen in top hats and ladies. High walls with wide niches on both sides of the street. On the left a row of houses, opposite which the university with its facade of six columns. Above, in the triangular pediment, the Russian imperial symbol, the double-headed eagle.

works.d: Graafiline leht vaatega Emajõele ja Kivisillale Tartus. Esiplaanil Emajõe vasak kallas kahe sõudepaadiga. Keset jõge ühemastiline rehvitud purjedega purjekas. Üle jõe kalda äärel puust tõke. Suurturu nurgal kolmekorruseline kivimaja, sellest vasakul madal klassitsistlik kaarakendega ehitis. Paremal Kivisild üle jõe. Kivisilda kannavad kaks poolümarat kvadraatsetest kividest tugisammast, nende vahel ülestõstetav osa kahe võidukaarelaadse kolme avaga väravehitisega. Keskel taga Suurturg ja raekoda. Paremal üle silla Jaani kiriku torn.(eesti)
works.de: Print with a view of the Emajõgi River and the Stone Bridge in Tartu. In the foreground, the left bank of the Emajõgi with two rowboats. In the middle of the river, a single-masted sailboat with reefed sails. On the far bank a wooden fence along the shore. On the corner of the Great Market a three-storey stone building, to its left a low Classicist building with arched windows. On the right, the Stone Bridge across the river. The Stone Bridge is carried by two semicircular piers made of square stones, between them a lifting section with a two-arch-like gate structure with three openings. In the middle, in the background, the Great Market and the town hall. On the right, across the bridge, the tower of St. John's Church.

Ees keskel jõel sõidab purjekas viie mehega. Vasakul kalda ääres veel paate. Parema kalda külgi katavad viinamäed. Küngastel lossivaremed. On the right bank a large two-storey convent building and behind it a church with a tower.

works.d: Piiblistseen: Jeruusalemma hävitamine. Vasakul ja keskel stseenid meeleheitel inimestega. Vasakul ees põgeneb mees rinda paljastades madudega kättemaksuvaimude eest. Keskel ees pika habemega vanamees, kolm naist sh. üks surnud naine. Vanamees hoiab mõõka käes, tema kõrval varandusehunnik. Paremal ees lahkuvad vagad ja õiglased palmiokstega ning lauldes, neid saadavad kolm eredat valgust heitva lambiga inglit. Paremalt tungivad mahalangenud sammaste vahelt sisse roomlased, kes haaravad naiste ja vara järele. Ratsahobusel istub Rooma keiser Titus, keda saadavad liktorid ja ümbritsevad Rooma võimu sümboliseerivad embleemid. Ülalt lendavad alla kättemaksuinglid põlevate mõõkadega. Kõrgel pilvede
works.de: Biblical scene: the destruction of Jerusalem. On the left and in the middle scenes with people in despair. In the foreground on the left a man flees baring his chest from spirits of vengeance with snakes. In the middle foreground an old man with a long beard, three women incl. one dead woman. The old man holds a sword in his hand, beside him a pile of treasure. In the foreground on the right the pious and the righteous depart with palm branches, singing, accompanied by three angels casting bright light with lamps. From the right, through fallen columns, the Romans force their way in, seizing the women and the property. On horseback sits the Roman emperor Titus, accompanied by lictors and surrounded by emblems symbolising Roman power. From above avenging angels fly down with burning swords. High among the clouds

works.d: Siseruumis mustrilise vaibaga kaetud laua ümber istuvad neli meest. Laual lebavad raamatud, paberid ja liivakell. Vasakul istub pikas tumedas mantlis Melanchton, avatud raamat põlvedel. Keskel laua taga istub Luther, barett peas, ühes käes hanesulg, teises avatud raamat. Lutheri selja taga seisab Bugenhagen nahkkraega mantlis, paremas käes väike raamat, vasakuga hoidmas Lutheri tooli leenist. Paremal, nägu profiilis, pika valge habemega ja valgete juustega Cruciger, käes sulg; tema ees laual paberileht.(eesti)
works.de: In an interior, around a table covered with a patterned cloth, four men are sitting. On the table lie books, papers and an hourglass. On the left sits Melanchton in a long dark coat, an open book on his knees. In the middle, behind the table, sits Luther, wearing a beret, in one hand a quill, in the other an open book. Behind Luther's back stands Bugenhagen in a coat with a leather collar, in his right hand a small book, with his left holding the back of Luther's chair. On the right, face in profile, with a long white beard and white hair, Cruciger, holding a quill; in front of him on the table a sheet of paper.

works.de: A group of armed Estonians has gathered under the trees, listening to the speech of a man standing on a higher platform, who is explaining something to them with a clenched fist. In the background on the left a stone manor house is visible.
